dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dar byung ste/rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib 'jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur 〉 dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1 28yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ha cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du brtan mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad gar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin— legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung 'i bod rig pa dpe na khang nas/sbyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i sbyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar med du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung 1

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'byug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad skar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di 'bas legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhung sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung lha'i bod rig pa dpe na khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad nos te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin dag ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam bto ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhugate/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las dar gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ga kho gnang na dpe rnying 'tshor ba/phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba6pa'i tshes la/

ba// sgrig gsal bshad/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 200ldanas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / g.yin yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la ra bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags zhan 6) (gnartong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) 'a) (ja) ste thun slong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho semadzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (ja spu (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags6) stergyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod na mas mchogo ldan/ khri chen dan zhe mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags rta)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags (tha)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tso drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags 9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags 6)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags 6)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i 5

las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags6)ste bstod tsho gos dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (5) (mi (tsha)ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (0ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos tshan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags rton)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi tshigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (kha)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma rtoge ste le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su lañja mong tsam byung yang da lta glog klad du la lha'i yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags(2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/6

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang /tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes lan brgyar zhu'o/ /ser ga khuganang gas dpe rnying 'chos bas phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags smyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'khrungs pa'i rgyud za hor gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zhing byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'brol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi cho me skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhengs/ chos gzhis mchode rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigs par 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras sbungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras pod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhu'o/ /ser ga khu gnang pas dpe lhang 'chos ba phyogs ga khang nas/10

dkar chagazur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar theg mchog bstan pa'i shing rta/ (1)nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rtogs brjod nyung ngu rnam gsal/ (181)rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa slob bshad bstan pa'i nyi 'od/ (266)rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo khyab bdag he ru ka ngur smrig gar gyi rnam par rol ba gdan gsum tshang ba'i sde dpon rje btsun bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa bdud rtsi'i za ma tog (435)dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa ma lus pa'i ngo bo khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dpyod ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/ (513)

// raṃ 4 dzo rtso glu sdu skre — — — pa'i shā nga0/ to ru — sta dzi ri —— ri la 49 — par ri 4 ci — da rngo sta rtoX/ rdzo —— / dz+ra /〉 〉/ ri rdo kwacho rte — —1 — shā tre spra rngo / mushā ༈ /shā ri snye nga 7 ga / ༈ byo nga shā rī/ba zu rta nga

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanano༅༅//zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar theg mchog bstan pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so/༄7//na maṇ+ḍa mas mā lu ya/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs rab 'byams zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro zhing sdud pa'i khyab bdag kun bzang he ru daX rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i zlos gar mkhan zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos kun ka dag dbyings nas rang sar grol ba dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa theg mchog bstan pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bka' drin mnyam med dpal ldan bla ma dam par phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi na zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo rang rig gdod ma'i rang zhal mngon gyur de srid 'bral ba med par brtse bas rjes su bzung du gsol/spros pa'i mtshan ma yongs dang nyer bral ngo bo chos sku'i mkha' klong las//rang bzhin lhun grub gsal 'grib med pa longs spyod rdzogs sku nyin mor byed//sku dang ye shes rang gdangs 'gags med sna tshogs sprul sku'i thar 'phrong can//rgyal kun spyi gzugs chos dbyings rang sar grol ba'i 2namagon des dge legs stsol//mdo rgyud gtsug lag dpal gyi 'byor ba la//mnga' sgyur mchog dman gdul bya ma lus par//chad med 'jug pa'i ches dkar 'phrin las rgyun//rab rgyas rdo rje 'dzin khyod phyag gi gnas//ngag dbang 'jam mgon grub pas thog mtha' bar//bkra shis rnam gsum 'khor lo'i mdzad bzang nor//kun nas yid dga'i 'dod pa 'jo ba'i gter//dam pa'i ngo mtshar rtogs brjod gleng

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyeba'i gzhi/ /rgya gar rigs 'dzin brgyad kyi yon tan cha/ /rab gang rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nus mthu ther/ /byin rlabs ga bur gzigs ma 'bum 'dzag pa/ /gdung mun sel la zla med zla ba'i mched/ /'khor 'das kun la ya nga bral ba'i rtsal/ /rdzogs chen 'dus ma byas par lhun grub pa/ shwakya seng ge gzugs gzhan yongs bsgyur ba'i/ /mngal skyes pad+mā ka ra byon tam ci/ /tha dad 'char sgo'i 'bum phrag chu nang du/ shar zla rang gi ngo bo mi gtong zhing / /'jig rten khams rdul grangs kyi dpogs min (2ba)pa/ /'dren pa'i khyad par dbye nus rnam mkhyen tsam/ /'on te shel dkar kha dog gcig pu la/ /brgya phrag tshon gyi mdangs 'od 'char ba ltar/ /gdul bya'i dbang por 'tsham pa sgyu ma'i gar/ /skye ba med las skye ba'i cho 'phrul shar/ /lnga rig shes bya'i thang phung lo ma'i khur/ /'thibs por lci yang mdo sgyu sems phyogs kyi/ /don bzang ro brgya'i 'bras bus yongs dud pa/ /bshes gnyen dpag bsamaljon pa'i khyad par chos/ /'gro kun dub pa'i smin legs 'byog zur gyis/ /gzhan phan thugs bskyed gzhen nu nyer khrid kyang / /mi dge'i nu 'bur reg byar rjes chags blo/ /bag yod rnam gsum khrims kyis ring du btang / /gsar rnying chos kyi bka' rnams gangs ljongs 'dir/ /sdug po lag na rdo rje mi yi gzugs/ /bsgyur ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pa'i tshad/ /chu gter gting bzhin bdag 'dras ga la rnyed/ /mkha' mtha' zad nas ldog min rang nus tsam/ /tshad du byed pa'i 'dab chags rjes 'gro bar/ /rang blos gang dpogs dad pa'i sor mo yis/ /rtogs brjod rgyud mangs las drangs glu dbyangs len/ /de yang thams cad mkhyen pa chos skyong bzang po'i gsung las/ gang gi gsung zer cha tsam gyisakyang seng ge 'phrog byed nor gyi gnyen sogs kyi/ /gzhung lugs kun da'i tshal rnams zum mdzad gser mngal can dang dpal mgrin la sogs pa/ /'jig rten 'di na che bar rab grags lha mchog kun gyis gang gi 'khas pad la/ /gus pas btud pa'i lha mi'i bla ma zas gtsang sras pos rtag tu dge legs mdzod/ /ces yul rnam pa la ched du brjod pa'i sgo nas shis pa brjod pa dang / 'jam dbyangs —2

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)sa paṇa gyi (3na〉sdob sbyor me tog chun po las/ gang gis srid dang rnam grol rnam gsum gyi/ /the tshom dra ba kun nas 'brel mdzad pa/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i zhabs la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zhes yul khyad par can la phyag bya ba/ mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā bas/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag gsungs dang ni/ /ting gi mtha' can legs sbyar lha yi skad/ /byings dang rnam 'gyur rkyen gyi rang bzhin du/ /gnas phyir 'phags yul mkhas rnams tshul 'dir rol/ /zhes brda sprod kyi brjod bya'i gtso bo dngos po nges par bstan pa lta bus mtshon te sngon byon gyi mkhas pa rnams bstan bcos kyi thog mar gsum pa'am gang rung re mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs te tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang nas gleng bar bya ba ni/ rig sngags 'chang ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba khyab bdag rdo rje sems dngos chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par thar pa (3ba)bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che las/ nga snying rje che bas zhing khams dag /nga sna tsho gos sprul pa ston na yang / khyud ma dag rnams la ci cha yod/ /nga bu med rnams la bur ston yang / /ma snying med ma la ci cha yod/ /mi dbul po dag la nor ston yang / khong mngon shes med la ci cha yod/ /thang skam bo dag la chur 'byin kyang / /mi mngon shes med la ci cha yod/ /mi nad kyis gdungs la sman ston yang / /nad sgrib pas g.yogs la ci cha yod/ /nga khrims ldan mkhan po'i skur ston kyang / /nga thugs rje chen por nga yis shes/ /nga gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍita/ khyud gang la gang phan ston gyur kyang / /mi mkhas par rlom la ci cha yod/ /ces pa ltar sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa rnams ni gdul bya'i mos pa sna tshogs pa'i dbang las/ mkhas pa/ grub pa/ brtul zhugs spyod pa/ sbas tshul can/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po/ rgyal phran/ blon po/ sna bo/ khyim bdag /bud med/ bya/ ri dwags/ gru zam/zas gos gnas mal sogs sprul pa sna tshogs bstan nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i tshad ni spyan dang mngon par shes pa mnga' ba ma gtogs tshur mthong byis pa'i blo can rnams kyis brjod pa'i yul —3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'amin na'ang / sku'i skyes rabs dang thugs rgyud gcig pas 'gro don mdzad tshul rags pa tsam rdo rje'i gsung dri ma med pa 'di lta ste/gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūm̐/ 'dir skyes rabs shig dgos gsungs pa la mgon po 'bri gung pa dang rgyal ba g.yung gi gsung las slob ma dad pa ches na slob dpon zog por gtong gsung ba bzhin/ thog med nas rnam smin gyi lus blangs pa la thug pa med mod/ de'i nang nas (4na〉ye lus chos ldan bar ma chad kyi skye ba blangs pa ni srid mtha' tsam/ ngan 'gror skyes pa'i rabs ni brjod kyang dgos rgyu chung / bla ma dang lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ste 'gro don nus pa ni kha yar blangs/ 'on kyang 'di nas 'dir skyes zhes pa'i skyes rabs ston mkhan ni ma mchis/ rang gis shes pa la ni mkhyen gnyis kyi spyan med pa'i steng nyams grib dang dad zas kyi sgrib pas mog mog por song bas shes par dka'/'on kyang skabs 'gar gsal snang tsam dang lung gi zin tshul tsam bye ma la mar nag gi dpe ltar dam tshig gtsang phyir zhu na/ de yang grang so gter ston rigs 'dzin stobs ldan dpa' bo'i gter byang las/ ku mā ra yi sprul pa zhig /dga' ba'i tshul ston bar chod sel/ /zhes chos bdag tu ngos 'dzin gnang ba dang / de dang mthun par rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi chos bdag lung bstan du/ dbang chen che mchog byin brlabs pa'i/ /byang sems 'gro 'dul mthu stobs bdag /rigs 'dzin ku mā'i yang sprul gyis/ /zab gnad gdams pa'i bka' babs thob/ /gang brtsams las sbyor myur rtags thon/ /zhes dang / 'di dang sngon tshe che mchog sprul/ /zhi dul sgo nas drag po sa khros nas ma rungs kun 'joms pa/ /mthu yis 'dzam gling dus gnas bde/ /zhes gsungs pas dus gsum mkhyen pa slob dpon chen po'i spyan star gnyags ban du ngos bzung zhing / de rjes go rim nges med 'gro don nus tsam du skyes pa ni/ la stod dam pa dmar por skyes/ yer pa nas chos rgyal srong btsan gyis sbas pa'i gter kha kha yar blangs pa'i gsal snang tsam byung / de rjes zur mo dge 'dun (4ba tsher bum du skyes pa zhig dran zhing da lta snga 'gyur gyi bstan 'dzin phal mo che'i thugs sras su 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan de ltar lags de nas —4

zur wo tham yo ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanabar skabs mal yer pa ba'i gtor gshom btsun mar skyes pa'i 'bags pa shor bas skye ba de'i 'og spos dang dbus su ri'i byi'u zhig tu skyes ba gsal por dran kyang ma dag pa'i skye ba brjod kyis ma lang / slar yab sras gnyis kas rjes su bzung ba'i bag chags kyis shad g.yu brag pa'i zhabs zin tsam du gang nas sangs rgyas 'bum zhes par skyes/ sgom sde'i khri dang phug ron gyi brgya dpon gyi khral 'jal tsam ma gtags bstan pa'i bya ba rlabs chen mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ de rjes sman lung pa'i sras su skyes/ khra tshang dgon pa'i nags khrod du bsdad pa gsal por dran/ bstan pa la phan thogasaji ltar byung ma shes 'di mtshams gsang phu gling stod du bla brang pa chos dpal bzang po zhes par gyur/kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po'i slob dpon byas pa chos skyong gi nying zhakhrul du bstan no/ / de nas stag mgo chos rje yon to dpal bar gyur/ rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pas rjes su bzung / rje btsun myong kha pa la bsnyen par rdzogs da lta de ga'i bag chags lags/ de rjes rgya ma gog ces par rgya ma khri dpon gyi rigs su gtogs tsam grub pa'i dbang phyug nor bu'i 'phreng ba ltar byon pa'i sras che 'og tu skyes/ ming dkon cog rin cen du grags/ zing pa stag mgo dang snang gsal sogs kyi gdan sa lo kha shas byas/ de nas 'brom chu ris kyi snod du zur gyi gdung las mi'i srid pa bzung ba'i gnas tshulu ni da lta'i 'di ga'o/ /rang don ma 'grub pa'i bstan pa la phan pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ (ldan po gongs 'dus kyi lung bstan bka' rgya las gsal lo/ /de nas gzhan rigs 'dzin gter ston mang po'i yon bdag dang las rgya dang / chibs pa sogs su skyes pa'i tshad mang po 'dug kyang gang gsal rnams bris pa lags pas rang bzhin gyi sgro skur gyi gnas su 'gyur bas gzhan la mi ston pa mkhyen mkhyen/ zhes rigs 'dzin gu gu yang wang gi rigs dpon rig sngags 'chang ba don grub bkra shis kyis lo mang por nan tan gyis phebs pa'i bka' ma chogs par bris pa lags so/ /zhes byung zhing spus srang lha rje blo bzang nor bus dri ba zhus—5

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyepar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus zhang blon sna chen por 'brungs shing chos rgyal sprul pa lha rje dge ba 'bum gyis ra sa la zhabs tog mdzad dus nged gdan sa ba sangs rgyas 'bum du gyur pas sngon gyi las 'phros mthun grogs byas sogs mang po zhig gsung ba'i 'go brtsams mur a khu dang dbon po chos brgyad byung ba'i rkyen byas thugs bsnyel ba'i tshul gyis da mi dran pa 'dug ces gsung /ma nyan nan gyis gsol bas khyed rang yang lha sa'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs dus las bskul bar yod pa 'dra zhig 'dug pa slar gsal po dran byung na rim gyis rgyu mtshan byed cing thengs shig yang bsam grub gling gi rten mkhar gyi rtsa bar bud med mche ba gtsigs pa ral pa sar nyil ba zhig gis gnyags ban gnyags ban khyod drang sman spyil chos rje/ lha rje blo bzang nor bu gsum skye ba snga ma spun yin pas da lam yang snying tig gi gdams pa sgo/da zer bas sgra lhang nge ba gsan tshul/ yang mi zhig gis khyod sgrol ma skyabs kyi skye ba yin zer ba de su yin dri ba mdzad par thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi (5bsnya gnas nga yin zer byung sogs kha yar gsungs pas zhang blon/ nye gnas sgrol ma ba gtsang du phebs tshe spun du thugs dran gsos pa'i lha rje zur bu che shākya 'byung gnas su zhabrungs pa zhal gyis 'ches na'ang 'dir mi gsal la zur mo dge 'dun 'bum lnga rting gnyis tsam byung 'dug pas shākya 'byung phyi ma'i lcam sring ma de yin par mchis sman lung pa'i rigs su 'khrungs pa ni nyang chos ldan mgon po yin nam snyam/ gzhan ma'i zhib cha ni rang nyid 'chi ba ma dran pa'i blo ngan gzhan 'gebs kyi rnam pas rje bla ma de yun ring por bzhugs pa gzhir bcas kyis slar zhu long yong ba'i phyi gshol gyis zhib par ma 'tshal/dgongs 'dus kyi lung bstan pa bka' rgyar gsal gsung ba ni/ de dus gnyags ston ye shes ku mā ra/ /las kyi grangs zad lha dang zhal mi gnyis/ /rje yi chab srid nga dang las kyis 'brel/ /ma 'ongs 'jug pa dus kyi mthar lhungs tshe/ khyod ni byang khams skyong ba'i rnal 'byor ba/ /mi yi seng ge shes rab stobs dang ldan/ /cha lugs ma nges cir yang ston byed cing / /bstan pa'i srol 'dzin rgyal —6

zur ོ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)gyi ming can zhig /gdug pa 'dul cing 'gro ba dpag med 'dren/ /de dang de tshul bstan pa'i mthar thug par/ /nges par bstan pa'i me ro yang yang slong / /de phyir bsam pa'i go cha brtan por bzung /zhes gsang mtshan pad+ma dbang rgyal du grags shing byang khams kyi mthar thug par mthu stobs kyi sgo nas bstan pa 'phel gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos rgyun chad 〉 nye ba mang po'ang gso ba mdzad/'phral thugs chung ba ltar la don 'khor 'das gang la'ang nyam nga med pa seng ge lta bu'i spyod pa dang thugs rab kyi rtsal sogs gang sa nas lung bstan shin tu (6na)'grig par snang ngo / /'gro la rjes brtse'i shar ri'i phrag pa nas/ /skyes rabs zla ba'i 'phreng ba mdzad med du/ /bstan 'gro'i kun+da ba 'ad pa'i grangs 'dzin na/ /smra bo thog mar spyan snga mngon shes sgrubs/ /'on te zhing 'dir ye shes sgyu ma'i gar/ /cha tsam skal ldan gdul bya'i ā dar+shar/ /rab gsal ke ta nas bsrungs dwangs mtsho'i spun/ /the tshom rnyog ma'i dri ma rgyang du bsrings/ /zhi khro kun 'dus che mchog hed ngu ga'i/ /bka' babs gnyags ban dz+nyā na ku mā ra/ /bka' gter bstan pa'i srog gi zung chen ber/ /slar byon pad+ma thod 'phreng gnyis pa bzhin/ /de yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs las gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa las kyi sa par gsungs pa'i bzhed tshul yod na'ang chos mngon par/ sgra mi snyan sgrib gsum du 'dod/ /ces dang / sdom gsum du/ gling gsum skyes pa bud med las/ /'gro ba gzhan la sdom pa bkag /ces so so thar pa'i sdom pa skye ba sogs nas 'dul mngon pa'i dgongs pa'i shugasal gling 'di nyid las kyi sa par bstan la/ bde mchog sdom 'byung du/ shar gyi lus 'phags ba lang spyod/ /de bzhin byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /gling gsum po yi mi rnams ni/ /longs spyod chen pos yang dag 'tsho/ /rnam rtog med cing rtog dpyod med/ /blun rmongs bye brag mi phyed pa'o/ /'dzam bu gling du legasaskyes pa/ /las kyi sa par rab tu grags/ /legs byas nyes par byas pa'i las/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /skyeb sngon ma'i rnam na 'dir/ /skye bo kun lamathong bar 'gyur/ /zhes wo ma bu gling pa —7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shenyid las kyi sa pa dang khyad par blang dor gyi las la ma rmongs shing dbang po rno ba (6ba) dang / shesarab che bas slob dpon klu byang gis/ 'on kyang 'go smos pas go ba dang dbang po rno zhing grims pa ste/des na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'dzam bu'i gling gi skye bo'i gnas kyi dbus su 'khrungs shing chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes mchog gi sprul sku'i tshul bstan nas chos gsung ba'i sa yang gling 'di nyid yin par gsungs la/ ri gi a ra le'i rgyud las/ gnas ni shar gyi lus 'phags po/ /de bzhin du ni ba lang spyod/ /gnas ni byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /gnas ni de bzhin 'dzam bu gling / /gling bzhin lha mo bzhi dang ni/ /ri rab spyi bor ri gi bzhugs/ /zhes bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'grub byed sa bcu gsum pa mngon du byed pa la nang du sbas pa'i rtsa lnga'i rlung sems dbu mar chud/ phyi'i yul chen lngar brtul zhugs spyod pas de'i mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus sa bcu gsum gyi rtogs pa bskyed do/ /de'i rtogos pa bskyed pa'i phyir yul chen lhag ma lngar bstan pa gling bzhi dang ri rab la ngos 'dzin te/ nang gi sbas pa'i rtsa lnga dang / /phyi ru yul chen lhag ma lnga/ /'dus pas bcu gsum sa bskyed par/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyan las gsungs/ /zhes gsungs shing bde mchog la sa bcu gnyisalas ma bshad dbang bde chen 'khor lo lha lnga po de rang lus la 'god pa na snying ga'i nang gi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab bzhi dbus dang bcas par bkod nas don gyi sa bcu gsum pa dang spyod par mdzad/ chosamangon pa nas badzā sa ra zhes bod skad du rdo rje gdan dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa rnams khyod dang 'byon 'gyur gyi gnas mchog lte bar byas pa'i byang ngos ri nag po brgyud dgu 'das pa'i pha rol du gangs ri dpal dang ldan pa'ang ri bo spos ngad ldan pa gnyis (7na)kyi bar na mtsho ma dros pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ de'i phyogs bzhi'am brag nas chu bo chen bo bzhi la bdun re g.yas phyogasasu bskor nas phyogs so sor 'bab/ spos ngad ldan gyi byang dpag tshad nyi shu na brag gser gyi bya skyebs can lha ma yin gyi ngos zhes bya ba/ de nas rim gyis dpag tshad nyi shu na shing su la rgyal po rab brtan/ de'i shar phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab pa/ brgya byin gyi glang po che rab —8

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ lhanabartan brag zhing rdzing bu gsum la dgun dpyid ston gsum gyi zla ba bzhi so sor rgyu ba/ ma dros pa'i mtshor dza lha'i shing 'bras bu dmar po rdza ma tsam yod pa chu'i nang du lhungs pa'i sgrar brten nas lho gling 'di la 'dzam bu'i gling zhes ming chags pa'i gling 'di nyid la/ dus 'khor las/ 'phags yul bod li rgya nag dang / /ke la sha dang gangs can che/ /zhes yul drug tu gsungs pa'i bod ni/ jo bo spyan 'dren gyi ched du rgyal ba 'brom gyis bod ston rnams la brdzangs pa'i 'phrin yig tu/ mang rta'i dbyibs 'dra 'dzam gling gi /bye brag brjid ldan gangs ri'i byang / /lo ha te 'gram rin chen khungs/ kha ba can zhesaming grags na/ /blo chen stobs ldan mi srun pa/ /bod ces bya ba gnas pa'i phyir/ /zhes pa'i rgyal khams 'di nyid kyang / /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /su la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes kha ba can gyi yul mtshos gang ba rim gyis bri nasaswā la'i ljongs byung zhing / rgya gar gyi rgyal po rū pa ti dpung bcas g.yul pham ste bud med kyi mas su zhugs nas 'ongs pa las rim gyis mi'i 'gro ba 'phel bar bshad pa dang / gtso bor lag na pad+ma'i sprul pa spre'u byang (7ba)chub sems dpa' dang / 'phags ma sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i brag srin mo 'dus pa las gdong dmar sha zan gyi phrug gu mang du 'phel te bod mi'i rgyal khams su gyur par 'bangs spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal por 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par sprul pa rim par byung ba'i thog mar rje gnya' khri btsan po byon/de nas lha mo dri ma med par lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes ba thog tu babs te kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyis pho brang yum bu bla sgang du bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ de nas gdung rabs lnga na phyag na pad+ma'i sprul pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i 'phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gas la bzhengs/ jo bo rnam gnyis gdan 'dren pa sogs bstan pa'i srol gtod/ de nas mi rabs lnga na —9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gis mkhan slob rnam gnyis kyis gtsos lo paṇa rnams bla'i mchod gnas su bkur/ zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyi gra btsugs nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ rgyal rabs gnyis na phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa lha khri lde srong btsan gyis yab mes kyi gsung rab dgongs 'grel rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ rma gnyags gnubs nyang sogs kyi brgyud pa rim par byon pas mdo sgyu sems sogs sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa rgya cher spel/bstan pa phyi dar la jo bo smri ti/ dpal mar me mdzad/ kha che'i bsod (8na)snyoms pa chen po sogs tshad thub kyi paṇa chen dang / rin bzang / 'brog mi sogs 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu ches mang ba rjes 'brang dang bcas pas mdo sngags kyi bstan pa shin tu dar bar mdzad pas na/ khro phu lo tsā bas paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya shrī can mngags nas be+e ḍūrla'i tshong 'dus su kha che paṇa chen la zhu 'phrin phul bar/ma ga dha sogs rigs 'byung gnas kyang sdig to yi/ /dmag tshogs kyis bcoms tse( rgyan kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khengs deng sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabs bskyod zhu/ /zhes dpal ldan shākya seng ge'i ring lugs ches cher dar ba bod yul 'dir rje bla ma 'di nyid bstan 'gro'i ched du yang srid bzung ba'i rigs rus cho 'brang ni/ mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje'i rnam thar du/ mi brgyud lha nas chad pa dang / chu brgyud gangs las byung ba dgos tshul gsungs pa ltar khungs btsun pa'i gdung rabs ni/ 'og min rig pa rang gsal lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas rang rig gdod ma'i ston pa kun tu bzang po'i thugs rje gzugs khams bsam gtan gnyis pa'i rtse mo 'od gsal lha'i gnas su 'gros nas lha dbang po sme ba'i gtsug tor can du sprul bas 'od gsal lha dbang gzhen nu gtsug tor can du grags shing / lha rnams kyis sri zhu rgya cher bskrun/ gdul bya'i zhing 'dzam bu gling du yod par dgongs nas gnas gong ma rnams las rim gyis babs te brgya byin gyi pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi rtse mor byon/ rang 'od kyi gur khyim du — 10

zur r+ṣa thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)bzhugs par brgya byin 'khor bcas kyis bsnyen bkur zhing mtshan bde byed gzhen nur grags/ de'i tshe lha min gyi dbang po sgra (8bcan/ mgul phreng / rab gnon/ thag bzang ris bzhis gtso bo byasapa'i lha ma yin gyi g.yul bshams pa na/ brgya byin gyis lha grags ldan mchog skyong la thabs zhus pas bde byed gzhen nus 'dul bar lung bstan pa bzhin gsol ba btab pas khang bzang gi rtsig pa'i zur las babs te phyi rol tu byon/ legs ldan tshogs bdag nag po la bka' bsgos pas tsan dan gyi beng chen po'i nang nas bdud 'dul gyi dmag dpung / beng stod nas lha dmag bye ba dung phyur/beng rked nas btsan dmag bye ba dung phyur/ beng smad nas bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur spros nas lha min gyi dpung tshogs bcoms pas mtshan lha rje dpa' bo g.yul las rgyal bar gsol/ ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas babs te ma ga dha sogs rgya gar gyi gnas rnams su bzhugs nas sgom sgrub 'chad nyan mdzad pas snyan pa'i grags pa sa steng kun tu khyab pas 'od gsal lha'i rigs yin zhing / rnam rgyal khang bzang gi rtsig pa'i zur las babs pas zur zhes bod skad du sgra bshad pa'ang snang / 'di nyid kyis bstan 'gro'i sman yon du ma gyur bar dgongs nas mtshan ldan gyi bu mo zhig phyag rgyar bsten pas sras zur spyang zhu can 'byungs pa bod du byon/mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus gnubs nam mkha'i snying po/ 'bre rgyal ba blo gros/ ro gong bi du rā dzā/ dru bu u pe sha rlangs dpal gyi seng na lte kuku rā dzā la sogs pas lo tsā mdzad nasagasang sngags kyi rgyud sdomang du bsgyur/ o rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas gnyags gnubs 'khon swo zur sogs sngags 'chang grub brnyes mang po smin par mdzad pas bod du zur gyi thog ma yin nges mdo khams kyi sog (9na〉pa sgang du byon nas sras bskrun par zur rgyal ba gsum bsgrags byung / de srasazur bshes gnyen rtag spra can/ de sras zur dbang phyug rgyal ba/ de sras zur rin chen rgya mtsho/ de srasazur 'tsho bzang mig po che lnga po ni mdo khams su byon/ de'i sras zur ā tsarla chen po/ zur kha can lag can/ zur bzang shes rab 'byung gnas gsum zhakhrungs pa'i ā tsar+shas rgya gar du thengs gsum —11

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebyon/ rgyal rigs zla ba'i dbang mo phyag rgyar bsten pas sras nyi ma'i snying po 'brungs/ de nas rgya gar du rigs brgyud mang po 'phel skad/zur kha can lag can rigs pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing nyis thog gi ka ba 'degs pa'i gyad kyi rtsal dang ldan/ gtsang du byon pas sras mo 'khrul zhig rje btsun zhes pa byung bas pa tshab kyi yangs pa chen por bzhugs/ bskyed rdzogs gsum la mkhas shing rgyud bshad man ngag mang du gsungs zur mo byon pa'i thog ma 'di yin zhing sku 'bum la mi ma yin gyis skor ba byas pas lam dod/ de 'og zur mo dkar rgyan/ de 'og zur mo dge 'dun 'bum sras gnyis dang bcas byung yang gdung ni ma 'phel zur bzang shes 'byung ni chung ngu nas mkhyen pa che/ bskyed rdzogs rgyud man ngag 'tshol bar gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes rin po che dgung lo brgya dang sum cur nye ba bsgrags yang rdzong du bzhugs pa dang mjal nas zab chos rnams zhus/ swo ye shes dbang phyug /gnubs bla chen byang snying gsum mched grogs mdzad pas swo zur gnubs gsum zhes grags/'di las sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba lha rje zur bu che shākya 'byung zur bla ma zur sgom chen rdo rje 'byung gnas/ zur sgom chung dang bzhi byung ba'i yab la ngos 'dzin mi mthun (9ba)pa 'ga' snang yang khungs btsun pa mdo khams nas lung pa ril po rjong du song ba g.yang mo bya bar yab gong du smos pa dang yum pad+ma gsal le gnyis kyi sras su zhabrungs pa'i tshe yab kyi mnal lam du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong can yum gyi phyag tu babs pa dang mnal sad nas/ nyi ma shar ba 'grig pa sogs yab yum gnyis ka la ltas ya mtshan pa mang du byung / sku bltams nas mes rin cen rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan shāka 'byung du btags/ gzhen nu nas yig klog byang zhing yab mes sogs sngags rnying ma'i bla ma du mar dbang gdams pa mang du gsan/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi drung du tshig rdzogs mdzad pas sprul skur 'dug ces mtshan ma spos/ khams su bzhugs ring mes rin cen rgya mtsho la mdo sngags kyi thos bsam mang du mdzad/ 'gro don dbus gtsang du yod par dgongs nas yar klungs na — 12

zur r+sā thams cad mkhyen pa cho dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)mo lung du phebs/ kri yog dzigasum la sgrub pa mdzad kyang bogs che bar ma byung bas lung bstan bzhin rdzogs chen zhu bar gtsang la byon/ cho ge lung gi nyang ye shes 'byung gnas la sgyu 'phrul dang sems phyogs/ ge gong gi lce shākya mchog la bdud rtsi/ yul gsar gyi gnyan nag dbang grags la dbang dang thabs lam/ tho dkar nam mkha' lde la mdo lnga thems dang 'grel par byed pa par khab/nyang stod kyi 'bre khro chung pa la ka dag dang lhun grub/ rtsa shod ldan ma sher tshul la yang dag /bka' sdod ye shes snying po la mdo sogs mdor na bla ma brgya rtsa lhag tsam bsten nas chos mtha' dag la sgro 'dogs bcad de mkhas pa'i phul du phyin kyang tshe gcig la rigs 'dzin gyi sar bgrod pa zhig byed dgongs pa'i tshe/ mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin dgon pa med kyang da lta'i 'ug (10na)pa lung gi chos khri'i g.yas logs kyi phug par bzhugs nas sgrub pa mdzad pas sa lam gyi rtogs pa mthon por son/ a ra'i slob ma dru bu klog 'byung la sban du rdzogs chen gsan/ brag dum phug pa/ spang bo che'i brag sgom chen/ brag dmar chang lding sogs dben pa mang du bsten nas sgrub pa mthar phyin/ slob ma lta dgongs kyi rtse mo zur chung ba/ sgyu 'phrul gyi rtse mo mi nyag 'byung grags/ mkhyen brtse'i rtse mo zhang 'gos chud ba/ sgom sgrub kyi rtse mo bzang sgom sher rgyal te rtse mo bzhi/ rtse lkog brgyad ni/ lo rog /lo thung / rta rog /tsag bla ma/ sum pa dbang tshul/ sum pa blo rgyal/ 'ol sgom/ phug ston nam mkha' 'od/ gzhan yang sgom chen brgya rtsa brgyad sogs slob ma mang du byung ba'i zur chung pa shes rab gragasani zur ā tsarla bod du byon nas thag tu bzhugs pa'i sras thag ba sgom chen dang jo mo shes rab skyid gnyis kyi sras su rgyan 'phar gdong du ga byungs khar yum la nyi zla shar nas 'jig rten gyi mun pa bsal ba sogs mnal ltas ya mtshan pa lnga byung / thugs rab shin tu che bas we klog dang cho ga chosaspyod brda bstan ba tsam gyis mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gcig pa la jo mo zhig blangs pa zhing gi shā 'od rgyug sar dor ma gsar pa zhig gsol ba chus spangs ba la jo mos khros ba'i rkyen gyis ber dang spyang thul zhig yod pa bsnams nas zur po che'i drung du mas bros la byon pa dus mtshungs su khrab/ zangs—13

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)zhu/ g.yu khyer ba'i chos zhu ba gsum yang 'dzom/ zur chung pa 'byor rgyu'i gong du bla ma la sku phrag steng du seng 'brug /'khrab pa sogs mtshan ltas khyad par can byung nas drung du shar mar btang / khong bzhi por spang zan dang lo (10ba)thug gnang ba zur chung pa ma gtogs gzhan gsum gyis zar ma nyan par rten 'brel 'phyugs te khong gsum gyi phyag rten ma bzhes pas bla ma dang chos gzhan nas rnyed 'ong zhes phyir ldog pa'i gcig 'gos khug pa lhas btsas yin pa khong rgya gar nas phyir byon rjes sngar gyi de la snying nad byas nas gsang sngags rnying ma chos log yin zhes dril bsgrags skad/zur chung pas bon po'i yas zan dang lo tshod sogs dka' thub la brten nas thos bsam la brtson 'grus cher mdzad/ nyin zhig lha rje chen pos bse'i ga'u phul dgu tsam 'gro ba zhig bsnams nas khyod la skom ster rgyu med dam gsung ba yas kyi zan chang yod zhus pa khyer shog gsungs nas snod do gsol/ de nas kyang yod na khyed shog gsungs nas lan gnyis gsol/ da 'dug gam gsung bar bre gang tsam 'dug zhus par da mi yog pa 'dug yog na khyod bsod nams bod du mi shong ba zhig 'ong da dung yang bsod nams chen po 'ong gsungs nas nas khal gsum gnang/ 'di zad rjes yo byad yong bar lung bstan pa bzhin de kho na ltar byung / dbang zhu ba dang dpe 'bri ba sogs kyi mthun rkyen du spar gyi mkhar sngon na g.yu mo bya ba phyug mo ma smad gnyis yod pa'i bdag gis gsung ba ltar bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ de gnyis kyi ka ca la brten nas dpe 'bri ba sogs chos kyi mthun rkyen mdzad/ ring zhig na khyod kyis bstan pa'i don rgya chen po sgrub dgos pa yod pas logs su sdod gsung ba ltar mdzad nas lha rje'i drung du bzhugs pa'i tshe bye stong nas chang 'dren pa dang / ri rtse zhal zas 'bul ba sogs gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i dngos grub brnyes/ lha rje zur bu ches zur chung pas gtsos slob ma rnams la sgyu 'phrul gyi chos mang du gsungs/ yang (11na tshe)ben du sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe rnal 'byor pa zhig gtor ma slong ba'i brda thabs la brten bzang gong shes rab rgyal po bsam yas mchims phur rog shāka 'byung gi sang chos zhu bar btang bas gdams pa shin tu mang ba gnang ste tshang ba bla ma —14

zur r+ṣa thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)la phul/ chos kyi rjes su tshangs pa dung thod can ngas pas zur pa'i pho lha chen por mnga' gsol/lha rjes mchims phu'i chos kyi khrod nas yang dag bdag don grub pa la nyams len mdzad pa'i tshe chu mar khur gyur pa dang / chang 'tshod gcig gis mi nyi shu tsam la zla gcig ldangs pa sogs grub rtags mang du bstan/ bla chen 'brog mis paṇ+ḍita ra gser 'bul ba'i kha long 'khyer shog gsungs pa ltar mi ma yin gyi byung ba'i gser srang brgya phul nas lam sgor brgyad kyi nang tshan bsam mi khyab gsan pa'i rdzogs chen la bogs thon/ chos kyi 'gro don che sgang la bo dong mnga' bdag brag gi phug tu yang dag mar me gcig pa'i sgrub pa mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'i tshe zur chung pas gtsos slob ma rnams kyang 'dus pas dpon slob thams cad kyis sgrub pa mdzad/ mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ltar rta nag gi mda' grog po kha lhor bstan pa'i mdo na phug pa shar bstan zhig rnyed pa der sgrub pa mdzad pas yang dag lha dgu'i zhal gzigs/ nye skor gyi grog po'i logs la 'ug pa'i tshang yod pas de nas bzung bla ma lug par grags/ phrag pa ra'i zi ri se can zer ba'i btsan rgod des 'phrin las bsgrubs shing zur pa'i chos skyong gi gral du mdzad/ phyogs der 'du 'dzi che drags pas phyir byon tshe gzhi bdag jo bo snang mar gyis srog snying phul/ brag rgya bor phebs nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma gsum gyis (11ba)shangs kyi mda' na lung pa zla gam lho nub tu sgo bstan pa sogs tshe gcig la byang chub thob pa'i gnas khyad par can yod pa tshol zer ba'i lung bstan ltar dpon slob rnams kyis gdong po thang kha nas shangs kyi lung pa'i dpyad la gzigs te rgyud nas bshad pa'i gnas der phebs shad mo yon tan rgyan gyis sa phug phul/zur chung pa sogs 'khor rnams kyang rang shong gi khang pa brtsigs nas sgrub pa mdzad par yul mi kun dad de rnyed bkur bstab/ slob ma rnams la yang dag gi dbang gnang ba'i dus zur chung pas bla mas ji ltar gzigs pa bzhin bdag cag rnams la ston par zhus pas snyigs dus 'byung po stobs che skabs 'dir de 'dul ba'i phyir du he ru ga'i sku zhig bzhengs pas de dus bstan gyis gsung / zur —15

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kye chung pas zab chos shig zhus pas/ nga ni nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /skye 'chi med pa rdo rje'i sku/ /'da' dang mi 'da' yongs mi mnga'/ /'gro don mthar phyin rdzogs dbang byin/ /skal ldan khyod la smin par shog /ces byin gyis brlabs pas rtogs pa phul du phyin pa brnyes/ khyad par khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi lha dngos su gzigs shing mi dang mi lab pa bzhin gsung gleng mdzad pa byung / de nas lug pa lung sngar gnas rnying pa yin pa dang rgyud man ngag las byung ba'i yon tan rnams tshang bar dgongs pa'i der phebs/ rnga'am dre'u la shing bkal nas brtan pa mdzad pa'ang shing chu mig 'od ma'i mdog can gyi sar phab pas klu de yang srung mar 'gyur bar dgongs te sman dang rdzas la brten nas klu bcos zangs lung dgu pa zhig gis kha bcad/ dbu rtse ba nor khang steng 'og khyams stod smad dang bcas pa'i 'gram pa bting ba'i rgya rtsis gnas gsar (12na ting mnyam pa mdzad rgyur rdo bzo bas cung zad bskums zer/ dbu rtse'i ka ba gcig gis ma stobs de lha rje'i zhabs kyis bsgril bas stobs par gyur cing shing 'byog po rnams mda' ltar srong ba sogs rdzu phral bstan pas shing bzo ba dad de sngar shing gron chen po bcug pa'i 'gyod mtshang la rtsig pa med pa'i ka bzhi ma phug nas phul bar mgon khang mdzad/ lha khang grub nas dbu rtse na yo ga'i lha sogs brten pa lha'i tshogs rnams bzhedas/ lha khang legs po byung bas 'di'i nye skor gyi thang rnams kyang gser du 'byug pa 'brom ri tshur zur nas gser 'don par dgongs pa na de'i btsan gyis nam phyed tsam la 'ongs te de ltar mdzad na nga'i gser thams cad zad 'gro bas lha tshogs la 'byug rgyu'i gser 'bul bas len par thong gsol ba bzhin rten gyi sku sha thams cad gser chus byugs/ gser ra'i mchin pa tsam zhig lha khang zhig gsos kyi thebs la gter du sbas par grags/rab gnas kyi tshe zur che chung gis rnam snang gi dbu gtsug nas zhugs thugs dar thon/ thugs ga nas zhugs pa spyi gtsug tu thon pa kun gyis mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul la brten bzo bo rnams dad de lha khang gi rgyab tu bkra shis sgo mang gi mchod rten bzhengs/ bla ma'i mtshan gnas la — 16

zur r+ṣa thams cad 4 pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanathogs te dpal 'ug pa lung du grags/ rtse mo bzhi la go tshod kyi dri ba mdzad par lan phul pas lha rje dgyes nas khyed rnam pa'i snying gtam 'di nyon zhig /dam pa'i lha chos byed pa la/ lam lta sgom spyod pa gsum du gda' zhes sogs kyi zhal gdams gsungs/ lha rjes tshogs pa bskyangs shing zur chung pas yang dben du ru lu'i sgrub pa mdzad (12ba)pas shangs kyi sgrub khang gdong la rgyu'i he ru gaḥzhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig phreng nge 'dug pa gzigs te bla mar zhus pas khyod kyis dpal chen po'i grub pa thob par 'dug pas 'u cag rnams 'dengs gsungs nas shangs kyi sgrub khang gdong du phebs/ der lha khang brtsig par thag bcad nas sa 'dul mdzad pas bla ma dpal chen du mthong ba mang po byung / gra pa kun gyis rdo re bskyal nas zur chung pas gyad rdo zhig bzhag yod glengs pas mang ma tsha ba la song shul bde gshegs rgya bos pha bong bskul ma thub pa re phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhir bzhag pas gzhan rnams chags snang dang bral te gus par gyur/ 'og khang gi ka ba 'khyog po bzhi yang mda' ltar bsrangs/ lha rjes gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i lung bstan bzhin dpal chen po'i sku bzhed ba'i sta gon gyi tshe ting nge 'dzin gyis bkug pas lha bzo mkhas pa 'dra chos zhu bar 'ongs pa yin zer 'byor bar chos ci 'dod yong bas dus kyi snyigs mar nag phyogs rnams 'dul ba'i dpal chen po'i sku zhig 'grub na 'gro don che bas grogs gyis gsung ba bzhin khas blangs/ dam rdzas dang sa sna rdo sna sogs sku rgyu dang bsres pa'i tho tshad cig bzheng ba'i zhal bkod mdzad/ bzo gang legs byas kyang zhal gzigs dang ma mthun pas sang nga la bltas nas bzhengs na yong bas shog gsungs de nyin zur chung ba dang bzo bo sogs 'dus par bla ma dpal chen phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas 'ug pa lung gi brag gdong dang / g.yon btsad po pur khang zhes pa'i ri rtser bzhag pas bzo bo rnams re zhig dran med du song / dran gsos nas sku'i lte ba man chad tsam las mi dran pa 'dug da zhal gsum (13na)phyag drug pa zhig ston par zhu ltas pas de 'dra mi dgos zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig bzhengs pas yong gsungs pa'i lte ba man chad bla ma dpal chen gyi skur bzhengs pa ji lta ba la sku stod tshul —17—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)ldan ma byung bas/ khyed tsho las ma dag pa'i skyon yin pas sku rgyu'i rdzas rnams sbyar nas 'di gar zhog khyed rang tsho sgrub chu la khrus dang lha khang la skor ba bdun byas nas shog /de bar ngas lha la gsol 'debs bya yi gsungs pa ltar nang du 'ongs tsa na sku stod rang byon du phebs/ lha rjes/ nga nyid lta bu'i gang zag la/ /nga nyid lta bu'i rten zhig byung / /snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba 'dren/ /nad dang gdon gyi gnyen por 'gyur/ /sngar yang he ru gaḥ nyid la brten nas he ru gaḥnyid byung ba yin la/ da yang he ru gaḥ nyid la he ru gaḥthim par 'gyur/ zhes ma 'ongs pa'i lung bstan mdzad/ rgyud lung dang mthun pa'i khro mo brgyad dang / ldebs ris la mdo sgyu'i lha tshogs sogs rgya cher bris/ rab gnas mnga' gsol gyi chas dgon par zur chung pas 'og gdong brag gi klu ming sring bkug ste rdza mar bcug /de steng nas dkar mo gtsang mas bkang lha rje'i sku phod bkag /rdo rje mdud pa'i rgyas btab pas chang lo slar mi mdzad pa byung / phad snod mang po g.yar bar rtsam pa khyor ba re blug bla mas gtor ma mdzad pas nang par snod thams cad phyes gang / sram sa bon grong par glang mang po g.yar nas sha la longs spyod slar glang rnams phyir gtad pas sha chang zan rnams 'dzad pa med pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/ bla mas lder sku la ma 'ongs 'gro don mdzad 'tshal zhus pas sku stod 'gying zhing he he gsungs pas da lta bzhad zhal du yod/ (13ba〉spyab rtags bstan pa'i sha chang zan sogs kyi lhag yod pas dpon slob rnams kyis lo gcig gi bar sgrub pa btsugs/ rtse mo bzhi dgongs pa 'gran bcug pas gzhan gsum ri bo ltar mi g.yo bar byung yang zur chung pa tā la gang tsam 'phags nas bzhugs/ zur chung pa'i 'dzab sgra sgrub khang / phyi rol/ ri sna gsum nas nyan pa sogs la che chung ma byung bas/ lha rje'i zhal nas/ mched grogs mnyam po yin yang khyed gsum gyis zur chung pa la 'gran par mi nus pa'i gzengs bstod/dpon slob rnams grog po'i sum mdor byon nas gzigs rten brten pa rnams legs po byung zhes brag steng du zhabs bro mdzad pas long bu man chad 'dam la rgyab pa ltar song / zur chung pas zhabs rjes la byin rlabs zhus pas ral pa'i thor tshugs nas snyan cha yan 'jim pa la bcug pa ltar shul — 18

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanalam me gsal/ 'ug pa lung du 'bras bu dpal chen po zhas gsum phyag drug pa'i lha khang bzhed bar byon pa'i tshe zur chung pa mkha' la 'phur nas brag rgya bor bzhud/ lha rje zhabs chu la ma reg par byon pa'i rjes su nye gnas kyi bla ma la 'jus nas 'ong ma nus pas gtsang po pha rir lus/ ko ba sgug ring kha skom te chang btsags nas btung pa chang btsos nas lo gcig dang zla ba bzhi song bas 'dir gcig bcug yod pa 'dug bsam bltas pas sbrul gnyis phyir thon/ de nas chang ma byung bas rten 'brel 'phyugs te lha khang ma 'grub/ lha rje chen por sku bsod rgyas pa'i skabs nya rin ma ma g.yung drung bkra shis bza' mi gnyis dge ba bya 'dod nas mchod gnas su bzang dris pas ban sngags bon gsum la kha ma 'cham pas gsum ga gdan drangs nas tshogs gsog byas/ lha (14na/bang bzheng ba'i yon sbyar na'ang rten gyi gtso bo la mchod gnas gsum ma dad pas so sor brtsigs/ lug pa lung pas bon po dang bsdebs nas brtsig par brtsams pa'i tshe ban bon lha bsres na mi legs par dgongs te rtsigs pas bon por byin nas sgro phug tu brtsigs pa na sgro phug gi rgyab ri lha ri gdong dang thang gi yang gdong gnyis la ri sbubs su bcug pa'i gser 'bum re byed gsungs pas lha ri gdong gi gzhi bdag dang rta nag 'byong ri tshugs po gnyis 'ongs nas gser 'bum mo bzheng ba dang gser ci 'dod 'bul bar khas blangs/ lha rjes len par byon par pha bong kha phye ba'i nang nas gser ka pā la gang bsnams/ 'brong rir rnal 'byor lnga btang ba rdo dkar zhig bteg pa'i 'og nas gser byung ba gsum gyis bla ma'i bka' bzhin srog chags kyi gzugs byung ba dang 'phro bcad nas 'ongs/ gnyis kyisasred pa byas pas gser khung rdib pa'i 'og tu shi /gser gyi khrod du mnal lam dang mthun pa'i gser ra'i mchin pa tsam yang byung / rten gyi rgyu char song ba'i lhag ma bre gsum tsam lha khang zhig gsos kyi thebs su gter du sbas/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin zur chung bas mdo dgongs 'dus bshad pas dus gcig la dpe 'grems sum brgya tsam byed/ rim gyis g.yas ru khang khri'i lha khang du 'chad nyan skyong ba'i dus go ma chod mi gsum la gra pa rnams gtad nas brag rgya bo'i dbyibs dpal chen po go rā ma —19

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebargyad kyis bskor ba'i rnam par yod pas brag rgya bo dgu 'dus su grags par byon nas sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe srog chags sdig pa re'u tsam pa dang gzhan yang grangs med pa dngos su byung zhing / mnal lam du mi nag po (14ba)zhig gis thag gi thang la bskyur ba mnal sad tsa na thang de gar byon 'dug pa yang med par gnas de nyid du sgrub pa mdzad de sgyu 'phrul las byung ba'i rdor sems la bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs shing thag gi lung pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpas gang ba byung ba bsam gtan gyi mthu tsam las don dam par ci yang med snyam du rgyun bskyangs pas rdzogs pa chen po rang snang rig med kyi dgongs pa shar te rdos bcas kyi dngos po gang la'ang mi thogs par byung / de tshe sba dge mthong bya ba mtshan nyid pa'i slob dpon zhig gi gra pa 'dra 'das nas ka ba chos can du bzung nas thal 'gyur 'phangs pa na nged rdzogs chen pa rang snang rig med la ka ba mi gda' zhes ka ba la phyag dbyug dbyug mdzad pas thogs med song bas dad pa thob nas slob mar gyur pa ma thogs byang 'bar du grags/gnas der lo bcu bzhi'i ngo mthong sgrub pa mdzad de dgon par 'byon rkyen sngar slob dpon du bskos pa'i mgo bya chas gsang snying 'di la thabs lam gyi dus rgyab chos sum rgyud dgos zer nas 'gos la dgyes rdor nyan par phyin/ mig chung dbang seng gis sgyu 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor phyir 'don pa'i dus su yo ga dgos zer nas sum pa ye 'bar la yo ga nyan du phyin/ 'og chung dbang nges sgyu 'phrul 'di la grub mtha' 'dzin par tshad ma dgos pa 'dug zer nas spang kha dar chung pa'i sar tshad ma nyan du phyin te go ma chod gsum gyi bstan pa ma zin pa dang / lha rje chen po'i sgo phug gi gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i phyag rjes kyi 'jug skyong mdzad dgos par byung ste bla ma gshegs pa'i gong du brag rgya bo nas bos te gdan sar bskos/ zur chung pas kyang nga bzhin slob ma skyongs/ rjes 'jug (15na sgoms kyis kyang bkur dgos pa'i zhal ta mdzad/ lha rje sram sgrub khang du phebs/ zhogs pa zhig nyi ma rtser shar la nye gnas kyis phyin tsa na bla ma sku tshags mdzad zin 'dug par gang la thegs dris par/ nga bde ba can du 'gro zhes phyag gnyis kyis rdor dril bzung 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur nas dpal chen po'i thugs —20

zur r+sā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanaskar 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan shin tu 'tsher ba zhig 'phro 'du lan gsum byas nas rdos bcas kyi dngos po rnams cho me nyid zad sar 'byol te chos sku'i klong du thim na'ang las ma dag pa'i ngor yang dben du khams pa zhig la gsang dbang dngos su bskur ba la log ltas dbang ma zhus par song ba bsgral zhing du dgongs te ma rga spyod mdzad pas stag gru khar shi ba gnas spar/ slob ma dam nyamasapa'i rkyen gyis bla ma'ang rigs 'dzin gyi gral du gshegs pa'i yang dben gyi mar gdong na pur sbyangs pa'i mchod rten zhig bshul dang pur sol yod skad do/ /lha rje zur bu che gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs su sgro phug gi lha khang mjug skyong dang rab gnas mdzad/ 'chad nyan shin tu 'phel bas slob ma mang du 'dus pa'i ka ba bzhi ni khyung po grags seng gisalha rje 'ug pa lung ba sun 'byin par gra pa mkhas pa bzhi btang ba'i skyo ston shāka yes khyed rdzogs chen pa'i lugs kyi sgrub pa kho na mdzad dam dris par nga dmigs pa gang la bstad 'dug gsungs/ 'o na mi sgom pa lags sam zhes pas nga gang la g.yengs 'dug gsungs pas spobs pa zhum/ de rjes glan shāka bzang gis khyed sgyu 'phrul ba snang ba thams cad lha dang lha mor 'dod dam dris par yul bem po rang rgyud du snang ba mngon sum gyi tshad ma sus 'gabs gsungs/ 'o na (15ba mi 'dod dam byas pas sems can rnams kyi ma dag pa'i 'khrul snang rang rgyud pa spyod par byed pa'i ched du bka' mdo rgyud du ma las 'byung ba dang sus 'gal bar nus gsungs pas lan med du gyur pa na khong bzhi pos bla ma khyad par can 'di 'dra rnyed par dka' bas bla ma khyung po dang thabs kyis bral nas drung du 'ong ba'i bro bor/ khyung po grags seng gis sun dbyung ngam dris par ma nus tshul brjod pas lta log mkhan de 'dra bsad na sangs rgyas thob gsungs pa gsan pas lha rje rgya bor chos khri'i khar phebs pa'i tshe sbyor sgrol gyis 'tshang rgya ba sngags lugs ma gtogs med snyam yang khyung po grags seng lta bu'i mtshan nyid pa'ang blo phugasanga'i chos la gtod par 'dug gsungs ba 'ad skad/ mtshan nyid pa bzhi po slob mar gyur pa ni sems phyogs kyi ka ba gung bu'i skyo ston shāka ye/ mdo'i ka ba skyed lung gi yang khen bla ma/ sgyu 'phrul —21—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyegyi ka ba chu bar gyi glan shākya bzang po/ 'phrin sgrub kyi ka ba nag mo ri'i mda' ti chos shāka bzhi/ gdung brgyad ni/ ma thog pa/ skya ston chos seng / glan shākya byang chub/ caka shāka rin/ gnubs ston bag ma/dbus pa sa 'thor/ shu ston zla grags/ rtse khram byang dpal dang brgyad/ sgom chen gnyis ni/ 'ba' sgom dig ma/ bon sgom do bo/ yus bo che ni/ la stod kyi zi ston bsod rgyal/ lcam bcu drug /dral ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dkyus ma mi gnyis/ sta ku ra mi gnyis/ go ma chod mi gsum la sogs pa mang du byung / lha rje 'di nyid kyis 'ug pa lung du snga chos/ sgo phug tu gung chos/ brag rgya bor dgongs chos gsungs/lha rje rgya bo la sngags rnying ma ba'i khrod nas mi 'dud pa med pa tsam yod par/ 'gos lhas (16na〉tsas kyis gsar ma ba rnams lha rje 'ug pa lung pa la phyag mi 'tshal ba'i khrims bcas pa'i skabs shig shangs su ston mo zhig gi gral dbur lha rje bzhugs pa dang 'gos dpon slob byon pa 'grig nas 'gos kyis phyag mdzad pa na gra pa rnams kyis ci yin dris pas kho'i sar slebs na dpal chen po'am de yin snyam pa las 'du shes g.yin mi 'char gsungs skad/ rgya bor bzhugs dus nam phyed la rta pa dkar po zhig byung nas shar ri dpal gyi rtse la byon zer ba ltar phebs pa'i rdzis ra zhig tu dro bstab/lha ze mo'i rtser mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bro 'khrabs pa'i rjes su bzhes pa mdzad dgongs par chas rnams rdzis rar lus pas phyir byon pa der gsol zan gyi lhag ma la tsan dan dkar po'i myu gu zhig skyes pa rnying ma'i bstan pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel du dgongs te lha khang ka dgu ma zhig bzhengs pa nyin mo mi las mtshan mo mkha' 'gros brtsigs pa 'ol che bar byung bas mkha' 'gro lha khang du grags/legs ldan tshogs kyi mgon po rnying bstan sbyi dang khyad par zur pa'i bstan pa bsrung bar dam bsgrags/ ka ba dgu la yang dag lha dgu bzheng ba'i dgongs pa yod pa de dang nye ba'i sgrub khang gdong du sku snyes mdzad/ sgro phug gi lha ri gdong la zhabs g.yas brkyang / sgrub khang gdong du g.yon brkyang ba'i 'bras bu he ru gaḥzhig gzigs pas zhabs g.yon pa'i thad du he ru ga:zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i lha khang bzhengs/ 'gro don rgya che ba'i ngang nas dgung lo drug cu re gcig gi dus brag rgya bo nas o —22

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ tanargyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du gshegs/ gdung zhugs 'bul gyi tshe me rtag gi char/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur/dri ngad bzang po sgra snyan pa sogs kun gyi (16ba〉spyod yul du gyur cing las dag pa 'gas lha'i gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan yang mthong skad/ pur dud brag la chags par mchod rten rang byon byung /gdung ring bsrel phal cher mkha' 'gros gdan drangs/ sngar brag rgya bor lo bcu bzhi tsam bzhugasadus spyan dang zhal la sdom gyi ba thag chags pa nye gnas kyis chus shing 'then pas spyan hur gyis gzigs nas nga de gar bzhag na thod pa mgo la mi 'gebs pa zhig yong rgyur da skye ba zhig len dgos pa 'dug gsungs pa rje btsun sa paṇ+ḍita yin par snang ngo / /lha rje zur chung pa'i jo mor btsad mo dar ma bo dhi byon par sras jo btsun rdo rje 'bar dang sras mo shākya lcam mo gnyis 'byungs 'di nas mang du mched pa'i sras snga tshar zer chos zhu ba 'khrid nas rim gyis thugs mthun pa'i gsang yum mda' ti jo shāka gi lcam mda' mo gtsug tor lcam bya ba khab bzhes min par brten gra pa rnams kyis sdang bar byas pa na skyo ston shāka ye la 'di'i srin lag la bstan pa'i gtso bo zhig 'dug pa/ glan la jo mo'i lus la sangs rgyas kyi sku thim pa/ mda' ti jo shāka la spyi gtsug nas gser gyi rdo rje thim pa ste slob ma gsum gyis mnal lam dang lha rje'i zhal nasa'adi'i lus la phyag rdor gyi sku zhig thim pas bde bar zhog gsungs pa ltar ring zhig nas sras bltams par mnal ltas dang bstun nas yab kyis shākya seng ger btags/ spyan rtsa grung bas yum gyis hor po zhang po nas gras te mda' tsha hor po/ phyis sgro phug tu bstan pa bskyangs pas gsang bdag sgro phug par grags/ de'i tshe yab kyis spong dag mdzad pa dang thug na'ang btsun ma zhig gis nas bong rgyab brgya dang mar khal brgya tsam phul pas rkan mar thogs med du (17na bang / dus der mdo khamasanas ja dang gser gyi 'bul pa gtos chen byung bar grags/ yab snga ma nas gshegs kyang yum dang zhang pos bskyangs/dgung lo bco lnga tshun mda' phur bzhugs nas yig chos dang sgrub 'phrin bslabs/ de nas glan —23

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedang khyed kyi sar byon nas yab chos kyi rgyud lung man ngag la sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la gdan sar phebs pa sku bsod che bas skye'i sar lo gcig tsam ma gtogs chos 'tshol bar 'byon ma thub pas tshur gdan drangs te ka ba bzhi la mdo sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs gsum gyi rgyud man ngag 'phrin sgrub dbang / glan la rdzogs chen skor lugs/ lha rje shangs pa nag po la rdzogs chen pa rgyud pa tha ma'i skor rgyud gdams ngag dang bcas pas mtshon te bla ma mang du bsten nas mkhas pa'i mthar son pas zur thams cad mkhyen par grags/ 'gro phan shin tu che bas slob ma gdugs thogs pa stong / po ti'i kha phye ba'i shob sgras nya ri lung pa'i lug gi khyu 'drogs pa lta bu byung / chos grwar chos nyan pa'i go sa dga' mi dga' la gser thang nas khal nyi shu rtsa bzhi ma'i dus kyis zho re'i 'jal len byed pa byung /de dag nas thugs zin pa'i slob ma bzhi gsum bcu gnyis kyi nag po bzhi ni zur nag 'khor lo/ rgya nag skyi mkhar pa/ nyang nag rdo po/ lce nag dpal seng / ston pa bzhi ni/ nye ston/ zhang ston/ rgyabs ston/ rgya ston/ mes bzhi ni/ gtsang pa khyi ston/ g.yung ston hor po/ spong ston lcags kyu/ dbus pa chos seng rnams yin la de'i nang nas rgya nag skyi mkhar bas rgya brtson seng sun dbyung ba sogs la bla ma dgyes te man ngag phra mo tshun chad gnang bas slob ma gzhan las gdams pa che/ skabs (17ba)shig ston pa bzhi por tshogs chas khyer shog gsungs/ lha rjes kyang bsnams te dpon slob thams cad lha ri gdong gi rtser byon tshogs 'khor mdzad/ khyed rnams nga med pa la mya ngan ma byed ces gdams nas gsung mgur re dang sbrags nam mkha' la 'phur te mi mthong ba tsam du gshegs pa na slob ma rnams kyis sdug bsngal gyi rnam 'gyur mang po dang bcas mtshan nas bos pas bla ma mar byon nas ngas kha brda bcag pa la mi nyan pa brgyud pa la shis pa bag mi yong gsungs/ lo phyi ma la mya ngan las 'das te pur sbyong ba'i tshe sngags gzhen chas mdzes shig gis rta ngang pa bzang por dung gi sga rang gug legs po zhig gtad nas phul ba rtsad ma chod pa lhas gdung 'bul byas par grags/ gzhan yang klu dang gnod sbyin sogs kyis nor bu mang po phul/ mdor na lha rje 'di nyid gsang bdag mi'i srid pa —24

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanabazung ba'i snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po zhig go/'di nyid la sras rdo rje grags de nas mang du 'phel ba la phyi tshar du gleng mod yongs grags sgro phug pa chen po tshangs par spyod pas sras med par grags/ lha rje zur po che'i gcung sgom chen rdo rje 'byung gnas kyi sras zur ral pa can zhes chos skyong bran du 'khol zhing sbyor sgrol mthar phyin pas sngags nag cig byung / de'i sras zur shākya mu dra/ de'i sras rdo rje dbang phyug dang zur bzang sgom gnyis byung ba zur lugs kyi 'phrin sgrub brgya lugs sogs la mkhas par grags/ rdo rje dbang phyug la sras zur a mes shes rab blo gros/ zur ston bla ma/ zur a mes shes rab 'byung gnas gsum/ a mesashes rab blo gros la sras zur rdo btsun shes rab bzang po/ zur lha rje rdo kham/ zur lha rje dbang (18na)nge / zur dpal le dang bzhi'i shes rab bzang po ni bdud rtsi sman sgrub/ thun mong tshe sgrub/ dngos grub bam sgrub/ mchog gi yang dag sgrub pa bzhi la shin tu mkhas/ a mes sher blo nas gdung thor bu 'phel/zur sher bzang gis sras zur he ru nas nag chang shar/ ka tsha gong 'og /lug pa lung gi bla brang rnams bzhengs shing dgongs mkhyen mtho bar grags/ de'i sras zur 'od pa ni shong pa'i bla ma nyang gi gdung brgyud du 'khrungs pa'i tshe skye ba phyi ma 'ug pa lung du 'byon pa dang sku tshe 'di la sngon gnas gsang ba dran pas sku skye snga phyi'i slob ma mtha' dag skyong bar mdzad/ jo mo ma gcig dpal dge la sras mo lnga btud nas byung bas thugs chad de yod pa'i tshe kha che paṇa chen phebs pa gdan drangs pas paṇa chen gyis gnas 'di'i bya ri dwags kyang 'phags pa'i sprul pa/ byang la ngos bstan pa'i ri 'di dag rigs lnga'i tshul/ bya ri la gras pa'i lung chung 'di dag kyang yi ge 'khor lo tsho gos chen gyi rnam par yod pa'i gnas 'dir gsang sngags ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bar ma chad du 'byung zhing slar sras po gnyis yong bar nga'i ming nas gras pa thogs/sras mo rnams kyis kyang gzhan phan yong bas sdang po ma mdzad ces lung bstan gnang / sras mo lnga'i che ba zur mo 'od 'bum mkha' la 'phur ba sogs rdzus la che/ zur mo sgom chen gyis mgon po —25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'abran du 'khol te mthu che bas pha mes kyi dgra rnams brlag par mdzad/ zur mo g.yang dpal mi ma yin la chos ston pa/ zur mo g.yang 'bum khyim la byon zhing zur mo dkar ru chung ngu nas zhing khams gzhan du 'phos/ sras zur shākya mgon po dang pa shi shāka 'od gnyis byung ba'i (18ba)gcen ni mngon shes mnga' bas skye 'chi dang bar do gzigs pa brtul zhugs shin tu che/ gcung pa shi shāka 'od kyis brag rdo rje tshe brtan nas tshe chu mu men gyi ka pā la gang dang slob dpon chen po'i dbang gi phyag phur rin po che ze khyim las grub
