pa spyan drangs/ mkhas grub kyi snyan pa che bas se chen rgyal pos gong du yong dgos pa'i lung byung bar slob dpon khro bo sku tshab la mngags/ tshe chu phul ba bzhes pas gong ma se chen dgung lo brgyad cu thub pa de'i byin rlabs yin zer/ phur pa 'ug pa lung nas rin po che kun bzang rtse ba'i phyag tu 'byor ba thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sog yul la thegs khar sku srung la phul ba'i mtshan pad phur khams gsum rnam rgyal du grags/ gong nas gnang sbyin gya nom pa dang sban hor dud zhe lnga'i sa'i 'ja' sa byung / klu'i cho 'phrul gyis rgya rgan gyi mtsho bskams bcug nas phul ba'i sar sngags sde chen po btab/ phyag bzo mdzad pa'i legs ldan gyi sku de khyung tshang nas spyan drangs pa'i dus dgun thog ser sogs 'tshub lhongs che/ ka ca sogs gnas gzhi 'ga' bya jog tshang la gshor ba tshur blangs/ snang srid lha 'dre la bsdos nas sban la rka chu drangs/tshe chu'i gter yig las/ rdo rje brag gi lte ba laḥ byang chub sgrub pa'i sgrub gnas 'byung: zhes pa ltar sku tshe'i smad la mkhar brag rdo rje brag gi lte ba la sgrub pa mdzad/ mi ma yin dam la btags dgung lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa la dag zhing du gshegs/ bla ma 'di la yum mi gcig pa'i sras zur nyi ma seng ge /zur shākya seng ge /zur dpal ldan mgon po gsum gyi dang po ni khro phu lo tsā bas nyi ma seng ge zhes pa'i mtshan btags/ mkhan chen bsod nams seng ge'i (19na jung du rab tu byung / yab kyi dgongs rdzogs rgyas par bskrun zhing zur tsho'i gdan sa lo bcu gcig tsam mdzad/ zha lu a mes kyi lag nas yab kyis bcol ba'i 'ja' sa blangs/ rgya rgan bar sgo phyin chad kyi lcags ri sbyangs sku bsod 26

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)rgyas pas zur tsho'i lha sdo mi sdo 'brog dang bcas pa stong skor gsum du phye/ sa skya'i nang chen gyis gong du zhu log phul nas bya rog tshang du dpon chen kun bzang pa bkrongs pa'i dus rgya'i dmag dpon mi chen sams bla mar gser ka ṭo ra gang phul ba ma bzhes par de tshab tu 'gro ba mang po'i srog bskyabs de rnams kyis zur pa'i bza' khral gzhal/ bar dga' lha khang khyams dang bcas pa bzhengs sku rim sgrub pa'i sngags pa khral med mang po gzhis 'jags su bcug /khro phur 'bum mo che ba'i brtsig skabs chu dkon par phud gter bden pa bdar sku chos brdabs pas char chen po babs/ gong gi sku rim du rgya rgan spa'u srog mkhar dge leb tu sngags bzhi'i mtshams la bcug /'bri gung pasastod hor gyi dmag drangs pa'i tshe rgya nag gi dmag dpon thi mur bhe kha dang dpon chen ang len gyis gtsos pa'i sa skya'i dmag gis dpal mo dpal thang du gdong bsu btang ba'i tshe gong so sgom chen gyis 'go byas gshin rje'i sgrub pa dang rlung nag bskor bas stod hor gyi g.yul pham nas mang du bsad cing khri che gsum tsam bros pa gangs 'ur gyis mnan nas shi /stod hor gyi dmag dpon rgyal bu rin wo dang 'bri gung gi sgom pa btson du zin pas sa skya ba'i bstan pa'i srog rtsa bzung / ra tsa pa'i bu sring phyug mo byin rlabs khab tu bzhes pa'i sras zur byams pa seng ge /slob dpon mgon po dar/bde byed (19bsgo gon po dpal gsum dang / yum mi gcig pa'i sras mo g.yang 'bum dang bzhi byung ba'i thams cad mkhyen pa byams pa seng ge ni chung ngu nas 'bri klog 'bad rtsol la ma bltos par mkhyen/yab kyi drung du dong sprug dang yang phur cha gsum gyi sgrub dbang gsan/ 'phrin las kyi skor rnams slob dpon sangs rgyas mgon la zhus/ khro phur mkhan chen bsod nams seng ge la dge tshul bsgrubs pa'i mtshan byams pa seng ger btags/ mtshan nyid kyi chos la sbyangs nas bcu bzhi la gral skor mdzad pas mkhas grags thon/ mkhan pos sems bskyed gsum pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas tshogos pa la mngon pa bshad/ zur shāka seng la yang dag dang sgyu 'phrul tshe sgrub/ mda' shāka 'phel la gsang snying /lce ston sgrub pa 'bum la sgyu 'phrul dang rdzogs chen/ bla ma sba ston la sgyu phrul zur lugs dang dgongs27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kye'adus rtsa phung / zo lung pa bla ma bshes gnyen la mdo dbang dang se lugs kyi zhi khro/ tha lo la sgra tshad/khro phu dpal mchog la rdor phreng / bsam sdings 'grub pa dpal la lam 'bras/ bla ma yon tan mgon po la mdo lugs kyi phyag rdor dang rnam 'joms/ dpon dpal mgon la bstan srung / sman rtsis g.yul rgyal skor/ gangs pa shāka 'bum la rdzogs chen klong sde dang gshin rje dmar nag /bla ma zhab pa sras 'dzom dang mgon sar gyi bla ma lha rje sogs la gdam ngag mang du gsan te thos bsam mthar phyin/gnas shar rtse rgyal/ 'ug pa lung / nya ri sgrub phug sogs su sgom sgrub lhur blangs nas skyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po la nang byan chud/ yi dam gyi lha'i zhal gzigs/ dam can bran du 'khol ba'i sngags 'chang chen (20na)po 'di la slob ma snga tshar g.yung ston rdo rje dpal/ sban gsum grong rkarma rgyal mtshan/shangs ri pa'i sdom pa lha rje bzang / dpe po che ba yon tan grub/ slob dpon mgon seng/ nyang stod stag tshal ba slob dpon dga' rab/ la stod sba ston gzi brjid byams pa dpal/ phyi tshar ni rta nag sgrol ma sbug pa 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rje/ ra thung grags bzang / snye mo nyi zla/ shangs phu'i bla ma rin cen rdo rje/ la stod pa rdor seng / thugs rje byin rlabs gnyis/ kha reg pa gzhon nu mgon/ rgya rgan pa'i jo bo mgon grub sogs khyad par can gyi slob ma dang gzhan yang rjes 'jug rgod po'i nyin lam gyis khyab pa lta bu rnams 'khor lo rnam pa gsum gyi las la bkod/ sngar gangs pa shāka 'bum la lha rje byams seng dang g.yung ston pa dpon slob gnyis kyis tshe bdag sdig pa snying 'dzings kyi 'khrul 'khor la mkhas par sbyangs pas dpon slob gsum gyi steng du zha ga sras 'dzom ste bzhis 'ug pa lung du bcas chog mchod rten bzhengs/ g.yung ston pas thod pa zhal dbye bsgrubs pa'i bka' shin tu gnyan cha che ba zhig thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phyag tu 'byor/ lha khud kyi byon sde'i mdzo ro dngos grub kyis lha rje la zas ngan drangs nas dgung lo so drug la gshegs par g.yung ston pas gshin rje tshu bung gi 'khor lo bskor nas bon grong mi nor dang bcas pa gtsang pos khyer nas shul med du stongs pas/ bla ma'i sku dgra thug la kho bo tsam/ zhes sogs kyi zhal po'ang mdzad/ gcung —28

zur r+sā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)bde byed mgon po rgyud bshad dang 'phrin sgrub la mnga' brnyes/ phur srung bran du 'khol/ g.yang 'bum ni lce ston sgrub pa ba la thug nas lo bzhi bcu'i bar (20ba)mtshams mdzad pas sgrub skra thog gis mi 'gyongs pa byung / bde byed mgon po sogs nas brgyud pa mang du 'phel/ pa shi shāka 'od dang yum mi gcig khyed 'dren dpal gnyis kyi sras zur shākya seng ge chung dus ljags mi bde bar dbyangs can ma bsgrubs pas smra ba'i seng ger gyur/ 'phags pa rin po cher dge bsnyen zhus shing mtshan yang 'phags pas btags/ khro phu bsod seng la dge tshul gsan/ slob dpon lcog ro rdo rje la yang phur tshe gsum sogs tshon sgrub mkhas par sbyangs/ sna bzhi rdo lhun la gdangs dbyangs/ g.yung ston ye shes pa la gsang snying / bla ma mdo sde par yang dag /lce ston la rdzogs chen gshin rje phur pa/ bla ma yon rtan mgon po sogs la cho sgo dang gdams pa mang du gsan/ yab kyi gshegs rdzong grub nas gdan sar byon/ gong nas go lug rgyal pos/ gser bre chen bzhi/ dngul bre chen nyi shu/ gos yug nyis brgya sogs kyi gnang sbyin byung bar brten dgon pa rnams kyi chos gzhis dang mi sde 'jags pa'i ched du btang / gong nas dbus gtsang mnga' ris kyi sngags pa thams cad kyi mgon du bskos pa'i 'ja' sal sa skya nas bla ma bdag nyid chen pos rgyab gnon mdzad/ 'chad nyan dang bstan srid kyi sku rim la brtson zhing lugs gnyis nas mngon par mtho ba'i mdzad pa rgya che/ pa shi'i sras chung ba dpal ldan mgon po ni bla ma sgrub pa ba dang bla ma mdo sdeb/ g.yung ston ye shes/ rgyal sras mi tri seng ha/ zur sangs rgyas mgon bo rnams bsten nas yo ga gsum gyi cho sel mkhas par sbyangs/ 'di nas mched pa'i brgyud pa'ang mang / zur shākya seng ge dang jo mo don grub dpal gnyis kyi sras su zur bzang po dpal/ (21na khrir seng ge bzang bo/ zur shākya bzang bo dang gsumathong ba'i gcen ni/ bla ma byamasapa seng ge /slob dpon rdo rje mgon bo/ jo bo rdo rje 'bum rnams la rgyud bshad dang 'phrin sgrub zhus/sa skya rin chen sgang du 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por dge bsnyen bsgrubs pa'i mtshan bzang po dpal du btags/ gong ma spu yan tho gan gyi gnang sbyin bzang po bstsal zhing gong du —29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelan gnyis byon pa'i sngon mar char 'bebs/ ngo log par thog ser btang bas gong ma mnyes/ pho brang steng du sprin nag sdig pa'i gzugs can sus kyang bshig par ma nus par ma mo phang khab kyi mdos dar khang bco brgyad kyis bcings pa btang bas sprin nag 'thor/ gong ma la yang dag gi dbang phul/ pho brang shangs mdor mtshams tshugs pa'i las bzhi'i phur pa yod skad/ rgyal por dge bskul zhus nas 'grel pa par khab sogs rnying ma'i chos sde nyi shu rtsa brgyad par du brkos/ rta khal drug cu'i gsung rab bod du gdan drangs/ gong ma sku gshegs rjes bla ma tshad pa'i snyun gyis grongs par thug par mkha' 'gro ma sngon ma'i rnam pa can gyis bum chu dang / chos skyong gi sprul pa'i sngags pa nag pos thugs gar chu gtor bas snyan las grol/ btsun mo tha lus dngul bre bcu phul bar rdo rje sems dpa'i sku dang / lcam dral gyi 'chams sku bzhengs pa'i 'chams skus bod la gom pa bdun spos pas bse 'bag gom bdun mar grags/ bod du byon nas bzhi thog tu bla ma bdag nyid chen por 'bul ba sogs mchog dman mtha' dag chos dang zang zing gis tshim par mdzad/ slar gong du byon nas dgung lo so brgyad pa la rgya yul du sku gshegs/ zur bzang (21ba)po dpal dang yon bdag mo a 'dzin gnyis la sras zur shāka 'byung phyi ma bla ma chos rgyal ba/ dpal ldan 'od 'tsham gsum 'khrungs/gcen gyis dgung lo lnga la rtsa rgyud gsang ba snying por bshad pa mdzad/ dgung lo bdun nas bshad gra bskyangs/ bla ma kun spangs pa la dge tshul dang byang sems bsod grags pa'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mtshan shākya 'byung gnas su gsol dpal ldan bla ma dam pa/ zur shāka seng / sa bzang lo chen/ sgrol ma pa 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rje/ g.yung ston pa mkhas btsun sangs rgyas sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas gsang sngags rnying ma gtsor gyur pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos la thos bsam rgya cher mdzad/ mkhas grub kyi snyan pas sa steng khyab gzhan don rgya che ba'i ngang du dgung lo so brgyad pa la ba khri shegs/gcung lha chos mi chos la mkhyen pa che ba de pho brang ta'i tung dgung lo nyer lnga pa la gshegs/—30

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanalcam sring ma mi chos mdzad pa'i mtshan zur mo dge 'dun 'bum zhes rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sprul par byed/ shāka 'byung phyi ma 'di nyid nas yang dben dang yangs pa'i gsang sngags gling sogs kyi brgyud pa 'phel/ 'bring po zur seng ge bzang po ni yab la sngags rnying ma'i chos phal cher gsan/ sgrol chen la gsang snying dang lam rim zhus/ dgung lo bcu'i steng du rgyud la bshad pa mdzad/ bla chen ti sgri kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du rab tu byung / glan bsod nams mgon po dang bsod nams 'bum pa gnyis la mdo dang 'phrin sgrub sogs mang bar sbyangs/ gdan sar byon rjes bla ma shes rab rgya mtsho sogs bsten nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang por thos bsam mdzad/ gong ma do gon (22na skon gyis dngul tham gnang ba'i phud chos rje sgrol ma bar phul/ bshad nyan sgom sgrub spyi rim mdos gtor sogs sngar gyi srol rgyun rnams je bzang du btang / dgung lo don gnyis pa la 'ug pa lung du gshegs/gcung zur shākya bzang po thog mar gdan sa mdzad cing de rjes gong gi bla mchod du lan gnyis tsam byon/ lcam sring ma yang dag 'bum dgung lo bcu gsum la grongs pa'i sha rī ram bdun tsam dang de nas mang du 'phel/ zur seng ge bzang po dang dbon mo 'bum me gnyis kyi sras cha ho ta hu na gang du byon pa'i mtshan da ra kha cher btags/ gong ma'i lung gis cha ho ta hu'i las ka bzung / bla ma dam pa'i drung du dge bsnyen zhug mtshan bsod nams 'bum du btags/ zab chos mang du gsan zhing gdan sa yun ring bskyangs 'di'i brgyud pa rgya rgan span du 'phel/seng ge bzang po'i phyi tshar yum phyug mo khyed 'dren 'bum la zur ri rgyal lhun po 'khrungs pa chung ngu nas gshegs pa'i gcung zur rdo rje rgyal mtshan ni bla ma legs ldan pa la yab chos rnams gsan/lha chos mi chos gnyis ga'i sgo nas bstan pa bskyangs/ de'i gcung bla ma grags chen pa/ de'i sras dpal chen mgon po/ gcung sangs rgyas rdo rje ni ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi sprul par grags dgung lo bcu bzhir 'ug bya lung gi gdan sar byon/ thugs sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs bla ma du ma bsten nas thos bsam mdzad/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba la mchog tu brtson/ pa rnam bde ba —31—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyesgang du bla ma'i khri khar dpal rta mgrin bzhugs pa las dag mang pos mthong ba sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa rgya cher bstan/ (22brkog mgo dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi steng du srung mas bskyal bas mtshon mthu stobs kyi snyan grags che/ sne'u rdzong rtse nas bdag po grags pa 'byung gnas kyis ca hu sogs bdag rkyen cher mdzad/ lha sa bsam yas sogs gnas chen rnams mjal zhing che dgu kun gyis btud de zang zing gi 'phrin las rgyas par gyur/ sngar drung chen rin po ches sa skya'i mnga' thang bsdus pa'i zhar la lug pa lung pa'i stong skor gyi sde rnams kyang gshor zhing zhal ngo 'di gnyis kyi thog khag gsum du gyes pa'i 'jig rten gyi 'byer kha cher ma byung zer/yab sangs rgyas rdo rje dang yum rdo rje dpal ba gnyis kyi sras su zur khrag 'thung tshe dpal mgon po 'brungs/ zur bu che shākya 'byung gnas kyi sku'i skye ba yin/ ka bzhi gdung brgyad kyi mkhas pa sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas yab chos kyis gtsos sngags gsar rnying mang du sbyangs/ rje sgrol ma pa sangs rgyas rin po che la sgyu 'phrul tshe bdag gshed dmar zhus shing sgrol ma ba'i 'phreng skor bco lnga la mkhas par gyur/ tsags bla ma dang gnyags bsod nams bzang po la yang dag gi skor gsan/ rje btsun ma don grub bzang mo la bka' gter gyi chos mtha' yas pa zhus shing khyad par 'od gsal sgrol ma drug pa'i chos bdag tu dgongs te/ g.yung ston sangs rgyas kyi rdo rje sems pa'i thugs kyi me long / rgyal sras chos rje'i maṇ+ḍal chen mo/ rje btsun ma nyid rang gi 'khrid/ dbang ngo sprod kyi chas tshang ma gnang nas thig le gsang skor gyi bdag por bskos/ gdan sar bzhugs nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ 'byung po skad ngan tser re 'dul ba dang dgra bo bstan srung gi zhal du dmar stob mdzad pa'am mngon spyod (23na〉pa nang byan chud/ paṇa chen sku mched kyi yab 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs mkhas grub kyi slob ma mang du byung /bla ma 'di'i gcung rdo rje tshe dpal ni/ gzhon nu'i dus klog yig rang shugs kyis mkhyen na'ang ri dwags rngon pa sogs thugs spyod rtsings par yab kyis zhi drag gi thabs du mas dka' spyad la —32

zur r+sā thams༅ mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanabacur bas sdig sgrib rnams byang ste thugs blo las su rung zhing 'khrid khang du rdzogs chen gsang skor gyi bla ma rnams zhal gzigs shing e ka dza ṭi sogs kyis 'phrin las sgrub par khas blangs/ rang byung gi rtogs pa nang nas brdol ba bla ma'i bka' drin du mkhyen pas gzhan don gyi skabs ma gtogs tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa'i dam bca' mdzad/ rdzogs chen gyi sgo nas gdul bya mang po smin grol la bkod cing khyad par gshin rje'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag sum cu tsam mdzad pas mthu stobs kyi snyan pa che/ drug cu rtsa gcig pa la gshegs pa'i dus me tog gi char/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur/ rtsibs shar gyen bsgreng sogs kun gyis mthong ba dang las dag gi snang ngor sangs rgyas byang sems lha'i bu bu mo mang pos bskor nas mngon dga'i zhing du gshegs pa mthong / mi ma yin rnams kyis zla gcig gsol ba btab pas gzugs med pa'i sgrar bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs zer ba byung /bla ma 'di dang byang sems chos skyong dam pa la sras zur shākya dpal 'byor/ zur mkhyen mchog sirnyi pha la/ zur ārla rat+na gsum 'khrungs pa'i gcen ni gzhen nu'i dus nas klog yig dka' tshegs med par mkhyen sngags 'chang hor mgon la nyer mkho'i chos skor dang zur hwa ma yab sras la yab chos rnams gsan/ na (23ba tha za' phying pa nag po zhig gsol ba dang kha mchu mang du langs pasayul mi rnams kyis kha mchu nag por btags/ rin spungs nas bka' brkyan gyi rnam pa byung ba rkyen ngan grogs shar gyi tshe bdag mchod rten gyi sgrub pa dang phur pa lo gsum du bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs/ gshin rje dang phur pa'i nus mthu la mnga' brnyes pas/ /e ma lo gsum bar du sgrub khang zhwa bzhin gyon/ /bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bsrangs/ /tshogs 'khor bstod bskul ma nor gzhung bzhin byas/ /de yi 'bras bu bskyar rtogs zung 'brel thob/ /'di phyi'i skyabs gnas blo gtad sus zhus la/ /mthu dbang ster ba'i rdor gzhan nga yin snyam/ /log lta'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod pa'i dus/ /sgrol byed bshan pa'i sngags nag nga yin snyam/ /tshe lung khrus lung rnam shes rdo rjer gsal/ /sbyor ba'i dus su sangs rgyasang yin snyam/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang don la gnas/ /'gro —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)don 'phrin las shin tu 'phel pha rgod bsod nams bzang po dang chag lo rin chen chos rgyal sogs la sngags gsar rnying gi chos mang du gsan/ rin po che zi sna kun bzang rtse ba chos kyi 'byung gnas/ston pa shāka rdor/ khra ri rin po che/ gcung gnyis sogs zhal slob mkhas grub mang du thon/ khyad par gcung gnyis dang sras shākya rat+na lcam sring la yab chos mtha' dag shin tu 'grus pa gtad rgya'i bar du mdzad/ rin spungs don yod rdo rje'i zhabs phyir yar klungs la byon dus sne gdong gong ma chen po sku ltem par phur dbang phul bas dpon sa sde srid kyi ti shri yin zhes sde dpon kun gyi bla mar gyur/ ngo mtshar pa'i ltas du ma dang bcas te 'og min du gshegs/gcung (24na〉smu bring ba mkhyen mchog sirnyi pha la ni/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta'i bag chags sad pas saṃ skṛ ta'i skad sogs rig gnas la thogs pa mi mnga'/ 'ug pa lung pa nyag phra skabs slar 'di gar 'ong zhes zhal gyis bzhes par grags/ gcung ārla rat+na ni/ sku tshe smad la gsang skor sogs rdzogs chen la nyams len chig dril mdzad/ 'gro don 'phrin las rgya che zhing gshegs pa'i dus pur las mar khu babs pa mtsho ltar 'khyil zhing lha'i bdud rtsi'i ro bro ba byung skad/zur shākya dpal 'byor gyi sras zur shākya rat+na ni gdung brgyud nyag phra bar byung bas bu slob thams cad kyis dga' ston rgya cher mdzad/ bla ma shāka rdor gyi drung du slob sbyang / yab dang zur ārla la yab chos rdzogs par gsan/ 'jig rten gyi tshugs ka ngan par gtsang chen don yod rdo rje'i mnga' thang sgang la rgyab pa'i gtan tshigs lon pas go bcad/ bla ma rat+na'i mtshan can la rdzogs chen gsang skor/rigs 'dzin rgod ldem/ sangs rgyas gling pa/ rat+na gling pa/ mnga' ris mtho lding gi gza' rgod sogs gter chos mang po dang / gzhan yang gnubs chen rat+na shrī/ gnubs rol dpal rdo rje/ dkar chen kun dga' grags pa/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po sogs bsten nas gsar rnying gi chos mang du gsan/ 'gro don che zhing khyad par rin spungs pa'i srung 'khor ba'i gtso bo mdzad/shākya rat+na dang yum rin cen rgyal mo gnyis la 'jam dbyangs rgyal ba'i sras po dang gsang —34

zur wo thams cad mkho pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)bdag nor bu gnyis 'khrungs pa'i gcen mas shākya rdo rje nyi ma dpal bzang por btags/chung ngu'i dus nas 'chams dbyangs cho ga phyag len la shin tu byang / 24bsko ser mdog can gyi lcang ra paṇa wo blo gros bzang po la dge bsnyen dang chos kha yar 0/yang zur hwa ma shākya rat+na/slob dpon tshe ring mgar legs/sgrol ma ba rnam rgyal rat+na/lo ston sogs mang du bsten nas sngags rnying ma bka' gter gyi phyogs la mkhas par sbyangs/gzhis ka rin spungs su mkhas mang 'tshogs sar mkhyen pa che ba'i grags pa thon/yab yum gyi sku dgra gdug pa chen po zhig mngon spyod kyis bsgral/lha sabs ma yas sogs bod kyi gnas chen rnams mjal bar phyin/gdan sa'i 'dzin skyong la brtson zhing 'phrin las che/gcung gsang bdag nor bu ni chung ngu'i dus nas byang sems chos skyong dpal mo'i bag chags sad de mkhyen pa yangs/gzungs ston grags pa la cho ga phyag len gar 'chams sogs sbyangs/gter wo chos kyi rgyal po lha bas legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje/gcen dang zur mo tso r+pā mas gtsos bla ma mang du bsten nas gsang sngags rnying ma la mkhas par gyur/rin spungs zhal ngo nang mtshams kyi dge skyon la brten zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jigs grags gzigs phyogs ma legs pasadrung 'khor ma rungs pas brnyas par chos skyong gi rtags mtshan bstan/'brug pa pad+ma dkar posa'abrong rtse rgyal byed tshal 'debs pa'i sa 'dul ba mdzad/rje pad+ma dkar por mos pa chen po thob bsa'abrug lugs kyi chos mang du gsan/dur khrod bas mtha' sogs dben pa bsten nas drag dmar gyi grub pa brnyes/brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa skyong ba'i rnal 'byor pa mdzad bzhed kyang gtsang stod sde pa dme mthu stobs pa'i bla mchod srung 'khor la bsam grub rtser bzhugs//25na po pon sa yar rgyab mar sring 'bebs mdzad pas bsgo phun tshogs rnam rgyal 'brungs/de mtshungs mchog dman kun la 'gro phan gyi 'phrin las rgya che gshegs khar zur bstan 'dzin rdo rjer rig pa gcigs bzung la o rgyan sgoms shig zer ba'i gsal 'debs kyis gsung ba ltar dgung lo don lnga pa la zangs mdog

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she dpal rir byon/mched gnyis kyi jo mo rdo rje rgyal mo la sras zur dbang phyug rdo rje/ zur don yod rdo rje/ zur rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ zur dpal mgon rdo rje/ zur shākya grags pa/ zur pad+ma rgyal po ste mched drug byung pa'i dang po ni/ thugs rab che zhing yig chos cho ga phyag len rnams tshegs chung ngus mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu gsum la bsam grub rtser 'chams bshad byang ba dang 'chams mkhas pa'i grags pa thon/ rgyas ba'i sras po la yab chos rnams gsan be+e ro sgrub phug tu lo gsum gyi ring mtshams bcad/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug la phur dbang gsan/ rigs 'dzin bdud 'joms rdo rje chu bo rir bzhugs pa'i dus byon nas yun ring po'i bar zhabs 'bring du bcar te gdams pa mtha' yas pa dang byang theg mchog gling du chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal la dbang chos mang du gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma mkhas grub du ma bstan/ kong por byon skabs chos 'khor rgyal du thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshor phur pa'i dbang phul/ dwags kong tshor 'gro don rgya che ba'i ngang nas shangs rdo rje gling du thugs khur bzhes nas bzung dpal mgon/ bram byams mgo ba/ dges lung pa/ ri sbug pa/ dgon sa rab/ glan nya tshal ba/ rtsegs pa dgos skyes la sogs pa sngags 'chang mang du 'dus par mchog (25ba)sprul legs ldan rdo rjes 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo gnang bas bstan pa'i nyi 'od brdal/ rang nyid kyis sgom sgrub dang slob ma rnams la 'chad nyan gyi 'gro don che/ slob ma'ang kyi ston tshe ring dbang po/zur bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ dpal mgon dbang phyug sogs gzhan phan nus pa mang du byung / zur rdo rje rgyal mtshan yi dam lhas rjes su bzung nas mtshan ma khyad par can brnyes/zur dpal mgon rdo rje ni mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje dang yab sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas mkhas grub tu gyur cing gdan sa bskyangs/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi sras zur bstan 'dzin rdo rje ni gsung rab spyi dang tha snyad rig pa sogs la'ang mkhyen pa yangs/ sngags rnying ma bka' gter gyi dbang lung 'khrid man ngag sgrub pa 'phrin las la nang byan chud/ khyad par kyi ston tshe ring dbang po la —36

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)rigs 'dzin chen po nas brgyud pa'i mdo dbang gsan pa'i phyag phyir bla chen chos rgyal rdo rje yod pasade la khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen pos gsan/ des mchog sprul pad+ma 'phrin las la phul bas de la brten nas dbus gtsang khams gsum du rnam par dag pa'i dbang rgyun gyis khyab/ bar skabs su spyan 'grib pa zab phur byon dus mi dkar po zhig gis ras kyis zhal khyim phyis pa zhig mnal lam du byung ba de nas zhag shas song tshe rang byer song ba slob dpon chen po'i byin rlabs su thugs nges mdzad/shing phag sog po ar sa lang gi dmag yar 'brog la brgyags skabs rigs 'dzin yol mo pa chen po pa rnam du sog bzlog mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi mthar sngags pa 'ug pa lung pas dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad btang ba yin zer nas mi mgo mang po spungs pa gzigs pas sku rim do dam (26na)bde 'byor byang pa 'phel 'phel la ltas 'di bzhin byung bas sog po de bas gnod par mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan gsungs pa sogs dam can las su 'khol ba'i mthu rtsal che bar grags/de sras zur tshe dpal nyi ma bzang po/ zur yang phur tshe bdag rdo rje/ zur shākya shes rab gsang bdag bstan 'dzin dbang po dang gsum byon zur shākya shes rab kyi sras zur tshe dbang bstan 'dzin nyi ma bzang po dang zur mthu stobs dbang po mched gnyis/ de gnyis kyi sras zur shākya bstan 'dzin bsod nams dpal 'byor bzang po sogs nya ri 'ug pa lung pa dang yangs pa'i gsang sngags gling gnyis ga'i gdung brgyud gzhung ma chos srid gnyis ldan du yod cing mkhyen mchog shākya 'byung gnasakyi sras bla ma pha la sku mched nas yang dben dang gsang sngags gling sogs su 'phel nyid de dag las 'phros pa'i gdung brgyud la la dben pa bsten pa dang gnas nges med du byon pa nas la stod lho brag dang skyid shod tshor mched pa'i la stod du spang bde legs rgyal mtshan zhes mkhas grub 'gran zla dang bral ba de nas gdung 'phel/)lho brag tu zur dwangs ma ba bstan 'dzin 'gyur med kyis mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po dang rlungs nor bu dbang rgyal sogs dam pa du ma bsten nas rnying ma bka' gter phyogs la dbyis phyin —37—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)par sbyangs/ khyad par mngon spyod kyi skor la rtsal du thon pas rlungs rigs rab brtan dbang po dang gung ru dbyangs dpon pa sogs zhal slob mthu stobs can mang du byung / skyid shod phyogs su mched pa ni gdung brgyud gcig dbus kyi gnas rnams mjal bar byon pa'i bsam yas su bzhugs skabs skyid shod du dgon gnas btab na 'gro don yong (26ba tha'i mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin rgod dkar la thog nas gzigs pas skyid shod thang pa'i mda' de lung bstan gyi gnas yin par mkhyen kri lung dgon btab nas bzhugs pas bla ma kri lung par grags/ bu slob mang du 'dus par sgyu 'phrul yang phur gshin rje sogs rnying ma bka' gter gyi chos rgya cher gsungs gzhan phan gyi 'gro don che bar byung /de la sras rigs 'dzin thang pa 'byungs gzhen nu'i dus yig chos sgrub 'phrin sbyong ba dang yab kyi chos rnams bum pa gang byo lta bur gnang / rgyal sngon lcags zhu sogs kyi ser srung dang grong chog gi 'phrin las che bar byung / gzims khang gsar du brtsigs nas phur sgrub mdzad pas grub rtags mang du thon/ khyad par rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub brnyes pas 'phan yul zing pa stag mgo nas gzims khang gi bar du nyin 'khor btang ba'i kun ya mtshan gyi gnas su 'dzin/ gzims khang la phur sgrub khang du grags de'i sras zur dhi ngam gyis yang phur gshin rje sogs chos bka' rnams yab la gsan/dgun phur sgrub khang dang dbyar 'byom chu rigs brgyud kyi ser ba bsrungs/ lo lo bzhin phur sgrub mdzad par gshegs rgyu'i lo ser bsrung la phebs gdong phur chu rnams la gsol 'debs smon lam mdzad nas phyir byon pa'i rjes su sras phur zhig lhungs byung ba na bza' la 'khril ba yin nam snyam yar skyal bar chas pa na da lo 'brom stod la 'gro dgos yod ces phur pas gsung byon pas gdan drangs/ phur pa gsung 'byon ma da lta'ang yod/jo mo skyid dpal zer ba la sras zur lhun grub rdo rje 'khrungs/ chung ngu nas yab gshegs pas ser srung yum gyis mdzad/ sras dgung lo brgyad pa'i (27na)dus 'bri gung pa'i ti se'i ri la 'gro mkhan —38

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)dang sbrags nas sa skyar phur pa'i dbang zhu bar byon pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug gdan sar phur sgrub mdzad pa'i rgyal mo bsdams pa dang der phebs pa 'grig /slar yang shes pas rten 'brel legasazhes zhal gyis bzhes nas phur pa'i dbang dang 'brel ba'i yig cha'i lung gnang / ri pa log mi dang 'grogs nas lug bya lung du byon/ yab chos ci rigs gsan/ gnas rnams zhib par mjal te 'brom stod du phebs/ dur khrod klu mos rgyal du lo gsum gyi bar phur pa chig dril du bsgrubs lo gsum rdzogs par nye ba'i nub cig sgo'i thad du 'od dmar lam me ba zhig byung ba ci yin nam snyam gzigs tsa na me dpung chen po'i dbus na dpal rdo rje gzhen nu zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa khra lam gyisagazigs pa'i mus la 'ur sgra dang bcas nam mkha'i mthongs su gshegs song bas rab dngos su zhal ston pa'i bsnyen rtags mchog tu gyur cing yi dam lhas rjes su bzung bas mthu stobs nus pa shin tu che/ sgrub 'phrin gyi las gang mdzad thog kho nar 'gro ba'i chu lho byang gi khengs rlomes can rnams kyang spo bos mthu byed du 'ong zer nas brnyas bcos byed mi nus/ rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi gsung las kyang spo bo de ri mo sogs phyag bde ba zhig mi 'dug /nus mthu zur pa'i gdung brgyud phyis byung ba ni shas che zhes bsngags brjod kho na mdzad/ zing pa stag mgo'i gdan sar snang gsal nas rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po'i rnam sprul kun dga' che mchog phebs pa dang 'grig ste mjal bar byon/rin po che rnying ma gter ma'i skor la mkhas grub shin tu che bas yun (27ba)ring por bsten nas bka' brgyad bde 'dus/ gter kha gong 'og gi log tri/nā ga raka/ 'char /tshe bdag me'i spu gri/ khro chu sogasaganubs lugs skor/ mkha' 'gro snying rtag dang yang rtag khyab 'a sun lhar/ rat+na gling pa'i phur pa/ rtan ga/ma ning / dri med lhun po'i rlung dmar/ pad+ma gling pa'i gu ru zhi drag /po glu gling pa'i thos grol/ 'bri gung pa'i gter gsar dgongs pa yang zab sogs dbang lung 'khrid rgya cher gsan/ yi dam gyi lha rnamasal bsnyen sgrub mang du mdzad/ khyad par nā ga ra ka'i sgo nas phyag rgya thengs gsum spos pas thugs rusache ba'i tshad du phyin/ sku mas bkren par rat+na gling pa'i rnam sras mdung dmar can gyi sgrub pa mdzad —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)pas zhal dngos su bstan nas sbyin pa phyogs med du thongs longs spyod yong gsungs pa bzhin grong chog la byon pa'i 'bul ba dang skyes ma kun dbul po'i ris la 'phangs med du btang bas 'byor pa che bar byung / yer pa zla ba phug tu mtshams mdzad tshe chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gnas gzigs pa la phebs pa'i gnas 'brel gyi dus spo bos rdor sems snying tig gi gsol 'debs gsungs pa gsan nas khyod kyis theg pa'i yang bcud thob pa e yin dri ba gnang bar ma thob zhus par khyod kyis 'don pa'i gsol 'debs de gang gi yin gsungs par rdor sems snying tig gi yin zhus par 'o mang po khyod kyis ming gi rnam grangs ma shes 'dug /bla ma su la zhus gsung bar rgod phrug snyan brgyud ras par thos tshul zhus pas dgos phebs pa bzhin sku mtshams khog nas dbang lung 'khrid rnams phul/zhabs drung rin po cher yang chos 'brel gsan/ sku dgra'i ris la rlung 'khor dang mnan (28na)gtad sogs las sbyor gyi sgo nas tshar bcad pa'i phyag rjes kyang mang du snang /dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgyar/ rnal 'byor rba gsal ye shes dbyangs khyod kyang : snga ma'i las bzang 'di la spyod byed cing : 'di yi smon lam mthu la brten nas kyang : yang cig skye 'ga' brgyud pa'i yang phyi la: 'gro ba'i don rtsa 'brom zhes bya ba'i yul: mi 'gyur rdo rje ye shes dbyangs kyi mtshan: ngang tshul bzang po legs pa'i blo dang ldan gtsug lag khang skyong de la brten nas kyang :rlabs chen spyod pas 'gro ba 'dren thabs ston ya ka me dpal rlung gi 'khor lo sgyur rdzu 'phrul ston byed bstan pa skyong ba 'byung : de phyir rgyud mar rim bzhin 'gro ba 'dren: zhes yul mtshan mdzad pa sogs kyis yid ches pa'i lung bstan gyis zin par snang /'di nyid la sras lnga byon pa'i che ba zur chen gzhen nu don grub ni chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis rigs 'dzin ku mā rā dza'i skye ba yin zhes lung bstan/ chung ngu nas yi ge 'dri klog mkhas par mkhyen/ thugs gnyer gyi tshe lha gdong sngags 'chang ches gcig dpal 'byor gyis brnyas bcos se ba byed 'dug pas lha gdong pa mtshams kyi tshe rmi lam du bud med cig gis shel gyi sam ṭa zhig 40

zur r+sā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ tanabastan nas khyod kyis slob dpon gyi sras la brnyas pa byed pa zhig 'dug pa mi rigs zer bar sam ṭar bltas pas khri srong lde btsan gyis sras mo lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi zhal zla ma dpal mtsho/ de nas yer par rigs 'dzin ku mā rā dza sogs yin tshul 'dug pas de nas bzung dad mos che bar byed/rtsis dkar nag dang lha ris phul du phyin pa sbyangs/ yab la nyer mkho'i chos dang gdams pa zhus/snang (28bskos la ba rin po che kun dga' tshe mchog la gter kha gong 'og /rgya zhad khrom/ o rgyan gling pa/ las 'brel rtsal/ sangs rgyas gling pa/ rat+na gling pa/ pad+ma gling pa/ skadze gling pa/ rje 'bri gung pa gnam lcags me 'bar gyi gter chos sogs gter kha mang po dang / klong chen pa'i dgongs gter gyi dbang 'khrid lung man ngag phyag len mtha' dag zhib par gsan/ lha sras rgyal po'i rnam sprul 'bri gung zhabs drung chos rgyal phun tshogs/ byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po/ rje btsun bon mkhar ba mi tre byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ sde pa snang rtse ba nam mkha' tshe brtan rgyal po/ stag lung zhabs drung ngag dbang rnam rgyal sogs ris med kyi bla ma mang por gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos du ma dang khyad par be+e ro tsa na'i rnam sprul 'phrang mgo gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi grol tig gi chos bdag tu ngos bzung gter gsar gyi skor rdzogs par gnang / de'i tshe gter srung gi lhongs kyis slo bur du bsnyun zhing mtshan mo dngos nyams 'dres par khrag gi rba klong du sku gzugs g.yengs pa lta bu'i cho 'phrul byung bar gter ston gyis gtor bsngos dang gter srung gi srog gtad mdzad pas rang zhir song / 'tshub de yang bstan skyong rdo rje gshog rgod ma'i zhal gzigs pa'i sngon 'gror 'dug /rin po che kun dga' tshe chog gi zhabs 'bring du lo mang bcar ba'i chos lhag ma rnams kyang bum pa gang byor gsan pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yin zhing thugs dam thang kha 'bri ba sogs spyod lam gyi sgo nas kyang bla ma mnyes par mdzad/ gtso po thos bsam sgom gsum la brtson pas thugs sras su byung / rin po che sku bshegs (29na)dus gdung la sku 'dra dang ring bsrel dpag med byung ba'i gtso bo dbu thod bam ril la skyon rin po che/ tshe chog /thugs rje chen po sogs rang byon phebs pa'i bzhugs gnas gser gdung —41

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherin po che bzheng bas mtshon gshegs rdzong rgyas par sgrub pa'i do dam mdzad/gung ru dbyangs dpon pa dpal ldan grags pa sde pa yug sngags 'chang dang zur dar ma ba bstan 'dzin 'gyur med gnyis nas brgyud pa'i sdeb gshor rlung gsum gza' gdong dmar nag gtad sel dbye bskrad sogs mngon spyod kyi las mtha' mang po'i dbang lung phyag khrid la zhib par sbyangs pas dus thog der dbus gtsang gi ljongs su zla med kyi sngags 'chang du gyur/ yar gtsang skur gsum mnga' thang sgang la rgyab pa'i skyid shod lung pa phal cher yang bzung ba'i shugs kyis dge lugs yon mchod mdzad dka'i tshe thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtshos thugs khur bzhes te bstan pa'i spyi rim mang du mdzad skabs rab 'byams pa bsod grags pa sogs za zi'i khrom 'dul gyi sngags rlom du ma yod na yang gung ru dbyangs dpon pa khrag 'thung ye shes rdo rje dang chabs gcig par 'grul med kyi las sbyor gnad du bsnun te yar rgyab pa dpon blon la rtags mtshan 'gyangs med du bstan pa'i zhal po dang lag len 'phrugs par brten bdag rkyen che ba dang mtshan rigs 'dzin 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu gsol/ sku yon dang mthu stobs phan tshun 'gran bzhin pas stod smad kun gyi bla'i mchod gnas su bkur/ dgung lo don dgu pa la rigs 'dzin gyi gral du gshegs so/ /kun bzang thugs rje'i 'od zer lha yi bur/ /yongs shar (29bsni(da lnga'i lam las nyer babs te/ /grags pa'i mu khyud nye dbang tshogs bcas kyi/ /bsod nams zhing du rnam rgyal khang rtser byon/ /phyogs lhung gdon gyis snying btab lha min dpung / /legs ldan nag po khros pa'i g.yul ngo mā /srog sogs mgo lus ga khu bas pa'i khrag gi rgyun/ /gaṅgā'i klung chen des kyang bsgrun nus min/ /'phags bod 'dzin mar 'od gsal lha yi gdung / /zur rigs sngags 'chang mu thi la yi 'phreng / /rim byon rnam dag brjod pa'i srad bu la/ /brgyus 'di blo ldan mgrin pa'i rgyan du longs/ /dam pa 'di nyid ni chos rgyal mes dbon gyi dus dbus gtsang ru bzhir grags pa'i dbu ru'i sa'i cha sa hor mchod yon gyi dus khri skor bcu gsum du phye ba'i tshe hor dga' bde bzang po dang si tu —42

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)smon lam rdo rje khu dbon gyis bdag mdzad pa'i/ tshal pa khri skor gyi char gtogs shing de'i nang gses sa skyong bkra shis rab brtan gyis brag dkar 'dam ra man chad skyid shod du ngos bzung ba'i dge bcu tshang ba'i yul gru de yang/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tsho gis bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can de yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa byi rnams rigs su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyi don bsgrubs te/ /longs spyod tshe dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod ldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag po de yang 'grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid bya/ /zhes chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod yul 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che srol gtod pa'i tshe/ lha ldan sprul (30na)pa'i gtsug lag khang dang ra mo che gnyis kyi ga rjo la shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang chen po bzhedas pa'i sa yul phyogs 'dir mdzad pa'ang / /bka' gdams glegasabam rin po cher/ mi kho la nyen mongs mi mnga' yang / /nga 'jig rten sgrol ma zag med la/ /mi kho yi btsun mo byed do skad/ /rgya nag po'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbus su byed do skad/ /sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad yul gyi dbus/ /gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phub pa'i 'og /phyogs bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa'i sa/ /gnas phun sum tsho gos pa dam pa'i yul/ /mi khyod kyi zhing khams dam pa yin/ /gnas de ru las can dpag med 'du/ /chos bde stong rol pa'i glu len cing / /nyams bkra shis bde bar skyong ngo zhes/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar lha sa lte bar byas pa'i steng gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad/ /'og sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ logs bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi ri mo mngon par gsal ba phun tshogs dge mtshan dang ldan pa'i nor 'dzin gyi cha 'brom chu rigs kyi brgyud du yang srid bzung ba'ang gong du zhakhyungs rabs kyi rim pa smos pa'i rjes ma drung pa dkon mchog rin cen zhes rgya ma khri dpon pa'i rigs las gter ston kun dga' dpal bzang gi gdung brgyud kun dga' tshe mchog gi gcung du gyur pa des zing pa dang snang gsal gyi gdan sa lo shas mdzad cing gdung brgyud spel/—43

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i chos rgyun 'dzin pa rje pad+ma gar dbang 'bri gung du bka' chos zhu bar byon pa'i rdzong gsar gyi mdun du sgar mdzad bzhugs pa'i sar rat+na gling pa'i gter chos rnams gsan par byon pa'i tshe zangs kyi dbang phyug mi (30ba)tshad tsam khur ba rdzong nas dpal 'bri gung gi chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi gzigs snang la shar bas mi ma gis 'di 'dra zhig khur zhes nye 'khor ba rnams la gsungs/ pad+ma gar dbang gis drung par dbang lung mang po dang khyad par lha chen gyi skor rdzogs par gnang / rat+na'i phyag nas kyi dbang rten byin rlabs su stsal bar brten gdul bya'i 'ur langs/ lha sa bsam yas rwa sgreng 'bri gung mthil sogs su dkar me skor chen gyi mchod sprin mang du mdzad pa'i rjes ma lha sar phebs dus yar lam mar lam gnyis ka 'brom stod du bzhugs nas gter chos du ma dang / khyad par rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i rlung zhags kyi dbang lung tshang bar gnang bas deng sang brgyud pa'i gtso bo'ang 'di skor 'dren/ rigs 'dzin lhun grub rdo rje la ra dzi'i phyag nas ma'i dbang brten gnang nas 'di nga'i skye ba rjes ma la sprod rgyu e yong ltos gsungs/ khyed kyi sras po'i jo mo 'di mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags dang ldan par 'dug ces mnyes mnyes dang bcas mdzo mo zhig gi gnang sbyin mdzad/ zhal ngo rnams kyis phebs skyel zhus skabs nged rang rnams myur du thug pa'i smon lam byed ces don gyis sku skye bzhes pa'i lung bstan/yar byon nas dam sel zhig gis sku gshegs pa skye ba g.yin gyis bar ma chod par yang srid 'dzin par sngon du phyogs pa'i tshe yum gyi mnal lam du/ nyi zla shar ba mkha' la 'phur ba/ lo tog dang shing tog rgyas pa/ lus sems la sngar med pa'i dga' bde khyad par can byung ba dang mthun par yab zur gzhen nu don grub dang / yum mkha' 'gro'i mtshan ldan yid 'dzin gnyis kyi sras su khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug (31na)gi lor yum la bsnyun pa sogs mi bde ba med pa'i ngang nas sku bltams/ zhabs gom 'debs mkhyen pa dang gsung 'byon pa'i 'go brtsams pa nas sngon gyi bag chags sad de nga 'bri gung du 'gro zhes gsungs par brten rgyab tu gdan drangs nas shar phyogs su —44

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbying sporang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)rgyang tsam re 'byon pa'i stang ka byed dgos pa byung / yab kyis mtshan chos rje nor bur gsol/ me lug dgung lo bzhi pa'i dus mes rigs 'dzin lhun grub rdo rje sku gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la snang gsal nas rin po che ngag dbang ye shes grub pa gdan drangs pa'i tshe sngon chad thugs rgyus med kyang thugs 'tsher snang ye med par rin po che'i sku pang du yang yang byon/ phyag dril la 'a sdus nas 'di nga'i dril bu yin gsungs pas khong dpon slob thugs rtog thos nas dril mangs dang bsres te khyed rang gi dril bu long gsungs pa na zhabrul med du ngos bzung nas nga rang gi 'di yin zhes bdag 'dzin gyi tshul mdzad pa na thugs yid ches te drung pa dkon mchog pa'i sku skyer ngos 'dzin mdzad/ tshe dbang hriḥ gcig ma dang bla ma zhi drag gi dbang sogs ci rigs gnang / dril bu stsal ba de la rgya dril kha chag gi ming thogs/ gzhan yang snang gsal dang lhang lhing gi gnas tshulu/ sngon gnas sad pa'i yid ches mang du gsungs pas sku skye yin min gyi brtag dril sogs ma dgos/ de nas rim gyis phyag bris 'bri klog rnams brda bstan pa tsam gyis mkhyen par ma zad sngags lung rjes su brel po ma yin pa'i nyan pa po'i rna bar lhon pa la po ti tshad ma tsam nyin re 'dril ba la ha cang gis grul pa mi dgos shing lu3 wartu/ga smi ra/ nā ga ra/ rgya mtsho mthas mtshon rgya (31ba)yig lus 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu gsum tsam/ hor yig gsar rnying / bod kyi gzab shur/ o rgyan zi chen zi chung sogs gter kha du ma'i brda yig gisamatshon pa'i yig rigs rnams gzugs legs shing brda dag phul du phyin/ yab kyis pol du nyer mkho'i sgrub 'phrin gyi lung gnang / bla ma zhi drag /zhi khro/ bka' brgyad/ yang zab/ khro chu sogs chog 'phrin chos spyod kyi ris 'phral gyi nyer mkho mtha' dag byang chub/thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo snang gsal du rigs 'dzin chen po ngag dbang ye shes grub par dbu skra gtsug phud phul ba'i mtshan ngag dbang bkra shis kun dgar gsol/ dbang rjes gnang dang ljags lung nyer mkho stsal/ lhang snying mor phebs dus mchod gshom 'og tu nga'i lham yod gsungs par btsal ba zhabs phyag la thar po zhig rnyed pas thams cad yid ches/ yang gtor sgam 'og tu sngar —45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesprul zhig yod pa da e yod dam gsungs nas bsngogs pas sprul dkar po zhig don nas sku pang du stod/ sku gong ma'i gsang yum gyi pang du'ang snga mo'i dus bzhin bsdad song bas der 'khod rnams bla ma dran pa'i dad dungs kyis mchi ma 'don pa dang lus kyi ba spu ches cher ldang bar gyur/chu byi lo zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar byed pa rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po rgya ha ka ling tse bar gyi rgyal khams phyogs med kyi gdul bya'i 'gro don la bzhugs sgar bteg nas phebs pa'i mkha' rog shan khar yab sras lhan rgyas su mjal bar byon pas rigs 'dzin chen po rgod ldem gyi dag snang tshe gur sbrags ma'i bka' dbang gnang / sku skye 'di gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan pa la phan thogs chen po zhig yod (32na)pas gtsang sbra dang do dam chen po gyis zhes yab la bslab bya dang bka' bsgo phyag mdud dam rdzas sogs rgyas par bstsal/ dgung lo lnga drug nas gzugs 'gros 'bri ba'i tshe ri mo'i ris rang shugs kyis mkhyen pa'i klong brdol ba ltar dgung lo dgu bcu nas yab kyis thig rtsar bcur ba'i lha bris phul ba tshegs chung ngus mkhyen cing / rjes su chos kyi 'phrin las che drags pa'i gnang long mi yong ba ma gtogs zhi khro'i sku gang la'ang lhongs shin tu che zhing nyid bkod sogs che phra tshang mar nyams dod pas lha bris chos dbyings su grags pa'i khengs pa can gyis kyang khong gi bla ma ma mdzad par nged tsho ltar ri mo nyag bskyangs na sman thang 'jam dbyangs lta bu'i 'gran zla dang bral ba kho na yong rgyur 'dug ces gleng / khams pa kun dga' rtse mo dang 'bri gung phyogs nas dar ba'i byed sgrub kyi lnga bsdus sgra gcan/ 'o1 'pho zla 'pho/ mgyogs rtsis/ rgya nag gi spor thang gi rdel 'grems sogs kyang yab kyi drung du gsan/shing yos mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gung ru dbyangs dpon pa khrag 'thung ye shes rdo rje'i drung du chos dbang gi rlung las byed/ rat+na'i stobs ldan rlung 'khor/ bram ze sdom pa bzang po'i rlung 'khor/klu sgrub kyi byang chub rlung 'khor/ dri med lhun po'i rlung dmar/ be+e ro'i nye 'byed rlung 'khor/ 'bro lo'i rlung nag /rta mgrin gsang 'dus kyi mngon spyod skor/ sngags sdeb snying gzer nag po/ rgyas sdeb snying —46

zur 'a thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ (tanagi me long / dregs pa nyi shu/ khra mo brag gi gza' gdong dmar nag sogs drag sngags kyi rigs mang du gsan/shing yos dgung lo bcu gnyis tsam nas rin po che ngag dbang ye shes grub pa'i zhabs (32ba)drung du bcar te zim pa/ snang gsal/ byi phyi lung pa/ zur du brag dkar sogs su bla ma mnga' bdag chen po'i gter byon bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i dbang / rgyud lung nyi shu/ 'phrin las che 'bring / khro bo rol pa'i skor sogs rgyab brten gyi lung / gzhan yang lasa'abrel rtsal gyi mkha' 'gro'i snying tig /klong chen pa'i yang tig /pad gling pa'i bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho/bla med bdun/ bka' srung / drag dmar/ tshe dpag med rdo rje 'phreng ba/ da rma gling pa'i zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol/ gter sgrom nas chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs kyi gdan drangs pa'i yang zab kyi dbang chen dbang phran sogs phal cher sgrub chen dang 'brel ba/ sgrub skor gyi lung / rdzogs chen gyi nyams su da/gzhan yang tshe bdag me'i spu gri/ gshin rje khro chu/ phyag rdor dregs 'dul/ 'char ka nyang lugs/ gter mgon phyag bzhi pa/ gshin rje sha zan 'bar ma/ rat+na gling pa'i dpal mgon ma ning sogs gter kha sna tsho gis kyi dbang lung man ngag mang du gsan/ bde 'dus kyi me rtag dbus che mchog la babs bla ma dang tshe dpag med sogs nub phyogs su babs pas gsang mtshan pad+ma dbang rgyal dang / dbang gi grong khyer/ thos grol gyi gsang mtshan chos dbyings rang grol sogs mtshan mang du snang / phyag chen lnga ldan/ gcod kyi dbang 'khrid dang / tshog bka' gzhan yang 'ga' zhig gsan/ snang gsal lugs kyi cho ga phyag len gar thig dbyangs sogs dbyis phyin par sbyong bar mdzad/ snang gsal ba'i rgyun la lo gsum ma gtong srol yod pas rkyen byas gtso bor nang don dang bsnyen sgrub phugs gzhol bas zing pa stag mgor lo gsum (33na)phyogs gsum gnang ba lo gcig gi bar thog mar thun mong gi sems 'dzin sogs phyag chen gyi nyams bzhes cung zad dang gtso bor slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod phreng gi thugs kyi nying khu jo mo mkhar chen bza' la gnang ba'i rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying tig gi ka —47

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)dag lhun grub kyi skor kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams pa'i yang tig gi dgongs pa ltar thugs nyams su bzhes pas kun rdzob kyi chos ma lus pa'i rdzun phug rdib ste rang rig gdod nas dag pa'i kun tu bzang po gcig mthong du thugs su ngo 'phrod/ 'od gsal longs sku'i zhing khams la khor yug tu 'byams pas sngon gnyags ban gyis gling du gyur pa slar yang me dang spra ba'i tshul du bogs chen thon/ snying tig dang thos grol gyis bar do thugs nyams 'og tu chud pas/ paṇa chen shul du tha mal 'byung gzugs ni/ /bzhag pa mang mthong duḥkhas yid skrag nas/ /lam 'di'i sa bcad 'bring po rtsal du gton/ kho bo'i bla ma bar do rnam drug yin/ /zhes gdengs khel gyi gsung yang bstsal/pad gling pa'i bla ma zhi drag phyag rdor dregs 'dul bde 'dus kyi bka' brgyad dril sgrub sogs kyi ljags bsnyen tshad thems dang / nā ga ra ka'i bsnyen pa'i tshe zhag bdun thog tu phyag rgya thebs nas de las yang ba mdzad ma dgos/ khyab 'jug gi bsnyen pa'i dus rwa gzhob kyi dri chil byung ba'i me rlung dmar nag gi khrod na gza' bdud chen po khra lam gyis bstan nas khyod kyi skye rabs kyi chos skyong nga yin zer bas lus zi bun ba zhig byung / g.yu sgron ma'i sgrub pa mdzad pa 'khor ba'i rtags gsal zhing lhan cig phyag g.yog gis snod lus nas gtor ma gshom ma thub (33ba)pas de nub mnal lam du gtor ma ma chag par dgos pa'i brda ston dang / gzhan yang sang nyin mi 'di 'dra 'ong sogs 'byung 'gyur lung mang du bstan/bsnyen sgrub kyi dus rtsa ba gsum gyi dngos nyams su zhal gzigs lung bstan chos 'chad byung ba rnams sbas tshul gyi reg zig dang gzhan la 'phros char ma mdzes pas des khungs 'dri ba'i rngo ma thogs/ rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa'i zhabs phyi gnang nas rtsa ba bzhis dar nā ro ta pa'i rnam sprul 'bri gung zhabs drung bkra shis phun tshogs la log tri'i rig gtad dang 'bri gung dgongs gcig gi lung thor bu gsan/ zing par bzhugs skabs rin po che pa'i sbyin bdag gcig gis sku dgra byas par bla ma'i phyag g.yog mdzad nas dpon slob bdun gyis gshin rje sha zan 'bar ma'i las tshogs mdzad —48

zur r+pā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanapas rtags myur du thon/ zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku za dam nas 'bri gung la phebs rtsis kyis yung thang du bzhugs sgar gnang sar phyag dbang la phebs pas khyod sku skye yin na yon tan la sbyangs pa byed dgos da dung bslab gnyer zhig byas na yong ba'i bka' 'phros dngos su phebs 'dug pa za dam gyi chos gra 'grims na dgongs pa'i mdangs yin pa 'dra/ sgar pa gnang skyong bzang bas gnang sbyin dang bdag rkyen che bar mdzad/ drung pa phun tshogs pa la dbang lung dang gdams pa kha yar dang yab 'khor lo'i dbang phyug la ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ tshe dpag rdor 'phreng / dregs 'dul/ tsa ri zhing skyong /zab chos phyag bzhes dmar 'khrid kyi mtha' rgyas bcad do/ /yang dben dkar mo'i mngal du ma sgrubs kyang / /'phyugs med rigs kyi gaṅgā sa bsrings pa'i bskyed/ /blo (34na)gros gdong drug snga 'gyur smig tshal du/ /na tshod gshon nu'i khye'u rtsed 'jor rol/ /sa lam yon tan cha gang chu shel dbang / /dam pa'i spyod tshul ri dwags rab bkra'i zhan/ /sna tshogasarig byed sa mos kha 'byed pa'i/ /mkhyen yangs zer 'phreng 'gyed la mi ngal spro/ /rnam gsum yo ga'i chu klung mgon khyod zhabs/ /bsil ba'i rgyal mtshan rtag tu lha sngags kun/ /snang bzhin 'byamasaklas gzhan sde sbyin skyes la/ /dogs bral rang bstan 'chi med dga' ston dpyid/ /lcags sprel lo dpon sa stag lung ma gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs la pha bong kha nas rdo rje 'chang dpal 'byor lhun grub gdan drangs/ yab zur chen 'khor lo'i dbang phyug phyi rten gyi bris sku bzheng bar byon pa gdan 'dzom/ sngon nas dpon slob thugs 'dris yod pa'i gsung gleng zhib mol mang por byung ba'i mus nas khyed kyi sras po snang gsal drung pa'i sku skye de chung ngu nas sgom la dril na bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya che ba dka' zhing lhag tu sgyu 'phrul gsang snying 'di la bshad rgyun nyag phra bar 'dug pas rgyud bshad kyi bla skor zhig mdzad na bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa yong bas re zhig nged kyi sar bslab gnyer la thong / der ma zad sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi chos gang dgos byed par spro/ chos la phyogs ris che na bla ma bzang ba dka' las che phebs pa de —49

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)yang rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha ba lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs dang rje 'di nyid gnyags lo tsā bar 'brungs pa'i dus rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i rdo rje'i mched po dang / gzhan yang sku tshe mang por dpon slob tu 'brel zhing rje pha bong kha par lkog gyur gyi chos rnams (34ba)'chags thogs mi mnga' ba'i mngon par mkhyen pas dam pa 'di nyid ris med kyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu son te bstan pa spyi bye brag gi rgyun bzang po spel bar dgongs par mchis/ yab kyi thugs la shin tu 'thad pa bzhin rje nyid 'di gsung gleng mdzad par bla ma la dad pa dang gsan sbyong la spro ba phan tshun 'gran bzhin pa'i yab sras bka' gros mthun te chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po yab yum gsum gyis bod kyi sa 'dul ba'i thog mar sgrub pa mdzad pas rigs gsum mgon po zhal gzigs pa'i gnas pho brang ma ru'am pha bong kha byang chub shing gi nags khrod du dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag 'khon ston chos kyi rgyal po dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi zhabs drung du phebs/ zhal mjal ba tsam gyis mi phyed pa'i dad pa thugs rgyud la 'khrungs/dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes mtshan dpal 'byor 'phrin las rab rgyas su gsol/ ri khrod pa'i dge slong 'ga' zhig gis sku skye sku gzhen zhing thugs rab che bar 'dug pas se ra byes lta bur mtshan nyid kyi thugs gnyer dang grub mtha' dge lugs pa kha gtsang ba 'gab tshul byung ba/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa/ yab 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan sras mnga' ris paṇa chen sogs ston gyi rnying ma'i bla ma du mas mdo phyogs kyi thugs gnyer mdzad cing shes bya'i mtha' rgya gcod pa la'ang gu yangs nyams che bas thugs la mi 'thad pa rang ma byung rung yab zur chen 'khor lo'i dbang phyug mtshan nyid la bzhed pa che ba rang med 'dug cing / rje rdo rje 'chang la snyan 'bul mdzad par/ bka' las khyed kyi thugs rab dang dgung lo sogs sgo du ma nas mdo (35na)phyogs kyi grar zhugs na shogs che nges yong rung / gdung rus dang skye brgyud mtha' dag rnying ma bar song bas rten 'brel gyi dbang gis sngon gyi snga 'gyur ba'i bshes gnyen mdo phyogs la mkhas pa 'ga' zhig byung yang phyogs —50

zur r+sā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanare la brten pa'i 'phrin las rgya cher ma 'phel/ kho bos bslab sbyangs mthar phyin byas pa yin rung nyi ma thang dang byes kyi 'chad nyan khyug tsam zhig byas pa ma gtogs bstan pa'i bya ba blo kha khengs pa'i rgya che ba zhig ma 'grub/ rjes sor byang rtse sogs gdan sa chen po'i ris la shog zer yang de las gnas 'dir sgrub sde zhig tshugs na bod spyi'i bde thabs la phan pa'i lung bstan dang lo rgyus du ma mthong bas lhag bsam rnam dag gis kun nas bslangs te nang don la dril nas bsdad pa yin/ nyid kyang sgyu 'phrul la bslab gnyer zhib pa zhig mdzad nas rtses dang du bstan pa'i rnam gzhag cig mdzod/ de rjes nged kyis thob pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos rnams gsan na phugs bstan pa spyi sgos thams cad la phan pa yong ba'i bslab ston phebs pa don lung bstan du 'dug cing de don kho na dang len gnang /gnas tshul de thos pas gra khrod nas rje bla ma la 'khang ra'i rnam pas skur zhus byed pa byung / 'on kyang drung du bcar bzhugs kyi ngos thugs dam gtor bzhengs dang drung yig sku brnyan 'bri ba sogs phyag g.yog 'phal sel gnang /'di nas bzung dag zhing du ma gshegs bar sku tshe'i rten 'brel du tshe dpag med dang sgrol dkar gyi brgya thang lo lo bzhin phyag bstar nas bzhedas/ gtso bor gnang rgyu'i chos kyang rdo rje 'a sang zur sgro phug pa shākya (35ba〉seng ge'i bag chags sad par ma zad yab 'khon tshe dbang nor rgyas kyi bar du rgyud bshad zam ma chad par yod gshis rtsal bshad la ma ltos par rigs 'dzin rim pa'i gsung rgyun dang mkhyen pa'i klong nas rdol ba zung du 'jug pa'i gsang snying gi brtsi bzhag chos thun gnyis re gnang ba 'dzin gra sogs med pa'i skyon gyis thugs 'dzin dka' tsam byung ba zin bras rgyab e chog zhu ba mdzad par shog bu sum cu tsam la ma slebs par zin bris mdzad na 'jags chen po mi yong bas nged kyis tshod byed gsungs/ skabs shig de tsam ran tshod yin pas tshig zur dag ma dag sogs lta khyad kyis thog kha'i gnam yengs kyi zur nas dgongs mo skyor mdzod phebs pa bzhin gzims chung steng nas bshar sbyang gnang bas da cha zin bris su phob phebs pa bzhin le'u lnga pa yan —51 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyel zin bris shig kyang mdzad/ rgyud yongs rdzogs kyi khyi ka song yang de man gyi reg zig 'phro can du lus/ phyogs nas dbang chos zhu mkhan byung tshad kyi grwar mchod dpon gyi phyag g.yog dang sbrags nas gsan zhing dbang rjes gnang gi phyag len la zin bris btab ste spyan lam du phebs pa 'di 'dra yin na brtsi bzhag kyang thengs res chog pa 'dug ces dgyes pa'i rtser son/ 'di skabs bsnyen rdzogs ma grub pa dang ma nas pha bong khar bslab gral ma gtogs slob mi 'dug rung rdo rje 'chang 'bras spungs tshor phebs pa'i skabs rje 'di nyid tshad ma'i gral 'gor 'jog pa dang rgyun du phyag g.yog gcig la phogs sogs bdag rkyen gzengs bstod pa mdzad/mkhan po shāka gzhen dang slob dpon ye brtson gnyis kyis (36na sngon 'brog mi dang stag lo gnyis rgya gar du brdzangs skabs bstan pa'i gzhi ma yin pas 'dul ba nyon/ /bstan pa'i snying po yin pas sher phyir nyon/ /bstan pa'i nying khu yin pas gsang sngags nyon/ /zhes bslab bya mdzad pa dang / deb sngon du/ de ltar bod yul 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib cher byung mod kyis theg pa chen po gsang sngags ni deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong zhing zhes pa'ang bstan pa dar nub byung zhes pa 'dul ba la ngos bzung pas bstan pa'i rtsa bar dgongs te rje bla ma'i zhabs drung du/ mngal bskol brtsis pa'i dgung lo nyi shu'i dbang du btang ste rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo yang bskyar gyi tshul du dge bsnyen nas bzung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bar dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su rab byung zhu ba nas gsol bzhi'i las kyi bar bsgrub bya gsum kho nar bcad pa'i gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan gyi phyag len 'khrul ba med pa'i steng nas sgrub pa mdzad/ bla ma dam pa'i spyan ltos kyis byin len dang rung chu sogs bcas pa phra mos mtha' brten pa'i bslab pa la gus shing thugs rgyud dul/ 'phral gyi spyod lam tsam gyis kyang bstan rgyun la phan pa'i bag yod kho na lhur bzhes pas gzhan dag kyang nged kyi btsun pa 'di zing pa sku skye 'dra ba zhig byung na zhes tshad du bzung ste yid smon du byed/ gsang snying gi ṭī ka rdzogs nas 'grel pa par khab/ klong chen pa'i phyogs bcu mun sel la gzigs 'jug dang —52

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)sngags gsar ma'i gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud dang sgron gsal la sa bcad mchan bu mtha' gcod sbyar ba'i (36ba/ri grel pa bzhi sbrags su grags pa rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i bzhed srol dri ma med pa dang /rim lnga gsal sgron/ bde mchog sbas don kun gsal/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dus 'khor spyi don dri med 'od rgyan rnams kyi ljags lung dang sbrags pa'i zhib bshad gsan/mkhas grub nor bzang pas mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs/ gsang 'dus kyi khyi rka'i zin bris rags rim thugs blor bzung / rtses dang gi gra skor la las chen pa tshos bstan pa ris med nas/ dri ba sna tshogs yong gi yod 'dug par brten rdo rje 'chang gis thugs rgyus khog nas deb ther sngon po/tshal pa'i deb dmar/ bu ston chos 'byung sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i rnam thar yig tshang /chos ma rga pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i sa lam gyi rnam gzhag /bod du chen po rnam gsum du grags pa'i lta ba'i khyad par/ rig gnas lnga'i spyi bshad/ rlangs kyi po ti bse ru dang chos 'byung mig 'byed 'od stong sogs nas bsdus pa'i phag mo gru pa'i sde srid byung tshul sngags legs sun 'byin du grags pa'i rnying ma gtso bor gyur pa la yin byung gsar ma'i phyogs la'ang 'jams yig dang de lan gyi rtsod spong sogs sna sgor ma nas gzigs rtog mdzod gsung ba bzhin/ phyag dpe mang por gzigs rtog dang rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun zin bris kyi ris kha yar thugs su chud par mdzad nas 'phral 'phral dogs gcod gnang bar brten mdo rgyud kyi chos thams cad la mkhyen pa'i klong rdol ba lta bur gyur/shing pho byi ba'i lo chos gra chen po dpal gyi rtses dang gi dgun chos thog gra skor (37nasgo phebs/ thugs gnyer gnang sa'i stobs kyis lnga mchod bar babs/ gnas tshang gis bshad pa gnang sa'i ka ba de la rdo rje g.yu sgron ma gnas pas gsol mchod gnang ba 'gab tshul zhus pa ltar mchod mjal dang sbrags gsol mchod bzabs rgyas mdzad pas mchod khang nang du phebs dus steng gi dar lcog dang snyan shal rnams g.yo zhing dbu thog tu snyan dar zhig babs pa srung ma dgyes pa'i mtshan mar 'dug ces dkon gnyer gleng / de yang g.yu sgron ma 'di bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan rdo rje g.ya' —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)ma skyong yin zhing gnyan chen po thang lha zur phud lnga pa'i gsang yum gnam mtsho'i rgyal mor yang grags/grol tig gi gter srung rdo rje gshog rgod ma dang zhi khro'i khyad ma gtogs thugs rgyud gcig pas dam pa 'di nyid la shin tu 'go ba zhig yin par snang /sne'u sdong rtse dang rtses dang gtsang gzhung nas bzung ba'i skabs rtses dang 'ong gseb tu cha kha pa'i gnod pa byung ba sngar chos rgyal byang bas 'bag pa ge'i zhabs 'dren zhu mi rnams la tha na skyel gnang ba'i snod rgya mtsho sbug tu chag nas 'phel ba yin pas gzhan gyis bzlog mi nus zhes rdzong dpon drung 'tsho blo rnam pas rdo rje brag nas byang bdag rigs 'dzin bla ma rin po che gdan drangs pa dang 'grig pas sngar sku na phra dus spyan lam du thogs tsam las thugs 'dris che ba med na'ang de skabs phyag 'bul la ched bstad phebs te rgyu mtshan snyan dbang du gsol bar/ sngar rnying ma phyogs la rgyud bshad kyi dar rgyas che'ang dus kyis bstan pa mar 'grib lta bur 'dug pa khyed kyis gsang (36ba)snying la bshad pa mdzad pa shin tu legs zhes dgyes par byung / sngar e brag sna rab 'byams pa la'ang rtsod pa byung 'dug pas da lam yang de ris mi yong ba'i nges pa med pas zon skyor mdzod gsung ba'i bslab ston dang / drung 'khor phyags phyi ba rnams la de ring bar pa 'dra yang mi dgos pa'i nges pa med pas bshad pa'i sar ltad mor rgyug ces phyag g.yog 'phral sel ma gtogs rdzong bda' mdzad pa mngon mkhyen du shar bar mchis/ gsung bshad tshugs gdong de sngon chos sde ba rnams kyis sa gar rnying gsum phyogs mthun pa yin pas sa kur gang rung la 'bab dgos rgyu ma babs pa'i nyes chad lta bur las chen po tshor phyag chos zhes rtsod pa btang bar/ lnga mchod pa rnams kyis de lan 'jal rtsis byas par rje nyid kyis dge 'dun gyi dbyen du gyur na skabs su mi babs/ kho bo phyag 'tshal ba la mi 'tsher gsungs nas phyag mdzad pas rtsod pa chos thog tu zhi/ gsung bshad brjod bya'i don bzang zhing rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor 'jebs pa las tshan pa rnams kyis mdo sngags tha snyad gang la dri ba zhus kyang lan thogs med du 'brel chags kho na mdzad pas sku yon dang mkhyen rab kyi grags pa thon/ phyag phreng gi —54

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)thag pa chad pa 'di 'dra'i ris la 'phrin las che ba'i rten 'brel yong zhes gleng / lnga mchod pa'i lasachen pas gsung bshad shin tu legs pa byung ba rjes kyi dpe la zhog ces gzengs bstod/ de sngon chos sde ba phyogs nas lnga mchod pa tshor sngags bon 'dra la byed du bcug nas ngan gtad yod dam zhes som nyi che bar nga la srung (38na〉zlog gi thabs dgos tshul gsol ba ltar spyi so'i sku rim mngon byung gi sgo nas gnang / byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po rtses dang za ra bas gdan drangs pa'i zhabs phyir phebs gsung gleng zhib mol dang bstan pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad par legs skyes stsal/gter kha gong ma'i brag dmar 'bring pho mo'i spu gri'i dbang zhu ba gnang / dpal ri sgrub sder phebs nas rigs 'dzin shes rab 'od zer gyis gter rdzas sogs rten rnams zhib par mjal zhing rgyal sras dme kun bzang la chos 'brel gsan/thang yig las/ khyad par yar lung shel gyi brag phug 'di: bdud rtsi sman sgrub byas pa'i gnas yin pasaḥ gsang sngags mthar phyin phyo rgyan yul lta buḥ ya mtshan sgrub khang brag phug khyad 'phagasayodaḥ zhi khro sogs kyi gzhal yas khang mang bzhugasaḥ bod 'bangs dga' dang spro bar gyur ba'i bragaḥyon tan brgyad ldan bsam las 'das par brjodaḥ de la gnas tshad tu ru gis mi phebasaḥ gangs dkar ti si rtsa ri zab bu lung: gnas gzhan la yang yon tan yod mod kyang ཿ bsam grub shel gyi brag phug char mi nye phyo rgyan he ru gaḥdang mtshungs dper bzhagaḥ 'bring dang tha mas sbas yul gangs la bsgrubaḥ sgrub gangs ri brag mang po bsam 'das kyangaḥ sgrub gnas gtsug lag khang dang zung 'brel ba: 'di gsum dge ba brgya 'gyur 'thob pa'i gnas: tsho gos 'khor byas tshad chud zos song re skanaḥ zhes slob dpon chen po'i sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las kyi gnas lnga dang chos 'khor gsum dang zung 'brel gyi gnas gsum du gsungs pa (38ba)thams cad kyi nang nas 'gran zla dang bral ba yar klungs shel gyi brag phug mjal bar phebs/ gnas 'di o rgyan chen pos sman sgrub mdzad pa yin zhing gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra che mchog yon tan grub pa'i bka' babs pas gnas zhag —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyeganang skabs rtsa ba gsum gyi zhal gzigs dang sngon gnas rjes dran gsal bar byung / pad+ma gsang phug dang mtsho rgyal phug sogs gnas gzigs zhib pa dang bstan 'gror bde skyid 'byung ba'i smon lam rlabs po che mdzad/ tshur lam rdo rje brag tu sprul sku rigs 'dzin chen por drag po rtsal gyi byin rlabs thugs dbang e ka dzā ṭi'i bka' gtad ljags lung thor bu gsan/ 'brom stod gzigs khang du rgyang tsam gzhugs nas pha bong khar phebs/ 'di nas bzung phyogs phebs kha yar ma gtogs lo bdun tsam gyi bar bcar bzhugs mdzad nas bka' gdams glegs bam/ bstan rim chen mo/ be'u bum sngon po/ dpe chos skor gsum/ bka' gdams thor bu/ blo sbyong legs bshad kun 'dus/ dpal ye ma/ mtshon cha 'khor lo rma bya dug 'joms kyis mtshon pa'i blo sbyong gi yig sna mang po/ mdo sde mdzangs blun dang mdo phran gyi ris kha shas/ skyes tshoms/ bslab spyod/ sa rgyan te bka' gdams gzhung drug /byams chos sde lnga/ dbu ma rigs tshogs drug sogs rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po/ gsang sngags lam rim gyis thog drangs rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang 'dus/ gshed skor/ bde dgyes dus 'khor sogs kyi mngon dkyil/ bskyed rdzogs/ gzhung 'grel/ zin bris phal mo che (39na)byang chub lam rim che chung / rtsa 'jug gi rnam bshad/ tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad sogs mdo phyogs dang 'brel ba'i gsung rab du ma/ gsung 'bum thor bu/ 'dul 'dzin pa'i gleng 'bum/ bslab bya che chung kun rig ṭīka chen gyis gtsos rgyal tshab mkhas grub sogs rjes 'brangs kyi yig cha du ma/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos/ rgyal sras bka' 'bum/ spyan snga lha gzugs ras pa'i chos drug sogs grub mtha' mi gcig pa sna tshogs kyi lung mang du gsan/ gsang 'dus rim lnga/ 'pho 'khrid gser gyi sgo 'byed/rgyal sras thogs med pa'i yig cha'i steng nas blo sbyong don bdun ma/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod rnams rgya mtsho'i bdud rtsi gser zhun gyi steng nas byang chub lam rim/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i lta ba spyi khyab rnams nyams 'khrid du gsan/ dmar 'khrid kyi rtags rnams go rim ma log par gsal —56

zur r+pā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam ltar/ 6)bar byung ba snyan du phul bas skye ba gong ma zhig goms pa'i las 'phro sad pa yin zhes dgyes/ dpang los mdzad pa'i me long ma'i 'grel pa'i steng nas snyan ngag gi gsung bshad rdzogs par gnang / le'u phyi ma gnyis la rtsom rgyugs phul zhing thugs rtsom dam lhod ci 'dra zhig mdzad kyang sgra don rgyan dang 'grel ba'i nyams 'gyur can sha stag 'ong / sgra pa kun dga' chos 'byor gyi yi ge'i steng nas mtshamasasbyor lnga pa'i ri mo/ sdeb sbyor brit+ta'i skor sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag kyang mang du sbyong dar mdzad/rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pas brag dmar ri mo can nas gdan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po klong gsal snying tig gi dbang / dbang phran (39ba〉yung 'khrid rnams rdzogs par gsan zhing ka dag lhun grub kyi 'khrid bskyangs pa sngar rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa la mkha' 'gro snying tig gsan pa gcig grogs gcig tu song ba'i sku tshe 'di ga la chos nyid rang sar 'byol ba 'dra dgongs pa tsam gyi nyams rtogs ches cher 'khrungs/ ra sa'i gtsang khang byang nas sprul sku dri med lhun pos gdan drangs pa'i rdzogs pa chen po don tig 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi dbang lung sogs sngags rnying ma'i skor yang mang du gsan/mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi steng nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i zhakhrul 'khor/ ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i be'u bum yongasardzogs/ gtor chen gtor sgrub 'khor lo'i las rim sogs shog dril bcu gsum gyi phyag bzhes dmar 'khrid gnod sbyin beg tse'i rjes gnang las tshogs man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ rje 'di nyid grub mtha'i gdod sngags rnying ma ba yin yang gsar ma spyi dang bye brag bka' gdams dang dge lugs kyi chos la shin tu mkhas/byi lo'i dgun byang phyogs hor gyi rgyal khams nas zhabs drung byams pa dge 'dun dpal bzang rgya mtsho bla ma ser mo ba brgya phrag mang po'i 'khor dang bcas pa'i sgar pa gtos che ba dbus phyogs su byon pa'i bla ma ser po pa'i khrod nas rje rdo rje 'chang gi drung du dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag tsam lan mang ba mtha' dag dang chabs cig par gsan/ nye gnas dka' bcu 'phrin las phun —57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6petshogs kyis 'grul pa'i thang dom blangs nas sku skyes srubs dbar tshor phyag bris mdzod/ (40na)phyag mdzod dang gnyer tshang gi gsos la phan pa 'dug tshul byung ba glu ma'i zhabs tog tu dgongs te 'bad nas mdzad pas phyag bris kyang zhag skyed nyin skyed kyis thon/shing glang lo sog po tsho chen bzhi bcu'i gur dkar po'i bdag po ji nor rgyal po'i gcung thub pa thal sun hung tha'i ji mdun na 'don mi bzang sogs dpung chen po'i rta rmig gi rdul gyis nam mkha'i khams gang bar byed pa lta bus gtsos ta'i ching chos rje/ gra gtsang rje/ se chen chos rje/ paṇ+ḍita klu'i rgyal mtshan sogs ser mo ba brgya phrag lhag pa'i byang 'grul gtos shin tu che ba 'byor/ zhwa chang chos rje dang paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis kyis thog drangs ser mo ba phal cher gyis sbyin bdag byas te rdo rje 'chang gdan drangs nas lha sar zla ba phyed gnyis tsam bzhugs ring / brag dgon spyan snga nas brgyud pa'i phreng ba zhe lnga ma'i dbang shin tu dngos gtsang ba/ zur bka' gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa bde mchog lo dril/'jigs byed/ gshed dmar/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med sogasagasar ma'i dbang du ma/ bka' brgyad/ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol/ rta mgrin yang gsang gisamatshon pa'i rnying ma'i dbang 'ga' zhig spyi bka'i rjes gnang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ rnam rgyal 'joms kyis mtshon pa'i zur bka' rjes gnang sogs chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i dus phyag las dang bsre ma dgos na dbang don 'phrod par dgongs nas de bar gyi mchod dpon dgongs pa zhus nas dbang gral du bzhugs/ mchod dpon gyi phyag g.yog dbon po lho brag pas zhus/ dbang rjes (41ba)gnang gi phyag len mi mthun pa'i khyad chos mtha' dag zin bris su btab nas spyan lam du phab/slar pha bong khar phebs nas kyang byang 'grul dang dbus gtsang gi chos zhu ba du mar tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs/ rta mgrin skyer snang / lcags ral can/ sgrol ma nyer gcig /snar thang brgya rtsa/mgon po bcu gsum/ rigs gsum mgon po lugs mi gcig pa du ma/ sgrol dkar/ dbyangs can ma dkar dmar/ dmag zor ma/ gur zhal rnam sras/ 'ad blon/ dpal lha sogs yi dam chos skyong gi —58

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ (tanabyin rlabs rjes gnang mtha' klas pa gnang ba dang sdebs su gsan/me stag rgya btab ra mo che'i smon lam gyi tshogs dbur sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyis rdo rje 'chang gdan drangs pa'i skabs gzhis ka shar du 'grul pa'i thang mangs 'dri ba'i phyag las la phebs pa bshol nas mchod dpon mdzad par phebs na'ang tshogs dbu 'phrin las chen po 'ur langs kyi skyon gyis klungs su ma brgyugs pas rje bla ma se rar phebs pa'i 'khas skyel mdzad/ gzhis ka shar nas rje nyid kyi gcen lags kun dgas do dam byas te tshes bcu shar ma ba rnams la rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas pad+ma gling pa'i rdzogs chen dbang gi phreng ba'i dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs dang mtha' brten du ras chung rnam sprul bkra shis rgya mtsho la dag snang du byung ba'i tshe dbang hrīḥgacig ma'i dbang gnang ba chos sgo phye ba'i thog ma yin zhing / de nas lo gnangs chags lta bur lha sa'i tshes bcu ba tshor spyi dbang rgyas pa re mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang sku na smin pa'i phebs 'grul ma rtag gshis ra ma rtse mnyes thang mkhar rnga sogs sbyin bdag mang po'i sar rkyen sel gyi (41na)dbang byab khrus gnang ba'i sku tshab tu rdzong bda' mdzad/ mkhar rngar thog mar phebs pa'i nub/ nub byang gi zur du thugasadam la bzhugs pas mnal thum zhig sad pa'i srod 'khor la mun nag gi dbus nas me mthe bong tsam zhig 'dug pa je nyer 'gro ba byung bas bar gcod kyis mtho 'tsham pa zhig yin 'dra dgongs nasamago 'khor dang tshar tshad mi yong ba'i phung po zan skyur gyi spyan dmigs gnang ba slar 'od gsal gyi ngang la sku dpung g.yas pa'i 'og tu btsun pa zhig kha sbub tu chud nas ma thon par zhu 'bul byed pa zhig shar ba de ga'i rgyal phran de dam la thogs pa'i nyams kyis sang nub nas 'tshub kyi thugs dogs tsam yang ma byung bar snang / nang so dar rgyas la lha chen gyi dbang gnang ba'i dus khong gi spyi gtsug tu thog mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i thig pa lnga babs pa dbang rtags kyi rten 'brel legs par mngon/lha sras mu tig btsan po'i yang srid dpal 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas chos rje bya khyung pa mkhas grub pad+ma bstan 'dzin gdan drangs te dgongs 'dus gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas gling pa'i —59

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegater chos rnams gsan pa'i zhabs phyir dpal ri nas rgyal sras dkon mchog chos dbang grags pa byon/ de zhor zing pa stag mgor rje ngag dbang ye shes grub par thos grol sogs mang du gsan pa'i skabs rje 'di nyid kyis gsol 'debs gnang bar brten chos rje rgyal sras pas grol tig gi sgrub chen btsugs pa'i thugs rje chen po/ rta mgrin sogs dbang phran rnams dang / nyams 'khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ gshin rje nag po sum dril te rje pradz+nyā ra smi'i gter chos yongs (41ba)rdzogs/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i 'jam dpal zhi drag phyed ma/ rnam sras skor sogs gsan/ chos rje rgyal sras pha bong khar thugs dad dang nged la dpon zhen gyi phrad par 'byon bzhed pa'i rje nyid la dge rgan gnang dgos tshul gsungs na'ang slar gra pa 'dras bsgyur ba yin nam thugs dogs ci 'dra zhig shar rung da lam long mi 'dug ces lha sa nas 'phyong rgyas su shar mar byon skad/dge 'bri gnyis 'gras ches pa'i rje kun dga' rin cen yan la 'bri gung phyogs nas bde gzar yang mang du bslang/ dgon pa bcu gsum tsam gyi zhwa thabs bsgyur/ chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs nas bzung mngon spyod kyi las sbyor mdzad cing zhwa lha khang du khyab 'jug gi sgrub pa sogs la brten khri rin po che bde ba can pa man chad steng grib kyis skyon pa mang bas 'di lo 'jam dpal dbyangs dkon mchog chos 'phel khri thog tu phebs pa'i sku'i dogs sel gyi srung 'khor bzheng bar dga' ldan du gdan 'dren gnang / lto 'khor sogs sku srung zab khyad can kha shas 'brel ba dang rgya lam gcod par mdzad/lo bzhi tsam song dus brag dkar ston chen gyis bcu gsum 'khor rtsis btab par khri rin po cher sku grib kyi snyun gzhi yong ba'i mo zur la shar yang de nas dag zhing du gshegs par lo bco brgyad tsam song rung mnyel babs de ris kyi thugs dogs tsam yang ma byung bas thugs nges shin tu che bar mdzad/ rgyun gcod kyi 'khor lo ma nyams pa'i stabs kyis khri rin po che kong po bstan 'dzin legs bshad kyang zer kha'i ris kyis ma bsnyun pa'i bar du song dga' ldan du bzhugs ring 'jam dbyangs —60

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ (tanadakon mchog chos 'phel gyi zhabs (42na〉nyung pa mkhar grong chos mdzad la phug lugs tshes spyod nyin zhag gi gza' lnga rtsa sgrub/ mkhas grub nor bzang pa'i mgyogs rtsis/ dus sbyor dum drug ta'i la dang bcas pa/ nyi ldog 'khor lo/ zhag gsum rnam dbye/ stong 'jug dbyangs 'char sogs la sbyong dar mdzad/ skabs shig brag khar byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen pos 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi drag po'i sbyin sreg gi sgo nas 'byung ba'i 'tshub lhongs tshar bcad nas thub bstan rdo rje brag tu phebs pa'i drung du byon/ dpal phyag na rdo rje'i rnam sprul chab mdo rje drung rin po che bstan pa rgya mtsho/klong chen rab 'byams gsum pa sha zug pa ngag dbang bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis thog drangs phyogs 'dus dang gnyug mar gnas pa'i don gnyer du ma dang lhan cig par rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi rab 'byams bka'i dbang / zlum po bzhi dbang / chos skor g.yu thog snying tig gi dbang bzhi tshe dbang chosaskor/ gi gang rlung sgrub/ las 'brel rtsal/ klong chen pa sogs gter kha thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i gza' pod yongs rdzogs/ gza' dbang sogs zab chos mang du gsan/ thugs brel che skabs dang ma 'grig tshe chos thun gnyis re chag med du stsal/ chab mdo rje drung rin po cher sngagasagasar rnying gi chos skyong du ma'i rjes gnang lung man ngag mang du gsan/ chos rje sha gzug par dus sbyor dum drug gi dogs gcod kyang gnang / zhabs drung rin po che'i dbu zhwa bzhes 'phro bcas byin rlabasarten sogs bdag rkyen rgyas par mdzad ngos pha bong khar phebs/chos rje sku skye ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma dbyangs can dgyes pa'i lang tshor grags pas bzang sdings dgon par gdan drangs/ (42bsgos rje rdzing kha ba'i khri steng nas sgrub pa pho mo la spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa'i chos drug gi lung dang / chos rje sku skyer sper du pad+ma gling pa'i gu ru zhi drag sogs dbang lung mang du gnang / tshur 'brug pa sprul sku pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa'i phyag chen chos drug bse 'pho sogs kyi yig cha'i lung yang gsan zhing dpon slob gnyis ka tha snyad rig pa la byang bas mkhas pa mkhas pa'i mdun sar mdzes pa'i dpe ltar thugs kha 'gre bar byung / rting sor chos rje sku skyes bzang sdings su chos khrims bsdams pas —6/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shechos bzang rgyal po sogs rtogs ldan rgan po thams cad mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig gis bla ma bkrong bar thag bcad pa sogs kha mchu cher langs bde chen rdzong dpon rta nag 'o rlon par bla mas/dpal gangs can 'dzin ma'i dbang po dang / khyod phur bu'i blo ldan mdun na 'don/ /bdag ci brtol gyi yus kha ma lags kyang / /rang chos bzhin du bgyid pa'i mgo 'don zhu/ /zhes dang / gshin rje rnams log sgrub rigs mthun khyu/ /da chags sdang gi tsher dong du cung ma tshugs/ /zhes sogs kyi 'phrin yig dang zhu khra sbrags ma bskur zhing / bde chen chos 'khor du/ thos bsam sgom pa'i spyod tshul mi dman kyang / /zas gos gnyen gyis phongs pa'i dwa ri da/ /'dug tshul gshin rje'i 'jig rten la 'khu ba/ 'di 'dra thugs kyis bzod na sems dpa' min/ /zhes sogs kyi 'phrin gsol na'ang yas mas tshang ma nas shogs ma thon par bya yul tu 'brug pa sprul sku rin po che'i sku zhabs su bros pa'i tshe gzhis ka gong dkar gyi thad du rtogs ldan gyi rjes bsnyegs slebs kyang rje 'di nyid kyis jag chings ra ru ma bskur ba gnang ba'i mthus ma mthong bas skyon du ma gyur pa gcig pu'i bka' drin yang bsam las 'das/(43na)sa sbrul lo bkra shis lhun po nas dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i zhabs drung gdan sa chen po ri bo dga' ldan gyi gser thog bzheng bar phebs pa'i 'di lo dgung skag snga bsu dang mo rtsis dang spyan ltas la'ang 'tshub lhongs kyi thugs rtog che ba'i bla ma gong ma zhig gis pus 'khyud dra mig ma sogs byin rten mang po sku la bcangs 'dug cing / rgyu mtshan ma go ba'i ser 'bras kyi gra pa 'dras dpon slob rin po cher sgom zhwa bzhes pa'i khar da ni sgom thag dang bcas dge lugs pa'i bla ma mi 'dra pa 'dug ces gleng ba'ang byung / lha sar phebs nas rje nyid gdan 'dren gnang ste gsang bdag lto 'khor sogs khyab 'jug gi sku bsrung dgos phebs pa dri ba mdzad nas spyan lam du phab/ rab gnas 'di ga nas gnang/ bdag gis chings sogs byed zhus pas bka' las/ khyed kyi srung ba btags pa de skyabs 'og tu bcug pa yin pas rab gnas kyang nyid kyis mdzod cig gsung ba bzhin phyag g.yog gang dgos dang / lha sa'i gnyer pa rab 'byams pa chos dpal steng grib kyi dogs gzhis na bar srung —62

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanabacos mdzad pas gzhi med du song / dpon slob zhabs drung gi phebs sgor khri rin po che na rim la 'bri gung phyogs nas gza' mthu'i dogs gzhi'i bsnyun mkhan mang bar 'dug par de la phan pa'i ris gser thig gi gañji rar 'jug rgyu dgos gnang ba bka' bzhin bsgrubs te dga' ldan du bzhugs skabs 'bul par phebs/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che dga' ldan nas lha sar phebs skabs yang dgon spyan snga skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs chos zhu ba kha shas dang lhan du bde mchog lo i pa'i dbang dang / phyag bzhi ba'i bum dbang bcu bzhi pa sogs gsan/ ston mjug rdo rje 'chang gis shes (43bsko sungs nas nged pha bong khar yong skabs rje nyid zhabs phyir bzhugs pa'i sger gyis ngos 'phrad la byon/ de snga phan spyan 'dris tsam las med kyang 'di skabs nas thugs 'dris pa'i 'go tshugs/ 'on kyang nged rang na phra gshis ngosakyi gsung gleng sogs ni ma byung / sa skyong bsod namasarab brtan dang tsha ba dka' bcu ba sogs kyis zing pa sku skye 'di spyod lam zhi dul che zhing yon tan can zhig 'dug ces gsung 'phros mdzad kyi 'dug na'ang nged rang mtshan nyid pa'i nyams kyis dag snang chung bas 'gangs che snyam pa'i nyams snang ma byung / skyid shod stod smad kyi sngags srid kyi mgon la spo bo dpal ldan rin chen gyi khang par phebs/ sgrub zhag dang 'brel ba'i gtor bzlog grol rjes 'byom stod man nas glang ra yan/ thang pa rgyal sngon sogs kyi khrom stong phrag brgyal bar tshe dbang gnang / lcags lug lo 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis zing pa sku skye'i srung ba 'di rnams zab pa zhig 'dug pas dpon slob tsho da lo e ri sgo phyogs la phebs pa dang bcas srung 'khor bzhengs na yong zhes sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan la phebs sgo gnang ba ltar rje nyid 'bras spungs su gdan drangs/ nyi 'od rtser zhag shas bzhugs nas srung 'khor rnams bzhengs/ 'khor lo lus la bcang ba'i blang dor gyi rim pa gnang bar gsung 'phros brjod pa dag po zhig 'dug snyam pa las rtog ge pa'i blo ngan gyis bsgribs nas dag snang gang yang ma byung / 'di la yum yid 'dzin ma chab bsags kyis sku ltem par pha bong kha nas 'brom stod du phebs snyun g.yog sogs sri zhu 'bad pa —63

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shechen pos gnang yang zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du sku gshegs pa rje nyid kyis rdo rje sgrob dpon mdzad nas zing pa'i gra pa rags bsdus kyis zhi khro gzhan phan (44na tshe(da kyi 'khor lo'i gdung chog btsugs pa'i stong rtsa dang / rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa dpon slob sum cu skor gyis zhag gsum gyi bar gsung chog dang rjes su sreg sbyang mdzad dgon sde mang por mang ja/ bla ma du mar bsngo rten/ dpal ldan stod rgyud gra tshang du tsha ra/ bris 'bur gyi rten bzhengs sogs dgongs pa rdzogs thabs rgyas par mdzad/ thugs brel rnams chod nas lo tsā ba chen po gnyan dar ma grags kyi bsti gnas gnyan mgon phug tu zla ba gsum gyi bar sku mtshams dam par bcad/ de mus nas kha ru srang nang pa/ gshe ma mkhar pa/ ring mkhar pa/
