rgyal sngon pa sogs la so so'i 'dod chos dang rtsis dkar nag gi phyag 'khrid bslab ston stsal lo/ /'khon ston 'jam dpal zhal lung nyi zer gyis/ /mkhyen pa'i 'dab rgya gral las shes bya kun/ /gzigs pa'i legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i bcud mngar pos/ /mtho ris sa spru dz+nya yi khengs pa btang / /rtses dang blo gsal 'du pa'i chos kyi grwar/ /'chad mkhas gtam gyi sbyor ba'i rgyud mang glur/ /snga 'gyur chos sgra 'dren pa'i rnam dpyod kyi/ /gdub gsil dbyangs can phyag sor rjes su snyegs/ /tshul ldan bag yod lcags kyu rnon po yis/ /sgo gsum nyer dul mkhas btsun bzang po'i gling / /ris med thub bstan shalbi ka yi khrod/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i 'gros kyis lhod por rgyu/ /shar phyogs gur pa pa'i pha 'das pa'i dge rtsar yer pa spos dga' ba rnams tshogs kyang khong tsho'i bla ma stod rgyud dbu mdzad 'on po rab 'byams pa grongs nas bar gseng dang 'grig pas rje nyid bla tshab tu gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs pas sku gsung thugs kyi mdzad pas yid phrogs te bla ma gnang dgos pa'i snyan gsan phul bar/ pha bong khar rdo rje 'chang (44ba tshe pa ci 'gab kyi bslab ston zhu ba gnang bar khyed la deng sang bzhugs pa'i par bkab cig mi 'dug pas re zhig khong tsho'i 'dod pa dang bstun nas bla ma mdzad na 'phrin las kyang che zhing legs pa 'ong tshul bslab bya rgyas par gnang / sngar spos dga' gsang sngags mkhar pa'i dgon lag lta bus sngags mkhar nas bsko srol yod pa ltar —64

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)dpon slob khri rin po che nas thugs khur bzhes pa zhig byung na dgongs pa shar yang yer pa phu mda' rnams 'phan yul za dam pa'i 'og tu song ba'i gar lugs shugs che sgang dang 'grig pas za dam nas spos dga'i khur bzhes mdzad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan phul ba ltar zhal gyis bzhes/ pha bong kha ri khrod pa'i nyams kyis gzan pa me shing dkon gshis gzhis ka shar du byon/ der spos dga' ba'i phebs bsu dang nye skor gyis phebs skyel ba 'dzom pa'i gra 'grig dang bcas gza' skar dus sbyor legs pa'i thog spos dga'i gdan sar phebs/ pha bong kha nas rdo rje 'chang / o ke nas zhabs drung rje btsun drung /za dam spyi gnyer gsum nas bsko 'ja'i tshan grangs/ gra rigs sbyin bdag sku nye sogs kyis 'bul ba rgyas par bstar zhing phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston spel/ sngon ma la yer pa ba'i gtor gshog mdzad dus 'bag btsog gshor bas bye'ur zhakhrungs pa'i tshe bla mas chos gsung ba gsan pa sogs sngon gnas thugs kyis gsal bar dran/ dgon pa'i srung ma gtso bo dpal ldan lha mo dung skyong ma yin 'dug pa dgyes pa'i mtshan ma byung gsung ba zhal gzigs lung bstan 'dra byung tshod du snang / dam sri'i rigs kyis rgyal sar yod snang ba rje bla ma'i lha sngags ye shes kyi gzi byin ma bzod pa'i thog mar gra ris rnams la bde dog gi 'tshub lhongs ci ris byung na'ang rim gyis rang zhir (45na)song /dgon bdag stabs nas za dam rkarma thub bstan nyin byed gling gi gnas mjal dang mang ja zhu bar phebs/ slob dpon rab 'byams pa sman thang pa dang gnyer pa gnyis kyis bkur bzos mdzes mtshon che ba byas/ tshogs la sgyu 'phrul gyi gsung bshad mdzad par dka' rab 'byams rnams kyis legasagaso'i tshig gi me tog gtor/ gra tshang gi gra rgyun yer pa ba tshos phyogs dkar gyi ja zhus byas/yer pa phu mda' dang 'brom chu rigs kyi sbyin bdag drag rim sngags pa lha rje rnams kyis dbang gzhi btegs pa'i khrom pa stong phrag tu nye bar tshe dbang gnang / bla brang dang mchod khang dgon rnying gog pa'i nyams kyis 'jig tu nye bar gsar du bskrun zhing / sgrub mchod dang yer pa mdos chen gyi rgyun je 'grib la song ba'ang rgyas par mdzad/ zla shas sku mtshams bcad de rdzogs pa chen po klong —65

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 64gsal snying tig gi snang bzhi'i lam la rtsal 'don gyi nyams bzhes bskyangs pas rig pa tshad phebs kyi rtags mang du shar bas sku mtshams grol nas pha bong khar phyag dbang la phebs dus 'od gsal 'char lugs kyi rgyu mtshan rnams snyan du gsol ba'i lan du/ khyed stag mgo yon tan dpal du 'khrungs skabs nyams ba ches mdzad pa'i bag chags bzang po bag la zha ba gsal 'debs gyi tshul du song ba yin zhes dgyes pa chen pos gzengs bstod/ yer pa brag gseb tu ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bzhugs pa'i phug par bla ma sku gsum gyi sgrub pa zla ba gsum gnang ba'i skabs rdo rje brag nas byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen pos g.yu thog snying tig 'di srung ma'i bstabs nas bka' shin tu gnyan pas gzhan la ma bshad gong du bla sgrub cig mdzad pa 'gab tshul byung ba bzhin gnang ba sgrub pa ma grol ring brag gseb kyi nang du (45ba〉spon gyi dri ngad yang yang ldang bas mi kun ci yin snyam pa'i the tshom za ba byung/ nub cig gi mnal lam du/ nyi thang lha rje blo bzang rgya mtsho 'di mtsho smad mkhan chen gyi skye ba yin pas lung tshar gcig bskyar nas nyon zer ba zhig byung bar brten/ spos dgar gdan drangs nas g.yu thog snying tig dang bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud grags pa'i lung gsan/ 'tsho byed phu lung pa dang cha pa drung 'tshos gtsos pa'i skyid shod stod kha'i lha rje dang sngags pa sogs don gnyer can mang po la g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i thugs tig rigs 'dus bla ma sman rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi mtha' brten drang srong bka' srung gi rigs gtad/ tshe dbang 'chi bdag bdud 'joms/ po ti yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang bcas rgyas par stsal/ o ke gzhis gar skyid shod kyi lcam dpon sa rje btsun mar lo lo bzhin rkyen sel gyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs bka' dbang gi ris 'bul ba gnang / dpon sa sku na dang sku chas thams cad smin pa'i mthar son/ za dam pa'i phogs pa lta bur song ba'i zang zing gi dbang yon 'bul ba gnang ma bde bas mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho dang thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phyag rjes sogs nang rten gyi rigs mang du 'bul ba mdzad/—66

zur ོ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)rje kun dga' tshe mchog gi khro chu'i mdun bskyed zhal gsum phyag drug bshad par 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas rtsod pa la lung rigs nyi ma'i snang bar grags pa lcags stag lo mdzad pa dngos lan btab na ma 'gab pas 'di spo bo ban grong pas zhabs drung la kha g.yar nas brtsams par ngosabazung ste rje nyid kyis rtsod lan legs bshad 'byul pa'i mun sel zhes chu sbrel sag zla ba'i tshes(46na)bcu bzhi la thugs rtsom mdzad pa zhabs drung rin po che'i spyan lam du phab/ de lan rgyas pa zhig mdzad rtsis kyi nub lho phyogs nas mtshon cha'i char pa 'bab pa'i mnal ltas byung ba 'jam dpal dug sdong ma mnyes pa'i thugs dogs kyis rin po che ngag dbang ye shes grub par 'jam dpal rigs gsum 'dus pa'i dbang brgya tshar gsan te yang lan ma gnang bar bzhag skad/chu sprel sprel zla'i mar ngo'i tshes bcu la lha sa'i tshes bcu shar ma ba rnams kyis yer par dpal o rgyan chen po'i mchod pa rgyas par bteg pa'i gral dbur gdan drangs par bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i zlum po bzhi dbang gnang / mar lam tshes bcu ba rnams la gdab lan gyi tshul du spos dgar gzhis len rgyas par mdzad/ 'di lo than pa che bar stod smad kun nas char 'bebs kyi rigs byed mkhan mang yang thog tu ye ma babs pa'i lo tog rnams tshig par nye bar rgya nag chu 'khor mjo ru ma/smyug tshigs sogs kyi las sbyor mdzad pas zhag bdun tshun la ri klungs kun char gyi rgyun chen pos brlan te mi phyugs mtha' dag bde ba'i ngal gsor bkod/ phyag len gtsang zhing byin rlabs che ba'i snyan grags kyi 'ur langs/khams ka thog gi bla ma pad+ma blo gros byon nas rje 'di lha sar gdan drangs/ gter kha du ma'i dbang lung dang gsang snying gi 'grel pa phyogs bcu mun sel gyi bshad lung gnang ba/ sprul sku gsung sprul sogs khams bod mang por chos rgyun khyab che bar byung / tshur dgongs 'dus kyi po ti'i lung dang dbang spyi rgyud sogs rgyud dgu bcad thabs dang bcas pa/ las byang me tog 'phreng mdzes/ bka' srung gi las byang bskang gso/ zor las gnam lcags thog mda' sogs lung kha yar gsan/ bla mas sbyin —67

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6ne bdag mdzad nas mtshan brgyad gra tshar (46bskong slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar zhing bkod phyag bris su mdzad/ khams stod nas bla ma dpal 'bar drung pa lha sar 'ongs te ltag sgo ba'i der gnas tshang byas/ dgongs 'dus gtso bo dgu'i gser sku dang bris thang sogs bzheng ba'i zhal bkod dang / gon jo sku skye zar bas chos longs sprul gsum gyi gser sku khru re lhag tsam bzheng ba sogs khong khag gnyis rka'i 'bur sku rnams kyi gzungs 'bul rab gnas mdzad cing 'dod chos kyang kha yar stsal/rten bzhedas kyi 'tshub yin nam zer gang ltar bla ma'i nu bo lha sar 'das/ phung po bsam yas mchimasaphur bskyal ba'i sreg sbyangs la gdan drangs pa bzhin pur sbyong gnang ba'i thog ma gnas bzang ba'i rten 'brel du dgongs te phebs/ mchims phu dang zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i rten brten pa rnams zhib mjal snyan dar gser chab sogs dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod 'bul ngos rgyal bstan 'phel ba dang 'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i smon lam rgya cher mdzad/ phar tshur gnyis ga'i phebs lam rgod dkar brgyud lha sar phebs/dpal 'bar bla ma de nu bo la shin tu brtse ba zhig yod 'dug pas ched gnyer du zhus pa bzhin zla gcig gi bar rus pa rnams la sbyang ba gnang / bla ma gnyis kyis 'bul zhabs kyang rgyas par byasanas dpal sdong zhes pa chu mo bya'i lo lha sa sde ma lag dang bcas pa gtsang sde srid nas dga' ldan pho brang du sbyor 'jags gnang ba'i smon lam chen mo'i dus legs bya 'bul bar phebs/ skyid shod stod smad kyi sngags pa rnams kyis gtso bor gsol ba btab pa'i zhar byung du lha sa'i tshes bcu ba thor bu/'tsho byed kyi ris/ 'phyong rgyas sras po sogs don gnyer can drug cu skor la mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po'i gter byon(47na tha ka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa lha bdun brgya nyer lnga'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgrub chen zhag nyer gcig 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i sman sgrub kyi tshe/ khrol bu'i sgrub par 'phel dka' rung 'di skabs ma rga pa 'phel zhing phyi ma'i sgrub pa'i tshe spos dga'i dgon pa'i nang sman dris gang zhing rlung gi rgyu phyogs kyis yer pa phu mda' dang nye skor gyi grong gseb tshor —68

zur mu thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)yang dri ngad ldang zhing 'phel kha shin tu che bas sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan bla na med pa'i dam rdzas yungs 'bru tsam re khar song yang 'khor ba mtha' can du gyur te myong grol gyi 'phrin las rlabs po che spel/rdo rje spyan ma'i rmi lam du 'tshub stongs kyi ltas shar yang bka' srung gi gsol mchod la gtso 'don mdzad pas bar chad kyi 'tshe ba cung zad kyis kyang ma nyen/ chos rgyal rin chen phun tsho gos kyi phyag len kun dga' tshe mchog sogs nas brgyud pa'i lugs bzhin mtha' brten du sbyin sreg dang gros mol gnang zhing / nang gi dngos grub len chog grol nas yar phebs pa dang tshes bcu bzhi'i zla ba shar ba 'grig pas rten 'brel gyi sgo legs/ grol dbang gi nyin stag rtse nas gung thang bar gyi tshes bcu pa sogs don gnyer can lnga brgya tsam la bkra shis tshe'i dbang dang dngos grub len chog gnang zhing sgrub gtor dang bdud rtsi chos sman gyi skal ba bkye/ rje ngag dbang ye shes grub pa lha sar jo mjal la phebs pa'i yar lam spos dgar gdan 'dren gnang nas gzhis len bdog pa'i dngos po gya nom pa'i 'bul ba dpangs mtho bar mdzad/ saḥgacig ma'i tshe dbang gsan zhing pad gling pa'i tshe dpag rdor 'phreng yang bskyar du gsan pas snyan gsan phul bar dbang tsag gcig phyag bris mdzad nas bsnams 'byon pa zhu gsungs (47ba)pa ltar thugs dam rten gyi thang kha zhig kyang bzhengs nas zing par phebs/ tsaka li phul nas zhal thang la phyag nas zhus shing dbang rgyas par gsan/nged hor nang brgyud rgyal nas sa spungs su slebs skabs snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i phyag tham stsal ba ni/ gangs can 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs gcig pu/ /rgyal ba'i sras po sems dpa' skyabs sgrol mdzad/ /zhing 'dir ngur smig gar gyis rnam rol pa/ /rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs drung du/ /kun rtog zir gyis 'dzin ma'i khyon ma lus/ /tshar du dngar ba'i mchod sprin gyis brisashing / /sor bsto snying gar zum pa'i 'jo sgeg dang / /lhan cig gus pa chen pos mchid 'di zhu/ /legs byas chu gter las 'ongs lha bcas kyi/ /mgon du gyur pa'i yid bzhin rin chen dbang / /thub bstan rgyal mtshan rtse la mchod 'os pa/ /'tsho zhing gzhes pa srid gsum dpal du gyur/ /gang 'di —69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6nesgyu 'phrul sras po slar 'ongs sam/ /'on te ma pham mgon po'i zlos gar nyid/ /sngon med legs bshad tsha zer 'bum 'gyed pa'i/ /rtsod dus rdzogs ldan nyin byed khyod du nges/ /lar rtsod rtsom pa'i tsha zer rab 'gyed kyang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i cha shas ma yol zhing / /mkhas btsun 'bum phrag du ma'i ral pa'i rtser/ /gang gi zhabs sen zla ba 'di med byung / /chos 'dul sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan legs bzung yang / /rtsa grol lhag par chags pa'i snying rje dang / /snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lor shar ba'i rtsal/ /gsum ldan 'di ko mgon med kun gyi mgon/ /mkhyen pa chos kun gzigs pa 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /'gro kun brtse bas skyong la 'jig rten dbang / /ma rung bdud dpung 'dul la mthu chen thob/ /sku gsum 'bras bu'i snye ma deng 'dir (48na〉sten/ /'di na phyogs bral 'grim pa'i gus ldan pa/ /sgyu lus lnga pa'i mgron du ma gnyer kyang / /srid pa'i nyes brgya mthong bas yid phyungs te/ /'dod chung dben par rgyu la ring zhig mchis/ /zhu mchid snying por bgyis pa be+eḍūrla/ /rgyud mang dad gus snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs can/ /mgon khyod lha bcas 'gro ba'i cod pan du/ /zhabs sen sa 'dzin spo ltar yun ring por/ /brten pa'i gdung shugs sa bskul 'dod pa'i smrangs/ /gang gi rgyal ba'i mdzad pa mtha' klas pa/ /dpag nus min yang gus pas yid drangs te/ /zhal dkyil mjal 'dod spu long che cher g.yo/ /'on kyang zin med bya bas blo brid cing / /'dab gshog rnam g.yeng gzhan dbang gis bcings pas/ /ngos kyis mjal bar ma sleb yid gdungs te/ /'phags nor bdun gyi bdud rtsi'i zas ldan yang / /bdag cag legs byas zhing du gyur slad du/ /lha rdzas mchode pa'i rim gro dang bcas te/ /chu shel dbang po smin drug res babs pa'i/ /snga ma'i phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa la/ /bka' brgyud kun gyi gtsug rgyan g.yu brag pa'i/ /gtsug gi rgyan gyur rje btsun mal yer gyi/ /grub pa'i gnas mchog dus kyis bskal gyur pa/ /sde dgon gog po'i gtsug lag khang nas phul/ /zhes par de mtshungs kyi lan 'bul ni rngo ma thogs/sku yon sgor ma nas legs po yod 'dra snyam pa shar/ gzhan yang bi spyi ta yod pa'i tshigs bcad —70

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)kyi phyag bris ngo mtshar ba rjes su kha shas byung rung mtha' dag brir ma lang / da mthun gyi lan 'ga' zhig kyang phul/ sngags 'chang lha gdong pa'i mthu byung ba 'dra zer gang ltar nang pa glang kha ba'i pha bu gnyis ka 'gyangs med du 'das pa'i bsngo rten la bla ma zhang (48bsko bka' 'bum po ti dang po 'bul mi slebs gdong spos dgar rgyun du sdod pa'i bya rog gnyis grog skad snyan po sgrog cing gzims chung gi zhal dkar nang du yod la khad pa'i rkyen gyis thugs la sngar med pa'i dgyes nyams che ba shar/nub cig 'od gsal la mi nag po zhig gis 'dir shog zer nas byon pa'i mchod khang chen po zhig gi nang du gdan drangs byung pa bla ma zhang yin zer ba zhig dang mjal ba ni sngar gyi bya rog dang mi nag po gnyis ka dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rnam 'phrul bstan nas gung thang gi bla ma mdzad dgos par bskul ba dang / de la 'gro mgon g.yu brag pa'ang dgyes pa'i sku'i snang ba bstan par gor ma chag /mi ring bar gung thang chos khri lho lcog gnyis nas bla ma mdzad dgos pa'i snyan gsan byung ba 'gro mgon brtson 'grus grags pa'i bstan pa la phan zhing mgon po bya rog gdong can gyis 'phrin las sgrub pa'i sngar byung ba'i rtags de rnams yin par dgongs te zhal gyis bzhes/ sde pa rtse kha ba/lo pa'i nang so grags pa/ tshe sa spus gling / zhal slar brtsam pa sogs drung 'khor dang sdo phan tshun gyi che bgres rnams kyis chibs bsu/ gra dmangs kyi gdugs ba dan rol mo sogs phyag mtshan thogs pa'i ser sbreng dar bcas smin drug gis nya ba'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i dus chos khri'i gdan sar phebs par bde chen rtse nas sde pa rdzong phyi ba'i bsko 'ja'/ gra rigs sbyin bdag rnams kyis zang zing gi bdog pa rgya cher phul/de nyin nam mkha' dag pa la 'ja' sprin pir gyis bris pa lta bu/ nyi ma sngar las 'od gsal la dgun yin kyang dbyar sos 'du ba'i sa la drod chen po phebs pa'i ya mtshan zhing skya ser tshang ma bag dro ba'i (49na〉rtos bzang ba ni gdan sa pa sangs rgyas 'bum slar yang rang gi bsti gnas su phebasapa'i ltas su snang / de nyin btsun pa byed mkhan bdun tsam byung ba'i skra phud bzhes shing ming 'dogs—71 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shā zhe mdzad/ mchod khang chen mo mjal bar phebs dus sngon ka nas rjes dran mang du shar/ khyad par mgon khang gi sgo rang byer song mgon khang shin tu mun pa nag kyang mgon po'i zhal gyi thad du 'od sgor mo zhig shar nas thams cad gsal bar gzigs pas kun ya mtshan du byed/ sgom sder byon dus sku skye sngon ma'i dus thugs la shar zhing sangs 'bum gyi sku gdung gzigs pa'i tshe de dang rje nyid dbyer med du song ba lta bu'i thugs nyams la ja phor gang 'thung yun tsam 'byams/ sku gdung gi srin mdzub de byin rlabs rten la bsnams/ de nub mnal lam du rgyal po bse'i khrab can 'ongs nas khyod bla brang pa chos dpal bzang por gyur dus bsrung ma yin gsung ba sogs dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur mang du bstan/sbyin bdag rnams kyis so so'i gnas khang du gdan 'dren pa dang tshul spom 'bul gyis mtshon pa'i rnyed bkur rgya cher btab/ shing byi'i lo zhang lha tshe ru ba spus grong pa gsum gyis do dam byas nas khrom dbang dang drung 'khor so sor sger dbang stsal/ rgya ma btsong gtun rong pa'i rab 'byams pas thang yig la dgag pa btang ba'i rtsod yig 'bri gung rdo rje brag snang gsal gsum du phul ba'i zhu yig tu deng sang dbus phyogs su rnying ma la khyed dpon slob gsum mkhas pa 'dug pas 'di la lan zhig mdzad dgos/ drang nges kyi don so sor phye ste lung regs dang 'brel ba'i lan byung na kho bo'ang rnying ma la 'dug /de min rnam dag min pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan (49ba thad snang ba 'bri gung dang rdo rje brag gnyis nas bla chen dbyings che sa'i lugs kyis zhu lan tsam yang ma byung 'dug /zing par rin po che ngag dbang ye shesagrub pas khos rnying ma'i bstan par zhugs pas phan rgyu yang med ma zhugs pas gnod rgyu yang med 'di 'dra'i lan byed pa las brel ba gzhan bcad chog tshul gyi bsgyur byang 'ur sdum rbad kyi lan zhig byung tshod du 'dug pas lhag par yi ma rangs pa'i snga 'gyur gyi ring lugs la ngan smras kyi than skad phyogs brgyar sgrog pa'i gnas tshul phu lung kyang ra grong 'tsho nas rgyu mtshan rje nyid kyi snyan du gsol bar brten lan gnang bzhed kyis rtsod yig rtsad gcod mdzad kyang dum bu zhig las phyag tu ma 'byor zhing /—72

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)de rdo rje 'chang la spyan 'bebs gnang 'dug pa nged kyis pha bong khar bka' chos zhu bar phyin dus gsung sgros kyi lhongs la thang yig gi lo rnams dbyar lo dgun lo ston lo dpyid lo sogs sna tshogs brtsis pas lo ril por 'jog mi thub cing / 'dul ba lung nas bshad pa'i rgya gar gyi yul chen po drug dang yul phran mtha' yas pas spyi bye brag gi dbye ba phyed po mi 'dug pas rtsod pa dang 'brel che bar ma mthong /de las dpal 'dzin gyi rtsod yig tshig don bzang rgya mtsho gling gi dbang mo che sogs kyi rigs lnga gdan du bting ba'i skor lta bur gsang 'dus kyi rgyud du/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /zhes sogs dang / dus gsum pa yi sangs rgyas rnams/ /dgra bos bsad par bsams nas ni/ /zhes pas mtshon te dngos shugs kyi dgongs pa len rgyu mang po 'byams yig gi rigs tsho'i lan la dka' ba mi yong yang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ rang nyid rgyal 'dod pha rol smad bab 'dod/ /g.yo sgyu'i (50na〉khyod pa tshig rtsub ngan sems can/ /ngag 'chal sna tshogs smra zhing gzhan rgyud bsreg /da lta'i rtsod pa 'di yang dmyal ba'i rgyu/ /zhes pa lta bu'i rtsod lan gyi g.yeng ba las mnyam gzhag thun gcig byed pa dga' gsung ba thos shing / dus phyis 'bras spungs su rje nyid dang gsung gleng byung ba'i rkyen gyis slar spus srang gser khang pa brgyud rtsad gcod mdzad pas skrus srang pas brag sgo rab 'byams par yod tshul thos nas g.yar ba dge slong shākya la bcol ba'i sa nas ma byung zhes g.yar du ma 'dod/rtsod yig tshang bar ma 'byor pas lan gnang ma thub pa'i ngang la lus/ dus phyis brag sgo rab 'byamasapas brtsams pa rnams kyang rgya ma rab 'byams pa'i de ga nas khol du phyung ba'i ris su 'dug /ji skad du/ yon tan ldan pa yon tan la dga' zhing / /yon tan med pa yon tan la mi dga'/ /nags kyi bung ba mtsho yi pad+ma ra dga'/ /sbal pa lhan cig gnas kyang de lta min/ /zhes pa ltar snang ba rigs kyi sman pa gtsang stod dpon tshang tsha rong pa tshe dbang rigs 'dzin du grags pa'i dpyod ldan des dam pa 'di nyid kyi snyan pa'i grags pas yid drangs te lan cig ma yin par gtsang phyogs su 73

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6nephebs dgos pa'i snyan 'bul byung ba dang / dzi srid sku zhabs chos khri ba'i zhu don yod pa gnyis sbrags nas g.yas ru gtsang gi rgyal khams su byon pa'i 'ug pa lung gi mda' span gyi thad du phebs pa na/ lha rje zur bu che dang zur mo dge 'dun 'bum du sku 'khrungs pa'i dus kyi gnas tshul du ma bsnyel gsos/lug bya lung phyogs kyi rten bshad dang lo rgyus rnams gsungs pas zhabs 'bring pa (50ba〉zhu ngo mtshar du gyur/ bkra shis lhun por dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i zhabs drung mjal bar phebs pas bdag rkyen thugs la btags/dga' ldan bka' brgyud kyi phyag chen rtsa 'grel de skabs rang phyogs la grags che bas ljags lung gsan/ gzhis ka rtser zhu don yod na dpon blon rnams dbyings che bas 'gor gzhi chen po yong ba'i lung bstan/ pho brang bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i rtse mor sa skyong mi'i dbang po mjal bar phebs par bzhugs gral lan mang gnang zhing zur gsos gnang sbyin dpangs mtho ba zhu don gyi phebs gsal sogs 'phral du gnang / dpon tshang tsha rong par gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyi yang snying regs 'dus sman rgyal gu ṇa'i bla sgrub kyi dbang bzhi/ drang srong dang chos skyong gi bka' gtad tshe dbang lung man ngag thams cad rdzogs par stsal bas khong pa rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa lhag par thob/ phyir phebs gdong gtsang sde srid nas skyid shod phyogs su rnying lugs kyi bla ma khungs can yod pa shes ma byung khyed rigs rus yon tan thams cad nas khungs btsun par 'dug pas slar bstan srid spyi'i sku rim byed dgos pa 'dug tshul gyi bka' bkod mgron gnyer dpon rtsa khu nas kyis bsgyur/tshur lam nyang stod dpal 'khor chos sde'i dge rtsa tshugs pa'i sgrub mchod kyi gar 'chams sogasagazigs mo che zhing gtsug lag khang dang mchod rten chen mos gtsos pa'i gnas mjal mdzad/slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi dngos slob rgya sngags 'chang chen po 'jam dpal gsang ba sogs rigs 'dzin rim par byon pa'i gnas rnying dang / (51na tha ka' brgyud kyi gdan sar lung gis mtsho ni pa'i gnas gzigs gnang nas lum pa'i gru brtan phyag g.yog dmangs ma gzhung la —74

zur wo thams go mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ (tadabatang ste/ dpon slob nyung bsdus shig gis rigs 'dzin chen po mjal bar phebs nas rdo rje brag tu bzhugs zhag gnyis gnang rim gyis gung thang du byon/ gtsang la phebs ring gra pa gzhen pa rnams la klog grwa/ bar shar ba rnams la kun rig gi phyag rgya 'ching tshul dang dung chen sbyong ba sogs zhal brda gnang ba tsho tshul ldan byung ma byung gi rgyugs bzhes par der rin po che ngag dbang ye shes grub pa dag zhing du gshegs pa'i zhugs 'bul sogs grub na'ang mchod 'bul la snang gsal du phebs rtsis la dbur stod phyogs su hor yan gyi jag chom mang bar yab zur chen gyis jag chings rwa ru ma sgrub pa gnang bar mnal lam du mun pa 'thibs pa dang ser ba 'bab pa gnyis ka byung bar thugs dogs shar rung bla ma la dad pa'i gdung shugs kyis the tshom med par phebs pas phebs lam du hor rta pa bdun brgyad tsam zhig dang mjal yang dri ba zhu ba las nyer 'tshe ma byung /bya yul mang ra'i mdor rta pa sum cu tsam khyad nyer 'byor kyang dpon slob rnams ma mthong bas gdams pa dang mtshan ltas gnyis dar thugs yid ches/ rin po che'i dbu thod bam ril lag mthil gyi rgya tsam gyi dbu skra yang ma tshig pa thugs ljags spyan gsum gdung lcags gcod dang bcas pa rnams la dngos bshams kyi mchod 'bul snyan dar/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa la gsol 'debs dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bzhes pa/ bstan 'gro kun la sman yon du 'gyur ba'i smon lam mdzad/ zhag shas kyi (51ba) bar bzhugs nas gra ris rnams dang khams pa gsar rnying gi gsung gleng zhib rgyas gnang / rin po che kun dga' tshe mchog gi phyag nas ma'i o rgyan rin po che'i rnam thar zhing bkod/ phyag dpe nyer mkho kha yar/ gdung skal gyi byin rten sogs bsnams lam zhon du rnam rgyal chos rdzong du phebs/ rin po che ngag dbang ye shes grub pa zhabs drung chos kyi grags pa'i dbu lhar song ba'i phyogs 'phul gyis mi mnyes pa yod 'dug gshis/ khyed tsho'i bla ma snang gsal ba zangs mdog dpal rir 'byon rtsis phyag mdzod pas rta ma bskur ba'i lam la lus pa e yin dbu skra ma tshig pa bzang ngan ci yin zhes zhe ma gshags gsungs par/ phebs lan du dag pa ye shes kyi sku —75

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'azangs mdog dpal rir 'byon par chibs pa'i dgos byed med pa 'dra/ dbu skra ma tshig pa de ris zhabs drung gong ma rin po che rnam rgyal la'ang byung 'dug pas bzang las che zhus par phyag mdzod pa hor che brgyud kyi mi ngo lha ba can de ma dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur chen po byas skad/'bri gung zhabs drung dkon cog rin cen yer pa dang lha sa'i gnas mjal la byon pa'i tshe thugs rgyus khog nas phyag chen la shog gsung ba bzhin phebs pa po ta la'i mchod khang dmar por nang so nub pa bar zhabs drung gis jo bo'i g.yas mjal 'di rang la dga' ba byed pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin dri ba gnang bar thugs ka g.yas na yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs pas yin pa 'dra zhus pa'i lan du/ jo bo'i sku lugs ma yin na lugs rgyag dus yid bzhin nor bu thugs ka g.yas la song ba sus mthong sogs 'brel med mang po gsung gi 'dug zer ba dang nged dga' ldan khang gsar du bsdad yod par gleng brjod (52na)byed snang / glang ra'i bar chibs skyel mdzad pas bla mas phyogs dkar dang rgyus yod thigs byung zhes mnyes mnyes mdzad cing zhabs drung la phyag bzhi pa'i dbang sogs chos tshol yang gsan/ spos dgar zla gcig tsam gyi rin po che snang gsal ba'i gdung rus la mchod 'bul dang dri med bshags rgyud kyi gsung sgrog chag med du mdzad/dga' ldan khang gsar du ngos 'phrad la phebs byung bar dpon slob gling smad zhabs drung dang gsung gleng zhib rgyas ngos dpon slob rin po ches rin spungs zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyud nga ro de bzangs sdings sku skyer yod 'dug pas chos rje'i drung gis g.yar nas phyag dpe bshu ba'i ma dper yong ba mdzod ces phebs sgo gnang / dkar phibs chen mor gsol tshigs zhu sar sku mdun sman thang nas blo bzang rgya mtsho'i phyag bris ma'i cha 'phrul gyi thang kha bkram 'dug pa nas shog dpe 'ga' zhig 'phral du 'bri ba gnang song bar gnam yangs nas lta mkhan gyi drung 'khor mang pos mthong bas phyag bde ba dag thugs rtsol che ba'i dper 'dzin/de yang pha rol tu phyin pa lnga'i mdo las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi —76

zur r+sā thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)bye ma snyed du khyim na gnas te/'dod pa'i yon to lnga rnams la brten cing longs spyod la/wā thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yang sems mi bskyed na/de tsam gyis ni byang chub sems dpa' tshul khrims 'chal pa zhes mi brjod do//de ltar 'dis 'di lta ste/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa ma dkrugs pa'i phyir ro//tshe dang ldan pa gang po dper na/mi la la 52btokho nyes pa med par btson rar bcug ste/de btson ra der lo mang po lo brgya phrag mang po/lo 'bum phrag mang po btson rar bcug la/de'i lhag pa'i bsam pa yang tshogs par ma gyur/des rkun po'i sems kyang ma bskyed du zin kyang /de bzhi rar bcug na/de tsam gyis ni de rkun po zhes brjod pa ma yin no//tshe dang ldan pa de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' de yang khyim na gnas shing 'dod pa'i yon to lnga rnams la longs su spyod pa des/tshul khrims 'chal pa zhes bya bar mi brjod do//gal te bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du tshangs par spyod pa spyod la/de yang nyan thos kyi sa'am rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yongs su bsngo zhing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa yang /'khrugs na de tsam gyis na des tshul khrims dang ldan pa zhes mi bya'o//gang gi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyan thosakyi tshul khrims la gnas na/de byang chub sems dpa' zhes mi brjod do//de ci'i phyir zhe na 'di lta ste tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro//zhes dang /rin po che sdud pa las/gal te byang chub sems dpa' 'dod yon lnga spyod kyang //sangs rgyasachos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun skyabs song ste//sangs rgyas 'grub bya snyam du kun mkhyen yid byed na//mkhas pa tshul khrims pha rol phyin gnas rig par bya//zhes sems can gyi don du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che bslab pa rnams la 'dod yon rnams grogs su 'gyur ba/'od srungs kyis zhug pa'i mdo las/ji ltar grong khyer skye bo'i mi gtsang lud//de ni bu ram shing pa'i zhing la phan//de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon 53na sgongs lud//de ni sangs rgyas chos rnamasabaskyed la phan//zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par/7mdo sde las/bram ze'i khye'u bla mas tshong dpon gyi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6nebu mo la spyod pas tshul khrims kyi phar phyin rdzogs pa dang ded dpon snying rje can gyis mi nag mdung thung bsad pas bskal pa grangs med dgu'i tshogs 'dums par bshad pa sogs thun mong ba'i theg pa'i skabs su'ang gnang bkag gi khyad par ches mang zhing / slob dpon seng ge bzang pos brgyad stong 'grel chen du/ bskal pa grangs med pa gsum mam bcu'am sum cu rtsa gsum gyi bar du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tsho gis gnyis bsags te gdong mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pha rol tu phyin pa la yun ring por tshegs kyis sangs rgyas sgrub dgos na'ang rdo rje theg pa'i khyad par gyi chos snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la 'tshang rgya bar nus pa/ bshad rgyud sa sbu ṭi las/ /tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas sam/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid thob la/ /zhes dang /mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi le'u drug pa las/ skye 'dir sangs rgyas mchogo nyid du/ /sems bsgoms pas ni sangs rgyas so/ /rin cen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /ces nye lam khyad par can du gsungs pa'i thabs kyang rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ bshad rgyud sa skru ṭa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa rnams mthun par/ dgod dang lta dang lag bcangs dang / /gnyis gnyis 'byung dang de bzhin du/ khyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyi/ /zhes 'dod chags lam du byed tshul mi 'dra ba bzhi tsam gsungs pa'i gtso bo rnal (53ba tshe cur bla na med pa'i smin grol gyi rim pa yin pas/ sdom gsum du/ des na smin byed dbang dang ni/ /rim pa gnyis la 'bad byas na/ /de ni tshe 'di bar do'am/ /skye ba stso drug dganas ba/ / ces dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum gyi khyad par gsungs pa'i tshe gcig gi lus rten la grol bar byed pa dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi phyag rgya'i lam la bltos pas/ spyod bsdus sgron mer/ de ltar cha rkyen ma tshang ba med pas legs par bslabs pa'i phyag rgya rnams dang lhan cig bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la slob par byed pa dag gi phan yon bstan pa ni/ zhag bdun zhes pa la sogs pas gsungs te/ dbang po rab kyis dngos grub kyi dus ni zhag bdun no/ /dbang po 'bring gis zla ba phyed de zhag bco lnga'o/ /dbang —78

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)po tha ma yis ni zla ba gcig gam zla ba phyed dang gnyis te zla ba phyed kyis lhag pa'i zla ba ni zla ba phyed dang gnyis te des dbang po thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sems dben gyi dpe'i 'od gsal skabs nges par las rgya la brten nas bde chen gyi ye shes 'dren dgos pa/ rim lnga las/ sgyu ma dag ni thams cad las/ /bud med sgyu ma khyad par 'phags/ /ye shes gsum gyi dbye ba ni/ /gsal bar 'di las mtshon par 'gyur/ /'dod chags nyid dang chags bral dang / /de yi bar do gsum po ni/ /dbang po nyid ni mnyam sbyor pa'i/ /rdo rje pad+ma lus las so/ /zhes dang / gsang ba grub pa las/ /las kyi phyag rgya mnyam ldan pas/ rdo rje pad+ma mnyam sbyor ba/ /bden pa gsungs pasamangon sum du/ /'di 'dra'i sgom pa gang gsungs pa/ /dang po'i las can sems can la/ /las (54na)kyi phyag rgya gang spongs nas/ /byang chub sems ni rab ston pa/ /gzhan gyis mtsho ni pas mi mthong ste/ /dang po'i las can rig par bya/ /zhes med du mi rung ba'i lam nyams su len pa'i pho nya'i mtshan nyid ni/ mdor bcas las/ dme sha can gyi bdag nyid che/ /bu mo ut+pal mthing kha'i mdog /mig yangasadam pa rnyed nas ni/ /mnyam par bzhag cing legs par bslabs/ /sgrub pa po la shin tu mos/ /zhes gsungs shing / theg dgu'i yang rtse nges don rdzogs pa chen po khreg chod dang thod brgal gyi lam gnyis la lta ba dang / spyod pas bogs 'don pa'i phyi ma'i skabs/ klong gsal thems yig las/ de dag klong gsal snying khrag dwangs ma'i skor/ /mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs/ /zhes pa'i nang tshan zab lam nyi zla kha sbyor las/ bde ba'i rang bzhin chags med dbyings na rol/ /kun+ta'i dpa' bo rtsa rlung bde bas tshim/ /zhu bde'i rang bzhin 'khor lo lnga la rgyas/ /zhes gzhan lus thabs ldan la brten nas shin tu myur ba'i gsang lam la bslabs par sngags mkhar phyug po gling smad pa'i dge slong sogs du mas yo ga sgrog pa ni/ nā lan+dar rnal 'byor dbang phyug dge 'dun rnams kyis 'byung ba dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug dril bu par grong khyer ba rnams kyis thal mo brdabs pa'i tshul du snang zhing / slob dpon dril bu pas/ e sto bi sha'i yul gyi rgyal por/ dngos rnams yongs su shes pa'i —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'amakhas pa rnams la brnyas par mi bya ste/ de ni rtsa rtse chung ba bas kyang chung ba'i 'byor pa rnams la chags pa min/ khyun mi chad par chang 'dzag pa yis 'gram pa nag por gyur pa la/ /glang chen rnams ni (54ba)pad+ma'i skud pa phra mos khyig par mi nus bzhin/ /zhes pa'i don du mngon/shing phag phag mo lo'i bka' brgyud pho brang du chos rje sku skye dge ba gter kha'i khrag zhag ma thems par sbyin bdag gcig gi rten bzhengs la rab gnas mdzad pa bskul bskyod dang / rol mos nyen bslangs slo bur tu grongs pa'i sreg sbyangs dang rten bzheng gi thig rtsa zhal bkod gzungs bzhug rab gnas gnang / bsngo zhus 'bul mir bya yul nas 'brug pa sprul sku dpag bsam dbang pos dpe cha thams cad tho nang bzhin zegs 'thor med par bskur gsungs par brten/ der pha bong khar bsdad thog rje nyid kyis phyag bris dang bcas rin spungs pa'i snyan ngag gi 'grel pa bya yul nas rtsad gcod byung bas dgos tshul phebs pa bshus grub mtshams dang 'grig pa'i zhus dag gtong long med par 'bul dgos byung /dbyar gyi ring rje bla ma 'bras spungs su gdan drangs/ nged zil gnon gyi bsnyen mtshams shig byed kyi yod pa'i mtshams khog tu phebs nas gegs sel bogs 'don dang dmigs skor ljags lung sogs chos 'brel kha yar zhus/ phal cher nyi 'od rtsar bzhugs pa'i tshe bdag gi zhal thang che chung sogs phyag bris gnang / 'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i phyag 'khrid zhib par zhus/ 'phan yul za dam gyi gnyer pa steng grib kyis mnar ba'i byin rlabs la byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po gdan drangs pa mkha' rog gi gru brgyud phebs gshis shan khar gung gi dro 'debs pa'i rnyed bkur rgyas par gnang / zhabs drung rin po ches rje 'di nyid kyi snyan la zhal sbyar nas gsung gleng mang du gnang bas der 'khod rnams dpon slob thugs nang gtsang zhes gleng ba 'phan (55na〉lcal nas tshur lam yer pa brag gseb kyi gnas gzigs gnang nas spos dgar gdan 'dren mdzad/ de dgong 'byom stod gzhung gi tshes bcu ba tshor le'u bdun ma dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi lung gnang / mtshan mo rje nyid la brag stag pa'i man —80

zur r+sā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbying rang grol gyi rnam thar/ khyadangag sgron ma drug pa/ phag ston gyi rin po che 'od 'phro/ se ston pa'i mchod rten gsal byed kyi sgron me rnams kyi lung / mnga' bdag nyang gi bla ma rdo rje 'chang / byang gter gyi phur pa srid gsum bdud 'dul dang sras mchog nyi ma sogs sku la bcang ba'i nang rten rnams kyi mjal ka dang chos sman gyis gtsosadam rdzas byin rten gyi ris dang bya mang phug gi gter ma'i o rgyan chen po'i thugs dam sdig par yang kha shas btab nas gnang / nang par dpon slob sum cu skor la tshe gur sbrags ma'i bka' dbang stsal/dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bu'i dgyes par gyur/ nang par lha sar chibs kha bsgyur bar rgyang tsam gyi bar phebs skyel gnang /zur chen gzhen nu don grub kyi sku'i tsho gos gsog tu dmigs pa'i yer pa brag gseb/ spos dga' ba/ gar phu dgon/ 'byom stod dgon/ sdings phu pa/ lcags rdzong rtsa brgyad pa sogs chu byang kha'i ser tshogs kyi gral dbu brag gseb bla ma gdan drangs/ byang brgyud kyi skye bo pho mo rnams la ston mo sbyin gtong gis tshim par mdzad/ spos dga'i thugs khur bzhes ring brag gseb dang spos dga'i sman bla'i cho ga blo la gang yod rnams tshogos par lo lo bzhin bde gshegs brgyad kyi mchod pa stong tshar btsugs/ skyid shod stod kyi sngags pa rnams kyis dpa' bo'i brtan bzhugs phul ba brtan bzhugs kyi thog ma yin 'dug cing spos (55brko gar stan chags ring bzhugs gdan de ga 'ding ba gnang ngo / /ris med 'gro ba brgya phrag phan bde'i sgo/ /thog ma'i rten 'brel 'phrin las lde mig gis/ /mal mer g.yu brag gdan sar legs phye tshe/ /snga dro dgongs khyad bzhin du sngon byung gsal/ /sku gsum bsnyen pa'i dngos grub byang bdag gis/ /lung bstan rigs 'dus snying tig sgrub pa'i dus/ /rtsi sman dri bsung mngar pos kun khyab pa/ /g.yu thog mgon de slar yang byon tam snyam/ /dbyingasarig dag pa'i mkha' la 'og min shing / /mngon sum zhi khror 'byam klas stag mgo rjes/ /bsgomasanyams ding 'dir sad pa'i gzengs bstod glu/ /rje btsun bla ma'i mgur gyi bum par blangs/ /zhi dang —81—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('khro bo kun bos bka' brgyad lha'i/ /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor bye ba'i rigs so sor/ /skal bzang gdul bya nyer smin mān+da ra'i/ /cod pan dbang rtags gtsug tor rgyan du mdzes/ /bcu drug phyed phyed rdzogs pa dga' ba bzhi'i/ /bde chen ka dag dbyings su zung 'jug pas/ /bcu gsum lam gyi bgrod pa'i rtse mo sa kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs/ /'thibs bu'i sgrib srab dad pa'i skya rengs mas/ /rab drangs mgon khyod zhabs sen nyi 'od kyis/ /bdag blo'i pad+ma thog mar yongs ba 'ad pa'i/ /bsod nams byas 'bras smin pa'i rtse dga' rgod/ /'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi skor dus phyis dbus gtsang gnyis ga'i rnying ma rigs rus dang skye ba'i rlom sems can phal cher gyis cha tsam yang ma rtogs shing shes par khas 'che ba 'dra yang log rtog gi zang zing lo kho nar gyur par mthong bas byin rlabs kyi chu bo ma nub cing man ngag la nang byan chud pa 'bri gung zhabs (56na)drung dang byang bdag rigs 'dzin gnyis po las med 'dra bas/ de gnyis gang rung gi drung du chos bka' rnams gsar par babs pa 'gab tshul gyi rgyu mtshan gsol zhing dgongs par bstad pa'i 'bri gung zhabs drung bye ri stag rtser bzhugs gshis skabs su babs pa tsam 'dug rung 'bri stag gnyis sngar nas sgrob shin tu che ba'i khar gtsang nas lcam phebs pa'i gshis drung 'khor rnams kyis sku dbyings ched du bcos pa 'dra mo'i snyan 'bul zhu khag pa tsam byung dogs kyis rdo rje brag tu phebs par thag bcad/ ston gyi me tog grub bstun phebs rgyur sog po ar sa lang dmag khri phrag tsam dang bcas 'dam du 'byor pa'i stod smad thams cad g.yang srag che bas dgon phan tshun gyi nya len dang bcas skor cig phebs ma thub/ dgun smad chibs kha bskyod de zhal gyi phur phebs skabs er khe ja'i sang gis gtsos pa'i sog po g.yas ru'i dmag rnams 'bri gung nas mar 'ongs dmangs ma 'phan yul du brdzangs/ nyis brgya tsam zhig lha sa dang 'bras spungs su 'ongs pa'i ga re 'brom stod tshor me rgyag shing bshus tsha dam ches pas yab 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gis thugs blor ma chud nas gdan 'dren btang ba ltar log phebs pas rnga chen 'phrang du sog po dang —82

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanamajal rung ma mthong ba bzhin min nam skyon du ma gyur/ sog po de kur sog gi grags che zhing khyad par khong tsho'i bla mar zhwa dmar rab 'byams pa bzang po zer ba yod pa'i stabs za dam nas yer pa phu mda' khyab pa'i lugs byas 'dug kyang / rje nyid thugs blos ma khel bar dga' ldan pho brang du srung kha dgos tshul zhu ba mdzad pa ltar dar khan (56ba tshe skem ji'i gnyer pa shes rab bkra shis gnang ba dang / ma nas g.yas ru'i dmag dpon de grub mtha' dge lugs yin snang bas gnod pa'i rigs ma byas 'dug /ar sa lang gis gtsos pa'i sog mangs yar 'brog tu yod pa phyogs ga la 'gro 'on ma things pa'i gshis 'thangs ma phye bar stan chags ngos 'bras spungs su zhag bcu skor zhig bzhugs sar phebs/ 'jam dpal rlung sgrub dang 'gong po ar gtad kyi lung phyag 'khrid zhus/hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i mjug tu tha'i jis gtsos pa'i dmag rnams gan pa la rgyab nas 'ong skabs sog po kha 'thor ba mangs pa'i srung kha rkyang pas thub ris mi 'dug rung / gu ru tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyi dmag bzlog sogs jag chings sgrib shing gi ris mdzad pas spos dga' dgon la 'brom chu rigs kyi skyes shin tu tshan che'ang gnod pa'i rigs ma byung / dmag dum zhig gis thang pa'i phu brgyud brag gsob la rgyab nas gshor god che bar byung bas phu mda' g.yog gshis ya mtshan du 'dzin/me byi zla ba dang po'i nang du chibs kha bsgyur ba'i tshe zhabs drung bla ma rin po che dpon slob gtsang nas sog bzlog sgo gang gzab mdzad dgos tshul la brten/ mtshams lung dbang chen dang yang rdzong du gshin rje'i sgrub pa la phebs pa'i yang rdzong du bzhugs pa dang 'grig /gter gsar lung bstan du/ drag po'i bu mchog dpral sme can gnas chen drag por zab gter sbasaḥ zhes pa'i thog ma'i chos bka' drag po'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i gnas shig tu spel dgos pa byung nas dol gyi phur gnam sa gnyis ka gru gsum du yod pa zhig la rje gong ma thugs the tshom gnang ba'i lo rgyus dang bcas yang rdzong 'di slob (57na ji pon chen po'i sku 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dben gnas/ gnubs —83

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'achen gyis nye 'byed rlung gi 'khor lo bskor ba sogs mngon spyod kyi las sgrub sa yin/ da lam ga me gu ru'i sgrub pa dang 'grig pa rten 'brel legs/ sku mtshams ma grol bar bzhugs gsung ba bzhin phyag dpe 'dra 'bri ba dang yang rdzong gi gnas rnams mjal ba mdzad pas gnubs chen gyi gzims phug tu tshe bdag gi zhal ras rang byon gsal bar gzigs/ brag gi dbar nas rdo'i dung dkar rang byon zhig phyag tu 'byor/ grub thob me long rdo rje dang zhang gi thun mong gi gnas dar phug tu sang phebs rgyu'i nub gnas bdag klu mos dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gzigs snang du shar/ gnas su phebs tshe sngon gyi bag chags 'ga' zhig sad/ grub thob me long rdo rje'i sku dang zhabs rjes spyan lam du thogs dus thugs mos shin tu che ba dang gnas 'dir sgrub pa la sgril na dgongs pa thun mong ma yin pa shar/gnas skor grub pa dang sku mtshams 'grol gdong 'grig pa'i sgrub gtor steng nas ga me gu ru'i srog gtad yongs rdzogs lung bcas/ gnas kyi khyad nas tshe bdag lcags 'dra'i gnyen po don rgyud dang drag sngags mtshon cha nag po'i rgyud sogs chos tshan kha shas kyi ljags lung gi dbu btsugs/sang nyin zhabs drung rin po che rdo rje brag la thegs zhor sgrags sngags grar phebs rtsis kyis gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam rten thub chen gyi sku la dar dkar yug 'di 'bul rgyu yin pa nged rang rnying ma ba la mi tshos mi shes pa'i mthong rang byed kyi 'dug pas khyed kyis thugs rtsom dang paṇ+ḍi ta sogs mdzod gsung ba bzhin rje nyid kyis phyag bris su btab/ sngags (57ba'i ra sgar pa'i gzims chung du gdan drangs dus rkarma pa'i bzhugs khri'i che ba yin zer nas zhabs drung bla ma rin po cher kha gang ma gcig las ma bting bas thugs dgyes rgyu ma byung zhing thub chen gyis gtsos pa'i mchod khang rnams la phebs dus mgon khang du rdo nag po snying gi dbyibs can zhig mgon po ber nag gi thugs yin zer/ mjal gar phul tshe sngags 'chang spos phor bas gar lugs la mthu mi yong ba bden pa 'dug /chos skyong sku gshegs 'dug ces gshags kha byas skad/rdo rje brag tu zla ba gsum gyi bar zhabs phyir bzhugs te nges don bde 'jug gi steng nas bka' —84

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanagater gyi dbang gi chu bo thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'i 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs/ lcags 'dra pad gnubs kyi rigs so sor ma 'dres pa/ lcags sdig chosasdernams kyi lung man ngag /khyad par mchod rten bcas choge gi phyag len dmar 'khrid du bstar/ gzhan yang thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi sgrub pa sde brgyad dang sdo drug gi dbang / chos tshan nyer lnga thems can thems med/ dmar nag gshin rje'i yang snying mthu stobs dregs pa'i rgyal po/ gnubs kyi shog ril dgu pa sogs gdams pa zab dgu gnang 'phrin las che zhing ljags klog dal ba sogs nas 'phro lus dogs nas gal che ba rnams sku dngos dang gzhan ma bla ma e ljag par zhus na ji ltar yong snyan du gsol bar tshang ma nged rang gis thub par byed pas gtan nas mi 'gab phebs pa de dus dogs pa ma shar yang rjes su sngags 'chang ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis dpon slob bar du sel cung zad yod pa de la dgongs 'dra zer/ dgongs pa ma khrol (58na thar lho brag mkhar chur 'byon nyin dbu zhwa yang brdabs zhes pa mi bden las che/ bden na ma zhus(pa skabs su babs pa byung 'dug gsung / gnam lcags ur mo'i dpe'u ris gzhung gi shugs bstan zab khyad can chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi phyag dpe'i steng nas zur rigs 'dzin pas 'bri gung rtse bar ngos bshus mdzad pa spyan lam du phab pas 'di'i dpe cha 'dir yod pa de bor nas ma rnyed pa da lam bu yig bsnams byon pa dngos grub rang du byung zhes dgyes pa chen pos tshar gcig bshu ba gnang zhing / rigs 'dzin chen po 'phrang 'go shel gong du phebs pa'i lam du rang 'thag ya khod cig 'dug par chibs kha bskyil nas steng 'og gi 'bor lo sprod lugs sogs kyi ngo sprod zhib tu gnang /'di lo gtsang sde srid nas bskul lcag mdzad pa rnams su ma zad rnying ma ba thams cad dad blangs kyis hūṃ rub phaṭa rub dang / lhag tu byed pa rigs 'dzin chen pos sog po 'di pas gtsang po lho khar 'don pa sogs sngar ma grags/ bod kyi lha mi thams cad la brnyas gsungs shin tu mi dgyesapa'i dgu gtor khyab 'jug gi 'gyu dus thams cad byang la 'phen zhing dbu zhwa brdabs/ gdab las —85

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānekyi tshe ming 'bod sogs hor bzlog la shin tu brtson par gnang / bka' chos kyi srubs dbar tshor bal po rdo brkos pas bzhengs pa'i rgya gar gyi rigs 'dzin brgyad/ bod kyi grub chen dgu/ ga rjo la rnams la gser chab sgron pa/ thugs dam tsag li bzheng dgos pa'i stabs mtshan mo mar me la sgor gyis phyag dpe 'bri ba sogs kyis spyan mnyel bar tshur phebs gdong (58ba)rigs 'dzin chen po'i bka' las/ bstan pa la e phan dgongs pa'i thugs rus ches na phugs spyan la skyon yong bas thugs zon mdzod gsung ba'i bslab ston dang / nyid zhang gi gdan sar bzhugs pa la mkho che ba yong bas bla ma zhang gi sku mar pa lha skal ma g.yas ru byang pa'i rten gtso 'di 'bul gsungs nas gnang /tshur phebs nas spos dgar yab sras gnyis dang rgyal sngon a khu pad+ma gsum gyis 'khor lo rnams kyi dbe'u ris bzhengs/ sgo tshang nang pa lags rigs 'dzin sogs kyis lcags sdig gi glegs bam bris/de dus nged 'phan yul lha khang na bsdad yod par rje nyid kyi phyag bris dang lcags 'dra'i glegs bam phyed lhag tsam zhig bshu ba'i ma dper gnang / dbyar dge 'phel du 'brum 'dzem la yod thog lcagasasdig byang pa'i bla dpe dang bu yig gnyis ka gung thang nas skyel mi gnang ba bu yig ma dper phyag tshags dang ma dper chos rgyal byang pa'i bla dpe yin pa gras kha bris shog tshang mar gzigs 'jug ngos phyir bskur gsung bar dge slong gnyer pas dpe cha gces po yod na chu mo 'di 'dra la bskur nas chu la gzhor na mi la sprod rgyu med par ci drag gang drag yong zer nyams 'char byed snang / nged rgyal du 'brum 'dzem la zla ba drug pa'i nang du 'gro dgos shar bas rje bla ma 'byangs med phebs dgos pa'i zhu 'phrin phul/hor zla dgu pa'i nang du dpon slob rnams kyi phyag phyir dbu mdzad don grub bkra shis dang bcas chos 'khor rgyal mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du phebs/ zla ba lnga tsam gyi bar bzhugs/dbang lung man ngag ji snyed dang khyad par bcas chog chen mo'i phyag len dang dbang (59na sgong man ngag mtha' dag shin tu zhib par zhus/ 'brug pa sprul skus sgron ma drug pa gnam lcags 'phrul gyi lde —86

zur r+sā thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)mig tu/ da: 'dom gang gru bzhi brtsig /ces pa ma gzigs par nag po khru gang bang rim bzhi zhesapa'i tshogs la 'khrul nas srog shing la mda' tshad mi dgos gsung bas mtshon ga tshig lung ma drosatshor dpags kyang chos 'di shes pa rang gi sar gtug pa gnang ba legs 'dug bsam pa shar/dpe'u ris po tir longs pa'i phyag bris gnang / lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal gyi de zhi ko zhir dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i rten mdos 'dzugs pa mdzad/skyid shod du phebs gdong nged kyi zla bo sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtshos byas nas byed rtsis kyi lnga bsdusasgra gcan dang nag rtsis rags rim tsam zhus bka' gdams gleg bam gyi zhu lan nor bu'i 'phreng ba'i lung dgos gsung ba phul/ rgyal nas phyir phebs zhor chos 'phro dogs gcod 'dra dang bcas rdo rje brag tu zhag kha shas bzhugs rtsis la 'phrang 'go phyogs su 'brum pa mched dag cing phyag g.yog rnams kyis mthong ba ma thar ba dang ar sa lang gi pha chog thu'i dpon mo zhig 'das pa'i dge rtsa mo rang gi kha chems bzhin grub mtha' ris med kyi bla ma mang por 'bul rgyu bskur 'dug pa rdo rje brag tu phul ba rnams yar stod bkras rab kyi sa cha'i zhu rten la song ba'i thugs mkho dang drag las gnang ba'i dam sel gyi lcog sgang ba'i gra pa mang po 'byum mjug steng grib kyis byas pa'i zhabs drung rin po che thugs ngal ba sogs phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad nas mdor bsdus pa'i rgyur brten zhag gsum las ma bzhugs par go bor (59ba〉rgyud gung thang du phebs/ dgun zla gsum gyi ring 'brum nad mched skabs sbyin bdag gra ris tshor phan thogs ma byung zhes re 'bang thor bu zhus snang / chu lho kha'i dgon sde rnams kyi re 'dod bskang nas spos dgar phebs/ 'brom chu brgyud sogs byang kha ba tshos mjal/ dus rgyun du 'phrin las che ba'i khar 'di dus thor nad stabs nas gson po'i rim gro srung ba/ gshin po'i yar 'dren sogs kyi thugs brel shin tu che bsnyung /me glang lo 'di char zhed lhag par che bas brag sgo ga: zhig tu nye bar sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi phebs sgo bzhin sto 'phye'i thig dang sa 'dul la phebs/ mchod rten gyi thig rtsa dang zhal 87

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()bkod zur chen gzhen nu don grub kyis mdzad/rdor dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor rje bla ma'i phyag brisadang phyogs mtshams kyi dkyil 'khor brgyad gzhis ka shar nas lags kun dgas bris/gtsang nasasog bzlog la lha sar rje nyid kyis khro rol/rgyud stod smad nas drug cu pa/ser 'bras nas dge 'dun lnga brgya tsam gyis rgyab chos dang bcas sku rim gnang /zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu la pha bong khar rdo rje 'chang dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par nyi thang slob dpon drung 'tsho ba dang dka' bcu 'phrin las phun tshogs gnyis mol bsdur ngos rje bla ma ma phebs par gsang rtsis kyis dge slong 'phrin las chos rgyal gdan 'dren la btang ba bzhin 'phral du phebs sngar nas gsung 'phros kyi lhongs la rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i lung 'dren dang bcas bya sprel lcags khams yin zhing /khyad par lcags kyi bya sprel me la sreg mi rung bas thog mar nang bzhugs byas na nyes pa sel ba'i phebs sgo yang yang gnang ba thugs la bcags te zhag bdun 60na ) thugs dam la bzhugs ring gsung chog dang mchod 'bul mdzad/thugs dam grol rjes gza' skar dang bstun pa'i tshes nyi shu'i dgong mo sku gdung rin po che chud mi 'dza' ba'i phyag tshags dam par mdzad nas rin po che'i sgrom bu bcug ste nang bzhugs su mnga' gsol/lo ma gsar ring rje nyid nas gdung yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du wo re bzhin mchod pa lnga tshar chag med/gdung chog pa tshor nyin 'byongs kyi zhabs tog gdung 'bul rgyas par mdzad/sa stag shar nas zhugs 'bul mdzad pa'i sngon du grub rtsis kyis dngul gdung bzheng ba'i thig rtsa bzo bkod gzungs bzhugs rab gnas kyi bar phal cher pha bong khar bcad bzhugs gnang nas phyag bstar/chos lung mdo spyil gyi dgon pa da ga 'a ldan pho brang nas gnang ba ltar rtsis bzhes/chos khri lho lcog gnyis rkar bla brang dang 'du khang brten thub med cing gra tshang gi ming so sor btags kyang don la shogs chung bas gcig tu bsgril/bla brang 'du khang gsar bzheng gi char bla brang gi phyag 'debs/sgrib kyi shas yong gra tshang gnyis rang gi gshas bogs rnams lo snga ma tsho nas zur du bsags/rje nyid kyis daX ldan zhol thar rgyas nas sgrib kyi bar la me tog

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanamadzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril te dpon po dge 'dun bsod nams dang dkon cog rgya mtsho gnyis la rtsis sprad nas do dam bcol/ chos khri'i bla brang rnying pa'i steng na spyil bu lnga tsam bsnan te rgya khyon che ba mdzad rtsis sa stag zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du yab sras lhan du phebs/ spom gta' sogs rtsis dkar nag las byung ba'i bcos ka rgyas par mdzad nas hor zla gsum pa'i gza' skar bzang bar rtsig ming khrid de ar (60ba)po btsugs/ mi ring bar dga' ldan khang gsar du gdan drangs 'bras spungs mchod khang chen por bzhugs pa'i bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi thig rtsa dang ljags bkod lañca dang jo bo shākya mu ni'i dbu rgyan zhig gsos kyis zong 'phul gyi phyag bris sogs gnang zhing / sngar nged rang dang sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho gnyis kyis rgyal du bslab sbyang zhus pa'i 'phro mthud grub rtsis kyi lnga bsdus/ byed grub kyi mgyogs rtsis/ lo 'pho zla 'pho/ gza' lnga tshes spyod dang nyin zhag gi rtsa sgrub/ nyin zhag ma'i mgyogs rtsis/ dus sbyor du ma drug /stong 'jug /zhag gsum rnamasadabye/ dbyangs 'char/ lto 'phye'i thig rtsa rnams zhib par nyan/ stod rgyud zhal snga nas bzang grong pa sogs lha sa skor du steng grib kyi gnod pa sna tshogs byung bar srung bcos byin rlabs mang du gnang /dbyar sos chos lung tshes bcu ba rnams kyis dbang gzhi bteg nas dgon pa steng shod du khrom dbang stsal/ gung thang mkhar las gra rigs rnams ma gtogs mi lag nyung pa'i 'ol chung bar brten las g.yor yong du re ba'i byi ri stag rtser 'bri gung zhabs drung rin po che chos kyi grags pa'i drung du phebs nas/ snang rtse gter ston gyi lung bstan du zho stod nang nas 'bri yis gad bdar byed: tshal thang rtse na mnga' thang bskyed par 'byung zer ba 'di 'bri gung nas thugs khur bzhes pa'i tshal gung phyogs su zhig gsos gnang na 'bri gung pa'i chos srid la phan pa yod 'dra ba'i rgyu mtshan 'jebs chags pa 'bul ba gnang yang rdzong gi gzhig gsos sogs byed sgo mangs pa'i 'u lag gi mthun rkyen mi thub ces zhal gyis ma bzhes pa thugs la gnang ma 'dod pa rang yin shas ma kha rung stag rtses (61na po tsos pa'i sa smad rnams gtsang pa'i lcam sku dbang btsan gshis 'bri gung nas don du thugs —89

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'a dbang 'dus pa'i las g.yor gnang thabs ga la bde/ ma nas sngar chos rgyal rin cen phun tshogs rgya ma khri khang gi gro bo lung du me tog 'thor nas lo ngo gsum bar gsang sgo byas dus gal la hor dang lcang 'jig pa sogs blon po rnams kyis mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po dang snang rtse gter ston gnyis la zhabs drung sku bde dog gi brtag pa zhus par rigs 'dzin rjes sku khams mthar thon mi yong ba'i phyogs dang / snang rtse nas sku rim phab pa'i sku khams bzang ba yong ma byung na nga gter chos lag tu mi len zhes lung bstan/ gsang sgo 'grol gdong snang rtse nas brtan bzhugs 'bul bar byon pa sku gdung nang bzhugs byas sar btang nas yol ba bsal bas sde pa snang rtse ba zhal skyengs te o rgyan pad+mas nga bslu ba zhig yin zhes gsungs pa sogs kyis 'bri gung phyogs su khong par yid brtan chung zhing snang rtse nas phag mo ba'i bla ma yin gshis phyogs 'phul sogs gang sa nas lung bstan des rba phigs ris su mi snang / 'on kyang zhabs drung rin po cher sgrol dkar yid bzhin nor mchog gi skor gsan nas gung thang du phebs/ rigs 'dzin yol mo ba chen po rdo rje brag nas yer par sog bzlog la phebs pa rje nyid stag rtser bzhugs pa dang dus 'grig nas mjal ka dang gzhi lan gnang ma thub par thugs 'gyod cher mdzad/ dbus gtsang gi thor thag phal cher chod nas 'bri gung phyogs su byung ba'i snang gsal drung pa phun tshogs pa thor nad kyis grongs pa'i phyi rten la slob dpon chen po'i rnam (61ba)par gra tshar lnga/ bsam pa lhun grub ma rnams bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la zing par phebs/mang ja bsngo rten gnang zhing gra ris rnams kyis bsnyen bkur nas zhag lnga tsam bzhugs/sa yos zla ba dang po'i nang du nged yer pa'i gnas mjal la phyin ri skor sogs tshang mar rten bshad la rje nyid phebs te gnas kyi lo rgyus las 'phros pa'i gsung gleng shin tu rgyas par byung /mchod rten rtse dgu dang sri gcod 'bum pa skor sar gnas 'di la phyis skor hor sog gi gnod pa mang bas phyis nas de ris mi yong ba'i spyod lam gyis phebs pa ltar byed blo tsam zhus/ phyir lam spos dga'i 'khris su rje bla mas dkar spro'i gzhi len gnang zhing zur chen gzhen nu don grub dang mol 90

zur r+ṣa thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)mchid smar bar byung /zhabs drung rje btsun ma sku gshegs pa'i gsal 'debs nas bzung zhag shasabazhugs ring byang zhu lam bstan sogs ma chag pa dang zhugs 'bul gnang /byang bdag rigasa'adzin ngag gi dbang po pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su bshegs pa'i gnas tshul gsan 'phral rdo rje brag tu phebs kyang stod nas rigs 'dzin yol mo ba ma byon me mchod 'gyangs pa'i sku gdung rin po che nang bzhugs grub pa dang 'grig pas gdung khang drung du bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon por shar ba la gsol 'debs mchode pa gdung 'bul gyis mtshon pa'i legs byas kyi tshogs chen po bskrun zhing dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bzhes/zhugs 'bul dus los gtong ba'i cha dan gnang ste phyir phebs/zhe dgu'i sku tshigs thams cad la gsung chog mchod 'bul dang lo lo bzhin dus dran gyi mchod pa mdzad/rgya ma byin chen gzhis ka dang btsong 62na〉yin rong pa'i mi ngo skyes rgyal rnams la chad lhag che bar sri ngan bzlog ba'i rim gror gdan drangs pa'i zhor la ri bo maṇ+ḍal dang khri khang /o rgyan chen po'i sgrub gnas gog chung gsang ba'i phug pa mjal te sgrub phug tu bla ma las byang tshogs mchod dang bcas pa gnang zhing tshogs 'khor bgod 'grem gyi skabs slob dpon khang dmar brag gu rus rje nyid kyi sku skal ma zhus par thugs rtog zos te thugs dam brtag pa gnang bar yul phyogs de ga la gnod pa shar ba o rod du ral dpon po'i dmag gis lo mjug rgya ma bcoms pa'i rtags su gnang /hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu la 'brom stod gzhung gi tshes bcu ba rnams kyis yer par gdan drangs/bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i dbang rgyas par stsal zhing spos dgar sbyin bdag rnams la gzhi len bshams/rigs 'dzin yol mo ba'i gter lung du/ri bo dpal 'bar gyi zab gter sa yos lo gdan 'dren dgos pa'i dus rtags su slebs na'ang /lo snga ma gtsang dpung lho nang du bcug pa dang 'grig pa'i mda' dpon dgos lung pas dbang yod kyi phag rir sku rim la bzhugs su bcug pa dang /ri bo dpal 'bar gyi gter byang yom bu /nga nas spyan drangs pa'i brjod don bzhin bla gnyer

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'gra rigs log sgrub byed pa'i ngan dbang can tshos rang thag chod bzhin du 'khyags pa kha'i me 'bud lta bur sprul pa'i sku stod nas gdan 'dren pa/ gal te 'gong po spun dgu yis: mtho 'tshams gter 'di thon pa dka': zhes pa'i thog tu babs te rigs 'dzin yol mo ba rdo rje brag tu phebs/ 'phrosabyung ba ltar rje nyid kyang byon zhugs mi 'bul ba'i phyag g.yog gnang gsung skal (62ba)byin rten zhus shing gter ston yol mo bar bka' chos kyi 'brel ba gsan/ rigs 'dzin rjes dad kyang rten bzhengs ma grub bar sdod rtsis yod pas bla ma rin po ches sku rten bris sku bse tsaka la cha bzhag cig 'bri ba dang rten gyi zhal bkod la phebs dgos gsungs pa bzhin slar ma 'gyangs par chibs kha bskyod/ thub bstan rdo rje brag tu re zhig stan chags ngos rigs 'dzin brgyad kyi sku thang / dur khrod kyi bkod pa bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs las byung ba'i byin can ngo mtshar ma'i zhing bkod dang lha mgron rnams rigs 'dzin nyid kyis phyag bris mdzad pa sor bzhag /thub chen gyi thig rtsa/ gdung tsha/ tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma/ o rgyan rin po che/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po dang bcas pa'i snang brnyan khri tshor bcar bar gser dngul mtshal gsum sgron pa thub chen gyi bzhugs khri'i 'og tu bod 'bangs spyi'i bde thabs la phan pa'i 'gong po ar gtad dang sgos kyi dam srir dmigs pa'i log tri'i 'khor lo sogs 'dri ba'i phyag len mdzad nas rang gi bsti gnas su phebs/ mdo spyil du a khu tshe dbang grongs pa'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul dang chog mangs kyi gral dbur yang dgon spyan snga gdan drangs/zla ba bcu pa 'di nag rtsis pa'i lo mjug sngags pa zor 'phen gyi zla bar song gshis khro rol sogs dus rim mang tsam star chags su gnang ba zin nas phyir lam lha sar dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che dang sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gnyis mjal nas 'bras spungs su zhag gcig bzhugs/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam dung chos rin po che bod mkhar bar gnang sgo mo dbon po brgyud phyag tu byung 'dug la ster bya mdzad/rdo rje brag tu (63na)phebs nas thub chen gyi zhal gser spyan 'byed sogs rten bzhengs kyi 92

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)mthug skyong rnams grub ste rje nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i dpon slob gzhi byes rnams kyis mchog sprul zhig ma phebs bar grang so gter ston chen po rigs 'dzin bla ma'i gdan sar bzhugs dgos pa'i gsol 'debs gnang ba bzhin zhal gyis 'ches/ lcags 'brug gi lo gsar nas sngar rigs 'dzin yol mo bas rgyang yon po lung nas gter gyi kha byang bzhes pa'i shog ser gyi ljags lung dang chos bdag las can snying gi bu bdun byung ba'i gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra'i sprul pa de rje bla mar ngos 'dzin mdzad/ byang gter rdo rje phur pa lugs gsum las 'bring po spu gri'i dbang dang lugs gsum ga'i chos skor gyi lung / gru gu yang waṃ gi gter ma'i 'joms byed rtsal chen nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad lung man ngag phyag len dang bcas pa gsan/bde chen rdzong dpon chus sa bde yangs pas rdzong gi ldebs su mkhar las gsar rgyag byas pas sngags mkhar klu bdud kyi gnod pas byin gzhug la ste'u thebs par gnyan kha 'khris pa'i shin tu nyen par sku rim la gdan drangs rgyal po'i mdos dang gtor bzlog sogs gnang zhing 'brug pa bka' brgyud chos sdings bla mas mtshone thabs rten 'brel shes so cog /yod 'dug rung nad par phan ngo ma ltas shing nyi thang slob dpon drung 'tsho bas nad pa'i rtsa ni bsngogs tshar khyed mdos 'chos kyi bzhugs rgyu e yin sogs rje nyid la gsungs pa thugs ba ched kyang 'byon stabs ma bde/ 'on kyang zhang ston pa'i bon pos klu bcos pas nad pa shi mal nas lhogs/ rdzong dpon rgan par phan thogs(63ba ji ba gnang rgyu ma byung rung gsog khang nas la 'dod chos kha yar stsal/ nub cig mnal lam du mi dkar po dar dkar gyi gos rim pa mang po brtsegs pa phying zhwa dkar po gyon pa zhig gis rdzong la phyin kha log tu bskor ba dang / yang mi gnyis ji bshad lta bus tshul gyis rdzong bdag myur du brjes 'gro zer ba gsan pas mnal sad dus rdzong dpon gnyis brje rgyu e yin dgongs pa bsam ma byung rung la rting ma rdzong sde pa dga' ldan par gshor bas de'i ltas dang mi dkar po de sog po'i lha yin pa 'dra gsungs/ dbyar kha lam shar nub rnams kyis sbyin bdag zhuganas khrom dbang dang de ga'i gdab —93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānelan sogs dbyar gzigs kyi thugs spro bar byung / rje nyid kyi gcen lags kun dga' lo snga ma sna dkar rtse nas chu bo rir khri lcam de nyid kyi sku gdung gdan 'dren pa'i rtsis bshags nas tshur 'khor ba dang bstun steng grib kyi rnam pas yun ring ma bde bar dbang byin rlabs rim gro sogs lung yang du stsal zhing / lo 'di'i ston dus kyi chos nyid du gyur tshe bde chen gyi zhing du 'dren pa dang pur sbyang sogs rgyas par gnang / de dga' ldan khang gsar du tsan+d+ra pa'i rtsa ba/ snyan ngag me long / gso dpyad kyi rgyud chung gsum 'dzin pa sogs tha snyad kyi bslab sbyangs byed skabs lha sa nas sde pas rgyal po bar khams su bzhugs pa'i sku rim la las sbyor mang tsam dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang yang byung bas/ sngar las sbyor gyi ris la sbyong bdar byas pa rnams kyang bar skabs su blos btang ba'i nges rgyu rang med pas rje bla ma dga' ldan khang gsar du gdan drangs/ gshin rje dang rlung 'khor gyi lag len la brjed gsos dang dogs gcod zhus/ bi rir bde gzar yun ring 'gor na (64na7sa sbyor tshan che ba dgos mdog kha ba nas mchod rten la dgos pa'i rdzas gsog pa sogs 'og brabs gnang ba'i snyan gsan phul nas 'bras spungs su phyin/ma 'gyangs par 'chi bdag zhal dbye gsar bskrun zhig dang 'khor lo 'ga' phyag bris su stsal nas gnang zhing slar yang dogs ma chod pa'i ris la snyan sun yang yang zhu dgos byung / dbon po sbyin pa rgyal du rdzong bda' mdzad skabs dpon g.yog thams cad a gyis myos te lam du bde yangs pa'i g.yog po dang thug phrad byung bar brten rdzong dpon gyi rta drel brgyad cu skor phyogs/ dmag gis cho me lung bkra shis sgang gi gzhis ka bskor dus rje bla ma bar mtshams la phebs pa rdzong dpon gzhen pa gsog khang nas gnam lcags drag 'bebs dad gus che gshis dmag log pa dang rta drel gyi gtod len sogs ngo tsha sbas pa lta bu'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba byung /lcags sbrul smon lam nas 'khor 'phral rje bla ma 'bras skrungs su phebs/ 'joms byed nyi zla nag pos gtsos pa'i lung man ngag kha shas zhus/ de mus bdag thor yan zhig gis na bar byang ngos—94

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)nas sku gzhen par mi rnams kyis mchu 'gros las thag chod rang mi gsung 'dug pa sde pa dang ta zhing chos rje sogs thugs nyams can rnams kyis 'brum bar thag bcad 'phrod bsten gyi tshe rje nyid nas srung 'khor gegs sel gyi byin rlabs dang mdos gtor gyi rim gro mang du stsal/ rab gsal gyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab las byung ba'i glang po'i lo rgyus ltar sde pa gtsang du dmag mdzad par thugs blo rtse gcig pa'i shugs kyis rma kha dang khyi tshil gyi dpe bzhin bcas chog mchod rten bzheng ba'i mthun rkyen (64bsgo dzad bzhed 'dug par brten dus g.yin du dgos byed gra mi 'grig par nges te nged rang nas rje nyid la rgyu mtshan gsol ba ltar chos lung mdo spyil du phebs/ sde pas grong smad nang so a bar btang ba'i chos lung gzhis ka nas gsol phogs sogs dgos cha rnams phul/lha 'dre drag po gnas khyad kyi za lung 'du khang gi shing cha nas dgos 'tsham drangs/ shing bzo ba se ra rab brtan/ sprul sku lam rnyed/ cha khar dpon bo/ chos lung pa gnyis/ lag g.yog gang dgos rnamasagatong dgos pa'i ngos sbyor zhus/sde pa byang nas phebs bstun grub pa dgos pa'i phebs sgo la brten thugs brel g.yin pa'i ris bskyur nas bcad rgya gnang zhing dpon slob tshang ma nam langs sa rub kyis thugs rtsol mdzad kyang phyi rgya'i mtshon rtsi sogs grub tsam dang nang gi lha dang zhib chags rnams ma grub pa'i dus rgyal mo che chung gis gtsos pa'i sog po skyid shod du slebs/ bde chen mnga' khul gyi drung 'khor dang gsang sngagasamakhar pa rnams ngo log par tha'i ji rdo rje rnam rgyal dang dar khan nang sos rgyal mo che chung gi sog dmag khrid pa rnams rtse 'dzom du bde chen rdzong la skor rgyag btang ba'i tshe/ tshal gung gi bla ma rnamasakyis skyid shod tha'i ji mjal bar phebs pa'i skabs chu gsor thongs la res rje nyid la chu bsgyur char gcod gnang dgos tshul zhus pa 'bras spungs su phebs par gtugs gshis de ga'i phyag len rnams gcung la bslab ston mdzad de hor zla lnga pa'i tshes bco brgyad la chos lung mda' nas dan bag bar gzhung ko gnang nas 'bras spungs su phebs/ lha tshogs kyi sku dang 'khor ling sogs zhib cha'i phyag —93

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'alas dang nyer lnga'i nyin (65na〉gun gdong mkhar la 'tshangs ga'i skabs skyogs gcog pa sogs rtsis dkar nag gis sto bcos de nyin dgos pa rnams thugs grabs tshags su btsud de brtson 'grus dka' bcu bar rtsis sprad nas byed lugs kyi bslab ston gnang / rdzong nang nas sgrogs gnyis tsam zhig btsugs yod 'dug pa thabs byas 'phral chag pa sogs nges shes 'grongs pa mang du byung /sngon chad sog pos gtsang par dmag byas pa mtha' dag rlungs su ma brgyugs shing sde srid gtsang pa mnga' thang sgang la rgyab dus yin gshis rang phyogs kyi gra ris de nyid ma go ba'i snang ba gdong nged kyi ris thor bu la cha ci yod 'gangs che sa nas dpon slob paṇa wo rin po che dang sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gnyis po ma gtogs rked so yan gyi rang phyogs pa phal cher la nga zhing 'bag mgo gnyis kyi 'jol 'gros mkhan mang ba 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag 'di la lhas things pa gal che ba don la mi bden rgyu yang mi 'dug /lhag tu rje 'di nyid lta grub kyang gsang sngags rnying ma ba yin zhing gtsang pa nas sku rim pa'i gral du 'jug pa'i bdag rkyen sogs gang sa nas gzhogs phyed g.yang bskyur gyi thal song de 'dra gnang don mi 'dug rung pha bong khar bzhugs yun rings pa'i dge bstan la thugs zhen dang skyid shod pa'i dpon zhen yin 'dra bsam pa byung rung / slar zhib tu dpyad tshe dam pa 'di nyid la lkog gyur gyi gnas rnams chags thogs mi mnga' bar mngon par mkhyen pa zhig snang bas/ dge lugs ma da yon gyi bde gzar tshabs su 'gro ba e shes gzigs pa'i me long du shar ba gor ma chag /lcags 'brug gi dpyid gtsang gi skran du skya (65ba tha tsun gnyis 'gro ba'i rjes la rlung nag chen po dum chad rde'u rnams kyang khyer 'gro ba'i thag sgra byed pa'i 'tshub ma'i khrod du bud med nag mo ral pa rting par slebs shing dre'u la zhen pa zhig gi rgyab mdun kun tu mi ro mang po brtsegs nas khur ba yul mi 'gas mthong bas rtog pa skyes te/ a gsas phab nas dris par lha mo dmag zor mas sde srid gtsang pa'i bla khur zhes smras pa/ gtam de blor ma chud nas kha khrims bsdams pas lo shas brjod —96

zur 0 thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)gleng cher ma byung 'dug rung phyi skor gcig nas gnyis su mched pa'i gnas tshul dang yul mi rdor bsam sogs la'ang rgyas 'dug pa srid gsum dbang mos rje bla mar lung ma bstan pa'i nges pa'ang med dam snyam/ bcas choge gi rab gnas sgrub pa las sbyor mjug rlon gtad kyis mtha' bsdu ba'i bar mtha' dag la zhal bkod kyis khyab par mdzad/ gtad pa lam gyi mtsho kha ral dang 'khar nag gang la 'gab kyi gsung 'phros byung bar mkhar nag la gtad na ming yig rigs rim lo gsum las mi khungs pa 'dug ces lung bstan pa ltar de kho nar song / khams gsum 'khrug byed las kyi rlung dmar dang gnam lcags khur mo'i skor yang phyag bstar nas bzhengs/ rlung 'khor shun gyi spel hril du 'dzugs par phebs pa ma 'gyangs par rdzong rgyab tu gla pa sgal ral 'ongs pa sogs rtags sna tshogs byung/ than rnams chos sdogs ra par 'byol gnas 'dzin cha'i nang kun gra mi 'grig pa'i nyams chen po byung zhes ngam ring mkhan chen lo tsā ba gsung 'gros mdzad/ hor stod pa'i dpon rnam sras can gyi dmag stong phrag tsam yas mas gang 'os su mtho 'tsham pa'i (glan)thogs 'chab kyis sde pas sras po rab brtan btang nas dmigs bsal zhig dgos tshul byung ba bzhin srog 'phyan pa nag po'i rlung 'khor 'dzugs pa gnang song ba zla pa gcig gi steng du dpon rnam sras can kha shas chu shur du sog pos bsad/ de nas lo gcig gnyis kyi khongs su rnam ru ba rnams rtsa brlag lta bur song /sog po'i rta pa kha shas kyis snye phu brgyud sle'u chung du phyin par yul pa rnams kyis rta ded pa slar lha sar 'bul du 'ongs kyang sde pa'i dgongs par phogs pa'i bka' bkyon babs lci ba yong ba'i ston 'gro dang / sngar nas sog bzlog pa'i gras su song ba dang / lcog sgar ba'i bla ma e ljag gis mchode yon gyi thog tu sngags bsdebs kyi rlung 'khor btsugs pa'i grags pa bsam yas zur mkhar phyogs su mchod pa dgu mdzad/ mdo sngags gling pas khyer yongs par brten/ sdomagon chags 'jig la gya ba'i nyes dmigs shar skabs rab 'byams pa lnga ba dang sngags 'chang spos phor ba gnyis kyis yol mo sprul pa'i sku'i phyag tham khyer nas rje nyid kyi drung du 'ongs pa bstan pa dang bla ma'i dam tshig la —97

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shākadagongs te thugs khur che bzhes gnang bas e waṃ lcog sgar ba'i rtsa ba tshugs/ slob dpon pa'i rlung 'khor rjes su 'bebs pa'i spar bkab med par thog steng du skyur nas thums ral ta re gnyis 'khyar ba gra ris 'dras dpe la khyer 'dug ces snye mo dgon pa ba'i nang zan 'dra las 'phrang sgo drung pa'i bus thos pa rjes su gleng brjod byed snang /bde chen rdzong sde pa dga' ldan bas rtsis bzhes par rdzong 'og gi sde dgon mtha' dag gi legs bya phul zin gshis dben sa byang sems (66ba〉pas 'grel yang yang mdzad pa yab zur chen gyis gsan pas gnas tshul 'di bzhin 'dug pas mgyogs tsam phebs gsungs pa dang thugs brel yang ha lam chod pas yar phebs gdong tshe dbang zhig dgos gsung ba bzhin phul dus nged kyi gzugs thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i rnam pa phyi gsal nang gsal rgyab kyi po ti'i rtsig pa sogs kyang mi sgrib pa zhig tu gzigs te tsaka lir 'dra ba gnang 'dug pa/ rang blo rang la lkog tu gyur par gzhal na yong don ga la yod kyang rje nyid blo 'das bde stong chos sku'i ngang nas dam pa rigs brgya'i tshom bu khor yug tu shar ba'i gzigs snang yin nam snyam/ yab sras lhan rgyas su skyid shod kyi zhal ngo phyi ltar du g.yang mo khyu gcig la nang ltar du ma re bu re'i tshul gyi gsol thab khag bzhi tsam yod snang bar so sor thugs bde dwangs pa'i legs 'bul mdzad/ ma gcig tha'i ji'i dpon mo dang o pa shi sogs la spos dgar phebs nas bka' dbang gnang mus la zur 'khor lo'i dbang phyug glo bur du bsnyun pa'i mdo spyil du phebs/ snyun g.yog sku rim sman dpyad kyi sri zhu cher mdzad na'ang dgung lo bdun cu don dgur phebs pa'i zhing khams gzhan du gshegs/yang zab kyi 'khrid zab mo'i thugs dam dang sku tshe sngon ma'i bag chags kyis/ 'jam gsar pas/ dang por 'chi bas 'jigs nas thos pa btsal/ /bar du 'chi brod dgos snyam sgom pa byas/ /tha mar 'chi rgyu med pas nyal nas bsdad/ /rgod po nga yi bya ba tshar nas gda'/ /zhes pa ltar chos pa rab 'chi ba la brod pa'i tshul ma gtogs chos pa'i mal sar tha mal pa'i phung po 'jog pa cha dang 'dra —98—

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)bar ma mchis/ 'on kyang rjes 'jug rnams kyi (67na thags byas kyi ched du 'bri gung dang yol mo sprul pa'i sku sogs bla ma rnams la bsngo rten/ zhi khro dang kun rig gi chog grwa/ chog mang la tshal gung gra dmangs kyi mgon du yang dgon spyan snga skal ldan rgya mtsho dang grol ston la chos khri ba'i tshogasadabur ra ba stod nas sogs sku nye mtha' dag rjes su yi rang bar gyur/ a mdo nas zhing skyong paṇ+ḍi ta zer ba rtsis dkar nag dang lha bris shes pa des sngar khyed rtsad bcad kyang dge rgan rnams kyis ma bshad pas ma byung /da lam mjal du 'ongs pa yin zer nas bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi mgyogs dbang sogasachos bka' kha shas dang go la'i 'khor lugs kyis mtshon pa'i rtsis kyi dogs gcod mang du zhus/dngul gos dar rdzas gtsos pa'i 'bul ba phul/ gser thog chos rje lo snga ma yongs pa nas bzung 'byor res kyis bka' chos zhus shing 'bul ba sogs gus pa lhur len/ 'di lo mi tsho gos ches pa dang dam sel gyi sku khams nyog pa tsam byung bar zla ba brgyad pa nas bzung sku mtshams shin tu dam pa rgyang tsam gnang ba'i khrus chab sogs rten 'brel gyi cho gas dam grib kyi rigs rnams rjes med du bsangs/ zla ba dgu pa'i tshes gsum gyi nub mo lo 'di ga dang rjes su rgyal po'i sog po dang yong she ye'i bu nor bu rin cen zhabrugs nas phan tshun bcom res yong ba dang ma dmigs pa'i sa nas dgra dpung yongs pa/ tshes bzhi'i dgongs dga' ldan pho brang gi (67ba sbra'i sa su bla ma mgo dkar bo gnyis kyi rkang pa lcags sgrog gis bcings pa tshes lnga'i nub 'od gsal du rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa phebs nas slob dpon pad+ma'i sku seng ge la ci babs pa zhig gnang ba/ tshes drug gi dgong dga' ldan pho brang gi ltag sgo rgyab tu sde pa gcod pa dpon slob sgo ma dang khyad par mgron gnyer don tshang pa shin tu gsal bar grong smad nas kyis skor g.yeng 'ga' zhig mdzad mthar g.yu bde sogs sku chas—8—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānernams rim gyis rtsis blangs pa shar tshul gyi tho chung dang phyag tham dngos gzhir dmigs ltas 'di tshor dpags na btsun pa lcags kyis bcings pa ar la gtad pas rang zhin 'gro nyams kyis gnas rnying rgyal po'i bar chad la thugs dogs che ba ma dgos shing gtsang pa'i mtshan don yang mtha' tshes pa zhig yong ba mi 'dug /dgra ngo gsar pa zhig la thugs bcag dgos phebs pa rjes su dpyad tshe gzhis ka rtser bar pa skor g.yeng yang grong smad nang so a bar yan 'dug pa dang gzhan ma'i dogs gnas sogs lung bstan du nges pa rnyed/ gu ru'i sku seng ge la bcibs pa ni bde gzar la brten nas bod kyi lha 'dre 'tshub ma zil gyis gnon pa dang / ri dwags seng shes gcan gzan 'joms pa ltar 'jigs pa med pa'i brda thabs yin nam snyam/ zhabs drung byams pa'i gzims dpon se chen no mon to gyi 'dod sbyar bzhin lha sar phebs/ chos kha yar dang gza' lnga dus sbyor phan byed man ngag gi phyag len gyi ris gnang gos dar gyi 'bul ba gya nom pa phul zhing khong byang la shon gdong sposadagar gzhis len rdzong ba gnang /hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du rje bla ma sa spungs su gdan drangs te gter kha du ma'i dkyil (68na〉khor gyi dbang dang lung man ngag mang du zhus/ lo gsar dus rim la gshin rje khro chu'i sgrub zhag bdun dang bcas te zor las gnang ba'i tshe sku mdog kyang rgyun dang mi 'dra bar smug nag tu 'gyur zhing lta bar mi bzod pa'i gzi byin dang bcas me rlung sogs zor bkra rnams shin tu legasapa'i byin rlabs kyi 'a kha che/ chu rta zla ba dang por yab kyi dgongs rdzogs la byang chub r+ṣa po'i gser gdung rgyug mtho lnga pa zhig bzheng ba gnang ba'i do dam dbon po sbyin pa dang / bal po gu ṇa shi na can gsum gyis byas pa'i brdung 'phul phra gsum dngos gtsang zhing gzungs bzhugs phyag bstar ma/ gsung rten la dri med bshags rgyud gser chos dang thang yig skya chos/ sku brnyan 'phral du ma grub pa'i dod zhal thang rnying pa rnams kyi gong gsham zhal khebs gsar du brjes pa'i rab gnas pa yang dgon spyan snga dang / bzo bo 'go lung tshang mar zhabs tog yon 'bar gzab rgyas gnang /—/00

par skyid shod tha'i ji bgres pa rdo rje rnam rgyal gzigs mor byon pa'i bzhugs mcher chos khrir mdzad par gzhi len gzab rgyas bstar/ dbyar mchod yon lhan rgyas gtsang nas 'khor ba'i nged klu sbug tu sgar byas yod thog tshal gung gi bla ma rnams dang phyogs mthun du ngos 'phrad la phebs shing lhag par rje bla mas rigs 'dzin chen po'i phyag bris ma'i phur (68ba)pod yongs rdzogs kha'u'i rten rdo la zhal gyi sku brnyan thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i phyag bris ma byin rten du stsal/ bla ma gong ma'i dpon yin dgongs pa'i zing pa'i dbon po nal nal gzhung du sne sbyor sogs yar skyed yong la re kho na thugs la bcags kyang dbon po rang gi rang la byin rlabs zhu ba'i mar mchongs rgyag pa la dga' ba zhig 'dug pas gnang thebs che ba zhig byung ma song /zla ba bdun pa nyis brtsegs kyi sngon ma'i tshes dgu'i mtshan lam mnal sad 'phral phyag bris su btab ni/ na mo gu ru ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ rje zla bral 'khor lo'i mgon po mchog /dpal tshogasaganyis kyi 'byor ldan ngag gi dbang / /don ye shes su lhun grub yongs 'dzin rje/ /mas brjod dka' gsum spyi bo'i rgyan du mchod/ /yongs rta lo gro bzhin zla ba yi/ /tshes bu ga'i dgung gi tho 'i rangs cha/ /rmi lam gyi bar do'i 'khrul ngo la/ /bdag dus kyi phyogs su kha bzlas 'dug /dgung sngo sangs dang sagazhi mun pa'i klong / /gzha' tshon gyi dra bas sbrel nas 'dug /de'i bar mtshams med par thog ser dang / /btso glog dmar gyi bu yug 'tshub cing 'dug /'di lta bu'i cho 'phrul ci yin snyam/ shar phyogs kyi ngos la phar bltas pas/ /mi lus la g.yag gi mgo can zhig /don chu 'dzin gzugs su grub nas 'dug /lho phyogs nas rta yi mgo can zhig /snga ma bzhin phyogs 'dir bltas nas 'dug /da nub nas kyang de bzhin yod dam snyam/ /chu lha yi phyogs su phar bltas pas/ /mdog dmar po khro —101 —

rgyal dbang lnga dzing ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'bo'i gdong can zhig /snga ma bzhin tshur la bltas nas 'dug /da kho bo bar dor 'khyams 'dug snyam/ /bden med kyi mos blo ma btogs brdzi ba ru mthong / /bgegs cho 'phrul 'di yi lta ga la/ /snyam pa'i dga' spro'i gdengs shig byung / /de yi mod la gzugs med sgra gcig gis/ khong thugs rje'i nyin byed bum par sbas/ /spyir 'gro drug kun mun pa'i klong du 'dug /sgos rkang gnyis kun mun khung lam mi rtol/ /'di myur du 'char ba'i gsol ba thob/ /ces zer ba'i mod la zhagi la snang sad/ /spyir rmi lam la rtag pa'i go skabs bral/ /sgos kho bo la tig gtad ma mchis kyang / kho 'khrul snang 'khyar bo'i brda chos 'di/ /don thog tu bab pa 'ga' yang byung / /'di rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa dang / /'bangs 'gro ba'i bde sdug gi ltas ma ga rta gos/ /mi kho bo la cho 'phrul 'di tsam ci/ /mgon rgyal ba'i snyan du gsol ba lags/ /don blang dor gyi thugs rjes 'gro ba kun/ /bde ldan gyi zhing du khrid kyang 'tshal/ /zhes shugs khrung du mal gyi dgon hrul du bris/ /zhes nged la dog cha yod pa'i lung bstan dang mthun par dam sel la brten nas lud par khrag yong ba'i glo nad 'dra mo la lha rje rnams kyis ngos 'dzin cher med cing sman 'jam rtsab gang gis kyang mi phan pa'i rim med la 'gro ba zhig gis zla ba phyed gnyis tsam mnar ba/ zla ba brgyad pa'i mjug tu 'phrod bsten la ma ltos par bla ma dam pa'i thugs rjes glo bur du zhi bas mos pa lhag par 'phel/ khal kha er ti ni hung tha'i jis klu sbug gling khar gdan drangs/ seng gdong mas gtsos 'dod chos kyi dbang rjes gnang du ma dang srung ba'i ris mang du /nya pa/gtsang gi skya langs la dpon (69ba〉(ba paṇa chen rin po che'i sku zhabs nas/ dmag bskul gyi mi sna bka' shog byung ba ltar sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho yer ti ni hung tha'i ji'i rtsar rgyu mtshan mol bar btang ba de gong tha'i jis rje bla mar gtsang phyogs kyi bde gzar ci 'dra yong gi brtag pa zhus par/ de —102

zur — thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)nub 'od gsal la nub phyogs su sprin nag khrod nas thog ser glog sogs 'tshub chen po dang sprin gyis nyi ma sgrib la khad la bud med rta la zhen pa zhig gis nyi sprin gyi mtshams la rgyug cing nga'i gnas gzhi 'jig dogs 'dug zer ba'i mod la nyi ma sprin gyis ma sgribs tsam shar tshul gsungs pa'ang dran te tha'i ji rang gi gcung po da yan no yon dmag bcas bteg pas sog po'i sgra skad kyis kyang phan thogs chen por song / rtsis snyan ngag sdeb sbyor mngon brjod lo rgyus sogs la dogs gcod zhus par lan rgyas par gnang bas shin tu
