mos te dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal ja gos dar kha grangs lnga bcu lhag bcas kyi bdog pa phul/ tha'i ji 'di bod kyi skad yig la mkhas shing mthong rgya che ba'i khengs pas bla ma yin tshad la gus po byed ris su ma mchis/ nged rang gi dge sbyor rten du rigs 'dzin rdo rje drag po rtsal dang khyab 'jug gi bris sku'i phyag bris gnang tshe 'od gsal du gzims chung mgon khang yin rgyu ba zhig na khyab 'jug gi snang brnyan gzi byin ltar mi bzod pa'i lha dngos su song ba 'dra mo dang / rwa gzhu thog tshad tsam pa sogs chos skyong 'khor ba'i spyan ltas mang du shar zhing / nged kyi pha mes brgyud pa'i srung ma'i lugs su song gshis bla rdo srog 'khor rtod gnon sogs 'khor lo tshang ma lus la bcad rgyu gnang ba 'byor dus de phan dam grib kyi rnam pa'i lhongs shig yod pa'ang tsher ma dbyung ba ltar gyur/zil gnon gyi thod sku (70na〉3ga bris su mdzad dus mtshan ltas byung ba phyag bris su stsal pa ni/ rmis ltas thod pa 'di bri dus 'di thod pa min rus sbal gyi khog pa yin zer/ bltas pas rus sbal khog pa gser gyi mdog can zhig 'dug /mi zhig gis gling 'di snyoms 'jug dgu dag pa yin/ gling 'di 'phags lam brgyad dag pa yin/ gling 'di rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis dag pa yin zer gling so sor rten bshad byed pa zhig byung / de nas bzung rnam rtog tsam la thod pa 'di kha dog gser du song 'dra dang lci ru song ba 'dra zhig byung lags/ zhes phebs pa'ang dpal ldan dus dgra'i dbang po'i thugs kyi ngo bo rnam pa srid gsum tshe srog 'chang ba'i rus sbal du bstan pa sogs ched du gnyer nas —103

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'basgrubs par ma bltos pa'i ye shes pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub ba'i ltas su mngon mod/ kho bo brtson pa chung ba'i bcas sgrub ring du ngas na'ang 'di lo sgrub pa mthar phyin pa'i ngos bcas chog bum par bzhugs/dgun smad bde chen gling khar kun ci rgyal mo'i sgar thog tu gu shri bla ma dang er te ni chos rje gnyis yod pas gdan drangs/ srung 'khor dang rim gro mdzad/ gu shri bla mas theg chen gan dril dang rta sogs kyi 'bul ba mang du phul/ bdag nad 'di las grol na yer pa phu mda' chos gzhis su zhus brag gseb gtsang dgon la btang nas bde mchog gi sgrub sde 'dzugs/ nyid kyang spos dga'i khur bzhes rgyun skyong dgos yer pa dam pa chos thebs su sbyor sogs zhus 'dug kyang bla ma ma 'gyangs par grongs pa'i thog tu ma khel/ mal dro gung mkhar la sa skyong thog rgod rnam rgyal gyis dbu mdzad pa'i dmag gis bskor ba'i thus rim la bde chen du gdan drangs khro 'char dang glang (70bskor sna bsgyur gnang / drung 'tsho cha par shig nad byung bar kū su lu'i tshogs gsog gcod dmigs sogs la nan tan byas na phan yong shig gis so btab par mi tshugs na gsang spyod ji ltar thongs kyi zhu lan byung ba'i de nub nas shig rnams gar song cha med du gyur to/ /bad gnubs brgyud pa'i zhal lung zho 'thung rus/ /mthu stobs rtse brgya 'bar ba rdo rje'i mtshon/ /chos rgyal byang pas mgon khyod phyag mtshan du/ /gtad tshe dga' rab dbang phyug snying rtsa 'dar/ /lan cig min par nges gsang bdud rtsi'i thigs/ /bdag snying sprin pas rig rtsal kun bzang srog /zungs gyur drin lan byang wo thob nas kyang / /rigs kyi cod pan gyur la mjal par spro/ /rje bas g.yu brag ye shes pho brang cha/ /tshur mthong snang ngor ga hrul slo bur du/ /'chi med grong khyer sal mngon sum par/ /'jig rten mes pos sprul snyam 'phyang mo nyug /pad+ma 'od zhing bsgrigs pa'i lha gral du/ /thugs rje dbang grub rang rtsal nyer 'phos kyang / /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob gtso bor grang sob/ /bstan 'dzin gtsug tor rtser bkod nor bu'i nyog /snam zan grong pa'i rkang 'thung 'khrig pa'i klung /—104

zur 'a thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanakhe nyen bsher gyis don chen 'grub pa'i zhugs/ /'bar min ma babs las kyi rta gdong mes/ /sgar gtsang srid sde'i chu bo skem ste mtshar/ /'byung 'gyur lcags rdul las phra'i gzugs brnyan kun/ /ye shes me long ngos su sgrib med par/ gar tshe ekhri ya na'i mkhan po dang / /lci yang 'phrang la gzhal kyang gang gis dbye/ /brgya bshig stong du 'gugs pa'i g.yo 'khrul gyis/ /rnyed 'tshol 'byon ma'i zlos gar bsgyur min yang / /rang rgyud rnam par grol ba'i thugs rje che'i/ /'phrin las gdul byar 'jug de dngos po'i gshis/ /(71na'i lug chos 'khor bsam yas su phebs/ /dbu rtse ya ka bla 'og gling bzhi gling phran jo mo gling gsum sogs rten brten pa rnams zhib mjal dang gser chab spyan 'byed dkar me snyan dar gyi mchod 'bul/ 'jig rten spyi dang bye brag gangs can ljongs kyi skye rgu rnams bkra shis bde legs su 'gyur ba'i smon lam gyi mtshams sbyor gnang bar dge lugs mchod yon sger gyi bstan srid la phan thabs zur pa zhig yin par dogs nas bsam yas rab byung ba rnams kyis de'i nus pa sbyong byed kyi lugs su dpon slob rnams grags rim gyis khrus gsol byasapa'i gnas tshul brag kha ba'i drung 'khor 'dras mnga' ris drung par bshad 'dug /bsam yas mthil du bzhugs nga byang brgyud glo bur rgyal po nyag re a 'phel gyis gzan shing rgyas par phul/ mtshams phug gi sgrub gnas su phebs pa'i blon po mgul du rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa kong smon lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med dang mjal/ bang ri gter ston hūṃ nag me 'bar gyi dkon cog spyi'i dus kyi dbang lung rnams gsan/ gsang phug gis gtsos pa'i gnas rnams su mchod 'bul gsol 'debs/ smon lam rgyas par mdzad/ phyir lam phyag 'phreng gi thag pa chad pa ma mkhyen par dur khrod du phebs dus mdo 'dzin ma gtogos ma byung bar thugs dogs kyi rnam pa gzhan ngor gnang ba don du mdzad pa tha ma'i yang mtha' sku gdung rin po che der gdan 'dren pa'i mtshan ma kho nar mchis/ phyir lam rdo rje brag tu phebs/ rigs 'dzin yol mo ba sngar yam bu rgyal pos gdan drangs dus bal tshad kyi snyun ro yod pa langs pa'i mjug dang 'grib rkyen sel gyi byab 'khrus 'bul —105

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāneb gnang / zhag kha yar (71bsngags 'chang chen po'i zhabs pad bsnyen/ smon lam gyi thog yol mo sprul sku lha sar mchod yon mjal bar byon pa'i sne shan gyi snyan 'bul dang do dam mdzad/sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gzigs phyogs legs pa dang 'grig pa'i mthong bzos bdag rkyen bsgrags zhang lhan gyi mchod gzhis dang gnang skyes rgyas par byung song ba sprul pa'i skus dbu mdzad phyogs de'i gzur gnas mtha' dag rje 'di nyid kyi bka' drin phyungs pa'i rjes su yi rang mod/rab 'byams pa lnga ba sogs lhas sbyin drin bzo med pa'i ring lugs la brten pa rnams la cha mi 'tshal/ gzhis ka shar du gnas g.yar ba'i rigs 'dzin chen po dpon slob la rnyed bkur gzabs rgyas dang lha chen rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal gyi chos ka yongs rdzogs gsan/ sog po nor bu rin cen la dmigs pa'i gnubs kyi man ngag ral gri phyung rgyag cig mdo spyil du bzos nas blo bzang chos dbang la bskur te bla brang gi nang du ma khyer gnang 'dug pa bzhin rags subs shig la sbas phyag bris nang du khyer yongs pa dang 'tshub kyi rnam pa'i tā zhing chos rje steng grib phog pa'i ngag lkugs par rdzas sngags za yig gi bcos gas 'phral du smra ba bye ba'i ngo gso thon/ sngar phan ston yas mas tshor me rtag kho na la brten nas dpon gzhis bla brang 'dzin dgos par pad+ma mkhar pa'i phyag bzo bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gser skus thog drangs zhu rten dang bcas mchod gzhis zhu ba gnang ba char zhod snyomasatshe 'bru khal lnga brgya tsam thon pa chos lung na ga'i thog nas sbyor 'jags kyis 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la brten mi dgos pa las gsung ram 'degs pa'i gra tshang 'dzugs thub pa'i thugs kyi re che (72na)sar bro thabs pa ni ma byung /zla ba gnyis pa'i mjug dga' ldan pho brang du phebs/ pad+ma gling pa'i bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho dang phur pa lcags khang ma'i dbang sogs zab chos mang du zhus/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad kyi dgong phur pa'i dbang gi sta gon gnang nas bzhugs gnas su phebs thog grang shum dang 'dar sil gyis sku bsnyel bar rim gro pas zhabs byug phul kyang mnal ye ma byung ba'i ngang la pho brang zhol gyi 'khur thab 106

zur ོ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ tanal me gshor nas rim gyis shar brgyud rnams tshig pa'i zhugs kyi phung po bdun thog tsam 'bar te lung pa thams cad nyin mo ltar gsal ba na snyun cher ma phyungs pa ltar zhi zhing /byang ltas dang rgyal 'gong gi 'tshub lhongs kyis pho brang lte ba la 'tshor nye ba'ang rje bla ma'i lha sngags ye shes kyi nus pasarlung kha shar phyogs su 'gyur bas gnod pa ma byung /gtso bor phur pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod gnang zin pa'i mthur mngon/'bras spungs su ar po'i stabs nged se rar sdod dgos shar bas rje nyid kyang phebs rgyang tsam bzhugs nas chos lo rnams stsal/gnas rnying rgyal po'i 'tshub lhongs che tsam byung bar 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgo nas mnan srog sgrub pa'i 'khor ling 'bri ba dang phyag len gyi zhal bkod gnang /yer par lam du rigs 'dzin dus chos nyid du gyur par gsal 'debs ston mjug me mchod legs byas spel ba'i mthun rkyen gya nom pa'i ches 'jug rnams kyi blo'i re ba bkang /bla ma bka' brgyad yongs 'dus kyi spyi lung mdor bsdus snying po las/khyad par 62bsko dug pa sprul gyi lo shar dus gnam rtags 'od dkar skya rengs yang yang 'char:gza' skar gzug cing byang du hor sog g.yo 'ol dga'i phyogs su chos pa'i rkyen byas 'khrug dbus gtsang sde zhabrug 'gro rnams nyam thag 'byung :sa g.yos nad rims lo gsum lo nyes 'byung :lo dgu'i bar du dbusagatsang dbu rur 'tshog ces pa'i don ltar sbrul rta gnyis la rgyal khams byings la sad mo che byung nasathams cad mu ges mnar bar brten skyid shod nas sde pa thog rgod rnam rgyal gyis de ris la phan ba'i bcos thabs dgos tshul gsol ba bzhin bde chen du dpon slob tshang mas zhag bdun gyi bar sdong dkar gyi ngos bum gter bca' ba dang sgrub pa mdzad nas skyid shod stod smad kyi ri mtho sa bkra legs pa dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu yod sar sbas/nor bu mchog rgyal gyi g.yang 'gugasaganang bas nye skor tshor sad skyon lo snga ma las chung tsam byung rung yul khams byings la ston thog bsdu med du ma song tsam las lung bstan gyi lo ma thengs pas legs pa zhig byung tshod min 'dug/yol mo sprul pa'i sku'i zhabs drung du phebs pa'i tshe sprul / rin po che yang rab 'byams pa sogs gra ris ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shākarungs pa du mas thugs dkrugs shing lo rgyus la lar sprul pa'i sku dang am ljags sel med par grags la/ phyag mdzod mnga' bdag pas sde srid sna dkar rtse par zhus pa ltar na rab 'byams pa sogs las kyang slob dpon par thugs 'khang che tshul thos pa dang sngags sdebs snying gzir nag po'i ma (73na〉tha dang ma'i kha bral nas ya dang de bzhin pa dang la sogs yig 'bru mang por bris srubs kyis sngar slob sbyangs byas pa rnams dang mi mthun pa'i mgo zhabrugs par brten rje bla mas phyag dpe de ga yol mo sprul skur spyan 'bebs dang sbrags dag pa zhig g.yar po dgos tshul zhus pa'i lan du slob dpon pa thugs bsam nag drags dpe mang por 'di 'dra 'ga' 'ga' byon 'dug pa'i khrod kyi sdebs shig tu mchis/ dag pa 'di bzhin phul yod ngo gsung pa'i phyag bris ngo ma mthong ba dang klu gong blon po'i skye ba'i ngos 'dzin sogs la dmigs na yid gnyis su snang ba ci yin cha ma 'tshal/ gang ltar gros dbang ma rungs pa kha shas kyis/ chu rta skya langs chen mo'i dus kar lugs dang sa 'og 'brel thag byas nas dmag phyi 'brangs rtsis kyis sgar btags la rtse gsum bskyon pa sogs slar gnas pas nga 'di tsho'i khrod du bsdad na mi rgan rjes su khrims rar mi tshud pa'i nges pa mi 'dug ces 'phrang 'go shel grong du gzims khang byung bzhugs pa dang 'grig /rje 'di nyid kyi gzigs snang la gzims khang gi g.yon ri la nye sras brgyad rang byon dang chu bo gyen du 'gro ba sogs ya mtshan pa byung ba rnams phyag bris su bkod nas spyan 'babs dang gnas tshul gnang bar bla ma rin po che lung zin gyi skyes bu dam pa yin pa dang thugs nged kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra bas dag snang la nges pa ci yod/gzhan kho bo'i nyal sal de 'dra yong ba'i re med/ g.yung gi rnam thar du slob ma dad pa can gyis bla ma zog por gtong ba'i dpe yin 'dra gsung / (73ba〉lo rgyal byang pa'i gter gsar bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi dbang lung gi gtsos zab chos du ma gsan/sprul pa'i sku dgung lo so bdun dus byon pa'i tshems shig sngar gnang yod 'dug pa rtags bzhin e byung zhes dri ba mdzad par da lo ring bsrel zhig 'khrungs tshul zhus par da rgad po 'gro ran —108

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)pa'i rtags yin phebs/ tshur chibs kha bsgyur gdong thugs dam rten gyi phag mo'i sku khyad 'phags shig la bzhugs khang bzo rogs gyis gsung ba bzhin bsnams phebs/ gung thang chos khri'i shing rtsi 'dzugs pa'i sta gon mdzad/ shel grong nas sprul pa'i sku'i phyag bris shig byung ba bdag gi rmi lam du dur khrod 'di na nged kyi gtso mo mi 'dug zer bud med mang po ngu ba zhig byung bas phag mo'i sku de med pas lan 'dra ba bzhugs khang gi tshad blangs pa'i sku tshur bskur gsung ba bzhin 'phral 'bul dang bzhugs khang yang bal pos myur du bzos nas phyag du 'byor bas dgyes par gyur/ 'di lo sos dbyar gnyis ka char zhod shin tu dkon zhing sprin 'khrigs pa na rlung dmar chen pos gtor ba'i stod smad kyi char 'bebs pa kun ngal brgyas 'bad pa bya lam rjes med du song / rje bla ma'ang phyogs phebs thugs brel gyis lus pa dbyar dkyil la'ang zhing thams cad zangs sder lta bu thugs kyis ma bzod nas las sbyor gnang bar 'bebs ma rag la sngar bzhin rlung gis gtor ba/ nub cig mnal lam gyi tshul du bla ma chen po dbu shin tu dkar ba sgar gtos chen po rgyab pa'i gzi brjid can zhig mchis (4na)pa sngar nas thugs 'dris yong rgyu ba'i mjal bar phebs pa'i dri ba mdzad par nged tsho 'dir char pa srung gi yod zer bas/ nang par nas 'byung po de dag yas kyis bcos ma thag char chen po zhag kha yar babs kyang gzhi nas zhed chung bas lo tog gi rtsa ba tshugs pa ni sems can spyi mthun gyi las la ma grub pas dka' bar snang / gra tshang du phur pa zhig 'dzugs rtsis kyis las byang gi rgyas bsdus sogs la bslab ston zhus par grang so gter ston gyis mdzad pa'i sgrol byed drag po'i rno mtshon chos dbang gi gter gzhung kha yar dang bcas bka' gter gyi bla ma mang po'i bzhed tshul gyi dogs sel stsal/ stag lung zhabs drung dang rgyal tshab drung pa lho brag nas gtsang du phebs pa'i sgar khrod du 'brum nag gcig mched pa mchod yon ston ka dbus su phebs skabs nad mtshams ma chod pa'i skyid shod skor du gron chad kha yar byung bas nged 'ol dga' phyogs su 'gro ba'i sgo dod/ rje bla ma dngos su gdan 'dren ma thub bas srung ba zhu bar sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs de skabs gra tshang gi la/glu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shāshāsgrigs 'grim yin pa btang bar gang ci'i blang dor gyi bslab bya lhug stsol du byung /'ol dgar bsdad skabs rje bla ma sku khams mi bde ba'i gnas tshul thos par tshe dpag med lcags kyi stong po'i dbang bskur gyi dmigs rim dang 'brel ba'i sku tshe bsring thabs kyi brtan bzhugs mang du byas pa'i tshe 'od gsal gyi tshul du bdag gis tshe dbang phul ba'i rnam pa byung ba dang mi ring bar snyun tshul bstan pa'ang gzhi med du dwangs pa'i ngos mjal tshe zla dus tshes grangs(74ba)'grig pa'i gsung gleng thos pa rnams ngo mtshar gyi gnas su 'dzin pa nged la de 'dra 'ong ba'i lung rtogs kyi cha shin tu phra na'ang rje bla ma mi 'phrog pa'i thugs rje dang nus mthu tshad med pa mnga' bas kho bo'i che ba dbyung ngam snyam/ stag lung zhabs drung rin po che'i bka' drin la brten nas skar lugs kyi dgon pa sdod mkhas nyi shu skor ma dor tsam gyi su pra cho rab tu gnas na'ang smyug la legs bshad gling pas snga phyi bar gsum du byed 'dzol 'ji ba spyod pas 'chi bar nye ba'i dkyil 'khor nyer bsdur thug gshis gle'u chung byams pa gling dang smon po bdog gnyis legs gling par ni mi 'jags/ zhang lhan dang sa brjes zhus na phyag 'tshal sgog rnyid lta bu'i btsun chung gang las gdung ma de la 'byar ba'i dpe'i rnying ma pa rnams kur lugs kyi dgongs pa len dgos gshis ma nus/ sle'u chung rtsa ba dge lugs kyi dgon pa yin pa bla ma drag shul mthu ldan zhig byung na mchod gzhis rnams kyang rang dbang ma 'dus dogs pas sad srung ba'i sprin pa lta bur rje nyid kyis zhal 'dzin gnang dgos tshul rdo rje brag pa dpon slob tsho nas byung ba/ dgon pa 'jig par nye ba'i gser brtan pa'i sa ro de 'dra la thugs bed ga la yod kyang rigs 'dzin yab sras kyi dam tshig la dgongs nas zhal bdag gnang ste zhabs kyis bcags/ der sprul sku sle'u chung pa'i spyil bu/ bzo ra/ mchod khang na phyag bzo'i dusagasum sangs rgyas gas la'i nang du bzhugs pa/ gser gdung gnyis/ jo bo rje/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i sku 'drar nang bzhugs sku chos dang gtsang khang nub tu nag po skor gsum gtso bo thog tshad la rje'i zhal dkar yod pa/ (75na tshe ka tsang khang shar du dam can seng zhen thog tshad rnams bzhugs pa'i lha 110

zur r+ṣa thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)khang yang 'jig tu nye bar zhig gsos kyi zhal bzhes mdzad rung dgon pa'i kha 'dzin ma gnang na sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan kyang mi dgyes/ rgyas rgyas gnang bar gra ris rnams rkarma pa kho nar song zhing rdo rje brag pa'i gnyer las 'dzin rnams kyang rta po'i sgal bcos ngan la mngon te phyogs 'phul gyis gnang dka' dgag bya che zhing dgos pa chung bar dgongs te lo shas nas 'khur ba skam po'i zem 'jog mdzad pa/ spyi pa dang bar pa gros pa gsum/ /phyogs ris zug rngu ldang ba'i rgyu/ /zhes pa'i don du ma song ba'i legs thog tu 'byol/ tshal mthil gyi dgon lag yin zer ba tshor 'gong po spun dgu 'tshub pa 'dra ba'i ras rul gyis dus 'da' bas sle'u chung gi 'od gsal sgang du bla mgon gyi sku bskum khru gang tsam pa sarba ga tsā kho nye ba la zhig gsos phran bu gnang / rgyang tsam bzhugs ba ched kyang shing chu'i stabs kyis ma thub cing phyir lam shel grong du rigs 'dzin chen por brtan bzhugs phul zhing zhag bzhi lnga tsam stan chags/ spang gzhong ha ri kha pa tshos bla ma'i snyan gsan phul kyang mdzad par ma shar/shing sprel lo chos 'khor lha sar gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i sku rim du 'joms byed 'char kha nag po'i bzlog pa gnang / rigs 'dzin yol mo ba sku ltem zhing mkha' 'gros gdan 'dren pa'i spyan ltas byung ba gcung sgam smyon sprul sku dang phyag mdzod mnga' bdag pa can gyis bsun bzlog brtan bzhugs sku rim gyi ris byas na gsol bar/ rin po che spos dga' nasagadan 'dren thub na nged rang gi gter lung du gsal ba bzhin (75bskong sa nas rten 'brel 'grig pa tsam yong shas che gzhan byas ma byas med gsungs pa ltar gdan 'dren byung ba bzhin phebs/mkha' 'gro grib sel bsun bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs/ mkha' 'gro'i bshags skong /rje nyid nas na bza' dang bcas sgar pa so sos brtan bzhugs phul/ dam tshig gtsang ba dang yid mthun pa byung bas lo gcig tsam sdod gsungs pa der 'khod rnams kyi mya ngan sel byed kyi dgongs gzhi can las tshad ldan min 'dug gshis rigs 'dzin nyid kyi sku rwa hu la'i rnam par gyur pa dang nub —111—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ('acig rwa hu la'i skal ba chad ces bud med kyi skad lhang ba zhig gsan pas de ma thag bzhes can nang gi khrung bzhes 'phro de bsngos nas gnang / sang nyin nas khyab 'jug gi mdos nag cig gtong dgos 'dug ces rdo rje brag nas sngags 'chang brag lha ba don grub rgyal mtshan gyis gtsos pa'i brgyad gra gcig bos nas btang ba'i mdos yang thog tu bskul ba'i dus rigs 'dzin chen pos sngags pa rkyang pas btang ba'i nyams kyis rim gro la 'gyur mdog kha po 'dug kyang mdang rmi lam du rab 'byams pa lnga ba gar byed pa byung bas mi rgan yun ring mi sdod par 'dug gsungs/nyin cig shog bu la rnal 'byor pa ang rag tsam ma gtogs gos med pa he ru ga'i chas sprad cing lag na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzung ba zhig phyag bris su mdzad nas rje bla ma dang sgam po sprul sku sogs la ston par gnang / 'di gang yin zhug pas ma 'gyangs par mi rgan dbyibs 'di 'dra ba byas nas rgya gar phyogs su 'gro ba 'dug /skye ba phyi ma'i pha ma gnyis kyang mdun thabs byas zin pas rgya gar du skye ba len dgos shas(7na ji gsungs pa'i tshe/ dpon slob rnams kyis nges par sku'i bkod pa bsdu na gter zhabs bzhes pa'i ched bod rang du sku skye phebs dgos tshul gyi gsol 'debs nan cher mdzad na yong rgyur da dung bzhugs la res rten 'brel la gnod dogs pa lta bus ri bo dpal 'bar gyi gter 'gyangs skyon du song / gsang ba'i lung bstan sogs zhal chems phal cher rje bla ma la gsung 'phros kyi tshul du gnang / re zhig sku khams bde ba'i khul gyis gung thang du phebs/ sman chu bla ma steng grib kyis mnar bar srung bcos byin rlabs mdzad pas bde 'go bstad/ chos khri'i 'du khang gi ldebs bris rnams phyag bstar te gnang ba'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi la la mkhyen lugs 'ga' re sman lugs dang rnam grol ba lta bu rdzu phrul phyag gis 'du mdzad/ gnas bcu rgyal gyi si thang la cha bzhag bzheng bar gnang ba lha bzo ba dmangs mas mdangs tshon bcad gsum gyi 'phro 'thud nas legs par grub/ drung rams pa dpon dar ba dpal 'byor dar rgyas dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po yin yang rdzas bsod chung bas sku chas dbul bar gra pa'i dzam dmar gyi dbang lung —112

zur r+pā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ (tanaganang ba bzhin zla gcig gi bar khong gis bsgrubs pas mtshams grol rgyu'i zhog bye ri stag rtse nas sku rim la byon zer ba'i bda' byung bas dngos grub myur ba'i thog chod/ de nas bzung ste sdeb dga' ldan pa khag gnyis/ skyid shod stod smad kyi rta drung mang po dang sog po'i dpon mi bzang du ma'i bla mchod du gyur/me phag lho 'brug pa'i thog tu ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor chen sogs bsgrub par 'bras (7ba khongs su byon zhing pha bong kha'i gdan sa mdzad nas bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i ti shir gyur pas mtshone 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'ang rje 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin/ gung thang mchod khang gi tshe dpag lha khang du spyan snga skal ldan rgya mtshor rnam sras dang tshe ring ma'i skor sogs bzhed chos kha shas 'bul ba gnang / sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin nged rang gi dge sbyor rten mtshan brgyad kyi bris sku nyin thang du grub pa'i zhib po de 'dra rdzus la gyi bkod pa ma gtogs lha bzo ba ji ltar lag mgyogs kyang yong tshod du ma mchis/ slo bur du gdan 'dren byung ba ltar 'phrang 'go shel grong du phebs/ rigs 'dzin chen po mjal ba gnang ma 'gyangs par pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su gshegs pa'i sku bur nam zla'i stabs kyis nang bzhugs kyi zhal bkod mdzad/ bla gnyer gros pa tshos dgongs rdzogs kyi khur gang yang 'khur ma nyan pas byis pa rnams kyis gra ma 'grig par re zhig gsang ba'i rgyas btab/ nged 'ol dga' nas 'bras spungs su slebs dus rje bla mas bye ma a krong gi slob dpon chen po'i sku la stod byang pa'i nang rten gtsang sde srid nas theg mchog gling pa'i spyi rdzas su sbyar ba theg gling dbu mdzad rab rgyas kyis sprul pa'i skur phul ba dang thob rgyal du bzhengs pa'i bka' brgyad gra tshar dpus bsgyur du byung bar/ sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis mkho dgu'i 'byor pa char bzhin du snyil bas rdo rje brag gi gdan sa ba'i dgongs rdzogs sde pa gzhung nas btang ba de 'dra la dpags na las ma byas pa dang mi 'phrad byas pa chud mi 'dza' bar bshad pa'ang mi bden pa 'dra zhig (77na skong / phyag mdzod mnga' bdag pas dpus bsgyur gyi 'byor lan du skyabs mad —113

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedam pas bor ba'i nyam thag bar dor 'khyams pa lta bu bdag 'dra bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs tsam yang gtong rgyu med pa'i skabs su dgos byed bka' drin che tshul gyi yi ge shod thebs med pa bris 'dug pa myangs na rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nar snang / rje nyid nas zhe dgu'i bar gyi sku tshigs dang dus dran gyi mchad pa sogs dngos grub kyi rtsa ba bla mar dgongs te mdzad/lo snga phyi tshor gsang sngags mkhar pa'i bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs kha shas kyis sa skyong thog rgod rnam rgyal gyi sku mdun nas bogs pa'i bong bu khal bcas 'phrog pa sogs sde pa gtsang pa'i mtshan don gyi nyi ma nub long med pa nas rmu rgod skye bo'i lug pa skad gsang mthon por sgrog pa'i rim pa mang du byung song ba'i sdebs su/ 'brom stod nas gcung lags dgos pas ser bogs rdzong du phul bar sngags mkhar bas snying nad kyis ser gnyis phyogs par sde pa bsod nams rab brtan kyi bka' shog zhus pa'i lam du ma song ba'i lan du ngan bslabs kyis gcung rkyen lam du btang ba kha mchu'i 'jog kha mi mngon du zhal ras 'degs thub pa zhig yong la res zhu 'bul gnang song rung a ma shi ba'i bang phyin gyi dpe kho nar song /gtsang dus bla ma sog bzlog pa dang khams pa lung pa'i nu bo lta bu bsad na ge sar gyi stong ltar byas pas mi zin pa yod tshod du 'dug na'ang 'di res lha sa skor lam gyi ku ku zhig bsad pa las drag pa'i dge stong sa bcad ma stongs tsam las byung ma song / 'on kyang 'di snang gi bzang ngan mun (77ba)nag gi slog 'gyu tsam dang khyad par rdzogs chen pa rnams snang grags thams cad bde gsang chos sku'i rol ba yin gshis gong gi gnas tshul thams cad spros bral gyi ngang nas phaṭa rgyab ste tshe phyi ma bshul thag ring bar dgongs nas dge sgrub kyi bslab ston gnang / rkyen ngan dang de la dmigs pa'i zhe sdang gi rgyus mi ma yin gyi lus blangs 'dug tshul a lags bsod nams kyis snyan du phul bar brten zhi khro dang thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas rigs drug gnas 'dren dang / gri sgrol gsang ba'i man ngag la brten nas gnas ngan len las spar te mi lus su nying mtshams sbyar ba ni gzhis ka — 114

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa cho dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)shar gyi lags 'phrin las rnam rgyal yin par snang / rtsas ma chod nas grang so gter ston chen po'i sku gdung zhugs 'bul la phebs/ gdung la mchod pa brgya rtsa zang zing gi 'bul ba mdzad/ me mchod grub nas zhag gsum gyi bar bur khang rgyas btab pa'i ring ye shes kyi me rang 'bar lta bus dbu thod ril po dang gdung rus phran bu tsam ma gtogs phal cher yal ba mkha' 'gros gdan drangs par thugs nges mdzad/ sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu dang mnga' bdag phyag mdzod pa sogs kha shas la zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi dbang lung gnang zhing sprul sku la lta bas bogs 'byin pa gsang ba med byung dang dur khrod bdag po'i rjes gnang chos skor gsan/rigs 'dzin yol mo ba'i sras mo lha lcam jo mjal la byon pa sne shan sogs kyi zhabs 'degs dang khyad par bla ma'i sras mor song bas 'bul ba rnyed bkur bzabs par gnang / stag rtser sdeb tha'i ji mched kyi jo mor lha rgya ri ba'i lcam byon pa'i sna chog srung 'khor (78na rim la phebs/phan bde sprul sku ngag dbang rgya mtsho khengs dregs kyis bla ma bsten par bag tsha bas chos thob thob nyung bar rje nyid kyis 'jigs byed bcu gsum mas thog drangs gsar rnying gi dbang chos mang du gnang / khong par mi tra 'khrid drug tu grags pa'i zhal snga bka' brgyud pa'i zab chos yin khul zhig yod snang ba gsan/ gnam gong bla ma pad ma legs grub kyis phan bde ba'i slar chos zhus snang ba khong pa yon tan che tshad cig 'dug pa thugs mgu ba'i gsung gleng mdzad/bar khams nas 'phags pa lha'i drung 'tsho bar g.yu thog snying tig gi dbang lung / rgyud bzhi'i lung / nga'i zla grogs sngags pa zhig la thos grol gyi dbang lung stsal/ mdo spyil ba rnams kyis rgod tshang pa'i gsang yum ma gcig 'gro ba bzang mo'i phyag len gyi brtan bzhugs phul/ 'di lo nas bzung hor zla bcu par khro rol/ pad gling drag dmar gshin rje khro chu/ 'joms byed/ 'char kha/mgon po 'bar ma/ sdebadun rnams kyi mdos gtore gyi rim pa/ hor zla bcu gnyis par gzhung gi sku rim du dmigs pa'i bla ma zhi drag /gshin rje dug sdong nag po gsum gyi tsho gos brgya/ gter mgon — 115

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānephyag bzhi pa dang dam can sdodagu'i bskang brgya/ 'jam dpal khro chu rigs gsum 'dus pa'i gtor bzlog rnams star chags su 'dzugs pa mdzad/ stag rtse nas zing pa'i dgon 'og gi mi phyugs la khral gsar 'gel byung bar bla mas tha'i jir zhus kyang ba khang sku skyes mi dbang g.yul rgyal nor bu'i dgongs pa 'di ni rta rnga brgya gshags las kyang phra zhes byas pa'i lo rgyus ltar don ma smin pas (78ba)bla gra nang zhig bas rje bla mas mthun rtsis kyi bslab ston mdzad rung / gra pa rnams kyis stag rtser gtugs pas dgon pa rtsis bzhes skabs bla mar 'jags gang che'i thabs dang sbyin bdag tsho dang bstun pa'i ngos slar ldab rgyu'i sa bcad la g.yog khams pa zhig gis mo ston bsad pa'i rkyen gyis 'bri gung phyogs su bros/ sdob stag rtse bas dbur stod sems dpa' chen po bla mar bsko ba'i 'jas byung bar gra ris rnams 'jigs te rje nyid dgos tshul stag rtser zhus pa bzhin tha'i ji'i phyag tham byung ba 'di ris thugs sun las spros pa'i dge mtshan che ba mi 'dug rung bla ma gong ma'i bstan rgyun la dgongs nas zhal gyis bzhes/ zing pa dpon po rang gis byas nyes ma go ba'i rje bla mar log par bltas te zas ngan gyi sbyor ba rtsom zhing nang rten dang khyab 'jug gi ngam shing brku bar btang yang lam du ma song ngo / /rtag tu gang snang thams cad dag zhing gi /rten dang brten pa'i dal bar mas klas kyang / /zan g.yang gsung gi dben gnas zung 'brel bar/ /sri zhu gzhan bskul ched du dngom mam snyam/ /gter min gter brdzus rag la gser gsol mkhan/ /ma yin sprul pa'i skyes mchogo grang so ba/ /dgyes bskyed rtse mor son pa'i mchod pa'i sprin/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun la bstab pa bzhin/ /dga' ldan bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs snga 'gyur bas/ /mi srid srid pa'i ngal bsten snye ma'i 'bras/ /smin tshe bzhed pa'i don gyi e raṇ+ḍa/ /bskams pa'i cho ga rdzun min mngon sum rdzogs/ /lus med lus can sna tshogs sbyod 'phrul me/ /dus mtha'i (79na ji na za ltar 'bar tsha dbal rtse/ /dpal chen phur pa'i byin rlabs 'thor rlung gis/ shar phyogs rgya mtshor slebs par bsnyal ba bzhin/ zhal grong ri —116

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6debo'i khyad par gzigs pa'i nyams/ /'od mtshan dpag med gnas kyi mched por 'gran/ /kun dga'i ra bar thub dbang sras slob kyi/ /snang brnyan sgyu ma bkye ba'i grong la 'khu/ /klu gong log pa'i smon lam thugs btsun yang / /sprul pa'i gter ston re zhig bzhugs gsol thebs/ /ras la snum ltar rnga yab gling gshegs par/ /drin bzo'i mdzad khur mgon khyod phrag par lci/ /shing mo bya lo dmar po rir pho brang gsar bzheng gi sgo dod pa'i thog mar rje bla ma 'bras spungs su phebs zhag shas bzhugs nas nged dpon slob phyogs mtshungs su sa 'dul la po ta lar byon/ rje nyid kyis lha srin ldebargyad cha mnyam pa'i ched du rgyags rngan gyi cho ga zhogs star dang / hor zla gsum pa'i nyer brgyad kyi nyin phyag bstar nas rgyud sde'i dgongs don bzhin sa bdag sto 'phye'i thig 'debs gnang / rang byon 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra sa skyong g.yul rgyal ba'i dus po ta la nasagazhis ka brag dkar du gdan drangs/ rta lo sde pa a dpal gyis dmag gi rngan par se chen tha'i ji la phul ba bod rten gcig mtha' la 'khyar na mtha' dbus 'jig ces lung bstan ltar shes ldan rnams blo mi bde zhing rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa 'phags pa yar gdan 'dren pa'i rtsol ba byed ran yin zhes mang por gsung yang do dam byed mkhan dkon zhing yul dus gnas skabs kyisahrūb (79ba)kyang dka' bar 'di'i dus blo gros dang brtson pa mchog tu yangs pa da la'i kun ci rgyal mos do dam mdzad nas/ 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku brnyan yid bzhin gyi nor bu gdan drangs pa dang 'grig rten gnangs che ba tsam gyis phyi 'brang gi 'byung po mi yong ba'i nges pa mi 'dug pa dang rgya 'dre zhig yod pa'i mtshan ltas kyang shar bar brten/ dpal chen khrag 'thung drag por khros pa'i chas su zhugs te bgegs sgrod gnang bas mi ma yin gyi tsho gis rgya mtsho'i pha mthar bskrad rmang zhabs su dgra 'dre gnon pa/ stod du bum gter dang sel srung 'jug pa sogs pho brang chen po bkra shis dge legasakyis khyab pa'i 'phrin las mang du gnang /de nas mdo spyil nas dben par dgongs te zla ba dgu pa'i bar rdo rje gsum mi 'da' ba'i —117

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'bacad rgya dam par mdzad/ 'phrin las drag por bsgrub pa'i rigs 'dzin dme ma hā gu ru'i ljags bsnyen gyi tshe nub cig seng g.yabs nas gzugs med pa'i lag pa nag po zhig brkyang nas mar me la lag pa 'gebs pa'i 'tshub lhongs kyi rnam pa'ang byung / yang zab kyi rdo rje gro lod dang byang pa'i gter gsar 'chi med sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi ljags bsnyen dus dam sri 'byung po thul nyams dang sku che'i bar chad sel ba'i ltas ya mtshan can 'ga' zhig shar/ zhe gos shig gsang spyod kyi skar gsal nas thig le dkar po zhig shar ba rim gyis gcig 'phel gnyis 'phel song nas mthar gzims chung gi nang thams cad khengs pa na zhal dang spyan yo zhing phyag g.yon pas tsho mi zin pa byung ba mngon spyod kyi (80na7sa sbyor mangs pa dang / gzhung gi drung 'khor las tshan la dgra gnyen bar ma mtha' dag mnyam pa ris med kyi tshul du shan dang chu kha da rbad bcad la song ba'i dam sel gyi skyon du nges shing /zhabs 'bring pa rnams kyis bcos ka gnang dgos tshul gsol bar thog mar sngags rdzas kyi thabs shig mdzad na dgongs pa la deng sang bstan srid thams cad dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs 'dir bskyas chen btab pa mi legs rgyu mi 'dug dgongs khu 'khrig med pa'i thugs thag rbad chod kyis ro snyoms gnang bas nang par snyung gzhi'i shul tsam yang ma lus par sbrul gyi shun pa brjes pa lta bur song /'bri gung pa rigs 'dzin chen po chos kyi grags pas mchod yon du las sbyor gnang ba rnamasanag gu zer ba'i phyag g.yog nang ma zhig gis stag rtse tha'i ji brgyud mchod yon du gsol ba la brten ston mjug zhabs drung rin po che lha sar sgor bskyil gyis thugs sun che skabs phan thogs dgos pa'i rje bla mas phyag bris byung ba dang chos rgyun sogs gang sa nas byed spro bas sde par nye len btang bar mi yong ba'i 'jas byung rung nan to chen po byas pas sku la dam dog yod pa'i nyes dmigs lta zhog sa cha rdzong gzhis sku chas tshang ma la zegs 'thor med pa'i rang 'jags kyi zhabs tog 'grub pa'ang gtso bor dam pa 'di nyid kyi thugs rje'i mthu kho nar nges/ rje bla ma 'bras spungs su gdan drangs te bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub dbang / g.yu thog snying tig sogs zab chos —/18

zur r+sā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ lhanamang po'i bka' drin stsal/ rje nyid kyis brag sna chos rje o rgyan bstan 'dzin (80ba 'a yang rdzong snying tig gsan song rung khong pa mtho dma' che drags pas brgyud pa la yang med pa lags sam snyam kho bos ni zhu ba ma shar/me khyi zla ba dang po'i mjug tu 'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon cog chos 'phel dga' ldan gyi gnas su rje btsun myong kha pa chen po'i spyan sngar phebs par sngon du phyogs pa'i nged kyi phyag 'bul la phyin pa'i dus rje bla ma'i sku mtshams zla dgu ma'ang grol zin pa dang 'grig pas mar lam chos khri bla brang du zhag gcig bsdad gzhi len rgyas par gnang / tshe dbang lcags sdong ma zhus shing de thog nas brgya rtsa zhig sku tshe'i rten 'brel du phul/ bla brang 'du khang sogs la shis brjod kyis gsung ba bzhin me tog gtor/ 'di lo'i dbyar nged kyang mtshams dam pa zhig byas pa'i skabs de dus rang gzhan su la'ang dogs gnas med rung rje bla ma'i spyan ltas su nged rgya nag la 'gro dgos pa shin tu gsal ba'i lung bstan dang bud med dkar mo zhig gis ras kyis gril ba'i bum pa gnyis khyer nas 'di tshe chu yin pas bzhes pa zhu zhes phul 'dug pa de skabs sku khams mi bde ba'i dus yin pas sku tshe'i 'phrang bsal bar snang / bum pa cig shos kyi chu nas kyang dgos gsungs pas 'di nged la ster rgyu yin 'di ma gsol na da lo dog cha chen po yod tshul dang yang gsang drag mo'i bris sku bzheng ba gnang bar bu mo des bltas nas khyed ma gcig dpal lha'i sku bzheng gi yod pa e yin zer ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs snang mang du byung ba mtha' dag blor ma nges shing brir yang ma lang / rigs 'dzin yol mo ba chen po'i thugs dam gsal snang la shar ba bzhin chos rgyal byang pa ngag gi dbang po'i sku'i rnam par sprul pa mon mkhar rnam sras gling du bya nag gi rigs su (81na〉cun pa'i lung bstan shog khra gnang ba ltar nges shes 'drongs nas sprul sku rin po che rdo rje brag tu gdan drangs pa rim gyis 'bras spungasasu dbu gtsug gsil bar phebs dus rje bla ma sku khams bsnyun pa dang 'grig gshis ngos phebs ma thub par legs skyes kyi zhu 'phrin 'bul ba rgyas par gnang /—119

rgyal dbang lnga pa pag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānesngar sgar pa mnga' thang sgang la rgyab pa'i dus zhwa dmar ba'i drung yig kha rag bod 'brug pa 'jam dbyangs sngags rnying ma la mi gus shing khyad par rigs 'dzin yol mo ba dkar chas su gyur pa tshan po che 'debs pa sgar pa lugs gnyis ka nas dgun chu bzhin rim bri'i steng sde pa rgyal bzang pa yul don pas kho pa sdod gnas ma rnyed par rdo rje brag tu chud la re'i rgyu mtshan legs lags mang po gsol yang / grang so gter ston thugs bkyel che bas mchode yon nas dgongs khrol byung na ma gtogos mi nus zhes de ris kyi bsten sgor ma mdzad rung / rjes sor bla ma e ljag gis skar btsun mang po bskyil ba'i gnas tshul 'phrang 'go drung pas sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi snyan du phul bas rten brten pa thams cad gnas dbyung mdzad rgyu'i gsung gleng dngos su'ang thos shing bla ma btsan 'jog gi phyag tham gnang bar rje bla ma zur chen la ngan dogs byed tshul lho byang gnyis gar gleng zhing bla ma'i g.yog de don 'di yin med par gung thang du yongs nas nyin kha yar brlag stor 'tshol ba lta bu'i bla brang gi phyi nang kun tu sgor sgor nyug nyug mang du byas pa na zhabs 'bring pa rnams kyis mi (81ba〉dzo'i lab rigs dang bcas zag rdzas 'tshol mi yin 'dra zhes zhus 'dug rung khong de 'dra mdzad don med ces thugs dogs cher mi gnang /sde pa zhang mkhar nas rig byed pa 'jam dpal rdo rje rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang por shin tu gus shing tshur yang thugs nang gtsang ba'i phebs sgor byang pa dang 'phyong rgyas pa sku nye mchod yon g.yin dang mi 'dra gshis thams cad mkhyen pa bsnyen rdzogs bzhes par legs ja dang bcas ngosakyi mjal 'phrad byed 'dod yod kyang slob dpon e ljag pa/ sde pa phun tsho gis gling pa zhabs drung snying snying sogs kyi blor mi chud 'dug pas lag thog tu 'gel mi bde ba 'dra gsungs pa dang / rigasa'adzin yol mo ba chen pos da lam slob dpon pa rang yang mchod yon mjal bar lhan du 'gro gsungs bar dpon slob rnams tshur phebs pa dang e ljag skyid ga spongs bde ba can ba'i rim gror 'gro ba rgyab gyes byas/ 'das pa'i bar la lo mang rab song rung mchod yon phyogs su ye mi yong ba —120

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanamanong langs rgyu yod mdog kha mo la khong pa skyon can min pa'i sgrub phyogs kyang ci rigs snang bas/kun mkhyen bus rnying rgyud la gsungs pa ltar lkog gyur gyi rigs 'di btang snyoms su bzhag pa legs sam snyam mo/ /rje nyid lus can kun la byams brtse che bar ma zad snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rdo rje brag phyogs kyi nyes skyon mtha' dag sped pa lhur len pa las gsang ba'i rnam thar tsho zhal gyi zur tsam la'ang 'don pa mi srid rung brgya kha thal mos mi khebs pa'i nyams (82na)kyis skad ca gzhan dag nas rim gyis mched pa'i gra las dol gsal ba'i dper snang ngo / /rdo rje brag nas gru gu yang waṃ gi dbon brgyud khams pa sngags 'chad don grub bkra shis dang gong dkar nas sngags 'chang stod grong pa gnyis la 'jam dpal rigs gsum 'dus pa khro chu dug sdong /dam chos dgongs pa yang zab/ sba dong gi gter ma'i 'jam dpal zhi drag phyed gsum/ lha chen dbang phyug rlung zhags/ gter kha 'og ma dang rin cen gling pa'i nā ga raka rat+na'i dam can gter gnas mi 'dra pa gnyis/ rlung 'khor zhi drag gi ris sogs dbang lung phyag 'khrid mang du gnang / gzims khang shar pa'i bla ma gra ris 'ga' zhig gis rje 'di nyid la 'os tho byas par dge slong bsod nams rgyal mtshan can gyis dge min rnying min 'di 'dra la mi bsko zhes mas 'jog gi gtam btang na'ang nā lan+da'i 'bul dpon khams pa bros thabs kyis song rjes bla ma med mur/ bkra shis ljongs chos rje'i bla ma dbu mdzad zer ba bde chen nas bsko bar sngon du phyogs pa gang sa nas khong tsho'i blor ma chud pa'i sla nga tsha dus kyi skam pa dang grod pa ltogs dus kyi zan gong bzhin khong tsho gros thog nas gung thang lcags ri nang la bla ma gnyis kyi dgos don mi 'dug /lhag tu sa rnying gnyis nang mthun pa bcas bla ma gnang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan gsol ba khong tsho'i g.yo skor gyi zhu ba mkhyen pa gzhir bcas dang sle'u chung gi skor la rdo rje brag gi slob dpon dang chos mdzad rdor legs sogs gros dbang kha shas kyi thugs sun che tsam byung ba'i lte bor dbon po dgos pa la thug pa slar (82ba tshes zhags pa 'bul bar 'ong pa na sku 'khor rnams kyis dam sel 'dra ye yod gsol bar nged rang rdzogs chen par song —121

rgyal dbang lnga pa ༅ dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shākabs 'khon 'dzin byas zhan 'dra zhes spyan 'drisang na pa tsam yang mi gnang zhing / bstan don la thug pa'i ris ma gtogs sngar gcung po gsod mi gros bcas sogs la las sbyor gnang dgos tshul tshang mas zhus par thugs do mi gal bas mtshon rang don du sku dgra gdug pa can gyis drung du btud na phan pa lhur mdzad pa'i rgyal sras chen po'i rnam thar ma gtogos ye mi gnang ba dang / gzims khang shar pa rnams grub mtha' bsgyur dogs kyi mya ga gyis non par brtse ba chen pos zhal gyis bzhes shing bde chen du'ang de ga'i rgyu mtshan gnang ba thugs la 'thad rgyu med tsam gyi ngos sde pa gzhung gi la cha'i ral gri la 'dzem bya'i rnam pas 'gab gras dang bcas gza' tshes dge bar gzims khang shar pa ba rnams kyis chibs bsu ser sbreng gi mdun bsus te gdan sar phebs thog sa skyong thog rgod rnam rgyal gyis bsko 'ja'i gnang skyes/ yang dgon/ chos khri sogs phan tshun gyi gra ris sbyin bdag tshang mas legs 'bul bzabs/ sgom sde dang gdan sa khyon gcig pa'i gshis sku tshe gong ma'i rten 'brel gyis nam mkha' 'ja' sprin gyis khyab pa sogs ltas ngo mtshar ba byung / dbyar gzims khang shar pa rnams kyis dbang gzhi bteg pa'i tshe bde chen nas sgrib bar gyi khrom dmar nag tu 'khyil bar tshe dbang gnang / sbyin bdag rnams la shangs len bzang du mdzad/me phag shar nas bla ma khro bu bas gso le ba btab pa (83na〉pa brten bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen 'dzugs pa gnang bar yang dgon spyan snga/ gnon 'dzem pa sgang pa/ sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis sogs kyis gtsos pa'i bla ma sngags pa/ sman pa sogs brgya skor la sman sgrub ma gtogs sgrub dbang rgyas par stsal/ grol dbang khrom du dbang rdzas yang dgon zhabs drung gis 'degs mkhan mdzad pa spyan snga lugs gnyis ka nas khung btsun pa'i grags pas kun ha las las su byed/ mtsho smad du byang ngos nas bkra shis phun tshogs kyis gdan drangs pa'i zhor lam snang rtse gzhis kar gu ru jo tshe'i gter rdzas du ma dang sde pa nam mkha' tshe brtan rgyal po'i phyi rten gyi gser gdung / gtum drag me 'khor gyi dzo sku sogs gnas gzigs mdzad/ de nyin gung tshigs kyi bzhes pa —122

zur byu thams cad — pa chog dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)gra 'grig rgyu med par ji ltar 'gab zhus pas gzhis ga'i rgyal po 'dis gzhi len byed pa 'dug gsung ba ltar gzhis gnyer blo 'gyur nas glo bur du gsol tshigs zhus/rgyal khang gi rgyal po desakyang gzugs dngos su bstan nas 'phrin las sgrub par dam bcas r+pā du 'dug/drag dmar gyi dzosku de deng rgya nag la 'gro dus rtog pa bcug pas gter kha tshad ldan tsho'i sku dang mi 'dra ba'i 'jim bzo ba mkhas pa zhig gis bzos tshone nas byon shin tu gtsang bar snang /kong po rdzogs chen pa 'bras ljongs phyogs la 'byon pa'i lam yig rje nyid kyi gsung bzhin smin grub zhus/me tog mchod pa'i skya hrags gcig sgom sde bar 'khri ba'i gra bsgrig tshar du dngar bas yang dgon dbus gling gnyis kyang nad langs pa'i je rgyas su song /chibs rags phan tso gzigs resabyung skabs yang 83bskogon spyan sngas dbu zhwa 'bud pa sogs bkur bzos che bar phul/ston mjug 'bras spungs su phebs nas zhag shas bzhugs de mo sprul skus kong po spyi khang du gdan drangasakhro chu'i chos skor sogs zhu 'dod tshad tshad pa la phan bde sprul sku phyogs su phul nas phyag thog tu ma bkal ba'i gsung gleng zhib mol dang khong gi phyag tu rkun rgyab rdzun mas byas pa'i zhal gyi be'u bum nag po'i dpe yod 'dug pa ma dpe dkon gshis gol bshus gnang song ba mi 'gyangs par chosaphyag tu 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel sngon 'gror dogs/lho'i jus rim la chos rje dpon dar gyis phyag drug pa'i gtor wo mdzad pa'i 'khor lo/sngags 'chang don bkras pas shun du 'dzugs rgyu'i 'jomasabyed rlung 'khor rgyun gyi bzlog mnan so gos phyag bris su stsal/gung thang du gshin rje khro chu'i zor lasakyi sgrub zhag bco lnga gnang ba rtags bzang po yod 'phror yang dgon spyan snga 'byug zhen ches pa'i ja rgyugs kyi gdong zor sal lhungs pa gur dang go cha gu ru rat+na'i sngon 'gror song /yang dgon zhabasadrung gis dbu mdzad gung thang pa rnams kyis gyib sel bsu bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugasaphul/rin po cho ngag dbang ye shes grub pa'i dbu thod thing pa ba tsho'i rten skal du hril le bzhugs pa rin po che rang gi sku bas bzheng ba gnang ste nang du bzhi nas zing par gdan 'dren la phebs gung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ shānethang du grub pa'i dbang phyug tshe 'phel bzang po'i sprul sku kun bzang dbang po la byang chub gling pa dpal rgyal mtshan gyi zab chos kun bzang thugs gter/ rat+na'i drag dmar/ bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang sogs zab chos dkon pa mang du gsan/ stag rtse tha'i ji (84na7ched kyis dgos pa'i rdo rje'i sku rim srung 'khor la gdan drangs/ 'bri gung gi phyag dpe sku khrus pa'i dpe cha sna bsdus pa'i mi khur gcig tsam dang / rwa lo'i thugs dam rten yin khul rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi zhal thang phul/sle'u chung du mi zhig 'drer skyes nas khog tu brlams te bla ma 'dra la gtugs nas nga lus 'di dang bral ba'i thabs shig gyis labs par brten/ nang mi rnams kyis byang bzhu phul bas ring por ma lon par tshe 'phos nas mi lus thob ste byis pa'i dus nga spos dga' dpon slob kyis 'dir btang zer smras pas 'ur langs te skyabs 'jug zhu mi je mang du song /dga' ldan pho brang du phebs nas zhag shas bzhugs dbang lung 'ga' zhig zhus shing snga sor gsung gleng yod pa ltar yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sder khyab bdag gnas gsar ba chen po'i drung du zab chos rnams gas par 'gungs med du phebs pa'i thugs thag bcad gung thang du grabs yul la skor tsam phebs ngos/ rdo rje brag tu rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog mjal bar phebs chos 'brel gyi thog ma tshe dbang khyuḥgacig ma 'bul bar mdzad/ rje bla mas rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i skur lcags sdong ma'i dbang gi phyag 'khrid stsal zhing tsag li yang 'dri ba gnang dbang bskur lugs kyi deb la'i rgyugs bzhes pa'i skyon bsal ngos sku tshe 'di'i bka' chos kyi thog ma nged rang nas zhu zhes dbang khang du rje bla ma dam pas dbus rnam gling sde ba yab yum gra ris rgan rim dang bcas par lcags sdong ma'i dbang tshar gcig dang phyi dro rje bla ma dang lcog sgar ba yongs rdzogs la gsol 'debasale'u bdun ma'i lung ste chos sgo gnyis 'byed pa'i khur bzhes gnang bar sprul sku rin po che yang (84ba)rjes su yi rang gi thugs bzo ba'i gsung bgros kyang thos/rnam sras gling nas gdan 'dren byung ba dpon slob lhan du byon pa bcur du bzhugs pa'i nub —124

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)rnam sras gling gi sdob a mi glo bur du tshe dus byas pa'i bang phyin srod 'khor la byung ba gsal 'debs la 'phral du bteg pa bya skad rgyab pa dang rnam sras gling du phebs pa'i 'pho ba/ bar do'i smon lam dang rigs drug gnas 'dren mdzad/ legs pa gling nas glang phu nas dgra 'dul gyis mtshams sbyor gyi zhu yig dang bcas bkra shis rtse chos sder zhabs drung dbon rin po cher bka' chos zhu bar phebs chog pa'i nye len dang / sne'u sdong rtser bkra shis rtse'i gzhis ka bzhugs mtsher la g.yar po zhu bar theg gling dbu mdzad rdzong bda' gnang /de nub bya sar bzhugs gnas mjal mdzad sang phebs lam du tshe chu 'bum pa mjal mkhan rnams log byung ba de nged rang tsho phyis pa tsam yin 'dra yang 'gro dgos gsungs tshe chu 'bum par zhabs skor gnang bas gnyags lo tsā bar 'khrungs pa 'a dus kyi mdzad pa mang po gsal bar thugs kyis dran/ tshe chu co zher bzed chog pa'i mang ba babs/ shel brag la rgyang phyag dang smon lam rgyas par mdzad/ bkra shis rtse chos sde'i rgyal sgo'i 'gag tu gra dmangs rnams kyis bsu ba dang bcas bla brang du dpon slob gnyis dar sna dang phyag 'bul rtse sprod kyis mjal 'dzom gnang / sngar phan ngos mjal lta zhog phyag bris phar gnang tshur gnang gi shugs 'dris kyang med rung snga mo nas thugs 'dris pa zhig bar skabs su ma mjal ba mjal ba lta bu'i dgyes tshor dang dag snang chen po rje bla ma gnyis gar byung ba sku tshe sngon ma nas dpon slob tu 'brel ba zhig yin tshod du 'dug (85na༄sa sku 'khor ba rnams la gsungs ba sngar zhal 'dris ye med pa'i skabs rje bla ma'i dag snang la khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba kha che dharma pā la'i rnam sprul dang gzims khang shar gyi bla brang rung ba zhig tu khri mtho ba'i steng sa skya pa'i bla ma sku bongs che zhing gzi brjid phun sum tsho gos pa la chos mang du gsan pa byung ba rjesasu rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i bzhugs gnas bka' chos gnang tshul sogs sgo mtshudas pa dang der ma zad kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan pa spel bar rdo rje lang tshar pa rje'i rnam sprul du thugasanges 'drongs par cha mtshudas su mchis/ thog mar nang so chos mdzad pa'i spyil bur bzhugs zhag gcig —125

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'amadzad rung sang nyin lha gzigs ma'i dbang pos bkra shis rtse'i gzhis ka bzhugs mtsher du g.yar po phul nas der bzhugs yul gnang /rje bka' 'gyur ba chen por 'di nas bzung snga phyir snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi chos bka' gtos che ba re gsan res rin cen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs snyan brgyud dang po'i rten 'brel sgrig phyogs rgyas par mdzad nas thog mar tshe dpag med dkar po phyag lugs kyi rjes gnang gis sgo phye/ kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rgyu dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sis ra'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i byin rlabs nyams 'khrid shin tu smin rgyas nā ro ta pa'i bzhed gzhung slob bshad thun mong ma yin pa chos skor yongs rdzogs/ in+d+ra mkha' spyod dang mi tri mkha' spyod kyi lung / rje btsun ku ru kul+le thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang / 'o bhi lugs kyi sis ra lha lnga'i byin rlabs/dmar chen (85ba)bgegs kyi rgyal po phyag bcu gnyis pa'i thun mong ba'i rjes gnang / dpal mo snying gi gser thag can/ nor rgyun ma dmar mo/ lha mo ti nu gsum gyi rjes gnang / dmar chen skor gsum dang dmar chung skor gsum gyi be'u bum yongs rdzogs/ zhal bsnyen dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang /rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i 'khrid kyi yig sna rnams ma gtogs pa'i dkar chag nang gi chos skor tshang ba/ snyan brgyud ha la nag po'i be'u bum sogs zab chos lhug par stsal bar gser srang gang phyag gtod kyi 'bul ba'ang mdzad/rje btsun bod mkhar ba chen po yab sras slob rgyun dbu ru phyogs su 'phrin las chas par skyid shod du khong dpon slob la dbang sdud yod ces log rtog byed pa thugs la mnga' ba dang / gshen rdor seng gis phag mo gru pa dbang du bsdus pa'i dag chol ma'i lo rgyus kyis kyang rkyen byas rje bla ma'i thugs la mchod gral gyi ze'u dmar po pha gi na dbang sdud cig med dam dgongs pa khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i mngon par mkhyen pas mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs la de tshur thong dang gsungs nas ze'u kha phye ste byin rlabs rten sogs spyan 'bebs gnang bas rje nyid thugs mos bla nas blar 'phel/ chos /26

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)'brel dgos tshul phebs par ras chung rnam sprul bkra shis rgya mtshor slob dpon chen pos dag snang du stsal ba'i tshe dbang yiḥgacig ma 'bul ba mdzad ring slar chos bka' mang tsam zhu ba'i snyan gsan gnang / mkha' spyod ma'i 'khrid kyi bsnyel tho spyan lam du 'bebs pa gnang bar 'bul thengs gcig la 'di 'dra'i dngos gtsang ba ya mtshan che zhes shin tu dgyes/ lugs gnyis (86na)kyi gnas tshul gyi gsung gleng zhib rgyas ngos 'dzam gling rgyan gcig pho brang sne'u stong rtser gong ma chen por phyag 'bul la phebs par sum gdan snyes 'bol gyi bkur bzos dang gzhi len zur gsos rgya nom pa gsol ja sbyor sbrel gyi bar dri ba zhib rgyas slar jo mo lugs kyi phur pa'i dbang lung zhu dgos 'dug ces bka' 455/'di lo zla bsgol khyad nas ho me zla dang po'i tshes bcu bzhi'i phyag bzhi pa'i gtore chen rten 'dogasadang 'grig pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i phyag nas ma'i ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i ru mtshon chen po bkram 'dug par smon lam 'phrin bcol mdzad/ yar lam rnam sras gling du rjes gcod la pad gling drag dmar gyi gtor bzlog /nag rtsis kyi sri gnon dang nyes pa kun sel gyi mdos gnang /sgrags su rgyal yum ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyi bla mtsho dang zhabs rjes mjal/ gung thang du phebs pa'i 'od gsal du mi ras ljang gu'i ang rag gyon pa rgya dang sma ra dkar ba lag tu rkang dung khyer ba zhig byung nas mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan sngon kha che dharmā pā la dang tshar pa chos rje/ gzims khang shar gyi bla ma sogs kyi skye ba yin nga la gtor ma re yang ma chag pa sbyin dgos/ nga'i chos skor rnams gang rung rung la ma ster zer ba byung ba'i sang nyin mgon po shing drung ma dang zhal gyi thang rnying zhig 'bul mi 'byor pa rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig par dgongs nas phyogs phebs kyi tshe 'bral spang mdzad/ nged lha sar yong thog yar klungs la phebs ba'i gnas tshul gnang bar nyang tsam phebs/ mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang me tog mngon par bkra ba'i lding khang du byon/'di lo lhor dmag bcug nas ma da yon gtsang du (86ba lnga zhugs pa'i 'gol skabs dang 'grig — 127

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen por gsan pa'i chos bka' rnams tshang bar zhus/ khyad par nā ro mkha' spyod kyi nyams 'khrid rdo rus thug par bsgoms pas kha phyir bltas kyi shes pa nang du khugs nas gsar ma'i dge sbyor lam du longs pa'i thog ma'ang 'di nyid yin pas bla ma dam pa'i sku drin ni byang chub kyi bar du 'khor ris su mi gda'/ dpal mgon gdong brnyan can gyi zab chos gnang dus gnas chung chos skyong yin zer ba'i rgyal po khog tu zhugs pa'i gzi brjid can zhig pho brang ltag sko'i 'gag tu byung nas zhing skyong dbang po'i chos skor 'di rnams gang rtsol gyis grub pa gyis zer ba byung gsung ba chos rgyal rdo rje drag ldan rang yin nam mgon po'i 'khor zhig gis rnam pa de 'drar bstan pa yin cha ma 'tshal yang don la chos grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzad pa'i legs par mngon/ grum bu'i bsnyel ro yod par dwags yul chab tshan la phebs pas 'phral du dwangs tshur lam bshes gnyen chen po sha ra ba'i 'bum pa mjal ba gnang zhing bla ma a rong dge slong gis gnas bshad bla brang du gdan drangs nas gzhi len zhus/ sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan 'dam bsam grub bde chen gyi ar po'i zhal bkod la thegs pa'i sa brko rdo slog gi nyen sel gyi sku srung 'bul bar mkhar rtse lcang rar byon pa'i gdab lan du yar klungs bkra shis rtse phyogs kyi 'grul la ma mnyes pa'i sgyur sbyang gnang / zing pa dgon gong 'og la tshe dpag med dang bla ma zhi drag gi dbang stsal nas gung thang du phebs/ yang dgon ka dgu ma'i sbug tu bde mgon 'khor mang gi logs bris skya ris dang spyan 'byed gnang /spyan snga (87nasgo la ldan rgya mtshor zhang bka' rgya'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs gsan/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos las sbyor mang po gnang zer ba'i snyan khra la brten sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi thugs kyi 'dzin stang g.yin du gzhol ba 'dra'i brjod pa sna tshogs kyis skyid shod phyogs su phebs par thugs ya nga ba rje bla mas mtshams sbyor gnang ba'i rkyen gyis mang mkhar mu gu lung gnyis par rnam par grol ba'i dga' ston gyi dbu tshugs te dbyar gyi dus rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba dpon slob rgod dkar brgyud gung thang du zhag shas bzhugs nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su nged dang ngos — 128

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ (tana'aphrad la phebs pa chos dang 'brel ba'i gsung gleng zhib mol dang / sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyis spyan ras kyis btsa' ba nas chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sar bstan pa'i bdag po jo shāka sogs gnas khyad par can gyi mjal ka gnang ngos zhang bde ba'i rdo rje'i pho brang chen por chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor ba'i mthun rkyen phul nas rje bla ma rnam gnyis stabs gcig par bzhugs/rje nyid kyis bkra shis rtse chos sder gsan pa'i chos 'phro'i rim pa mi dbang chos gsum dang /mi tri mkha' spyod gnyis kyi byin rlabs/ bstan srung bye ba'i sde dpon dpal gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad/bstoganyis ma/ gri gug lha lnga ma/ gshin rje ltar grub pa lha bstobadun ma bzhi'i dbang / mgon po lcam dral lha gsum/ lha brgyad ma/ lha bcu gnyis ma gnyis kyi rjes gnang thun mong ba/ mgon po khro chu'i rjes gnang / phyi 'khrid rdo rje brag rdzong / nang gi brag rdzong sngags rgod/ gsang ba sems nyid rtsal 'don/rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten pa'i gsang 'khrid rnams (87ba)kyi nyams 'khrid smin rgyas/mgon pod me 'bar ma/ der ma 'dus pa'i kha skong po ti/ gyi ljang glegs bam/ dud sol po:/ gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba snyan brgyud po ti rnams kyi lung man ngag phyag len ngo sprod/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon stobs 'phrog nag po gdong bzhi pa'i thun mong ba dang / las bzhi'i mgon po/bram nag shan pa drug skor rnams kyi rjes gnang / tshe sgrub srog 'khor dang bcas pa dang gsang 'khrid zab mo'i nyams 'khrid/ de skor gyi yig cha dang sngar 'phro lus pa'i man ngag skor kha shas/ zhal gyi las mkhan dmar po gnod sbyin beg tse'i rjes gnang dang sgrub skor yongs rdzogs/ lha chen ṭak+ki rā dza'i 'dod pa lha'i rjes gnang / 'jam dpal nag po'i rjes gnang lung bcas/ seng ldeng nags sgrol/dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ gnas brtan bcu drug /khro mo sme brtsegs rnams kyi rjes gnang / de dag dang 'brel ba'i yig lung / rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi ril sgrub/ gter kha 'og ma'i thod 'phreng rtsal gyi zlum po bzhi dbang / bla ma gsang 'dus kyi skor/ nyang gi drag dmar rdo rje spyi blugs kyi dbang / bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs/ phur pa spu gri/ bstan ma bstoganyis— 129

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)gsum gyi dbang dang chos skor yongs rdzogs/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dbang / rta pod yongs rdzogs/ paṇa chen sku mched kyi gter ma'i bla ma bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi rtsa dbang sgos dbang chos sde'i skor/ mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po'i gter ma drag po dbu dgu'i skor gyi lung / 'a zang kha sprin shugs ma dang sgrom bu ma nyis 'dus/ 'joms byed 'bar ba'i dbang chen chos sna thor bu/ rnam sras sprin gseb ma'i dbang sgrub skor/ dri za'i rgyal po 'bar ba rtsal (88na)gyi srog gtad/ grub chen lcags zam pa'i tshe dbang / byang gter tshe dbang lcags sdong ma sdong ston chos skyong bsod nams kyi phyag bzhes ma sogs sngags gsar rnying gi zab chos mtha' klas pa gsan/ gur zhal dmar po skor gsum sogs kyi gtor ma la brten pa'i phyag len ngo sprod khyad nas mchod dpon pa rdzong bda' gyis gnang ba bzhin btang bar lugs srol mi 'dra ba mtha' dag dpe ris su gtan la phab/ lag bzo byed dgos rnams kyang dmar 'khrid du nges shes 'drongs par byung / dpon slob lhan du yer pa spos dgar phebs nas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bar 'joms byed nyi zla nag po'i bka' gtad phul nas rje bla ma gar par dbyar mjal gyi khrom dbang gnang ba sogs kyi thugs brel gcod ring bka' 'gyur ba dpon slob brag gseb kyi gnas gzigs la thegs pa'i sne shan sogs khur bzhes mdzad/rje bla mas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po gtso bor gyur pa'i don gnyer can mang bar theg pa kun gyi yang rtse rdzogs pa chen po klong gsal snying tig ces chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i gter ma'i dbang lung / sprul sku dri med lhun po'i rdzogs pa chen po don tig 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi dbang lung / bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i dbang chen dbang phran/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dbang chen/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang bzhi lcags sdig lcags 'dra yongs rdzogs/ 'jam dpal rags gsum 'dus pa khro chu dug sdong nag po'i dbang lung / dam can skyes bu'i srog dbang las tshogs/ 'khrug byed las kyi rlung dmar dang rlung (88bskog /bram ze sdom bzang gi rlung 'khor/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i rnam sras ser chen gyi dbang dang sgrub skor/ zhab blon gyi rgyud sgrub — 13(3

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)thabs/ tsa ri zhing skyong gi srog gtad/ g.yu thog snying tig dang bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang lung / brang ti'i ga dmasang ga dngul bre'i drang srong ser skya'i sgrub lung / snar thang brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang lung bcas/ bla ma zhang gi bka' 'bum bod bzhi ma sogs zab cho sematha' yas pa 'bul bar mdzad/bka' 'gyur ba chen po 'bras spungs su skor tsam phebs nas yar lam gung thang du dpon slob mjal 'dzom ngos yar klungs su thegs khar 'bul ba zhabs ga bzabs rgyas mdzad/ zla gcig la nye bar sku mtshams shin tu dam pa'i sgo nas brag rdzong ma'i las rung gi gzhi bsnyen zhig gnang bar rtags ya mtshan can byung tshod nas nged kyis skye ba sngon ma sa lugs kyi yi dam chos skyong gi skor la nyams len dga' rab byas pa 'dra bag chags gzhan las che ba zhig 'dug gsung / dgun gyi rang dga' ldan pho brang du phebs rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar bar gsan pa phal cher dang g.yin yang rgyal po bka' 'bum/ zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyis gtsos pa'i dbang 'khrid lung man ngag mtha' klas pa stsal/ brag rdzong ma'i 'khrid kyi dus dmigs ltas byung ba rnams snyan dbang du phul bas dregs pa rgyud gsum dbang du 'dus pa' ltas su 'dug ces dgyes par gyur/ brag rdzong ma'i nyams 'khrid kyisasrung bzlog bsad mnan gyis sa ma dhi gzhan dag la'ang mun khung du sgron me bteg pa ltar bogs thon zhing / mgon bo gnyis kyi nang 'khrid kyis sngon chad chos (pon skyong zer na kha gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa zhig phyi rol na yod rgyu'i 'dzin rtog gi ngan mtshang rdib nas rtsa khams rlung gsum thamasacad dregs pa'i ngo bor nges shing de yang gsal stong zung 'jug sems nyid gcig bu'i ngo bor thag chod pa'i sa skya'i bla r+ṣa kho na'i khyad par gyi thugs kyi chos zab mo 'dis 'brog mis zur bu che la bsam mi khyab kyi 'khrid gnang tshe bla ma chen po'i bka' drin gyis a po'i sems phyogs nor du song zhes pa'i lo rgyus bzhin sngar rdzogs chen gyi sems ngo sprad pa tsho la rtsal thon pas sngags gsar rnying gang la'ang dam pa 'dis drin gyis bskyangs pa la mtha' ma mchis so/ /me phag gi bde gzar gyi skabs nas lho 'brug gi dgon pa mtha' dag badz+ra mu'i 'dres su mi —131—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedabang bsod nams rab brtan gyis bkra shis 'brug rgyal gyi dgon pa sbyor 'jags gnang song bar rje bla ma sku tshe thams cad du 'dod chung chog shes la goms pas thugs dam stong sla gshis dgyes par gyur/ sa glang lo gung thang gzims khang shar gyi 'du khang gsar rgyag dang bla brang la zhig gsos kyi bya ba las kyi 'khor lo rim bzhin gnang / yang dgon spyan snga bsnyung bar yang yang sku khams skor bar phabs rdo rje drag ldan ma mnyes pa'i mtshan ma thugs dam la shar ba'i bslab ston bzhin gnas chung nas sku khog 'bod par btang ba ma 'byor gong la spyan snga glo bur du gshegs pa'i thugs dam gsal 'debs dang phyag g.yog grul thub med gshis dgongs rdzogs kyi bslab ston me mchod phyag bstar mchod 'bul sogs nan tan du gnang / zhig gsos kyi sa ris rnams gung thang du mchod khang sus (89ba tshe sna dzin la babs 'brel yod gshis sde ba bsod nams rab brtan gyis lha khang dang sbrags rtsis sprod mdzad/ mgar stong btsan yul srungs kyi gdung rabs chad pas sog rtsa btsugs pa'i ston bsdu long med par bde chen nas yang dgon nang so'i sa ris rnams rtsis bzhes pa'i rgyus rten bzhengs sos kyi than sprin ltar gyur par rje nyid nas yo byad dgos bya phyag 'don dang do dam gnang nas spyan snga'i gser sku mda' gang pa zhig bskrun te yang dgon du bzhugs su gsol bar skyid shod stod smad kyi gzur gnas mtha' dag dad pa'i gsos su gyur/ yang dgon pa'i rten bzhengs kyi zhan la thugs dam rten du o rgyan chen po/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ rje pha bong kha pa/ zhabs drung bla ma rin po che/yol mo sprul sku/ rin po che kun dga' tshe mchog khu dbon/ zur chen gshon nu don grub/ nged kyi 'dra 'bag rnams khyid gang ba re bzhengs par bal po gu ṇa dang shi na can la gla thob yon 'phar sogs bzabs rgyas su ju55/dbyar stod yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sder pha rgod gnas gsar chos rje'i drung du chibs kha bsgyur/ tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi chos rnams bka' gnyan zhing bka' sdod gshin rje pu tra khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bas phebs bsur btang ba'i ltongs lta bus lam du bzhugs pa'i nub sngar mi grags kyi — 132

zur ོ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)kha ba babs pas sang la la phyags phyi rnams mig phyid gangs zhu ba'i chu glo bur du rdol nas phu chu la phebs ma thub par rnga 'gor bzhugs/ sang nyin shar mar phebs rtsis bu tshal du cis kyang 'gro gsungasaphebs der gzigs snang gi rim pa byung ba phyag bris su stsal ba 'di lta ste/ ngas sngon (90na 'dir mang du bsdad pa yin bsams tsa na ḍā dril gyi sgra zhig byung ba'i ngang la mdun du slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi gtso bo lta bu/ g.yas su paṇa chen bi mā la chos gosangur smig can paṇa zhwa li khri'i mdog can gsol ba/ phyag g.yas na po ti phra ring bsnams pa/ slob dpon chen po'i g.yon na ma gcig ye shes mtsho rgyal bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod tsam dbu skra gsil ma rgyab tu bcings pa/ na bza' dar dkar dmar mthing gsum/ sku rags ling sngo skya bcings pa/ phyag na sngon po ril ril zhig bsnams pa mthong byung bas gu ru zhi ba'i yan lag bcu ba tshar gcig byas nas dzaḥlha baṃ sngos dbang bzhi blangs pas/ gu ru'i zhal nas/ dz+nyā na ku mā ma yengs gso ne mdzod cig /chos dbyings rnam dag ye grol gdod ma'i klong / /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum dang ldan/ /mi 'gyur gting zab brjod bral lhang nge ba/ /dri bral yan pa lhun grub chos kyi sku/ /zhes ngo sprad/ bi mā las/ 'khor 'das thams cad byang chub sems kyi dkyil/ /gdod nas dag ba sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /de nyid ma bcos lcog bzhag so ma'i ngang / /ye grol dag pa de nyid nyams su long / /zhes gsungs/ 'tsho rgyal gyis/ yang dag don la skye 'chi gnyis med kyang / /gnas skabs sha khrag lusa'adi nges par 'gyur/ /tshe 'di'i snang ba rmi lam ༷ / /rang ngo shes nas skad cig brtan pa thob/ /ces gsungs/ de nas bdag la sku zhabs chen mo'i phebs sgor bkra shis chos sde'i bla mar sa skya'i zhal ngo nas brgyud pa'i chos (90bskor gyi 'phro rnams zhus gnang byung bar bla ma de ci 'dra yod dam zhes sngar gung thang du lung bstan zur tsam byung na'ang de kho na la thugs ma bkal bar zhug pas slob dpon chen pos chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan 'di ris lo tsā bslabs nas chos mang du bsgyur bcug lo paṇa rnams la chos zhus/ btsun mo dang blon po'i dbang du song nas lo paṇa rnams la dka' ba spyod —133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shedagos mang du byung / da lta'ang dbang 'khrid lung sogs byed dgos pa sngon gyi las 'phro sad pa yin/snyigs dus gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i sgron me lta bu'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i ngang la mi ras ljang gu'i ang rag gyon pa rgya dang sma ra dkar po brang du sleb pa ral pa spyi bor bcings gseb tu gtsod rwa gzer ba lag tu rkang dung khyer ba zhig gis mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan 'di sngon chos rgyal khri srong gi lo paṇa rnams bsam yas su gdan drangs pa'i dus kha che'i paṇa chen dharma pā la yin/ de nas rgyal sras dngul chu chos rdzong pa dang gong dkar chos sde'i bla ma/ gzims khang shar gyi khri pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ de'i skye ba da lta'i bla ma 'di yin pas khyed kyi rtsar ngas yongs pa yin la gtor ma re ma chag par ster dgos nga dang gzhan mi 'dra bas nga'i chos skor rnams gang rung rung la ma sbyin zhig zer ro/ /zhes pa'i gsung gi gnang ba dngos su stsal zhing o rgyan gyi mkhan po gsang ba shes rab ltar paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pā la'ang tshe'i rig spro 'dzin pa la mnga' brnyes pas rje khri srong lde btsan gyi dus byon nas lo chen gyi bar bzhugs par mngon/paṇ+ḍi ta 'di rgya gar shar phyogs pa yin yang kha che dharmā pā la zhes grags che (91na〉bas 'jig rten gyi grags pa mi 'gog pa'i ched du dgongs pa 'dra/ de nas gtsang chung gling khar phebs rtsis la srung ma'i 'tshub kyis rlung dmar shin tu che ba langs pas gru gtong ma thub par blo mdar bzhugs/sang nyin g.yo ru khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang gi rten brten pa rnams mjal ba mdzad tshe rgyal khang gi sku thog mar kha dog dmar ba la mthar smug nag tu 'gyur ba zhig kun gyis gzigs/ bkra shis rtse chos sder gzims khal 'bebs long med par ser ba drag po slo bur du babs pa'i thigs pas dpon slob mjal 'dzom gyi dus sgo mangs kyi steng du bzhugs gdan 'ding dgos byung / de dang dus mtshungs su gong dkar 'ong gseb tu chu 'thab kyi rnam pas mi zhig bsad pa dang / bka' chos tshugs nas ring por ma lon par rje bla ma sku ltem pa'i bang phyin byung 'phral byang ngos nas dpon tshang gzhan phan dbang pos sngon mo chu 'dren gyi chab sman sbyar ba 'phral du 'bul mi btang zhing khyab bdag bka' — 134

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)'gyur ba chen po'i thugs dam brtag par chos skyong gi 'tshub lhongs yin tshul shar bar brten mgon po che chung las mkhan gnyis dang bcas par gra pa bcu gnyis kyis nyin gnyis kyi bar bskang bshags brgya tshar bsags/ chos sder mang ja spong dag gi spyi 'gyed gnang /sne'u sdong rtse'i bla sman gyis phyag rtsa zhus shing phu lung drung 'tsho ba rtsa ri'i gnas skor nas 'ongs pa'i 'phrod bsten zhus pa sogs rgyu rkyen 'dzom pa'i mnyel babs lci yang sman thun lnga tsam gyi thog gzhi med du song ba chab gsog dkyus ma la de 'dra dka' na'ang ma 'ongs pa na slob ma dam nyams shig yong ba (91ba〉byas skyong gi mkhyen pa'i rtags kho nar snang / bka' chos kyi rim pa mgon po lha brgyad dang lha bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/ dud sol ma'i rjes gnang nan chags mar grags pa/ pu tra/ ber nag zangs gri can/ gcer bu zangs gri can/ ru mtshon gyi las mkhan bran bdud thun mong ba/ zhal las sbyor gyi mgon po glang gdong ma/ phyag rdor gos sngon can/ rnam srasaser chen smad lugs/ dkar bdud lcam dral rnams kyi rjes gnang / rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i rdzong chung tshe dbang / mdzod dbus ma nas byon pa'i tshe dpag med dkar po'i dbang / drag po dbu dgu ye shes rang gsal gyi rtsa dbang / ras chung lugs kyi tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig /tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma/ tshar chen gyi bka' 'bum/ sgo rum pa dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse gnyis kyi rnam thar gyi lung / bla ma dam pa dang mus chen gyi kye rdor mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog bya bral ma sogs zab chos mtha' yas pa dang / man ngag zhal bzhes snying nang gi khrag lta bu rnams sba sris med par stsal ba'i ljags lung nang gi slob dpon dharmā pā la'i brjod bya zhig gi skabs rje bka' 'gyur bas spyan nam mkhar gzigs nas zhal 'dzum tsam mdzad pa bu tshal gyi lung bstan de mkhyen pa yin nam dgongs pa'i thugs dogs shar/ bran bdud kyi bka' gtad skabs 'tshub ma kham nag cig gis dkyil nas mi nag po ral pa ltag par bcings shing re ba'i gos gyon pa rta nag zhon pa zhig rdo gcal nas gzims chung bar 'ur 'ur zer nas rta ma babs par nang du byung ba bka' las/ de 'dra gsal po — 135

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pemathong yang rnying ma (92na tha'i ris la zog gi khag yong bas dgongs khrel dogs snyan 'bul zhu ma nus gsung / sngags sdeb snying gzer nag po dang srid pa'i gter khyim gyi lung dgongs bzhed bzhin 'bul ba gnang / nang so dge 'dun rgya mtshor gter mgon phyag bzhi pa dang sman lung lha mo'i dbang dang bskang gso'i lung stsal/ tshur phebs gdong dpon rin po ches da lam nged rang tshar lugs pa rnams kyi gdams pa yod dgu thams cad phul ba yin pas chos skyong rnams phyi 'brang byas mi yong la che/ sngon gyi bla ma rnams la'ang de ltar byung 'phros 'dug phebs/ sang thegs khar bla brang du gdan drangs chos sde'i rgyal sgo bar khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bas skyel mar byon nged tshos g.yab dbyug zhu dus chibs kyi zhal kha bsgyur ba zhu gsungs pa bzhin lcang gseb sgrol mtshams la phebs pa na thog kha nas rje btsun nyid kyis g.yab dar dang zhabs 'bring pa tshos gzan gyis g.yab mo sogs chos skyong phyi 'brang mi yong ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa gnang / sne'u sdong rtser zhabs drung gdung brgyud rin po che blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi lha mjal bar phebs thugs 'dogs bdag rkyen tshad med stsal/bsam gtan gling nas sna mo shag grub chen mi pham da rma sangs rgyas ja zhus dang bcas phyag dbang la 'byor/ rtse tshogs mkhan chen skyong bas ja 'dren zhus/ gtsang chung gling khar sde pa bying pa ma chen gyis gung gi dro'i bsnyen bkur/ rnam sras gling du zhag gsum bzhugs par spyi sger so so nas zhabs tog dang sde pa ma chen gyis gtsang gi bde (92ba)gzar dus nom par byung ba'i rta mgrin gyi li sku phul/ zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i rten la snyan dar dkar me zhal zas kyi mchod 'bul rgya cher bstab cing smon lam rnam dag gi mtshams sbyor dang slob dpon chen pos gung thang la khar bzhag pa'i zhabs rjes ngo mtshar can dang / be+e ro'i phyag bzo'i rta mgrin sogs pho brang 'og tu yod pa rnams kyang zhib mjal mdzad/ rta mgrin gling du tshes bcu gnang rtsis mchod pa thengs gnyis skyel bar zhabs 'bring pa zhig gis phyin skabs sgo ma byung ba dang phebs nyin yang sbug — 136

zur ོ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanagi lde mig lus nas sbug pa gnang dgos byud bar thugs tshig pa'i rnam pas rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og la nan cher gzigs/ bzhugs mtsher du phebs nas rta mgrin gling na chos gter gyi skal ba zhig yod rung rten 'brel ma 'grig ces drung du 'khod pa rnams la bka' stsal/bsam yas mdo sde mchod pa'i deb la dang 'grig ste lcog tu phebs bstan srung dregs pa'i sde dpon gnod sbyin chen pos stag lngags khar kha gang ma zhig bting ba'i gdan bzos dang gu ru pad+ma'i bstan pa la sngar bzhin 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed dgos/ srung 'khor dang mdud pa la rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa dga'/ rigs 'dzin pa rang gi bstan pa 'di yun ring po'i bar du gnas pa'i 'phrin lasasdug 'dres byed do zhes dgyes dgyes dang mtshon cha rnams kyang rje nyid phyogs su ye ma 'phangs pas tha'i jis gtsos pa kun ya mtshan gyi gnas su byed/ phu lung gya ra bas zhag gcig gis zhabs tog zhus shing ba lam shar nub sogs stod smad kyi sngags pa (93na sgoms bsdus pa'i mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul/ ston po ta lar phebs nyin pu tra'i 'tshub lhongs kyi rnam pas ser ba chen po slo bur du babs/ bkra shis rtser gsan pa'i bka' chos rnams dang sngags gsar rnying gi chos bka' mang du zhus/ drag po dbu dgu'i dbang gi nyin mchod dpon pas gtor ma khur yongs pa gnam sgo la lhung grabs kyi rngur che bar byung / 'di res dang dus gzhan dag tu'ang snga 'gyur gyi chos srung bka' gtad 'dra'i tshe slob ma phur pa gshin rje rta mgrin sogs thugs la gang 'thad pa zhig gi bskyed rim mdzad pa zhu zhes brda sprod pa gnang dus rang gi blo la gang 'thad bsgoms pa slar gtor ma lag tu gtong pa'i tshe sngar gang bsgoms pa de da'i mtshan smos te khyed rang der gsal ba la chos skyong gtad byung dgongs pa'i mos pa mdzod sogs gzhan sems mkhyen pa'i mngon shes thogs med ma gtogs pho tshod dang gsang gtam nyan dgos pa'i ris de 'dra ye min/ phan bde legasabashad gling par snga 'gyur gyi sgrub 'phrin 'dzugs pa'ang bla ma dge dar bas gra mi 'grig pa'i thabs kho na dang kho rang gi kha la nyan pa tshor khral bcos las tshul ldan byas gzhan 'dra dang sde pa'i snyan —137

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sedu'ang spos dga' sku skyes zhu 'bul mangs pa'i nged tshor byed gtad byung tshul rje bla mar lkog tu skur 'debs tshan po che/ yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sde 'jig tu nye ba'i 'phrul sogs gsang ba'i rnam thar mang yang / bshes springs las/ mi ni a mra'i 'bras bzhin ma smin la/ /smin pa dang 'dra smin la ma smin 'dra/ /ma smin ma smin par snang smin la (93ba ji/ /smin par snang zhes bgyi bar 'drar rtogs mdzod/ zhes pa'i don thugs la mnga' ba'i tshul bstan gyis khong pa bsam bsam pa rta dang 'gro khar rkang thang gi rnam pa'i bla ma byed par chos 'chad rgyus lag gtugs nas sla nga tsha dus kyi skam pa'i tshul du rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa nas brgyud pa dang / nā ro mkha' spyod gur zhal sogs gnang ba sngar stobs 'phrog dbang pos nga'i chos bka' su byung byung la ma byed gsungs pa'ang 'di ris la dgongs gshis sku tshe'i gegs su song ba'i 'gyod pa ni rtas mi zin pa lta bur snang /lcags stag nang du rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku dpon slob bka' chos gsan par phebs/ byang gter/ tshe bdag /dgongs pa yang zab/ gza' pod sogs dbang lung mang du 'bul ba gnang / gar bu dgon du sprul sku rin po che/ bla ma 'dzom pa sgang pa/ gnyis su gnas pa dang phyogs mtha'i sngags ban mang du tshogs par zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyi sgrub chen zhag bco lnga skor la rdzogs par mdzad pa'i 'og sgo bde chen gyi skor dpon slob nyung bsdus dang / steng sgo rnam grol gyi chos sogs dngos gzhi tshogs pa byings la stsal ba'i mtha' brten sbyin sreg gi bar snang gsal ba'i phyag len ma 'phyugs pa/ grol dbang la stod smad kyi khrom chen por bkra shis tshe dang sgrub rdzas kyi dbang bskur gnang / gar bu dgon pa ba tshor sger du spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs/ smyung gnas kyi cho ga /ma ṇi'i bzlas lung sogs kyi re ba bkang / yang dgon bla ma sha ra hor sku skyer tshal lugs bde mgon gyi dbang sogs nyer mkho'i chos bka' mang du stsal/lho brag nas sprul sku (94na)gsung sprul dkor chen bshags te lha sar byon pa'i lam zhor gung thang du dpon slob gdan 'dzom/ phar gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi dbu tshugs dang tshur chos 'brel 138

zur ོ thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanatsam gsan/po ta lar sa 'dul gyi tshe lha sar mchod yon zhal mjal bar byon 'dug rung zhal 'tsho ba bzhin med pas 'di res sprul sku rang la thig le bcu drug gi lung dang thugs sras zla ba'i dge bsnyen bsgrub par gos skrungs su 'byon par rje bla mas mtshams sbyor gyi phyag bris gnang ngo //gnam gyi she mong dpung pa srid pa'i rdzong //rdzogs ldan slar bzhin rngam pa gsar pa sgo//brgya phrag 'byed la yangs pa'i rnam dpyod kyis//sal blo gsal phur bu'i mched por 'gran//rang rig bla mar nges btsal zla dgu'i bar//rang bzhin lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i klong //rang las mi gzhan don gyi pad+ma 'byung //rang snang ngo bor 'byams klas dngos grub brnyes//lha gcig mu tig btsan po'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul//grags pa don ldan chos rgyal 'bri gung pa'i//bstan srid pad+ma'i skud pa ltar phra ba//mi zad rdo rje'i zungs su deng byin btsos//kun 'dus zhi khro'i bu ram ljon tshal du//bdag rgyud dug lnga'i thig le'i ye shes lngar//dbang chu nyi mas smin gos shākya'i brgyud//gto mdun don rnams grub drin gang gis gzhal//mgon khyod gtsug rgyan mi nyag byang pa rje'i//mchog sprul zla ba tshes pa 'khor 'das kyi//yon to bye ba'i cha rdzogs nyer bsdogs su//rdo rje'i slob dpon chen por deng 'dir grub/khyun gyi dbang po'i mkhan po khrims ldan gtso//brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin bi rā ba//94ba〉(snyengs 'dir gnas gsar chos rjer yongs grags zhabs//dam pa'i gtsugator rtser 'god rten 'brel 'grig/bla ma yi dam khyad par gnyan mgon des//lung bstan bden gtam 'gyur med gto tshigs kyis//snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan bdud rtsi'i bas//gang gi thugasagasang dpal ber yongs su gtams//phyi 'gyur chos zab kyis gdungs gnas ngan las//bde 'gro'i rten la dngos su nyams myong bdag/zab rgyas gdams pa ro brgya'i bza' ba la//ci dgar spyod 'di a ho bla ma'i drin//sa dbang sgra 'dzin la bcug phra ma yi//chang myos gnyis 'thung rgol ba'i spobs bral yang //ngag 'jam gzhan snang 'drid pa sor mo'i dug/'khor lo'i ri mo can gyi zhabasal bsku//thugs rje nyi dkyil mkha' la rtag 'cha/ yang //'phrin las chud ngu'i bu gar rab 'jug

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepas/ /mchog dman bar pa rjes 'dzin khyod nyid kyi/ khyad par ma lags sangs rgyas spyi yi lugs/khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po sa glang gi mjug khu lung du yab yum gyi sri zhu la phebs pa'i thugs brel chod 'phral gung thang du shar rgyag chibs kha bskyod nas stan chags/ dpon slob gnyis byi lo chos kyi skyes 'bul res gnang ba'i 'phra mus khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen por gsan par dus kyi 'khor lo'i thun mong pa'i las sgrub lha gsum du grags pa'i tsher ma can gyi nang zhi ba sna tshogs yum dkar mo/ klu dang sa bdag 'joms pa rdo rje khyung khra/ char dbab gcod byed pa rdo rje shugs/ sman bla sprul sku/ dbang gi sgrol ma dmar mo/ 'jam dpal ye shes yon tan bzang po/ rnam 'joms ljang sngon ba (95na)ri lugs/ phyag rdor u tsarla/ mi g.yo dkar sngon/ sme brtsegs/ zla rgyal lugs kyi rta mgrin lcags ral can/ ras chung lugs kyi rta mgrin/ spyan ras gzigs gtso 'khor gsum pa/ dzam ser nag /seng gdong nag mo/ dur khrod bdag po/ gur mgon gsang 'khrid kyi rjes gnang / bran bdud kyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/ zhal sgrub dus thun mong ma yin pa/ khyung zhal can/ srin po ri'i dpal mgon seng ge nag po/ lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma rnams kyi rjes gnang / rnam sras drag po bka' shin tu gnyan pa/ gsang sgrub ljang ser be con can/ drag byed rta sngon srin mo bzhis bskor/ nang gsang ltar sgrub pa lha dgu/ drag byed seng zhen klu brgyad kyis bskor ba/ drag byed rkang thang lha brgyad/ mdung dmar can lha bcu gsum/ yang gsang drag po srin po bzhis bskor/ mthing kha zhal gsum phyag drug pa las mkhan mdung dmar can dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor gnyis/ gar mkhan mchog ljang gu zhes gsum phyag bco brgyad pa lha brgyad/ gar mkhan mchog dmar smug zhal gsum phyag bco brgyad pa/ dkar po sems dpa'i lha dgu/ yang gsang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa/phag dkar shes rab gsal byed/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs/ rdo rje nam mkha'i lding gser mig 'khyil pa 'byung po 'ur 'ded kyi rjes gnang / man ngag skor sgrub thabs rgya mtsho las sku'i rnam 'gyur dang sngags mi 'dra ba brgya bzhi bcu'i rjes gnang dang rgya gzhung gi lung / dus 'khor gyi — 140

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)bdag po chen po ma gtagos sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs/ gshin rje gdong (95bajug /rnam snang mngon byang / ma ṇi ka badz+ra lugs kyi rnam 'joms mthing nag lha bcu dgu/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun/ srung ba lnga/ lha nga gcig /rigs gsum spyi/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu/rdo rje phur pa lha khra stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang / smad las drag po sgrol ba'i rjes gnang / sngags srung ma'i srog gtad dang chos skor/ o rgyan bla ma sku gsum sgrub pa/ gsar 'gyur ma ni ka nā thas thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtser gnang ba'i rgya gzhung dang de'i lo rgyus 'grel pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi zhal lung /dkar bdud kyi sgrub skor/ lam skor phyi ma brgyad kyi lung / tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs/ tshar chen gyi kye rdor bskyed rim/ gsung ngag khog phug rje mkhyen brtse'i zin bris sogs smin rgyas dang /khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i zhabs phyir dpon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal sogs kha shas la sangs rgyas gling pa'i 'jam dpal skor gsum dang / drag
