dmar dbang phyug /dregs pa nyi shu /gnod sbyin rtag mtha'i skor/ ser srung drag po lnga dril/ rat+na gling pa'i rnam sras mdung dmar can/ dzam nag /lha chen/bla ma zhang gi bka' 'bum bka' rgya'i dbang lung / bka' chems bka' khol ma sogs sngags gsar rnying gi chos mtha' klas pa 'bul ba mdzad/dar rgyas chos sdings nas mkhas grub chen po rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub la rje bla ma rnam gnyis chabs gcig par rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gter chos kyi phur pa yang gsang bla med/rta phag gsang sgrub/ zab lam gsang 'dus/ rtsa gsum 'bras bu'i don 'khrid/ phyag tshan nyi ma'i snying po/ skyes rabs lung gi lde mig sogs zab gter (96na〉 'thor/ dag snang mdzod khang dgu pa/byang gter drag po spyan mang / las 'brel rtsal gyi drags 'dul/ sgrub thabs chig brgyud/ rigasa'adzin yongs 'dus kyi dbang lung sngar ma gsan pa'i 'phros gang yod/ gu ru lha khang gi yang gter skor klong chen pa'i yid bzhin mdzod/ sgo las 'phro gling pa nam mkha' rdo rje'i sems dpa'i thugasasgrub kyi dbang lung / dri med kun dga'i thugs rje chen po ye shes 'od mchog /spa gro gter ston tshe —141—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shering rdo rje'i rdzogs wo ci ti re gsal byed nor bu'i dbang lung / shes rab me 'bar gyi rdzogs wo 'khor 'das rang grol/ gar dbang las 'phro gling pa'i bla sgrub phyi nang gsang gsum/ rgya ban rdo rje dbang phyug gi rtag tu ngu'i bcud len/ dam pa dmar po'i bdud rtsi'i bcud len/ 'phrang 'go gter ston gyi 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa/ zla ban gzi brjid 'bar gyi sngags sdeb snying gi me long mang rong gter ston gyi tshe sgrub thugs kyi yang snying / snang rtse sde pa'i tshe 'khrid yang snying 'dus pa dang 'jam dpal nag po/ spo bo pad+ma rigs 'dzin gyi nor bu pad+ma'i 'phreng ba'i gsang sgrub/ bal po badz+ra ma ti'i rims srung / gu ru khrung nag gi gshin rje'i sku gsung thugs kyi za yig /bon po drag rtsal gyi ser srung / lcang sman don grub dar gyi dug sman gdams pa/ g.yu thog snying tig gi sman bla mched gsum ye shes khye'u dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / de nas mi ring bar gsung sprul 'bri gung nas tshur byon pa dang 'grig par bla ma yang tig gi rjes gnang sogs 'ga' zhig gsan zhing khyab bdag bla ma rnam gnyis nas khong dpon slob gnyis la (96ba)bzhed chos kha shas 'bul ba mdzad/'di lo nub cig rje bla ma'i 'od gsal la shar tshul bka' las/ nub mo zhig gser khang gling du 'dug pas 'og khang gi gung na o rgyan chen po dang mkhan po bi mā la yin rgyu'i paṇa chen gsum zhal shar du gzigs/ khri chen po'i thog tu zhal bzhin dang paṇa zhu res mthong res mun pa'i slong nas mi mthong ba zhig bzhugs 'dug /g.yas gral du paṇa chen mang po'i gral/ g.yon du rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis thog drangs btsun mo mang po 'dug /bdag dang zla bo ngo mi shes pa gnyis gsum zhig kha yar khyu byas gdan med par 'dug /bzhugs gral der ja chang zhus pa'i nyams tsam byung / de nas gral grol ba'i slob dpon gsum bzhugs g.yas kyi gral rked nas paṇa chen rgad bu ras dkar po'i phywa ra gsol ba 'khar ba dang ku ba'i snod khyer ba zhig 'dug /rgyal po de'i lho zur gyi lcog der sgron me bcas thegs pa dang mnyam du bdag la rtsis sprad nas do nub khyod kyi slob dpon 'di'i zhabs phyi gyis la nub lcog tu bzhugs/ da lta'ang khyed rang dpon slob tu 'dug /slob dpon 'di khrung sing la —142

zur mu thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)dgyes po yod pas 'di zhus sku rdab ma byung ba gyis gsungs ku ba'i snod chang gis gang ba zhig gtad byung /nub lcog tu gdan drangs pa'i sgron me yang 'dug chang zhu zhing bsdad pas dgyes dgyes mdzad/skad cha mang po rgya skad mdzad byung yang go ma byung da lta'ang slob dpon de mig sngar gsal po 'dug pas bris pa yin/dpyod shes pa ni ma byung /paṇa chen 'di la slob dpon thams cad gzigs nas ba 'ad mo dang dgyes dgyes mdzad cing gces97na spros chen po mdzad kyin 'dug go/zhes slob dpon de'i sku gzugs phyag bris su btab pa/lo paṇa rgyal blon 'dzum pa'i gzigs snang dang paṇ+ḍita bsres po de khrung la dgyes pa da lta'ang dpon slob tu 'brel tshul gang la dpags kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi rū pa yin par snang /zhabs 'bring po dang nye skor gyi sngags ban rnams bsdus pa'i bsu bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul bar khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po gdan 'dren gnang nasadapon slob zhal rgyas kyi rten 'brel legs tshogs su gyur/'di lo dgun stod nas rje bla ma gdan drangs pa'i zab chos mang po zhig zhu rtsis la 'tshub lhongs kyi rnam pas nged rang bro 'tshal ba dang mchod dpon pa na ba shed ma gsos pa sogs nas rim gyis 'gyangs pa hor zla bcu gcig par rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi 'phro mus/gur zhal rnam srasakyi rjes gnang sngar ma thob pa phal cher/gzhan yang nyer mkho'i rjes gnang rnam grangs mang ba zhus pa mtha' dag dgyes bzhin du stsal/mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyis 'dod chos mang du zhus pa'i nub mnal lam du mi zhig na re/mchod dpon pa 'di 'byom ston pa'i nye gnas su skyes skabs sabadag gi nad kyis zin pa'i stogs skye ba gzhan du'ang byung zhing da lo na ba'i gnod pa'ang de dus kyi klu gnyan de ga yin pas zon byed dgos 'dug zhus par brten slar gter kha 'og ma'i nā ga ra ka'i dbang dang srung ba za yig mang du stsal/des mtshon sngags rams pa blo bzang don grub kyis gsang ba snying po'i sa ga'i rtsi zhag dang /gzhan yang dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ 97bsngags ramasapa nam mkha' bzang po sogs gra tshang gi gra pa raXs rim la 'dod chos dus snga phyi du mar mang du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheganang /sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan nas lho 'brug pa la rtags thon pa'i las sbyor mdzad dgos pa'i phebs sgo bzhin mdo spyil du sku mtshams khog nas lags a gur dang ngag dbang 'phrin las gnyis kyis zham ring zhus rlung dmar dang srog 'phyan pa nag po'i 'khor lo phyag len du bstar ba khro chu dug sdong nag po'i sgo nas dgugs gzhug lha dbye rlung lha'i mchod bstod bskul zor 'phen sogs dang / dge slong byams pa blo bzang can gra tshang gi gra pa bzhis 'khor lo sgrub pa'i phyag g.yog zhus phag ri rnam rgyal dkar po'i rdzong du 'jugs par gra tshang gi gra pa snang rtse ba dang lags ngag dbang 'phrin las gnyis kyis phyin/ than rdzas rnams rdos po'i phu dang ku ku 'phrang sogs su bskyal bas mi ring bar rdo gdan lcags rir dug sbrul brgyugs pa/ rta khyu la rta nad/ ra lung gi dung rang byon gyi gangs zhu bas mtshon ltas ngan sna tshogs byung zhing zla ba lnga tsam nas zhabs drung 'brug pa chu tshan du byon thog chu la bse dug 'debs mkhan byung nas skrangs sam yang zer/ la la steng grib rgyab bam zer ba sogs kha mi mthun pa'i chu tshan kha nas 'dol ler gdan drangs te sbu nag khar sku mtshams bsdams so zhes dril bsgrags nas da lo phan lo nyer drug gi bar phyi nang sus kyang mthong rgyu med par gsang ba'i rgyas btab pa'i phyag rjes ni lha rje zur bu che chung gis kyang dka' bar snang bas gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes kyi mched zlar 'os sam snyam/ bla ma tsa ri ba 'brug pa'i phyag tu rgyab na dmar gsod las the mi (98na〉〈ma yang kur brgyud pa'i rigs 'di bong bu sna tshugs kyi rmongs dad che ba'i bag chags shig yod 'dug pa'i skyon yin nam dam sel lta bus khong pa rdzong dpon byed skabs yin pa ma 'khyangs par 'das/ lcags sbrul bde gzar rang bstan chags 'jig la gya ba'i nyen can gyi sku rim mdzad par 'bru khal lnga brgya las ma byung rung da lam 'brug pa gdung brgyud gshegs par dbus gling 'od gsal rtse'i bogs khal bdun brgya tsam gyi sbyor 'jags byung /sgam smyon sprul sku lha sar zhabs skor la byon par gzhis ka shar du gnas g.yar nas bsnyen — /44

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanabakur/sde pas brag gseb bla ma'i gzhi rten la mer pa spos dga' bzhes pa thog ma'i dgon par song bas thugs la ma babs kyang rtsis 'bul gnang /sngar chos rgyal byang par rigs 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gter ma'i dug dbang tshar gcig gsan yang lcags yos lo sgam spyon sprul sku phyag rdor nor bur 'gro don ched du tshar gsum/tshe dbang brgya rtsa/byang gter gyi chos 'a kha shas/ma gcig lab sgron gyi gcod lung dang /rje gzha mi la'i dusakyi ras pa brgyad kyi nang tshan gcig gi sprul pa yin nam zer ba'i gleng gzhi la brten skabs su babs par dgongs te mi la'i rnam mgur sogs bka' brgyud kyi chos du ma gsan/phar rdzogs pa chen po mkha' 'gro snying tig gi dbang dang 'khrid yig la dka' gnad kyi sar zhib bshad dang bcas pa'i ngo sprod/ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po'i 'pho ba 'jag tshugs ma 'bul ba gnang /gzims khang shar gyi 'du khang gi ldebs bris bcugs pa'i skya bris rnams phyag 98ba tha star zhing mthar gtso bo rnams kyi spyan 'byed kyang mdzad/chos khri'i mgon khang du phyag bzhi pa'i 'bur sku mi tshad tsam bzhengs pa'i gzungs bzhugs rab gnas gnang /kong po rdzogs chen pa gsung snyan bla ma nam mkha' 'jigasamed du grags pas lha 'bras mo gshong gi gnas sgo phye nas 'od 'bar lha ri rdo rje'i phug tu thog mar lung bstan gyis dbu brnyes nas rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi zab chos byung ba rnams gung thang du gdan drangs/lung bstan du/byang sems 'gro 'dul mthu stobs bdag ces sogs kyis cho seb dag tu ngos bzung ste rtsa dbang tshe dbang chos skor rags rim gyi lung /shar dung mdzod dkar po nas byon pa'i rdzogs pa chen po ka dag rang byung rang shar/dbus snying mdzod smug po'i lhun grub dgongs pa zang thal gyi dbang lung nyams 'khrid shin tu rgyas pa/spyod pas bogs 'byin pa phag mo zab rgya'i dbang lung 'khrid/rlung 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa/sangs rgyas gling pa'i thugs rje chen po lugasagasum gyi nang tshan phyi rgyal po lugs kyi skor sogs zab chos mang du gsan/nyin zhig rje nyid ma phebs par rin po che kong pos gtsos pa rnams kyiX gung thang mchod khang du zhakhrul 'khor mdzad pa'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyesgang la dbu ru phyogs kyi bla chen zhig glo bur du byon pas khong dpon slob 'bros dgos pa dang rdzogs chen pa'i phyag la a rang byon gyi ri mo yod pa'ang zhag gsum gyi bar mgo mjug ldog /rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa sogs gter kha gsar rnying gi lung bstan gyis zin pa zhig tu thugs nges kyi zhag gsum gyi bar gung thang mchod khang rtser gcod dmigs mdzad pas ngan rtags de rnams bzlog song (99na)zhes rje bla ma'i snyan du gsol/ rin po che rdzogs chen par pad+ma gling pa'i chos skor kha shas/ rgyal po bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ dri med bshags rgyud/ nā ga raka /ki gang nag po/ smyung gnas kyi phyag len sogs bzhed chos du ma 'bul ba mdzad/ rin po che rdzogs chen pa'i mnal lam du 'brug pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal myur du gshegs pa'i rtags dang / rje bla mar yang de mtshungs byang pa dpon slob phan tshun zhib mol gyi gsung gleng dang thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/dpon slob gnyis chabs cig par rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi 'chi med tshe'i ril sgrub mdzad/tshags gur du mgron gnyer kun dga' blo gros kyis gdan drangs te tshe dbang zhus/ g.yog rnams kyi sar bla ma 'di 'gangs chen po zhig 'dug kyang sgrub pa ba kun bzang rnam rgyal la chos zhus pa de byabs chen po ma byung zer/ 'di nas bzung lo lo bzhin gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur ba'i sbyin bdag gi mthil du gyur/slob dpon chen pos rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas spyan drangs te gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā rar gnang ba sde pa gtsang pa gnyags kyi brgyud pa yin khul gyis zhal ngo na rim gyi sku srung yin pa'i snyan pa glang phu nas sogs kyis brjod pa dang / la la gnubs kyi sngags 'chang nag por ro zan gyi thugs dam rten yin zer ba stod ling dkar la smad lcags las grub pa'i mda' gang tsam bde gzar gyi lo chos sde gsar pa'i rbab yol byas pa'i che ba dang bcas mchod yon nas gnang ba'i gtan tshigs rgyab gnon len pa'i ster bya la mgron gnyer kun blos rje bla ma brgyud 'bras spungs su byung ba phur gshog la gzong gis brkos pa'i rgyal sras (99bsgo gon gyi thugs dam rten du bzhengs zer ba snang bas rgya — 146

zur r+pā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ (tanagar rdo rje gdan nas phebs pa sogs ni dgongs pa nges par zhu dgos su 'dug/gang ltar rgyab gnon 'gangs che ba'i ris kyang sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi snyan gseng gi ut+pal ma phye bar byas cho go gi med gshis gsung gleng byung bar rgyab gnon gnang chog phur gog 'di 'dra phyag ro dgag pa las mi yong gsung ba thugs kyang bden par 'dug pas phyir phul ba tshag gur du'ang lag ro zhig dgog gi yod tshod nas rje bla ma'i phyag tu phul/se dung sku skyes thang stong rgyal po'i phyag 'phreng yin zer ba'i 'phreng rdog gcig dang khams phyogs su glang po che'i so la sgro btags nas byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi tshems yin zer ba mang po yong gin yod 'dug pa de 'dra zhig kyang phul/gung thang mchod khang thub chen gdan sa'i mched zlar song ba'i phyi rgya che la nang du mchod pa dkon gshis ltad mo la khrom che ba re lo star gyis 'dus na de thog tu dge bskul gyi mar me'i rgyun 'phel bar dgongs pa'i tshes bcu'i 'chams 'dzugs pa gnang rtsis kyis o rgyan yab yum gsum/sang rdor gnyis/mkha' 'gro sde lnga/gsung sprul phyogs kyi gri ging spre'u'i zlos gar bcas 'dzugs pa gnang /lo rting ma nas sdo pas phod ka bcu tsam gyi gnang sbyin dang yang dgon nas zhal brnyan g.yar ba'i tshes bcu'i gar 'chams gung thang pa'i gra pa rnams kyis bslabs nas brgyab/zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po'i mchod pa la tshang mas khur blangs dgosagras nas sa dge'i gras su 'os kyis las pa lo bcu gsum gyi bar tsam sgrig pa gnang ba'i deng sang yang dge ba rgyun 00na togs su yod/dbyar 'bras spungs su zla ba gnyis tsam stan chags dusa'akhor dang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs lo snga ma nam dus grang gshis zhu ma thub pa'i dbang lung man ngag tsho dang dug dbang tshar gsum/byang gter gyi rdzogs pa chen po ka dag lhun grub yongs su rdzogasapa gnang ba'i nyams 'khrid gnad du bsnun drags pas rgyun 'di ga skyong rgyu byung na yar sangs rgyas la re ba dang mar ngan song la 'jigs pa gnyis ka mi dgos pa 'dug snyam pa'i brod kha tsam byung rung /chos bsod med pa'i ris 'di yong la khad tshod la mi the ba'i dpe'i nyams kyis rgyun skyong rgyu ma byung /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)sngar mkha' 'gro snying tig dang klong gsal snying tig zhus pa'i phan yon gyis da lam ngo 'phrod pa'ang sla ba tsam snang / phag mo zab brgya'i skor yang gzhan lus thabs ldan gcig pu ma gtogs nyams 'og tu chud nges stsal/ rang blo brtson gnyis ka zhan drags pa'i skyon ma gtogs sangs rgyas lag bcangs su gtod pa'i 'dren pa 'di las lhag pa gzhan nas 'tshol mi dgos par nges pa'i phu thag chod/ dag snang rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi dbang lung yang tshang bar stsal/ nged gong gi lung lci ba'i pho brang du 'degasapa'i sngon 'gror chos 'khor rgyal du 'gro rtsis kyis lha sa nas thon pa'i nyin rje nyid tshal gung gi bla ma rnams kyi sdebs la bsu skyel gnang bar phebs/ blo khang gsar du gung gi dro'i sar rje nyid kyi gzigs snang dang rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi lung bstan skor la brten pa'i gsung gleng zhib rgyas gnang /gung thang du nub cig mnal lam na bud med dar gyi na bza' gsal ba zhig gis khyed rang la stod dmar po 'brungs (100ba)dus gter nas spyan drangs pa'i dung de mtsho smad mkhan po'i skye bas/ster ba 'dug zer ba sang nyin gling stod chos rje blo bzang rgya mtshos dam pa dmar po'i gter ma'i dung 'di bdag la gnas byang pas sbyin byung ba 'bul du btang yod tshul gyi zhu shog 'byor pa ni dpon slob gnyis spu'i che bar mngon/ bkra shis 'brug rgyal du khrom gtos che bar tshe dbang gnang / dgon pa de ga'i srang nang pa'i spyil bur rdo rje gsum mi 'da' ba'i bcad rgya shin tu dam pa mdzad pa grol bstun rdo rje brag tu phebs/ gzhi byas nang ma gshin par mthun sbyor pa chen po'i klong du ro gcig par gyur pa mchog sprul sku na phra ba dang bcas sngags 'chang ngag dbang phun tshogs kyis rje bla ma'i phyag g.yog zhus nas sde tshan so sor bzhugs pa'i bka' drin mdzad/ sde pa rnam sras gling pas gzhis skar bsnyen bkur nas klungs bskor te gu ru jo tshe'i gter gnas bod kyi ri bo rtse lnga'am zangs g.yag brag gi gnas mjal gnang / brag la bka' 'gyur gter du bzhugs pa sogs dkon gnyer la rgyus med pa'i gsung bshad la dad nas rjes su mjal bar 'ongs / nged lho kha nas 'khor te 'bras spungs su slebs bstun ngos phrad la phebs/ yar lam grong smad du nang so tshe dpal ba rigs drug gnas 'dren — 148

zur mu thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanadang sde ba 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i ma la tshe dbang stsal/bde chen du sne'u sdong rtse nas zhabs drung lcam phabs pa'i sna 101na lto me la gdan drangs pa bzhin gegs sel sku rim gyi rim pa mang du gnang /chu 'brug zla ba gnyis par rgya nag tu 'degasagadong gi mi tshogs tshes par brten ha cang gi 'gol rgyu med rung rje bla mas 'bras spungs su rgyang tsam bzhugs de dus lcags zam sprul sku kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug phebs par mnga' risarigs 'dzin chen pos 'bras gzhong lha ri rin cen snying phug nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skor dang /o rgyan chen pos rigs 'dzin rje la dag snang du stsal ba'i rlungs sbyor tshe sgrub gnyis gsan nas nged rang la gnang ba ni rgya nag tu tshe la bar chad med par gegs med du 'khor ba'i rten 'brel lhun grub tu 'grig/thugs dam brtag pa dang spyan ltas tshang mar rgya nag tu 'gor gzhi che ba mi yong ba'i phebs sgo byung ba ltar de bar dgongs 'dus sogs chos bka' mang tsam gsan dgos pa'i snyan 'debs dang rkyen sel gyi rjes gnang 'ga' zhig zhus/rje bla mar brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'i rten 'byung bsgrigs/'phral yun gyi bslab bya sogs gsung gleng zhib par gnang /lam gyi gegs sel la po ta la'i zil gnon lcog nas khro rol rgyas pa zhig mdzad rjesatshal gung byings dang sbrags nas dga' ldan pho brang du skor tsam phebs pa'i zhag gnyis bzhugs/khyab bdag gnas gsar ba chen po nged dang phrad par phebs zhor gung thang du zla ba phyed gnyis lhag tsam stan chags par bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i 'khrid yig za ma tog la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtses kha 'byed lhan thabs sbyar ba'i rim lnga'i dmar 'khrid/paṇa chen shākya 01ba tha nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog dkar po'i nyams 'khrid/rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi thugs kyi nying khu 'dam dpal dmar po lha lnga'i dbang dang spros med kyi nyams 'khrid/rwa chen gyi sgrub dkyil la 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i lhan thabs sbyar ba'i rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang /me shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro stan brgyud kyi 'khrid rwa chen shes rab rgyal mtshan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyegyi dkar chag dang der ma 'dus pa sogs rwa pod yongs grags dang shin tu zab pa dpal 'dzin pod chung / mchog sprul nyi zla 'od zer gyis chu bo ri nas gdan drangs pa'i bla ma sku gsum gyi nyams 'khrid/gtsug tor dri med lha lnga'i dbang / bir srung nang ma/ rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing /jo bo'i chos 'byung brgya rtsa/ gsar ma rgyud 'bum nas po ti kha shas rnams kyi ljags lung gsan/dpon slob gnyis dar dge slong bsod nams rgya mtshos bsnyen bkur gdan drangs pa'i phebs lam du lug gu nag po zhig gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bas dug dbang zhig zhu dgos yod gsungs lan du rje bla mas 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi sha zhig dgos kyang mi rnyed pa 'dra gnang ba'i sang nyin mes ston khro rgyal dpal mgon gyis gnas mo dung dkar la sngags rgyag par phyin skabs lam du khang sang gi zha/ga gu de 'phags 'phags 'ga' zhig byas nas shi ba mthong bas gnas mor blangs te dpon slob gnyis la gnas tshul dang bcas phul bas phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bdog pa'i skyes dbul nas lug gu'i ched du bzang spyod smon lam dang ljags bsngo gnang / rje bka' 'gyur bas thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol (102na)gyi cho ga dang rje bla mas zhi khro'i bkongs mdzad cing sha de la brten nas byang gter du dug dbang kyang 'phrad 'bul gyi bzhed pa bkang /gling stod zhabs drung gi gsang phur gdan drangs 'du khang chen mor dgram rgya'i ras yol gyi rten gal che bar phyag bris dang gzhan ma rnams la bslab ston mdzad/ nged rgya nag nas ma 'khor bar sde pas zil gnon lcog tu rje nyid bzhugs gdan 'jags pa'i bstan pa spyi sgos kyi sku rim gang dgos kyi thugs dam brtag pa zhal bkod sku ngos kyi gnang dgos rnams mthud ma shor ba dgos pa'i bslab ston bzhin phal cher bzhugs/ rin po che dar rgyas chos sdings par bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa po ti dgu'i dbang lung / pad gling pa'i bka' brgyad thugs kyi me long / nag po skor gsum sogs pad ma gling pa'i gter chos sngar ma byung ba mang du gsan zhing phar chos rgyal byang pa'i gter gsar ga rma gu salas 'brel rtsal gyi gnod sbyin dmar nag /lha chen gyis mtshon pa'i bzhed chos du ma stsal/ 150

zur r+sā thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ tanagung thang dkar me'i dus khrom dbang dang yar 'brog brag la bla mar zhang gi bka' 'bum bka' rgya ma gnang bar gung thang du rgyang tsam bzhugs/ slar po ta la'i zil gnon lcog nas khro bo rol ba dang sgrol ma'i mdos sogs spyi sgos kyi rim gro mang du mdzad/ rin po che rdzogs chen pa gtso bor dag snang lung bstan du/ ltar snang za zi blo brid rjes gong zhing / /mi wo 'dod pa'i rkyen khar btang srid na/ /lnga bcu rtsa drug tshe yi tshad nyid do/ /zhes chos skor rnams gol du spel drags na nga drug mi bsgral bar bshad pa dang 'phral rkyen 'bras ljongs su mnga' bdag stag (102bskom pa phyogs nas zas ga drangs pa'i snyan nad chud pa dang spo bo bdud 'dul rdo rje zer ba'i gter chos gang slebs su bkra mi shis pa re yong gi yod snang bas khams nas khong pa'i slob ma zhig chos skyel du btang ba lung gsan pa'i sgang la pad+ma dra ba bkod pa'i zhing du gshegs par mchod 'bul rgyas par mdzad/ rin po ches zhal chems bzhag pa'i don bzhin gos mo ljongs su bum gter skyel ba dang zhu don 'dra yod 'dug bas mtshams sbyor gyi rogs ram gnang /brag dkar bkra shis steng du bka' 'gyur gdan 'dren dgos skor lho phyogs kyi dus gzings dang bcas sde pa'i dgongs par ma babs pas phyag thog tu ma khel/ lha btsun mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gis zhal chems mang du bzhag nas gshegs song ba'i gnas tshul gla ba sgang pa yong skabs gnang 'dug /gung thang du dpal ri sprul sku la rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi bka' srung gi dbang dang sngon ma'i 'phro mus kyi lung rnams tshang bar gsan zhing phar yang chos bka' ci rigs stsal/ nged kyi mtsho kha nas sto khri ya tha'i ji bod la brdzangs skabs zhu 'phrin dngul gyi rten dang bcas pa'i brtan bzhugs slar bka' chos gsan dgos kyi tho sogs phul ba ltar bla ma'i rtsad gcod kyi thugs rtsisamadzad rung / lo phyi ma'i dpyid /lho 'brug bas mon bum thang la gsang dmag btang bas mtshone chu dang lha'i dbe bzhin dgra gnon glang chen sna bsgyur/ ga'u chu bskyur so gos jus rim gnang dgos mngasapa'i thugs g.yeng gis rim 'gyangs su lus/ sog yul nas rgyal khang rtse sprul sku yum sras dang gnyug —131—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)mar gnas pa'i tsha ba sku skye can byang ris pa'i bla ma che kha la (103na〉〈 so'i bzhed pa dang bstun pa'i dbang chos mang du gsungs shing byin rten gyi rim pas thugs 'dod bskangs/ gser dngul gos dar sogs kyi 'bul ba tshan po che bstab/ gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po sku cung zad sreb par gdon 'grol gyi cho gas gzhi med du dwangs/ a mdo nas zhing skyong paṇ+ḍita dge logs kyis 'ongs nas zang zing gi bdog pa'i phyag rten ring du brkyang zhing 'dod chos ci ris zhus/chu sbrul gsar nas dpal phag mo gru pa mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang mchod yon dang mjal 'dzom la phebs pa bzhugs mtsher du mjal bar byon pas bzhugs khri'i steng nas bzheng ba sogs bkur bzos bla na med pa gnang / bstan pa spyi sgos kyi sku rim ci 'dra mdzad kyin yod kyi dri mol dang dgyes zhal lhug par bstan me tog mchod pa'i dus 'grem pa'i gos sku ha cang hrul drags par gso ran gyi grubs yul la dgongs pa zhu ba mdzad pas sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyis sman bla'i gos sku rnying pa las chung tsam zhig gnang ba zhig gsos par sbyor 'jags mdzad/ lhun grub pho brang par gdung brgyud grul thub med par sku skye'i sgrib shing la brten skabs mtsho sna dga' ldan rtse phyogs nas rgyal po'i chad pa chen po yong ba'i thabs mkhas kyis dril bsgrags te mon phyogs su bskrad nas dgon pa bdag gir bzung ba'i rnying ma rgyud 'bum rnams gong dkar dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pa'i spyi rdzas dang dmangs ma rnams po ta lar drangs nas rje bla mas dbye g.yang mdzad par (103ba〉na ter ston yab sras kyi phyag dpe 'gangs can rnams gong pa'i phal cher 'dam snyigs cha khang ma shas che bas dgongs 'dus po ti dgu pa zhig ma gtogs tshang ba'i ris dkon pa 'dug gsung / dwags yul chab tshan la phebs thog rgyal smad bla mas sa 'brel zhu ba dang gzims gur la skor ba brgya rtsa sogs gting nas mos pa'i rnam 'gyur byas/ slar po ta lar phebs nas khro rol slang dgu mas gtsos bstan pa spyi sgos kyi sku rim du ma gnang / nub cig mnal lam du sde pa bsod nams rab brtan klu sbug tu sku mtshams la bzhugs pa zhig byung ba sa bdag gi 152

zur mu thams go ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanaganod pa yod par dgongs te klu'i gtan sdom dang dum gter gyis mtshon pa'i bcos ka du ma mdzad/mi ring bar 'bras spungs gser thog gi phyag las dus sde pa'i zhabs glo bur du skrangs pa'i nyen dmigs che bar myur du dwangs pa bcos sngon chug nas gnang ba'i phan yon du mchis/gzhis ka rtse'i tshes bcu'i 'bag rnams gung thang dkar me'i 'chams la dgos tshul zhu ba mdzad pa rgyu rkyen lhun grub kyis dgyes bzhin du gnang /dkar me bskul dbang dang 'brom gzhung gi tshes bcu ba rnams la bla ma zhi ba'i dbang rgyas pa zhig mdzad/lo snga ma sad skyon che ba byung ba 'di lo sde pas bslab ston phebs pa ltar sad srung sprin gyi go cha'i phyag len bzhin thugs khur bzhes pas lo tog mod la 'byol ba'i legs tshogs su gyur/nged rgya nag nas 'khor ba'i smin drug zla ba'i tshes bcu drug gi nyin thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor du rje nyid bsu bar phebs pa dang gsol ba'i ring gsung gleng gi 104naris zhib rgyas dang /'brom stod du 'byor skabs tshal gung pa byings dang lhan cig par yang zhabasazung 'khor lo'i ri mo phyogs der mdzo par bkod/zing pa ba gra pa bco lngas gung thang du zhi khro gas phan 'od kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga stong rtsa zhig 'dzugs pa mdzad/nged phrad par byon pa'i phyogs 'dus kyi khrod nas zhal 'dris yod pa'i bla ma mang dag cig mjal ka gsung chos zhu bar 'byor pas thugs g.yeng che tsam byung zhing /khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po gos spungs su phebs pa'i phyir lam gung thang du zhug shas dpon slob gdan 'dzom nas bka' chos gsan res kha yar gnang ngo //mkhan slob chos gsum zhal lung mngar po'i ro//bye ba phrag brgya myangs pas ma tshim par//deng dus btungs pa'i bag chags slad ma'i tshe//yang yang sad pa'i skyes rabs pha mtha' ring //rgyal khams rlung la bskur nus 'phung byed las//ldebargyad rba klong 'khrug pa 'khor lo'i rtse//lho 'brug gdung brgyud blon 'bangs ming grangs can//phal cher ring min mi rtag lam la bkod//sbas yul kun rtse 'bras mo'i gzhong gling du//nam mkha'i rnal 'byor bkod smyon he ru gar//bka' babasarigs 'dzin srog sgrub chos bdag gi/gtso por mgon khyod mnga' gsol me tog gtor//sngon dus

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherang gter skal bar rnyed pa'i dung / /bla sman shākya dbang phyug rnam sprul gyis/ /slar yang dbul ba'i lung bstan mngon sum pa/ /rmi lam tshul du ston pa'i rgyu de ci/ /rams tshos rgyas 'dus (104ba)seng phrug mdzes pa'i 'phrul/ /gzhan 'drid ma yin zab gter g.yu ral can/ /legs ldan thugs bcud bdud rtsi rab 'khyil bas/ /'gyur med srog gi ka ba deng 'dir tshugs/ /bde gshegs kun tshang che mchog he ru rka'i/ /bdun brgya nyi shu'i 'khor lo rang sde'i tshogs/ /nyer chud bzlog bsad mtshon char bdud sde la/ /phab 'di drag sngags bdag po gnubs chen bzhin/ /gangs can bstan srid dpal mo'i srog gi shing / /mi dbang gnyan rgod byad kyi zhags rgya las/ /bkrol 'di mchims phu'i gnas su pad+ma 'byung / /'jam dpal klu yi srin po'i rjes su 'gro/ /shing rta zla ba dang por dga' ldan pho brang du phebs zla ba gsum tsam gyi bar stan chags kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rang mtshang rjen par ston pa 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i spros pa med ba'i zab 'khrid rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung rgyun thun mong ma yin pa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi drod rlangs ma yal ba rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi nyams 'khrid/ rwa pod/ bla ma dgongs 'dus po ti dgu/ rigs 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i gter kha sogs zab chos mang du zhus/ skrangs 'bur gyi glo bur du zhabs bsnyan nas 'phrod bsnyen la gung thang du phebs pa'i tshe yid 'gro ba'i mgon po zhal gzigs bka' rgya'i dbang gi dus ngar sbug gi klu mo'i gtor ma chad pas lan klu gtor btang na legs gsung ba bzhin mdzad pas gsos sman gyi 'phrod bsten las ngo gso che ba byung / nged bcad rgya dam po zhig yod pa'i khog nas zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten (10ldan〉khyung smon lam tshigs bcad dang bcas pa phul/ sgags sngags lcog gnyis nang ma 'cham par dge slong yid bzhin zer bas gung thang du 'ongs nas sde par snyan 'bul gyi sne sbyor zhus par phan tshun gnyis skar dge bshad sdig grol gyis dbyen bzlums nas badz+ra mu las rnam par grol ba'i gar bstan la phan pa gnang ba ni sngags rnying ma ba'i phyag len gyi gsos su gyur/ bdun gsum gyi bar bsnyen sgrub kyi sku mtshams shin — 154

zur wo thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)tu dam pa gnang / nub gcig mnal lam du mi dkar po ā tsarla'i rnam pa can zhig gis lam sna byasate nub phyogs su zhal bstan ri mthon po zhig la 'dzegs nas thegs pas 'phang ring po brgyud pa'i mthar gnam sgo 'dug pa phye nas nang du byon/ ri khrod kha lho smad du blta ba phyi nas chom rkun sogs kyi 'jigs pa med pa'i shin tu btsan pa nang yangs shing rtsi shing nags tshal me tog 'bras bu can sogs bde ba can gyi zhing bkod lta bu'i shin tu spro ba khang pa rnams kyang rgya khang 'dra rung ba'i gser thog g.yu thog yod pa/ snang bar ban+de dang skye bo rnal 'byor pa sogs ri khrod pa yin khul de rnams sngar nas thugs 'dris yod rgyu ba la 'phral du 'di yin rang gi nges 'dzin mi thub pa zhig 'dug par thugasadagongs la gnas 'di 'dra las skyid pa nga mi rnyed pas tshe mtshams byed dgos dgongs thugs thag bcad pa'i ngang la mnal sad byung gsung ba de nas lo gsum tsam gyi thog sku'i bkod pa bsdus nasapad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su re zhig gi bar bzhugs pa'i rtags su mngon/dar rgyas chos sdings nas rigs 'dzin chen po 'phrin las lhun grub kyis bka' brgyad bder gshegs 'dus pa yongs rdzogs kyi lung rgyun dam nyams 'dres khyer gyi bslad (105ba)pa ma zhugs pa'i khungs btsun pa e nas rigs 'dzin cho ge dbang kun bzang la gsan te gung thang du phebs zla shas bzhugs par bka' brgyad bde 'dus/ 'jam dpal rdzogs chen sogs mtha' yas pa gsan/rin po che chos sdings pa dang grub chen rkarma gsang sngags gnyis la rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi dbang lung gsan zhing grub chen gsang sngags par rdzogs pa chen bo sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi lung sogasachos bka' ci ris gas/ gar par dbyar mjal la phebs pa'i nub 'od gsal du jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku mdun du bla ma bla gos thar song bzhes pa'i dbu dkar ba zhig la mi mang pos gus 'dud byed 'dug pa su yin dri ba gnang bar bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya 'chad ka ba yin zer/des rje nyid la phyag mdzad pa byung ba sang nyin gsang phu rnam rgyal gser bkang pa'i drung chen dkon cog dpal 'byor gung thang du byon byung ba dpon slob gnyis thugs nang dag cing chos bka' gsan —153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6peres mdzad/'jam dbyangs bla ma dkon cog chos 'phel dag zhing du gshegs rjes drung chen 'di las mkhas btsun bzang ba zhig gsang sne'u thog phyogs su ma byung bar ma zad khyad par rdzogs pa chen po dang gsung ngag lam 'bras gnyis ka la phul du phyin zhing byang chub kyi sems la mnga' 'byor bas 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo rje'i rnam sprul du the mi tshom par gnang / nged gtsang nas 'khor ba dang bstun zhag shas rje nyid 'bras spungs su bzhugs pa'i gzhis ka shar lags a gur gyi zhing bkod kha yar bris pa'i zhal bkod dang shog dpe gnang / byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar 'bri dgos tshul phebs pa bzhin nyer bsdogs byas/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang du rje bla ma 'bras spungs su gdan drangs dgongs 'dus kyi dbang chen dbang phran gyis gtsos pa'i chos bka' mang du (106na)zhus/ lho brag smra bo lcog nas mnga' bdag bstan 'dzin chos dbang la srid pa'i gter khyim gyi ljags lung stsal zhing phar yang chos 'brel gsan/zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po sku gshegs pa'i lo gcig gi bar gdung nang bzhugs byed par shar ba ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang klu'i rgyal po'i pho brang gi steng du yod pa phyogs de klu sa che gshis zhal ngo phyi ma rnams la skyon mi 'jug pa'i slad du phyogs bzhir 'khor lo sbyor ba sogs gegs sel gyi bcos thabs mang du gnang / lo snga ma mchod yon rtser rgyas gzhis ka rin spungs su byon dus bla ma bon lung pa gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis mjal ka ma zhus par rdzong dpon dwags po bkra shis kyis gtsang po lho kha'i bsod snyoms bkag pa sogs drag shul gyi cho ga ci ris byung bar shing lug khong pa gung thang du rje bla ma ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po'i drung du byon/ gong ra lo chen gyis chos log tu ngos 'dzin pa'i ga rma gu ru rnam dag tu song nas srog gtad dang lung rdzogs par zhus/ don gyi gtso bo sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi phyag 'bul grub pa'i sne sbyor gnang / phag mo bka' brgyud chos sdings pa'i sku skyes gtsos phyogs 'dus mang bar 'dod chos — 156

zur byu thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ tanakyis re ba bkang /nub gcig mnal lam du 'bri gung nas gdan 'dren la 'ongs zer ba'i bu mo 'ga' zhig byung ba mi legs par dgongs te de la dmigs pa'i sku mtshams gnang rung mtshan lam du thog 'bab pa sogs 'tshub lhongs che ba las bzang ltas cher ma shar bas gshin rje khro chu'i bzlog dang gzhis ka shar nas sbyin bdag byas pa'i mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog gi brtan bzhugs phul/kho bosamo rtsis sogs zhus par shar ba'i sku rim gyi ris phal mo che dang bying pa sngags rams pa blo bzang don grub kyis rdo rje slob dpon byas pa'i gra tshang 06bgi gra pa grangs bcad kyis gung thang du 'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i srung bzlog sreg mnan dang bcas bsgrubs pas bstan 'gro'i mgon du lham mer bzhugs pa'i skal bzang du gyur/zla ba gsum pa'i nang du khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po 'bras spungs su phebs pa'i phar lam gung thang du zhag shas dpon slob gdan 'dzom pa'i rkyen sel gyi bka' chos gsan lan mdzad/lho brag nas rin po che gsung sprul phebs par pad gling pa'i drag dmar gyi dbang sogs snga 'gyur gyi chos bka' mang du gsan zhing phar yang de mtshungs 'bul ba gnang /rje bla ma'i sku rim du rin po che gsung sprul gyis drag dmar gyi gtor bzlog mdzad/snon chos rje 'dzom pa sgang par mchog sprul mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi gsung rgyun 'khrul pa med pa rgyal po lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i nyamasa'akhrid sogs cho ge kha shas gas/snang ba mtha' kyi yas rnam sprul zhang 'gro ba'i mgon po'i dben gnas bya dkar 'brong por phebs/sku 'dra rin po ches gtsos rten rnams la gser chab spyan 'byed snyan shal mchod pa smon lam sogs rgyas pa gnang ba'i nyin nam mkha' dang bya dkar 'brong po'i nyi grib mtshams gnyis kar 'ja' tshon dang nyi ma'ang 'ja' spungs kyis bskongs par mes kyi sngagasa'achang khro rgyal dpal mgon gyis ltas bzang po byung ba ngo mtshar che lags zhus par sngon gyi smon lam gyi shugs yin de bas lha mo khang yin snyam pa zhig tu bdag la zhang gis rtsa ba'i bla ma drug gi sgrub thabs gsung yod/mkhas btsun spel phug pa zhesaXr skyes dus gtsang 'o yug tu bsdad pa zhig kyang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo' dran gsungs/ spyil bu brag thog gi bla mas gdan drangs nas bsnyen bkur/ dbyar 'bras spungs su stan chags bka' brgyad bder gshegs 'dus pa po ti dgu dang dpag bsam 'khri shing sogs bka' chos (107na〉pang du stsal/de dus dwags lha sgam po'i sprul skus khra mo brag nas gter bton khul la zhib tu dpyad na shog ser rnams phar sbas nas med tshul gyis rab rib mdzad nas shog ser gcig lus 'dug ces ston pa mdzad byung ba rje bla mar spyan 'bebs zhus pa rgyab mdun gnyis gar zhib tu gzigs nas shel brag tu mchog grub rgyal po'i don la sbas tshul 'dug pas o rgyan gling pa'i shog ser rnying pa yin 'dra zhes bzhad/ rme ru ba rnams lha ldan sde'i phyi rol tu 'pho ba dang bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i rten bzhengs kyi sku rnams bzhugs gnas shig dgos pa nyis 'dom gyis gnas khang gsar du rtsig pa'i sa 'dul la yar lam zhabs kyis bcags nas lto 'phye'i thig mdzad/ rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin mchog gi sprul sku gung thang du phebs par byang gter rdzogs chen ka dag lhun grub kyi dbang lung nyams 'khrid chos kyi bdag por dgongs nas smin rgyas su stsal ba'i sngon 'gror rdzogs chen bka' gnyan pa'i sku tshe'i gegs sel la rig 'dzin sprul sku rin po ches khyab bdag bla ma dam par brtan bzhugs bzabs rgyas dang tshe dbang zhig 'bul ba gnang zhing / skabs shig bla brang gi 'kha ring ba rnams la tshe dbang dgos tshul rje bla ma'i bka' phebs ltar sprul sku rin po ches chos khri'i rab gsal du dbang sgrub mdzad pa zin mtshams rje bla ma'ang 'bul chas dang bcas phebs par bzhugs stan nges par dgos gsungs pa la yang ma gsan par dbang gral du bzhugs pa sogs rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang por mi phyed pa'i thugs dad gcam bu tsam ma yin pa'i nang rtags phyir shar gnang /rje bla ma'i sku rim la sprul sku rin po ches 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi zor las drag po'i chas su zhugs nas gnang ba rigs 'dzin yol mo ba'i rnam thar du/ pad gnubs brgyud pa'i (107ba'i sa stobs drag po'i mtshon/ /rim gyis bstar ba kho bo'i lag char lon/ /mi bzad drag —158

zur 'a thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)rtsal 'bar ba'i gnam lcags thog /mthu chen dmar gyi gtor ma'i 'gran zlar song / /zhes byin chags po zhig ma rtag gags rdo rje slob dpon gyis sbug chol dkrol ba dang me dar dbyug dbyug sogs a ce lha mo mdzad srol ni mi snang / lho nas zhang gi lugs 'dzin ka leb dgon pa ba yin zer ba'i bla ma dpon g.yog gsum 'ongs par bka' 'bum bka' rgya'i dbang lung dang byin rlabs rten sogs stsal ba de tsho lho 'brug gi sa nyal ma bla chen stag tshas rje sa skya pa chen po bkrong bar khams pa rdor rgyal btang ba'i lo rgyus bzhin/ dad rten 'brug phyogs kyi srung ba dang zag rdzas byas tshod du 'dug pas rnying ma bzhal ngo tsho gsol stogs la rgyas bsdus gnang dgos pa'i brda chos su 'dug /me sprel lo byang phyogs sa'i tshangs pa dga' ldan pa thog rgod rnam rgyal gyis bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la shog gsung ba bzhin nged kyis bde chen rtser phyin pa'i yar lam mar lam tsho tshal gung gi bla ma rnam pa tsho bsu bar byon pa'i sdebs su rje nyid phebs shing phyir lam chos khrid gung gi dre'i gzhi len bzabs rgyas dang / rigs 'dzin chen po gzhon nu don grub kyi phyag bris ma'i bka' brgyad bde 'dus lha bdun brgya nyer lnga'i zhal thang gra tshar ster sbyin mdzad/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par bsnyen bkur dang bkras btags kyi 'gyed gnang / dar rgyas chos sdings kyi gdung brgyud bgres pa 'bras spungs su gtsug phud 'bul bar phebs zhor yar lam gung thang du phebs/chos rje ma chen gyis gnang ba mi 'gab tshul zhus pa la ma gsan par rje bla mas sku na phra mo de la bzheng ba phyag lan btsal ba be+e ro'i rnam sprul chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa yin par mngon mkhyen du shar bar snang zhing rten 'brel la dgongs nas (108na rko bu zhwa sogs kyi skyes gnang / yab srasaganyis lhan cig pas bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang lung dang tho ling gi gza' mon ba'i skor rdzogs par gsan/dbyar smad 'bras spungs su phebs gru gu'i sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis la chos rgyal byang pa'i gter gsar ma rgyud snying po don gsum gyi skor gsan zhing de 'phral nged kyis kyang zhus/ gra tshang —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losegi gra pa 'ga' zhig la sngags ris sbyong ba'i gras 'debs pa dang bris dpe sogs kyi bslab ston mdzad/ 'di lo lhor dpung 'jug chen mo'i sgo dod rje bla mas dbyangs 'char mkha' 'gro sde lnga sogs kyi mo'i ris dang gtso bor thugs dam brtag pa tshad mar 'gro khyab mi yong ba'i gsal kha byung song rung sde pa'i dgongs par ma babs gshis gzhan ma gnang thebs dang bral ba'i jus rim du sngar btsugs pa'i rlung dmar tshur blangs nas kha gso ba dang dregs pa nyi shu gsar du 'dzugs pa'i phyag g.yog gzhig ka shar a gur dang ngag dbang 'phrin las gnyis kyis byas nas phag rir sngar bzhin 'dzugs pa gnang / sngags pa rnams kyis long dus sku rim la bka' brgyad kyi thang ka med na bag grang tshul zhus pa ltar snang gsal gyi thang rnying gra tshar 'bri gung na yod pa g.yar po zhus te skya ris rnams phyag bstar ma tshon mdangs bcad spyan 'byed bla ma dga' rab kyis gtsos pa lnga tsam gyis byas/mkha' klong yangs pa'i bka' brgyad 'bru 'grel gyi steng nas zhu dag mdzad pa rta mgrin dang ma mo'i lha thang rnying la chad pa 'dra thon pa'i ma las bu rgyas pa legs par grub/ de yang bka' phyi ma gsum la 'jig rten pa'i ming btags kyi dregs pa drag rtsal can mangs pa'i 'tshub lhongs sel byed du zing pa'i dge slong seng ge sgang pas nyin re bzhin bka' brgyad kyi las gzhung bsrangs te sde dpon sum cu'i gsol mchod/ sde dgu'i sger bskangs (108bsgo dang bskangs/ tshogs mchod chag med du btang / rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku dpon slob kyis rang byung rang shar gyi las gzhung bsrangs rang lugs rab gnas bse sgrom ma la rje btsun chen po'i don gsal gyi mdzes rgyan sprad de sta gon dngos gzhi sogs sbyor dngos rjes tshang gi tshul du dam ye dbyer med du gnang / rten bzhengasal 'gyogs dang legs bya 'bul ba'i sku nye sbyin bdag gra ris rnams la gdang lan gyi dga' ston rgya cher mdzad/ srang nang pa/ dbang ldan gling pa/ gling byang pa/ a bo rdzong dga' rnams kyis bsdus pa'i mkha' 'gro bsu bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul/ mes kyi sngags 'chang khro rgyal dpal mgon gyis gung thang mchod khang rtser tshe dpag hrīḥgacig ma'i sgrub pa byas dus rmi lam du kho rang ras — 160

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ tanadang skya'i gos dang phying zhwa gyon nas rta nag po sga gtad pa zhig khrid rgya nag yin khul gyi grong khyer chen po'i sgo 'gram na 'dug pa nang nas dar gyi gos gon pa'i mi bag dron zhig yongs rta de la zhen kho rang gis khrid pa byung ba gnyid sad nas kyang mig sngar lam lam shar bas skyo shas kyis mchi ma mi thub pa byung ba gang yin dri ba zhus lan du rje nyid chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus kyi zhang blon sna chen por gyur pa'i tshe a khu rta rdzi yin pa da lam mtshams byas bas sdig pa srab tu song nas skye ba dran pa yin gsungs/ stod smad kyi sngags pa dang sbyin bdag gra ris sogs bsdus pa'i grib sel bsu bzlog dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs rgyas par phul/ 'bras spungs su gang ci'i bslab ston dang gsung gleng la skor tsam phebs pa'i yar lam grong smad du nang so a sug 'das par gnang skyes dang bcas byon/sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gnyis la rkyen sel du tshe dbang dang drag po'i dbang stsal/ rigs 'dzin sprul sku dang grub mchog (109na〉karma gsang sngags la rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ rgyud bstobadun/ gter mgon phyag bzhi pa dang 'bar chung skor gyis gtsos pa'i chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ 'bri gung zhabs drung rin po che chos kyi grags pa 'brasaspungs su nged dang ngos god la phebs pa'i yar lam 'brom stod du rje nyid dang rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku dpon slob lhan cig par mjal bar phebs nas tshe bdag rnon po nang gcod kyi dbang dang /'char kha gnam skas ma'i zor dbang gsan cing / snga sor g.yar po'i thang dpe phyir 'bul gsar bzhengs tsho spyan 'bebs dang phyag nas zhu ba gnang / gung thang du phebs nas sprul sku rin po cher gza' pod sogs bka' chos kyi los dang ne'u chung ri sku skyer phyag rdor dregs 'dul gyi skor stsal/rigs 'dzin sprul sku gnyan tshad kyis sku ltem babs snyi bar drung 'tsho phu lung pas gsos sman dang rje bla mas rgya nag spor thang gi dag rtsis dang bstun pa'i sku rim rgya mi chung ba 'bebs pa/ 'chi blu skyasardzongs gnang yang sku khrus btang ba ma phigs/ lha rje 'brang rgyas pa'ang ri khrod du mtshams la yod pa dang 'grig /mkha' ru srang nang pa 'bod dam zhes gleng gzhi byung 'dug na'ang khong tsho snang rtse ba'i brgyud —161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she'ajin yin zhes sprul pa'i sku'i thugs la mi 'bab cing srang nang pa'ang ma nges pa 'dra byung na sman log btang ba'i khag ngan byed dogs kyis 'phral ka ma 'grig pas/ 'brang rgyas par phu lung pas ci drag gi dri ba btang bar ri lu drug cu'i bar spar nas btang bas phigs yong de nas ma byung na byed thabs med kyi kha dmar btags/ drung 'tsho bas kyang sman bsnan nas phul/ rje bla mas drag dmar gyi bka' dbang mdzad pas sku srog la glags lta ba'i 'byung po 'dzam bu gling na yongs su grags pa de mthar (109ba〉bskrad pa'i mthu sman gyis snyun nad thams cad phyir ded nas zla ba gza' las grol ba ltar rgyal dbang pad+mā ka ra'i bstan srog gi zungs su gyur/lho'i dpung 'jug gi sku rim la mgon po g.yul bzlog gi mdos chen btang / gu ru mtshan brgyad gtso bor gyur pa la rdo rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod yod pa'i thugs dam thang kha gra tshar gyi skya ris phyag bstar ba tshon mdangs kyi phyag g.yog bla ma dga' rab dang legs rgyan pa can gyis byas nas bzhengs/ nub gcig mnal lam du rje nyid kyi phyag phyir sbus srang lha rje blo bzang nor bu sogs tshes bcu ba kha shas dang bcas zangs mdog dpal rir thegs khul gyis pho brang de'i rtsa bar phebs pa na o rgyan chen po yin zer ba'i drang srong gi rnam pa can zhig 'dug par phyag mchod mdzad mur gnas de lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer du song ba'i nang der sman rgyal gcig pu las ma bzhugs shing pho brang gi rtser phebs pa dang nyi ma'ang la thog tu slebs pa zhig byung bas kho bo yun ring sdod mdog ma kha khyed rang tshe gzungs 'bum ther sogs rim gro bzang ba byas na lo shas skyon mi yong tshul gyi phyag tham gnang bas lha sar gdan drangs nas tshe dbang brgya rtsa zhus dus rje nyid kyis o rgyan rin po che yab yum mngon sum du zhal gzigs pa'i mur slob dpon chen po yal ba zhig byung ba/ bka' las bdag la rten 'brel legs rgyu ma byung khyed rang la dmigs pa sprad du tshe dpag med kyi gsal snang legs pa byung song bas lo shas skyon mi yong ba'i khag theg byed gsung ba bzhin de kho na'i thog tu babs/ me bya lha sa ba'i spyi rim gyi khro rol la bar khang du phebs/ mi ring bar la stod nas zur spang ston bde legs — 162

zur wo thams cad ma' pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ 6)rgyal mtshan gyi dbon brgyud rin po che chu mig pa ngag dbang 10na ) phun tshogs la mdzad lnga 'dusapa'i zab gter gyi dbang 'khrid lung ches mang ba gsan zhing /phar rat+na'i gter chos gtso bor gyur pa bzhed sbyar stsal/zla ba lnga pa'i 'gor thugs dam thang kha legs par grub pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad pas mar me 'dzin pa sogs ye shes pa rang bzhin du 'i bzhugs pa ltas ngo mtshar ba byung gra tshang chos rje la 'dod chos kha yar stsal zhing gos dar sogs kyi 'bul ba'ang bzang du bstar/de yang bka' chos gsan pa'i bla ma sngar smos pa las gzhan pa yod shas che'ang ngo 'phrod pa ma byung zhing dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin stsal ba'i slob ma ni/dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi mchog gi sprul sku blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las/bya 'chad ka ba'i rnam sprul gling stod chos rje dkon cog dpal 'byor/gling smad chos rje stag kha ral/gra thang mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal bzang /gos yul skyed tshal mkhan po byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/lha lcam pad+ma gsal gyi rnam sprul gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/yang ldan ma rtse mang zhu lan las/bod khams gangs ri rtse dgu'i ljongs 'dir phubasam yas lho phyogs mtha' 'khob mon kha sa grong khyer rdo mchog can kyang byaḥbrag dmar zam lam can kyang bya gtam shul spar rjes can kyang bya/〉bo lcog po zhes bya ba'i mkha' 'gros byin rlabasaganas de phugasang sngags brgyud 'dzin ral pas lus nub pa srid pa tha ma'i skyes bu mi yi mgonaḥrgyal po mtshan rtags legs pa lnga dang ldan sgyu ma'i skyes bu 10brgyal rigs rnal 'byor pa gsang sngags rgyud sdoganas kyi snying po rnams rig pa brda yi tshul gyi char du 'bebs rgyal ba'i sras mchog mi yi seng ge de lho brag gtam shul smra bo lcog po phum 'ongs gsang sngags bdag por gyur nas ni:sku'i bkod bas 'gro ba ma lus 'dul thugs rje chen po dngos kyis 'gro ba 'dul ba yin nyid kyi gdul byas 'gro ba mthar thug ༷ 'gro don sangs rgyas nyid dang mnyam pa 'byung :

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62) nyang ral gdung rabs bco brgyad yan chad du: sngon tshe rgyal po'i smon lam mthu yod pas: chos bzhin ma byas sangs rgyas thob par 'gyuraḥ byang chub sems dpa'i rigs kyang mang du 'byung : log spyod bdud kyi tshang 'dres la rtog pa: gang zag las lo med pa gcig mi 'byung : snying gi dkyil du chongs la sgrub pa gyis:zhes pa'i gdung rabs bcu drug pa mnga' bdag smra bo lcog chos rje bstan 'dzin chos dbang /bi mā'i rnam sprul khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rdo rje/ brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dbang po kong smyon rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'jigs med/ dran pa nam mkha'i rnam sprul dar rgyas chos sdings pa rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub/ de sras chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ dpal ri sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma 'phrin las/ zur chu mig pa ngag dbang phun tshogs/ sgam spyon sprul sku phyag rdor nor bu/yang dgon spyan snga skal ldan rgya mtsho/ rgyal khang rtse sku skye/ pha bong kha'i gdan sa pa dpal 'byor dar rgyas/ byams chen bla ma blo bzang chos grags/ lam pa bla ma star sdong blo gros lhun grub/ 'dul ba slob (111na〉dpon pa blo gros rnam rgyal/ mkhas grub rkarma gsang sngags/ rigs 'dzin kun bzang dbang po/ bla ma 'dzem pa sgang pa/ sngags 'chang don grub bkra shis/ khams pa bla ma pad+ma blo gros/bzang sdigs sku skye ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma dbyangs can dgyes pa'i lang tsho/ phyag mdzod mnga' bdag da rma/ sman sgom 'brang rgyas pa ngag dbang don grub/ ka thog pa dpal 'bar drung pa/ sbre bon po lung pa/ tre bo se dung sku skye/ khal kha se chen nor mon khan/ o rod gra tshang chos rje/ zhing skyong paṇ+ḍita/gser thog chos rje/ bla ma dge 'dun dar rgyas/ bla ma khro phu ba/ chos rje skyi ston pa gu ru tshe brtan/chos rje rngod pa/ byar gsung snyan sku skye/ sha ra hor sku skye/ bla ma sman chu ba/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi sku skye/ bla ma khams pa spun/ bla ma theg mchog gling pa/ sna bu cho'i/lung pa/ rtsa sgrub sde sku skye/ spyil bu brag thog pa/ 'phan yul rgyal smad bla ma/ sgo mo sku skye/ dar ma snang bla ma bsod nams dpal 'byor/chos rje bla ma/ kong po gnam sgom bla ma/ bla ma sngags rams pa/ bka' brgyud pho brang sku skye/ bla ma — 164

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ yonabrag ra ba/ mdo pa sku skye/ rdzing kha sku skye/ bla ma dga' rab/ sngags 'chang stod grong pa/ bka' brgyud chos sdongs bla ma/ pad+ma gling pa'i gdung brgyud mched/ ka leb bla ma/ bla ma bsod nams lhun grub/bla ma chos dbyings rang grol/ zangs yag brag bla ma/ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho sogs bstan pa zin pa dang chos wel nos pa rags rim tsam brjod kyis mtha' dag gleng bar ga la nus/ gzhan yang bzo rig pa/ sgra snyan ngag /rtsis skar nag sogs(111ba)tha snyad gtsug lag gi slob ma dang 'di phyi bar gsum gyi skyabs gnas zhus pa'i yon bdag bcas pa'i grangs ni ston mtshan dwangs pa'i rgyu skar gyi grangs lta bur mngon/thugs rtsom gsang ba snying po'i le'u lnga pa yan gyi ṭīk+ka rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa'i gsung rgyun zin bris su mdzad pa g.yung 'grel rgyan gyi me tog ces ngo mtshar ba/ nged rang nas gsol ba btab pa'i bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub chen smin byed kyi chog sgrigs lhan thabs dang bcas pa rin po che'i 'phreng ba/ gzhis ka shar pa spun gyis zhus pa'i drag po dmar chen gyi bkang gso dang 'chi blu'i lag len/ las byang pad+ma ljon shing gi 'bru 'grel/ g.yu thog snying tig gi sdodagu'i las byang dam skong dregs pa tshar gcod sogs wen sgrub/ bkang ba/ gtor bsngos/ gsol 'debs/ smon lam/brtan bzhugs/ snyan dar zhal byang / chab shog khri ba dris lan/ rtsod bzlog /'grel shrīka so gosamatha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsgril na po ti gnyis lhag tsam yod tshod du 'dug pa nged kyi bsam par yab zur chen gzhen nu don grub kyi sku tshe dang mnyam pa zhig yong la re'i gsung rtsom rnams kyi ljagasalung dang bka' bsdu byed pa'i 'dun pa yod rung rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir gnyagasalo tsā ba'i thugs gar ring por ma lon par bsdus pas mos pa lam byed du gyur/ lar nas rje nyid bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ltar 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi ris la ye mi dgyes pa'i gshis thugs rtsom rnams kyang bskul ba po so sor rtsa yig de ga gnang nas ma dpe med pa kha yar byung snang / zin bris lus pa rnams kyang (112na)rang gi lto rgyab dang 'du 'dzi kho na las bla ma'i rnam thar —165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)dang yon tan mi sems pa'i dge 'dun nyi shu'i thog ma'i zhabs 'bring pa kho nas bskor te gar song cha med du gyur gshis brjod bya rjod byed dang bral ba'i rdzogs chen gyi gnas lugs kho na'o/ /snying por dril na tha snyad kyi gzhung lugs/ nang rig pa sde snod gsum/ rgyud sdebazhi gang la yang tshe rabs mang por sbyangs pa'i bag chags sad pa'i nyams kyis 'bru mar lta bur btsir nas dpral ba rngul 'dzag gi dka' spyad la ma ltos par lan re lan gnyis gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs su chud la/de yang thugs su chud do ba'i dper na gsar ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig gi rigs 'gre dkyil 'khor thams cad la 'gebs pa/ rjes gnang la gcig shes kun grol/ rnying ma'i sgrub 'phrin kyang sna gcig pu de ga tshang mar khyer nas gong ma'i phyag len mtha' dag nya dang nyug ma bsres pa'i khyad chos cung zad tsam yang mi mdzad par bka' mal mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi dbye ba/ de la'ang rma gnyags gnubs gsum/ so zur nyang sogs so so'i bka' babs dang bzhed tshul/ gter kha gong 'og /gnubs gter/ byang gter/ gling pa bcu gcig /dri med gsum gyis mtshon pa'i gter kha so so dang rjesa'abrang gi bla ma rnams kyi phyag len mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ gsar ma'i rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rjes gnang 'khrid rgyud bshad la rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa 'di ltar mdzad ces skabs thob ma 'dres pa dang khyad par khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po yongs 'dzin du bsten pa nas bzung spyir sa (112ba〉rugs dang sgos kha'u brag rdzong pa'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang rig gtad 'khrid man ngag mtha' dag la 'di ni 'di'o zhes shin tu zhib cha che ba'i gangs can 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi chos kun la 'di kho nar sbyangs 'dug snyam pa ma gtogs da lam rang o zob zob dang spom yor yor yin 'dug snyam pa'i rnam rtog za ba cung zad kyang ma mthong bas 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu mthon mthing ral pa'i zur phud dor nas byon kyang 'di phan las 'gro rgyu med bsam pa yod/ sngar nas zhal 'dris med pa dang yod kyang mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur kho na lhur len cing dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas sku la sdo ba/ rigs la brnyas pa sogs dgra gus pa'i gnyen btang snyoms pa bar ma'i 'gro ba mtha' dag /rigs pa'i — 166

zur ོ thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanadabang phyug gis/tsan+dan ste'ur mtshungs pa la//chags bral zhes ni brjod pa yin//zhes g.yas nasatsan+dan gyi lde gus byug pa dang g.yon nas sta re phyar te gnod pa byed pa gnyis mnyam pa nyid kho nar gzigs te rje dpon dang sde dgon gyis chad pa drag pos gzir te sdug bsngal ba rnams la thabs du ma'i sgo nas mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa/sde phan tshun/bla gra/dpon g.yog/grong pa yul pa/spun zla khyo shug sogs nang ma 'cham par khrims rar gtug pa la mngon du phyogs nas rang gzhan kun mnyam nyes kyi sbyor ba la brtson pa rnams la khe nyes dmigs dge bshad sdig grol gyi bslab bya bar pa rgyu 'don gyi gnang sbyin sogs thabs du ma'i sgo nas bzlums te bde 'jags su 'god/'phral du thugs la phog pa'i ris la'ang dus re zhig ma gtogs phugs ma nas 'khon du 'dzin pa'i gnag pa'i mthar thug mi mdzad par slar thugs rje chen pos rjes su 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po 3ba〉〉re zhal gdams su/g.yog po grag sreg mang bo las ka mi yong ba/bza' ba yong ba/'bul ba btsal nas mi yong ba/kha smras btsal nas yong pa/cha rkyen khyer nas mi yong pa/god kha khyer nas yong ba/gtam snyan khyer nas mi yong ba/gtam ngan khyer nas yong ba de lta bu'i g.yog po 'khor du mi bzhag pa gal che/bzhag na gus zhabs ye ma byung na'ang lo gcig la zan stong brgyad cu bya na dang bcas pa 'tshor ba yin pas de 'dra mi 'jog pa gal che/zhes gsungs pa ltar mkhyen rab dang rnam dpyod 'di tsam la sngar 'phrin las chud dus/phyag bris gnang ba rnams ma gtogos phyis kyi phyag dbe rnams mig gzugs sdeb brda dag legs rgyu med cing bka' brgyad pod dgus gtsos pa'i glegasabam mang po bzheng ba'i dgongs pa bstad rung de ris kyi yon to can ོ du zhabs phyir bskyil ba'i thugs rtsol zhan zhing dgon pa'i ris kyi gra pa bstan bshig phyir ldog na dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed mkhan rnams sto gos kyis mgo bskor nas thabs kyis bskyil ba nag can gzhan du 'gro mi nus pa chos 'jig rten gnyis ka mi yong ba'i mi ā+o mas mang po zhabs phyir bsten pa gzhan dag 'dras 'di 'dra lto gron che la phyag g.yog tu mi 'gyur tshul zhuX pa na dngos gzhi de ga 'dra zhig 'dug kyang yong

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shethang chen po cho gang byas kyang las sla 'di 'dra'i ris tsho mi tshe phyid pa dka' po yong bas snying rjes skyong ba'i thul yin/ nged rang gi nyams len rgya chen po zhig ma thub kyang theg pa chen po blo sbyong dang spros bral bde chen ma'i/ 'di ltar mig gi yul du snang ba yi: zhes sogs blo ka gsum po'i don dang ma 'gal tsam zhig dgos ris su 'dug /bla ma (113ba)mang po bsten nas chos la thos bsam byas pa'i dgos pa bde sdug gi rtogs pa gang shar spang gnyen gyis zin pa zhig ma byung na dred po chos rgyus mkhan chos dang gang zag ya bral du 'gro bas/ rgyal sras rin po ches/ lto 'grangs nyi ma dro tshe chos po'i gzugs/ /rkyen ngan sdug bsngal byung tshe tha mal pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don du ma song ba zhig dgos/ zhi ba lhas/ gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes gnod lan du bzod pa bsgom pa ni gnad chen po yod tshul rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa gsung zhes rgyu mtshan yang yang du mdzad/mi dbang bsod nams rab brtan grub mtha'i dbang gis zhal mdzes tsam las gting nas ye mi dgyes pas sha tshar bcar ba'i thugs 'dogs mi gnang ba mkhyen rung bde gzar snga phyi bar gsum tshang mar las sbyor gyi sku rim dang sde pa'i sku tshe bar chad sel byed kyi srung 'khor 'bul ba/ brtag pa dang mo phywa rtsis bsdur mdzad nas sku rim gyi zhabs bskul sha brgyab rus na'i dpe kho na gnang / rje nyid kyi sku dgra sger dmigs kyi ris la da lam rang las sbyor tsam mdzad na bsams kyang zhag 'phul nyin 'phul kho nar 'gro ba'i zhib mor dpyad na sems can mtha' dag la ris su ma chad pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po phyag na pad+ma mngon sum du krong gis byon byung yang de las lhag pa zhig 'ong don med/sog po nor bu rin cen/ hor stod pa/ 'brug pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ kong gar srid kyi bla dpon sogs ming yig dmigs su bcug nas las sbyor gang mdzad lo lnga drug tsam las 'phyi mtha' byas te dang po'i sangs rgyas 'jam dpal gyi zhing du spyan drangs pa kho na yin/ 'byung po ma rungs pas 'tshe ba la srung bcos byin rlabs ci (114na〉sna dra zhig mdzad kyang rtags mtshan 'phral du thon/ 'phral thugs 168

zur r+ṣa thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanache ngas sogs med pa'i drag zhan mtha' dag la gus 'dud lhur mdzad kyang bla chen du rloms nas chos skyong gi ris kyi lder sku dang gseb kyi zhabs la 'jus nas tshe ring ba dang nad med pa dang nga la bar chad ma gtong sogs kyi gsol 'debs mi mdzad par 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das pa'i bstan srung dregs pa kun gyi gtsug tu rdo rje'i phyag rgya bkod nas dam bsgrags pa brtul zhugs grub pa'i rtags mtshan sogs mthu stobs kyi khyad par ni lcang lo can nas gsang ba'i bdag po gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol pa dang rnam pa tsam las ngo bo tha mi dad par nges/ 'phral du mo rtsis kyi rnam pa mdzad na'ang don du rdzogs pa chen po'i 'od gsal khor yug gi ngang nas ji lta ji snyed kyi chos kun rjen par gzigs nyams kyi 'byung 'gyur gyi gsung 'phros gang mdzad thog kho nar 'gro bas rgyal dbang pad+mā kā ra gnyis pa las gzhan du ma gyur pa sogs rdo rje 'chang kun spangs chos rjes nged dang grub thob lcags zam pa'i rnam thar gzhan gyis blor mi chud gsungs pa'i mched zlar mngon pas rang blor shar tshod kyi snying po tsam bsdus te smos pa yin no/ /rim gyis gos spungs su phebs zla ba gnyis tsam stan chags gra tshang gi gra pa nyi shu skor la sngags ris kyi bslab ston dang 'dul ba slob dpon blo gros rnam rgyal la 'pho 'khrid sogs 'dod chos 'ga' zhig stsal/ gter ston o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma'i bod srin mo gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i shog ser bu yig gi steng nas ras gzhi la zhing bkod che ba zhig phyag bris su gnang / nged kyi nyams 'khrid dbang ljags lung mang du zhus/ dbang rnams rdzogs res kyis bdag gis gang thob kyi chos rnams da cha phal cher rdzogs (114ba)pa yin zhes ring por mi bzhugs pa'i brda chos gsung yang kyal ka lta bur go /zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin gnas chung lcog nas chos skyong chen pos rig pa 'dzin pa 'di 'dra phyis nas rnyed par dka' bas chos la rtsol 'don gyis gsung ba rang bzhin gyi bskul ma yin nam snyam pa las gas pa'i rnam rtog ma 'phros/ nged kyis tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang gi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i brtan bzhugs phul ba'i tshe gtor mar chab sbran pa mar me la phog nas —169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyeskad cig la shi ba sogs rnam rtog za ba'i ltas mi legs pa 'ga' zhig byung / de yang gzims khang shar pa tshor da lo nged kyis me tog mchod par ma yongs par bla tshab cig btang na ding sang gzhan 'dras byed skabs shul chung khyad yong gsungs par rgan pa rnams kyis phebs dgos tshul nan du gsol bar nged de ltar bsams kyang 'dod par yod na byas chog ces zhal gyis bzhes tshag gur ba'i nang mi sogs phyogs phyogs kyi sbyin bdag 'dra la'ang da lo me tog mchod par cis kyang shog gnang zhing so so'i blo dang 'tsham par bslab ston rgyas par mdzad/gung thang dkar me ba tshor bdag khrom la yong dgos pa'i ka pe ma mi 'dug gra gang 'grig gyis gsung bar khong tshos zhu nan phul bar do zhag nas shul che ba mi yong na yongs chog phebs pas gdan sa 'jog pa'i lo mtshams lta bu gnang rgyu bzhin yin nam snyam pa las rnam rtog gzhan 'phros tshod mi 'dug /'bras spungs su phebs gdong tshag gur sde pa bsod nams rnam rgyal la khyed nged dang lhan du 'gro'am ji ltar byed gnang ba nang du log tshul gsol ba na phyag mdud legs pa zhig stsal slar phrad yong shas che'ang khyed tshang sdig che ba 'dug pas 'dzem dgos tshul sogs kyi bslab ston dang bla brang nas phyir (115na)phebs gdong mgul nas sku srung zhig bkrol te thugs sras mar gnang ba sogs kyang rjes su btags na yun du mi bzhugs pa'i brda chos su mchis/zla ba bzhi pa tsam gyi nang du gung thang mchod khang rtser bzhugs pa'i nub kyi mnal lam du rje bla ma dang nged dpon slob lhan cig tu ri logs shig la byon par nged tsho'i ri'i stod du song zhing rje nyid smad der phebs nas gzigs rtog ma chug pa'i mur mi nag po gnyis kyis 'dzin par 'ongs zhes sku la mtho 'tsham pa bsnyen phur gyis phyir ded pa zhig byung gsungs/ lags rab brtan glo bur du na bar sman sgom 'brang rgyas pas bla rtsa'i babs dpon slob rang gi sku la nyen pa shar bas sku rim gnang dgos tshul nan bskyed zhus par da lta lag na yod pas ka ca 'di bka' 'gyur gyi rgyur bsngos grub gsungs nas tshal gung du mang ja sogs nyung zad las ma mdzad/ gung thang pa'i grong pa zhig gi khang pa 170

zur byu thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanal glo bur du me shor ba/zhang rin po che'i sku 'dra gsung 'byon ma'i dbu zhwa lan gnyis sar lhungs pa/zhabs 'bring pa dang gra ris sogs la rmi lam ngan pa sna tshogs byung yang tshang ma dmu gab kyis bcings pa'i rnam rtog cher ma 'phros/khro rgyal dpal mgon gyi rmi lam du rje nyid rgyang zhig la byamasabazhugs mdzad nam mkha' nas 'ja' tshon gyi sne nar gyi btang bar phyag gis 'jus nas thegs pa byung ba sang nyin snyan du phul zhing gsol ba btab pas nga rang la'ang de 'dra ba 'ga' re byung gal la hor pa'i sku skye'ang gshegs 'dug nga la der rang yang sgar chen mgyogs nyin 'dod pa 'dra phebs pa sogs zhing 'dir mi bzhugs pa'i rtags mang du byung bar snang /hor zla bdun pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin gsar ma rgyud 'bum gyi ljags lung gnang ba'i 'phro nas cho me mtshams115ba)mdzad/sngar phan rten 'brel gyis ljags lung gzhan ma'i tshig bkra legs pa zhig nas dbu 'a zhugs ched gnyer gnang yang da lam de 'dra'i par bkab ma byung /'phral rkyen sngar smosapa bzhin slob ma dam tshig dang mi ldan par zab chos stsal ba/bstan srid kyi ched du bde gzar snga phyi bar gsum mtha' dag la drag las kyi sku rim mangs shing gzhung gi gnyer las 'dzin pa la'ang bde gzar sngon ma'i dus dgra'i lte bo'i ris kyang ma nges par 'ong ba sogs dam sel gyi ris 'bad med lhun grub tu byung zhing bdag gzhan mnyam brje lta bu'i dgongs pas khyab 'jug gi srung bcos la'ang 'dzem bag ye med pa'i ha cang rgya ches pas sgo du ma nas sku tshe'i bar chad du song ngam snyam/'on kyang dam pa'i ris zhing khams ga' na du gshegs par gzhol ba'i tshe sde brgyad rnams kyang bsu ma'i tshul la spro ba'ang yod los su snang /gtso bor zhing 'di'i mdzad pa phal cher rdzogs nas rnga yab pad+ma 'od du phebs par dgyes pa'i rgyus nged kyi gam nas phyir byon pa'i bzhugs gnas su 'byor ma thag sku khams nyogs te cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan te sa srod tsam la ltar snang du sku'i bkod pa bsdusanas zhag gsum gyi ring chos nyid kyi bar do'i 'od gsal la mnyam par bzhag nas chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i klong du gshegs/zhing khams 'phos/la bstan ma thag pa nas gdung yid bzhin nor

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)bu'i drung du dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa shin tu rgyas pa snyan dar smon lam tshigs bcad ma/ bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon por bzhugs pa la bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa dang dbang bzhi len pa sogs nan tan tu byas thugs dam grol nub nged kyi rmi lam du rje bla ma lho nub phyogs kyi thag ring ba zhig la thegs rgyu'i khul gyis phyag g.yog (116na)dmangs dang rta sga gtad pa sum cu tsam dgon gsham du rol rol 'dug pa sngar 'di 'dra'i spros pa mi mdzad par da lam gzi brjid chen po zhig gnang ba ci yin snyam pa shar/rje nyid gzims chung rab gsal du shar mar phebs nas snang gsal ba bkra shis rgya mtsho'i dag snang tshe dpag med hrīḥgacig ma'i dbang lung gnyis ka sngar nas phul zin kyang nyams 'khrid lus song ba da lam 'bul zhes tshar gcig thugs las shar gyis gsungs nas ring stabs su thegs pa byung ba ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung ngam snyam/ gnas tshul rdo rje brag tu gsan ma thag sprul sku rin po che mchod 'bul la phebs dbu zhus gtsos pa'i mgyogs bsngo phul/ thugs dam ma grol bar gsang sgo'i rnam pa byas par go bo spyi khang du sdod mi 'dras dga' ldan pho brang nas re ma khang gi bar du 'ja' dkar po tal mar zug pa mthong bas bla ma de grongs yod pa thag chod glengs/ sku rim du ming btags pa'i gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis thugs rje chen po'i cho ga btang / nye len yin khul gyi mchod dpon pa yang yang phyin par sku mdangs snga dro dgongs zhogs kyi bar la'ang legs su song ba'i zhing ma brjes pa 'dra mo 'dug zer/ lags a gur rab brtan ngag dbang 'phrin las sogs sku nye rnams kyis gros thog nas dgongs rdzogs kyi do dam pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar zhang tsha dkon cog rnam rgyal btang / dgongs rdzogs la ser 'bras gnyis su mang ja'i thog bla ma khri gdan zur bsdoms pa bcu drug la so sor bdun tshan re/ pha bong khar mang ja dngul gdung rin po cher snyan shal mchod 'bul gdan sa bar dgu tshan/ 'phrul snang ra mo che po ta la gsum du dngul srang lnga bcu gzhal ba'i dkar me/ jo bo shākya mu nir ling ser gyi snam sbyar/ snyan (116bskon la che ba gsum/ de phyin dmar — 172

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanalcags bsdoms pa'i mchod khang sum cu skor la so sor snyan dar gsum re mchod pa sna lnga/ tshal gung du mchod pa snyan shal/ chos khri ba/ gzims khang shar pa/ zing pa ba gsum bsdus kyi gdung chog pa sum cu/ grub chen ga dze gsang sngags pa'i spros med 'od gsal don gyi mchod 'bul/ gtor ma ba gcig /sku nye gra ris sbyin bdag sogs kyi gdung mjal la 'ongs pa'i dkar me snyan dar sogasamachod 'bul rgyas par byas/ rtsis bshags pas chu lug bsam yas su phebs dus phyag 'phreng gi brtag pa'i thog tu babs te sku gdung rin po che mchims phur gdan 'dren pa'i sta gon la lags a gur dang rab brtan gnyis kyis dgon zhabs bar re mos kyis gdan drangs/ de nas chu kha bar 'do le la bteg nas la gsang ga dbang 'phrin las/ dpal nor bu/ dgos nor/ bkra shis bzhis spyan 'dren zhus/ sang nyin ko gzhung la phebs pa nas bzung 'ja' sprin rtsibs shar gyen bsgreng za 'og mig mang ris/ nyi ma dang nye ba'i sprin thams cad 'ja' ris kyi rnam pa rgyun mi chad pa'i ngang nas thub bstan rdo rje brag gi mdun du dar cig ko ba 'gyings pa ni sprul sku rin po ches gtso mdzad dad 'dus kyi slob bu rnams thugs rje'i spyan ras kyi byang chub bar du btsa' ba'i brdar mngon/ khyad par mchims phu'i ri mthong ba nas bzung ste phyogs kyi sprin thams cad lha'i gzugs dang bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi rnam par song / dur khrod du sku gdung zhag gsum bzhugs ring gra nas rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub dpon slob bco lnga phebs te sku gdung rin po che kun bzang dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rgya cher mdzad/gsang (117na)phug tu be+e ro tsa na'i phyag bzo'i slob dpon chen po'i sku brnyan gyis gtsos par gser chab spyan 'byed dkar me snyan shal mchod pa/ mchims phu'i gra tshang la mang ja spyi 'bul/dpal ri sprul skur gos phod kyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan/ bsam yas mthil gyi mchod khang rnams la gser chab snyan shal mchod pa khyad par byang chub chen por gos phrug nag po'i thog se'u'i gnas bcu tshang ba'i bla bre che legs/ bar khang steng khang gnyis su 'phan cha/ rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul sku —173

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)rin po che dpon slob nyi shu skor gyis thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi cho ga la brten nas sku gdung rin po che 'phags mchog phyag na pad+ma dang dbyer ma mchis par sreg rdzas kyi me mchod phul ba'i dud pa'i sne la 'od dkar po sder ma tsam zhig gsang phug tu 'ja' dkar zug pa'i steng du song ba der yod kun gyis mthong zhing me tog gi char babs/ rgod dkar po zhig gis nam mkha' nas skor ba byas pa 'phral gyi ltar snang tsam las don gyi slob dpon chen po'i sprul bar sems/ pur khang la zhag gsum gyi bar dar sdings pa dpon slob kyis mchod pa mdzad nas zhal phye ba'i tshe dbu thod dang thugs ril po/ gdung lcags gcod dang gdung log mang du phebs/ sprul sku rin po cher sku phod kyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan gsum/ slob dpon pas dbus par spyi 'bul/ chos rje dar sdings par gos phod kyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan gnyis/ gra pa rnams la spyi 'bul/ gdung thal rnams dur khrod gong du bzhugasakhang brtsigs bzhugs par sku dkar cod pan phul/ gdung rnams gdan drangs pa rgod dkar la thog tu kha ba babs pa'i rdog po rnams sa la lhung ma thag 'dab ma lnga drug bdun brgyad sogs me tog gi rnam par song / khyab bdag (117ba〉brka' 'gyur ba chen po gtsang du bzhugs pa dang 'grig pa'i sku gdung gi bya ba la gdan 'dren ma thub/ thugs dam gsal 'debs gos ber gyis gtsos pa'i dgu tshan gsum 'bul ba dang dngul gdung gi rab gnas gzungs bzhugs la phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsan phul ba zhal gyis bzhes na'ang / sde ba bsod nams rab brtan gyis rnying ma ba zhig byung na mngon chung ba tsam yang rab tu dge lugs pa zhig rang 'gab/ sa skya pa'i ris ma 'bod gsungs par brten de ga'i gsed bkrol zhu mkhan btang bar nged dpon slob gnyis su sngon la yong yang cig shos des rjes kyi bya ba byed pa'i sa bcad yod rung bla ma dam pa'i dgongs pa mi rdzogs pa 'dra zhes thugs cung zad mi dgyes pa'i tshul mdzad snang / 'bri gung zhabs drung rin po che/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che/ dga' ldan khri gdan zur lcags zam sprul sku/ gsung sprul/ sgam spyon sprul sku/ gsang phu gling stod smad/ ra ba stod/ rtse shar/ bkra shis ljongs/ tshal stod smad/ yer pa/ rme ru ba/ bka' brgyud pho —174

zur wo thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanabrang pa/rtsa sgrub sdeb/bka' brgyud chos sdings pa/ne'u chung ri pa sogs bla ma mang por bsngo rten/sku tshigs thog tshal gung gi dge 'dun drug cu tsam la zhabs rta go/thugs rje chen po'i cho ga stong rtsa la phan bde legs bshad gling pas zhag gsum bzhugs shing dgung zhag pa dang bcas pa'i zhabs tog dus re gzhis ka shar dang gzhis ka phra mo gnyis nas bteg/gra tshang la bsngo rten spyi 'bul du bka' brgyad gra tshar phyag bris ma/rnga chas gtsos pa'i tshan grangs/zhang rin po che'i sku 'dra gsung byon mar rje nyid kyis me tog mchod par bzhes pa'i dbu zhwa/gos ber/lha khang gzhan ma rnams la snyan dar mchod 11zha ) 'bul/bdun lnga pa'i zhabs tag lags ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis bstar/chog mang tshal gung gi thog tsa ri ba/sga lo phug/khang dmar brag pa/ba po shis ga rgyal/dgon pa rtsedang 'og/byang mkhar ba/bka' brgyud chos sdings pa rnams kyi gral dbu yang dgon spyan sngas mdzad par 'bul ba tsha ra spyi 'gyed/der ma 'dus pa spos dga' ba/gar bu dgon pa ba/mdo spyil ba/zing pa stag mgo ba/rin cen brag pa rnams la mang ja 'gyed bcas/rdo rje brag tu mang ja phur pasagatsos pa'i spyi 'gyed bto /o rgyan rin po che dang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi par la gdung tsha so sor stong phrag lnga re sman sgom 'brang rgyas pas khur bskyed nas btab par gser dngul mtshal gsum gang babs na bza' sbran nas dad rten du bkye/sprul ba'i sku myur 'byon gyi gsol 'debs dgos tshul bzhin brtsams nas phan bde legs bshad gling pa dang dgon khag/tshes bcu ba rnams la btsugs/sbre bon po lung pa sogs phyogs mtha'i bla ma dang bde chen gyis gtsos sbyin bdag che phra rnams kyisagadung 'bul rgyas par spel/thon thon la dgung zhag pa so sor dkyil thang /bum pa/mchod kong /ting bdun tshar/rten khebs/spyi 'bul/gra pa so sor rdul gzan res gtsos pa'i lnga phywa re rgyar dod dang bcas pa/sku nye rnams kyi sku myur phebs la sku rim gyi brtag pa dgos tshul byung ba brtag babasanang bzhin grub chen mas gu rgyas yer par drag dmar gyi bsnyen pa bye chung gcigazhal brag tu sngagasarams pa nam mkha' bzang pos badz+ra gu ru bye chuX gcig btang /dngul gdung byang chub mchod rten

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyergyug mtho bcu bdun pa'i thig rtsa gzhis ka shar lags skus gur gyis byas/ shing bzo ba lam rnyed (118ba)dang dkon cog gnyis a ma shing gis gtsos pa'i bal po brgyad sku rgyur dngul srang bzhi brgya/ gser zho nyis brgya/ zangs dngul chu sogs dgos cha phon ma chungs pa/ zhal 'debs gzhung nas g.yu pad la gtogs tsam gcig /g.yang ṭi'i 'phreng ba gnyis/ byu ru'i 'phreng ba sogs dang / lha sa'i tshesabacu shar ma ba rnams kyis dngul srang lnga/ sgo sna shag pa'i dngul srang bdun/ sku nye gra ris sbyin bdag rnams nas kyang zhal 'debs 'gyogs sogs mang du byung / las rgyun zla ba gsum gyi bar bzo bo rnams la phogs thog mtha' bar gsum gyi ston mo gla thob yon 'phar dang bcas pa/ bka' 'gyur zhig 'phral bzhengs kyi thugs rtsis 'dug pa lam du ma brgyugs par dngul lnga bcu ma dang sbug chol gyi zhu rten byung bar brten dgongs pa rdzogs byed du rgyal rtse nas drangs pa'i bka' 'gyur gung thang mchod khang du bzhugs su gsol/sa khyi zla ba gsum par rten bzhengs gegs med du grub pa'i dar rgyas chos sdings nas rigs 'dzin chen po 'phrin las lhun grub dpon slob bco lnga skor gyis sa ga zla ba'i tshes gsum nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung gis gtsos pa'i yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel bla ma gong ma rnams kyi sku gdung dang sku bal gyi ring bsrel/ gzungs chen sde lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i chos sku'i ring bsrel/bla ma zhang gi gsung 'bum sogs po ti drug cu skor/ bum pa'i nang du gtso bor dbu thod bam ril/thugs/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku par btab pa'i gdung tsha stong phrag bdun tsam/ seng khri'i nang du chos skyong nor lha'i gzungs/ shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs bcad/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ tshogs bdag 'khor lo/ lha chen dbang phyug gi rten mdud/ dpal mgon ma ning nag po'i gri snying srog 'khor/ la stod dmar po'i gter (119na)dung / ja gos dar mtshon cha sogs gzungs bzhugs shin tu rgyas pa/bum pa'i sgo nang du rje nyid rdo rje 'chang gi cha lugs can gyi sku khru gang tsam/ tshe dpag lha khang du sngar ldebs ris med pa la ldebs ris gsar du bskrun te byang gi dbus su dngul gdung / g.yas g.yon — 176

zur r+ṣa thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ rtanadu bka' 'gyur/yab kyi gser gdung dang bcas bzhugs pa'i dbu thog tu gos bzang bsgrigs kyi bla bre bzhi/gos dang kha btags so so'i 'phan cha re/gzhis ka shar dang lagasang ga dbang 'phrin las kyis phul ba'i kha btags kyi 'phan cha re/snyan dar gong pa gsham bcas/dar kha dog sna tshogs sum cu skor/li ting gsar rnying bdun tshar re/kong bu gnyis/zangs dmar gyi me dam cha/gi gu shel gyi maṇ+ḍal/phud phor cha/gos sku gdan 'dren gyi rgya sbug/rgya dung /rnga/gos ngur smig gi gdugs rnams kyi spyan gzigs rgya cher spel/rin po che dar sdings pas bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i sgo nas tshes bzhi la sta gon dang lnga la rab tu gnas pa'i thog rdo rje brag sogs phyogs 'dus dang gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis phul ba'i snyan dar gyi dra bas sbrel/rab ston yon bzabs rgyas dang der 'dus kun la gang 'tsham gyis bsnyen bkur/lo gcig gi bar zla re'i dus mchod la dge 'dun sum cu rer sri zhu/sku mchod chen mor ra stod gra tshang gis zhag gsum gyi bar gsung sgrog dang tshal gung gi tsha ra'i gral dbu gling stod chos rjes mdzad/dbus gling rtse'i bogs steng nas nyin ltar gyis mar me sdong rkang re dang zhal zas lnga/sku mchod chen mor mchod pa nyer gcig dang dge 'dun bdun cu skor la zhabs tog nyin thub/de mthun yum sras gnyis nas mar me stong rkang re/dkon gnyer gyi phogasadang sku mchod kyi thebs sogs gan gtsang du sbyor ba'i bar gyi do dam zhang tsha dkon cog rnam rgyal 119ba ) gyis byas so//'jam dpal thugs kyi me long dwangs shel ngos//chos kun ye nas spros med rang sems su//thag chod blo las 'das pa gdod ma'i mgon//gzhan nas 'tshol ba'i gnyis 'dzin 'ching rgya bcad//phun tshogs bde ldan ngo mtshar zhing khams na/khyod thugs dga' ba'i o rgyan mkhan po des//chu dang rlabs bzhin snang tshul tha dad pas//spyon zhes bskul ba'i sgyu ma'i 'phrul de mtshar//sna nam rig sngags 'chang ba'i sprul pa'i skur//chos kun ye nas lhun grub 'du ma byas//zang thal zad sar 'byol ba'i 'pho ba che'i//lam zab pha phab tshul ༷ mngon sum bstan//rab stims zhing rdul snyed

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyedu bgrang min yang / /bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lhar grags sgrub sde brgyad/ khrag 'thung gar la bzhengs pa'i nyams 'gyur tshogs/ /ras dkar dwangs mtshor shar ba'i zla gzugs bzhin/ ta shes byar srid kun mkhyen la 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /ris med 'gro brtse lag na pad+ma'i mched/ /bdud sde'i dpung tshogs gzhes la gsang ba'i bdag /bshes gnyen dam pa'i gzugs su deng 'dir grub/ /rnga yab gling la dgyes pa'i zhabs kyi gom/ /dbang gzhu'i lam la lhod por gshegs pa'i 'gros/ /ngo mtshar ltas kyis kha bas yongs bskor 'gro/ /'dor ba'i 'phyon ma'i gar la mchi ma bku/ /'on te gnyags ban thugs bskyed zla ba'i cha/ /gang ba'i gar+sha zhe nu ri bong 'dzin pa'i gzugs/ /ljongs 'di'i mkha' la yongs shar ga bur rdul/ /gdung sel snying ga phan bde ci yang bzhad/ /de ltar ekhri ya na'i slob dpon chen po 'chi med grub pa'i rigs 'dzin pad+ma ka ra'i gdung 'tshob zur chen chos kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi rnam (120na)par thar pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba ni spyan dang mngon par shes pas ma gzhal bar dpe dang gtan tshigs tsam gyis bsgrub pa'i gnas min zhing thun mong ba'i gdul bya rnams kyi blo ngor shong pa'i rtogs brjod rgyas pa tsam zhig brir 'dod na'ang / dam pa nyid zhing khams 'dir sku'i bkod pa mngon sum du gyur pa'i dus reg zig tu 'khod pa med cing dri bya'i yul yang ches cher dkon pas rgya cher gleng ba'i rngo ma thogs rung gzhis ka shar lags a gur dang / ngag dbang 'phrin las gnyis kyis spyod yul du gyur pa rnams la mes kyi sngags 'chang khro rgyal dpal mgon sogs kyis zur brgyan pa'i shog dril gyi sa bon zhig byung bar nged rang nas lo zla dus tshes mdzad pa'i rim pa mngon sum du nges pa'i steng nas legs par dpyad de bkod kyang spyir so so skye bo'i kun rdzob kyi 'khrul pa la zad pa med pas snang la ma nges kyi dogs gzhi la dpyad pa dang gzigs snang sogs ya mtshan pa'i ris gang rnyed snon par mdzod cig ces skabs legs par dbye'o/ /e ma rang rig kun bzang chos kyi sku/ /sgrib bral nyi ma'i snying po rdo rje sems/ /khyab bdag bla — /78

zur chen thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar/ tanama'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i glu/ /tshur mthong byis pas len pa'i go skabs ci/ /'on te zla ba'i ma ma yongs rdzogs pa/ /'thung bar nus pa min yang chub gcig gis/ /skom pa'i gdung ba sel ltar mdzad pa'i cha/ /phra mos bskal bzang gdul bya'i dga' ba bskyed/ /long long chu 'dzin gsar pa'i phang ba nas/ /snyan snyan dbyar gyi rnga gsang sgrog pa'i mod/ /ldem ldem gtsug phud g.yo ba rma bya'i tsho gis/ /zlum zlum sgro (120ba〉lta sgogs gdugs phub zlos gar rtsen/ /mang du thos don don bzhin bsam la mkhas/ /rgyu 'bras phra zhib zhib mor dpyad pas btsun/ /'gro kun la brtse brtse ba'i thugs rjesabazung / /rdzu wol nus stobs stobs ldan lha min 'dar/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /bcud chen bstan bde'i srog gi zungs gyur sman/ /sman mchog myong bas rnam grol shing rta'i srol/ /srol 'dzin ye shes gzhen nu gzhan na su/ /pad+ma'i 'dab stong byed dbus sngon byon pa'i/ /snyan pa'i gtam gyis rna ba ches mngar ding / /'jigs med brtul zhugs grub pa'i thod 'phreng rtsal/ /gnyis pa 'dren byed gzigs mor dngar 'di mtshar/ /rgya bod rigs 'dzin tshogs kyi mkhyen brtse nus/ /gcig bsdus rdo rje'i slob dpon rnam par thar/ /chu gter che las bdag blo ku sha'i rtses/ /len gang sngon bsags bsod nams bye bas rnyed/ /legs byas 'di'i mthus rig rtsal kun tu bzang / /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod min de srid du/ /skye bar mgon po khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes/ /mdzad nas 'bral ba med par rjes 'dzin shog /log smon dmod pa'i lcags kyi gtun bu dag /'khrul blo'i mngal du mi rtogs blang dor la/ /bcu phrag 'jug pa yangs pa'i mig
