sngon pa/ /'tsho ba srid zhi yongs la don ldan shog /rgyal gsung mtha' dag sems can ma lus pa'i/ /phan bde'i srog song kho nar nges rnyed kyang / /theg pa'i yang rtse bka' gter snying po'i bstan/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir dus kun dar bar shog /rtsa gsum thugs rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor che/ /'char nub spangs pa'i byin rlabs snang ba'i gzi/ /'gro rnamasabade skyid dgung nas (121na skyog 'bar ba'i/ /bkra shis dpal gyis 'jig rten yongs khyab shog /ces dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid khyab bdag rdo rje — 179

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesems dngos zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar theg mchog bstan pa'i shing rta zhes pa 'di ni rang nyid la bri 'dun snga mo nas yod pa dang / nye char rje btsun bla ma mchog gi thugs sras dam pa rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sde'i gsung gis bskul zhing g.yin yang gzhis ka shar pa lags a gur skrun/ngag dbang 'phrin las/ mes kyi sngags 'chang khro rgyal dpal mgon sogs don gnyer can du mas bskul ba la brten nas bla ma'i bka' 'bangs za hor gyi sngags smyon gang shar rang grol gyis me 'brug hor zla brgyad pa'i dkar cha'i bzang po gnyis pa la rgyal khab chen po pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtshos bgyis pa phyogs dus kun tu dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // sarba maṅga lo// //— 180

nyang ston khra k+ṣe pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ lhan༄4//to ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rtogs pa brjod pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//༄tsho//na masarba kū la pra bhu shrī maṅga ra we/zhi dang khro bo'i bgrang yas dkyil 'khor ma lus pa spro zhing sdud pa'i khyab bdag kun tu bzang po nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rtogs pa brjod pa nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba theg dgu'i yang rtse 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa spel bar paṇa chen bi mā la mi tra'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sprul pa'i rol gar shākya skyabs sbyin rgyal kun bos pa'i ngo bo bla ma rdo rje 'cha dang gnyis su med pa rang rig don gyi pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod min de srid kyi bar du bde chen 'khor lo'i pad mtshor 'bral ba med par gsol ba 'debs na thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung ste sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ngo bo rig rtsal 'dus ma byas pa gdod nas chos sku man shel gdangs//rang bzhin 'gags med ye shes lngar shar longs spyod rdzogs sku ma 'dres tshon//thugs 2na ) rje kun khyab sna tshogs sprul sku gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar//bsgyur mdzad blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i khas zung 'khor lor mgos phyag 'tshal//dus gsum wangs rgyas kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung //ma brgyad rnam rol shākya seng ge de'i//mi chagasaskyabs kyi sbyin pa'i phyag rgya yis//snga 'gyur bstan pa'i bdag por deng gzengs bstod//dri med bshes gnyen 'ja' lus 'pho ba che//yongs grub ri bo rtse lngar sgyu ma'i sku//ma bsdus mngone sum bzhugs pa rdzun pa'i gtam//min na nyang ston rigs su byon 'di ci//mkhyen spyod lang tsho dar ba'i 8

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shernga yab kyis/ /rnying bstan gog po'i rdul 'phyag gad bdar gyi/ /mkhan por pad+mā ka ras mnga' gsol bar/ /rgyal rnams dgyes pa'i legs so ster ba bzhin/ /brgya byin gtsug tor nor bur reg pa'i mod/ /mi lus skabs gsum gzugs su sgyur byed na/ /theg mchog chos kyis gnyis 'dzin rgya bral (2ba)mthar/ /sa lam rdzogs pa'i kun tu bzang de nye/ /ched du dman cha blangs pa'i mtshan mo'i mal/ /so skye'i gnyid la g.yur 'dod rdzu bag mun/ /mkhas grub ngang tshul skya rengs mas drangs pa'i/ /rnam thar rta ljang can shar gang gis 'gog /gzhan gsos mgrin pa'i dril chung 'brol ba'i glu/ /snyan po rna bar mngar ba'i pho nya yis/ /legs bos spang ljongs mar gad gos gyon pa/ /dbyar gyi dpal mo'i bzhin ngom dngos po'i gshis/ /thub mchog rnams kyi yon tan nyer brjod pa'i/ /nyams 'gyur sgra don bh+ra ma ra yi glur/ /me tog mchu sgros 'dab ma rgod pa nas/ /so 'phreng ze'u 'bru dkar po ston la brel/ khungs btsun rigs bltams thos bsam dngos grub brnyes/ /chos 'khor legs bskor 'gro don dpag yas mdzad/ /zab dang rgya che'i bstan bcos mang du brtsams/ /zhi ba'i klong gzims don ldan gtam gyi gzhi/ /gsang las yang gsang dbyangs can phang 'gro'i sgra/ /thun mong gcig pu'i thos 'dzin yul min yang / /mkhas btsun bzang po'i rgyud mangs las drangs pa'i/ /glu 'di shes ldan yid gsosardzisman ljon/ /mi phyed chos rjes 'brang dang zla zer gyis/ /dam pa'i yon tan kun+da kha 'byed pa'i/ /skal bzang 'di ko dus mkhyen rgyal po dang / /mtshungs snyam spobs mgrin mthar bteg smra 'di nyon/ /de yang bstan bcos rtsom pa dang bka' dang dgongs 'grel bsgyur pa'i tshe yul khyad par can la phyag 'tshal ba lo paṇa rnams kyi phyag bzhes yin pas/ mngon pa'i sde snod kyi thog mar 'jam dpal dbyangs/ (3na)mdo sde'i sde snod la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/'dul ba la thams cad mkhyen pa la ched du brjod pas bsod nams 'phel zhing bar chad mi 'jug pa dang chos de sde snod gsum po gang gi khongs su gtogs shes sla bar gsungs par ma zad brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos tsan+d+ra byā kur ṇa ra/ grub pa kun mkhyen kun la sman/ /'gro ba'i bla mar phyag 'tshal nas/ /zhes dang / cha bsags— /82

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ tanakyi mdor/ gnyis su med par gsung ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal zhing / sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos rin chen nga gnas las/ rgyal ba thub pa nyi ma ni/ /snang ba mchog gi bdag nyid can/ /nang gi mtshan mo shes bral gyi/ /nang gi nyin byed la phyag 'tshal dang / mngon brjod mu tig 'phreng bar/ gser gyi mdog can bsod nams brgya yi mtshan mnga' ba/ /bsod nams phung po ri bo dngos su rgyu ba bzhin/ /lha dang mis mchod dpal ldan shākya seng ge gang / /(3bgi ser gyi rgya mtsho 'dra ba de la phyag bgyi'o/ / zhes rgya gar kha spu can rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'brangs te yul khyad par can la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas las su bya ba/ mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni/ /snyan ngag mkhan de bde gshegs rtomachogo la/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang / /dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /zhes skyes bu dam pa rnams la snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs te bstod pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi rdul gyis bgrang bar mi nus la/ snyan ngag kyang mkhas dbang daṇ+ḍi sa/ tshigs bcad rkang bzhi de yang ni/ /brit+ta dzā ti zhes rnam gnyis/ /de yi spros pa mtha' dag ni/ /sdeb sbyor gzhung du nges par bstan/ /rig de snyan ngag rgya mtsho ni/ /zab mo rgal 'dod rnams kyi gru/zhes rkang pa bzhir bcad pa'i tshigs bcad nyid gtso bor gsungs shing snyan ngag rnams kyi mchog rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing yang de dang cha mthun mod/ mtha' gcig tu nges pa med pa slob dpon chen po dpal ldan ma khol gyi bde bar gshegs pa'i 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa bcad lhug spel mar mdzad pa dang / ljongs 'dir zlos gar gyi bstan bcos kyang tshul de lta bur ngos 'dzin pas/ rim lnga las/ rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /zhesabla ma dam pa ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i dbang phyug yin pas de la mchod bstod sogs ri mor gang byas (4na)dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la byas par 'gyur ba'i tshogs rgya chen po gsog la/ de yang tshogs gsog tshul rnam grangs mang ba gzhan dag gi sgo nas — 183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyebasags na mi rung ngam snyam na rang gi bsags sbyangs la khyad par med na'ang bde bar gshegs pa zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus pa 'dus pa'i bdag nyid kun bzang rdo rje 'chang mnyam med khra tshang pa chen po blo gros mchog gi rdo rje chos sku bde ba chen po'i dbyings su gzugs sku sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul nye bar bsdus kyang / me long mar/ sngon gyi rgyal po grags pa'i gzugs/ /ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob /de dag nye bar mi gnas kyang / /rang nyid nyams pa med la ltos/ /zhes sngon gyi rgyal po nga las nu la sogs pa deng sang dngos su med rung de dag gi snyan grags 'gro ba rnams kyi rna ba'i rgyan du gyur pa bzhin 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po nas bzung rgya bod kyi mkhas grub phal mo cher rnam par thar pa'i yi ge yod pa mang zhing tshul de dag brjod pa'ang / bshes springs su/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa rnyed dang ma rnyed dang / /bde dang mi bde snyan dang mi snyan dang / /bstod smad ces bgyi 'jig rten chos brgyad po/ /bdag gi yid yul min par mgo snyoms mdzod/ /ces 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du song ba'i grags pa dang snyan pa don du gnyer ba ma yin pa/ mkhas mchogo dpa' bos/ grags pa'i mtshan mar gyur pa bzang po 'di rnams kyis/ /bde bar gshegs gyur lam rnams gang yin bstan par 'gyur/ /yid la dad pa med pa rnams kyang dad par 'gyur/ /(4ba〉byas dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis rab tu dga' bar 'gyur/ /zhes dam pa'i rnam par thar pa la brten nas sngar dad pa med pa rnams gsar du skye zhing yod pa rnams gong nas gong du rgyasapa'i phyir na 'gro ba kun gyi legs byas rgya cher 'phel ba/ dkon cog sgron ma'i gzungs las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol/ /dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshon byed yin/ /dad pa rnyog pa med cing sems dang byed/ /nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsa ba yin/ /dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes legs tshogs thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dad pa la rag las pa'i phyir rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po'i rtogs brjod rgyas pa zhig 'bri bar spro ba'i rje bla ma'i zhabs — 184

nyang ston khra tsha pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)'bring ba so sor rnam thar gyi sa bon dgos tshul mol bar chos rje gdan sa ba smar ngag dbang thub bstan gyis sa bon 'phrin shog che ba tsam gyi rtsis las zhabs phyir yun ring bsdad kyang blor ma 'jags tshul dang gsan yig gi glegs bam las ma byung zhing /rong ba sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyis kho rang zhabs 'bring du bsdad pa tshun zhib tsam bris 'dug rung stod cha rnams gsal ba mi snang bas stod smad mi mtshungs pa'i go rims bsgrigs pa legs char mi 'gyur ba nas mdzad pa rnams sde tshan du byas te nyung ngur 'god pa la khungs btsun gdung las bltams pa/yongs 'dzin bsten nas thos pa rgya cher ldan〉dzad pa/bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen por goms pas dngos grub brnyes pa/grangasamed pa'i slob mar chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba/dgon gnas kyi zhal bdag dang bya ba las kyi 'khor lo sogs 'gro don mdzad pa/legs bshad kyi bstan bcos brtsams pa/rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir chos dbyings su 'dus ma byas pa'i klong du sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa dang bdun las/dang po ni/dri med 'od kyi 'jig rten khams ler/'jig rten kun rdzob tu mos pa sna tsho gos pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad sna tshogs gsungs shing /don dam pa'i bden bas 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad med de/sems can gyi bsod nams dang sdig pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad sna tsho gos su snang ba yin/zhes 'gro ba'i las kyi snang ngor 'char tshul mtha' yas par 'di tsam zhes tshad bzung bar mi nus na'ang mngon ba gong 'og/sangs rgyas mig chad/dus 'khor bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho so gos mdo rgyud du mnas tshad gsungasaba'i chos mdzo ba las/ gling bzhi ba dang nyi zla dang / /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / /sgos pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni//stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod//de stong la ni stong gnyis pa//bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no//de stong la ni stong gsum pa//mnyam du 'dzin cing 'byung ba yin//zhesa'ajig rten gyi khams 'di gcig tu byas pa de 'dra ba stong gi nang tshang ba stong spyi phud/de dang 5bamatshudas pa stong gi grangs tshang ba bar ma'i 'jig /na gyi khams/de lta bu stong gi grangs tshang ba gangs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyechen mtsho'i rgya mtsho chen por brten khor yug gcig gis bskor ba stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams chags 'jig cig car du 'byung ba 'di ni mchog gi sprul sku'i zhing du 'dod la/ theg chen pa'i lugs la bshad ma thag pa de bye ba phrag brgyar rab 'khyams mtshams ྅/ra gcig /de bye ba phrag brgyar rab 'byams rgyud gcig /de bye ba phrag brgyar rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i ma bar ma'i rgyud gcig /de bye ba phrag brgyar gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams sprul pa'i sku gcig gi zhing de rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i ba sbu'i khung bu re dang zhing gi rdul rer yang bye ba phrag brgyar gnas shing thub pa 'di nyid bdag cag gi ston pa longs skur bzhengs pa yin la/ gong gi zhing khams rnams gcig tu bsdoms pa longs sku'i zhing khams rer song tshul 'di yis nam mkha' ji srid khyab par gyur pa de snyed rgyal ba'i zhing dang sku'ang gnas so/ /thub pa de'i lhung bzed du pad+ma'i sdong po nyer lnga gnas pa'i bcu gsum pa'i steng na gling bzhi ri rab bye ba phrag brgyas brgyan pa ni mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sangs rgyas stong la sogs pa 'byon pa'i sa yin zhing / de yang 'jig rten khams ler/ gling ni zla ba 'od dkar can dang rab mchog ku sha dang ni mi'am ci dang khrung khrung dang / /drag po yang ni longs spyod sa ste bdun par dzam+bha'i mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyi sa/ /zhes ri rab kyi ri'i 'og na yod pa'i (6na gling drug ni longs spyod kyi sa dang / de'i phyi rol gyi gling bzhi gling phran brgyad las kyi sa par gsungs pa dang phyogs das pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs nas kyang 'byung la/ dza na skye ba la'o zhes pa'i byings las bsgrubs pa'i dzam+bha'i gling de sa dum bu bcu gnyis rdzogs par ngos bzung ste 'dzam gling chen po dang ri rab lho phyogs kyi gling 'di la chung ngu'i tha snyad du 'dogs na'ang chos mngon pa sogs phal cher du 'dzam gling che chung gi tha snyad mi mdzad cing las kya sa pa yang / bde mchog sdom 'byung du/ shar gyi lus 'phags ba lang spyod/ /de bzhin byang gi sgra mi snyan/ /gling gsum po yi mi rnams ni/ /longs spyod chen pos yang dag 'tsho/ khyim rtog med cing rtog spyod med/ /blun rmongs bye brag mi phyed pa'o/ /'dzam sku gling du legs skyes pa/ /— 186

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)kyilas sa par ra btu grags/ /legs byas nyes par byas pa'i las/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma yi/ /skye ba snga ma'i rnam smin 'dir/ /skye bo kun la mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes lho 'dzam bu gling 'di nyid las kyi sa par gsungs pa'i lte ba rdo rje gdan dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams mchog gi sprul pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya ba'i gnas bskal pa chags 'jig gi dus kyang gzhom zhig dang bral ba/ shar rgya nag gi rgyal khams su 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi pho brang ri bo rtse lnga/ lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas po ta la/ nub phyogs e nyi ya na zhes 'phur 'gro'i theg par mkha' 'gro 'du (6ba tha'i gling rang byung gi gtsug lag khang byang phyogs na chos rgyal rigs ldan gyi rgyal sa sham+bha la'i grong khyer gyis mtshon pa'i zhing dang yul gyi bkod pa mtha' klas na'ang / lha mo dri ma med pas 'i zhus pa mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'phags yul nas brtsis pa'i byang phyogs kha ba can gyi yul ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /su la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes mtsho rnams kong chu brlag tu them nas swā la'i sman ljongs su gyur pa'i spyan ras gzigs dang 'phags ma sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las gdong dmar sha zan gyi phrug gu mang du 'phel te rim gyis mi'i khams su gyur pa/ tshal pa'i deb dmar du/ ma sangs spun dgu/ rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bcu gnyis/ sil ma bzhi bcus rim gyis dbang byas pa dus ring zhig na bod spyi la dbang sgyur ba'i rgyal po ni glang dar tsam ma gtogs btsad po rnams rigs gsum mgon pos mtshon pa'i 'phags chen dam pa'i rnam sprul sha stag tu byung bas na/ bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che'i lha'i rgyal po'i skyes rabs su/ da hril te dril na/ sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' de dag rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul par grags te/ ral pa can la sogs pa gcig gnyis rigs gzhan yin gyi phal che ba ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba rgyal ba'i (7na)'byung gnas nyid yin la/ mkhan brgyud — 187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyebyang chub sems dpa' de rnams ni nga kho na nyid yin gyis gzhan du ma sems shig /ces gsungs pas shes nus shing bye brag 'phags pa sgrib pa rnam sel gyis bskul ba'i rkyen gyis bod 'dul bar byon pa/ de nyid las/ po ta la yi ri bo na/ spyan ras gzigs dbang nga bzhugs tshe/ /sgrib pa rnam sel der byon te/ /mgon po bod kyi yul du byon/ /bod rje gnya' khri btsan por mdzod/ /'gro ba'i don du nges 'gyur gsungs/ /nga ni bder gshegs chos sku la/ /'gro 'ong tha dad mi mnga' mod/ /bod rje gnya' khri btsan por grags/ /snang ngor tha dad du ma 'byung / /zhes bshad pa ltar rgya gar rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i brgyud las rje gnya' khri btsan po lha ri rol po'i rtser byon pa yon tan can gyi mi bcu gnyis kyis mthong ba gang nas 'ongs dris pas nam mkha' la mdzub mo ker bas lha'i yul nas 'ongs pa zhig tu go ste gnya' khri byas gdan drangs pas mtshan yang der thogs shing bod yongs kyis lha btsan por mnga' gsol/ 'di nas bzung gnam gyi khri bdun/ bar gyi steng gnyis/sa'i legs drug /lde brgyad kyi rjes su btsan lngar grags pa'i khri thog rje btsan te rgyal rabs nyer bdun gyi bar chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gyis bskyangs/ nyer brgyad pa'ang de nyid las/ po ta la yi rtse mo na/ /snying rje chen po nga bzhugs tshe/ /kun tu bzang po der byon te/ /thugs rje chen po bod du byon/ /tho tho ri zhes bod rjer mdzad/ /sems can don du nges 'gyur ro/ /nga ni bde gshegs chos(7ba)sku la/ /'gro dang 'ong ba mi mnga' yang / /tho tho ri zhes bya bar grags/ /snang ngor tha dad du ma 'byung / /zhesalha tho tho ri gnyan btsan pho brang yum bu bla sgang du bzhugs pa'i tshe dpang skong phyag brgya pa/ — ma ṇi'i rkos phor gser gyi mchod rten mdo sde za ma rtag gi snying po yi ge drug pa rnams babs pa don ma khrol yang mtshan gnyan po gsang bar btags te mchod pa mdzad pas rgyal po gzhen sha can du gyur te dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu bzhugs par grags/de nas rgyal rabs bzhi pa gnam ri srong btsan gyi sras ni de nyid las/ po ta la yi zhing khamasan/ /brtse ba chen po nga bzhugs tshe/ /thugs rje chen po nyid byon te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho bod du byon/ /bod 188

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)rje srong btsan sgam por mdzod/ /sems can don du nges tsā ra ro/ /nga ni bde gshegs chos sku yin/ /'gro dang 'ong ba mi mnga' yang / /de tshe srong btsan sgam por grags/ /snang ngor tha dad du ma 'byung / /zhes lung gis zin pa'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa thu mi rgya gar du brdzangs te brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos rnams la mkhas par sbyangs nas bod du byon te sngar yi ge med pa la 'bri klog dar bar mdzad/ rgya bal gyi yul nas kong jo dang khri btsun khab tu bzhes pa'i rten skal la jo bo rnam gnyis sogs rten khyad 'phags rnams spyan drangs/ yab yum gsum gyis pha bong kha'i pho brang ma rur sgrub pa mdzad bas rigs gsum mgon pos zhal gzigs lung bstan pa ltar bod srin mo gan rkyal du bsnyel ba'i dbyibs can gyi sa'i me (8na)btsa' rnams bcos te shākya'i rgyal po'i pho brang gi ga rjo la bzhengs pa sogs bstan pa'i srol btod/ de nas mi rabs bzhi pa mes ag tshom gyis paṇ+ḍita sangs rgyas zhi ba dang sangs rgyas gsang ba'i sar mngags pa'i pho nyas blor gzung ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga glegs bam du 'dri ba dang bzhugs gnas kyi lha khang bzheng ba sogasadakon cog gsum la bla mar bzung /de'i sras ljang tsha lha dpon gyi btsun mor rgya mo bza' phyi ma bsus pa rgyal bu sku gshegs te yab dang 'dus pa'i sras/ de nyid las/ po ta la yi pho brang na/ /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnasang bzhugs tshe/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje der byon te/ /dpa' bo wo po bod du byon/ khri srong lde bas bod rjer mdzod/ /'gro ba'i don du nges bar 'gyur/ /nga ni bde gshegs chos sku ste/ /'gro dang 'ong ba mi mnga' yang / /de tshe khri srong zhes byar grags/ /snang ngor tha dad du ma 'byung / /zhes chos rgyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gis 'phags yul gyi gnas brtan chen po ā tsarla bo dhi satwa spyan drangs dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad la brten pa'i la bo nyan mdzad par srid pa'i lha chen dgu dang bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs bod kyi mi ma yin thu bo che rnams bon la dga' bas thog dang shwa 'od nad yams kyi cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan bas yon mchod bka' bgros te srid pa gsum —189

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)na che ba'i sngags 'chang pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gdan 'dren pa'i pho nya brdzangs pa bzhin bal bod kyi mtshams nas bzung rdzu 'phrul gyis thogs med du gshegs nas/ (8ba/sna srin gdug pa can rnams kyi tsha ngar bcag zin yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gegs med du 'byongs/mkhan pos rab byung gi sde btsugs/ slob dpon chen pos ri brag dben gnas thams cad byin gyis brlabs te zab gter sbas/ lo paṇa rnams kyis gsung rab bsgyur nas 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab ste bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ 'di'i sras mu ba btsan pos sde snod gsum gyi mchod pa btsugs shing ltogs phyug lan gsum bsnyoms/ mu rug btsan pos mtha'i so kha bsrungs nas rgya hor gyi yul khams sku'i ma 05 phab/sad na legs mjing yon gyis skar chung rdo rje dbyings kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de'i sras ni de nyid las/ ri rab ri yi rtse mo na/ /lha min 'dul zhing nga bzhugs tshe/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa der byon te/ /sprul pa'i rgyal po 'gro la gzigs/ khyod kyi zhing khams bod yul der/ /da yang bdud sde bsam ngan rgyu/ /mtha' yi bdug pa der lhags te/ /thams cad sdig la bkod pa srid/ /de bas rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / khyed dang dbyer med dpa' bor bgyi/ /de tshe bdag gis 'di skad du/ /ral pa can zhes bod khams su/ /mtha' dmag la sogs bdud sde rnams/ /drag pos 'dul zhing bstan pa bsrung / /zhes mnga' bdag khri lde srong btsan gyis 'u shang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ yab mes kyi dus bsgyur ba'i chos rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ 'on kyang rgyal po sum cu rtsa drug la gshegs rjes gcen dar ma'i (9na)thugs la gdon gsol te bstan pa rin po che 'phel 'grib byung na'ang stod smad gnyis nas so sor thar pa'i bstan pa'i me ro gsos/'e ti dz+nyā na shrī/ mnyam med jo bo chen po mar me mdzad/ kha che'i bsod sgoms pa chen po shākya shrī/rgyal sras nags kyi rin cen sogs paṇ+ḍi ta tshad thub du ma dang / skad gnyis smra ba rin cen bzang po dang / sgra bsgyur rgyal po 'brog mi lo tsā ba gnyis kyis thog drangs mal 'gos mal ba ri rwa gnyan sa — /5()

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)rngog shong dbang chag bu zha lu lo chen gyis mtshon pa'i skad gnyis smra ba rgyu skar gyi 'phreng ba ltar byon nas phyi dar du grags pa'i mdo rgyud kyi srol bla nas blar 'phel/dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i skabs sa rtsis dang chos rtsis gnyis ga'i sgo nas mtha' 'khob tu bshad mod/ bshad sgrub kyi cha nas 'phags yul gyi bstan pa rim gyis 'grib ste phyogs 'di lhag par gyur pas/ khro phu lo tsā ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal gyis kha che paṇ+ḍita chen por phul ba'i zhu 'phrin du/ ma ga dha sogs rigs khrung gnas na sdig to yi/ /dmag tsho gos kyis bcoms o rgyan kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khengs deng sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyesachen byang phyogs cha khas bskyod zhu/ /zhes gsungs shing lhag par 'phags mchog phyag na pad+ma'i 'dul zhing khyad par can yin pas jo bo rje lha gcig rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs na 'od dpag med kyi lha khang zhig yod pa'i nang du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i thugs dam la bzhugs par (9ba)jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mngon sum du bstan zhing gzigs te thugs rje chen po'i zhal nas skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gang yin pa de khyod kyis shes sam 'di nas kyang byang phyogs na nga'i zhing khams yod khyod kyi yi dam jo mo sgrol ma'ang de na sems can gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs khyod kyi gdul bya mang po yang de na yod pas byang phyogs bod du song zhig /ces sras bcas rgyal bas ches cher bsngags pa'i kha bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs 'di'i 'gro ba rnams bka' chems ka khol mar sprel phrug spun bzhi brgya po sde tshan bzhir 'thabs pa dang mes pos bar mtshams byas te zhing la cha bzhir bgos gcig la gcig 'jigs nas tshan bzhir chad pas se dang / rmu dang sdong dang stong ste nang gi mi'u rigs bzhi po rigs kyi phyi mor grags/ drug tu byed na spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa'i yig tshang du/ dga' sdong 'bru gsum dgra dang bzhi/ /nu mo dpa' mda' gnyis te drug tu gsungs par nyang zhes pa dngos su mi gsal yang zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa spyan snga chos kyi — 191 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegrags pas mdzad pa'i khrus khang pa'i rnam thar du phyi'i rus chen ldong la nang tshan bco brgyad du gyes pa'i rog yin te zhes rus de rnams nang gses kyi rnam grangs byung bar sems shing de yang nyang rigs lam rje srong btsan sgam po'i dus rgya nag tu rgya mo bza' gdan 'dren pa'i pho nyar byon pa'i blon po nyang dang / paṇa chen bi mā la'i slob ma nyang ting 'dzin bzang po/ nyang ta thā ga ta/ nyang (10na)shes rab 'byung gnas sogs gsang sngags kyi grub pa brnyes pa zam ma chad par byon pa'i gdung las nyang ston bya khrid 'khor lo dang nyang po che bya ba yab tshan du gyes pa'i bya khrid 'khor lo'i sras gter ston chos kyi rgyal po nyi ma 'od zer dang phyi ma nas brgyud pa bla ma brtson seng ste lho brag nyang tsho dang 'phyong rgyas nyang tshor grags shing de dag las kyang 'phel ba e na nyang chos ldan pas mtshon stod smad du khyab che zhing nyang ston brtson 'grus seng ge'i gcung gi sras bla ma mnyam med chen po nam mkha' bsod nams la sras sku mched lnga byung bar yar klungs sprul sku mched lngar grags pa sman lung pa/ chos ldan pa/ dur khrod pa/ skal ldan pa/ dbang rgyal ba rnams yin pas sprul sku chos mgon pa'i 'phrin yig tu/ nyang ston chen pos bstan pa'i dbu brnyengs nas/ /mnyam med dbon ston bstan pa'i srol chen btod/ /mkhas chen sman lung pa yi dbu bzung nas/ /nyang ban sku mched ring 'dir dar zhing rgyas/ /zhes gsang sngags snga 'gyur ba bka' gter gyi bstan pa phyogs der dbu brnyes srol btod dar rgyas su mdzad tshul gsungs par ma zad gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug gi yab mkhas pa ston nyi'i sku'i skye ba chos ldan pa yin pas sprul skur grags shing sku mched mtha' dag la mtshan de ltar thogs/'di'i dus sman lung gi gdan sar ma byon pas chos dbang rin po ches bka' 'bum du yab nas gras te rin po che skal ldan pa yab sras sam nyang ston dbon po yab sras/ (10ba〉skobs 'gar yar klungs kyi dge bshes shākya 'od dang gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje zhes pa la dgongs nas slob ma rgyal ba rigs lnga yod/ 'og rta mgrin dbang rgyal yod/ ces gsungs/ dus phyis glen bsod nams mgon po'i gdan sa sman lung du bzhugs nas mtshan de ltar thogs/ bla ma 'di nyid kyis bla rdzogs thugs 192

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)gsum/ mdo sgyu sems gsum/ rdzogs bzhi spyod gsum sogs kyi sgo nas 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/khyad par sman sgrub rgya lugs dang gsang rdzogs kyi phyag len gcig tu dril nas snang srid thams cad ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i ngo bor byin gyis brlabs te las can grangs med pa ye shes lnga'i sar bkod/ sgyu 'phrul rgyud don rnam nges skor chos 'a lnga/ bdud rtsig po che'i bkod pas mar lung rigs dang 'grel ba'i bstan bcos du ma mdzad/ spang ston mtshan ldan nyi ma/ sprul sku chos ldan pa sogs gcung mched bzhi/ de dag gi sras brgyad shāka 'bum shāka gzhen gnyis/ g.yin yang dwagasaston dbang rdor/ mgar ston khams ston grags pa/ gnyal ri grong pa/ bal bkod dge bshes kyisagatsos pa'i slob ma mang du byon/ rdzogs pa chen po chos sku bos ma byas pas lhun grub 'od gsal gyi lam mngon du gyur pas/ dwags ston gyi rdzogs chen brgyud 'debs su/ shes bya'i gnas rnams ma lus thugs su chud/ /theg mchog nges don bka' yi gdams pa dang / /gsang ba'i rgyud lung dbang gi chu bo 'dzin/ /rtog tshogs 'od lngar dag pa'i sman (11na〉yung pa/ zhes pa'ang don la gnas/de ltar gcung chos ldan pa dang dur khrod pa gnyis kyi sras nyang ston shākya 'bum dang shāka gzhon gnyis de gnyis kyi sras sman lung pa 'byul zhig bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rma bsod nams pa shākya seng ge /srong btsun pa gzhen dbang gsum las dang po ni shākya dpal/ de'i sras sangs rgyas rin cen/ de'i sras blo gros rgya mtsho/ de'i sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de'i sras nam mkha' tshe dbang bla ma 'dis mnga' bdag chen po nyang ral pa can gyi byang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs bla ma gnyos zhig chen po mthing ma bar grags pa'i gdung rus kha yar nas khra tshang dang de nas gung rur chad pa gung mthing khra gsum zhes sngags sde gsum du gyes pa'i khra tshang pa'i gdung rabs rdzogs te srasamo'i sku mag la byon nas gdan sa yas mas gnyis ka sbrags pas chos rje khra tshang pa dang sman lung pa zhes mtshan gyi 'bod phyogs gnyis su gyur cing / de'i sras nyang dmi gzi brjid dang skam mthu stobasaganyis kyi jo mo yar stod 'chad dkar nas sde pa mkhar ldan pa'i sras mo bud med kyi nyes pa'i skyon —193

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebargyad dang bral ba thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs lhag pa'i lhar bzung ste yi ge drug pa'i nyams len chig dril dang skyes chen mang po'i mtshan nas smos te gsol 'debs brgya phrag mdzad pa dgung lo go gsum gyi bar du bzhugs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i rigs can de khab tu bzhes par dam pa 'di nyid 'khrungs pa'i yul ni chos rgyal mes (11ba)dbon gyi dus dbus gtsang ru bzhir grags pa las g.yon ru ste/ deng sang g.yor po dang g.yo ru zhes sgra zur chag pa'i 'don tshul snang zhing / sa gsum gyi mgon po 'phags pa rin po che dang gong ma se chen rgyal po gnyis kyi dus gnam la nyi zla zung 'brel dang sa la sa hor zung 'brel du gyur pa'i tshe khri skor bcu gsum du phye ba'i phag gru khri skor gyi khongs su gtogs pa 'dzam gling rgyan gcig pho brang sne'u sdong rtse dang ha cang gi thag mi ring ba g.yu pa gzhung zhes 'di med kyi dga' tshal sa la 'phos pa 'dra ba'i cha gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir bstan pa rin po che dbu brnyengs pa lha btsan po'i sku mkhar yum bu gla snang gi bya 'dabs gsang chen rnying ma'i grub brnyes he ru ka dpal mi'i sgyu dra'i gar mkhan rim par byon pa'i bsti gnas khra tshang bla brang du 'phags pa'i yul du stod 'grel ba ltar mang na zhes pa ljongs 'dir myos byed grags shing shar phyogs rgyal po'i khab tu yi wu'i du 'bod pa dbang thang dang bstun pa'i shing mo lug gi lo rta ljang dbang po me bzhi'i dga' ma dang rtse ba'i 'grub sbyor gyi 'phrod dge ba/ nyin mor byed pa shar gyi ri po'i phrag pa las nye bar thon pa'i tshe yum la mi bde ba med par dam pa nyid sku ston mtshan sprin bral gyi mkha' la zla ba shar ba ltar legs par bltams/ gza' skar dus sbyor gyi 'bras bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur pa'i bshad pa yod snang ba de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'khrungs pa'i dus mtshan mkhan gyis/ sa bdag rtog pa po rnams blo gros 'brul/ /rtsod pa'i dus su 'khor los sgyur mi 'byung / /bsod nams (12na lon gyi chos kyi mdzod 'di ni/ /nyes las rnam par rgyal nas sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan pa ltar dam pa 'di nyid kyang mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur ba'i don du mngon/ lhums su yod pa'i skabs slob dpon be+e ro tsa na'i rnam par sprul pa lha bro ba — 194

kho ston khra sgo pa blo gros ma ma gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ (tanamakhas grub chen po dme gu rus byin rlabs gnang zhing bstan pa la phan pa'i sras khyad par can 'khrungs par lung bstan/ gcings nas yum gyi pang thogs kyi dus kyang rje skadze gu ru la tshe dbang gsan zhing byin rlabs kyi mthu dpung thugs rgyud la zhugs pas mdo sgyu sems gsum dang gter kha gong 'og gnyis kyis gtsos gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel 'grig /yab mched gnyis thugs 'dod ma snyoms pa'i rje bla ma dgung lo bzhi'i dus gsol thab so sor gyes pa'i dme mthu stobs yum bcas kyis sman lung du bzhugs/ gsung 'byon pa yong ba nas phyag dpe gzigs pa'i stang ka sogs chos phyogs kyi bag chags kho na ma gtogs byis pa tha mal pa'i ngang tshul ye mi mdzad/ sman lung pa'i gra rgan dbon po nam rgyal zer bas nyin re bzhin gsol zho khyer nas dgos dgos 'di bzhes sku 'chams gnang ngo zhus pa'i tshe phyag gcig gong la dang gcig nam rgyal bar brten nas rtsa tshig dang bstun pa'i 'gros kyi stang ga'i zhabs kyi 'degs 'jog mdzad/ yab kyis mtshan shākya skyabs sbyin du gsol lo/ /phal spyod rnyog ma'i 'dam gyis gos med (12bcung / khungs btsun nyang rigs pad dkar rdzing bu'i dbus/ /dam pa'i ngang tshul ma snyigs spel legs 'dab/ /phan bde'i dga' ston bsu la 'dzum pa bzhin/ /gan jag thang ta'i rnam sprul lha gro pa'i/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsis thugs gsum yongasagatams pa/ /e nyi ya na'i mkhan po'i bstan pa yi/ /bdag por khyod nyid bsngags ched gzengs su bstod/ /gzig shun gos kyis klubs pa'i mgrin pa bzang / /gzhan 'drid rgyal mi re yang srid kun/ /mkhas grub brgyud mar byon pa ma la ya'i/ /dri bsung rtsol bar bltos min ngang gis 'thul/ /gnyis pa yongs 'dzin bsten nas thos pa rgya cher mdzad pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du bsten pa'i gtso bo rgyal ba'i gsung rab las/ mtha' bzhi gangs kyis bskor ba'i ra ba sa sbas pa'i rnal 'byor me long 'dzin pa 'byung : zhes dang / thang yig las/ sna thag sa sa byas hor dmag bod du 'byung : ga song zer yang de 'dra'i sdug bsngal med mi la srid gcad srid srung mang du yong : sems can — 195

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shes 'og non pa'i dus tsa na: gnam skas mkhar chur sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas 'byung : gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug ces bya 'byung :zhes lung bstan pa ltar sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gsung gi sprul pa gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi thugs sras pad+ma dbang chen zhes lang 'gro lo tsā ba dkon cog 'byung gnas kyi rnam par sprul pa gang (13na ti'i gdung brgyud mkhas shing grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba mtshungs med gar dbang rkarma dbang 'byor yar stod sham po gangs kyi nye 'dabs dmi lha khang du bzhugs pa'i dus dgung lo bcu bzhi lon nas zab rgyas kyi chos rnams gnang dgos pa'i gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i tshe thugs mthong shin tu che bas dgyes pa chen pos de bzhin cis kyang legs chos bdag po'i lag tu sprod pa yin zhes zhal gyis 'ches nas thog mar ji skad du/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub thugs dam khyad 'phags skor: gtsor brtan dgos pa kun 'byung thugs gter gcig: lho brag gnam skas can gyi brag la mchis: thugs gter lnga las khyad 'phags 'di kho na ci'i phyir nga yi snying nor mig 'bras yin: mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs: zhes dang / gzhan yang / thugs gter gcig ni lho brag gnam skas can la sbed: khyad par bla ma'i sgrub skor yin: mnga' bdag gsung gi sprul pas 'don par 'gyur:zhes gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi zab gter rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa klu bdud sku stod nas phyung ba bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i dbang lung 'khrid/ g.yin yang gsang ba bla med mchog gi sgrub pa/ gsol 'debs tshig bdun ma/ pad+ma thod 'phreng gsang mtshan gyi sgrub pa/ pad+ma bcud bsdus thabs lam gyi sgrub pa/ sku rked nas byung ba bla ma sku gsum gyi sgrub pa/ bla ma yongs rdzogs kyi dbang /rtsa gsum sgrub thabs dngos grub kun (13bskor grang / bka' rtsis las/ rim gyis byang chub thob thob chos mang gi cig car byang chub thob chos 'di na mchis: de gang zhe na sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor skor mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs: zhes theg pa rim dgu'i yang rtse rgyud sde kun gyi gtso bo — 196

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ tanardzogs pa chen bo sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi smin byed kyi byin rlabs rang rig kun tu bzang po gcer mthong du ngo sprod pa'i nyams 'khrid/ lung yongs rdzogs/ ma brgyud spros bral don gsal chen mo'i rgyud dang bcas pa/ lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring nas dam chos 'dus pa skor dgu gdan drangs pa'i nang tshan bstan pa babs kyi lo rgyus las/ lta ba yangs shing spyod lam bde de phyir thugs rje'i bstan pa rgyab sgom sgrub ma gtso bklags pas ba de phyir thugs rje'i bstan pa rgyas bya bla tshegs chung sgrub thag nye de phyir thugs rje'i bstan pa rgyas: zhes dang / rtsod dus 'phags pa'i 'phrin las dag: o rgyan thugs sras skyes mchog gis: bstan pa'i gsol 'debs dar rgyas byed ces 'phags mchogo thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs yang snying 'dus pa'i dbang lung / g.yin yang 'khor ba dong sprug /bka' rtsis las/ zhi khro bka' brgyad sgos sgrub chos mang gi khyad par yongs rdzogs dril sgrub 'di na mchis: de gang zhe na gsang ba yongs rdzogs skor mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs zhes dang / yi dam rtsa bar gsang ba yongs rdzogs sgrubs dusagasum rgyal ba'i spyi sgrub (14na 'di ga gzab 'di 'chang o rgyan nga dang 'du 'bral med cesabarjod byed kyi tshig ha cang mangs pa dang nyungs pa'i skyon med cing brjod bya'i don zab cing rgya che ba zhi khro yongs rdzogs slob dpon chen po'i thugs kyi thigs pa yin pas/ bde gshegs 'dus pa 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las gsang ba yongs rdzogs mar gyi nying khu phyungs:zhes snying po yang snying de nyid kyi sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i dbang bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa dang bcas pa spros pa shin tu che ba'i sgo nas thugs rgyud yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i nus dbang gi dusakhri mthon po'i steng du rje bla ma bzhugs su gsol bar rgyal ba'i sras po dme dbang 'byor nyid kyi dbu zhwa dang sku ber sgron/ rdo rje dril bu phyag tu gtad khyed chos kyi bdag po yin no/ /zhes gzengs bstod cher mdzad pa e gnyal lho brag gtsang phyogs na gdung brgyud mang zhing gzhan yang bla chen du grags pa'i slob ma mang bas phal cher gyis rje 'di nyid 'gangs chen du mi brtsi na'ang rgyal dbang pad+ma'i —197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyebaka' gter gyi bstan pa spyi dang bye brag gter ston chos kyi dbang phyug gi bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa 'byung 'gyur rtogs pa'i bla ma'i mngon mkhyen dang slob ma'i che ba gnyis ka phan tshun 'gran par snang /nged la dbang stsal skabs bla ma dam pa kurma dbang 'byor 'di ltar gnang ba sku 'khas su 'bul ba la dgongs gsung ba ni gzhan ngo bsrung ba tsam du mngon/ klu bdud dbu nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs sgrub dregs pa tshar gcod kyi dbang lung / rdzogs chen tshe dbang / rta (14bsgo gyin dbu dgu pa/ rta nag lcags ral can/ bka' rtsis las/ pho mo klu gsum sgrub mthu'i chos mang gi: bzlog thabs med pa'i cog rdung 'di na mchis: de gang zhe na ma ning tshig shur skor: mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs:zhes dang / rmi lam nyams 'jigs ltas ngan chos mang gi: mi nag sgos su sgo gcog 'di na mchis:de gang zhe na ma ning yang 'khol skor: mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs: mdze 'bras nad 'byung gtad kyi chos mang gi: hur thum mi sde rtsad gcod 'di na mchis: de gang zhe na klu bdud gan log skor: mthar thug yin no snying gi dkyil du chongs:zhes dpal mgon ma ning gi skor zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i dbang lung / 'jam dpal nā ga raka/ stag zhen byad ma 'bum thub/ mkha' ri zhu lan sogs gter kha 'og ma'i dbang lung man ngag phal mo che/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mnga' bdag nyang rin po che'i bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa/ rta mgrin drag po lha gsum/ rgyud bcu bdun/ le'u bdun pa'i skor gyis mtsho ni pa'i gter kha sna tshogs kyi chos rgyun yang mang du stsal/ thugs la shin tu 'dogs pas bzhes khrung gis cung zad bad pa'i bad 'gong gi rnam pa dang sbrags dbu la phyag byil byil dang phur phur mdzad cing bul chos bum pa gang byor byed do zhes zhar zhor la'ang phyag len dang dka' gnad thams cad yang yang bkrol nas gnang bas thugs la shin tu byang chub pas gter kha gong (15na tshe rog la g.yin dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen pa zla med pa ni nga rkarma dbang 'byor la gtugs pa yin zhes ngom chog pa zhig mdzod ces bka' gnang ba med kyang tsam du ma lus pa phyag thog tu khel ba mchog dman kun gyi mngon sum du — 198

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)gyur la/ rdzogs pa chen po'i sgom nyams mtho zhing rtsa rlung la nang byan chud pa'i bde stong gi ye shes 'dren pa la mnga' brnyes pa bla ma yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs shing dam can srung ma bran du khol zhes sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan la thugs dad dang bka' drin zla med pa'i rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa yin no/ /chos dbang rin po che'i sras chud ba mtshan ldan nyi ma 'od zer gyi gdung brgyud brag sna ba chos dbang bstan 'dzin nyi ma'am kun mkhyen dbang phyug tu grags pa'i drung du bla ma mnga' bdag nyang gi gter byon tshe sgrub mtsho skyes rdo rje'i skor/ rnam thar zangs gling ma/ mkha' 'gro gsang rdzogs/ gsang sngags lam rim/ log tri/ nā ga raka chu srin gdong can/ rta mgrin drag po lha gsum gyi skor/ gter kha 'og ma'i rdzogs chen ci te/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ ma rgyud spros bral don gsal chen mo/ klu bdud sku rked bla ma'i sgrub thabs kyi nang tshan bla ma gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung / rkarma gu ru dar nag ber chen/ phur pa spu gri'i dbang lung / jo mo'i nyams len skor dgu/ mnal lam zhwa nag ma dang rta dkar ma/bka' rgya ma/bkra shis tshe'i rdzong sgrub/ rnam thar mdzad pa bcu gcig pa (15bskogongasagater bka' 'bum/ zhu lan skor/ nyang zhus nges don/ sgrol dkar/ dzam dkar dmar/ dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo/ nā ga raka lcags ral can/ ga pa'i dzam dmar/ phyag rdor dregs 'dul/ dam chen skyer mdung / rdzogs chen thig le gsang skor/ rin cen gling pa'i klu bdud mgo dgu'i sgrub thabs/gnyal ston nag po'i lha chen gtsang shug ma'i skor/ bka' ma snyan brgyud rdo rje zam pa'i dbang lung gis gtsos pa'i gsan pa rgya cher mdzad cing bla ma'ang thugs shin tu mnyes pa'i nged la phyogs mtha'i slob ma yong mkhan dgon par byung khyed kyis ched bstad byon pa legs byung zhes rdo rje gling pa'i dngul chu sngags kyis 'dul ba'i man ngag gis mtha' brten pa'i gdams pa che chung la ma bltos pa mtha' dag sba bsris med par gnang zhes thugs mos che zhing bla ma 'di nyid ha cang gi mkhas tshul mi ston yang slob dpon chen po'i zhes yang yang gzigs pa sogs grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs zhes bsngags brjod mdzad/—199

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshebul shing dgon par rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa chen po nam mkha' chos dbang zhes mkhas grub dmi gu ru'i dbu mdzad chen mor grags pa la theg pa chen po snyan brgyud rdo rje'i zam pa grub thob dngos grub nas nye bar brgyud pa'i bka' brgyad bka' ma rdzong 'phrang gi skor/ rin chen gling pa'i tshig chod kun grol gyi dbang lung / nyang gi bla ma dmar 'brang / shin tu zab pa khros nag gi dbang lung /thugs rje chen po 'gro 'du' yid bzhin (16na skor bu/ mgon po g.yul bzlog skor/ paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bi mā la me tra'i thugs bcud gter ston mdang ma lhun rgyal gyis dbu ru zhwa lha khang nas gdan drangs pa'i zab pa pod bzhi'i skor/ 'od gsal sgrol ma drug skor gyi lung rags pa/ gter kha 'og ma'i rdzogs chen ci ti'i rgyud skor nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ sgrub thabs dngos grub kun 'byung le'u bco brgyad pa/ mnal lam zhwa nag ma dang rta dkar ma/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ gter ston gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar/ bka' chems gter 'byung chen mo/ lha bu btson 'dzin gyi gdams pa/ rgya ban rdo rje dbang phyug gis lho brag mkhar chu nas gdan drangs pa'i rtag tu ngu'i bcud len/ grub thob me long rdo rje'i rnam thar le tshan lnga dang mgur 'bum/ do ha skor gsum/ yab mnyam med chen po'i rnam thar/rin cen 'od 'bar sogs bka' 'bum thor bu/ sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i rnam thar gyis mtshon pa'i zab chos shin tu mang ba gsan zhing bka' drin che ba'i bla ma gcig tu mdzad/gsang chen slob bshad kyi sngags gra bkra shis chos kyi sder sgrigs 'grim mdzad nas rgyang tsam bzhugs 'phags yul gyi grub chen ku ku ri pa dang bod yul 'dir dpyal ston chen po sogs mkhas grub du ma'i rnam par sprul pa rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi drung du dgung lo bdun pa'i tshe dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang tshe dbang grub rgyal ma lcags sdong ma yongs rdzogs lha 'khrid du bstar (16ba)ba'i zab gnad kun lhug par gsan pas chos bka' rgya che che mo zhu ma thub rung gcig shes kun grol lta bu'i bogs che zhing sems thog tu babs pa byung gsung ba yang thos/ 'brum nag mched pa zhig la bslab ston zhus par o lo rang bred mi dgos zhes byin rlabs dang srung ba gnang bas dus der ma —200

to ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ tanazad gzhan don du mi gshegs par rdo rje tsher ma'i nad dbus gtsang du lan bdun brgyad tsam byung bar ched du gnyer ba'i 'dzem cha ma thub rung 'gos pa gtan ma byung ba dam pa de'i bka' drin yin zhes thugs gting nas gus pa'i rnam 'gyur dang gsung 'phros yang yang gnang /dam can srung ma sprin bzhin 'du ba'i gnas rtses dang bsam gling bde ba chen po'i gtsug lag khang sne'u sdong gong ma chen pos bar skabs su rtsis sprod gnang nas bzhugs dus dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang yar klungs pa khu dbon gyi dus kyi rten thug bka' shin tu gnyan pas 'gyel chag tu gyur te gzhan gyis lag tsam yang reg ma nus par lus pa rnams nyams gsos kyi dgongs pa gtad nas grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur pa bi rū pa dang rdo rje 'amang tshar pa chos rje sogs kyi sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi drung du gnyis med rgyud kyi rgyal po kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang / gur lha brgyad thun mong ba dang zhal bsnyen dus kyi mgon po'i rjes gnang gsan pa'i dusakhyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos rnying mar stong tshigs kyi mchod pa zhes dang 'ga' zhig bstod tshigs kyi mchod pa (17na phri khi gsung ba ji ltar yin phebs par stong tshigs kyi mchod pa yin tshul dang / gzhan yang rgyud las/ stong stong mtshams su khro rgyal bskul/ /zhes sogs yod tshul zhu ba gnang bas gsar ma la'ang rnam rgyal stong mchod ces gzungs sngags stong stong gi mtshams su mchod ces gzungs sngags stong stong gi mtshams su mchod pa 'bul ba yod/ gsar rnying dgongs pa los gcig gsungs phyag thal mo sbyar dgyes dgyes gnang zhing rnying ma'i chos skor mang tsam zhu 'dod kyang zhus dkon pa byung / da cha gang bzhugs stsol dgos pa'i gsol btab mdzad de dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bur gyur/gzhan yang zab lam nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs chos skor gyi lung / dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs bgragasum ma/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor lha brgya dang zhe gnyis/ gshed dmar lha lnga/gur mgon gri gug lha lnga/ rnam 'joms dkar bo/ phur bskru gri/ phur pa dpyal lugs rnams kyi dbang /—201

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs/ byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol gter kha gong ma'i drag po gzhung chen bde gshegs 'dus pa/ 'bring po me'i spu gri/ chung ba dpa' bo lha gsum/ g.yin yang thems med sogs chos skor yongs su rdzogs pa rdo rje spyi blugs 'bring po me'i spu gri'i dbang bcas/chos dbang gi yang gsang drag po rta skad can/ 'khor ba dong sprug /tshe sgrub bu ston gong khug ma/ dpal mgon ma ning gi srog dbang shin tu rgyas pa/ chu mo phug (17bskos gu ru tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis spyan drangs pa'i drag po spyan mang / gnubs lugs stag zhen gyi rgyud le tshan dang dbang / zhal glang gdong ma dang khyung zhal can/ bram nag bshan pa drug skor rnams kyi rjes gnang dang gnyan lo'i gter ma'i bram ze dkar po'i sgrub thabs/ rta mgrin zla rgyal lugs/ seng gdong nag mo/ 'char ka sgrom bu ma bka' gter/ o rgyan gling pa'i stag zhen gyi dbang lung / dpal 'dzin gyi 'jigs byed pod chung / 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i lung gis mtshon gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos bka' mtha' yas pa gsan/ sku chas dbul po byung bar chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyi gter gsar dbyug gu skrun gsum gyi dbang lung gnang ba nas bzung longs spyod kyang rim par 'phel gsung / dam pa 'di nyid mkhas grub kyi tshad du 'dzin pa'i thugs shin tu gus par mdzad/rje mnyam med dwags po zla 'od gzhon nu'i slob ma khams pa mi gsum phyi nang tshan rje dbu se dus gsum mkhyen par grags pa'i nye gnas nam mkha' 'od de nas rje grags seng sogs drung rtogs ldan pa rim pa gsum gyi bar ga rma pa na rim gyi bu chen mgo 'og tu lus chud yin na'ang / bzhi pa thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang pos snyigs dus kyi mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu 'gos ye bzang rtse pa gzhen nu dpal dang khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde sogs thub bstan (18na〉(ngas rdzogs kyi bshes gnyen du ma bsnyen nas shes bya'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i rtser son/ a pa'i gsol zhal gog po la gtsang gtsang mo'i rmongs chen mi mdzad par dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i rgyud sde'i bshad srol dang phyag len mdzad pas ra pho dkar po —202

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ tanalug khyur mi 'gre zhing 'dzam gling chos grags rgya mtshos thub chen gdan sa bting nas rtsod pa lhur len gyis 'phrin las skyong bar thugs ma rangs te kho bo zag pa mi 'phel ba'i sar gnas gzhi 'ding zhes bde chen yangs pa can gyi chos sde btsugs/sa skyong don yod rdo rje gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi sbyor bas chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs ming gi lhag mar gtong bar nye tshe mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa mdzad pa sogs la drung rtogs ldan pas nad pa sman gzhung bzhin ma na snyam pa'i phyir 'bud dang rjes su rje mi bskyod pa dbyangs can dga' bar grags pas ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po zhig 'di ltar bzhed ces zur za ba'ang mdzad snang / gtso bor gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po dpal phag mo gru pa spyan snga ngag gi dbang phyug zhing gzhan du gshegs/gong ma chen po kon ding ta'i go shrī chen hong wang sku nar ma son pa'i bar du rgyal khab chen po sne'u sdong rtse'i dpon sa'i go sa dang gdan sa mthil kun bzang nags khrod kyi spyan snga zung du 'brel ba'i sgo nas bod shing sgo can gyi rgyal srid nyams pa med pa'i mdzad bzang la brten dpon sa gong ma rim byon dang khyad (18ba)par med pa'i lung las kyi mngon par mtho ba nas sgar phyogs kyi drung rtogs ldan pa zhes spyan mas 'gebs mdzad pa'i spros pa dang bral ma pang du bu ma shong ba'i zhwa dmar nag gnyis zhal mdzes tsam las bya rog 'ug pa'i brtul zhugs su gyur pa de bzhin yin la/ spyan snga rin po che zhi bar gshegs rjes stod lung du bde chen sprul skur grags pa shin tu gsal ba byon par chos rgyal 'bri gung pa chen po rin cen phun tshogs kyis bdag rkyen dang / byang stag lung nas kyang de dang phyogs mtshungs gnang na'ang rje mi bskyod rdo rjes/ zhwa dmar can gyi char pa babs gyur kyang / /nga yi zhwa dmar dkon cog yan lag yin/ /phun sum tsho gis par gyur na rjes yi rang / /dngos su mjal snyam 'gram chu mi ldang ngo / /zhes kong po skyem pa'i zhal ngar tshongs pa de la ngos bzung ba'i sprul sku bye ba ther 'bum gyi dbu tshugs/—203

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)rje dkon cog yan lag gi sprul sku 'bri gung skyu ra'i rigs su sku bltams pa dpal ldan gar dbang chos kyi dbang phyug don kun yongs su grub pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba khams phyogs kyi 'gro ba rnams mthong bas don ldan du mdzad nas yar phebs/ ring po ma lon par gtsang skur gnyen srid rdo rje'i brag lta bu'ang dus kyi chad pas dum bur song ba'i bde gzar cher langs pas yar klungs shar nub mthil gsum du ston tog bsdu rgyu ma byung bas rkyen byas rnying lugs kyi bla ma lnga tsam zhig gsol chas kyis brdugs te da ji ltar drag gam zhes 'gro lding pa'i ngang nas zhwa (19na)dmar thams cad mkhyen pa'i sgar du byon par thag bcad pa'i ya gyal zhig rje 'di nyid yin la/ gar lugs 'di khog yangs shing mdzad pa rlabs che bas 'di chung 'di mi chung ces ris su chad pa med gshis khong dpon slob rnams thun mong du gur dkar nag g.yabs thab chas rta drel gyi rtsis 'khri/sgar pa dpe 'gre'i 'phogs dang gzims gur 'gag tu nyung ja bsgugs chog pa sogs thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung / bla ma gzhan rnams kyi lo gcig tsam nas dgongs pa zhus te so so'i gnas su byon/ rje bla ma'i thugs la thog mar sgar du 'jug rkyen de bzhin yin yang zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa 'di nyid mdo sngags dang tha snyad sogs shes bya rig pa'i gnas lngar mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa deng sang bod 'dir bla chen kun gyi nang nas 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig mchis pas re zhig zhabs kyi pad+ma bsten nas thos bsam rgya che ba mdzad par dgongs te thog mar bar ma rab byung nas bzung bsnyen rdzogs bar gyi sdom pa rnams zhu ba mdzad pa'i tshe mtshan rkarma blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rjer 'dogs pa gnang / sgar phyogs kyi bsnyen rdzogs pa rnams kyang rngul len dang lding slog sogs gos sbu gu can la mchor chas su byed pa'i spyan ltos ma mdzad par rab tu byung ba'i rtags kho na lhur blangs pas rje nyid kyi dpe zlar 'os pa lo tsā ba bstan pa tsam ma gtogos ma byung bas gangs babs pa'i thegs shig gur sdud pa'i tshe lo tsā ba bstan par zla bo zhig gis stod gos g.yar (19ba〉na btang ba mgo mjug slog nas gyon 'di bzhin 'dug byas par da nang min pa rkang gos dang lag gos ang de gyon ma myong byas skad/—204

to ston khra k+ṣe pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhabs drung du dus 'khor/rgyal ba rgya mtsho/phag mo/dgyes rdor lha dgu/bde mchog lha lnga/kun rig/tshe dpag med rtsa gsum dril sgrub rnams dbang /phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/bcu gcig zhal/'jam dkar/sman bla sprul sku'i rjes gnang /tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig/phyag chen chos drug gi 'khrid sogs/ga rma dam tshang lugs kyi dbang 'khrid rjes gnang du ma/gzhan yang klu sgrub lugs kyi sems bskyed/dbu ma 'jug pa/mngon rtogs rgyan/mdo sde rgyan/mngon pa mdzod/spyod 'jug/'dul ba'i bslab bya rgyas pa/dpe chos rin wo spungs pa/zab mo nang don/spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i bka' 'bum/blo sbyong skor/ga spungs rabs so bzhi pa kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i kha skong dang bcas pa'i ljags lung gi ris gang thob gnang /rgyun par gzims gur du dpe mtshams lta bus dus 'khor bsdus rgyud/kye rdor rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/rgyud gsang ba snying po/rgyud bla ma/sum rtags/snyan ngag me long gis gtsos pa'i rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po'i rtsa ba thugs la 'dzin pa/ṭīka 'grel rnams la gzigs rtog gis mtshone pa'i gsan sbyongs lhur gnang /'on kyang sgar pa 'phrin las che zhing phyogs kun tu phebs dgos pa'i stabs byes la gzhis bcol ba lta bus thugs ka khengs 20na ) pa'i phyag dpe rang ni ma byung gsung /shangs su sde pa lha bu bas chos rgyal rin chen phun tshogs kyi gter gsar rdo rje gro lod kyi dbang zhugadus dbang rdzas kyi phur pa ma rnyed par sde pa chos rgyal pho brang pas bsnyen phur g.yor bar byung ba dbang gral du chud ba'i gsol btab mdzad pas rjes su bzung /zab bu gdan sa pa mtshungs med sa me dbang rgyal gyis zhus pas don gnyer can kha shas la mkha' 'gro snying tig gi ljags lung stsal ba lhan du gsan/lung nas gnyan ba'i ris kha shas byed mi nus gsungs nas ma gnang zhing dbang yang ma byung 'bri gung pa'i zhal ngor gong gshis rnying chos rgya che ba ye thob bsams rung de phyogs la dgongs ba shin tu ma gtod bas gnang ba'i spros ba dang bral/tshes ba chu'i dus dbang dang dngos grub kyi daX ba ni sgar phyogs la ci yang mi 'dug/gtor ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyemago la bzhag nas badz+ra gu ru gsung ba'i byin rlabs yong ba nged lhan du sdod mi'i rnying bla lnga po dang bla ma 'ol bab sogs kyis lkog tu 'di 'dras dbang dang dngos grub gang gi'ang go mi chod pa 'dra zhes glengs na'ang phyi yul dul ba ga la nus/ 'on kyang thams cad mkhyen pa de gar dbang snang ba mtha' yas dngos yin pas/ tshig gi bdag pos tshigs su bcad/ /ces pa ltar gang gnang yang tshabs su 'gro ba zhig yod pa gzhir bcas gsung / dpon slob zhwa dmar bar yang ri drung pa phyogs nas byung ngam zer gang ltar gsol zas ngan pa zhig gis sku ltem babs lci bar tshang mas sku rim brtan bzhugs 'phrod (20ba)bsten la 'bad pas bstan 'gro'i sman yon du dwangs skyed che bar gyur te sgar spo ba'i nyin zhig rgya 'dre'i 'tshub lhongs kyi rnam pas thugs 'khrul bas gzims dpon sde pa spel chung par 'ol ba ngag dbang chos grags ma gtogs rta pa thams cad kyis ber zlam dang bse theb zhe gcig la rta rgyab tu spre'u re bskyon 'dug pa 'di 'dra ci yin zhes dri ba gnang 'dug /chibs rags bsgrigs ma dam drags gshis nged rta chas rnal bas khal ma'i zla la 'gro dgos pas chibs rags kyi zhabs phyir med gsung bar dpags na mkhas btsun gyi yon tan gzigs pas zhwa dmar bas phyi ltar du phyag phyi'i gras su gnang yang thugs kyi 'jog so bla ma kho na'i mos pa mdzad/ de'i stabs kyis sgar pa dmangs ma'i sems la ma ran pa'i skur zhus kho na byed pa yod tshul gra rigs 'dras gleng ba bla mar bstod bsngags kyi lugs yin 'dra yang / gsung ston pas/ slob ma dad pa can gyis bla ma zog por gtong gsung ba'i dper mchis rje dbu se dang nye gnas nam mkha' 'od gnyis khams kyi ri khrod gcig tu bzhugs pa'i brag phug gi ser kha nas sbrul thon pa de yang ri drung pa kun dga' lhun grub yin pa'i smon lam dang rten 'brel mdo khams su zhwa dmar nag nang zhig pa'i rkyen byas sam zer slar yar stod lhun po sgang du rkarma pa yon mchod lho brag dpa' bo'i rim 'degs dang bcas yang ri ba rnams sarba la btang thos sgar pa phyogs gcig tu 'dril te rgyal ba yab sras nyi zla zung 'brel (21na)du song /yab sras thams cad bsam yas su phebs pa'i tshe dpe gar lcog tu dregs pa'i sde dpon tsi'u dmar —206

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)pos rgyal ba da rma par/ zhwa nag 'og gi ban chung khyod/ /dam tshig de thub bam mi thub ces ral gri rdag dog dang bcas te 'tshub pa'i rnam 'gyur ston tshe zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pas dmod nas mdzad pa'i mus la cod ban 'dzin pa zhes 'jam mus kyis 'gro ba zhig yod pa spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i dus rtse 'khri mdzad pa dang sku tshe 'dir 'bri gung gi zhal ngor 'byungs par chos skyong bzos che ba yin 'dra gsung /sgar pa yab sras gtsang phyogs su phebs ga rma pa dbang phyug rdo rje gshegs nas sgar mang ma'i thugs khur dpon slob zhwa dmar bas mdzad pa 'di res sprul sku chos dbyings rdo rje la chos 'jig rten gnyis ka gra chag gru ma nyams par rtsis 'bul zhu ba gnang skabs tshes bcu'i 'chams kyi gzigs mo rgyas par phul ba'i bla ma sku skyes byin dbab/ sde pa pho brang pas gtum rngams/ rje bla mas tshogos len gyi 'chams dpon mdzad pa dgongs par 'byor che ba'i gtang rag tu chibs sga spu len srab rmed sogs cha 'grig legs pa zhig stsal/ de nas bzung chibs rags kyi phyags phyir yang chud/ brag kha gzims shag pa'i chos mdzad 'khor zhag tu song ba'i gzhis ka rtser phebs dus kho pa'i chab kyi phyag phyag khyer mi gyis phebs par las chan du chud dgongs pa'i mnyes tshor che ba byung / rgyun du bzhugs sgar las rdzong du mi bzhugs na'ang zhag bco lnga (21bskom zhig gi bar dme pa dpon slob bcu/ zhwa dmar ba brgyad/ drung pa lnga rnams rdzong du bzhugs par gsol thab kyang ma bzung ba'i gtsang gzhung nas khas tag shin tu smin pa mdzad pa de khrod du chud mi a kyi gleng brjod kyang yong gin yod 'dug /rdzong du zhag bzhugs la phebs nyin phyag phyag dol po chos mdzad gzhen par bskur song bar zhal skyengs pa'i nyams kyis rdzong du gdan 'dren la'ang ma phebs par gur nang du bzhugs/ re zhig bka' chos gsan pa dang sku yon sbyong dar mdzad pa las phugs yul gar lugs mdzad pa mi 'char gzhi bzhag gis dar lugs kyi cho ga chos spyod rnams thugs la ma bzung zhing dbus gtsang gi mi rnams kyang sgar skad zer ba'i khams skad 'dra mo zhig byed dgos kyi yod snang ba ma mdzad pas bla ma khra tshang —207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyeb zer ba 'di rnying ma ba'i chos khob khob 'di dang yar klungs pa'i skad treb treb 'di la 'gyur rgyu yang mi 'dug ces dmangs mas sdang ba tsam zhus 'dug /ma nas rab gnas kyi dogs sel sogs gsar ma phyogs kyi gsung 'phros phal cher la zha dmar ba drug pa 'di bzhed ces tshad mar 'dzin cing mkhas btsun bzang gsum mtha' dag gi sgo nas thugs dad ni che bar snang /'on kyang zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa nyid kyis yol mo gangs ra'i rdo rje gling du mdzad pa'i bcad lhag spel ma'i glu las/ slob ma bzang mang thon pa de/ /bla ma'i yon tan gtso bo zhes/ /mkhasagrub rnams la grags gyur na/ /de ci khyod la ldan mthong ngam/ /nged la slob (22na〉spra bzang po mang po yod zer ba'i grags pa don du gnyer ba yin na sprul sku skyes chen mkhan slob bla chen sku che rigs btsun sogs grangs 'dren rgyu ni lag ma thogs pa yod kyang / ma la/ rang la 'khor ba'i bu slob 'khod/ /mkhas btsun bzang por bskyed nas kyang / /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung nus pa/ /kye ma shin tu dkon pa byung / /ci zhig 'di lta bu 'byung ba'i rgyu ni gang yin na/ pha rol gzhan gyi skyon ni cung zad kyang ma yin te/ phru bar med pa'i gzar bu bzhin/ /rang rgyud yon tan med pas na/ /gzhan la de ltar mi 'byung ba/ /gtso bo'i rgyu ni de nyid yin/ gcig tu rang rgyud la bslab shes kyi yon tan smin par med pa dang /gnyis su gang shes pa'i chos de yang zla gcig sbrel ba'i 'chad nyan mi nus pa dang / gsum du go sa mthon por btags nas snyoms chung shes ldan gyi dri smed byed pa lta ga la zhig gam du 'ong sa yang med cing zhu mi nus zer spa bkong ste gnas dgos pa dang / bzhir na de tsho thams cad 'ong ba'i rtsa ba 'ur sgrob rnam g.yeng gi 'khor lo bskor ba ste skyon rtsa rang rkyen bzhi po der 'dus 'dug go /zhes pa ltar sku dbyings ha cang ches pas bka' chos kyang gzhan gyi zhor sgug las rkang btsugs zhu gnang gi sba mi phigs shing de yang thugs brel gyis sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba dkon zhing sgra snyan sdeb sbyor rtsis la sogs tha snyad dang gzhung lugs kyi dogs gcod zhu ba'i skabs kyang cher mi yong bar ma zad phyi ltar du 'gro ba mtha' dag la ris med pa lta bu las (22ba)don du gzhis rtse'i nang mgron ltar spyi —208

kho ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ (tanaspyi'i nang gi sger sger gyis mtsho ni dge skyon du ma nas rje dme dbang 'byor la chos 'phro zhu ba dang bla ma gzhan dag bsten pa khe che bar mkhyen nas dgongs pa zhus pas sku zhabs su shog gsungs nas nyid rang dar lugs phyogs gtogos byed pa bzhin ma byed dar bstan 'di rang gang 'dra byed mi shes khyed rang ni mnyam med chen po nas bzung sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs rnying ma'i skyes chen mang rab cig byung 'dug bas spyir rnying ma yang sgos pha chos rang la nyams len mdzod kyi bslab don zhib rgyasaganang ba mngon par mkhyen pa min pa'i kha mtshon mi chod mod phal cher rje chos dbyings rdo rje'i mdzad pa ba'i nyal lugs kyi be'u ldan kyog skye ba mkhyen rlabs kyis chod pa 'dra'o/ /gtsang rong gong rar mang rong gter ston 'jam dpal rdo rje zer ba zhig byung ba la thang yig nang gi bde chen gling pa dang gcig par 'dod/ gang ltar gter ston tshad ldan byung tshod du 'dug /gter ston de la sras sogs kyi brgyud 'dzin mkhan ni byung ris min 'dug pas bla ma chos nyid rang grol gyi rigs brgyud nyi zla grags pa zer bas gong ra bzung sdo pa snang rtse bas chos bdag byas/ de'i rjes su gong ra ngag gi dbang po zhes sgra snyan ngag la shin tu mkhas pa byung rin spungs zhabs drung ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyi dgongs par yang bde/ zhwa dmar sprul sku drug pa'i rig gnas kyi slob dpon yang yin zer ba de'i tsha bo gong ra lo tsā ba gzhan phan rdo rje zhes sgra ka lā pa/ snyan ngag me long / sdeb sbyor mngon brjod la byang ba sog bzlog pa blo (23na)gros rgyal mtshan dang snying phu rigs 'dzin gyis gtsos bla ma du ma bsten nas sngags rnying ma la thos rgya che ba gter kha gong 'og gis thog drangs snga 'gyur byings bden med du rtogs shing sangs rgyas gling pa dang snang rtse ba gnyis bden 'dzin mngon du gyur pa rgyud la ldan pa'i khengs rlomes can de'i drung du 'byon pa'i rkyen sman lung gi yab yum gra ris rnams kyis jo mo len rtsis byas pa rje 'di nyid tshangs par spyod pa'i brtul zhugs 'phags pa 'od srungs chen po ltar shin tu brtan pas thugs la ma bzhed nas re zhig 'phul thabs su rig gnas bslab par snyad de gong rar phebs/—209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesngar sgar du bzhugs dus tha snyad kyi skor sbyang bzhed kyang zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos/ tshul de lta mod kyi spur rgyal 'dir/ /g.yin kun la phyogs med gtong ba dang / /rang legs bshad 'tshol bar rlom na yang / /don sbyin len gnyis ka gser las dkon/ /zhes pa ltar zhib cha mdzad rgyu ma byung bar brten lo chen pā ra hi ta'i drung du legs par sbyar ba ka lwa pa'i mtshams sbyor/ ming le/ kun bshad/ kro ta rnams kyi sa ris yongs rdzogs/ snyan ngag me long le'u gsum gyi rtsom rgyugs sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas sogs rig pa'i gnas rnams la rtag 'grus su mdzad/ gzhan yang thugs sgrub drag po rtsal/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus/ khra mo brag gi bla ma spyi 'dus/ rat+na'i rta mgrin gsang 'dus/bi mā la'i snying tig /bstan gnyis gling pa'i sangs rgyas dgongs 'dus/ nyang gi (23ba)phyag bzhi pa/nā raka dong sprug /sangs gling pa'i thugs rje chen po/ spo bo pad+ma rigs 'dzin gyi bla ma zhi drag rnams kyi dbang lung / gsang skor snyan brgyud shangs lugs/ nyang gi gsang sngags lam rim be+e ro'i 'dra 'bag sogs bka' gter gyi chos mang ba gsan/ khyad par 'gro mgon dung mtsho ras pa'i yang ti nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig la rtags thon pa byung gsung / dbang bskur gyi phyag len brjod mi gtsang ba med cing lung gi ras klog bzang bas 'gro che ba 'khrid 'bog lugs kyang legs rab yod 'dug rung rdzogs pa chen po lta ba'i klong nas yod rgyu'i khul gyis sgrub mchod tshul ldan ye mi mdzad cing dkyil 'khor la'ang thig tshon gyi cho ga gang yang med par mdos dkyil dkyus ma ltar gang bder 'bri ba zhig yod snang /lho brag nas gu ru zer ba'i bla ma zhig gis sku tshab mthong grol khungs btsun pa khyer nas byu ru spos shel g.yu mu tig 'dra dang e brje zhes 'ongs pa rje nyid kyis gtsos pa'i chos zhu ba rnams kyis de 'dra'i rin med ces phyir slog tshar nas lo chen gyis de 'dra byung ba nged la 'phros mi gtong ba gsungs khro ba'i rnam 'gyur mdzad par de zhi bar sman 'di rang zab ces snang rtse gter ston gyi gter chos rnams dgos pa'i snyan gsan phul nas lha zhi klu zhir song skad sog bzlog bka' dam pas de —21()

kho ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ (tanaskor ma gtogs pa'i ga kho chos tshang ma gsan/zhang sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms dang /mchog gi sprul sku rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa gter chen nyi zla 'od zer gyi sprul pa'i zlos gar byang pa rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po chos rgyal bstan pa'i 24na ) rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs 'bring du bzhugs nas sku ber 'khur ba sogs gzims dpon gyi las tshan mdzad/dkyil 'khor gyi dbang kha shas dang gdams pa 'dra ma gtogos pa'i mnyam sbyor gyi 'khrid chen brgyad/thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i lung thor bu/'tsho rgyal gtsug gi rgyan gcig/sems bskyed bstan pa'i snying po/kha 'bar ma dkar nag khra gsum/phra men thun gyi bzlog pa'i 'chong /rta mchog yid bzhin nor bu/cho ge rgyal mtho'i mtshan can gyi gsung kha shas/gnyan lo'i gter ma'i dpal mgon dar khra can/tshe dpag med 'chi med dpal ster sogs zab chos kha shas gsan/dbang brda 'phrod cing phyag len gtsang bar snang /lung ljags klog dal drags pa dang thugs brel sogs 'gro che ba mi yong 'dug gsung /nub cig thun drug gi gsol 'debs 'ur ding nge ba ma byung bas nged rang tsho la gzhan ni lag rjes gang yang med yab chos rgyal ma bla'i mtshan can gyi phyag bzhes le'u bdun thun drug ma yod khul 'di'ang khyed tshos byed rgyu min pa e yin zhes phyi rol tu byon nas bka' bkyon tsha drag gnang ba zhig thos/gzhan mtshan mo'ang sku zhabs su bcar sdod byas rung thugs rgyud shin tu ldongs shing mas bcas mtshan med kyi zab bzhes 'phel ba 'phral du nged rang la yon tan med ces dman cha mdzad na'ang mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi gting dpog par mi nus pa zhig yod gsung /sngon rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang gi lang gro'i sngags 'chang lo tsā ba dkon cog 'byung gnas kyi gdung las rta nag sgrol ma sbug pa bsam grub rdo rje/sangs rgyas rin chen/nam mkha'i rnal 'byor sogs lha ru gaḥdapal gosadakar lcang le'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa sha stag tu byon pa'i rigs las sgrol sbug nas sku 'bring ba zhes chos blon pad+ma gung btsan gyi rnam sprul yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bu'i gter gsar du las

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyecan snying gi bu bdun 'byung zhes pa'i nang tshan/ dpal gyi rdo rje'i skye ba zhig: gsang ba'i tshul du slob dpon byed: ces lung gis zin pa'i mkhas grub de la se ston chen po'i dbang chog nges don bde 'jug gi steng nas 'jam dpal tshe bdag phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs dang / sgron ma drug pa sogs lcags 'dra'i chos skor gyi lung gsan/ thang yig nas bshad pa'i gter ston las 'phro gling pa 'khrul med cig lho brag chos steng dgon par byon bco lnga'i lo la gter bzhes/nyer lnga'i lo la sku 'das pa zhig byung ba dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi gsung las/ yongs la tshad mar grags pa'i rdo rje gling / /de yi ngos bzung nor ba ga la srid/ /ma nor las 'phro gling pa ci la nor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar som nyi ga la yod/ 'on kyang 'gro 'dul las lo gling pa/ gar dbang las 'phro gling pa/ chos 'byung las 'phro gling pa/ 'ja' tshon las 'phro gling pa sogs phyogs kun nas tab thob dir ri ba byung ba'i bang ri 'ja' tshon snying pos/ sdong po gnyis po dmar nag zhwa yi ming :zhes sogs kyi lung bstan dang bcas mtshur phur byon pa zhwa dmar mchog gi sprul sku zhing khams 'phos (25na〉spyab cing rgyal ba dmi pa chos phyogs la gzigs pa mi 'jug pas/ gter chos rnams dbon po phyag mdzod pa brgyud nas phul gsung bar brten zlos gar ra mjug gi tshos rgyag ma brin pa'i yar klungs su phyir log 'byon skabs brag khar rje nyid kyis dkon cog spyi 'dus kyi dbang lung gsan/ phar chos dbang gi ma ning skor dgos gsung ba dpe med tshul zhug pas thob yig e yod/yod na de ka klog pas chog gsungs byung zhes thugs ya zhi ba mdzad 'dug /'ja' tshon snying po gu yangs drags pas der ma zad dpon slob mjal res med par yang chos 'chad nyan yong ba'i rgyal ba zas gtsang gi sras po las spangs rtogs mtho ba tsam yod par grags/nyams dang rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag bris pa bla chen chos rgyal rdo rje'i drung du gter chen chos kyi rgyal po nyi zla 'od zer nas brgyud pa'i 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo/ 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i rtsa gsum dril sgrub dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ 'char ka gnubs lugs dang gnam skas ma'i brgyud pa chu bo —2/2

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)nyis 'dres kyi zor dbang sogs zab chos mang du gsan/ yab rje khra tshang pa chen po nyang ston ga me mthu stobs dang / dme gzi brjed la mnga' bdag gi byang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs mthing ma ba gnyos zhig chen po nas bzung khra tshang pa zhal ngo nang brgyud kyi khro bo rol pa'i lung phyag len zhib par gsan pas mun nag 'dom 'jal gyi khro rol mkhas po rnams dang ye mi 'dra ba'i pad+mā ka ra'i gzhung dang man ngag gzhal bzhes gnyis shig mdzub (25ba〉sprod rgyu yod pa'i phul du phyin pa thugs su chud/gzhan yang / mkha' ri'i zhu lan/ 'char ga'i mdos 'khor gyi phyag len phra zhib/ badze mthu stobs la sger du chos ldan pas mdzad pa'i bla ma gsang 'dus kyi las byang dang sgom rim gyi lung gsan/ pad gling gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rje'i drung du chos rgyal rat+na gling pa nas nye bar brgyud pa'i rnying ma rgyud 'bum gyi lung dang pad+ma gling pa'i bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho sogs kyi chos bka' nod par mdzad/yar 'brog yon po do pa bla chen bkra shis lhun grub la rgyud 'bum po ti bcu lhag gi lung gong ra lo chen dang chabs gcig par gsan pa'i dus bla ma 'dis rin po che spa lung par thug pa'i mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po nas brgyud pa'i gter chos mang po yod snang ba gsan bzhed kyang shrī bha dras yang yang brdzi gsang lta bar 'ongs pa dang lo chen gzhan phan pa'i sgra 'dzin gyi dbang por son na thugasaspu'i hūṃ sngon po las 'od zer 'phros dogs nas thugs rtsol cher ma bde rkun po'i nor ltar lkog ngosakho na'i sgo nas rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi lung dang mngon dod du pad gling drag dmar gyi dbang lung /mnal lam le tshan gsum gyi lung chos dbang dgongs gter gyi ma ṇi bka' 'bum/ 'dus pa skor dgu'i nang tshan bdud rtsi bcud len 'dus pa/ yang dag 'dzab dgongs 'dus pa/ bstan gnyis gling pa'i phyag chen ma rig mun sel skor/ gsang skor gyi spyi rgyud thig le kun gsal rnams gsan/ gtsang sde srid kyi bdag mo 'bri gung dbon mo rtag brtan sprul skus 'gugs sngags (26na)kyi sbyor ba la brten nas thugs rig ma gnas pa mkhar rtse phyogs kyi rgyu 'grul ches par klu gong rgyal po'i gnod par 'byul te kong po nas gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung brgyud snying bu ga me rigs 'dzin —213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyedabang po gdan 'dren mdzad pa gdon gyi gnod par ma song bas phan thogs che ba ma byung rung gong ra lo tsā bas gtsos pa'i don gnyer can mang po la bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi chos skor btsugs pa'i mjug tsam la rje bla ma yar klungs nas rong du phebs pa dang 'grig /sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter ma phur sgrub thugs kyi nying khu dang rnam sras kyi dbang lung / zab pa pod bzhi/ gter ston nyi ma 'od zer/sras 'gro ba'i mgon po/ mnga' bdag blo ldan/ mnga' bdag bdud 'dul/ de sras rdo rje/ de srasapad+ma dngos grub/ de sras 'jam dpal nor bu/ de sras kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de sras bzang po lhun grub rnams kyi rnam thar/ bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi lung rags rim dang khro rol skor la mtha' chod par mdzad pas gnyos zhig gi phyag len dang khyad par med pa'i khungs btsun par 'dug gsung /rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i nang tshan chu la nya ltar rgyug pa'i grub thob 'o bran dpal gyi dbang phyug gi gdung brgyud bla ma 'ol pa ba ngag dbang chos grags la gu ru drag po lha dgu'i dbang 'o bran lugs/de'i yig cha kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje dang dpa' bo gtsug lag pas bsgrigs pa/ phyag rdor gtum po nyer gcig /tshe dpag med lha dgu'i dbang / bcu gcig zhal/ klu dbang gi rgyal po (26ba)phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/ u tsarla/ 'o bran lugs kyi dmag zor ma/ zhang btsun dar ma rin cen pa'i gter ma dpal ldan rang byung rgyal mo/ seng gdong ma/ mgon po phyag drug pa rnams kyi rjes gnang / trag shad thal mo brdabs chog gi dbang lung / rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ 'char ka gnam skas ma/ lha mo dud sol ma'i las tshogs/ blo sbyong mtshon cha 'khor lo/ rma bya dug 'joms sogs chos mang du zhu ba mdzad/khong pa gsan rgya che bas de las mang ba yong ris yod 'dug kyang bla ma stag lung du bzhugs skabs 'phrin las ches pa drung pa ka drug pas gtsos pa'i bla ma gzhan rnams ma 'dod pa'i chags sdang gi bkrong rtsis byas pas sku srog thon pa gtso bor bzung bros pa ka ca mtha' dag gshor pa nas phyag dpe dbang rdzas kyis rgya sdugs nas ma byung skad/gnam mtsho ngo bo pa sbyin pa bzang pos gter kha gong ma'i rta nag yang chung bsgrubs pa'i tshe lung —2/4

nyang ston khra tsha pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ lhanapa rta skad gcig gis gang ba'i sgra gsan pa sogs yi dam gyi rjes su bzung ba de la bla ma 'ol ba pas gsan nas nyams bzhes kyi mthil ma gtogos g.yin su la'ang ma gnang ba 'grongs rgyu'i zla ba gnyis tsam gyi sngon du rje nyid la stsal ba dpon slob gnyis ka'i che bar mngon/ yar stod g.ya' bzang gi bla ma dme shes rab la snyan brgyud rdor zam gyi bka' srung lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka 'bar ma'i gdong can dang sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang / nyi ma mdung gang ma'i skor gyi lung nod pa mdzad/ pho brang pa'i sras mkha' reg sprul sku la dam chos zhi byed yang snying skor (27na skos na/ bla ma bon lung pa gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la pad gling nor bu rgya mtsho'i skor sogs 'ga' zhig zhu ba mdzad/de yang rdo rje la4 gnas gsar ba wo pos ngor du rgyud 'bum dang / gong dkar chos sder 'dul ba lung gsan na'ang de 'phros ma gsan pa'i rgyun 'tshal ba la byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngu lta bu'i ngang tshul dang ldan pas kho bo bka' 'gyur gyi lung yongs su rdzogs pa zhig 'dod na'ang zha lur lo gsum byas skabs rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi tshe stor dkar la brten pa'i stabs bad gan 'phel zhing lus stobs 'an pa dang / khyad par chos sde 'di nyid kyi khur 'bur gyi ming btags mkhan tshugasakyi sgrob sgrob kyis phyogs med du 'jug bde'i bgrod dka' ba byung bas khyed kyis chos 'tshol ba'i thugs khur bzhes dgos zhes sku chas kyi mthun rkyen du g.yu pad kyis gtsos pa'i bdog pa gya nom pa stsal na'ang 'phral du stabs 'grig pa zhig ci 'dra 'ong dgongs pa'i thugs the tshom gyi dus lho brag nyi lde dgon par lha tsha sprul sku bka' 'gyur gsan rtsis kyis mkha' reg nas sde pa rnam gling pa sdom brtson tshogs gnyis dpal grub gdan drangs pa'i gnas tshul dang / khyed rang yang bka' 'gyur gsan 'dod yod na zhen la 'gro ba'i gong ra lo tsā bas 'phrin yig bskur ba gzigs ma thag bla ma tshogs gnyis pa'ang ri khrod par song dpon slob thams cad chas rkyen 'dzom pa zhig ci 'dra 'ong ngam snyam pa som nyi'i skabs nyi lde sprul skus chos ra btsugs pa dang de'i (27bskonas tshul 'phral du thos pas sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje yin dgongs rje nyid la chibs dang phyag g.yog gcig bcas tsham —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)tshom med par snying stobs chen pos lam la zhugs nas thebs pas lam nor nas seng ge rdzong dang nye ba lung pa kha dog la gting zab pa zhig tu byon/ der skad cha dris bshad kyi yul tsam yang ma rnyed pas nye gnas kyis chibs khrid rje nyid kyis 'phongs nas skyor gyin lam gzar po la dka' spyad mdzad/mthar zam pa phra mo snar grod gcig yod par phebs de'i mi zhig gis ci yin dri ba zhus par nyi lde dgon du 'gro mkhan yin tshul gsungs pa na lam 'di la rta thar ba ngo mtshar lam nor tshabs chen zhing mi rta la skyon ma byung ba'ang go spyad do nub grong yod sar mi 'byor bas 'di khar bzhugs zer ba ltar mdzad/ sang nyin dri ba gnang bar yongs grags kyi lam 'di yin rang gi par bkab med kyang zam pa 'di don ri 'di tsho yar 'dzegs pa na lung ston kha yar yod stabs legs na bkra shis bde chen zer bar slebs 'ong zhus pa ltar rim gyis phebs pas lung stong zhig tu dro mdzad pa'i lho phyogs nas bya rog cig 'phur nas skad sna tshogs sgrog cing drung du nye sar sdod pa na nges 'byung dang chos skyong la gdung shugs drag po 'khrungs te gsol zan gyi steng nas gtor dbyibs bzos sngags kyi bsngo ba mdzad pas bya rog des lhag med du zos da bya rog gang song gi rjes la 'gro zhes phebs pa na bya des kyang mda' rgyang gang las mi ring bar 'phur sdod byed pa'i ngang nas lho stod kyi grong sna zin par 'byor/bya (28na)rog de dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sprul par mngon/ grong pa de dag gis nyi lde bla ma bkra shis bde chen du byon song zer ba ltar 'phral du phebs pas bla ma gzims mal du bzhugs grub pa'i drung du shar mar gdan drangs sher phyogs rdzogs nas mdo mang tshugs pa'i thog tu 'dir don gcod cig la 'ongs pa yin sang lhan du 'degs gsungs dgyes dgyes mdzad nas spre'u la brgyud nyi lder phebs/ bla ma tshogs gnyis pas kyang khyed byung na bsams yang yang sems la shar/da lam cis kyang legs nyin mtshan gnyis ga 'di gar bzhugs gsungs mdo mang gi po ti cha pa yan song grub pa'ang srubs dbar tshor gnang bas sher phyogs thor bu dang / dkon brtsegs phal chen bcas po ti lnga bcur nye ba'i lung gsan pas/ dam pa'i chos thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ don —216

nyang ston khra tsha pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po 'di 'dra'i tshigs bcad gcig tsam thos pas bsod nams che na tshang ba lta ci smos dgongs pa'i ston pa bde bar gshegs pa dang chos ston pa la thugs mos 'phel bar ma zad 'di lta bu'ang rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i bka' drin yin dgongs pa'i gus pa dbyar mtsho ltar gyur/slar yang rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi bskul ma gnang bar/ rnam gling sde pa tshogs gnyis dpal grub sku gshegs zin pas sngar zha dmar nag gi bar du phyogs khyer gyi sdo'akhrug bslang ba dang mon (2shab)du zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa 'phrin las rgyas pa'i sgo dod pa lho 'byug pas ma bzod par rtogs ldan gyi dmag btang nas bkrong rtsis byas pa bla ma'i ched du sku srog btang ste bya bral 'ga' zhig bsad pas bla ma 'di sdig pa'i rtsa ba yin zhes bla dwags rjes su dhīḥtsha zhes mdzes btsal bar snang zhing zhwa dmar pa dang dhīḥtsha sku skye na rim ltar 'bral ba med bar smon lam thebs pa'i skyes bu dam par gleng ba de la gsan pa'i sgo dod/ gsol mas kyi mthun rkyen rnams do bo rdzong nas phul nas rje bla ma lho brag bkra shis dge 'phel du phebs/ sprul sku 'jig rten dbang phyug la brgyad stong pa ma gtagos sher phyogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i lung nos pa gnang / rje btsun bka' 'gyur bar 'dul lung 'bul ma dgos pa'i stabs thugs rtsol ma thub pa nged kyis mdo mang dang sher phyogs zhus pa'i rkyen gyis bla ma tshogs gnyis bar lung thob pa'i bsod snyoms pa grub pa'i rdo rje la rong ri lung sbug tu 'dul ba lung sde bzhi tshang ba dang gter ston o rgyan gling pas spyan drangs pa'i thang yig sde lnga'i lung gsan/ nged kyis zur thams cad mkhyen par gsar ma rgyud 'bum zhus pa 'phro can du lusapa'i ngor gyi lung rgyun khungs ma de gong dkar chos sder yod pa gsan dgos pa'i gsol ba btab ba ltar rab stims chos rje rin cen rgya mtsho la gsar ma rgyud 'bum/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bde chen ral gcig gi dbang lung / tshe dpag lha dgu'i dbang 'chi bdag bzlog byed kyi cho ga dang 'dres pa/seng gdong ma sngon mo'i rjes gnang dang las tshogos/ ba (29na ji lugs kyi gur mgon rjes gnang /—217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)sgrol dkar gyi tshe 'khrid/ rje btsun rin po tshes mdzad pa'i gtor ma brgya rtsa/ ma ning gi las mtha' char 'bebs zab rgyas ma sogs chos du ma gsan/'di skabs 'tshub kyi rnam pas sku bsnyen pas drung 'tsho gsum dga' rdzong bda' byas shing mgon po che chung la bkang gsos gtsos sku rim che phra phal cher chos sde rang du 'phral grub gnang bas gsol sman gyi ngo blangs te yun mi ring bar gzhi med du dwangs khra tshang pa'i chos skyong gi gtso bo gcig rgyal po pe gar yin pas gsol mchod gnang rgyu mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rdo rje gdan pas dgon pa srung 'khor du bcug gshis chos sde'i nang du rgyal rmis kyang mi yong la gsol kha'ang gtong srol med/ sa skya khri chen phebs dus 'am bu yong sar tsi dmar ba yong ba gzhir bcas zhes bkang gso mdzad pas chibs chen la sbrag shi rgyab pa'i lo rgyus dang bcas chos sde pa tsho'i snyan 'bul la gsan nas chu bo rir rgyal po la bkang bshags gnang lha sras mu tig btsan po'i yang srid 'bri gung zhabs drung chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las rnam par rgyal pa'i sde zhes rgyal dbang pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob chen po de nyid sde pa rgyal bzang pas dpon sa do brag ma'i yar 'dren la gdan drangs
