pa'i tshe sne'u sdong rtse nas ja 'dren la rdzong bda' gnang skabs dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi nyams len dmigs rim gyi chos 'brel gsan/mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje'i chos bdag lung zin spyan mnga' ba le ba sangs rgyas bzang (29ba)po'i rnam sprul rje btsun stag lung pa ngag dbang bkra shis dpal grub nges don chos kyi nyi ma rnam grol mchog gi sder gter chen nyi zla 'od zer gyis bsam yas bar khang rnam snang thugs ka nas gdan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi dbang 'khrid lung rnams gsan zhing rje ba le ba'i phyag bris glegs bam sku'i 'bral spangs de'ang ma dper g.yar po sogs thugs rjes shin tu 'dzin pa mdzad/ gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra'i sprul nga 'i zlos gar zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol la 'bras spungs kyi dngos grub spyil por bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel dang / rjes sor —218—

nyang ston khra tsha pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanadapon slob gnyis chos bka' phar gsan tshur gsan gyis bcad mdzad na'ang yul dus kyis bskal pas phyag thog tu ma khel/chos rgyal byang pa ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i sku mchog blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sder rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi dbang /bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang 'khrid/mgon po mi'u thung chos rgyal byang pa ngag gi dbang po'i sprul pa'i sku mchog blo bzang pad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i sder rgyal po bka' 'bum gyi dbang /bka' gdams lha bzhi'i rjes gnang 'khrid/mgon po mi'u thung gsod byed kyi rjesaganang /chos rgyal byang pa'i gter gsar bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje'i dbang /zhabs drung bdag po'i dag snang ma srid pa spyi skong gi mdos/mkhas grub mnga' ris paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i sdom gsum rnam nges sogs chos bka' du ma'i bka' drin nod par mdzad/rigs 'dzin srog sgrub dang gter gsar rigs 'dzin thugs tig gnyis ka nas mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal gyi sprul par lung gis zin pa dpal ri sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma 30na〉nyun las la chos rgyal 'bri gung pa rin chen phun tshogs kyi gter gsar dam chos dgongs pa yang zab kyi dbang chen dbang phran lung yongs rdzogs/rigs 'dzin pradz+nyā ra smi'i gter ma'i rta mgrin dregs pa zil gnon gyi dbang /grol thig dang gshin rje nag po gsum dril gyi chos skor yongs rdzogs/'jam dpal tshe bdag nag po me'i sbu gri'i gza' gdong zhal gdams skor gyis gtsos pa'i chos tsha ni mang rab/rlung nag 'khrugs pa dregs pa khams byon ma rnams gsan/khong dpon slob nas sgo sna shag pa dang yig 'phrul la brten pa'i 'phyong rgyas su sgor bskyil dang chad las sogs kyi nan tur la snga phyir phan thabs kyi khur bzhes kyang che bar mdzad pa chos yon ga' na las khyad par du 'phags par sems/chos rgyal gter bdag gling ba 'gyur med rdo rjes brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas gdan drangs pa'i lung bstan rab gsal me long nas/bi mā'i yang sprul rat+na badz+ra ming :g.yu ru'i sar 'byung 'di dang yod pan bar sgo dam sri'i 'tshe ba nges par sel/zhes cho me bdag tu gyur par brten gags ra

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)rigs 'dzin thugs tig gi dbang lung gi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum pa gtams/ byang gling 'jam dpal dbyangs bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi sku'i rnam par sprul pa zha lu mkhan po khyab bdag rin chen bsod nams mchog grub la rtsa gsum dril sgrub kyi dbang sogs chos 'brel kha yar gsan/bshes gnyen chen po 'chad ka ba ye shes rdo (30ba)rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyi rol pa gling stod chos rje mtshungs med dkon cog dpal 'byor la bzang spyod la brten pa'i 'od dpag med kyi nyal sgom gyi 'khrid dang chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis mdzad pa'i dur khrod bdag po'i man ngag gi lung sogs gsan/ 'dan ma rtse mangs kyi zhu lan las/ nyang ral gdung rabs bco brgyad yan chod du: sngon tshe rgyal po'i smon lam mthu yod pas: chos bzhin ma byas kyang sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur: zhes lung gis zin pa'i gdung rabs bcu drug pa mnga' bdag rma bo lcog pa mtshungs med bstan 'dzin chos dbang gi drung du bla ma mnga' bdag chen po'i gzhung chen bde gshegs 'dus pa'i smin lam dbang gi rgyal po snang srid lha 'dre'i srog dbang dang g.yin yang drag po sgo 'byed kyi dbang lung thor bu gsan/se brgya mkhar ba chen po'i gdung 'dzin zo lung pa sngags 'chang legs grub tshe ring la zhi khro sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang / 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed gdong drug gi thugs sgrub bskyed rdzogs zung 'brel gyi dbang lung / tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i rigs gsum mgon po'i mchod rten bzheng thabs kyi lung rnams gsan/ se'i sngags 'chang mkhas grub rim par byon pa'i rigs las mnga' bdag gi rnam 'phrul bkra bzang chos rje thugs mchog 'od 'bar la chu mo phug gter ma'i drag po ya ka me dbal dbu dgu pa/ byang gter phur pa che mchog dang lcags khang ma rnams zhu ba gnang /so zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal por grags pa'i zur spang ston bde legs rgyal mtshan gyi dpon brgyud mang thos mkhyen pa'i (31na〉grin ldan ngag dbang phun tshogs la sprul sku tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis chu phug nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma rigs 'dus kyi dbang dang lung yongs rdzogs/ tshe dbang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ nyang gi snang srid lha 'dre'i srog dbang / byin rlabs lu gu brgyud/ chos rgyal —220

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanarin wo gling pa'i drag dmar gyi dbang / zhi khro dong sprug gi dbang / mgon po legs ldan gyi dbang chosaskor/ byang gter tshe dbang mning dang stag zhon lcags sgrog mā gyi dbang / rong zom gyi gsang snying 'grelapa/ chos tshan nyer lnga'i kha skong sogs byang gter gyi chos sna thor bu/ lnga dbang rin po che dbang lung /gra pa mngon shes kyi lha 'khon sbyong thabs/ gter kha sna tshogs kyi man ngag thor bu mang du gsan/pho brang gong ri dkar po'i chos rje dkon gnyer dpon mtshungs med dge steng pa byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas la sa phur lha khra/ gdugs dkar lha bcu bdun ma gnyis kyi dbang / bkra shis tshe ring ma'i rjes gnang / le'u bdun ma'i lung rnams gsan/ chos rgyal 'bri gung pa zhabs drung dkon cog phun tshogs kyi thugs sras mnga' ris bla chen dkon cog lhun grub la dgongs pa yang zab kyi dbang phran kha shas/ tshe bdag lcags sdig yongs rdzogs/ 'jam dpal me'i spu gri'i chos skor mang ba/'jam dpal khro chu dug gdong gi chos skor kha shas/ gshin rje du ba dum bu/ dmar chung rlung sgrub/ gnubasalugs bka' ma dang rgya'i gter ma'i gtad sel ngan sngags kyi skor sna tshogs pa/ sangs (31ba)rgyas gling pa'i dbang phyug /gtad khram rus sbal nag po/ rgyal sel lha khang ma/ kong po bya khyung pasabasgrigs pa'i gza' bcos dang gza' yum gyi dbang / gtad khram/ rgyal po byes chas/ rlung 'khor cha phri nag po sogs gter kha sna tshogs kyi gdams pa khyad par chos dbang rin po che'i 'jam dpal nā ga ra ka'i dbang / 'chi bdag zhal dbye ba'i dbang rdzas khyad 'phags rnying rlom phal gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa mnga' ris rigs 'dzin chen po'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med kyi dbang / sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe dbang paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud ba dang rje dkon cog phun tshogs kyi dag snang ma sogs zab chos mang du nod par gnang / rat+na gling pa/ 'gro 'dul gling pa/ zhig po gling pa ste gter ston gcig la gling pa gsum du lung gis zin pa'i gdung brgyud ye chos rje spel lcog pa thugs sras chos rje rin chen bzang po la chos rgyal rat+na gling pas ri bo khyung chen lding nas gdan drangs pa'i thugs sgrub yang snying 'dum pa dang mkhar chu phug rang nas brta zhe pa'i drag po me'i 'phreng ba gnyis kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs yang —221—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)snying 'dus pa'i sgrub chen dang 'brel bar gsan/gter chen rat+na gling pa'i chos rgyun 'dzin pa la 'gran zla dang bral ba e nyang chos ldan par rat+na 'phrin (pas la chos rgyal zhig po gling pas kong po bu chu nas gdan drangs pa'i sman sgrub gsang rtogs kyi lung gsan/ lho bro shu'i gter ston bde chen gling pa'i sprul sku rkarma chos dbang rgya mtsho la gter chen rdo rje gling pa'i drag dmar gyi skor/ bde (32na snga na gling pa'i gter ma tshe 'khrid yid bzhin me long gi dbang lung rnams gsan/ chos rgyal byang pa ngag gi dbang po'i zhal slob rnam dpyod mchog tu yangs pa bla ma brag la ba ngag dbang don grub rgyal mtshan la ri sbug pa rgyal sras rdo rje thugs mchog rtsal nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs chen gsang skor gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ rlung nag dregs pa nyi shu chos rgyal mthi'i mtshan can gyi bzhed srol thun mong ma yin pa rnams zhu ba mdzad/ snang tshad chos sku bde ba chen po'i klong du gyur pa'i rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa ga rma gsang sngags la rin chen gling pa'i nā ga ra ka'i dbang lung / 'tsho rgyal skor gsum gyi dbang / rat+na gling pa'i rtsa gsum nor bu'i don 'khrid/ tshe dpag med rdor 'phreng / klong gsal gyi dbang lung kha shas/ dam can gyi skor sogs kha thor sna tshogs/ ma gcig nas brgyud pa'i gcod sogs gsan/ zhal snga nas brag sna ba o rgyan bstan 'dzin la rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud bcu bdun/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang sogs gsan pa mdzad/ bla ma rin cen grub la gter ston o rgyan gling pa'i tshe dbang rdzong chung ma zhu ba gnang /khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i mchod dpon bla ma 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan la rjo bo lugasakyi sa la dkar po/ mgon po trag shad kyi rjes gnang / chos dbang gi thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprug gi lam dbang / gur zhal gyi yig cha thor bu'i lung gsan/ gsang sngags 'chang ba dpal 'byor grags pa'i dbyangs la khyab 'jug gsang mdos kyi (32ba/yung ched du nod pa gnang / bla ma lha rtse ba'i sprul sku ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub la gter mgon phyag bzhi pa'i skor gsan pa'i zhar la drag po phur zhabs ma'i dbang lung byung 'dug na'ang pad+ma gling pa'i drag dmar gyi pad+ma gī lu ya —222

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanazur du phyung ba lta bu'i thugs rab kyi rtsal las thon pa ma gtogs tshad ldan yin min dpyad dka' gsung /sman sgom 'brang rgyas pa ngag dbang don grub la dpal ldan rgyud bzhi/bye ba ring bsrel/nyams yig brgya rtsa rnams kyi lung gsan/rtse lugs kyi phur pa'i skor zhabs drung yab sras nasathugs rtsol gnang dgos tshul la brten 'on nas chos rje ban grong par phur pa'i las byang 'phrin las rgya mtsho/kha skong hu ya'i chu rgyun gyis gtsos pa'i chos sna dkon pa du ma gsan/gong dkar dkon gnyer bla ma par khang pa dang chos rje 'grel lnga pa la phur pa'i rtsa 'chams/'brub 'chams/rigasabasdus/mas gsar/tshes bcu'i 'chams/gar thig dbyangs gsum gyi skor/khro phu dus zhabasapar tsan+d+ra pa'i khog phug/dgung lo bdun tsam 'gro ba nas rim gyis rgya bod kyi klog yig du mar sbyangs shing lañca slob dpon ma rnyed pas paṇa chen ri zangs tog pa'i phyag bris la dpe mdzad pas phyogs 'gro mkhyen na'ang de tsam gyis chog 'dzin med par lto brag sgo mo bar rgya bod kyi yig sna'i dogs gcod sogs shes bya'i gnas phra rags gang la'ang mtha' gcod cing chos rgyun dkon pa chad du nye ba'i ris khungs btsun pa zhig byung phyin gsan par khengs dregs cung zad tsam yang mi mdzad cing /bka' las/me tshogs spu 33na ) gri'i so yang brgal nas ni//'chi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos btsal//zhes pa'i don yin pas yon tan gzhan rgya che ba las chos thob rgya che ba dga' gsung ngo //shes byar srid pa'i yon to mtho ris chu//blo brtson i kyis drangs kyang rnam dpyod kyi//lto ba mi dog yangs pa'i dzaḥ//nyang ston rigs kyi thig ler deng 'dir byon/khyad par rtsa ba'i 'dren pa lha dro pas//sras kyi thu bor bzung nas smin grol lung //chos dbang bstan pa'i rgyal srid yongs gtad tshe//sngags 'chang mang bkur seng ge'i khri steng 'gying //gtsug lag bshol med mar chags dmod mtshan dbyibs//blo gros mig stong ba po ba'i rnam dpyod mtshon//rtse brgya gdengs tshe rab rmongs lha min mo'i//mngal lhung brgya byin bla gos zol gyis bsgribs//bgrang yas yongs 'dzin chu shel gtsug rta me rgyan//mkhyen spyan zla zer phog chus mgon khyod bzhin//bkru bar lta phyir gdong pa drug sprul nas//gar

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)mkhan zhen te sa 'dir bskyod kyi dogs/ /mi mngon nyams rtogs mun pa'i khung bu sa /sna tshogs rdzun gtam 'khyug pa'i lce gnyis pa/ /ma yin lnga rig gdengs ka mthon po'i rtser/ /legs bshad dbang gi rgyal po gzi 'od 'phro/ /tha snyad tshig la chen pa sra ba'i gzhu/ /go yul rgyud kyis ma khugs mkhas rloms dang / /mtshungs min snang grags chos sku'i rang rig par/ /ngo sprad tsam nas ngang gis klong du grol/ /gsum pa bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen por (33ba)goms pas dngos grub brnyes pa ni/ khra tshang dang sman lung gnyis gdan sa phan tshun zung 'brel yin na'ang sman lung gi sras mo'i thog tu bkra shis chos sde'i gra pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho zer ba zhig gis mag pa byas te mi bdag bdag tu gzung bdag po sgo phyir 'bud pa'i dpe bzhin sku tsha mos kyang mi gus pa lhur blangs pas mnyam med jo bo chen po bsam yas su bzhugs dus lha btsun bo dhi rā dza bag dog pa'i rkyen gyis/ gang dang 'thab cing rtsod pa ni/ /dpag tshad brgya yi pha rol 'gro /zhes gsungs pa'i don bzhin khra tshang du sku mtshams mdzad nas sri zhu yum gyis zhus te rdzogs pa chen po sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang bla ma yang tig gsang skor sogs rdzogs chen ka dag lhun grub kyi nyams len gtso bor gnang bas rig rtsal kun tu bzang por gcer mthong du ngo 'phrod/ chos nyid mngon sum dang nyams gong 'phel gyi 'od gsal longs sku'i zhib khams la 'byam klas/ de'i mus nas ji skad du/ nga sgrubs sangs rgyas thams cad 'grub/ /nga mthong sangs rgyas thams cad mthong / /nga ni bde gshegs 'dus pa yin/ /snying po bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sngags/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus dril sgrub yin/ /sa ni bco lnga lam lnga yang / /nga sgrubs thod 'phreng bzlas pas bgrod/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsung rab thams cad bklags dang mtshungs/ /skyon pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ /lho nub rnga yab gling phran gyi/ /thag ring zhig na yod pa min/ /mos gus can gyi drung na ni/ /nga nyid 'du 'bral med par gnas/ /mngon (34na〉nas drug ldan stobs bcu sogs/ /bde gshegs rnams la mnga' bas —224

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanan/ /gsol ba btab pa nga yis gsan/ /mos gus byed pa nga yis shes/ /sgrub pa byed pa nga yis mthong / /nga yis mi mkhyen gang yang med/ /des na dga' brod spro tshul gyi/ /rigs lnga bskyed la bzlas pa bya/ /zhes pa ltar rigs 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub thabs grangs yas pa'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa sgrub pa'i sgrom brgyad kyi phyag len dang bcas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi rim pa gter gzhung la zhal shes kyis brgyan te zla ba gsum gyi bar thugs nyams su bstar bas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes paṇa zhu rgod sgro ldem me phyi rol nas 'byon mkhan yod pa'i kun rdzob a 'thas kyi rdzun phug brdig nas rang rig don gyi pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal du thag chod/ yi dam kun gyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa zhi khro bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs phyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas ma hā yo ga ltar sgrub pa 'phrin las yongs rdzogs/ nang lus dkyil la brten nas a nu yo ga ltar sgrub pa gcig dril/ yongs rdzogs phur sgrub rnams rdzogs pa chen po'i lta bas rtsis zin pa kho na rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhal 'khrid ltar mdzad pas yo ga gsum gyis sgrub lugs mthar phyin bas e ṇ+ḍi ya na'i ā tsarla'i dgongs don 'khrul med mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches ji ltar gsungs pa rje 'di nyid kyi thugs nyams su bzhes par mngon/gzhan yang bod 'dir bstan pa rin (34ba)po che'i dbu thog mar brnyes pa yum bu gla sgang dang khra tshang du nyang gi drag dmar gzhung chen bde gshegs 'dus pa dang chos dbang gi dregs pa tshar gcod gnyis ka la ljags bsnyen mdzad pa gter kha 'og ma rtsub cing gong ma 'phral 'jam la phugs chun che ba yod ces gnog chos su mdzad cing bslab ston ltar nged kyis kyang nyams len gyi lugs byas pa drag po dbu dgu tsha ngar che'ang 'di nyid 'jam rtsub ran par go zhing zhag 'ga' song ba na zhakhrul snang du po ta la'i mchod khang dmar po'i byang brgyud kyi rtsig steng na gzhir shin tu che ba zhig snang ba rlung drag pos bsnyel song ba brgyugs nas thag pa 'dra mos 'then pas g.yang la ma shor bar sngar shul las 'brongs pa byung ba bar chad las rgyal ba'i mtshan mar mngon/ bla ma mnga' bdag par —223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losemakha' 'gro'i bka' babs pa yin zhing mkhas grub chen po mnga' ris paṇa chen kyang 'di la yi dam gyi gtso bor mdzad tshul gyi lo rgyus dang bcas gsung ba thos shing sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan/ pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi gnas yar klungs shel gyi brag phug tu nyang gi khros nag la bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes kyang gtso bor gnang / srid pa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan khu dbon/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal kun bzang rtse pa yab sras kyis mtshon pa'i dam pa du mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas he ru gaḥrang byung gi gtsug (35na)lag khang dam can sprin bzhin 'du ba bsam gling bde ba chen po/ sman lung chos dbyings rtse mo sogs gnas du mar rdzong chen tshe sgrub tu grags pa nyang chos dbang o rgyan gling pa gsum gar yod pa dang byang gter gyi nang longs spyod rdzogs skur sgrub pa/ gzhan yang gnam skas ma/ rgyun khyer mkhar chu ma/ kho lha khang gi gter ma sogs dgongs don gcig tu dril pa'i bsnyen sgrub/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa 'khor ba dong sprug gi nyams bzhes kyang mthar phyin pas ngas ni lhog sngags dang gnyan sngags sogs sger du shes kyin med/ nad pa la'ang yig drug gi sngags btab pas phan tshul gsung gin yod par snang / mgon po legs ldan dang dpal mgon ma ning sogs chos skyong du ma bsnyen sgrub gnang bas mtshon mdor na gnas de dag tu ring ba lo dang thung ba zla grangs su bcad de bsnyen sgrub dpyis phyin par mdzad pas yi dam gyi lha'i zhal gzigs lung ston sogs mang du byung bar gor ma chag kyang gzhan dag gis dri ba zhus pa'i tshe mnyam sbyor dang bla ma 'ga'i gsung las/ sgrub pa'i snying po 'di la dril nus na/ /spyod pa bslab gsum mdzes pa'i sgrub rtags shig /rang gzhan kun gyi snang ngor ston nus shing / /de las gzhan pa'i grub rtags med kyang bzod/ /ces de 'dra'i ris mngon pa zur tsam yang mi mdzad na'ang gser sa 'og dang / 'od nam mkha'i dpe bzhin dgra 'dres mtshon mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad la 'jigs pa med pa'i brtul zhugs kyi dpa' (35ba)gdengs che zhing de dag kyang blo 'das chos sku 'dzin med —226

nyang ston khra tsha pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)kyi klong du rang grol bas gdengs tshad blo'i ra ba las yongs su brgal ba zhig mchis/ thugs nyamasabazhes kyi rim pa de dag kyang ji skad du/ nga dang 'phrad par 'dod na thugs kyi sgrub pa sgrub: myur du 'tshang rgya 'dod na mnyam sbyor nyams su long : 'gro ba 'dul bar 'dod na thugs rje chen po sgrubs:sku tshe ring 'dod bcud len nyams su long : mthu rtsal che 'dod cog rdung drug po sgrubs: mkha' 'gro 'du 'dod dam gtsang tsho gos 'khor rems: thun mong sgrub 'dod las tsho gos ma lus sgrubs dam chos spyod 'dod 'khor ba blo yis thong : gter rnams 'dod na thub chod chen mo sgrubs: de dag kun 'dod bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs sgrubs: zhes pa'i don kho na thog tu babs par mngon/ tshe sgrub byed mkhan mang yang tshe tshad kha dmar gdags dka' ba 'og tu gsal ba'i lo rgyus ltar drung chen rin po ches gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar zhabs 'dren mdzad par brten sa phag gnyis lugs ma legs pa'i bde gzar rgyun ring zhing brdos drag pa byung ba'i tshe bzhi thog bla brang nas mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pas chos skyong rbad bskul mdzad pa'i dus jo nang du kun spangs thugs rje brtson khrus kyis sbyor drug bcugs pa'i 'khrid pa zhig rlung 'gro 'ong gis sems mi gnas pa lta bu byung bas wor sgor sbus ru'i dmag dpon ni mkhas btsun legs pa yin/ g.yasaru'i dmag dpon ni mgon po gur (36na〉na sogs smras pa ltar sne'u sdong rtse phyogs su za kha shin tu zug che/ khyad par rdzong chung ba sngags 'chang chen po gzungs kyi dpal bas mgon po zhal gyi gtor chen gtsang po la bskyur bas skyon med du chus khyer ba gdan sa mthil gyi yas zur du 'bar nas nyin mo dud pa 'thul ba dang mtshan mo me 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba dogs pa zos te sne'u sdong rtse nas ltar btang ba gtor ma dang chu 'gram na rdol zhal bram gzugs kyi sku rang byon zhig kyang 'dug tshul byung bar brten mthil du bsam thongs mgon khang zer ba brtsigs/gtor ma sgam nang du bcug pa dang rdo sku rnams spyan drangs rtse mthil gnyis skar chos skyong du bsten pas ltas ga g.yang khugs kyi rnam pas mthu bzlog ste phag mo gru pa'i bstan srid kyang yun —227

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shering du gnas shing deng sang gi bar du gdung brgyud mi chad pa 'di bzhin byung / rdo sku thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos gdan drangs nas deng sang chos 'khor rgyal du bzhugs te rdo sku me 'bar mar grags/ gtor ma 'gar ba'i yul der gnyan cha zhes ming chags/ bsam thongs mgon khang cho mes rdib la song ba gnyan pa'i grags pas zhwa dmar ba'i sgar khrod kyi bla ma dbu che nga yin bsamasapa gang gis kyang 'gro ma nus par rje 'di nyid 'khyags pa kha'i me 'bud lta bur rdzong bda' mdzad pa rigs 'dzin chen po yol mo bas/ snang srid dang lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul de khyongs shog /ya nga dang med pa'i thog brdzis shig bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don ltar rig sngags 'chang ba'i brtul zhugs 'jigs (36ba)med seng ge lta bu'i spyod pas phebs te mgon khang rdo phung lta bur song ba 'u lag rnams kyis sa sel rdo sel byas pa'i nang nas spyan gzigs 'gangs che ba go mtshon rol mo nas bzung gtor snod kyi rdza slang gis mtha' brten pa thams cad chag grum med par thon kyang sa skya'i gtor ma sgam bcas ye ma rnyed pas las mi rnams zan la bkram/ rje nyid gcig bur zhal gyi gtor bsngos mdzad pa'i mus la sku mdun gyi nye phyogs su 'ja' mdung tshugs su zug pa'i shul du brkos pas rten sgam rnyed/ mgon khang phyi'i mkhar las dang nang gi rten dang gtor ma spyan gzigs mchod pa rnams sngar ltar bsgrigs rab gnas mdzad pas bka' gnyan pa'i grags pa deng sang gi bar du ma nyams pa 'di bzhin byung /gong dkar rdo rje gdan du bzhugs skabs nub cig 'od gsal la gser dngul nya phyis dung dang /gzhan yang mi'i dngos po las 'das pa ming brjod dka' ba'i rin po che'i snod du ma bcud sna tshogs kyis bkang ba mi ma yin gyis phul nas bsnyen bkur ba'i tshul byed pa ni lha klu gnod sbyin ljon pa rta mgo can gyis mtshon pa'i mthu bo che rnams kyis kyang rje 'di nyid mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du bzung bar gdon mi za'o/ /skyid gshong du bzhugs dus mañju mañju yang yang gsung bar ci yin nam zhus pas 'di tshod sdus phebs par nam gung yin ci yang bsdu rgyu med gsol bar yod ces yang bskyar du bka' stsal bas mal nas langs drung du phyin te ci yin nam gang yin nam gang yang mi mthong 'dug zhus pa —228

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)na da med song gzhan nged kyi mdun 'dir za ma'i rigs med pa'i mtha' dang bral ba zhig byung (37na sko de gas yong 'dug nyol shog gsung ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i tshod du snang / po ta lar phebs skabs shig ljangs kyi bzhugs mtsher du dag snang la sgrol dkar mang du zhal gzigs shing rta brdab 'byung nyen che bas sgrol ma thon zhes pa'i lung bstan ltar nang par chibs thog tu phebs 'phral sku skye la bskul zhig ces bka' gnang nas dpon slob thams cad kyis phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gsung bzhin pa'i ngang la snye thang rgya grong du ma phebs tsam la glo bur du chibs pa 'drogs nas nyen can la thug pa don du sku rdab ma shor ba sgrol ma'i byin rlabasadang po ta la nas sne'u sdong rtser chibs kha sgyur rgyu'i nub sku chas du ma chu la shor ba'i mtshan lam shar ba nang par zhabs 'bring pa rnams la 'di bzhin byung bas bca' ga gyis gsungs pa ba ma ri'i zam pa nas khal ma lhungs te sku 'gan sbyar gyis gtsos pa'i na bza' sogs mang rab cig chus spangs/ po ta lar bzhugs skabs shig khang pa chen po 'di yin med pa'i sbug na tse ber dang sag theb gyon pa'i btsun pa mi bongs gsum 'gyur tsam pa gzi byin can zhig bsdad de 'dra rung bas sgo'i phyi rol tu don nas rje nyid kyi phyag tu spyi sgos kyi legs nyes blang dor yod zer ba'i shog ril chen mo phul ba nang par ljags lung gi sar rgyal po li byin ha ra 'di 'khor po yod pas yin nam mdang 'di bzhin byung /sku rim dgos tshul ha lam 'di 'dra 'dug phebs pa nas ja yun gcig tsam gyi tshe gnas chung chos rgyal sku thog babs kyi sar mgron gnyer (37ba)drung pas phyin pas ji ltar gsung ba dang phyogs mthun pa'i shog ril zhig bskur ba mdzad 'dug /rin spungs su sku rim zhig gi skabs gong ra ba'i mchod g.yog des bslab ston rnams ras su bor zhing rtse sag lus la bcangs te mig ngan kho na blta ba de nyer dgu'i nub khams sang la phyin pa tshoms chen steng du lhungs nas gnam gang gi nyin tshe'i dus byas zla bo rnams la nga mi nag po zhig dang 'phrad pas lhungs byung glengs pa sogs sku dgra'i ris la ched du ma bskul yang ma ning nag pos yal bar mi 'dor bas mtshon ngo mtshar ba'i lo rgyus mang po —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)yod tshod du 'dug kyang sbas tshul ha cang thal bas mang ba ma 'tshal lo/ /sgrib mun dag rig nyi ma'i snying po'i khams/ /ye shes 'od tshon lnga rdzogs 'ja' ris can/ /chos nyid zad mthar khyol nye bi mā las/ /sngon nas myong zin de la mtshar du ci/ /sras bcas rgyal kun byin rlabs dkar mo'i 'bru/ /rig rtsal bla mar nges pa'i ye mal du/ /gnad gsang phab rtsis sbran pa'i dngos grub chang / /dngar pos myos pa'i rgyang glu rna ba'i gsos/ /ka dag thugs kyi bgrang yas rdzing bu'i nang / /zhi khro'i bsil sbyin mkhan shar byis pa rnams/ /mtshar 'dzin nges par mtshan dpe'i ri dwags gzugs/ /gsal zla 'og min mkhar bgrod su zhig bston/ /gtum chen drag po'i gar la bzhengs pa'i zhal/ /gdangs las sngags 'phreng zhun mar rab khol ba/ /rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phros pa'i dpal gyi rtser/ /yid srubs sbur ma tshugs pa'i go skabs ci/ /mi bzad 'khor dong yongs sprugs snying po'i gzungs/ /sdig (38na8ba des bskyed nad gdon dug sel sman/ /'gro mangs zug rngu'i tsher dbyung cha byad kyi/ /chu lha'i bu yi khengs pa thung ngur byed/ /bzhi pa grangs med pa'i slob mar chos 'khor rgya cher bskor ba ni rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gter kha 'og ma'i bla ma yongs rdzogs/ rdzogs chen tshe sgrub/bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/ rta nag lcags ral can/ thugs sgrub dregs pa tshar gcod/ gtum po seng ge sgra sgrog nyang gi mkha' 'gro gsang rdzogs/ bla ma dmar 'khrid/ rta mgrin nag chung / rat+na gling pa'i thugs sgrub yang snying 'dus pa/ drag dmar me'i 'khor lo/ snang rtse ba'i rta nag rnams kyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/ rta mgrin dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa/ 'char ka gnam skas ma/ gra pa'i dzam dmar/ pha dam pa'i 'jam dbyangs chos skor/ gdugs dkar bcu bdun ma'i dbang / sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i rjes gnang / dung mtsho ras pa'i gtor ma'i rdzogs chen yang ti nag po gser gyi 'bru gcig ma'i 'khrid/ 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo la thog mar sngon du 'gro ba'i dbang sgo —230

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ (tana'abyed phyag rdor zhes pa rtsibs kyi lha la sgyu ma la sogs pa bzhi/ gra bzhir bdug spos ma la sogs pa mchod lha bzhi/ sgo bzhir lcags kyu ma sogs te lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du bdud rtsi/ bum pa/'phreng ba/ cod pan/ me long / 'khor lo (38na)dung / rgya gram/ sna lnga'i thur ma/ sna bdun 'khor lo/ral gri/ mda' gzhu/ seng ge /nyi zla/ mtha' rgyas bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang dang bcas te dbang rim chen mo yongs su rdzogs pa/ lha mi'i theg pa nas brtsams te nyan thos rang rgyal sogs dang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa/ kṛ ya/ u pa/ yo ga /ma hā yo ga /a nu yo ga la dkyil 'khor sgo sbragasabagragacig yod pa'i nang ma nas rim bzhin zhi ba/ khro bo/ spor brgyad/ dbang phyug nyer brgyad mkha' 'gro sum sto rtsa gnyis/ ma bdun/ sring bzhi/ gsang ba'i yum bzhi/ ging chen brgyad/ khro tsho gos bcu drug /pho nya sum brgya drug cu/ ma mo drug cu/ rigs 'dzin rtsal 'chang / sgrub pa bka' brgyad/ rgya bod kyi rigs 'dzin brgya rtsa brgyad dang bcas pa'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa/ rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga la phyi mtshon byed rdul tshon la don bco brgyad dam nang slob dpon gyi lus dkyil la brten nas man ngag byang chub kyi sems rig pa'i rtsal dbang bco brgyad kyi ngo sprod/ rdzogs chen sems sde nyer gcig dang sems mang bco brgyad kyi ngo sprod rdzogs pa/ gzhan yang dngos grub che mchog rdo rje'i tshe dbang / rigs 'dzin brgyud pa bla ma'i dbang phyag len lung bcas gter chen chos kyi rgyal po lha btsun legs ldan rdo rje'i phyag len 'khrul ba med pa/ bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa brgyad stong ba ma gtogos pa'i sher phyogs yongs rdzogs/ dkon cog brtsegs pa/ sangs rgyas phal po che/ mdo sde sna tshogs(39na7 ste khyen bsdoms bka' 'gyur ro cog nas glegs bam bdun cu skor gyis thog drangs mdo sngags kyi chos grangs med pa 'bul ba gnang / ja gos dar gyi chos yon kyang snga phyir maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du bteg /thub bstan rdo rje brag tu rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog dpon slob rags bsdus la 'dus pa mdo dbang gi tshogs chen 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la tshugs nas sku chas zhugs kyi rdo rje'i 'gros sogs spros pa shin tu che ba'i sgo nas dbang yongs rdzogs lung phyag —231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)bzhes/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen bdud rtsi sman sgrub dang 'brel ba shin tu rgyas pa/ e waṃ lcog sgar ba yongs rdzogs dang bcas par bla ma gsang 'dus kyi dbang lung / bka' brgyad dang khros nag gi chos skor gyi lung rnams phul/ pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtser lha gzigs phag mo gru pa blo bzang mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nor 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi lha yab yum sras bcas la gter kha 'og ma'i bla rdzogs thugs gsum/ rdzong chen tshe dbang / bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs sgrub chen dang 'brel ba/ phur pa spu gri/ mthil lugs phyag bzhi pa'i bum dbang bcu bzhi pa/ zhing skyong /ma ning / zhang blon/ tshe ring ma/ rnam sras gser chen/ dur khrod bdag pos mtshon pa'i rtse lugs skor gyi dbang lung mang ba/ gzhan yang g.yu thog snying tig /sman bla'i rjes gnang / sgrol cho sogs dgongs pa dang bstun pa'i chos bka' mang du 'bul ba mdzad/ zhal ngo rnams la brtan bzhugs 'bul ba gnang (39bskobs drung chen rin po che ta'i si tu'i bka' chems su nga nged rang gis chun pas nang skor rnams chun/ nang 'khor chun pas phyi 'khor chun/ phyi 'khor chun pas 'bangs 'khor mtha' dag chun pa yin rung bar skabs su bdag mo sngon mas bka' drin ma bskyangs pa'i sdod pa de rgyu ma byung yang / sde srid dga' ldan pho brang pas tho yor la mi gzugs bzo ba gnang / da lam sne'u sdong gong ma chen po'i ti shrī ra bkur ba'i thugs rjes bzung tshul sogs rgyu mtshan zhib rgyas 'bul ba mdzad/ dbang grol ba'i dga' ston la bzhugs khri dpangs bstod tsho gis 'khor rgya che ba'i thog gos dar na bza' chibs spyas gtsos pa'i yon rgya cher phul/ dpal ri sprul pa'i sku ngag dbang pad+ma 'phrin las la bla ma gsang 'dus kyi dbang lung sogs cho khrig bka' kha yar stsal/gong dkar dkon gnyer dpon rin po che dge steng par bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi mgyogs dbang bum pa'i rgya can dang dpal mgon ma ning gi srog dbang gnang zhing tshes bcu'i gar 'chams kyi phyag len yang stsal/ dpon slob gnyis thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bu'i rje nyid nas rtse lugs kyi cho ga phyag len dpon slob dge steng pa las lhag pa med tshul dang dge steng nas kyis kyang —232

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)rje khra tshang pa sku btsun pa dang gsan rgya che ba'i dper 'dzin par snang /rta nag sgrol 40na〉 sbug pa'i gdung brgyud bgres pa gu ge chu rongs pa mnga' ris 'od gsal mchog gi sprul sku/chos dbang gdung brgyud nyang stod kha mo bas gtsos pa'i chos zhu ba drug cu skor la bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen sman sgrub dang 'brel ba'i dbang rgyas par btsugs pa'i grol dbang gi nyin khrom pa stong phrag brgyal ba byung /gzhan yang bka' brgyad bde 'dus/bla ma gsang 'dus/rje nyid kyi thugasartsom ma'i bka' brgyad kyi sbyin sreg rab gnas khro rol chog sgrigs rnams kyi lung stsal/se ston chen po bkra bzang pa thugs mchogo 'od 'bar/gdung brgyud kha mo ba/'bring mtshams phyogs kyi sngagasapa sogs don gnyer can drug cu skor la dang po sa chog nas brtsams te sngon 'gro las rim bcu gcig pa sa lha rnams sta gon la gnas par gsol ba gdab/dngos gzhi/rgyal chen mtho 'dzugs/dam sri mnan ba/sgo byang /ma tre bsgral ba/rdzas bsag pa/phyag phyag thig gdab/tshon byin rlabs/dkyil 'khor bri ba/rgyan 'god/bsre mnan/chas 'bul/mnga' gsol/sman sgrub kyi khrol bu'i sgrub pa/btags btsags gong bu'i sgrub pa/nyer dgu pa bsnyen sgrub tshar nas dbang bskur bar phyi'i dbang rim brgyad la cod pan/bum pa rnams/nang gi dbang rim dgu la rigs lnga nas rab gnasamanga' gsol bar rdzogs pa drag po sgrol dbang /dregs pa'i srog dbang bka' gnyan pa'i gshis bla ma lnga por stsal/rdo rje rgyal po bka' rab stims kyi dbang 40brdzi tshe bla ma rnams khri stan mthon po'i steng du bkod/gdugs rgyal mtshan bsgrengs rdor dril gto de nus dbang brgyad thun mong gi dbang lnga/ga 4 da bang /ltab: 'byams/dngos grub len chog/gtor zor/mar me smon lam/srung 'khor bsdub/bdag bsrung gi bar shin tu spros pa che ba mdzad/bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs po ti gnyis/thugs rje chen bo yang snying 'dus ba/ma ning rgyud sogs rnam grangs shin tu mang ba'i chosa'akhor bskor/spang ston dbon bo zur chen ngag dbang phun tshogs la bla ma gsang 'dus/sangs rgyasamanyam sbyor/gter mgon phyag bzhi ba rnams/ dbang lung /thang lha'i srog gtad kyis mtshone pa'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logebazhed chos du ma stsal/gong ra lo tsā bar bla ma gsang 'dus kyi skor gnang / legs ldan nag pos nye bar sprul pa dpa' dar mdzangs gsum 'dzom pa ma sangs kyi rigs brgyud sde srid sna dkar rtse pa zil gnon dbang rgyal rdo rje snang thig gos sngon nor bu'i rna rgyan gyi khur ring du dor te gos dkar rig sngags 'chang ba'i bzhugs gral dog por phebs pa'i yongs 'dzin du 'grog sna dkar rtse'i rdzong du gdan drangs pa dang slar rong ri lung sbug tu mi'i dbang pos zhabs pad tshur bskyod kyi dus snga phyi bsdoms par bla ma gsang 'dus/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa/ 'jam dpal nā ga raka gsum gyi dbang lung /rnam thar zangs gling ma/ ku ru dmar 'khrid/ thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu/ bde 'dus rgyud lung nyi shu rnams kyi ljags lung 'bul ba gnang / yar (41na tshe stod rkarma lha khang gi sprul sku rkarma nor bu dang gdung brgyud sogs la bka' brgyad sman sgrub dang 'brel ba'i dbang gis gtsos gter kha 'og ma'i chos bka' phal cher bstan rgyun la dgongs te 'bad pa chen pos stsal/ dhīḥtsha rin po che 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku skye la rdzong chen tshe dbang gnang / yar 'brog pad+ma gling par bla ma gsang 'dus/ rdzogs chen sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/ 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang mdzad/ lho gshog byang ring tshal dkar bar bla ma gsang 'dus/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa/ rdzong chen tshe sgrub kyis gtsos pa'i gter kha 'og ma'i zab chos ci rigs gnang / sham+bha ra bla ma snang dkar bar bla ma gsang 'dus dang tshe bdag gi skor stsal/ e dmar bla ma lho stod pa ga rma bstan srung la tshe dbang dang sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang mdzad/mngon dga' rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho la sman rgyal yon tan mgon po'i thugs bcud g.yu thog snying tig gi dbang lung rdzogs pa thugs bzhed dang sbyar/ zhal snga nas brag sna ba shes rab rgyal mtshan la gter kha 'og ma'i dbang chos 'ga' zhig dang / dga' ldan gsang sngags gling gi gra tshang la bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang gis thog drangs nyer mkho'i chos skor kha yar —234

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)'bul ba mdzad/la stod shrī lo spang pa bla ma sangs rdor ba brgyud bcas kyi pha chos gog po 'dor du 'jug pa dang dgon gnas 'phrog tu nye ba'i mya ngam gyi thang las phyir thon pa'i tshe ched du gsol ba btab pa bzhin bla ma gsang 'dus (41bskong bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung gis yid kyi gdung ba rab tu gsal/ yangs pa'i gsang sngags gling gi gdung brgyud la rdzogs chen sangs rgyasamanyam sbyor dang bka' brgyad rdzogs skor stsal/ nyang stod nas gnubs kyi gdung brgyud bla ma bgrang pa la 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag dang gter kha 'og ma'i dbang chos kha yar gnang / byams chen mkhan po nyang po nga phod chos rjer bla ma'i sgrub skor 'ga' zhig /rdzong chen tshe dbang / sgrol ma'i rjesaganang sogs thugs bzhed dang sbyar/ gra phu dgon sbug par gter kha 'og ma'i bla rdzogs thugs gsum gyi skor gnang / skyed tshal mkhan por rgyal po sku lnga'i srog dbang phul/ gong ra nges gsang rdo rje gling par bla ma gsang 'dus/ thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi dbang lung / rdzogs chen sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi 'khrid la rgyu 'bras chos bshad nas brtsams nas skyabs sems rdor sems sgom bzlas/ maṇ+ḍal/ bdag byin rlabs/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bla ma sprul sku bsnyen pa/ longs skur sgrub pa/ chos skur las la sbyor ba/ 'khor 'das ru shan dbye ba/ lusang ga yid gsum ru shan dbye ste gtan la phab/ de nas ngo sprod rtsal sbyong gdams gtad bar legs par gnang gdams gtad 'di bla ma'i sku tsher gzan zer pa yin kyang nged kyi bu'i tshab gra tshang yin pas nga ni rgas nas g.yeng ba cher gtong dgos pa zhig byung / nga khyed rnams kyi hur thag thong rang gzhan thams cad la mgo mi skor ba'i khyad par yod bas mnyam gzhag kho na la rtsol 'don dgos ba'i bslab ston (42na〉nga gnang /sa phag gad sgo zhang tshan gyis bde gzar bslang ba'i 'phro ma chod cing sde pa nor bu dang gong ra'i gra rnying rnams 'dris zab pas bzhugs ma nus par po ta lar phebs lcags phyi'i lo gsar gyi —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebazhugs gral la bstan pa spyi bye brag las brtsams ba'i 'phros gtam zab cing rgya che ba blo ldan rnams kyi yid dbang 'phrog pa dang dbyar gyi ring gter kha gong 'og gi dpe cha mang por zhu dag gong 'og sgrig pa 'di lo'i ston nged rang gi chos 'brel zhus pa nas bzung lcags glang nas me rta'i bar lo lo bzhin pho brang chen po po ta lar gdan drangs pa'i 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo/ zhi khro sgyu 'phrul tshe dbang dang bcas pa/ dong sbrug /mdo mgon legs ldan gyi dbang lung / snyan brgyud rdo rje'i zam pasagatsos pa'i rnying ma bka' ma'i skor bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub dbang chen mo/ bla rdzogs thugs gsum/ nā ga raka /sngags rgod log tri/ rta mgrin dbu dgu /rta nag yang chung / dpal mgon ma ning sogs chos dbang gi zab gter phal mo che/ khyad par sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang bla ma gsang 'dus kyi nyams 'khrid zhus pas zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i drung du rdzogs chen mang du thob pa'i me 'bar ba'i steng shing bsnan pa ltar nyams len gyi bogs ches cher thon gter kha gong ma'i bla ma dmar 'khrid/ thugs rje chen po 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu/ khros nag /mkha' 'gro gsang rdzogs/log tri/ gter stone gdung brgyud dang bcas pa'i rnam thar/ khro bo rol pa'i sgor gyi lung phyag bzhes(42ba)dmar 'khrid/ mgon po srog 'khor dang lha mo pa tra kun bzang / rgyal po bka' 'bum/ zab pa pod bzhi/ 'bri gung nas brgyud pa'i tshe bdag lcags sdig /'jam dpal me'i spu gri sogs gnubs kyi drag sngags zab chos mtha' yas/ rdo rje gling pa'i gur drag /rin cen gling pa'i chig chod kun grol/ byang gter phur pa lugs gnyis kyi dbang / bstan srung yongs rdzogs/ rat+na gling pa'i drag dmar/ dgongasapa yang zab/ grol thig gis gtsos gter kha sna tsho gos pa'i dbang lung man ngag /sngags gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum sngar thob pa'i po ti 'ga' zhig ma gtogs bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum nas po ti kha yar gyis mtshon dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin zla med pa zhus shing nges gsang rdo rje gling pa'i gra tshang tshugs pa'i mchod thebs rong dang gong dkar phyogs nas rgya mi chung tsam/ chu bo ri'i tshe chu sgrub sde bcas pa sbyor 'jags/ gos dar gser dngul sogs chos yon gyi maṇ+ḍal gang rgyas kyi —236

nyang ston khro6 pa blo gros mgo gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)lugs su phul ba sngar lo paṇa rnams kyis chos phyir srog kyang 'dor bar nus ba'i dka' spyad dang /'brog mi lo tsā ba dang zhung po du gu bas gser srang lnga brgya dus gcig la phul ba'i lo rgyus lta bur dpags na de 'dras gar yang mi phyin mod/deng sang kha rkyang lag stong mkhan gyi chos zhu ba tshor bsams na ngo mi gnong ngam snyam/rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tsho gos la bla ma gsang 'dus dang bka' brgyad kyi mgyogs dbang bum pa'i rgya can mdzad/g.yin yang chos gang gnang zhib tu ma 'tshal ba'i zhal slob 43na po lu mkhan rin po che khyab bdag rin cen bsod na mas mchogo grub/sgam po sprul sku/lhatsha sprul sku/chos rgyal 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling pa 'gyur med rdo rje/gos yul skyed tshal mkhan po byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin/mnga' bdag rma bo lcog bstan 'dzin chos dbang /gnas gzhi chos rje blo bzang pad+ma tshe dbang /mnga' ris bla wo sngags 'chang dkon cog lhun grub/rtogs pa'i mnga' bdag bres pa chos rgyal rdo rje/bon lung gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/sham+bha ra gdan sab brag la bla ma don grub rgyal mtshan/rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pa mtshudas med ga me gsang sngags/e waṃ lcog sgar slob dpon dpal 'byor grags pa'i dbyangs/bla ma gzug pa/rat+na bha dra'i gdung brgyud/mon pa smal po ba/tshar steng chos rje/drag gsum pa/sna mo shag mi pham ga me sangs rgyas/mchod dpon dbu mdzad/dge slong 'jam dbyangasagrags pa 'dar pa lo wo/sman sgom 'brang rgyas pa ngag dbang don grub/drung 'tsho ngag dbang lhag bsam/dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags sogs mang du yod 'dug na'ang thor bu tsam lasarang nyid kyis ma nges pa dang dri bya'i yul ma 'tshal lo//thub bstan 'dzin mar btab pa'i legasabashad kyis//sa bon dar drag mkhas grub yongs 'du'i shing //thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bu ro bda' ba//skal bzang 'chi med tsho gis kyi dga' ston gnas//bshes gnyen du mas snga 'gyur ring lugs kyi//gdugs dkar yu ba khyod 43ba tshe pa nyer gtad pa'i//phyag bzhes smin grol gdamasapa'i grib bsil la//bgrang yas las can ngal gsor byas 'di mtshar//theg dgu'i lam rdzogs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)mdo dbang tsan+dan ljon/ /bum stong gcig nas gcig byo'i dug sbrul gyis/ /'khril srog zur lugs ma ki tas bcad dri/ /rnam dag bstan pa'i rlung zhen phyogs kun khyab/ /ris med grub mtha'i spyi rta thub pa'i gsung / /'chad nyan gses bral rim gro'i 'grul zhud can/ /thos bsam lang tsho dar bab gom 'gros gsang / gangs can thang la dkyus thog bcad de med/ /lnga pa dgon gnas kyi zhal bdag bya ba las kyi 'khor lo sogs 'gro don mdzad pa ni/ rje bla ma 'dis khra tshang dang sman lung gi gdan sa'ang gcung dang sku tsha mo sogs ci dgar spyod pa las bden 'dzin gyi chen pa mi mnga' zhing rtses dang bsam gtan gling gnas khyad du 'phags pa dang ser khyim pa sogs kyi 'du 'dzi med pa nas zab bzhes kyi bsti gnas su thugs rtse bstad pa sne'u stong bdag mo sngon mas bzhugs su ma ster bas shel brag /bkra shis rtse chos sde/ sa ba grus mtshon pa'i gnas nges med du bzhugs ngos sne'u stong rtser dgos dus rdo rje dang mi dgos rdo 'jong gi dpes bzhugs gral 'phros gtam/ bka' shog gal che ba'i ris kyi bod rtsom/ khro rol 'char ka dgra mnan skong bshags sogs sku rim gyi tshe lha gzigs gong ma chen po'i zhabs 'bring du bcar pa'i mur shing rta gong ra lo tsā ba grongs pa'i slob ma mtha' dag der 'dus khrod nas sreg chog gsal 'debs kyi cho ga ba'i gtso bo rje nyid/ (44na)rin po che bres pa/ bla ma bon lung pa gsum bzhugs gnas kyang gcig tu mdzad/gsung 'phros kyi lhongs la ka ca che chung gi gleng gzhir bres nas kyis gzhis ka rtse dang thag nye bas bsngo rten la byung ba'i gser dngul dang byu ru spos shel phran tsam ma gtogs gzhan 'gangs can med tshul/ bon lung pas hor 'brog dang 'dris che bas rta spu gnag 'os sgom yod gsung bar/ rje bla mas kho bor dpe cha po ti kha shas las gzhan 'gangs che ba med phebs pa gong ra'i gra ris 'dras tshor bas bla ma sman lung nas kyi gsung de rnam dpyod che zhes ngo mtshar du 'dzin/ bla ma gsum thun mong du gsal 'debs kyi yon byung ba'i steng nas khe dang rgyal kha gzhan dang gyong dang bug kha rang gis len pa'i rnam pas khong dpon slob gnyis kyi thugs dang bstun nas bon lung pas hor sil/ bres nas —238

nyang ston khra k+ṣe pa blo gros ma ga gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)kyis phod ka bdag gir mdzad pa'i lhag rta dang sham thabs bsnams pas thugs 'dzin chags chung ba'i tshad du song /gong ra ba tsho'i nang gros sku skye ma byung bar bla ma bon lung pas 'dzin bdag gi ming btags dang / de gzhung gi dgongs par ma bstad na skor cig bla ma'i ming btags med pa byas/ bsngo ba dang grong chog gi dbu mdzad sogs bla tshab shrī bha dras byed rtsis rdo kha gcig nas gnyis su 'khyar ba'i rin spung rdzong sdod dwags po bkra shis kyis tshor ba sde pa'i snyan du phul ba dang de snga gong ra lo tsā ba chos gos ngur smig dang zhwa ser gyi sgrib shing la brten sde pa thugs 'khrul nas spyan rgyang mdzad na'ang / bla ma sog bzlog pa'i slob (44ba)pa'i gtso bo yin tshul gsan pas sog bzlog pa dge lugs la shin tu gnag pa gtsang gi drung 'khor la bzhugs dus nas thugs rgyus yod par brten sngar bdag rkyen gnang ba'ang thal char song snyam pa'i thugs 'dzin stangs gzhan du gzhol te khong tsho'i zhu ba mtha' dag sgrim slog rje bla ma sngar nas cung zad spyan sngar yang thogs pa dang / nged rang nas kyang skabs su babs tshul mol ba'i rgyus rje nyid dang sa ṅga bha dra can lhan cig par sde pa'i bslab ston la sngar phan gong ra ba'i gnas tshul zhib pa shes ma byung / khyed tsho snang rtse gter ston dang bla ma sog bzlog pa'i brgyud 'dzin yin 'dug pa chos lugs de bzhin byas na dge lugs dang dam sel ches pas gzhung gi sku rim pa mi yong 'dug /da cha sngar byed mtha' dag bzhag nas nyang chos dbang sogs gter kha rnying pa'i ris cho ga phyag len gyis mtshon skabs su gang babs bla mas 'dzugs pa dang /khyed tshos kyang bla mas gang zer la nyan dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhib gsed rdzong sdod la bslab ston bsko 'ja' sogs gnang nas bsko bzhag mdzad/ lo chen gyi phyi rten la dngul gdung / rdzogs chen bla brgyud/ gtsang khang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams bzheng ba'i thig rtsa zhal bkod rab gnas kyi bar thugs khur cher mdzad/ 'di dus rten gyis rab gnas kyi me tog bzung bas mtshon dbus gtsang kun tu phyag nas bzung ba'i lo rgyus mang du snang /—239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she 'du khang logs bris dang gtsang khang g.yas la rje bla ma'i yum gyi dgongs rdzogs su o rgyan yab yum gsum/ bla ma gsang 'dus dang thugs rje chen po yang (45na)snying 'dus pa'i lha tshogs 'bar ma sngags srung gi sku rnams bzhedas/ de lhag yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la gnas bcus bskor ba'i zhal byang la thugs rtsom gnang / rje nyid gter kha gong 'og la thugs chen shin tu che na'ang snang rtse gter ston phyogs la mi dgyes pa med pa'i bar gong ra lo tsā bar thugs dang dam tshig gi khyad nas de phyogs kyi chos lugs bsgyur ba skabs su mi babs shing gra ris kyi blor yang mi chud pas lam du mi rgyug pa sogs sgo du ma'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas rong byams chen du sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs de skabs mchod dpon yin pa brgyud nas dbyings sa la ni bka' gang phebs las snyan 'bul zhu ma nus/ dngos gzhi shar tshod 'di ltar byung bas chos lugs rang babs su bzhag pa'i sgo nas bla ma'i gdan sa byed pa la ni mi spro ba med/ grub mtha' bsgyur bar shar na bla ma'i dgongs pa ma rdzogs dogs pa dang nged rang la'ang phyogs mthong gi byed dka' las spros pa'i thon gsogs mi yong 'dra snang sog gong gsum gyi lugs bsnub pa rang gi dgongs bstad yin na bla ma gzhan zhig bsko ba gnang na 'gab tshul byung bar/ dngos gzhi thugs bsam thongs pa'i gsung 'phros yin 'dug rung thag chod nas bsgyur bkod byas tshe sde pa'i dgongs 'phog kyang byung dogs yod thugs bsam la dri ma med phyin dpon po'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa la nyes pa yong rgyu mi 'dug pas bslab ston dang bstun pa'i sgo gang zab mdzad dgos pa'i len phul ba thugs la bzhag pa'i bla ma gsang (45ba tsher dus dang bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs 'dzugs pa'i sgra sgrig gnang /dwags po na gsang rdzogs las byang gi par yod pa rnam rgyal gyi rdzong dpon rong bde skyid gling par gang mang btab nas dgos tshul gyi phyag bris mdzad/ chos dbang gis zab gter bzhes pa'i snyan pa sman lung pa mi bskyod rdo rjes gsan nas spyan sngar byon te bla ma rin po che la sngar ma grags pa'i dam chos khyad par can zhig yod 'dug pa bdag la thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhus pas 'di ltar —240

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)zab cing rgya che ba'i chos 'di dang por byon pa yin te lo bcu gsum gyi bar du gter lung bzhin bka' rgyas btab/ de nas kyang rgyud 'di gdan ma drangs kyi bar du rgyab brten lung dang bral bsartsod pas 'jigs nas ma bstan/ da ston pa la'ang bstan pa'i yul yang dkon par byung khyed byon pa legs de'i sngon la dbang gal che bas gra sgrig la lha gro dgon par phebs phyogs kyi chos zhu ba rnams la brda 'grem gyi pho nya btang nas ma 'dus par gdangs dbyangs rnams sbyong dar mdzad pa sman lung pa'i thugs su chud pa'i 'khrul med dwags stan dbang phyug rdo rjes rtse le dgon du btsugs pa da lta'i bar du rgyun mi chad du yod 'phros mchis pas gra ris gras nas slob mkhan gyi khas len pa e yod gsungs pa dzi na klu las khas blangs nas gdangs dbyangs rnams zhib tu dpyad gra ris rnams la khrid pas phal cher gyi blor chud/hor zla drug pa'i nang du bla ma gsang 'dus/ byang gter thugs sgrub drag po rtsal/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs/ sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/ thugs rje chen po yang (46na)snying 'dus pa/ phur pa spu gri/ dgongasa'adus pad+ma badz+ra rtsal gyi dkyil 'khor rnams rdul tshon la brten pa'i chog mang btsugs/ bsngo zhusakyis gtsos pa'i 'di phyi'i don du 'bul pa gang byung gra ris la mang 'gyed 'cham dbyangs bris thig sogs yon tan sprod mkhan rnams la zur rdzas mtshon skyed bstar legs po mdzad rung sa sgo bha dra dang shrī bha dras thog drangs gra pa phal cher rje nyid bla ma mdzad 'dod nas ri bskul mtsho skyom dang gter kha 'og ma'i skor 'jugs bzhed kyis snang rtse ba'i lugs bsnubs pa las gzhung nas mi mdzad dka' med btang ba yin snyam pa med pa'i log rtog gi mun pas btibs nas ci mdzad thams cad legs par mthong / gzhung nas gnang ba'i bsko bzhag kyang lha dbang phyug chen po 'jig rten thams cad ngas byas mnyam pa'i dpe bzhin gong ra lo tsā ba'i shul gyi dgon chos bzhis phyi nang nor rdzas gra ris tshang ma chos rje khra tshang par sprad yod do ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam gzhag brtan na'ang gong ra bla ma zhes pa'i snyan po'i ming tsam las nang nor rdzas rnams la zhal 'jug pa lta ci spyan gyis gzigs dbang —241—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyetsam yang med/ sa rnya rang bsdad dus kho pa'i zhen gyi gsol ja dang bzhes pa brten thub tsam yong na'ang sa ṅga ni ri lung sbug dang skyid khang pa'i nang gnyis su tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyi mthus mang ja ma gtogs nyung ja'i zur gsos tsam yang med cing dmangs rtsam gsar rnying la ma ltos pa bzhes rgyu byung ba rang la ya mtshan du brtsi/ rgyun gyi phyag g.yog o rgyan badz+ra/ rgyal mchog (46ba)pa ri kurma/ sī sha sogs re mos kyis zhabs 'bring du bsten yang chos phyogs kyi dad pa dang 'jig rten gyi khrel gzhung gang yang med pa'i khral chos kho na lhur blangs pas bsngo zhus la byung ba'i pho mo'i gos sna'i ris gsol ja nyo bar byams chen sogs su rdzong bda' mdzad pa nor nyan pa rnams kho rang tshos tshags byas/ rnying pa dag sdug btsongs pa'i rin gyis 'u zi 'dra srul ba mang du bzhes pa'i skyon gyis dbu ya dang zhabs nad sogs sku gzugs ma bde bas chu bzang du re ba'i ri lung sbug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe gra pa sgrigs 'grim ma nus pa rnams don sa ṅga la 'khor ba khag bla mar btags pa'i gong ra'i chags su sdod mi cher ma byung bas rkyen byas dmangs ma gros thog nas bla ma'i phyag g.yog la btsun chung rnams re mos byas dmangs ma gong ra rang du bsgril bar thag bcad/ gra gzhen lnga zan ril bsgril ba rong pa sku skye 'jam dbyangs rab rgyas la babs pa'i phyag g.yog la bskos rjes sa sa mdo dbang gi bod rtsag rnams rogs byed tsam yang med par sku skye bskur pa na gzhon pa'i theg dka' ba tsam la snying rus bskyed nas sha ra'i gru bton khu lung du khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bar mdo dbang 'bul ba gnang ba'i zhabs phyir 'byor ba nas bzung zhing gzhan du ma gshegs par phyag g.yog khur bskyed bcar sdod byas snang gong ra'i gra pa rnams kyang kha mdzes tsam las ha cang gus rgyu med pas thugs zhen gsog par dgongs te gnyen po bsten pa las yul ngan spong ba'i dpe ltar phyag phyir sku skye dang gtsang dge 'khor nas chos zhu ba'i sngags gzhen dkar po ba gnyis (47na thad nas 'bras yul skyed tshal gyi phu'i dgon chung chu legs pa zhig tu sku mtshams mdzad zla ba lnga tsam nas gsol chas chad ri lung sbug gi gnyer pa sam+bha 'a sru mos byed yod pa de'i sar dgon chung de'i gra pa rna ba 'on pa zhig yod pa pho nyar —242

nyang ston khra tsha pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)mngags pa'i phyag bris 'di lta ste/sru mo rang grol rnal 'byor ma/ /mos gus dag snang can de la/ /da lam yi ge phul ba'i don/ /sdug rgan byis pa gnyis dang bcas/ /bdag cag bya bral mi gsum gyi/ /chos brgyags rtsam pa rbad chad song / khyed kyi snying rjes kun blangs nas/ /da lam phye khug gang tsam zhig /'on pa 'di la bskur ba mkhyen/ /stogs pa'i nad la phan pa'i sman/ /bag zan gro zhib byung yang zhu/ /'di nas yi ge 'di bzhin gyi/ /gnas tshul sa sgor gsung bar mdzod/ /ces pa gnang rung zhag lnga tsam gyi bar bang phyin ma 'khor bar rje bla ma ni khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos dbang yon la bstar ba'i nag po spus legs de ga nas skol te zhus pas bzhes pa'i go yang bcad gsung ngag bsdams nas lha sngags ye shes kho nas dus 'da'/ bang phyin e byung zhes pa'i phyag brda mdzad pa ma byung mthong sa la mi 'dug do nub kyang mi yong ba 'dra zhus par sam ṭa la phyag bris gnang nas khyed gnyis na gzhen pas ltogs yod gtor ma'i mtheb skyu 'di rnams phab la zan tshod gyis skyon med gsungs pa bzhin zhabs phyi ba gnyis kyis mtheb skyu zos dgon khrod nas rtsam pa btsal bas nas nag gi phye zhig rnyed pa de med pa las e drag snyam bre lnga tsam zhig khyer (47ba)nas sku skyes sku zhabs su phul bas 'di bad gan la rgyag nga ltogs pa mi 'dug khyed rang gnyis zo ya gsung ba'i phyag bris gnang /de nas bang phyin 'khor te dmangs rtsam rdo sag 'dres pa khal gnyis tsam byung ba la'ang dgyes pa chen bor gyur/ rin spungs kyi yongs sdud bkar rgya ba sogs kyis gong ra ba bla gra rnams lugs legs po med 'dug zer ba'i skad cha gcig nas gnyis su mched pa 'bras spungs su byung ba brag sna chos rjer 'dri bar btang ba'i yig lan du sman lung pa 'di la byabs med pas pho skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan 'bul ba yong ris su mi 'dug /da cha dbye g.yang ma byung na mi tshe mi phyid thag chod yin tshul la brten rin spungs rdzong sdod dang khang dmar ba thun mong du sde pas bka' shog gnang ba'i dgon chas mchod —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losegazhis rnams sa lha'i lag nas blangs nas bla mar phrad zer ba yod pa ltar rin spungs nas rgyu mtshan 'di yin med par 'phral du phebs dgos pa'i zhu yig phul ba de skabs 'tshur phur drung pa rin po che rigashegs pa'i skabs dang 'grig pas gar lugs tshor rtsi bzhag gnang ba rje nyid sngar zhwa dmar ba'i sgar du phebs pa'i phyogs 'phul gyis thugs zos mi bde ba zhig e yin dgongs pa'i ci yin nam gang yin nam zhes thugs blo mi bde ba'i ngang nas bkra shis gling gi grong du gnas tshang mdzad pa'i nub bka' las/ gar lugs kyi gral du bsdam ra bzhin e yin g.yin ni sgar la phyin tsam las spros pa'i kur lugs kyi zhabs tog dang dge lugs la zhabs 'dren mngon thogs pa ni med/ nga rang gi yon tan phran bu re sbyangs chos bka' gang thob bla ma nges (48na thad la zhus nyes pa yod don mi 'jug kyang gang ltar lha sa phyogs la 'gro dgos pa yod 'gro chos rje ni med sngags pa kho ni 'gro e yong mi shes phyin kyang za rogs las mi 'dug /khyod kyi 'gro rogs byed dgos gsungs pa'i phebasalan du sku skye'i zhu bar thag ring thung gang gi sar yang mi 'gro ci zhu/ gzhan ma sku zhabs rang sku na bgres nga na gzhen yong thang gang yang med pas dper na da lam phyag g.yog grul thub rgan pa zhig yod na gsol zhib dang gsol mar lus med 'gro 'on kyang blo bsam ma log pa'i ngos nas bslab ston gang gnang mi zhu ri shi mod zhus pas khyod kyis sngar ltar byas pas chog pher yong 'dzom pas bya ba byed pa'i nges pa mi 'dug gang bskos gtso che de'i nang nas o rgyan rin po che'i thugs rje yin gsungs nang par pa ku klung chen po bsgral te rin chen spungs pa'i pho brang du phebs/ rdzong dpon mtshal mig pa dang zhwa khab pa yong sdud khang dmar pa gsum nas khang steng du yod thog gdan drangs phyag g.yog gnyis phyir bton bka' gros 'dra mo zhig btsugs song ba lags sdong po ba zer bas gong ra'i bla ma rang rtsad gcod pa zhig 'dug ci yin gleng ba sogs gang sa nas bka' bkyon yin dogs kyi phyag g.yog gnyis blo 'tshub cher langs/ nga 'debs gcig song mtshams sku zhabs su phyin pa na dgong dang mi 'dra ba'i thugs blo lhod par gyur te zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas skyon ma mchis sa lha'i lag nas —244

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanagang ci rnams rtsis len dgos pa'i bka' shog dang bka' bkod bsgyur ba yin 'dug gsung / de gong nas dogs pa zhig yod pa yin nam rdzong nang nas gcig (48bsgo gnyis brten gyi bya bsgor gang rung gi skyon gyis yongs grags rnams ma gtogs ka ca phal cher sbas bshugs byas pa'i stabasakyis gong ra sdodagon dang bcas pa phyag tu 'byor ba'i gtam dang gang yod kha sing lugs kyi mi la phyag gdang mi dgos pa'i phan yon tsam las grags pa don dang mthun pa nam byung bar snang / rtsisalen dus dngos po rnams bsdu ba dang mi sna'i sne len sogs tshang ma sku skye gcig bu'i steng du gal zhing gra ris gzhan ma tshos rogs ram ma byas pa'i sbyong spyod che ba byung skad/ka ca rnams ma sprad pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten nas slar rgya ma ba blo bzang rab rgyas rdzong bda' byas pa'i zhi ba'i skor g.yeng dang tsha 'jun ci yang byas rung kho pas brag phug rgyab bstad kyis sngar gang sprad las spros pa'i chas ka'i ris med ces khas ma blangs par mi sna rdzong sdod kyis snum la bkar bar thag bcad pa na zhu lan du/ gzhung nas sku drin bskyangs pa gcig pus cho go rdo snum gtan med pa zhig rang dgos khong rnams kyis ni mi thon nges yin des na khrims rar chud na nged btsun pa'i nang nas kyang bla ma'i ming btags tsam yin pas chos kyi bya ba dang mi 'brel bas de 'drar ma thug par mdzod/ phran bur tsam byung yang gra pa skyong mkhan yin 'dug ma byung na'ang sngar yang gang byung thugs rjer shes ba byas/ da dung bzod pa gang theg byed gsungs pas kha mchu yo gal ma dgos par thag chod/ sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan zhabs ma brtan rung bzhugs pa skad du dril rgya cher bsgragasapa'i gsang sgo'i skabs gong ra'i deb sogs spyan 'bebs (49na/nu bar phebs/gung thang dpon slob zhabs pad ma brtan pa'i gshis rnying ma phyogs nas dgos rigs rje 'di nyid 'os 'dra zhes mchod dpon pa'i 'char ston byung ba dang ma nas sku yon gyi babs kyang che bar go bas lha sa nas phyir phebs zhor 'bras spungs su zhag shas bzhugs nas de lo nged rang la dogs cha che tsam yod pa sel byed du kha 'bar ma dkar nag khra gsum/ mkha' 'gro grib sel/ mkha' 'gro bsu —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)bzlog gnang / 'dis mtshon lcags byi nas me rta'i bar gong smos kyi rim gro dang sdebargyad kyi grib sel/'chi blu/ gdon 'grol/ gshin rje 'char ga'i mdos chen rgyas pa gra tshang gi gra pa kha shas kyis gsung rim pa byas nas zhag bdun gyi bar las byang dus bzhir bsrang ba sdigs rgyun dang bcas bsgrubs mthar sku nub phyogs kyi lcog ril du bzhugs/chu stag lo kong po phan bde bas chab mdo dbon drung sogs dang lag sbrel ba'i kha 'jam gting rtsub kyi byed ngan thog dpung chen bteg pa'i jus rim la 'char ka seng zhon ma'i mdos gtor gnang ba'i dus srod kyi thun gtor 'bul ba'i tshe bshugs glu'i sgra chen po kun gyis tshor ba sgrub pa po rnams la spyan ltas ngo mtshar ba mdos gtong nyin rlung tshur 'od 'phro skad cig la shar phyogs su 'gyur ba'i me lce'i tshogs dum bur chad pa'i nus rtags shin tu che ba byung / slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phreng dang grub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam pa chen po'i gnas dpal gyi chu bo rir tshe chog 'dzugs pa'i shar pa lo shas ze bo 'chi med bkod pa dang de rjes slob dpon chen po'i che (49ba)chung yod pa'i rten 'brel gyi khyad dang bcas tshe chu sgrub sde bzhugs gnas su phul zhing sa ris kyang snga phyir sbyar bar brten mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rjes 'bras gshong lha ri rin cen snying phug nas gdan drangs pa'i tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sgrub mchod lo lo bzhin zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer dgu la sa chog /gnam gang la dkyil 'khor bris thig tshes gcig gi snga char sgrub pa tshugs pa bco lnga la dngos grub len chog bcu drug gi zhogs dkyil 'khor bsdus rdul tshon gshegs gsol la ser sbreng gi bkur sti dang bcas te chu bo chen por bshags tshur phebs rgyun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi cha rnams bshams tshe chog tshar gcig gtong ba'i bar gyi rdo rje slob dpon du rje bla ma nyid phebs shing de mtshungs zla ba gsum pa'i nyer dgu nas brtsams sa ga zla bar yang shin tu rgyas pa gnang zhing rgyun du'ang grangs bcad kyis tshe chog chag med du gtong ba'i thugs khur bzhes/sa khyi nas bzung bstan pa spyi rim bod khams kyi bde thabs la dmigs dbus gtsang gi sngags —246

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ yonasde mang po nas hor zla bcu pa'i nang du khro rol gtor rgyun btsugs pa'i gtsang gi phung po ri bo cher khro bo rol ba'i gtor bzlog dkyil 'khor rdul tshon bsad zlog dang khyung bcas 'khor lo/ gzhan yang ldebs kha dgu/ zer kha bcu/ kha bsgyur nyer gcig gis mtsho ni shin tu rgyas par mdzad pa'i nyer dgu la gtor rgyag dang / gnam gang la brgyags rngan sogs phyag len shin tu dngos gtsang ba gnang / zla ba bcu gcig par rin spungs su 'char can gyi sku rim gzhan yang dmigs (50na thas la gyi rigs ji snyed dang lha 'dre stong gi dra ba/ ma mo gling bzhi'i mdos deng sang rnying ma pa phal cher la grags chung ba dag chos rje smar ngag dbang thub bstan par phyag 'khrid mdzad nas dbus gtsang du lan grangs mang du song ba'ang nad mas gzug rtsod zhi ba'i gsos sman du gyur/ sne'u sdong rtser bka' chos 'bul bar phebs skabs zhabs drung dga' ldan dang phyogs mthun du rtses dang bsam gtan gling gi gnas mjal gnang / chos rgyal pho brang nas bsnyen bkur dgos cha rnams gra bsgrigs g.yo ru khra 'brug gi gtsug lag khang du bstan pa spyi rim la khro rol slang dgu ma rgyas par mdzad/ bkra shis rtse chos sder gser gdung dngul gdung gis gtsos pa'i mchod khang mgon khang rnams la mchod 'bul dang tshogs su mang ja/ de mtshungs ri bo chos gling yang zhabs kyis bcags nas mchod mjal mang skol mdzad/khra tshang du bzhugs thog gzims khang gong 'og /spangs che ba/ ge ra ba rnams kyi mi ngo la tshe dbang /sman lung du khrim dbang / thang po che'i mkhan po la 'bor ba dong sprugs dang khyams stod par tshe dbang stsal/ 'di skabs 'jig rten rmo mes pa rnams dad pa skyed par byed pa'i chibs khal gra ris sogs sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i gra 'grig 'byor pa che ba yod na'ang yar klungs phyogs su bla ma mkhas grub gnyis 'dzom gyi ris la phyis skor 'jug sgo che ba yong gi med 'dug pas 'phrin las kyang de tsam mo//phebs lam gyi zhen du gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi chos (50ba)gra chen po mchod khang mgon khang rnams kyi mjal kha dang tsho gos chen du mang ja skol ba gnang / nged rang nas sman gyi mthun rkyen dang bcas gsol ba btab cing rje nyid nas kyang sgrub rtsol gnang ste ri lung sbug tu thod sku rgyu skar nyer 247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshebargyad rdul tshon rnams kyi sta gon dang sa choge gis bslang ba/ bzung ba/ srung ba/ ye shes dang las thig gdab pa nas rgyal chen dam sri sgo byang ma tre dkyil 'khor bri ba sogs sman khrol bu btags btsags phye ma gong bu rnams khrol bu la'ang dam pa rigs brgyas sbyang ba de nyid rigs lngas sbyang ba gsang tshan rigs gcig gis sbyang ba ste gong bu'i sgrub pa/ de nas shar du brdung ba/ lhor tshag /nub tu sbol/ byang du yab yum gnyis med bdud rtsir 'phel bar bsam pa/ sman zhal phye nas dbang rnams rim bzhin bskur bas mtshon zhag gco lnga'i bar bsgrubs pa'i myong grol byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'od du 'bar ba nas gshos phor chung tshad gang ba tsam gyi dam rdzas 'phral du skyel mi gnang /g.yin yang 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po yang snying 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nasaskyes bdun myong grol gyi ril sgrub mdzad de mtshams med lngar spyad pa'i sdig can rnams kyang mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam du drangs pas dkar nag 'byed pa'i chos kyi rgyal po'ang las kyi me long thogs pa ngal ba'i khur du song / lha sa 'brang rgyas shag tu khro rol/ tshag gur du 'char kha'i mdos/'chi blu/ gdon grol/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/ rta mgrin skyer snang (51na〉rugs kyi dbang / kho re sbug tu khrom pa lnga brgya tsam la tshe dbang / skyid gshong / bde skyid gling / grags pa ba/ yul rnams su sbyin bdag so so'i blo dang mthun pa'i dbang bka'/ 'chi blu/ gdon byad 'grol ba/ mdos zor/sreg mnan/ skong bshags/ tshogs brgya sogs skabs su gang babs mdzad/'phrang sgo bde skyid dpal 'byor du mchod dpon dbu mdzad gnyis kyi rim gror dgra mnan/ chu shur khri smad du mgron gnyer bsod nams dbang rgyal gyi rkyen sel gyi dbang bka' dang rim gro sogs skyid shod yar klungs gtsang rong phyogs kyi mchog dman bar pa'i sbyin bdag kun gyi 'di phyi'i mgon skyabs gling dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad pa shin tu mang na'ang che long tsam las mtha' dag brjod par ma nus/ gong ra lo tsā ba'i skye ba zung mkhar sle spus pa'i bur byung ngam zhes pa'i sgro btags la brten dwags po gsal ba sgang pa'i bu lo rang gi ba dang bla ma gnyis ka yin pa'i ga me chos rgyal ba 248—

nyang ston khra tshang pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanal dgrar lta ba'i spyon pa zhig yod pa des phyogs kun tu dril bsgrags/ rje nyid la'ang gnas tshul zhug par brten bdag gong ra'i gdan sa bla ma'i sku skye ma phebs bar byed mkhan yang yin cing da cha sle sbus pa'i der gsal po byung yod 'dug pas sku skye gdan ma drangs na rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pas don la mi btub par ma zad da lta rong phyogs su nged rang la log lta byed mkhan mang ba'i khar sku skye la bdag rkyen ma sprad cesang na pa'i khyur rdzong 'dug pas gdan (51bskrengs sku zha khas su gtsug phud dang bdag gis dbang cho me rnams phul chos lugs snang sog phyogs dang ma 'dres pa zhig gang yong gi do dam byed gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan mchod dpon pa brgyud nged rang dang sde pa 'phrin las rgya mtshor gsungs byung ba sku skyer bdag rkyen sprad phyin gong ra ba lkugs ma'i zhabs bro sngar shul du lhogs pa las 'os mi 'dug pas rje nyid la dgon mchod gzhis gra ris dbus chu lho byang gang ris nas gong ra las mi zhan pa'i sbyor 'jags gang legs zhu/ gong ra'i skor bcas rnams rin spungs nas rtsis blangs pa'i rong du gong ra zer ba zhig dgos rgyu min nges yin tshul gsol bas nged rang dbus phyogs su sdod par yang spro zhing bka' bzhes de bzhin bka' drin che/ rong gi dgon gzhis rnams rtsisa'abul bar bdag 'gro dgos sam chos rje drung dgon pa ba bsdad yod pa khong gis chog ces thugs thag bcad pa'i phebs sgo gnang / zhag shas nas sku ngos kyis nged la kha sang mchod dpon brgyud pa'i bslab ston de bzhin phebs pa gong ra'i gra ris mthong snang can de tsho dang lhan du sdod ma dgos pa so sod cing dge sbyor smar ba dbus phyogs kyi dgon gra ris rnams rang dbang 'du zhing legs pa yong 'dug ba gong rar bla ma su 'dra zhig gnang yang ma stongs tsam byung na des 'thus ba 'dug rung sa risagazhung bzhes gnang ba'i dgon pa khungs med du song na sman lung pas kho rang dbus phyogs su gru bzhi lam lam byas lo chen gyi shul rnams ming tsam yang ma lus pa'i rjesang na 'di (52na 'dra bzhag cesadam log gi gral chen por gtong thag chod yin pas sku skye gdan drangs ma chog na'ang skor cig yar log chog ba dang 'tsham babs la 'bur ba skam po'i zem 'jog byas rjes dbus phyogs nas dgon —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losegazhis gnang na thugs rje che 'dug ma byung yang na so rgan po yin pas ri khrod du bsdad chog tshul phebs sgo nan chags pa ltar sde pa la'ang de ga'i mol mchid byas/ sku skye'i skor gyi gleng brjod ma byung na sham+bha ra rang slog yong grabs yod pas rkyen des chos rje brag la bar dpal rgya mthongs su babs gshis 'di res nas khal sum brgya'i gshor 'debs dang rjes su shol ra ba gnas rnying gi khrir byon pa nas khong gis gsol skal rnams sham+bha ra gyis tshab tu phul gra rnying phal cher grub mtha'i dbang gis phyogs su byer na'ang gra btsun gsar pa'i ris dang dbus gtsang gnyis kur dgon mchod gzhis yar rgyas su song ba'i nges gsang rdo rje gling pa zhes snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa mdzes pa'i rgyan du mdzad/sa sprel nang du las byang le'u brgyad pa'i chog bsgrigs dang 'brel ba'i tshes bcu'i gar 'cham rin po che kun bzang rtse pa'i phyag len 'khrul pa med pa 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i zhal 'bag /skra brnyan/phod ka /gar gos/ rus rgyan/ brog zhu/ ḍā dril/ bhan phur/ phyag mtshan gyi rim pas mtshon dgos cha che phra mtha' dag dang slob dpon chen po che mchog gi bris sku sman lung shāka 'od kyi 'bur sku/ gzhan yang rten mchod kyi rim pa yol pa/ bla bre/ snyan dar/ sbug sil/ rnga/ dung (52ba)chen/ thab gdan spyad kyis gtsos pa'i gra tshar gyi spyi rdzas thams cad deb ther du bkod/ sngar lo chen gyi dus kyi spyi rdzas rnams sa ṅgā gcig pus bdag gir bzung nas rjes su 'di byas ci yang ma byung bas da sgos bla gnyer gra ris sus kyang sger bdag tu ma song bar gong ra nges gsang gling par 'jags dgos pa'i tshogs gtam chos srung la gnyer gtad/gra tshang gi bca' yig rtsoms shig par bkas bskul ba ltar sa bon gyi don bzhin bris par tham gas gnon gsung ba bzhin rgyas btab/ bar skabs su chos rje thub bstan pa dang 'gyangs su song ba 'dra zhig snang ba khra tshang pa'i zhal ngo'i ris khrol mi 'dug pas khong par chos phyogs kyi spyan 'khrid sogs bdag rkyen mdzad pa 'gab tshul gsol ba bzhin gdan sa'i thugs rtse bstad cing sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs kyang 'o brgyal skabs dang rjes su mchod dpon gyi las 'dzin du 'gyur ba'i —250

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanabadag rkyen gang 'os gnang rtsis kyi phyag bris yig thog tu 'khyon pa sogs dgon yas mas mtha' dag le dbar mi 'chor ba'i gra sgrig gi bka' khyab cher mdzad do//gzhan phan 'phrin las sbrang rtsi dngar po'i bcud//mkhas btsun grub pa'i snyan grags dri bsung ngad //lhan cig 'thul ba'i 'dab stong 'dzum pa der//bstan 'dzin ut+pal gas gyis 'gran nusamin//sna tsho gis khams kyi khyad par brgya phrag nad//sel byed snying po'i ro nus bsdebs pa'i sman//'di phyi gto du nyer sim tshor ba la//sbyor khyod be+e ḍūr snang wo mgon po'i mne//log sgrub tsher dong mal yang chu skyes kyi//'dab ltar bsten 53na skos bdag gzhan mnyam brjes kyis//ngar 'dzin 'gong po rtsa ba gcod pa'i mtshon//snying rje'i mkha' la gzas par da gdod 'khrums//drug pa legs bshad kyi bstan bcos brtsams pa ni/gsang 'dus las gzhung bde 'jug rab gsal/thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa/bla ma'i 'khrid pad+ma'i zhal lung /gsang 'dus slob ma rjesabazung dbang gi sgrom/bla ma'i bsnyen yig/gsang 'dus 'cham dbyangs kyi gsal byed/rdzong wo tshe sgrub lag len nyi zlags la byed/gsang 'dus gzhung dang lhan thabs le'u brgyad pa'i jig 'don dkyusagacig tu bkod pa/rdzong chen bla ma'i gsol 'debs/mnyam sbyor sngon 'gro'i ngag 'don/rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bla ma dang zhi khro bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi las byang skong bshags bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i don gsal bka' gter zung 'jug rnam rol/sgrub khog ngag 'don khol du phyung ba zhi khro bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi las byang lhan thabs bkol byang phyogs gcig tu bsgrigasapa/yongs rdzogs rab gnas bde legs kun 'byung /de'i ngag 'don khol du phyung ba/khro rol chog bsgrigs nag po 'gro shes phyag bzhes go don gyis gsal bar byas pa/rdo rje gtum bo me lce 'phreng ba'i dbang chog dbang bshad dang tsos/rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sgom bzlas rgyun 'byer/bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs rnam bshad tshon las rab rgyas gu ru'i dgongs53bskyon/ de'i sngon 'gro'i lhan thabs rgyu sa chos bshad/yongs rdzogs mngone rtogs bstod wo gong ma'i zhal lung /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheyongs rdzogs las bzhi'i sbyin sreg ma 'dres yongs rdzogs/ gur mgon gyi rjes gnang / dpal mgon ma ning gi srog dbang / lha mo rang byung ba'i sgrub skor/ bod yul bstan ma'i srog dbang / seng ldeng nags sgrol gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang skal bzang dga' ston/ lha bsangs bar chad kun sel/ bsngo ba mdor bsdus/ rnam bcu dbang ldan dang mchod rten gyi thig rtsa nyung ngu gsal byed/ sum rtags kyi 'grel bshad zung 'jug snang byed yid kyi shing rta/ gsung snyan rin po che'i dri lan ka shi ga'i chun po snang ba'i mdzod kun tu bzang po'i dgongs pa'i rgyan/ nang so 'jam dbyangs la lan du springs pa'i gtam byis pa rgan po'i rlung sman/ mkhan rin po che ngag dbang chos grags kyi dri lan las brtsams te snyan ngag me long gi dka' 'grel dbyangs can ba 'ad pa'i rol mtsho/ grub ris rlangs kyi gdung rabs rtogs brjod/ dzam la dkar po'i rjes gnang / chos srung rnams kyi mchod bstod kyi rim pa/gsang sngags nang gi gtor bsngo/ tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gtor 'bul/ bla ma chos rgyal rdo rje/ sne'u sdong rtse zhabs drung yab sras/ gong ra rdo rje gling gra dmangs kyis zhus pa'i rje nyid dang shrī lo spang pas zhus pa'i brtan bzhugs/ gzhan yang khra tshang la brtan bzhugs rgyal yum phar phyin ma/chos dbyings zad med ma/ rgyal ba (54na)rgya mtsho ma/ bstan pa mtshungs med ma/ dong sprug mchod thebs gra tshang la 'jags dgos pa'i sne'u sdong gong ma chen por phul ba'i chab shog ni/ rigs mchog rin chen du ma'i sa 'dzin dbang / /legs byas 'od brgya'i snang bas 'byud pa de/ /kun khyab gling bzhi'i mun sel bstan 'gro'i dpal/ /mi dbang zhabs pad 'gyur med der phyag 'tshal/ /sgyu lusagog pos gtsang rong dog sa myul/ l+le gson dkor zas me mur 'gam bzhin du/ /sems nyid rkang drug khyod zhabs pad tshal der/ /'phur lding rtse ba'i 'bangs des 'di skad zhu/ /bde gshegs phag gru rang gi chos srid che/ /'dzin la slar byon tsam la ngo mtshar ci/ /dug sgrib ma sbyangs gangs can 'gro ba 'dis/ khyod mtshan thos pa'i skal bzang 'di ngo mtshar/ /'on kyang mun pa'i byug pa la dga' ba'i/ /nye 'khor grogs la ci yang snang srid phyir/ khyod sku skal bzang nam mkha'i nor bu de/ /rtsod dus chu 'dzin —252

to ston khra tsha pa blo gro mag gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)sgrib byed rgyang bsrings sa ma//bstan 'gro'i don dgongs thugs bskyed 'od brgya'i 'phreng //phyogasabacur bkye na nam mkha' ral gyi dogs/khyod thugs kho nar rtag tu zhen pa de'i//yid dam brtan po da dung mi 'dor ram//bgrang gzhi'i ba gam brtsegs pa'i ri mgul du//tshems 'phreng gangs ri zhu ba'i gsher rgyun gyis//dbu skyes dung dang kun+da bzhin byas kyang //spyan 'bras ut+pa la der ma reg gam//skyob ba'i spyan sngar bsnyen pa'i grub rtags kyis//rdo rjes phas rgol ri bo'i 54bsgong ba kun//bcag pa sgra skad yi ger 'phos pa las//spyan snga bka' brgyud grags snyan phyogs bcur gsal//dbyangs can mgrin brgya chags pa'i legs bshad gtam//ri bo'i ngos la mya ga med pa bzhin//phyogs kun bu mo'i rna ba'i rgyan nyid du//sbyin mdzad 'jam dbyangs tshes lnga rin po che//mgo zlar snyan grags thos pa'i kun dga' legs//sa chen phyag gis stid pa de dag kun//sgra snyan mngon brjod sdeb sbyor tshig phreng dang //don brgyud bde stong gar dgu'i thugs snyams 'bar//de lta'i rnam thar shing rta'i srol r+ṣa ma nyams pa//rin wo rin thang bral ba'i rgyan phreng mchog de ṣ+ka/khyod sku'i gdung 'dzin sras bcas rgyan du bzhes zhabs sen//'jig rten gsum gyi spyi bor 'god par chas lags sam//ring mo zhig nas dpon g.yog mchod yon du//'brel pa sman lung par grags rdo rje 'dzin//tsan dan sdong bo lta bu de dag kun//lha lam gshegs shul skyes pa'i gzhu mi gu rtag/yol mo'i phung po sa mthar 'khyar ba bdag/gong ma'i bka' drin gsob dang khyod dgongs kyang //'khrid phyir ga song dong sprug sgrub mchod kyi//dam bca' phul ba nyams par gyur pa yi//nongs pa chagasadang slar yang gra tshang 'dir//yun du 'jags pa'i bka' shog sgoms sprin mdangs//'dzam gling skye rgu yongs kyi cod ban du//sku'i bar 'os ba brtse bas rjes 'dzin ma'//de skad zhu tshon na chung ma//dbyangs mā rgyud wa mkhas 'di//bsod nams kha btags55na gos rgyan te//song ba spyan sngar smin gyur cig zhes pas gtsos snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa'i rigs mang ba yod 'dug pas mtshone legs par bshad pa'i pu sta ༷ phyed gsum tsam rong pa sku skye ngag dbang 'jam

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)dbyangs kyis bka' bsdu byas pa 'dren byed kyi yul du gyur cing der ma 'dus pa'ang mang rab yod tshod du snang ngo / /log par rtog pa'i 'brul gtam sa 'dzan rkang / /zhib mor dpyad ba'i rdo rjes nyer bcag nas/ /legs bshad rgyud mangs 'brol dang lhan cig glu/ /skal ldan nye dbang tshogs kyi rna ba'i dpyid/ /rtsod sngags gnam lcags 'bebs la chos kyi grags/ /nyams 'gyur snyan tshig smra la dbyug pa can/ /rnam dag brjod pa tsan+d+ra go mi'i mched/ /yangs pa'i blo gros drang srong phur bu bzhin/ /lung rtogs yon tan bla nas blar brtsegs pa'i/ /phung por spungs pa snod kyi 'jig rten du/ /ma shong nam mkha'i pha mtha' ral dogs te/ /dgu tshigs zhags pas 'ching bar mes po brel/ /bdun pa rtag 'dzin can rnams thar pa don du gnyer bar bskul phyir chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i klong du sku'i bkod pa bsdus pa ni/ sa pho khyi lo gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal po'i khri 'don la dbus su byon pa'i phebs lam sbrul gyi sa bcad pa sogs mi shis pa'i rtags mtshan kha yar byung ba dbus nas 'phral du chibs kha bskyod de ri lung sbug tu zhabs zung gi pad+ma bkod ma thag pa nas sku mtshams bcad de rdzong chen tshe sgrub kyi ljags bsnyen gnang bas mtshan lam du mi zhig (55ba〉shes lhung bzad bcu bzhi phyag tu sprad nas tshags kyis zer byung ba tshe'i tshad yin snyam pa yod/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis rdor bzlas mdzad de lo 'di tsam gyi bar sku tshe'i gegs zhi ba'i mtshan ma rnyed pas lo shas 'chad nyan rang la rtsol 'don byas chog pa yod gsungs/ spyan snga zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa chos kyi grags pas tshe sgrub mdzad pa na dgung lo 'di tsam bzhugasakyi lung bstan byung 'phros 'dug /chos rje sog bzlog pa'i phur pa'i chos 'byung du khams pa rdo rjes zha lu lo chen gyi sku rim la phur pa bsgrubs pas shing tog mang po byung ba bla mar phul bas gang bzhes kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sku tshe byung ba sogs lo rgyus mang po yong mchis pas de 'dra zhig gnang dgos zhes ljags lung gi dus nged la bslab ston gyi tshul du lan cig gnyis gsungs byung ba lo grangs ni de 254

nyang ston khra k+ṣe pa blo gros ma sto gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanakho na'i thog tu song / chu bo rir sku ltem pa'i dus o rgyan rin po cher gsol 'debs mdzad pas nub kha yar gyi 'od gsal du lhung bzed re tsam 'bul mkhan byung ba bsdoms na lnga tsam gyi tshod yin tshul sku skyar phebs sgo gnang 'dug cing chos rje ngag dbang thub bstan par lo bcu tsam bzhugs pa'i mtshan lam zhig byung gsungs pa yar klungs su rting ma phebs skabs dbang bka' gnyan pa'i ris mangs shing log lta nyi ma'i grib so dang dad can mtsho la dar dur gyi dpe'i dam sel 'di sku tshe'i sang du che bas lo grangs cung ma thengs pa'i 'phros snang /lcags phag zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bco lnga nas gzhan snang du bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan (56na)par gnas tshul gyi phyag tham na bza' skor dang chibs pas gtsos pa'i rten gnang 'dug par brtan bzhugs dang bcas 'tsho byed ngag dbang 'phrin las rdzong bda' zhus/ nges gsang gling du bskang gso brgya rtsa/ 'chi blu/ grib sel/ 'bum tshar bcu/ nyi khri dang lug bcu'i srog blu/ gzhan yang rong gzhung gi dgon che 'bring chung gsum la spong dag mang skol gyis mtshone pa'i sku rim du ma gnang / sku mi 'khrugs pa'i ched du gra pa rnams zur du tshogs pa 'gab tshul zhabs 'bring pa 'dras zhus par tshogs pa dang mnyam du bsdad par 'khrugs rgyu ci yod/ nged kyi bla ma mkhas grub da rma dbang 'byor de'ang nga chos sgra dir ri ba'i ngang la 'chi rgyu yin gsungs nas e ru bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi tshogs dkyil du gzhan don la dgongs pa yin/ nga rang gis dmigs pa byas gra dmangs kyis tshig dal por btan na zung 'brel yong bas tsho gos ga' na du mi byed ces zhing brje kha phan tshogs dbu rang du bzhugs/ gsol dang 'gags pa tsam ma gtogs snyun zug ha cang gis mngon pa med pas spros bcas spros med kyi thugs dam gyi rim pa chags pa ma byung /nges gsang rdor gling spyi sos brtan bzhugs 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad zhus par/ pad 'byung rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i byin rlabs las/ /blo gros mchog gi dgongs pa mi 'gyur zhing / /gsol 'debasaslob bu'i sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /dbyer med ka dag chen por yongs grol shog /(56ba thas pa —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'ganang bar brtan bzhugs kyi tshig gsal bar ma byung bas de min pa zhig dgos tshul zhus lan du phugs kyi rten 'brel yod pas 'di khas yong zhes gsar du ma mdzad/ thog po gdung brgyud kyis rje'i sku dgra byas pa'i skyon yin nam kho pa dang thag mi gcig pa de la skyon can yod mdog ma kha rung chas 'dres skyon lta bus gang ltar thog po ba'i brtan bzhugs pa hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin drung du btang ba'i dam sel lta bus rkyen byas sku khams thibs kyis song ba tshes bco lnga'i nyin zhabs 'bring pa tshos sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung phul ba bzhes rjes/ de yang nam mkha' gsum phrugs lta gdengs chos/ /gsal ba bsam bral snying po'i klong du chog /chos sku mngon gyur yang gyi zangs thal 'gro/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa ltar spyan g.yas btsum g.yon yas mas gang du'ang ma sgril bar dkyil rang du hrig ger sku drod sangs ma yal bar 'jog pa gnang /de'i tshe nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' 'od rma bya'i gdugs bzhin du phub pas mthong ba'i mi rnams sngar 'di 'dra'i 'ja' sprin ma dran zhes ya mtshan du byed/ byams chen nas gnas mo bsod nams bu khrid zer bas gong ra rnying pa'i grub mtha' bzung phyag dbang zhu ba lta smos mig tsam yang mi lta ba zhig yod pa zhogs pa thog bsangs gtong dus ri lung sbug 'jas gtums pa mthong nas de ga'i khyim mtshes rnams la 'di 'dra'i ngo mtshar ba mthong bas ci yin zhes smras par ri lung sbug
