dpon slob sku ltem yod 'dug (57na)pas me tog 'thor ba e yin byas par skad cig gis dad pa'i spu long g.yos te phyag brgya stong du btsal/ ri lung sbug tu'ang 'das bshags pa'i thabs mang po byas/zhag bzhi song nyin gnam sa bar gsum mtha' dag 'ja' 'od kyis kho ra khor yug tu dkris nam mkha' mthing zhun ma'i mdog rdul bral ston gnam ltar 'od du 'tsher zhing sa la cher 'bab rgyu med pa la kha ba'i gzegs ma 'dra ba'i skya thul thul byed pa ni lha rnams kyi man+da ra'i char gyi mchod sprin spel bar mngon/ nyin zhig tshogs dbus su 'ja' mda' gang tsam pa mdung tshugs su zug pa kun gyi spyod yul du gyur/ dbyar gyi sgang yin na'ang rul sums dang 'bu'i gnod pa lta zhog sngar me myong ba'i dri —256

to ston khra sgo pa blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanabazang pos khyab/ sku gdung rin po che yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhi khro rab stims kun gyi bdag nyid chen po dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor gyur pa la chos rje smar ngag dbang thub bstan pas thog drangs gra slob rnams kyis phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa gdung chog rgyas par btsugs/'di nas gdung 'bul gser srang gang / dngul srang brgya/ gos yug bcu/ ja khor drug ma dang grum ze bcu re/ tā tshang ko dra gsum/ bur ltang / gos ltang / rgyan ltang / dril dmar sngo ser ljang lwa ta snar sa rnams brgya re/ gos ngur smrig yug la sprul sku myur 'byon gyi tshigs bcad bris pa'i snyan shal/rin spungs nas mang ja snyan dar mchod pa bzabs pa/ brgyad tshan/ pho brang chen po sne'u (57bshong rtse nas lnga tshan/ rdo rje brag nas brgyad tshan gsum mang ja 'gyed bcas/ sna dkar rtse khri dpon pasabargyad tshan/ zha lu mkhan rin po che/ byams chen mkhan po/ gter ston rin po che/ bkra shis rtse dbon rin po che/ bde chen chos 'khor ba/ bla ma bres pa/ kha mo gdung brgyud/ ma' dga' rab stims pa/bon lung pa/ mnga' bdag pa/ dpon tshang dar rgyas pa/ nges gsang rdor gling pa spyi so/ rwa'i sngags pa chu dpe sdings ba/ thog bab/ dge lung pa/ ri lung sbug /mun zhol/ skyed tshal spyi so/ pad+ma gling pa/ dpal 'byor dar rgyas/ dkar po lcog /bon po ba/ chos rdzong spyi so/ skyer spyi/ skyed tshal bde rgyas pa/ zangs la mkhar/ grags pa ba/ o rgyan gling / thog po btsun ma/ byams chen mgon khang / ri sbug pa/ rdzong stag spyi so/ dbang rgyal/ tshe ring thon pa/ chos drung / skyid grong sdings pa ba/ sgo mo rab ba mtshal mig pa/ lhun grub chos sdings/ byams chen rtse/ sgo lung / gnas nang pa/ dkar chos mthil bla brang /bla brang 'og /gyang kha ba/ rgyal mkhar gnyer pa/ mu mang pa/ bde skyid gling pa/ 'tsho byed rgyal mchog /sangs mtho/ rab brtan/ gso rig /legs bshad/ dam chos rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang don grub/ 'gyur med/ ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ blo gsal/ bdud 'joms/ mkhyen brtse/ don grub rgya mtsho/ ngag dbang (58na rkom chos/ gu ṇa/ u da ya/ bstan 'phel/ gnyer pa/ dpal 'byor/ rdo rje rnam rgyal/ kirti/ngag dbang dpal ldan/ 'phrin las/ blo bzang rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog legs ldan/ o rgyan/ nam —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyemakha'/ mi bskyod/ ngag dbang pad+ma/ rdor rnam pa/ tshul khrims pa/ bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang kun dga'/ rdo rje rgya mtsho/ byams chen chos mdzad/ ru pa bstan 'dzin/ skyid khang dbang mo/ ram pa spyi so/phan bde legs bshad gling spyi so/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan/ drung 'tsho sum dga'/ lha sags ka shar pa/ lags ngag dbang 'phrin las/ ka brgyad sbug pa/ yar 'brog dpal de ba/ shar zur khang pa/ pad+ma/ chu shur mkhar btsun/ tshe chu sgrub sde/ dge slong don ldan/ rab stims pa grags pa dpal ldan/ chu bo ri nas ma 'a dga' gzims khang pa/ bsam gtan gling pa/ khang gsar chos mdzad/ sgron sdings dpon chen/ sgron se mi ser/ rgan po/ chos rab mdzes/ lha khang pa/ gnas gsar nas/ skyid pa/ gzims dpon/ mchod dpon/ mgron gnyer/ gsol dpon/ dbu mdzad sogs mdor na dbus gtsang stod smad kyi mchog dman du mas tshan grangs dang mar krog gis mtha' brten pa'i zang zing gi mchod sprin spros/ 'di gar thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten dang sde (58ba)par 'bul tshan/ sne'u sdong rtse rlangs ston yab sras/ mkhan chen zha lu pa chen po/ rdo rje brag sprul sku/ gter ston rin po che/sgrol ma sbug pa/ bla ma bres nas/ gnas gsar dbon rin po che/ chos rje bkra bzang pa/ bla ma chu mig pa/ lo spang pa/ mngon dga' rab 'byams pa/ bde chen chos 'khor ba/ sna dkar rtse zhabs drung /lcags zam pa/ bon po lung pa/ bla brang 'og /bshad sgrub gling / bra phu dgon pa ba rnams la thugs dam gsal 'debs kyi rten tshan grangs/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par mang ja spyi 'bul rgya sil shugs bcas/ yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sde/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan/ gong dkar dkon gnyer gra tshang chu shur dga' ldan gsang sngags gling / rong dga' ldan byams pa gling / 'bras yul skyed tshal/ rdo rje brag e waṃ lcog sgar ba/ 'brog stag lung gsang sngags chos 'khor gling /zangs la mkhar/ brag la ba/ e dmar/ thog po ba/ chos rdzong / yul lha brag dkar/ lhas sgang / sde bo che/ rdzing rtag /rgya chad/ dkar chos grags/ dkar chos gnam sdings/ kyog po/ chos lung gzhis ka /bzad lung / sgar dga' ldan 'brug rgyal/ khams lung / brag sgo chos lung / pad+ma gling pa/ spang chen —258

to ston khya sgo pa blo gro mgo gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtananyer skyer/ kha mo ba/ ri lung sbug /chu bo ri'i dgon khag rnams la mang ja bsngo rten thugs dam gsal 'debs la rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog (59na bdan drangs par thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas gsal 'debs nges gsang rdor gling pa'i tsho gos dbur phebs te bla ma gsang khrus kyi sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bur khrus gsol dang dbang 'bul ba gnang / stan chags ring gra tshang dang chabs cig bar bla ma gsang 'dus dong sprug bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi gsung chog mdzad/ zhabs tag 'bul ba rnyed bkur bzabs rgyas kyis mtsho ni lha mchod mi mchod rgyas par bstar bar mchod bsngo gsungs/zla ba bdun pa'i tshes lnga drug nas sku gdung rin po che ril por bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung gsar bzhengs bzhugs khang ar po sta gon la gra ris rnams kyi rdo gsog phag 'debs/ 'u lag gi dang bla pas bde skyid gling pa/ yul lha ba/ skyin mi sgab sdeb/ chu tshan lha khang pa/ skyid khang pa rnams dang chos rje thub bstan bas mkhas grub rong pa sher seng gi thugs dam rten zhal gzigs dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil thang sprin gseb ma bskur nas khung rgya dgos tshul byung ba ltar yi ge bsrings pa dang / lha khang ka thog pa rang gis kyang dang dod ngos shing rnams dbul ba'i 'dren mkhan rmu ba brgyad mkhar ba/skyer shing shag pa/ rin spungs zho me pa sogs kyis byas par brten gtsang khang ka drug ma nyis thog gi rtsis spen bad bcas zla ba dgu pa'i nang du grub bstun dngul srang sum brgya/ gser zho brgya dang bco lnga/ (59bcungs khal brgya/ chu zangs lnga/ zangs sbug zangs rgyan gyis gtsos pa'i zangs ldang tshod/dngul chu dang / 'di ga nas zhal 'debs su g.yu bad gcig /phud gyu gsum/ byu ru'i 'phreng ba/ me shel gsum gzhan yang zhal 'debs kyi ris 'dra dang bcas mdor na shing sol ba spyin gyis mtha' brten pa'i dgos cha lhun gyis grub par bal po drug dang shing bzo ba gsum gyis sor mo'i 'phrul chen pos bde bar gshegs pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten zla ba lnga'i khongs su legs par bsgrubs/—259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheyar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sde'i gzungs par gtos che ba btab 'dug cing 'di ga nas rgyal rtse'i gzungs par 'gro don ma btab pa mang rab/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sha rī ram gyis gtsos gsang sngags rnying ma gtso bor gyur pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sku gdung sku bal gyi ring bsrel dang bum pa'i nang du nyang ston sman lung pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag rgyun ltar sku gdung rin po che ma nyams pas gtsos gzungs 'bul 'khrul pa med pa chu pho byi ba'i lor bskrun pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis lho phyogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs su mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas kyis rtsa rgyud gsungs pa'i nag pa'i zla ba/ rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ras kha ba ri pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi don du sku dngos kyis 'byon par zhal gyis 'ches pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin legs par bsgrigs/ gdan sa pa chos rje smar ngag dbang thub bstan gyis rdo rje'i slob dpon mdzad nges gsang rdo rje gling gi gra pa rnams kyis bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs (60na)rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa dngos su 'jug pa'i rab tu gnas pa bkra shis me tog gi char chen phab/ bal po rnams la zla rer phogs khal gsum re/ rgyar lug khog phyed gnyis re ja chang so sor drug re/ zla re'i gla la dngul srang lnga re yod rtsis kyi dpus cha/ shing bzo ba gsum gyis zla ba phyed gnyis song ba dbu mdzad la rtas gtsos pa'i dgu tshan dang / gzhan gnyis la rim gyis cha shas pa sogs dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i khur len gyi gtso bo gdan sa pa chos rje ngag dbang thub bstan spyan snga ba sku skye ngag dbang 'jam dbyangs gra ris sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i sgo gsum 'bad pa chen pos legs par bsgrubs so/ /chos nyid zad sar 'byol ba'i bi mā la/ /'gro ngor nyang rigs tshul bzung ye shes lam/ /yar gyi zangs thal skas la 'dzegs sla yang / /snga 'gyur bstan pa mun pas byugs 'di ci/ /zla zhag mang por tshegs kyis rtswa mchog grong / /bgrod pa'i ngas yus 'tshong ba gzhan 'drid de/ /g.yas ru ri lung sbug 'dir gdul bya'i yid/ /mya ngan khang bur brgyal la mchi ma bku/ /nang du 'ja' lus 'pho —260

nyang ston khra sgo pa blo gros ma rdzo gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanab chen po'i sku/ grub pa'i mtshan ma phyi rol nam mkha' la/ /'gog med 'char ba dbang po'i gzhu ris tshone/ /tsho gos gnyis bir gyis ched du bris pa bzhin/ /de yang 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ /bdag pas mtho ba'i dam pa la/ /brten na bdag la phan pa sgrub/ /lhun po'i ngos la nye ba yi/ /bya rnams gser (60ba)du 'gyur la ltos/ /zhes lhun po'i ngos la nye bar 'khor ba'i 'dab chags kyi dpe ltar skyes bu dam pa bsten pa dang de dag gi yon tan yid la byed cing yang nas yang du goms par byas pa na skye bo phal pa rnams kyang skyon zhan gyis 'grib cing yon tan ngang gis 'phel bar 'gyur pa'i dgos pa khyad par can yod pas/yul shi bi par skyes pa'i rabs las/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das des bdag cag gi phyir bya dka' ba mang pos dam pa'i chos 'di bsgrubs pa yin pas rim gror bskyed de chos nyan par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba nyid dang snga ma bzhin du snying rje'i yon to bsngags pa dang tshe 'di nyid la bsod nams kyi 'bras bu mthong ba yang brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar rim gror bskyed de bsod nams bstsagasapa na bdag gis mthu chen po thob par 'gyur ba'i me tog grags pa rgyun chags pa yid du 'ong ba tshe 'di la bstan pa yin no/ /zhes dam pa'i yon tan brjod pa la 'bad na rang gzhan rnams kyi don rgya chen po grub pa yin na'ang / legs bshad rin po che'i gter las/ mkhas pa yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa/ /de dag legasabashad rin chen sdud/ /rgya mtsho chen po chu yi gter/ /yin phyir chu bo thams cad 'bab/ khes mkhasagrub rnams ni rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' kun ris su ma chad par thos shing de dag gi don legs par bsams pa'i sgo nas sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde'i snying po bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo dang yan lag bsregs bcad brdar pa'i gser lta bu rnam par dpyad cing dpyad don nyams su len pa'i dgos pa ste lung rtogs (61na)kyi yon tan ma lus pas thugs rgyud yongs su gtams pa rgya mtsho chen po chu bo'i gter yin la de'i gting mtha' 'di tsam zhes tshur mthong gi skye bo —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pe rnams kyis dpog par nus pa ma yin pas dpal ldan bla ma khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo 'di nyid kyang 'phags yul paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen du gyur pa'i tshe phyi nang gi theg pa kun la sgro 'dogs bcad par ma zad tshe gcig lus gcig gi rten la 'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po rdo rje'i sku mngon du mdzad nas sprul gzhi da lta ri po rtse lngar dngos su bzhugs na'ang de las 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa sna tshogs su bstan pa'i yang srid mang por mkhas grub kyi bag chags bzhag pa sku tshe 'dir yang sad pa'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul gyi grangs kyis kyang gzhal bar mi nus rung deng sang 'jig rten blun po rnams kyi grags tshod du stobs 'byor gos snyan grags sogs kyis bla ma bzang po bzang po zhes brjod pa'i yul du ma gyur cing / snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa spyi dang bye brag sangs rgyas nyang ston chen po'i ring lugs kyi 'phrin las kyang 'gos dang dpal 'dzin sogs kyi 'byams yig la ri bong cal sgrog dang lug chu 'bab kyis mkhas rmongs phal cher 'khrul pa'i lam du 'phyan pas ji skad du/'jig rten mi shes rmongs pa la/ /brten na blo gros ldan mi 'byung / /nyi ma'i 'od la nye ba yis/ /zla ba mar ngor gyur la ltos/ /zhes mar ngo'i zla ba ltar rim gyis 'grib pas khra tshang dang sman lung zhes ser srung pa'i sngags pa rang rkyang gcig tu phyogs de'i rje 'bangs rnams la snang bas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis/ blun (61ba)po bkur zhing mkhas pa rto ltar 'dor/ /chos ldan brnyas pa gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skyes/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu babs te ji skad du/ legs bshad mkhas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /go yi blun pos de lta min/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba na/ /'byung po'i bya rnams long bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin dam pa nyid kyi gsang ba gsum gyi yon tan rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen pos mkhyen nas rigs kyi cod pan du bzhes pa tsam ma gtogs yar klungs shar nub mthil gsum gyi skye bo phal cher legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo mig ldongs pas sa 'og gi gser sbram ltar lus mod 'on kyang / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ khong mdzangs bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ /gcig pu —262

kho ston khra k+ṣe pa blo gros ma rdzo gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ 6)yin kyang kun las rgyal/ /ri dwags rgyal po seng ge dang / /'khor rte la grogs mi dgos/ /zhes mgar ba sogs kyis byas pa la ma bstos pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong can byung ba tsam gyis phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal ngang gis thob pa dang / seng ge dkar mo rtsal gsum yongs su rdzogs pas grogs la ma bltos par 'jigs pa med pa bzhin 'khor dang longs spyod kyis skyo masabategs pa'i mar khu la re ba 'cha' mi dgos par/ dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / /bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'du/ /zhes lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi rnam par thar pas ri nas bkug ste sku tshe'i smad la 'phrin las kyi sgo brgya phyogs bcur bye bas ji skad du/ dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/ /don 'grub pa dang bde skyid 'thob/ /nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /yul phyogs dge zhes mkhas rnams sgrog /ces (62na tshe thun las kyi 'jug pa'ang zang zing gi 'du 'khod lhur blangs pa ma yin par gsang chen rnying ma bka' gter gyi bshad sgrub dang gangs can skye rgu'i phan bde rgyas pa'i thabs su gyur pa sha stag yin pas rtogs brjod kyi rim pa shin tu rgyas pa zhig dgos thang na'ang phal cher snyoms chung perdzapa'i brtul zhugs lhur mdzad pa'i rnam thar la phan pa'i bsnyel tho'i zin bris 'phreng gcig tsam yang ma gnang ba dang gra slob rnams kyang bla ma bsten nas rang gi stobs 'byor snyan grags re ba las yon tan mi sems shing chos brgya stong thos na'ang ngas zhus pa yin zhes tshur yus 'dren ja phor gang gis mtho dma' la thugs la btags ma btags kyi bzlas brjod lhur len pa'i skyon gyis yon tan gyi 'phreng ba tshig gi srad bur brgyu bya rgyu byed dang bral bas sa bcad ma stongs tsam zhig brjod zin to/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod/ /lha lam dog por byed nus mgon khyod kyi/ /mdzad bzang rdul char bsgrub bral slob 'khor gyi/ /dad pa nam mkha'i bya rjes ston pa'i dpe/ /mang mang gleng bar 'dod pa'i sems kyi rta/ /yang yang dri yul thad la brgyugs pa'i 'bras/ /yod yod dbyar chu'i drod tsam la re 'dis/ /gsal gsal skyon mtshang 'char ba'i me long bzhin/ /zab zab —263

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyertogs par dka' ba'i yon tan rnams/ /dman dman 'gro blo'i yul du gyur min yang / /rang rang dbang por 'tsham pa'i spyod lam zla/ /long long log lta'i rnyog mas bsgribs sam snyam/ /gangs ljongasayid can du ma'i 'dren byed kyi/ /'dzin mar rgyu ba'i nyams chung sa ku rtsir/ /rgya bod rigs 'dzin yongs kyis mgrin gcig tu/ /(62ba tha sngags tshe som nyi'i dra bar kun rtog chud/ /gzhan snang 'byul pa'i dbang du byed nus mdas/ /skye phal snying bsnun sgro skur cho nge'i skad/ /'byin mod blang dor dka' thub zhig pa'i lha/ /zog rdzun dkar mo'i mgul par 'byud la bral/ /'dam rdzab rnyog mas gosapa'i yid bzhin nor/ /rnam dag dpyad gsum ka shi gas phyis nas/ /lung rtogs rgyal mtshan tog tu bkod pa'i tshe/ /srid zhi'i 'dod dgu char 'bebs dngos po'i gshis/ /rigs kun khyab bdag che mchog he ru gaḥ mtshams sprin gos kyis klubs pa'i rdo rje sems/ /dam pa'i rnam thar cha tsam legasabarjod pa'i/ /bsod nams nam mkha'i mthas kyang 'jal nus min/ /rab dkar lhag bsam nya phyis yangs po'i khog /ngo mtshar gtam gyi mu tig phyur bu sa /spungs pa'i phan bde'i char pa tshe rabasakun/ 'khri shing lus phra'i ngang tshul ltar 'bab shog /'khrul sems 'dam dang 'grogs kyang dri ma yis/ /ma gos rig pa chu skyes ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /gnas lugs don gyi pad 'byung snang ba bzhi'i/ /yid 'dzin lha mor rtsed 'jos rtag rol shog /mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan sprul pa'i gar/ /rim byon gong 'og gter sgo phye ba'i chos/ /smin grol rgyud bshad gdams pa'i char chen pos/ /snga 'gyur ring lugs snye ma g.yur za shog /lnga phrag bcu mtha' rgyang ring lung gi bstan/ /dang por dar ba shākya'i 'phrin las nyi/ /skye rgu'i bsod nams dgung la legs shar pa'i/ /snang ba'i dga' ston phyogs bcur khyab gyur cig /ces paṇa chen dri med bshes gnyen gyi rnam sprul dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs khra tshang pa chen po blo gros mchog gi rdo rje'i rtogs (63na)pa brjod pa nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di ni 'dri 'dun gyi ri mo yid kyi rdo bar gsal bzhin pa'i sta gon gyi dus slar rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog blo bzang —264

kho ston khra tsha pa blo gros ma ga gi rdo rje'i rnam thar/ rtanapad+ma 'phrin las theg mchog dbang gi rgyal po yongs 'du'i zhes rang nyid kyi sgyu 'phrul kha skongs su mdzad pa'i rnam thar nyung ngu dad pa'i 'jug ngogs kyi sa bon dang bcas gsung gis bskul ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi rigs las lo rgyus smra ba'i btsun pa 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam ming gzhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal du 'bod pas dbus 'gyur 'chang du a nā la zhes phyogs 'dir mer grags shing mang bkur rgyal po'i khab tu bin shin zhes pa me pho 'brug gi lo khrums stod kyis nya pa'i shes rab phyogs kyi bzang po gnyis pa'i tshes la gtsug lag lugs brgya'i mdun sa pho brang chen po dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtshos bgyis pa sarba kā le khu dza snye//chos sbyin rgya cher spel phyir dga' ldan wan tshogs gling du par du bsgrubs//mthile//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()ra༅༅//rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa slob bshad bstan pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba bsdo kyigs rje rgo//༄7//na maḥpra bhu badz+ra dha rā ya/rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i bstan pa'i srog gi zungs su bslab gsum ngur smig 'chang ba'i zlos gang mkhan tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa slob bshad bstan pa'i nyi 'od ces bya ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs rdul bung ba snying pad ke sa rar 'god na smin grol lam gyi 'bras mchog mngon du gyur min de srid thugs rje'i mthu dpung lhag par bskyed nas dngos grub rgya mtsho'i gru char stsal du gsol//gzod ma nyid nas yongs su brnyes pa bla med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud//sems can kun gyi thar pa'i srog song gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod//rdo rje 'chang dbang mi yi gzugs kyis blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon//grags pa'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgreng zhabs pad 2nadakar chun po thod du 'ching //mtha' klas mkhyen pa'i nam mkhar thugs rje'i nyi//'char nub spangasapa'i rnam dpyod tsha zer gyis//chos phung bye ba'i 'dab stong yongs grol ba'i//mkhas grub skyes rabs tshangs pa'i blo las brgal/khyad par rgyal kun mgrin gcig legs so'i tshig/brjod yul 'dren pa bzhi pa'i bstan 'di la//mtha' klas byon pa dam pa'i sgros gar gyi//grangs tshang gzhal 'dod byis pa'i sems de ngal//bye brag grub pa'i 'khor sgyur ༷ rū pa//sa skya'i 'jam mgon rim byon thugs kyi

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanabs//snyan brgyud bstan pa'i shing rta chen po'i srol//phye ba'i rtogs brjod cha tsam gleng bar spro//chu 'dzin stug po'i phang nas dbyar gyi rnga//rab snyan glu dbyangs sgrog tshe mdongs mtha' can//dga' ba'i zlos gar bsgyur na shes ldan rnams//ngo mtshar dad pa'i spu long cis mi g.yo//rlung gis sbur ma mthon por bteg pa ltar//med bzhin sgro 2ba tha tags rdzun gyi rnam par thar//mthong na dam pa'i spyod tshul lhug pa mā/smra ba sngon bsags legs byas bye bas nyes//ku sha'i rtse mos 'thor te rgya mtsho'i mtha'//'dzad byed dka' thub bsten pa'i rjes 'gro ba//phra mo'i blo gros khab kyi mig bu sa khyod yon lhun po 'dzud pa'i go skabs ci//'on te rin wo gling nas nor bu'i tshogs//ded dpon gcig gisa'adren bar mi bzod kyang //rang gis ji tsam 'khur nus bdog pa yis//dbul ba'i gdung sel 'dod 'jo dngos po'i gshis//'byog tshig chags pa'i gdong pa rig byed sgor//sprul pa'i zol sbyor rgan po ma yin pa'i//mkhas grub ngang tshul gser sgong yongs smin pa//sngon med tshangs par ltab lha rnams brel/phyogs 'dzin gdon gyis phrag dog sbyin skyes mgor//mas stobs rdo rje rtse brgya rab bsnun kyang //risamed 'gro la brtse ba'i na stong dkyus//ring por skyong ba'i bshes gnyen 'chi med gtso//rlabs chen mdzad pa sos kyi dga' ston dus//'dren byed tshig sbyor dpyid kyi lang tsho ma//spel legs zlos gar 'phreng mdzes gsong po'i glu//gzur gnas ga' na gsos mgrin nas len 'di nyon//de yang slob dpon daṇ+ḍi sa/shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni//nges par bstan pa'ang de yi sgo//zhesathog mar shis brjod/phyag bya/dngos po nges bstan rnams sum ldan/gnyis ldan so gos ci rigs pa bshad pa'i da lam phyi ma'i sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa sngon du song bas skabs su gleng bar bya ba ni/ji snad du/mchoge gi khyad par nyid la reg na de yi yon to cha shas kyis//3na skom na pa dag kyang bsngags 'os la 'god mas chen rnams kyi byed pa'i phul//ma la yar nye phal gyi shing yang rkang 'thung bzang po'i dri bsung ngad//'amang bar byed pa'i nus ba rab mtho thos de dag rgyal gyur cig ྅ salho phyogs ma la ya'i nags klung du skyes pa'i shing ༷la pa dag kyang 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)la ya las 'ongs pa yi/ /stong dum phal la rin thang brtsi/ /zhes tsan+dan gyi dri bsung lan cig ma yin par sim pa'i nus pas ljon pa phal pa la'ang tsan+dan dang phyogs 'dra'i dri nus 'byung ba ltar mkhas dang grub pa'i yon tan yang nas yang du brjod cing bsams na rang cag blo dang spyod tshul ches cher dman pa rnams kyang bya ba ngan pa las ldog cing skyed thon nas dam pa'i rnam thar la rim gyis 'jug pa sogs dgos pa lhag par che zhing rang gi legs byas kyi phung po bla nas blar 'phel ba'i tshogs rgya cher gsog pa'i phyir dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa ma lus pa'i gsang ba rab 'byams mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bang mdzod gdan gsum tshang ba'i khyab bdag dgyes mdzad rdo rje bshes gnyen dam pa'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol pa tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par thar pa'i rim pa la/ mdo sde rgyan las/ skye ba skyed mos tshal 'gro ltar rtogs nas/ /spro ba'i sems drangs dga' zhing de la 'jug /cesargyal sras 'phags pa sems can gyi don du bsams bzhin srid par skye ba len pa ngang pa pad mtshor 'jug pa ltar spro zhing sprul pa bye ba ther 'bum dus gcig tu ston pas 'di lta bu'o zhes lce brgyas bskal bar brjod kyang zad pa'i mtha' ga la zhig /'on te thun mong gi gdul bya (3bsgoms la grags pa'i yang srid dang thugs rgyud gcig pa rags rim brjod na/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i bstod pa bkra shis mtshan bzang mar/ mgon khyod gdod ma'i dbyings su sangs rgyas kyang / /grangs med gdul bya'i khams dang bsam pa bzhin/ /ngo mtshar skye ba'i zlos gar bcu gsum gyis/ /phan bde'i dga' ston spel la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes dang / /'dar pa rin chen dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad mar/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i mgon po he ru ka /blo 'das 'od gsal dga' mas 'khyud pa'i dpal/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /mgon khyod 'og min chen po'i zhing khams su/ /sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan mngon gyur kyang / /zhing 'dir skal bzang 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i slad/ /bgrang yas rnam phrul bstan lagasol ba 'debs/ /'phags yul cu nyi ya na'i nor 'dzin mar/ /—268

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanamakha' stod dbang mos rjes bzung sbra li ra/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas gdug can kun sgrol ba'i/ /rnala'abyor dbang por bstan lagaso leb 'debs//gangs can ljongs 'dir sangs rgyas ston pa dang //chosasku 'od zer mtshungs med bu ston rje//yar klungs pa dang dge slong dbang mo sogs//mkhas grub brgyud mar bltams la gsol ba 'debs//zhes pa 'di'i dngos bstan la bdun las ma byung yang bkra shis mtshan bzang mar bcu gsum byung ba smos na dpal ldan rgyud kyi ye shes le'ur/dbyibs kyi rlung ni chen po thams cad dag gis sangs rgyas zhing rnams mtha' dag rnam par 'god par byed//4na'ajig rten khams 'di so so dag la slar yang khor yug ri bo chen po dag ni kun nas so//de yi dbus su las kyi sa ni chen bo dag gi rang bzhin 'jig rten khams su rab tu 'gyur//lhag ma longasaspyod rang bzhin yul gyi bde ba byed pa rin wo kun rgyas rab tu gang ba rnams//zhes phyi nang sbyar ba'i phyi rol gyi 'gro ba'i las snang gis ri rab dbyibs tshul mngon pa dang dus kyi 'khor lo tha dad pa'i lugs phyi ma ltar rdo rje'i rwa'i 'og na yod pa'i gling drug ni longs spyod kyi sa dang de'i phyi rol gling bzhi gling phran brgyad la bdun pa las kyi sa zhes bshad cing /dza na skye ba la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag/na'i a brjod don yin pas phyis/bu ka rkyen du byin/ka la ya na bzhin yang ste ya la brjod pa bor ba'o zhes ka phyis/rnam dbye dang po'i gcig tshig gi byin/mi zad pa la si dbyi'o zhes gi phyis/de'i sdeb la sde pa'i mtha' 'os/na ma ru bsgyur/gsal byed dbyangs med pa pha rol gyi yi ger drang ngo //zhes bsgrubs pas ri ni lus can skye ba'i gnas yin la/bye brag 'dzam gling chung ngu ni bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi le'u dang po las/'dzam bu gling ni chen po yi//dum bu bgraganyis kyi ni dbus//zhes pa'i lho phyogs dzasbu tri shas mtshan pa'i gling 'di nyid kyi lte ba ma ju ga ta dhar/tsan+d+ra par bṛ kho dha ra la sogs ba rnams sos/bsdu ba byas pas ma ga dha ste dbus 'gyur 'chang zhes dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs ba rnams mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i rten yin pas bskal mtha'i dusakyang gzhom gzhig mi nus pa rdo rje gdan 4ba〉rdo ༷ra byas pa'i phyi rol tu/lung las/mnyan yod

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)gnas bcas tsam pa ka /wa ra ṇa si yangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab dang drug po ni/ /de dag grong khyer chen por grags/ /zhes 'phags yul na yongs su grags pa'i grong khyer chen po drug dang gzhan yang shar phyogs rgya nag po'i rgyal khams na 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis rtsis kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'i gnas ri bo rtse lnga/ lho phyogs su dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten na dus kyi 'khor lo'i ye shes sems dpa' ma bsdus par dngos su bzhugs pa sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ de'i lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na ri bo po ta la zhes thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas/ nub phyogs na o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod he ru daḥrang byung gi gtsug lag khang / byang phyogs na chos rgyal rigs ldan rim par byon nas 'gro ba rnams phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi sgo nas bkri bar mdzad pa'i gnas sham+bha la/ der ma zad kye rdor bde mchog sam+bha ṭi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs las 'dzam bu'i gling dbus ma 'di nyid rang na yul nyer bzhi dang dur khrod brgyad sogs gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis yod par bshad cing / rma bya chen po las/yul 'khor lnga brgya/ ljongs chen po bcu drug /yul phran stong / gzhan yang mi rigs mi gcig pa sum brgya dang drug cu skad gas bdun brgya nyi shu sogs mtha' klas pa'i nang tshan rgya bod gnyis su sku'i sprul pa rags pa tsam bshad pa bcu gsum las/dang po rnal 'byor dbang phyug ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen pa'i brtse'i zhabs kyi gsang ba'i rnam thar las/ nub (5na〉byeg dpal phug tu bzhugs khri'i steng na bla ma bzhugs gsung ngag bskur nas gnang rgyu yin zer zhu mkhan mang po tshogs 'dug pa la bslab gsum pa gsal po 'dug gzhan ngo shes pa mi 'dug /khog phug yin snyam pa'i dpe cha zhig gi lung mdzad thong ba na/ thod phu'i blo gsal rgya mtsho de birnya pa lags sam zer ba zhig 'dug pa la don 'di ga yin te tshig 'di cung zad snga ba ma shes 'dug gsung / bdag gis thod phu'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug de/ da lta'i blo gsal rgya mtsho yin zhesabyas na bde ba 'dra zhus pas de ga bris pas yong gsung / de nas gzhud bshad cig kyang 'go tshugasasnang gsum yang tshugs byung nas na ning gi zin bris la zhus dag byed dgos snyam pa dang gnyid sad/—270

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanabasams pas thod phur byon pa'i rje gha ya dha ra rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi thugs kyi sprul par mnal lam bka' rgya ma las bshad/de dang pha bla ma thugs rgyud gcig pa'i brda ru 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs pa khungs shin tu che bas slob dpon 'di rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs bi kha sman gyi dbang po'i grong khyer na rgyal po gser gyi 'khor lo'i sras su sku bltams par mtshan mkhan gyis mthu stobs kyi sgo nasabastan pa gsal bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan nas mtshan dngul gyi 'khor lor gsol/so ma pā rir mkhan po dul ba'i lha la rab tu byung rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs/nā lan+dar mkhan po chos kyi bshesaganyen la bsnyen par rdzogs shing theg pa che chung gi chos mtha' klas pa dang khyad par rnal 'byor gsang mtha' 'khor lo sdom pags na/ gnas brtan dpal ldan chos skyong 5bas grags te nā lan+da'i mkhan por gyur/nyin mo sdosnod gsum la lar rtsod rtsom gsum dang mas mo bde mchog gi rnal 'byor lhur blangs nas dgung lo bdun cu tsam slebs kyang rtags bzang ba med pa'i khar mi sdug pa'i mtshan ma mang du byung ba slob dpon 'dis sbyor lam phal cher bgrod nas lte 'og gi k+ṣa ma la sogs par rlung sems 'dus te mthong lam thob par nye ba bla ma'i gdams pa'i phu thag ma chod pa'i skyon yin pa ma mkhyen par kho bo gsang sngags dang las 'brel med pa 'dug dgongs 'phreng ba chab khang du bskyur te rgyu'i theg pa la gzhol bar brtson pa na tho rengs mnal lam du bdag med ma bud med tha mal pa'i gzugs kyis lung bstan pa ltar mdzad pas nyer gsum gyi srod la bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dngos su dbang thob ste mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la zhakhrungs/khamasa'adus pa dang po gas mo drod rtags kyi lam 'khrid pa'i dus zug rngu dang gcan gzan gdug pa can sogs shar/khams 'dus pa bar ma thig le bde stong gi lam 'khrid pa'i dus me chu zhabrug pa/khams 'dus pa tha ma skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyi lam 'khrid pa'i dus bla ma yi dam gyi zhal ral ba sogs skyon du bzung ba nye lam rdo rje btsun mo'i gdams pas ting nge 'dzin du ngo shes nas nyams su bzhesapas zhag re la sa re thob nas zhag drug song ba naXdrug pa mngon du gyur/lam gyi bogs tshon sha

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losechang bsten pa la ma dad pa bzlog pa dang bstan pa la mi gnod pa'i ched du rab byung gi rtags bor te ngan par zhal gyis bzhes nas wa ra ṇa sir byon pa chu bo gaṅgā'i 'gram du nga (6na)ngan pa yin pas lam thong gsungs pas chu bo gyen du bzlog /wa ra ṇa sir dge 'dun rnams kyi grub thob tu shes te sngar rnga kha gnyis pa brdungs nas gnas dbyung gi bya ba byas pa la bzod par gsol/ wa ra ṇa si'i nags khrod du bzhugs pa rgyal po sto nan+ta tsakra sa pho brang du gdan drangs pa nang pa'i rnal 'byor par shes nas yan lag rnams lcags kyis bcings te chur bskyur ba sa 'og tu 'dzud pa sogs byas kyang gnod par ma nus pas rgyal po sogs yul 'khor ba thams cad rdo rje theg pa'i bstan par bkod/lho phyogs su byon pa'i lam du gru gla la brten nas chu bo bzlog pa dang phyir 'bab pa'i rdzu 'phrul mdzad/ mnyan pa'ang slob dpon gyi rjes su 'brangs pas skal ldan cig car ba'i lam gyis bkri bar 'os pa'i 'o bhi he ru dar grags/de nas chang 'tshong ma kā ma ru sirnyi la chang nyo ba'i rin med par brten nyi ma bzung ba na rgyal pos gsol ba btab pa ltar btang bas zhag gsum gyi mtshan phyed tsam song bas rdo rje gdan pa'i bstod par/ chu bo chen po gyen du bzlog /chang la nyi ma gte mar bcug /birnya pa zhes bya ba yi/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bsngags/ rim bzhin lho phyogs bhi mi sa ra'i rgyal po nā tha pa tas rang gi mchod gnas ral pa can lnga brgya'i slob dpon du bskos/ ra dang ma he khri phrag bsad pa'i khrag mchod byed pa'i dbang phyug gi rten la slob dpon 'dis phyag mdzad pa na de phyed tsam gas pas rgyal po 'khor bcas skrag par gyur/ ral pa can gcig las sad nas rjes su 'brangs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la ma zhugs pa la jug 'dod (6ba〉thod pa'i mtshan gzhi shar phyogs nag po par grags/de nas rta bra pra ti ma'i rgyal po dzim gim zhes bya bas 'jon dmar las grub pa'i dbang phyug gi sku zhal gsum phyag drug pa khru brgyad cu yod pa zhabs rdos bsnun te gnas khang nas bskrad pa kha bub tu 'gyel bar mu stegs pa rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas 'bras chan tsam gyis mchod pa'i —272

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanadam bca' 'dzin du bcug ste gyen du slang ba sogs mu stegs grangs med btul/lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i rdo sku rang byon zhig gnas sar mi byung tshad rang byung gi tri shu las bsad pa'i ro la tshogs 'khor byed pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams nang pa'i bstan pa la bkod/de sa ko ṭi'i ri sul gyi thugs rje ོ po'i rdo sku'i drung du phebs pa'i tshe thugs rje chen pos khyod kyi nus pas ri rab brlag par nus kyang sems can gyi las zad pa med bas mu stegs rnams la gnod pa ma byed ces gsungs pa so ba nā tha btul nasabaka' bzhin sgrub par dam bcas/so ba nā tha'i mu stegs pa rnams btul nas nang pa'i sde btsugs/slob dpon nag po pa shar phyogs kyi phyi pa'i rgyal po gdug pa can 'dul ba/ḍā ma ru pa rjes su 'dzin pa/o rgyan nas rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rgyab brten du gyur pa'i lung skor sde lnga spyan 'dren pa'i don gsum la brdzangs/slob dpon nyid thugs rje chen po'i bka' bzhin re zhig brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i 'phro bskol nas rdo skur thim mam zer/la la sku dngos rdo'i rnam par song bar glengs/de yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las//yi ge dha zhes sdome brtson wo//lho yi phyogs su rnam par grags//pha rol rgol ba bzlog nas kyang //de 7na tha wo sdom brtson sngags kyang 'grub/zhes pa chos khrung mang por slob dpon chos grags la 'chad pa chos kyi skad dod dhasme'i zur ni gnyis skar tshang ba dang bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i sdom brtson yin par mtshungs na'ang chos grags kyis tshad ma rigs pas rgol ba tshar bcad pa de 'dra ba'i paṇ+ḍita ni ches mang la/brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rdzu phrul gyis log lta bcoms pa bsam gyisami khyab pa'i mdzad pa dang sku tshe de la mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa dpal ldan chos grags la ma byung bas zhakhrul pa 'ong don med cing /grub thob thams cad kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba ni slob dpon 'di nyid do//gnyis pa s+tha bi ra ni shing sprul 'dar du zhal gyi gtor chen skabs tshar chen rang gi mnal lam du gsal ba bzhin rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs nas nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas mnyi ya na zhes yul de'i skye bo rnams 'phur nas 'gro ba'i ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i yul khyad par can der sku bltams pa na tshod gzhon nu'i dus rje ༷tsun rdo rje btsun mo mkha' la spyod pa'i dbang mos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)rjes su bzung ste lung bstan gzengs bstod/ mdo rgyud kyi gzhung la skyes thob kyi shes rab dang sbyor byung gi brtson 'grus kyis gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i rtser son bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa'i bslab pa la gtso bor mdzad pas mtshan sba wi ra ste gnas brtan du grags/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan por gyur te rgyal ba'i bstan pa chos spyod rnam bcu'i sgo nas nyams pa gso ba dang sngar yod rnams dar rgyas su mdzad par brten paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug tor gyi rtse mor 'dzegs (7ba 〉 shing brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mthar phyin pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis nag phyogs la dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gyi nus stobs phral nas yang dag pa'i lam la bkod pa sogs mdzad pa mtha' yas/ rdo ring rin po che'i skye brgyud grub chen lwa ba pa dang 'di nyid dus mtshungs pa yin nam snyam mo/ /gsum pa paṇa chen dharma pā la ni/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi gsal snang la shar bar som nyi mi mnga' bas/ rgya gar shar phyogs su sku gzungs pa'i slob dpon dharma pā la zhes gnas lnga rig pa mthar phyin zhing rlung sems la rang dbang du gyur pas sku tshe la mnga' brnyes pa zhig byon pa'i tshe/ rdo rje gdan gyi ka ba nas mgon po'i sgrub skor slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra gyis spyan drangs pa rgya gar du bka' gter gnyis su grags pa'i gter ma de yin zhing / man ngag rnams slob dpon klu sgrub la gsan/ bka' mi nub par bya ba'i phyir du paṇa grub dharma pā la la gnang 'di nyid kyis bal pa'i rten khyad par can rnams mjal bar byon pa'i tshe tshad pa'i rnyun gyis zin par gangs ri mthong sar phebs na phan zer bar brten ha nu tsho 'phangs pa'i kha ba'i dum bu la gangs can du grags pa'i mnga' ris smad kyi gangs ri dang / mtsho ma pham pa gzigs su byon pa na lha btsad pos chos la gus pa'i bkur sti cher mdzad/ khyad par skad gnyis smra ba rin cen bzang pos yo ga'i skor mang du gsan/ mgon po'i sgrub thabs rgya gar gyi gter ma rnams gsan pas lo chen nas brgyud pa la'ang bka' gter zung du la jug cing / las mgon gyi skor lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi gter ma (8na skos na tshe gnyis po zhu dag pher ba byung skad/ lo chen gyis gser snyim pas bcus nas phul ba ma bzhes nan —274

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanatar gsol bas khyer mi dga' na ngas 'di khyed gsungs nas rdog po gcig bsnams/ 'tsho bas phongs na nor dgos kyang nged de 'dra'i tshan min gsungs/ phar gshegs dus dharma pā la yin par shes pa tsam gyis 'do le la spyan drangs rnyed bkur bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung zhing rgya gar du 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam skad/ lhag bsam rab dkar las me 'bar ma yi dkar chag phal cher du/ kha che dharma pā la zhes gsungs pa/ /yo ga stod lugs brgyud pa'i de nyid dang / /gcig gam gcig na shar phyogs par bshad cing / /zhes pa'i dgongs pa gsal byed mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi dri lan du/ me 'bar ma yi dkar chag phal cher dang yang dgon pa'i zin bris las/ kha che dharma pā la zhesabazhad pa ni yi ge pa'i skyon cung zad dam gsung bgros ma zin par snang ste/ bod du byon nas lo wo gyi bla ma mdzad pa'i sto pā la 'di nyid ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs pa yin par yo ga dang mgon po'i lo rgyusayi ge rnams las gsal ba'i phyir ro zhes gsungs pas shes nus so/ /bzhi pa paṇa grub gha ya dha ra ni/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsang ba'i rtogs brjod nasagong du drangs pa bzhin rgya gar shar phyogs bha sgo la'i rgyal po tsaṇ+ḍa ru pa ak+ṣi'i yig mkhan gyi rigasayin pas ka pa smra zhes grags shing / mtshan dngos gha ya dha ra ste bod skad du sprin 'dzin zer rig pa'i gnas lnga la shin tu mkhas shing slob dpon gnyis spangs zhabs kyis rjes su bzung nas gsung (8ba)ngag gi bka' babs/ zab chos 'di nyid bod du dar ba'i rten 'brel 'grig tshul ni 'byog mi'i mnal lam bka' rgya mar/ lho nas mi nag po ri bo tsam pa 'phur byung ba'i kha nas dung gi seng ge skyugs/de'i kha nas gser gyi rdo rje byung ba'i lte ba nas bum pa chus gang ba thugs gar thim pa'i mnal lam byung ba'i sang nyin sgor ā tsarlas rwa dung bus byung ba na ltar btang bas la ba dmar po gyon pa zhig gis khyed la bstad nas 'ongs zer ba nang du bos nas gsung gleng mdzad par rgyud sde rgya mtshor mkhas shing khyad par rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi gdams pa yod pa mkhyen nas thog mar tshar gsum khug pa'i chos tshol sogs gsan/ logasum nas tshun bod du yong / de dus chos lon gser srang lnga brgya grabs—275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shekyis gsung ba bzhin zhal dan mdzad/lha rtse brag tu bzhugs pa'i tshe zhal dan bzhin paṇa chen gha ya dha ra phebs/ paṇ+ḍita'i zhal nas gsung ngag 'dzugs pa la gnas khyad par can dgos gsung ba chu la mu gu zhes pa'i sgra byung ba gar song rtsad bcad pa mthar mu gu lung du thim pas rnam par grol ba'i sgra rten 'brel legs par dgongs nas der gnas mdzad/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa lo gsum la rdzogs par gnang / paṇ+ḍi ta 'byon par brtsams pa la sngar zhal dan bzhin lo lnga bzhugs par gsol khas chos tshar nas bsdad par dgos pa med gser phri nas phul chog gsung yang rten 'brel mi legs dgongs te gser srang la bteg pa cung zad ma longs par lha rje zur phu che la gdams pa yod pas gser khur shog gsungs pa bzhin phul/ paṇ+ḍitang gser (9na)srang lnga brgya/ gla ni stong / rnga dkar nyis brgya dang rnga nag stong / gos dar sogs chos yon bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul bas paṇ+ḍi ta'i thugs la gser mang drags pas sgyu ma yin nam dgongs mang mkhar gril chen gyi mi mang sar cir 'dug dris pas gser shin tu bzang zer bar brten mnyes te da khyod la ci dgos gsungs par chos 'phro 'dra yod na zhu gsungs pas/ sku rgyab tu mgon thang bzhes 'phreng ba mgul la bcug gtor ma dbu thog tu bsnams nas lhag ma med pa'i dbu snying mdzad/ slar ci dgos gsung bar chos 'di bdag min pa bod du g.yin la mi gnang ba zhu zhus pas paṇ+ḍita mnyes kyang zer/ la la zhu lugs de cung zad ma byung bas gdung brgyud kyis mi phan pa'i rten 'brel phyugs par glengs skad/ 'on kyang mnal lam gyi lung bstan bzhin chos brgyud kyi bstan pa bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khams yongs su khyab pa'i 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam/ 'gos lhas btsas bla chen la chags sdang gi rnam pas khyad du thon pa zhig bzhed nas mi tri pa gdan 'dren du byon pa lam du gha ya dha ra dang mjal bar su yin dris pas d+me tri pa yin gsungs par brten gsang 'dus sogs kyi chos zhu bsgyur du ma mdzad/ rjes su rtsad chod kyang chos zhus zin pa dang shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas zhabs tog bstar/ phebs res 'di la sprin —276

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanagyi shugs can du grags pas/ grub brgya'i bstod par/ rgyal rigs rig pa'i gnas lngar mkhas/ /nam mkha'i lha la the tshom gcad/ /sprin gyi shugs can zhes pa yi/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes khrung /(9ba)bla chen gshegs nas gyi jo lo tsā bas gdan drangs khong la gsung ngag kyang gnang / gnyos yon tan grags kyis gdan drangs der paṇ+ḍi ta la 'chi ltas byung bas mkha' reg thod phur 'brog mi'i slob ma se rog gnyis yod sar phebs/ gshegs pa'i tshe dbu gtsug nas 'od dkar po dzom tsam gyi nang nas rnam shes kyi rdor zhal brgyad pa rkang gang tsam zhig sgra 'od me tog gi char dang bcas nub phyogasasu song ba'i ngo mtshar ba de 'dra bod du su la'ang ma byung zhing / mkhas grub kyi yon tan ni bsam gyisami khyab bo/ /lnga pa mkhas grub khyung po ni/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa yin par tshar chen nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes shing sangs rgyas ston pa ni khyung po'i skye bar grags pas/ rje btsun bod mkhar ba chen po'i rnam thar du/ sngon gyi dus na mkhas grub khyung po de/ /bdag sogs dmu rgod 'gro la brtser dgongasanas/ /dus 'dir tshar wo rdo rje lang du grags/ /bdag sogs gdul bya'i re ba skong der 'dud/ /ces pa yid brtan gyi gnas kho na nges pa'i phyir/ khyung po nyid kyi gsung las/ ban chung bdag gi skyesas gangs dkar mda'/ /snyem ra mang rje rigs khyung po yin/ /pha ru smos pa khyung rgyal stag skyes dang / /ma ru smos pa mgo bza' ba po shis skyid/ /de nyid nas du bdag nyid zhugs pa'i tshe/ /pha ma yul mi bde skyid ldan par gyur/ /stag gi lo la ma yi rum nas btsas/ /zhes pa ltar yul snye mo ra mang du yab khyung po'i rigs stag skyes/ bkra shis skyid kyi sras su sku bltams/ lo bcu lon nas yig rtsis mkhas par shes/ bas gnyis lo(10na〉lha pha mes bag chags kyi/ /sems phyogs bon bslabs rdzogs chen phyag chen bslabs/ /zhes dgung lo bcu nas 'bri klog rtsis sogs la mkhas par sbyangs/ bcu gsum nasabla ma g.yung drung rgyal po la bon gyi skor gsan mkhas par gyur te ka pa li 'dren pa bdun brgya tsam gyi tshogs pa bskyangs nas bon gyi 'chad nyan dang bstan bcos mang du mdzad pas dbus gtsang kun tu —277

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'adar rgyas su gyur na'ang 'di gsha' ma rang zhig min pa 'dra snyam rgya gar du 'byon par brtsams tshe yab yum gnyis kyi ring mi 'byon par gshol btab pa la brten/ sngags rnying ma ba bla ma 'byung gnas seng ge la sems klong man ngag gi sde rnams gsan zhing slob ma sum brgya tsam bskyangs kyang spyod pa la ma mgu bar lha sa bskor ba dang sbrags bla ma ni ru bar phyag chen/ mtshan brjod/ do ha/ dgra 'jigs kyi skor sogs gsan na'ang thun slong gi dngos grub tsam la ma rangs pas/ de tshe rgya gar grub thob a mo ghas/ /'di ni sprul pa'i sku ste rgya gar 'gro/ /paṇ+ḍita dang grub thob thams cad kyi/ /thugs bcud bsdus nas 'gro rnams smin grol mdzad/ /sna tshogs sprul pas gdul bya 'dul bar 'gyur/ /theg chen snying po mtha' bral chos sgra sgrog /mthar thug gsang sngags bde stong dbyer med kyi/ /seng ge'i nga ro phyogs bcur sgrog par 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan dang mthun par zhing btsongs pa dang / sru mo'i g.yu sogs la brten pa'i gser mang po bsnams nas byon tshul/ de nas rin chen gser phye 'phangs med khyer/ /gces pa'i srog la ma bltas dka' spyad nas/ rgya dang bal po'i yul du lan (10ba tha dun phyin/ /rgya gar mkhas pa brgya dang lnga bcu bsten/ khyad par mkhas shing grub thob lnga bcu dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma khyad 'phags rnam bzhi bsten/ /longs sku drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /dngos su chos gas ye shes mkha' 'gro gnyis/ /mnyes par byas nas mthar thug gdams ngag zhus/ /zhes ba la por paṇ+ḍita bha su na ma ti la bi t+pā ta sbyangs shing bya rgyud kyi skor gsan bla ma rdo rje gdan pa la dge tshul sgrub pa sogs bla ma brgya lnga bcu la rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa'i chos mtha' klas pa gsan/ paṇa grub thams cad zhal mthun par nā ro pa'i lcam ne gu zhes rdo rje 'chang la chos dngos su gsan pa zhig dur khrod so sa gling na yod pa thos pas der byon pa na shing tā la bdun srid tsam gyi mkha' la bud med smug nag rus rgyan sprad pa zhig 'dug par gser phul zhing gsol ba btab pas tshes bco lnga'i srod la sgyu lus dbang mo che'i dbang gnang ba sogs chos drug gi gdams pa rnams gsan/gzhan yang mi tri pa dang rā hu la sogs la myur mdzad mgon po'i chos skor zhus nas bod du byon/—278

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ tanaljongs 'dir chag chos rdo rje'i rgyas btab kyi brgyud pa bdun ldan sogs dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa phyogs kun tu khyab par gyur/ zhing 'dir mdzad pa rdzogs nas/bla ma yi dam lung bstan pa'i/ /mthar thug gsum gyi dus la babs/ /da ni zhing khams mthar thug pa'i/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du 'gro/ /zhes dus la babs pas 'pho ba ye shes skar khung ma la brten te dbu thod lag mthil tsam zhig mkha' la 'phar nas sgra 'od dang bcas te gshegs/ khams pa'i grwa (11na)pa rnams kyi dbang du song nas pur sbyangs pas/ 'di yi lus ni bde mchog 'khor lo ste/ /gsung ni mahā mā ya'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /thugs ni dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje ste/ /sprul pa'i gnas mchog gsang ba 'dus pa la/ /gsang gnas bde skyong gshin rje gshed du 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang mtshungs par/ lha sku dang ring bsrel gyi phung por song / deng sang yang shangs chos khungs btsun gyi rgyun ma chad pa tshar chen gyi thugs rje kho nar mngon no/ /drug pa paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa chen po ni/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis paṇa chen gyi sngon gnas dran zhing chos 'od yin pa rje mkhyen brtse'i mnal lam gyis shes nus pas/ rgya gar nub phyogs kha che khri brtan du yab tshong dpon srid brtan yum dge ba ma gnyis kyi sras su me mo lug gi lo la sku bltams/ spyir ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa rab gsal gyi rnam par sprul pa yin pas 'phags pa'i gang zag gi yon tan dpag par dka' zhing thun mong ba'i snang ngor yang chung ngu'i dus nas yig rtsis sgra snyan/ sdeb sbyor/ mjo ne brjod/ zlos gar dang gzhan yang rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad la mkhasapa'i rtser son/ mkhan po chen po ā kā ra gup+ta la bsnyen par rdzogs te tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur/ thun mong ba nang rig pa sde snod gsum dang thun mong min pa gsang chen rdo rje theg pa la sbyangs pas mkhas grub kyi snyan pas sa steng khyab/ khro phu ba gnubs byams pa'i dpal lo tsā mdzad bzhed kyis mang yul skyid grong du bzhugs dus(11ba)rgyal tsha'i slob ma don zhags par brtag pa zhus par 'phags pa wa ti la gsol ba thob ces —279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegasungs pa ltar btab pas lo tsā ba'i mnal lam du ā tsarla dung so yod pa zhig gis dung seng / byang chub shing gi lo ma la paṇ+ḍi ta bya'i gdong pa can dang shel gyi me long la paṇ+ḍi ta shin tu mdzes pa'i gzugs/ mi gzugs dkar po rnams gtad byung ba so so'i rgyab tu rgya yig yod pa de skabs ma mkhyen kyang seng ge lo tsā ba/ mi dkar mi tra dzo ki /me long burnya shrī/ shing lo kha che paṇa chen du 'dug pa bzhin bal yul dang rgya gar rnams su byon nas paṇa grub sngon ma gnyis spyan drangs pa'i rjes su/ rgya rtsis pa'i shing pho byi ba mchu zla ba'i tshes bdun la gdan 'dren pa'i ched lam du zhugs/ rgyang ro gong chung gi dge bshes rgya bla ma na re paṇa chen spyan 'dren pa la cum cum dang zhum zhus byas pas mi yong 'ud thag gis song gsung ba bzhin gro mor byon paṇa chen phebs lam nor ba'i chom rkun dug sprul gcan gzan sogs kyi 'jigs pa yod pa'i lam du byon kyang ci yang ma nyes par be+e ḍūrla'i tshong 'dus su byon/ lo tsā bas rgya yig bris pa'i zhu yig gser gyi sher snying dang gser srang lnga sogs kyi rten bzang po dang bcas paṇ+ḍi ta dza ya shrī dang wa ra ṇa si gnyis/ jo sras nyi ma dang khams pa byang grags gnyis pho nyar btang / gdan 'dren pa 'ong bar mkhyen nas la 'ur byon kyang ma byung bas phyir ldog par brtsams pa na bang chen rnams slebs/ paṇa chung rnams la ji ltar byed dri ba mdzad pas nged kyis mi shes chos rje nyid kyis mkhyen gsol ba la brten mtshams mdzad nas sgrol ma la gsol ba btab/ de'i dus rgya gar shar (12na)phyogs kyi gnas brtan mang pos slob dpon klu sgrub kyis rab gnas mdzad pa'i sgrol ma ngo chen du spyan drangs nas gdan 'dren la byung bar/ bod kyi pho nya bas dkon gnyer kha che bar rngan pa byin te rten gnyis zhal tshur bsgyur lo tsā ba byon pa na paṇa chen gyis gzhen nu 'di 'dras lo tsā ba e yong mi shes pas sems bskyed dang sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig byin nas phyir bzlog dgongs pa la dza ya shrīs bslabs nas lo tsā bas paṇa chung dgu la dri ba mi 'dra ba gnyis gnyis dris pas phyi dro nas nam phyed kyi bar du song / chos rje'i thugs dam nar ma mang po chag kyang thugs dgyes te bod na 'di 'dra ba'i chos smra ba 'ong ba ngo mtshar che gsungs/ rim gyis phag rir phebs phyogs 'dus kyi skya ser —280

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanagrangs med pa la man ngag kha 'thor mang du gsungs tshong 'dus nas chu mig gi bar du dge 'dun shin tu mang pos bskor bas khyim pa rnams kyis zhal yar lta dka' bar gyur/khro phur dbyar gnas mdzad pa'i tshul shing len mi brgyad brgya lhag tsam byung / brgyad stong pa dang so thar gyi lung mang du gsungs/ rtag tu ngu'i le'u la babs pa'i tshe mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal ri mo can gyi steng du po ti bzhugs pa la mchod pa mang po byed bzhin par nub phyogs la song bas rgyas khar kha cher 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ snar gyi glas mo cher byon nyis 'grol du gsungs pa la de bzhin nyid kyi le'u la slebs pa'i tshe chos rje'i phyag dpe brgyad stong pa'i po ti sgrol ma'i bang du byas der mchod pa mang po byas shar phyogs su song bas dbus su 'gro dgos pa 'dug gsungs shing (12bsdar yang dbyar gnas mdzad/ lha sar shākya mu ni sogs rten rnams mjal/ srin po rir dbyar gnas mdzad/rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang dang byams cho me sde lnga/ dbu ma rigs tshogis drug sogs chos mang du gsungs/bsam yas su lha btsun zhi ba 'od phyi mas gdan drangs mchims phu sogs gnas rnams gzigs/srin po rir bzhugs thog rgya 'bri mtshur gsum gyi gdan 'dren byung / byams pa'i cha rkyen gyi ched du gnyal lo ro sogs yul gru mang por phebs/chu sprel khro phu'i byams chen la rab gnas mdzad pas ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / sngon bla chen po'i sdom rgyun dang stod 'dul ba sogs byung na'ang bsod snyoms pa chen po 'di nyid kyis mkhan po mdzad nas byang rdor rnam gnyis sogs bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i paṇa chen brgyud pa zhes 'phags yul la 'gran bzod pa'i bstan pa rma med ba'i bka' drin rgya cher mdzad jo bo stan gcig pa'i sde btsugs/ dpal ldan sa skyar phebs dus rje btsun chen pos rdor dril nam mkha' la 'jog pa/ cang te'u so gos kyi sgra rang sgrar ga khrol ba/ rgya khab phye ltar gsol te phyir 'don pa/ sgyu ti'i rgyu ba bkag pas gza' 'dzin mi 'byung ba sogs la rgya gar na'ang 'di lta bu'i grub thob dkon zhesa'akhor lo sdom pa'i dbang gsan/ nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du rje btsun sa paṇ+ḍita bsnyen —281—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)par rdzogs/ bod rnams kyis bzhugs par gsol yang ma bzhed par 'bul ba'i dngos po rnams yul so so'i dge 'dun la bkye/ lo tsā bas glo bo'i bar gdan 'dren du byon par phyag gis ma theg (13na)pa'i gser gyi gnang sbyin mdzad/ kha cher lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas rgyal po mu stegs par song ba nang pa'i bstan pa la bkod yul der rab byung gi sde mang du btsugs/ sngar bod du slob ma rnams kyis dus mchod 'dzin pa'i dus mi shes pa 'dug gsol bas nam 'das pa'i dus na rdza sku rnams gas 'ong gsungs/ shing mo bya'i lo dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa dgur phebs pa na ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te dga' ldan du gshegs so/ /bdun pa chos rje sangs rgyas ston pa ni/ rnam thar gsol 'debs tshigs bcad mar gsal zhing rje nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes pa bzhin yul dbus kyi sa'i cha khyung btsun rdo rje dpal yum gyi pho brang gangs kyi ri bo'i 'dabs zhol rtsa'i bsil ma zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du ya bas dkar po'i rus las chad pa'i g.yung drung gi ston pa sa la dbang ba gsal ba'i khri zhes bya ba nas brgyud pa rim par bon gyi ring lugs la brten nas grub pa brnyes pa mang du byung ba'i mthar dam pa 'di nyid 'khrungs la/'on kyang bon la mi dgyes par chos 'ba' zhig don du gnyer bas yab mes kyi sgrub thabs gsum tsam las cher ma gsan/ dgung lo brgyad dgu lon pa'i dus 'bri klog sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu'i dus su ma gcig sprul sku la gcod dbang dang 'kha gdams tshig brgyud zhus/ bcu gcig dang bcu gnyis kyi dus su 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can du dgongs pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pa brtan pos dgung lo bcu gsum par bla ma rtso ri ras par rab tu byung mtshan brtson 'grus seng ger btags/ slob (13ba〉dpon sregs dum pa ras pa/ bzang yul ba/ khro phu ba/ sa skya pa/ slob dpon jo stan mkhar skya ba sogs yongs 'dzin bcu lhag gi zhabs pad nye bar bsnyen te theg pa che chung gi zab chos mang du gsan/bcu dgu par mkhan po chos rgyal gyi drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ khyad par bla ma rngog ston zhes 282

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)sa lo dang khro lo la dag pa mi ster ba skad byed pa de la kun las btus pa sogs zhus/ khong mos pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas gnyen ston gyi drung du byon pa'i tshe bla ma'i zhal nas de ring rab grong nas sgom chen pa zhig 'ong bar gda' bas o rgyan dang dza lan+dha ra tshun chod nas phyi'i rgya mtsho'i mtha' tshun 'geng ba'i chos bdag cig yin pas phyag bdar gyis gsungs/ mjal ba'i tshe khyod nga'i rtsar lo gsum gyi ring ma thon pa'i gong la lung bstan byed pa'i bla ma rngog ston grong ang gsungs pas mngon mkhyen thogs med du dgongs/ khyod 'dir 'ong ba'i rgyu ci yin gsungs par khyed sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs shing 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa'i yi dam gyi zhal gzigs chos skyong bran du 'khol zer bas 'ongs lags pas bla ma shangs pa'i gdams pa rnams gnang 'tshal zhus pas rje btsun ne gu ma'i thugs kyi nying khu chos drug gi dbang byin rlabs man ngag lung rgyab rten mtha' dag rdzogs par gnang nas brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun gyi tha ma yin no zhes ngos 'dzin mdzad/ 'gro don 'phrin las kyang rgya cher bskyangs pas shangasapa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa'i sgron me'o/ /brgyad pa kun mkhyen chos 'od ni/ bo dong du tshar chen phebs rgyu'i do nub rje mkhyen brtse'i mnal lam du kun (14na〉khyen chos sku 'od zer yin zer ba'i bla ma bgres po sku sha 'byor ba'i sku mas na bza' zhabs phyags sogs sang nyin rje nyid la ji lta ba bzhin 'dug gsungs pa kun mkhyen chos 'od kyi sku'i skye bar nges shes rnyed pas/ yul nyang stod gser sdings su gdung gsum pa yab kun mkhyen gzhen nu 'od/ yum mgar btsun ma shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi sras su g.ya' ma ri'i gtsug lag khang gi 'dabs su shing khyi ston 'bring nyi ma sgra gcan gyis zin pa'i dus sku bltams mtshan bdag med rdo rjer btags/ yum gyi lad mo mdzad pas yi ge'i 'bri klog dang kha rtan rnams tshegs chung ngus mkhyen/zhang po dang mnyam du gser sdings su chos zhu ba la byon pa'i tshe rtsed mor g.yengs pasanga'i chos 'go dang khyod kyi rtsed 'go tshugs pa chos la mi gus sam zhes bka' bgyon pas chos rna bas nyan pa dang yan lag gis rtse ba mi 'gal zhes chos rnams shar gyis bskyar bas kun ya mtshan zhing sngon gnas—283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegasungs pas kha che paṇa chen gyi sprul bar grags/ bla mas kyang yab tu zhal gyis bzhes nas de phyin chad bstan bcos kyi mdzad byang la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ces gsungs skad/bcu gsum pa la gnas rnying du mkhan po rin cen pa la rab tu byung ba'i mtshan chos sku 'od zer du btags shing nyer lnga la bsnyen par rdzogs/ dgung lo lnga nas bcu'i bar yab kyi drung du gsang 'dus dang bde mchog sogs zab chos mtha' dag bum pa gang byor gsan/ chos rje 'jam gsar ba la gshed dmar dus 'khor phar tshad/ 'jam rgyal la smyung gnas/ bzad ring la (14bsgo rga pa/ sa lo la sgra tshad snyan ngag sdeb sbyor bde dgyes/ bi bhū ti la 'phreng bskor gsum/ sa shrī la ka tsan/ dpyal chos bzang la dpyal lugs/ lce mdo sde seng ge la yo ga /'phags pa rin po che/ mchims chen po/ dzochung ma sogs mkhas grub mang po bsnyen nas mdo rgyud kyi chos la mkhas par gyur pas kun mkhyen du grags/ lha sar jo shāg gi drung du byon nas bshad sgom gang byas na bzang zhes gsol ba btab pas ston pa dngos su gyur te/ khyod kyis dang por brtsams pa nas zhes sogs kyis dbugs dbyung / hor dmag gi gnod pa byung ba'i tshe mang po'i srog bskyabs/ 'dol chung chos 'khor gyi dus mkhas pa'i snyan grags kyis khyab/ gser sdings su bzhugs nas dbang lung 'khrid byin rlabs rgyud bshad man ngag mdo phyogs kyi gzhung bshad sogs gdul bya'i re ba yongs su bkang / sa skam po las chu 'byin pa dang mngon par mkhyen pa thogs med mnga'/ 'od gsal khor yug tu 'byongs pa sogs rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog las nam yang mi g.yo ba'i ngang nas gdan sa slob dpon 'od zer mgon la gtad de dben gnas bya btang du don dgu pa chu 'brug hor zla gsum pa'i nyer dgu la nam mkhor zli ba lta bu la tshom bu so gnyis 'od lngas bskor ba thal byung gyen la 'gro ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te dag pa'i zhing du gshegs so/ /dgu pa kun mkhyen bu ni/ dpe khang na rgya dpe 'di 'dra yod ces dri tshad mdzad pa rnams phal cher 'grig cing / zha lu'i gdan sar phebs dus dbu zhwa ser po bzhes dgos zhus pas 'di sngar khri 'di'i —284

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)steng nas mang po zhig gyon yod (15na rko res sa zhu rang byed gsungs kun mkhyen bu'i dus bzhes pa la dgongs shing phyis kyi mkhan po la dngos brgyud gang gi sgo nas bu'i bstan pa la 'di nyid las lhag pa ma byung ba sogs kyis shes nus pas yul nyang ro sna bzhi zhes par gdung rabs bcu bdun par snga gos rnying ma'i grub thob rim par byon pa'i brag gi gdung las yab bla ma brag ston rgyal mtshan dpal bzang dang yum slob dpon bsod nams 'bum gyi sras su shab smad sgom gnas dgon gsar du lcags stag dpyid zla 'bring po nag pas nya ba'i nyer bzhi la sku 'byungs/ chung ngu'i dus yum gyisashes rab bskyed pa'i thabs mang du mdzad cing 'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs/ thog mar 'da' ka ye shes la 'byor klog mdzad pa sogs 'bri klog la thogs pa mi mnga'/ mes tshul khrims bzang po'i drung du dgung lo drug tsam nas chos rnam dag yin min gyi shan 'byed mdzad/ bdun la khro phu ba r+ṣa por sems bskyed zhus pas byang chub kyi sems thugs rgyud la zhakhrungs/ dgung lo brgyad nas rin po che khro phu bar bde mchog /mes tshul khrims bzang po la rnying ma bka' gter/ dgung lo bco brgyad par mkhan po rin cen seng ge dpal dang slob dpon tshad ma'i skyes bu la rab tu byung / mkhan slob gnyisasogs mkhas pa du ma bsten nas phar phyin gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo phyogs kyi gzhung 'grel mtha' dag la sbyangs pas mkhas pa'i grags pa thob/dgung lo nyer gsum pa la gtsang tshong 'dus mgur mo'i bla brang du mkhan chen grags pa gzhen nu dpal bzang dang slob dpon bsod nams grags pa'i drung du (15ba tha snyen par rdzogs/ mkhan slob gnyis la 'dul ba'i chos du ma gsan/ chos dbar la 'phreng brag lung sogs su phar phyin dang mngon pa kun las btus sogs kyi bshad pa dang / bsgrub bya khri phrag tu longs pa'i mkhan slob mdzad/thar lo la sgra / tsan/ dus 'khor/ kye rdor/ bde mchog /gshed skor/ tha snyad rig pa sogs/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge la sa lugs nas brgyud pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos skor shin tu rgya che ba/ pha rgod pa la gsang 'dus/ rong pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan la dus lor slob dpon 'phags pa la gsang 'dus rim —285

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)lnga sogs/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan la kye rdor gtso bor gyur pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos du ma gsan zhing 'chad nyan mdzad bzhin pa'i mur lcags pho spre'u'i lo dpal zha lu gser bkang du phebs nas sde dgon mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bur bkur zhing mdo phyogs kyi 'chad nyan rgya che ba dang sngags chos kyang gsungs shing / grub thob ze dmar bar bde mchog dang gshed skor sogs gsan/jo bo rje'i phyag tsha bzhugs pa'i spel chung zhig yod pa la gzhi byas ri phug gi gtsug lag khang 'dus sde dang bcas pa btab/ gsang sngags kyi dbang lung rgyud bshad gtso bor gyur pa'i 'chad nyan dang mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos po ti sum cur nye ba'i thugs rtsom mdzad/sa ga zla ba'i dus chen la rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor zhe lnga tsam zhal 'byed pa/ khyad par rnal 'byor rgyud la khro spro sgo bzhi'i gsol 'debs/ sa gar mchod gar sogs shin tu zhib pas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa ltar gyur/ bla ma chen po (16na)bsod nams blo gros dang thugs sras sems dpa' chen po sogs che btsun mkhas grub kyi slob ma nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar grangs yas/sgra tshad pa sogs zhal slob rnams la rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa chen pos rgyud sde bzhi phal cher gsan nas dar bas mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa zhes shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i mtha'i bar du khyab pa'ang 'phrin las kyi cha shas su sems/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi lam la brten nas spangs rtogs kyi yon tan ni bsam pa'i re ba las brgal zhing bstan 'gro'i don rlabs po che mdzad bzhin pa'i ngang nas shing 'brug hor zla drug pa'i nyer gcig la dga' ldan gyi gnas su byams pa'i thugs gar sku'i bkod pa bsdus so/ /bcu pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug yar klungs pa chen po ni/ 'dar du zhal gyi gtor chen dus tshar chen gyi mnal lam du 'jam dbyangs sgeg pa'i lo rgyus kyis nges par nus pas bod 'dir mi'u gdung drug tu grags pa'i nang tshan ldong gi rigs las rgyal tsha lung mang po chos kyi dbang phyug sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen rim par byon nas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rnams dang bla res slob —286

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanares su gyur pa'i dbon brgyud du shing pho spre'u'i lo la sku bltams/ chung ngu'i dus nas sngon gyi bag chagasabazang po'i mthu brtas pas yi ge 'bri klog sogs tshegs med par mkhyen/ khu ston seng ge bzang po'i drung du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nos mtshan seng ge rgyal mtshan du gsol/ kye rdor gyi dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad/sku na gzhen dus gzhung lugs la sbyangs te (16ba)dgung lo bcu'i thog bsam yas su phar phyin gyi gra skor mdzad/ bco brgyad pa la dwags po'i mkhar klu bzang du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang mjal nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ bcu dgu pa la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus/ 'di nas bzung phal cher drung du nye bar bcar nas gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa gser chos bcu gsum chos skyong che chung gi skor sogs dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab chos mtha' dag bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ gsung ngag gi dus nyams skyon med 'ba' zhig skyes pas bla ma dang chos la thugs nges gting nas zhakhrungs pas snyan brgyud bzhi pa mos gus gzhon nu'i bde ba lta bu der snang / bla ma'i phyag dpe 'bri ba sogs dang chabs cig par gsung rgyun zin bris su mdzad pa'ang pod longs 'ga' zhig mchis/ mgon po'i thun mong min pa'i bka' babs gsum la gdung brgyud rim byon/ yar klungs pa/bar sdings pa gsum du mdzad ba'i klu khu dpon rnams sa lo 'jam rdor man chad kyi gdung brgyud las sa skya pa'i don gyi bstan pa 'dzin par gzur gnas shig gis ltas na 'gangs nges par che/ der ma zad mdo rgyud kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu la gsan pa mdzad/gzhan yang kun mkhyen bu/ sems dpa' chen po thogs med pa/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo/ bla ma chen po bsod blo ba sogs yongs 'dzin bcu phrag gsum tsam bsten nas thos bsam rgya cher mdzad/nang bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor la brtan pa thob pas yi dam gyi lha mang po'i zhal gzigs shing byin brlabs/ dam can srung ma rnams (17na)bran du 'khol bas mthu stobs nus pa phul du phyin/ sku'i dog cha sel ba la mgon po zhal gyi rjes gnang zhus shig pa'i brdar chos skyong ā tsarla thod 'phreng bzung —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pebar sprul nas khyod mi rus kyi 'phreng ba 'di bzung na khe che ste mi 'dzin pa 'dug zer/ zham ring par gtogs pa zhig gis ka ca mang po khyer ba na g.yin zhig la mon bu pu tra babs te nga mnga' ris na la rtse nas 'ongs pa'i 'ba' ra yin/ pu ra yin/ rkun ma bsam yas 'ja' dkar na yod pa la khyed tsho mgo gtums nas sdod dam zer ba'i khungs ston pa sogs srung ma rnams kyis 'phrin las mtha' dag g.yel med du bsgrub/ thugs dam zab mo'i khor yug la bzhugs pa'i thun mtshams tshore 'phags pa rin po che'i dbon brgyud slob dpon blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gsang phu'i gdan sa pa rin cen rnam rgyal/khyad par yab 'jam dbyangs chen po'i rtsa ba'i bla ma dbon rgyal mchog pa sogs la gser chos snyan brgyud kyi zab chos rgya cher bstsal bas deng sang gi bar du rje btsun gong ma'i bstan pa'i srog tu song /gzhan yang gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos 'khor rgya cher bskor/ brtag gnyis kyi smi ka dang kun rig gi dkyil chog sogs thugs rtsom mang du mdzad/ skabs shig mar ngo'i tshes bcu la drung chos rje pa'i dus dran gyi sgrub mchod mdzad pa'i tshe tho rengs bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar gnyis bsgoms nas cung zad 'od gsal du song pa'i ngang du srid gsum 'gran zla bral ba'i chos rje de nyid byon te 'o 'di yin te zhes pa gsung byon pas dngos su mjal ba las brgya 'gyur gyis lhag pa'i (17brkog snang dang /nyams sad pa na dad gdung gi yus kyis brnangs byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'bar ba'i rkyen gyis sngar las lhag pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs shing rim gyis rtogs pa'i yon tan gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur/ gsang ba'i bdag po mi'i gzugs can grub chen las kyi rdo rjes sku tshe 'di'i rjes ma bde ba can gyi zhing du 'khrungs par lung bstan pa bzhin snang ba mtha' yas kyi nyal sgom dang bde ba can gyi smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar nas dgung lo re dgu pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo dbo zla ba'i gnam gang la 'od dpag med kyi thugs gar gshegs so/ /bcu gcig pa pha rgod bsod nams bzang po ni/ tshar chen shangs zur khang du phebs dus bris thang dang gzims khang sogs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi ngos 'dzin mdzad par snang / bla ma 'di nyid sku —288

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)zhabrungs nas chung ngu'i dus tha mal pa'i spyod tshul ye mi mdzad par 'bri klog bslab sbyangs sogs la brtson par mdzad/ yongs 'dzin mang du bsten te bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa nas mdo rgyud kyi chos tshul du ma gsan/ khyad par sngon gyi bag chags sad pas dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa la thugs mos par byung nas 'jag chen kun dga' dpal bzang la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ne gu'i thugs kyi nying khu chos drug gi smin byed spyi bga' zur bka' byin rlabs/ rtsab chos drug /sdong po phyag chen/ yal ga lam 'khyer/ me rta go mkha' spyod/ gos bu 'chi med rang grol gyi 'khrid/ rgyab rten gyi lung so gos chos drug 'jag lugs la thos bsam sgom gsum (1sha rdzin par mdzad/ sgyu lus 'phyongasashing rmi lam la rang dbang thob pas dag pa'i zhing khams mang por bgrod cing der bzhugs pa'i 'dren pa rnams la chos zhu ba sogs lam rtags ngo mtshar ba mang du byung / shangs zur khang du bzhugs pas zur khang pa bsod nams bzang por grags/ mchog sred rnam sprul rje btsun kun spangs chen bor 'jag lugs shangs chos stsal ba sogs mkhas grub kyi slob ma mang du byung zhing thos bsam sgom gsum gyis nyin mtshan dus 'da' ba zhig go/bcu gnyis pa rnal 'byor dbang mo ni/ stag tshang lo tsā ba dang dpon slob tu 'brel ba'i bag chagasakyis tshar chen rin po ches sgra pa sku skye la 'jam dkar zhal gzigs ma'i rjes gnang gsan pa gnang zhing / rje btsun ma 'di ni g.yas ru'i sa'i cha bza' shing gi ra ba sogs kyis khor yug tu bskor ba'i yul ljongs yid du 'ong ba'i khang par rje 'di nyid kyi sku zhang gi rigs su bltams nas chung ngu'i dus gtsug lag gi yon tan 'ga' la bslab sbyangs mdzad/ srid pa'i bde ba mtha' dag me 'bar ba'i klong ltar gzigs bas bcos ma ma yin pa'i nges 'byung gi bsam pas khyim thabs kyi bya ba dug can gyi zas bzhin spangs te shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin cen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i drung du rab tu byung nas tshul khrims mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrungs bas dge slong dbang mo zhes snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs kun tu khyab/ dam pa de nyid gtso bor —289

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)gyur pa'i mkhas grub du ma bsten nas dbang 'khrid man ngag gyi zab chos rgya cher gsan/ (18bskong rang byung rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du rtsa khams rlung gsum thams cad dag pa ye shes kyi lha bde stong gi rol par 'char ba sogs yon tan phun sum tshogs pas ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gtso bo mdzad pa zhig go /zhi bde'i pad 'dab 'jam mnyen mal stan las/ /sred bral sna tshogs 'gro khams tsher dong du/ /nyer 'jug snying rje'i cha gang chu shel dbang / /lhag bsam rlung gis gdul bya'i mkha' la drangs/ /thugasabaskyed nam yang mi yol rlabs 'phreng gis/ /gzhan phan gru gzingasadal med rtag g.yeng bar/ /rang bder gcig tu gzhol ba'i chu lha mo/ khrel rgod so yi lbu ba 'khrigs pa bzhin/ /'dus gsum bgrod dka'i 'phreng las sgrol ba'i sa/ /drag mnan ring min zung 'jug phyag rgya che/ /brnyesakyang da dung bslab pa'i zol sbyor gyis/ /g.yin 'drid sgyu thabasa'adi 'dra rigs sam ci/ /sna tshogasasprul pa'i gser zhun nyag thag la/ /mkhas btsun bzang grub rin chen brgyus pa'i rgyan/ /lung rtogs gom stabs lhod po'i sa srungs lus/ /mngon par spud las glang po phal gyi min/ /kun dga'i bde ba bskyed nusadri zhim ngad/ /bayi+on pa'i bser bu lho phyogs nags kyi klung / /lan brgyar myul ba'i reg byas bsnun pa'i mod/ /gyen du ldang ba'i ba spu'i rtse mo rtsub/ /bcu gsum pa sku tshe 'di'i rtogs pa brjod pa la gang du byon pa'i yul ni/ kye rdor bshad rgyud ṛ ki a ra li'i rgyud las/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po 'grub byed sa bcu gsum pa mngon du byed pa la 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di sa bcu gsum pa thob byed kyi skabs su gsungs pas gling gzhan las ngo mtshar (19na)bar bdag med bstod par/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga bdud bral cha dang bcas/ /snying gi dbus zhugs gtsug tor mchog tu thim/ /'phags pa'i lam lnga drug pa cha yi dngos/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum sar phyag 'tshal/ /zhes byung zhing mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram du shing dzasbu tri sha'i 'bras bu rdza tsam pa chur lhungs pa'i sgra las dze+e zhes byung bas gling dang shing gnyis ka la ming der chags pa'i gling 'di la shar du rgya nag dang khri brtan/ lhor rgya gar dang kha che/ nub tu stag sde dang gzig yin/ byang du khrom dang ge sar/ dbus —290

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanasu bod yul gangs kyi ra ba dang dgu'o/ /zhes pa'i bod kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ bod kyi yul dang de bzhin du/ /mā la wa dang pā li sogs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul yin no/ /zhes bde mchog tu bod 'di srung 'khor gyi gnas brgyad kyi zla tshang dang / kye rdor du gnas dang sa sbyor ba'i sa bcu gnyis par bshad cing / bal po'i rgyal po de wa lhas khri btsun la gdams par/ nga yi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod/ /bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ /bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / /ngo mtshar med byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ /'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tsho gos 'byung / /zhes phun sum tsho gos pa'i yon tan khyad par 'phags par bstan zhing / zhing sa dang khang sa gnyis te sa'i dge /khang rdo dang chus bskor gyi rdo ste rdo'i dag/ zhing chu dang 'thung chu ste chu'i dge /khang shing dang 'bud shing ste shing gi dge/ gam (19ba 'brog dang rgyang 'brog ste 'brog gi dge zhes dge bcu'i yon tan yongs su tshang ba'i yul ོ po 'di nyid la bod skyong ba'i rgyal po mes dbon gyi dus dbu ru dang g.yo sa g.yas ru dang ru lag ces ru bzhir bshad cing / tshal pa si tso deb dmar du sa hor mar yon gyi dus gong ma'i lung gis phyed gsal chen mo byas skabs chu mig khri skor gyi sa'i char ga rta gos pas/gsol 'debs las/dus 'dir mtho ris phun tsho gos rgyas pa'i shong / /dpal ldan rmu zhes rab grags bsti gnas su/ /rigasarus mngon mtho'i skal bzang yab yum gyi/ /sras su dge bar 'khrungs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rje btsun yum gyi ye shes gsal snang du/ /dpal gyi 'dab rgyas gtar ma'i 'dzum dkar las/ /o rgyan sku brnyan thugs kar thim pa dang / /rgyal ba'i mchod rten gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i bye brag yul ni rdo rje gdan nas dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa na grum stod dpal ldan sa skya/ de las ha cang gis mi ring ba mu ku ta zhes bod skad du rnam par grol ba ste tshe gcig la grol lam rnyed pa'i gdams pa gsung ngag rin po che bod 'dir thog mar byung ba'i gnas dang 'dabs chags pa/ 'phags—291

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)pa don yod zhags pa'i sku rang byon bzhugs pa'i sa'i cha/ ba da ra'i gling bgrod kyi rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab tu/ rtse mo shin tu mtho ba yi/ khrel gyi sa gzhi mdun du mthong / / bya rnams kyis kyang bgrod dka' ba/ /'jam pa'i brag ni gcig pu der/ /zhes shin tu mtho ba'i brag ri dang spang ljongs gangs kyi rdul mang yongs su brtsegs pa las snyan pa'i sgra lhung lhung du sgrog pa'i chu'i lha mo dbu ba'i do shal dkar po ring du 'phyang (20na)ba'i rgyun mi chad par 'bab pa/ ne'u gsing gi ngos su bya sna tshogs skad snyan sgrog cing ri dwags rnams bag phebs par rgyu ba/ 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa las/ de nas an+da rnyil gyi 'od ltar sngo/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis gnam sngon bzhu ba bzhin/ kho ra khor yug mtsho 'gram ltar mi mngon/ /gting dpag dka' ba'i mtsho 'jing nang du zhugs/ /zhes gnam sngon zhun ma lta bu'i lcags kyi chu klung chen po 'bab pa'i 'gram dang nye ba/ rab gsal gyi rtogs brjod las/ gser gyi ba gam gzhal yas khang / khang pas bskor ba'i grong khyer ni/ /'od ldan zhes bya bsod nams nas/ /'od ldan mtho ris lta bu yod/ /ces 'chi med kyi gnas sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i grong khyer gyi kho ra khor yug yid du 'ong ba'i mtha' skor kun tu sprin bzhen gyi rtogs brjod las/ bung ba'i na chung rnam sprul longs spyod ldan/ /sbrang rtsis myos shing rnam par 'byams dus der/ /me tog rab rgyas 'khri shing tshal gyi gzhin/ /rigs 'dzin rgyal po'i sras ni rnam par rgyu/ /zhes kha dog sna tshogs mngon par bkra zhing dri ngad bzang po 'thul ba'i ze'u 'bru la bung ba rnams chags pa'i glu len cing 'bras bu can sogs yal ga 31 ma me tog kun nas dud pa'i ljon shing gi 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba/ spang ljongs mar gad zhun ma brdal ba lta bu dud 'gro rnams dal bur rgyu bas 'tsho zhing / 'bru sna tshogs yongs su smin pa'i snye ma'i tshogs mgo bo cung zad dud pa/ klu kun tu dga' ba'i zlos gar du/ ha ri tsan dan gyis byugs lus can lha yi me tog 'phreng ba rab tu 'dzin/ /nor bu'i rgyan gyi 'od dag rig pas dwangs shing bkra bar bya ba'i gos dang ldan/ /(20ba〉spyab pa'i skye bo dag dang lhan cig spel bar gyur pa'i rigs 'dzin 'di dag —292

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanarnams/ /tsan dan grib bsil dag la dga' ma'i 'thung lhag tu gyur chang dag 'thung bar byed/ /ces skye bo rnams gos rgyan bzang po dang chang gis myos pas glu gar rtsed 'jo ji snyed byed la/de yang mdo rgya cher rol pa las/ dge slong de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na 'dug pa ni rnam par lta ba chen po bzhi la rnam par blta ste/ bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dus la rnam par lta ba dang / gling la rnam par lta ba dang / yul la rnam par lta ba dang / rigs la rnam par lta ba'o zhes pa'i rigs la lta tshul/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ 'dzam bu'i gling ni chung ngu 'dir/ /bdag ni shākya'i rigs rjes 'gro/ /zhes nyi ma'i gnyen gyi brgyud rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i rigs phun sum tshogs pa la gzigs pa ltar dam pa 'di nyid kyi rigs ni bod 'dir rus chen bzhir gyes pa'i nang tshan rmu ldong stong mi nyag ste bzhi las ldong gi rigs su gtogs pa/ de yang yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed las/'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sa skya pas/ /chol kha gsum la kha lo sgyur ba'i dus/ /de yi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dpon chen dang / /slob dpon dge gshes blon chen rim pa rnams/ /mkhas mchog stobs ldan grangs las 'das mod kyi/ /thog mar yus po che yi mi gsum po/ grum pa sa skya'i dpon wo shāka bzang dang / shar smad myong kha'i dge bshes rin brtson dang / /mdo stod gon byo'i har che ston tshul yin/ /de gsum nang nas rigs mtho blo gtsang ba/ /dge bshes chen po nas brgyud deng (21na〉nga bar/ /bla ma'i zha khas tag dbus gtsang bya ba dang / /bkur skyong phyogs la blo gros spyan ldan zhing / /mi mthun dpung 'joms ma sangs bka' babs zhes/ /snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs su kun khyab pas/ /blon chen 'di pa'i byon tshul 'di ltar ro/ /de'ang 'di ltar thos te/ sngon bod du chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang / de'i sras bzhi pa khri lde srong btsan rgyal po'i sku ring la mtha' dmag 'gogs pa'i bod yul gyi phyogs bzhir sgo bsrung ma bskos/ khyad par bod dmag khri dmag mang po khyer nas bha ta hor gyi sgom gra bcom/ g.yul rgyal snang spyad nas phyir byon dus de phyogs kyi sgo srung ba la bod dmag slebs nas rkyen btus pa'i dpa' —293—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)bo mi dgu/ dmag brgya phrag dgu dang bcas pa hor bod kyi so mtshams su bzhag /de dus khong rnams kyis nged rnams ji tsam la log yong rgyu yin zer ba zhus pas rgyal po'i lung gis nged kyi bka' ma byung bar ldog tu med gsungs pas/ de phyin nas dpa' bo mi dgu po'i rus ming bka' ma log zer bar chags te/ der yun rings pas bka' ma log gi bod 'brog sde tshan mang po yod do/ /se chen rgyal po'i blon chen saṃ gha ching sang zer ba de yang rus pa bka' ma log tshang yin zer bar 'dug /de rnams kyi che brgyud las chad pa shar tsong kha mtsho sngon gyi mthil na skad gsar pa bya ba dang / jag rong pas/ku ku med bya ba yul khams chen po gsum gyi bdag po ye bzang ring mo'i sras che ba skya ming dbon po rin chen rgyal mtshan bya ba blo gsal zhing skye mched dwangs pa zhig byung ba de nyid gzhen (21ba〉kyi nas dkar po'i chos la mos pa zhig yod pas/ yul khams rnams mched zla kun 'dzin du bcug nas/gtsang sa skya bla ma'i snyan grags chor/ mos gus chug ste zhabs la gtug par 'dod nas yar byon pas mdo stod kyi hor tshe ston tshul yang chos don du gnyer ba la der ma brten sa skyar chas pa dang khong rnam gnyis bya ba lung par mjal/ mdo stod smad kyi phyogs sred dang sku tshe sngon ma'i 'brel shugs kyis spun phu nu ltar thugs shin tu mthun par byung nas de'i dbyar gya ma 'brong ngu dgon par bsdad/ston de 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa gong nas yar phebs dus 'brong du dgon pa bas gdan drangs bsnyen bkur zhus/ de thog tu khong rnam gnyis pas kyang rab byung zhus dbon po'i mtshan rin cen brtson 'grus bya bar btags/ bdag bslab gnyer mthar phyin pa zhig byed 'dod pas rjes su bzung du gsol zhus pas/ de bzhin legs/ slob dpon shar pa ye shes kyas bslab gnyer gyi mgon gyis la dge bshes chen po zhig mgyogs par yong bar byed do gsungs pas dge bshes la snga ba rin cen brtson 'grus bya ba'ang de dus nas byung bar gda'o/ /der gnyis gas phyag phyir byon sa skyar phebs bslab gnyer mdzad pas shes rab dang thugs rus che ba'i tshad thub par byung / ring po ma lon par sa skya'i dge bshes rnams kyi nang nas mkhas grags thon par byung / bar skabs nas snga ma 'phags pa'i —294

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanaphyags phyi zhabs tog mthil bzhugs yun ring mdzad bya ba'i ljid khur chen po mang du bkal/de mtshams sa 'bri 'khrug pa'i 'go tshugs gong du khrims kyi gtug bsher la phyogs phyogs nas mi drag pa 'gro dgos pa byung dus dpon (22na thin shākya bzang po dang / dge bshes rin cen brtson 'grus/ rin po che ston tshul gsum pos bla ma dang bstan pa gdan sa chen mo'i phyis la bsamasate blos blangs nas byon/ khrims lugs su song bas tshal gung thang nas pho brang shangs mtho'i bar la an khur nas rkang thang la byon/ gong du thug bsher legs/ sa skya pa'i bya ba rnams gang 'dod legs par grub nas yar 'khor ba'i dus khong rnams sa skya ba la yus che ba'i mi gsum du grags pa byung zhing chen bor gyur/ spyi sgos su bla ma'i gnang sbyin/ brgya stong so sos bya dga' chen po byas/ khyad par dge bshes chen po la ja rin du sa skya'i drug phya ma'i 'dab sgo dang tshong 'dus kha meb kyi mgo byas grang khang ga ra/ phul gyog gzhis ka rnams gtsang mar gnang / skya btsun thams cad kyis bkur sti zhabs ga che bar byung / de skabs su mched grogs ston tshul ba'i gros la bslab gnyer gyis dka' spyad bshesaganyen gyi snyan grags thob/ sa skya pa
