gsang sngags zab mo'i bdag po yin pas da yang gsang sngagasadang mthun par mdzad na sku khams kyi 'tsho skyong du'ang 'gyur/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su'ang bu slob rjes 'dzin sogs khyad che bar yong zer ba la gsan nas/ nyang stod bye mda' pa'i ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum mngon chung ngu'i gyog gzhis kar bzhag phyag rgyar bsten pa la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba ban rgan blo gros rin cen/ bar pa sto dkon cog /chung ba dbon kun dga' rdo rje rnams byung / bar ba 'di 'gro mgon phyag na'i sras dharma pā la rak+ṣi ta dang lo zla zhag (22ba)dus mnyam du 'brungs pa nasamatshan 'di chos rgyal 'phags pas btags par yang byed do/ /de'i dus na hor rgyal bu chos dpal bod chos la byon pa'i bsu skyel zhabs tog la dge bshesachen po de bas 'bad rtsol bskyed pas nyi ma nub phyogs kyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas phyir 'byon dus sog pa mdo bar skyel thung la byon par rgyal po mnyes nas byang re thag phyir 'then gang —295

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pe'adug /rin cen brtson 'grus mi brgyud dang bcas pa shes su chug cing / khyod kyis she mong 'dabs pa bzhin bu tsha bo rnams kyis kyang gong ma yon mchod la she mong 'dabs chug zer ba'i li ji bzang po gnang / de nas dge bshes chen po sa skya'i tshong 'dus khang leb tu bde bar gshegs rting sras che ba ban rgan la yab kyi rjes su zhugs nas khrims gnyis kyi bya ba dang sa skya'i zhabs(tog /nang so'i mthil len/ dngos su bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs la gtugs she mong 'dabs par ta'i tu'i pho brang du byon nas bla ma'i sku drin la ol jo thu rgyal pos lha rgod mdung rtse yan dang ra g.yu mtsho man 'di blo gros rin chen mi brgyud dang bcas pa shes su chug gsung ba'i 'ja' sa gtsang ma gnang /gcung gnyis po nye ring med par bskyangs/ gcen la byang gi khri dpon dang gcung la du dbyen sha'i las ka zhus nas bskos/ dharma dkon cog gi gzhi ba la ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi zhal ta ma gcig dang / dpon kun rdor la ma gcig 'od 'bum gyi tsha mo zhig blangs pa gnyis ka la sras ma byung /ban rgan pas zhal ta mdzad zhal ta ba re re 'og tu bzhag pa la khri dpon dharma dkon cog la sras khri dpon chos rgyal (23na skong dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po byung / du dben sha kun dga' rdo rje la sras khri dpon dkon cog rgyal mtshan byung / khri dpon rgyal rgyas yab kyi shul du bya ru'i khri dpon thog gcig byas sku gshegs/ sras med pas dkon mchog rgyal mtshan khri dpon la bskos/ bla chen kun blo'i phyags phyir gong la byon yar phebs jo mo sreg shing dbon mo blangs nas mthong smon sa cha/ lha khang / spang grong gi kha 'dzin byed dus sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba dbon po dkon cog 'od zer dang dkon mchog rin chen/ mkhan po bsod nams blo gros/ chung ba rgod po rin chen rnams byung ngo / /gcung po 'di ma sangs kyi sprul pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di'i skabs su dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po pa de nyid 'brog khri skor gyi ru thog mtsho mo ru khyung gis bskor ba sgar chen bzhugs dus chibs gar ba ston chen bya ba zhig bor nas lha 'dre mi gsum la bca' hu bkram rtsad gcod pa phyogasabazhir btang bas/ shar phyogs pa'i mi gnyis kyis kha ba skya sib babs pa'i steng la rta rjes 'dug pa —296

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)mthar ded pas shar sog la skya mo'i zhol na sgar chen zhig 'dug pa de khrod na chibs pa yang 'dug nas mgron gnyer la rgyu mtshan bsnyad sgar 'di su'i yin dris pas sgar 'di ma sangs kyi sgar yin/ ge sar dang sgu ldi la sogs yod zer gur nang du khrid sgu ldi yin zer ba de na re/ nged kyis kha sing nas byang stong la yongs dpon chen pa dang mjal rtsis la ma phrad/ da gzod khyed kyi dbon po zhig yod pa de dang yang yang phrad zer ba gyis la/ rta dang mda' rgod sgro ma 'di phul zer nas khyer yongs/ dpon (23bsgon pa la phul de rting dpon po rgod po rin cen pa zhakhrungs so/ /dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po de nyid ti shrī kun rgyal ba'i zhabs la gtugs gong la phyag phyir byon/ bla ma'i sku drin dang khrims kyi bya ba la mkhas pas sngon ma dpon chen shrī ming dang de rting dbusagatsang dpon chen sngon ma thog mar phebs dus ban rgan pas zhal ta mdzad/ jo mor bla ma mus chen pa'i dbon mo dang / dbon mo jo mo rim bar blangs na'ang sras ma byung ba zhal ta ma 'bum rgyan grab la sras grags pa rgyal mtshan ba byung zhing / rting ma zur sras dpon bo hor tsha ba bya ba zhig kyang byung /dpon chen pas dbon po dkon cog 'od zer byang khri dpon la bskos/ sras po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa sa skya nang sor bzhag /dbus gtsang sdel bkod nas dbon po dkon cog rin cen phyags phyir khrid yongs gong ma mchod yon gyi drung du byon snga rting dril bas lo bco brgyad tsam gong du bzhugs/swon jing dben gyi rtsa ba'i dpon chen mi shangs len gsum mdzad/ lung gu ta hu'i zon gnang / yar 'byon khar nga'i sbra ber khyung gsum gyi tshong pa bod la lo re bzhin yong ba'i 'bab sa'i gnas gzhi zhig brtsig dgos zhus pas gang 'os tshol gsungs par shangs nang g.ye dmar sgang brgyud nas sa che bar 'dug pas 'di dgos zhug pas bye re bab lha gdong yan/ thag mngal gdong / dang ra shing gcig man gyi sa cha/ rgyal ba bzang po'i rta sga 'bog sal byin zhing / de khongs gang 'os su gnas gzhi brtsig tu chug gsungs pa'i lung bzang po gnang bas yar phebs nas shangs mthong smon gyi sa 'di na chu (24na skonas pa'i rdzing zhig 'dug pas ming dang gang sa nas rten 'brel legs pas 'di khongs su —297

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shechug pa gyis gsungs/ lcags ri spel lcog rnams dkyil du khang leb chen mo dang bcas pa btab/ de rting gong ma yon mchod kyi sku rim smon lam 'debs shing spos sreg pa'i lha khang zhig bzhengs su 'jug pa dgos zer ba'i zhu ba gong du btang bas/ de bzhin yin chug gsung ba'i lung phebs nas myug rgyal khang rgyal po'i pho brang la dpe blangs pa bzhengs/chos sde 'di sngon bod rgyal blon dus kyi ka ca rnying pa dang / ri rting ma ma'i dgon lag rnying pa dar cha med pa zhig 'dug pa'ang dpon chen pas rgyal khang bzhengs pa dang mnyam du/ so paṇ+ḍi ta 'jigs med grags pa chos dpon la gdan drangs sgos kyi mnga' zhabs la btsun khral thengs gnyis brgyab nas bshad gra btsugs chos sde'i she mong bskyed/ chos khrims dar bar mdzad/yab yum gyi phyi rten la g.ye dmar snang stod du sku 'bum chen mo bzhengs zha lu bu ston rin po che gdan drangs nas rab gnas dbus gtsang du rgyas pa'i dpe thub pa mdzad de/ lung gis bskos pa'i dpon chen gnyis byang pa'i phyag tshab gcig dang bcas pas gong dang dbus gtsang du dpon chen thengs gsum mdzad pa de bar la/ gdan sa chen po'i snang zhabs tag bla ma la bkur sti/ mnga' zhabs kyi skyong dar/ phag gru khri dpon dang mkhas pa la sogs khrims 'gal mu med byed mkhan rnams la drag lasakyis 'jun 'dur/ gzhan yang rgyal khrims chen po'i bya ba gang la'ang nye ring med cing blang dor ma 'dzol bar (24ba〉phyung bas kun gyis byang chub sems dpa'i dpon chen du grags shing / gong nas rting la phebs rjes la sra sa blo gros rgyal mtshan pa byung ba/ gcen dpon grags rgyal ba dang dgung lo bcu bdun bco brgyad kyi khyad yod pas na grags rgyal ba'i sras yin par byed pa'ang yod la/ khong rnam gnyis kyi bar du dbon po hor tshas dpon thog tu lo gcig gnyis bzhugs zer ba'ang gleng / dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po bas khrims las kyi bya ba dpon chen dbang brtson la 'phrod pa'i skabs su lha rtse'i gzims khang lho mar bde bar gshegs so/ /pur bzhu dus thugs thugs thag dang bcas te byon pa de gzims khang gung ldebs ris la —298

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku 'dra bzhugs pa de'i thugs kar thim pa kun gyi mthun du grub pa/ phyi skor gyi dpon chen la 'di nyid bla ma la gus shing khrims gnyis kyi bya ba mkhas par byed do/ /dpon chen pa'i sras po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa snga sor sa skya nang chen bzung rting la dpon chen gyi ming thob shangs mthong smon bzung ba'i skabs der sku gshegs so/ /gcung po dpon po hor tsha'i sras sna dkar ba dpon kun dga' rgyal po brgyud chad/ blo gros rgyal mtshan pas gi tu'i ming dang las/thob/ dpon chen pas dbon po 'di dang mthong smon sbrags nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan la sprad/ gtsang phyogasakyi sdo pa dar lcog dkar po 'thugs pa'i sngon ma byas zer ba'ang 'dug /'di'i ring la mthong smon spel chen bzhedas/ sgo spe zur cog rnams kyi kha sgron 'obs lcags chung bzos so/ /de'i sras bzhi'i che ba du dban (25na sko byang chub rgyal ba dpal bzang po ba lhog thung du grags pa thugs rgod cing rtsom rkyen pas de'i ring la rdzong shangs dang phyi nang gi sde 'khrug mang / de 'og mkhan po kun dga' blo gros pas myug chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad/ de 'og tu dben sha kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas rgyal mthong bzung kun dang mthun pa'i lugs shes che bar byung / gas bo chung ba dbon po kun rdor ba'o/ /du dben sha kun rgyal bas gdung brgyud lcam blangs pa la sras gcig byung ba du dben sha rin cen rgyal po ba sku brtan par bzhugs pa'o/ /khri dpon dkon cog 'od zer bas byang ru thog gi khri dpon mdzad cing / dbon po dkon cog rin cen dang rgod po rin cen pas myug rgyal khang gi 'go byas dre sgal sogs 'dzin/ mkhan po bsod namasablo gros pas zhad po'i gdan sa sreg shing mkhan po mdzad pa'i skabs su mthong smon na dpon chen grags rgyal ba yod pa/ dpon skya g.yog ris kyi dbang du song nas shangs pa nang ma bde/ dpon po sku mched che ba gnyis sku gshegs rting dbon po rgod po rin cen pas stag tshang rdzong khar bla chen bsod blo sku mched pa'i zhabs la ga khugs/ rgyab bcol nas rdzong shangs bde gzar yun ring / dgung lo bco brgyad pa la bla chen pa'i phyag phyir las chen g.yas ru byang nas gong la byon/ bla ma'i sku drin la tho gan —2glu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)the mur rgyal pos phing gcig pa'i mi dpon/ hing swon jing dben gyi hu shī'i mtshan dang dam stag /ban rgan blo gros rin cen pa'i dus ji ltar gnang ba bzhin gyi bod 'brog dbang (25ba)ris rnams rgod po rin cen hu shrī mi brgyud dang bcas pa la 'jags su chug gsung ba'i lung bzang po dang bcas gnang / yar phebs bla ma sku mched pa'i zhabs tog sde pa stag tshang rdzong pa'i phyi'i dgra bzhi la dmag dpon gyi bya ba gang la'ang sde pa'i mtshan jus gtso bor bton nas/ dpon sa nas kyang thag rta nag gi gnyer kha gnang / sna dmar rdzong brtsigs/ shangs pa nang ltar gyi bde gzar 'pho 'phyugs mang na'ang phyi nang sus kyang rgol bar ma nus pas rgod pa'i snyan grags shin tu che zhing me pho stag lo la rdzong stag sna don grub rtse bzung ste de'i char gtogs pa'i mnga' zhabs bod 'brog mang du chod nas da lta'i bar la brtan zhing 'phel ba dang bcas pa yin no/ /de la yum mi gcig pa'i sras po gsum byung ba'i che ba rta nag pa dbon po shākya rin cen/ bar pa byang ngam ring pa rgyal ba rin cen/ chung ba skyor mo ba sog po rin cen rnams te/ shākya rin cen pas yab kyi gnyer las kyi rjes rta nag bzung / de la sras dug tsher rin cen dang / nam mkha' rin cen/dge sbyong dkar por grags pa rnams so/ /rgyal ba rin cen pa la sras rnam rgyal rin cen pa dang dpal ldan rin cen byung ba gnyis ka yab kyi sngon la 'das so/ /sog po rin cen pas lha bu khong lam rdzong gsar brtsigs/ sras rgyal po rin cen pa dang dge sbyong bsod nams rin cen pa/ grags pa rin cen pa rnams byung ngo / /khri dpon dkon cog 'od zer ba sku mched phyogs gcig pa'i dus kyi sras po gcig byung ba drung chen glang po rin cen pa/ de nyin yab (26na)grongs pa'i rjes la stag tshang rdzong khar zhabrungs/ dpon sa bla brang dang khu bo rgod po rin cen pa 'tsho skyong mgo 'don yang dag mdzad/ cher skyes nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal mthong / dbang rnam sras pa'i zhabs la gas gzims dpon mdzad/ khu dbon phyogs gcig tu dril nas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong dbon sa'i zhabs tog bur rta'i gsog dras 300

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)skyong dar 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang la'ang shin tu mkhas shing thugs rtsol che bas grags pa phyogs kun 99ba 21/khyad par dbus pa bdag po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas phag mo gru pa srid la gtogs pa'i dbusagatsang gi dmag dpung stobs che ba bsdus nas me pho khyi lo ston stag sna rdzong la skor rgyag yun ring byas/nang yan 'tshog skyel bred sdigs ji snyed cig byung nas yab sras dpon g.yog rnams kyis legs par sra bcas phur btsugs 'thab srol sprad pas dbus gtsang du mkhregs pa'i tshad thub pa byung rting stan shar gtsang srid du grags pa'i 'go de nas btsugs pas sa skya pa'i bstan jus yar 'phel du byung ba blon chen de nyid kyi thugs bzhed dang 'phrin las la brten pa'o/ /de'i sras lnga'i che ba drung chen nam mkha' rin cen pa ni sku gzhon nu nas klog yig sogs bslab shes kyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du phyogs nas mi dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan ba dang / mes po hu shrī chen po'i zhabs lag tu gas gso le ja bzung / pho rtsal sna dgu bkur skyong 'grogs la ma tshe srid 'dzin pa'i byab la yon tan sgor mor 'dzom pas kun gyis ma sangs sprul par 'dzin cing (26ba)khyad par khyi lo dmag chen gyi dus rdzong gi rtse zhol srung ba gang khag pa thams cad du phebs nas sgrogs mda' rdos nang sprad pas gshin rje ngo dmar du grags shing phyi nas gdong len mi su yang med pa byung ngo / /gzhan yang dmag che chung 'thab srol snga phyi mang po'i 'go la byon nas dus nam yang gdong 'bud ngo lang kho na mdzad cing phyis skor bya ba gang la'ang gtan brling gtso bor bton pas phyi nang kun gyis 'di ni dpa' mdzangs 'dzom pa'i skyes bu chen po yin zhes grags so/ /de'i la khud bo rgyal bzang rin cen/ rgya mtsho rin cen/ nor bu rin cen/ grub pa rin cen rnams yin la/ gcung 'dis rdzong rab 'byor rtse gzung tshar shon bod 'brog gsar du chod/ gcen gyi khab tu gdung brgyud lam mo byang sems nam mkha' rgyal mo ba byon sras che ba chos rgyal rin cen pa mched gsum ste sku mched khu dpon zhal ngo yang mang la rags ba sku brtan par bzhugs par lags pa/301

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)blon chen che brgyud ma sangs sprul pa'i rigs/ kha drag mi dpung 'dzom pa 'khor bcas 'di/ /phas rgol mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba dang / /dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas gyur cig /ces byung ba'i mes drung chen nam mkha' rin cen yan chad shangs pa yin na'ang / de nas la stod du gzhis bzung ba yin zhing / de yang chos rgyal rin cen dpal bzang zhes yi dam gyi lhas rjes su bzung zhing dpal mgon stag zhon bran du 'khol ba'i mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug de'i jo mor mkha' 'gro'i rigs can/ bon po dben rtsa kha pa'i sras mo bkra shis a mtsho zhes pa sngon gyi las 'phros chos (27na)la mos pa dkon cog la bla mar 'dzin cing dge 'dun la rnyed bkur dang ngan long la sbyin gtong brtson pa/ byams pa dang snying rjes rgyud dul ba/ khyad par stag tshang lo tsā bar shin tu dad cing / de nas brgyud pa'i chos nyamasasu len par gzhol ba de gnyis dam pa 'di dang lcam sring lnga tsam gyi yab yum yin zhing / tshes bcu'i dus chen zhig la sangs rgyas kun 'dus rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi 'phrin las gyer ba'i nub yum gyis dpal gtor phyogs la dbu sngas bstad de gzims pa na mnal lam du dpal gtor gyi pad 'dab gcig chad pa'i rnam pas sgo dbye ba lta bu byas/ de'i nang nas gu ru rin po che'i sku yid du 'ong ba 'od zer dang bcas pa zhig seng ge la bcibs te thal mar byung nas thugs gar thim pa dang / yang nub cig stag tshang lo tsā ba dpon slob nas nged tshor do nub gnas tshang dgos 'dug pas nang sor zhus pa'i sdod yul g.yor gsung ba ltar sta gon mdzad pa'i tshe bla ma de 'jam dbyangs dmar ser gyi rnam par gyur pa thugs kur thim pa'i snang ba byung /mnal sad tsa na lus shin sbyangs kyi bde ba lta bur yug cig lus pas 'khob ta ma zhig gis da bzhengs/ las thebs 'chag zer bas nyams de sad kyang de nyin gyi phyag las mtha' dag sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i bde ba de ma'i ngang du 'gro ba zhig byung / gnas pa de nam byung ba'i dus dngos su me tog gi char/ 'ja' dkar po/ sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri bzang po 'thul ba yong zhing / yang mnal lam du mi zhig gis g.yu ster ba/ gser gyi mchod (27ba lhan 'od zer 'phro ba khrus gsol zhing skor ba mdzad 302

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)pa sogs dam pa 'di lhums su 'jug pa'i ltas ngo mtshar ba mang du byung / 'khrungs lo ni 'o skol gyi ston pa drag po zhes pa lcags sprel la sku bltams nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya bcu bdun 'das pa 'phags pa'i yul du stod 'grel lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs te dus bhi zhes pa rnga chen du grags shing shar phyogs rgyal po'i khab tu zhin zu'i zhes chu pho khyi lor 'jig rten yongs grags dang bstun na 'thad cing gtsug lag dang bstun na khrag skyug ces pa chu mo phag gi lo'i dus kyang mdzod rang 'grel du / sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi dus kyi dang po ni dgun no/ /gnyis pa ni dpyid do/ /gsum pa ni dbyar ro/ /zhes 'dul mngon pa rnams dus kyi thog ma dgun du mdzad/ 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ sa ga'i nya la skya rengasashar ba'i tshe mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa nag pa'i nya la shrī dha ṣ+yoka ṭa ka ra/ zhes ston pa sa ga'i nya la sangs rgyas pa nas brtsis pa'i bcu gnyis pa nag pa'i zla bar dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa gsungs pa dang rigs ldan grags pas/ tshangs pa'i drang srong bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi rigs bzhi rigs gcig tu byas nas dbang bskur zhing rtsa rgyud las bsdus rgyud bsdus pa'i zla ba yin par brten lo 'gor mdzad cing / dhū ba ga'i 'das lo 'tshol ba'i tshe'ang nag pa nas thog mar byed pa'i lugs srol dar na'ang bod 'dir yongs grags kyi zla 'go ni rgya nag spor thang chen mo'i rjes su 'brang bas de la'ang lugs mi 'dra ba (28na sko sum byung ba'i zhabrul pa med pa ni/ rgyud gab pa gnad gzer las/ dgun nyi ldog pa'i tshes snga ma/ /lo ni snga ma'i mjug yin la/ /snga lo phyi lo'i 'pho mtshams kyi/ /pho brang lha tshogs thams cad dang / /sa bdag rje blon 'khor bcas rnams/ /dgun nyi ldog nas bskya bar byed/ ces smal po'i zla ba'am hor zla bcu gcig pa dpyid ra stag tu phug pa ba sogs tshad thub kyi mkhas pa mang po ba ched pa/ 'phags skyes po'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab tu/ de nas yid srubs longs spyod grogs/ /sbrang rtsi 'thung ba rnams kyi gnyen/ /skal bzang 'khri shing 'byud byed pa/ /legs ldan dpyid ni mthong bar gyur/ /cesadapyid zla 'bring po nya ro hi ta'i khyim rgyal gyi zla ba'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes bas res—303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)gza' nyi ma/ zla skar smin drug gi res la babs pa'i tshe rmu gshong dge ba'i tshal zhes sum rtsen gyi gzhal yas khang la co 'dri ba der/ gtsug na nor bu'i rtogs pa brjod pa'i yal 'dab tu/ de nas dus ni yongs rdzogs te/ /mkha' la bdud rtsi'i 'od zer bzhin/ /'gro ba'i rab rib kun 'joms bu/ /lha mo la ni btsas par gyur/ /ces yum la snyun sogs gang yang mi mnga' bar ston gyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba bzhin sku bltams pas gsung mgur las/ ser gzugs bdag gi skyes pa'i yul/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi gtsang stod cha/ /chu bo pa klu'i lho yi ngos/ khu1ma stod sa skya'i bya 'dabs (28ba〉sdongs/ /'brog mi lo tswa'i gnas kyi mda'/ /'phrang gsum nang nas srin 'phrang gdong / /rmu rje btsad pos bzung ba'i sa/ /der ni sngon gyi las dbang gis/ /dal 'byor rin cen rnyed pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kha ba'i rdul brtsegs shel dkar rdo leb bkram/ /mar gad gos klubs 'dzin mar ljon pa'i tshal/ /yid 'ong chu skyes lo tog bkra ba'i 'gram/ /gnam sngon zhun ma'i nyal 'gro dal gyis 'bab/ /phul byung ngo mtshar bkod pa'i khang bzang gis/ /'chi med ba gam mdzes pa la 'khru ba'i/ kho ra khor yug khyab pa grong khyer gyi/ /grags pas rgyu skar tshogs rnams blta ba bzhin/ /'jam dpal rdo rje 'phags pa'i zhabs pad rdul/ /dmar 'od gtsug tu lhungs pa'i yus po che/ /bstan srid bla nas blar 'degs ri mo'i rjes/ /mig gsum 'phrul can des kyang ga la khebs/ /ka ba med pa'i gnam gyi sgo mo nas/ /tshangs pa mi gzugs hor gyi rgyal po'i lung / /btsan pos spyi bo gyen du bstan no cog /kun gyis btud bya'i dpon chen las gas mtho/ /gtsang byed pad+ma'i sbubs nas thon pa'i co/ /'dri ba'i rdzun min bden gtam skya rengs mas/ /mngal skyes nyer drangs tshe dbang rigs 'dzin ni/ shar ba'i 'od stong 'bar la su yis bston/ zhes rab ral gri sa rgyu wā ra'i mdangs/ /ma rig dra ba 'joms pa rnon po'i mtshon/ /chos phung rin cen 'byung gnas gcig pu pa/ /sgrub pa'i dge mtshan mngon sum lta bur gsal/ khungs btsun rigs kyi lang tsho dar ba'i rje/ /bzhin mdzes dga' mar 'khrud pa'i (29na)—304

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnamathar/ 6)rtsed 'jo las/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i khye'u nga las nu/ /thub bstan mang bkur gtsug rta re rtse mor btsas//de yang btsas ma thag nas mtshan bzang gis spras pa lta bu'i mthong na mi mthun pa med pa'i mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba tha mal gyi byis pa dang mi 'dra bar lta bas mi bzod pa'i zil che ba zhig byung zhing btsas ston dang mtshan ston rgya cher mdzad/ yab kyis mgon po stag zhen sogs la gtang rag phul ba'i dus nam mkha' nas rnga bo che 'dra ba'i skad chen po dang de nas gcig rjes gcig non lta bu'i dung dkar dril bu rkang gling rnams kyi sgra kun gyis thos/ sang nyi shar la yab kyi gur zhal stag zhen sogs kyi mnga' gsol mdzad pa'i bsangs kyi dud sprin gzims khang gi shar don yod zhags pa sogs rang byung du yod pa'i brag ri'i rtse nas nub kyi brag ri'i rtse mo g.ya' dang spang gis mtshan pa'i rtse'i bar sbrul 'khyil ba 'dra ba'i 'ja' tshon sna lnga 'khrigs shing me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs ya mtshan du gyur/ sku'i skyed kyang gzhan las che zhing dul ba yid gzhung ba blo gros dang ldan pa sogs gang zag khyad par ba'i bag chags kyi mthu brtas pa zhig go/gsol 'debs las/ gzhon nu nyid nas nyams kyi snang ba la/ /phyogs kun ngo mtshar rgyal sku'i snang brnyan gyis/ /phyur bur gtams shing las kyi dri ma'i cha/ /dag pa'i snang ba gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'bri klog tshul rnams ma bslabs thugs su chud/ /srung ma'i rnam sprul dpa 'bo dmar gsal dang / /dzo zhi'i tshulugazigs(29ba 'dod khams dbang po yis/ /'phrin las ma lus sgrub la gsol ba 'debs/ /rin cen seng ge'i khri la 'khor ba yi/ /yongs 'dzin skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po de'i/ /lhag pa'i lha yi sgrub thabs zhal lung gis/ shes rab snang ba rgyas la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes dgung lo gsum tsam gyi dus rol tu phebs pa na sa gzhi thams cad bdag cag gi ston pa'i sku gser sbyangs zhun ma la nyi 'od phog pa lta bus gang ba gzigs pas zhabs gom 'degs 'jog mi nus pa'i snang ba dang / yang skabs shig mi lus dud 'gro'i mgo brnyan can 'jigs su rung ba mang pos mi gson po btso sreg byed pa gzigs pa'i mod la rang nyid la 'phos ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung ba las —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyesgrib kyi cha shas cung zad tsam lus pa gnas sbyong gi nyams kyi sgo nas sbyangs pa'i gsung rgyun snang ba lam 'bras pa'i lugs la gnas sbyong gi nyams 'di 'dra shar na phyin chad gnas ngan de len mi dgos par 'chad pas rtags bzang po yin mod 'on te rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi sprul pa la de 'drar bltos pa min yang thun mong ba'i ngor de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal pa sor bcu drug pa zug pa sogs las bcu spyad pa'i skabs dang rjes su mthun par mngon/yab kyi phyag dpe rdo rje gcod pa de gzigs na sngon chad 'bri klog tsam mdzad ma myong yang 'di 'dra zhig zer rgyu yin pa 'dug dgongs te thogs med du klog pa dang 'bri ba'ang slob dpon bsten pa'i rtsol ba la ma bltos par shugs5grang gis mkhyen pas/ bka' las/ klog mi dran gong nas(30na)shes kyin 'dug /yi ge 'di rdo la thod le kor gyis bris shing / de rjes nyi ma gcig gnyis bris pasashes byung gsung ba kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs kyi rnam thar du gsal ba'i bag chags kyi klong rdol bar sems/ de'i tshe phyi rol tu byis pa 'ga' dang lhan cig tu byon pa na 'byung po ma rungs pas brlams pa'i khyi zhig gis phyag shubs la 'changs pas gzhan rnams bros rje nyid thugs tshad pa'i rkyen gyis he ru ga:zhal brgyad pa'i rnam par rang byung gis shar nas sdigs mdzub mdzad pas pha tshad du bros/ der rjes byis pa gzhan rnams kyis rol mo dkrol tshul dang rje nyid kyis 'jim pa la bzos pa'i gtor ma zhig sku rtsed kyi tshul du 'phangs pas khyi de'i kha nas khrag skyugs nas shi /dgung lo lnga drug tsam gyi tshe nub cig yab kyi stag zhon gyi thun gtor bsngos pa skyel du byon pa na mi nag po 'jigs su rung bas gtor ma de dngos su blangs song de la 'jigs nas cung zad bros te phyi log mdzad gzigs pas de'i 'khris na'ang 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'dug pa nges mai tri pas nga khyod la dngos su gtad khyod kyis tshul bzhin bsten ngas kyang mchog thun gyi dngos grub sbyin pa yin pas gtor ma re ma chag par bslang zer/mar byon nas yab la zhus pas nged rang gi chos skyong yin gsung yang sngon ma de stag zhen dang phyi ma de ye shes mgon po phyag drug par nges shing des rkyen byas nas mkhas grub khyung por 'khrungs pa thugs —3(36

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)dran gsos snang / skabs 'gar mi dmar po gzi brjid shin tu che ba dang ā tsarla'i rnam pa can gyisadaga' ba'i rnam (30ba〉gyur ston zhing thugs 'khrid pa'i tshul dang gtor bsngos mdzad pa'i gtor ma dngos su len pa byung ba mi dmar po de gnod sbyin beg tse dang / dzo ki gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa yin tshod du snang /'dod khams dbang phyug mas rtags mtshan khyad par can bstan pa sa lugs la lcam dral sbrags sgrub kyi rjes gnang tsam las med na'ang rje nyid kyis gzhung du gsan nas bla ma'i sku dgra bsgral ba sogs kyi lo rgyus bzhin 'di dus nas chos skyong gi las 'brel gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod par mchos shing der ma zad chos skyong che chung thams cad kyi bka' babs pas rol mo 'ur chem tsam la srung ma bran 'khol du mi rlom par snyan brgyud bzhi'i rten 'brel gyis tshar lugs zhes grub mtha' 'bur dod 'di nyid 'byung ba'i sngon 'gror gor ma chag /chos 'khor sgang pa lo chen shes rab rin cen yin zer ba'i paṇ+ḍita zhwa mo bad 'dab can gsol ba zhig rin po che'i khri seng ge gnyis bsnol bas bteg pa'i steng du bzhugs nas gzhon nu zhes bos te khyod dang sngon nas las 'brel yod pa'i lha mnyu shrī dkar po 'di yin bas/ de'i sgos rgyud dang sgrub thabs yin zer ba'i lung mdzad/ mtshan brjod bklags rjes sgos rgyud min gsung ba'i mod thugs la thim pa'i snang ba shar/ de nas bzung phyag dpe 'dzin bshar sogs gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i thugs rab shin tu yangs par gyur pasaphyis bka' las/ de dus gnang ba'i sgrub thabs de ma tis mdzad pa 'di 'dra mo 'dug khyud de ma go ste lo stob de nyid kyang skye bsnga ma'i bla ma zhig yin par 'dug /(31na〉sgo chen kho rang yin tshod dug da'/zhes gsungs pa sku skye sngon ma dge slong dbang mos stag tshang lo chen gyi zhabs la thug cing / kun spangs chen po'i dngos kyi bshes gnyen yin pas snga ma'i snga mar song ba dang lo chen nas brgyud pa'i ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar rje snga mar bka' babs pa 'di g.yin las khyad zhugs shing chos rgyun gzhan ma kha shas yod par ma zad legs bshad kyi bstan bcos mang por thugs gcigs che ba dang /—307

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'astag tshang pa'i bstan srung spyi bshags bskang ba'i skabs mdzad pa sogs sgo du ma nas 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu de'i 'phrin las spel ba'i sngon 'gro'i sgor snang /de dag gi dus dpal rta mgrin zhabs brgyad pa sogs yi dam gyi lha du ma'i rnam par shar zhing bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor zab mo las byung ba'i phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa/ sdom gsum du/ nged kyi phyag rgya chen po ni/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang / /rim pa gnyis kyi khyad par las/ /byung ba'i rang byung ye shes yin/ /zhes pa la dbang 'byor bas/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses/ gzhen nu nyid nas rang lus lha skur gzigs/ /dam can srung mas dngos su gtor ma blangs/ /klog dang yi ge ma bslabs mkhas par mkhyen/ /byis pa'i spyod las 'das la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhe gso/ /gsol 'debs las/ chos lung 'dzim gyi gtsug lag khang chen du/ /yongs 'dzin zhabs bsten dge bsnyen brtul zhugs nos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho las/ /dge tshul sdom pa bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes 'dul (31ba tha la bstod pa las/ rgyal ba ston pa de yi bstan pa dag /mdo dang chos mngon yin gsung 'dul ba ni/ /bstan dang ston pa dngos yin de yi phyir/ /nyis 'gyur phyag bya 'dul la phyag byos shig /ces mdo mngon gnyis kyis bstan pa'i go chod kyang ston pa'i go mi chod/'dul bas gnyis ga'i go chod pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa ye bzang rtse pas/ de ltar bod yul 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa la 'phel 'grib cher byung mod kyi theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi bstan pa ni deng sang gi bar du nub ma myong zhes dar mas bstan pa bsnubs par grags pa'ang 'dul ba la dgongs shing / gang du cho ga ma nyams pa dang de la brten nas sdom pa len pa/ gzhi gsum gyi bya ba sogs yod pa der bstan pa yod par gsungs pas/ rje 'di nyid thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i sgor la jug par ba ched de/ na tshod ldan zhes pa shing mo phag gi lo rgyal po lo gsar pa'i dgung lo bcu bzhir phebs pa'i dus 'dzim chos lung gi gtsug lag khang du yongs 'dzin dam pa blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du tshangs par spyod pa dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gsan/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi bslab bya mtha' dag —308

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)legs par bslabs te bag yod pa'i gnas kho na lhur blangs/de nas dbang phyug ces pa me mo glang gi lor bka' gdams glegs bam gyi ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ chos dge ba bcu yis khyad 'phags pa/ /gling phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling / /sgosanyang shab sa yi lte ba ste/ /sa de yi nang nas khyad 'phags pa/ /mtho bkra shis (32na tshe gtams pa lhun po'i 'dabs/ /nor pad+ma rā ga lta bur 'dun/ /zhes dpal snar thang las chad pa'i chos gra chen po bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sdo' por phebs jo bo a ti sha'i rnam thar du/ mnal lam la bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas gdugs tshod gsol ba'i gral gsham na jo bo nyid bzhugs par de bzhin gshegs pas mi ma gi ci la chags nas rab tu mi 'byung zhes bskul ma mdzad pa jo bo lta bu rab tu byung ma byung la ma bltos kyang phyi 'ar bas kya gdul bya la dgongs pa bzhin rje 'di nyid kyang thun mong ba'i 'gro ba dang mthun 'jug pa'i phyir du rab tu 'byung bar bzhed nas/ 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam par sprul pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal gyis mkhan po/chos rje blo gros rgya mtshos las slob mdzad de tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes brje ba rnam pa gsum gyi skabs mtshan blo gsal rgya mtshor gsol/ de'i tshe me tog gi char sogs ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / lhung smad phyed dang bcu bzhi ma gtogs pa dge slong dang cha 'dra ba'i bslab bya'i gnas mtha' dag la legs par bslabs te dpal ldan shākya'i sras po ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan bsgreng bar mdzad/ chos rje blo gros pa slob dpon du bsten nas mdo phyogs la gsan bsam gyi rigs tshong gi skabs 'bad rtsol chen po la ma bltos par mkhyen pa na gzhan dag gis chos rje tshar pa bslab gnyer mi byed 'dug ces gleng bslang ba'i tshe/ de dag gi log rtog bsal slad du dge 'dun gyi tshogasachen po'i dbus rgol ba rnams(32ba)lung dang rigs pas tshar gcad/ kho bo blo gsal rgya mtsho nyal nas bsdad de 'di shes da shog /ces bka' stsal pa na gangs ri'i rtse mor seng ge 'jigs pa med pa'i nga ro'i skad bsangs bsgrags tshe gcan gzan dang ri dwags rnams kyi snying 'gas pa ltar rtog ge pa —309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losergan po mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams kyi ham thul yul bud nas gdong pa smad de zhus pa'i gnas la bkod/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa'i dus kyi skabs shig thon gyi lha ri phyug sgom bya bar dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi gdan sa brgyad pa mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug thon pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i drung du byon pa na sku 'brum gyis bsnyung ba ma dgongs par chu grang mang du bzhes shing khrus mdzad zhal zon yang ma mdzad pas je thur gyur pa'i tshe glang phu ba'i nang so sman pas 'brum pa yin tshul zhus pa kho dang rgyun gyi phyag g.yog pa tshos 'brum pa ma thar bas sku 'khris su yod ma bcug par sman pa gzhan zhig dang thon pas bskos pa'i phyags phyi ba gnyis kyis snyung g.yog byas/grang khang zhig tu bzhugs pa'i dus spyan 'byed 'dzum mi shes shing gsung yang 'byon mi thub pa'i shin tu dub pa na chu grang mo gsol ba'i snang ba re byung dus dngos su skyems pa'i gdung ba thams cad sangs 'gro ba dang / dgongs shig lha rjes phyag rtsa bltas sgo rgyab tu song nas tsod cod mang po byed kyin 'dug pas da rang dga' mo mi yong ba 'dug 'pho ba zhig mdzad dgongs sku chung ngu'i dus lha khab grub chen ma bya ba la zhus pa'i mkha' spyod ljang gu'i 'pho dmigs de mdzad pa na/ thugs gar lag pa grang mo zhig bkab nas da lam (33na྾pho ba byed mi dgos zer bshol mkhan byung ba'i thugs snang shar/ re zhig na 'tsho byed kyis rtsa bltas te da skyon mi gda' zer/ rim gyis sku khams bde nas spyan zum pa'ang bye/ phebs 'grul thub nas der ma bzhugs par ri sul dben par byon zhing thugs dam mdzad pas myur du dwangs/ rje mkhas btsun pa'i drung du 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang dang jo bo lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang rta mgrin lcags ral can sogs chos skor mang du gsan/ khyad par las gshin gyi rjes gnang gsan dus dngos su bya rog cig sku gzhogs rang du babs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung / chos gsan tho phyag bris ma zhig 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis gzigs par mang po 'dug gsung ngo / /klog yig 'ching rgya dam po brgya phrag mdud/ /rnam dpyod sor rtser zhar la 'grol ba'i blo/ /mtho —310

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)ris blo ldan phur bu'i rigs kyi brgyud//gnyis pa kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bzung ngam snyam//lha min gdon gyis nyer btab brlang spyod khyi/khrag 'thung rnam par rol pas zil mnan tshe//cha phra'i zla ba tshes kyang smag gi rum//sel ba'i dngos po'i gshis la gang gis bston//dag pa'i bkod pa rin cen rtsig ngos la//bgrang yas bde gshegs snang brnyan laṅka'i gzugs//ma 'dres so sor 'byed pa dga' byed lha//bstan srung sī tar gol med rtsed gar rol//ring nas las 'phro'i 'o mtsho 'gyis ba'i dbus//ma smad mkhyen pa'i 'dab stong bshad pa'i rtser//33bar la pa'i zur phud dor ba'i 'jam dkar lha//sngon med mtshams sprin gsar pa'i phang bar 'gying //skyon mang khung bur thar srog gcod pa'i lce//rkyong la yid byung sgo nga'i sbubs rgya nas//tshas spyo sgrog shog rgyas pa'i khyung wo bya//gto mdun mkha' la 'phur bar gcig tu brel//mar gad mnyen lcugs 'khri shing mdza' na mo'i//bde stong 'khor lor 'jug las nyer ldog pa//gsang chen bstan srog gso ba'i rtsi sman gyi//rig byed dran pa'i tshangasapa gsar pa bzhin//gsol 'debs las/yang yang skye bar rjes su bzung ba'i rje/khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rings pas//sa 'dzin dbang po mchog gi pho brang du//byin sa sa lung bstan mdzad la gsol ba 'debs//de nas kha'u khrag rdzong rdo rje'i spor//'dren pa mchog de'i zhabs rdul gusabasten nas//gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol lam//mtha' dag gsan par mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/khyad par mkhas grub dbang po sa skya pa'i//gsung gi gsang ba slob bshad zab mo'i bcud//ma tshang med pa chog brgyud tshul du gdams//gsang chen bstan pa'i bdag por gsol ba 'debs//zhing skyong dbang po'i rjes gnang gnang ba'i tshe//mkha' dbyings dung r+sā gling bu'i sgra dbyangs dang //lhan cig tshig gi rang sgras shis pa brjod//bsnyen sgrub mtshan ma gzigs la gsol ba 'debs//zhes 'og gdon gyi rnam pas zhabs la dreg gi snyun byung bar sel thabs thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshor zhus pa na deng sang chos rje kun spangs pa 34na sgos stobs nus pa'i snyan gragasache bar 'dug bas khyed rang der byon na phan thogs 'ong gsungs pa sku tshe sngon ma nas 'brel ba che ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pedang snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa nyin mo bzhin gsal bar 'gyur ba mngon par mkhyen pas gzigs te lung bstan par gor ma chag pas/ rigs kyi bdag po kun spangs rje dang thog mar mjal ba'i 'phral rkyen gyi mtshams sbyor zhabs bsnyun pas byas te/ de skabs gtsang stod seng ge rtser slob dpon bram ze mchog sred kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rje btsun kun spangs chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po phebs pa'i drung du yab dang lhan cig par byon te zhal mjal ba tsam gyis 'phrog tu med pa'i thugs dad bla na med pa 'khrungs/zhabs bsnyun pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus pas dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje u tsarla'i rjes gnang stsal/ rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la bar chad sel ba'i bka' bsgo 'phrin bcol la brten nub cig mnal lam du sku smad la sbra tshal g.yogs 'dug pa'i ngang la g.yag khyu chen po byung bar ya nga ba'i snang ba shar ba'i tshe de khrod nas g.yag chen po zhig gis nged tsho khyed la gnod pa skyel du 'ongs pa min zer nas rwa rtses sbra tshal blangs nas phyir bsal song ba dang / yang skabs shig bud med cig gis sa la ri mo 'ga' zhig bris pa'i grangs brtsis nas lo 'di'i bar zhabs kyi snyun ro cung zad langs yong de nas gzhi med du 'gro zer ba kho na ltar byung / g.yag rnams dregs pa pho brgyud dang bud med de mo brgyud kyi rnam 'phrul te bstan (34ba)srung rnams kyis 'phrin las bsgrub par snang / slar bkra shis lhun por skor tsam phebs nas mdo phyogs kyi thugs gnyer 'phro 'thud/ tshad ma'i bshad pa dang zhal blangs kyi skabs rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras 'di ltar bzhed ces grub mtha' zur khyad yang yang gsungs pas der tshogs rnams kyis chos rje tshar pa 'di rang re'i chos gra 'grims pa tsam ma gtogs don la sa skya pa yin 'dug ces ma rangs pa byas skad/snga dro zhig bkra shis lhun po'i khron pa chen po'i thad der phebs pas bud med lang tshor dar la babs pa sma ra dang smin ma se khyug ge ba byas pas khyed la rje rdo ring pa'i gsung las kha'ur myur du byon gsung gi gda'/ de'i lag rtags 'di yin zhes glegs bam chung ngu zhig gtad nas gar song cha —312

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)med du yal song ba dpe de mkha' spyod skor gsum gyi be'u bum yin 'dug /mi 'gyangs par rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa rnams nyan pa legs pas 'dir byon zhes kha'u skyes lhas nas rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i phyag tham byung ba na rje btsun mi la rje mar pa'i drung du byon pa lta bu'i dga' spro bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas grum stod kha'u brag rdzong du sang phebs rgyu'i do nub nam phyed tsam la mgon khang gi sgo brdungs nas sang chos skyong sogs man ngag rnams kyi snod tshar pa yong ba yod zer ba gsan pas sang nang par rdo ring rin po ches mdang 'di bawo byung bas de ring khong 'byor ba 'dra gsungs/sku 'khor ba zhig gis byung tshul snyan du gsol bas khong yul gnyan pas stan legs pa zhig thing gsungs 'phral du (35na〉spyo zhabs su btang ba'i tshe ras yug dkar po sne tshang ba'i mjal dar phul/ chos rje'i drung phebs lam la 'o mi brgyal zhing bde bar byon pa bka' drin che gsungs/ sngon nas zhal mjal zhing thugs mos che ba'i steng bshes springs las/ rdo thal gyis byugs dgung zla'i 'od kyis ni/ /chos dkar nyid du ci ste mi bgyid lags/ /zhes sngar bas kyang ches cher lhag pa'i thugasamos 'khrungs bkra shis lhun po'i khron pa kha'i gnas tshul zhus nas dpe de gzigs phul bas ba 'ad mo mdzad pa dang sbrags nga'i mkha' spyod mas gdan 'dren la phyin gda' ba glegs bam 'di'ang de'i chos skor yin/ da re zhig dpe khrod du skyol mdzod gsungs pa bzhin phyag dpe'i khrod du skyel bar phebs pas dpe rags brtsigs pa'i gseb nas dpe de bton shul har re 'dug pa der bcug pas khrig 'grig song bas dad pa dang ngo mtshar dpe gang gis kyang mtshon du med pa thob ba'i gsung sgros gnang ba lam yig tu lar 'di skor gyi gtam mang po zhig yod kyang gsung ba'i don du mngon/ phyi ltar du zhing skyong dbang po mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i dben gnas kha'u brag rdzong gi rnal 'byor spyod pa'i 'dus sde rnams mdzes pa'i rgyan/ nang ltar du lha sngags ye shes kyi nus pas rdo rje'i chos skyong mtha' dag bran du 'khol ba'i mas stobs kyi gad brgyangs srid rtse'i bar du sgrog pa'i dpa' bo/ gsang ba —313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6geltar na bde stong zung du 'jug pa'i sgyu ma'i gar gyis dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro ba dang bsdu ba'i byed po khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dngos dpal ldan bla (35ba〉pa dam pa 'di'i zhabs pad yun du bsnyen pa'i ched du don med kyi g.yeng ba'i 'du 'dzi thams cad rgyang du bsrings/bgrang bya du mar bag phab ste bzhugs nas dam pa'i chos kyi bka' drin nod pa ni/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu 'brog mis 'phags pa'i yul du paṇa grub shi len+d+ra ru tsi'am slob dpon mi thub zla bar grags pa la rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bras shig gsan zhing yongs su grags pa mu gu lung du paṇa chen gha ya dha ra la rdzogs par zhus te rim gyis 'phel bar bka' srol mi 'dra ba bco brgyad tsam byung zer yang / gtso bor gyur pa rje btsun sa skya pa chen por bka' babs pa yin la/ de la'ang tshogs bshad ngor rdzong gong dkar ba gsum la dar rgyas che na'ang rjes 'brang gi mkhas grub phal cher gyi mig dang rnam pa'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis yab 'jam dbyangs chen po dang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos 'khor lo stom pa dkon cog rgyal mtshan kho nar stsal ba chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi tshul du thugs kyi bum pa gtams pa las nye bar 'ongs pa snyan brgyud slob bshad kyi nyams 'khrid zab mo lan grangs gsum gyi bar du smin rgyas su gsan pa'i cha lag dpal kye rdo rje'i rgyu dus kyi dbang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dbang / de'i sis ra'i byin rlabs lam dus kyi dbang / lam sbas bshad byin rlabs 'khrid dang bcas pa/ gsang ba'i lam zab 'khrid dang bcas pa/ nang gi lam zab lus dkyil la rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i (36na)byin rlabs/ bla ma rin 'byung dang tshar gsum khug pa'i byin rlabs/brda tshig brgyud/ gsang bcu'i rgyas btab/ sgrub pa lung sbyin sogs lam 'bras la brten pa'i dbang byin rlabs nya shu/ de dag gi rgyab chos su gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ gsung ngag gi glegs bam gnyis/ gzhan yang dbang gi chu bo chen po sogs rje btsun gong ma'i gsung mang po dang rje rdo rje 'chang chen po yab sras gnyis dang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen pos mdzad pa'i ye ge sogs rje nyid la 314

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)gang bzhugs pa thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan pa yang / deng sang khyi dang slo ba lta bur thug phrad byed pa'i lugs dang ye mi 'dra bar bla ma la yun ring po nas gsol ba btab/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par byed pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba snyan brgyud dang po'i rten 'brel/ so so'i thad du nges par dgos pa'i dbang byin rlabs lung rnams tshang bar gnang ba snyan brgyud gnyis pa'i rten 'brel/ snang gsum nas bzung dbang bzhi pa'i bar gyi 'khrid rnams bla mas kyang dmar 'khrid du bstan slob mas kyang rgyud la myong thon ma byung gi bar bsgoms pa snyan brgyud gsum pa'i rten 'brel/ de la brten nas snyan brgyud bzhi pa'i rten 'brel bla ma la rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi mos gus skyes shing sgro 'dogs thams cad cig car du chod/ nyams dang rtogs pa'i mtsho rdol rten 'brel thams cad rang 'grig tu gyur pas mos gus gzhen nu'i bde ba lta bus thugs rgyud tshim pasatshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhi'i bdag (36ba)por gyur to/ /deng sang tsho gis bshad pa rnams bar do sogs kyi 'khrid glegs bam dngos bstan la med ces blor mi shong yang 'jam mgon sa paṇa gyis/ 'on kyang rten 'brel zab mo'i gnad/ /da dung kun gyis rtogs par dka'/ /glegs bam tsam la brten pa yi/ /lam 'bras pas kyang 'di mi shes/ /zhesaglegs bam la ma brten pa'i snyan brgyud yod pa ma go ba'i skyon yin la/ gal te tshe 'dir ma grol zhing 'da' kha ma yang gnad du ma song ba'i rigs la bar dor 'o brgyal nges par 'byung bas/ dbang po rab la'ang bstos sa bstos 'jog gi rab 'bring tha gsum 'byung bas rtsi lugs shes dgos shing 'khor 'das dbyer med la bshad lung yam me ba las ma byung bas sa skya pa'i dge bshes chen por rlom te sems ngo sprod par phyag chen yam zhig zhu zer nas rtogs ldan blun po skyabs 'gro'i gnad tsam yang mi shes ba zhig la thal mo sbyar nas bsten pas zhabs la thag pa 'dogs pa mang zhing /dbang bzhi'i dmigs rim yang 'khor 'das dbyer med dang gdan gsum tshang ba'i gnad don ngo ma 'phrod pas chag med rnams bshar sbyang tsam gyi kha ton lci ba dang / bshad pa rgya chen po las nyams—313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelen gyi snying po med par go nas da gzod nyams len byed rgyu gzhan nas 'tshol ba skad byed pa'i rang mtshang mang po nyi ma dang sbar mo'i dpe bzhin kun gyis mthong ba ltar yin la/ slob bshad 'di nyid tshul ldan zhig thob na dbang po 'bring yan chad la tshe gcig la 'tshang rgya bar nus pa'i chos gsungs pa de 'di yin pa 'dug /(37na〉sa shad pa dang nyams len gang byed kyang 'di las lhag pa med snyam pa nges par skye zhing rnam dpyod dang bsod nams rab tu gyur pa rnams la gdams pa thos tsam nas bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos gus skye/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du ye shes kyi gzi 'od rab tu 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pas slob mas nyams su blangs tsam nyid nas mtshan rtog gi dri ma bral ba'i phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes myur du 'char la/ dam chos kun gdul bya'i blo khrid las/ phyogs 'dzin gyi grub mtha' skyong ma myong / /zhes gdul bya mos pa sna tsho gos pa rjes su 'dzin pa la chos mang du nyan pa las rang nyid nyams su len rgyu 'di rang gis chog snyam chos dang bla ma gzhan la 'gram chu mi ldang ba zhig yong bas/ lam glur/ rdo rje ring pa dang mjal nas bla ma dang chos gzhan la brten nas sangs rgyas sgrub bsam pa med gsung ba'ang don 'di la dgongs par snang /lam 'bras tshogs bshad tshar gnyis/ lam 'bras dang 'bral ba'i byin rlabs mang ba/ g.yin yang lam skor phyi ma brgyad/ bsam mi khyab dang mchod rten drung thob kyi byin rlabs/ gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang nas mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhan la 'byung ba/ mkha' spyod skor gsum gyi byin rlabs/rje btsun yab dang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams 'khrid yar klungs pa nas brgyud pa/ chos skor gyi lung / thun mong bsgrubs pas mchoge zhan la yang ba rigs byed ma/ bgegs kyi rgyal po/ 'dod (37ba)rgyal ste dmar chen skor gsum gyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs rjes gnang lung man ngag /snying gi gser thag /ti nu/ nor rgyun ma ste dmar chung skor gsum/ dzam dmar srog sgrub/ 'jam nag /seng ge sgra/ 'chi med rdo rje'i lha mo/ seng gdong ma/ tshe dpag med dkar po yum bcas sogs gser chos skor/ bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sde dpon rdo rje nag po chen po la bka' babs—316

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)bzhir bzhugs pa'i skor nas gsang 'khrid dang bran bdud kyi rjes gnang thun mong min pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbang rnams ma gtogs lha brgyad dang bcu gnyis ma thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pasathog drangs/lcam dral las mkhan phyi nang bran bdud dang cas pa'i rjes gnang /phyi rten dang mchod gtor la brten nas sgrub ba/nang rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga la brten nas sgrub pa/gsang ba yang gsang sems nyid la brten nas sgrub pa'i snying por gyur pa nang 'khrid yar klungs pa dang /gsang 'khrid gnyis/rdo rje brag rdzong ma phyi nang gsang gsum gyi 'khrid/rgyab rten gyi yi ge mgon pod me 'bar ma/der ma 'dus pa'i rga arnyan dam pa yar klungs pa bar sdings pa gsum gyi yi ge sogs shin tu zab pa'i yig sna dang /yi ger ma 'khod pa zhal nas zhal snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa mtha' klas pa dang thun mong ba ngor pa'i pod ser dang bdag — kun dga' dbang phyug nas brgyud pa k+ṣe bar gsan pas/dkar chag gnad sgron las/des na 'khon ston rdo rje 'chang //gang de'i thugs srasakun spangs rje/kho bos gtsug gi ni / rgyan du bsten/sgyu gsung bga' rnams la da pas bsgrubs//skyabs gzhan spangs nas gcig tu dril//de yi mas las thugs rje'i rgyun//bka' drin bdud rtsisasnying myos kho'i/ shes pa kho bor gda'//zhes gsungs/gsang 'khrid kyi rjes gnang dang gsang 'khrid dngos gzhi/las bzhi'i mgon po'i rjes gnang sogs kha shas ma gtogs dpal mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po gdong bzhi pa'i rjes gnang spu gri so rdeb dang tshe sgrub srung 'khor gyi 'khrid las tsho gos yig chud shog dril/der ma 'khod pa snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa sogs tshang bar gsan/zhal gyi rjes gnang skabs rje ṣ+ka kyi sku'i mdangs na bza'i kha dog sogs mthing khar gzigasashing khyad par ye shes dbab pa'i bar la bar snang nas mi rkang gi sgra shin tu gsal ba dang phun sum tsho gis pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra zhes sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dbyangs dang bcas nasasgrog ba gsal bar gsan/khyad par mgon bo ga/nga bas ༅ gyi rjes gnang gsan pa'i tshe phyag

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyemadzad pa nas bzung 'jigs pas sku lus kyi tsho mi thub pa lta bu dang ye shes dbab dus mgon khang rdib pa 'dra ba dang kha'u'i ri thams cad nyil ba bzhin gyi tshag sgra 'ur sgras khyab pas re zhig thugs dran med du song / thugs dran rnyed tshe gnas lugs don gyi mgon po rang rgyud la shar ba'i bde ba chen po byin rlabs kyi chu bo ma nub pa yin gsung byung ba na bla ma'i zhal la gzigs par mi bzod pa 'jigs su rung ba (38bton ga tu shar zhing snyun ro sogs bgegs kyi rnam pa 'dra ba'ang sangs man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal gyi las sbyor mdzad pas zhag 'ga' nas bsgral bya de bu tras dngos su khrid/las 'di bzhin bsgrubs yod pas gtang rag tu bskang gso zhig 'phral rtsom gyi bskul ma byung ba ltar bskang gso khyad can de thugs rtsom mdzad/gzhan yang dur khrod bdag po/ dkar bdud sogs sa skya pa'i zab chos su grags pa'i dbang lung du ma/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang byin rlabs spros med kyi 'khrid/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs/ nag po mtsho skyes ḍo ma bhi ste kye rdor lugs gsum sogs bla med kyi dbang mang ba/ gsar chos rnam pa lngar grags pa rtsa ba ba gu chas drug /stong po phyag rgya chen po/ yal ga lam 'khyer rnam gsum/ me rtag mkha' spyod dkar dmar/ 'bras bu 'chi med rang grol rnams dang / de dag dang 'brel bar ba gu'i dbang byin rlabs nyer lnga sogs dang / rgyab chos su yig skor gyi lung tshang la ma nor bar gsan/ su kha sirnyi'i dbang dang de dag dang 'brel ba'i yig sna/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa rgya gzhung dang bcas pa sogs mdor na rje btsun nyid la mnga' ba'i zab chos rnams lhag ma lus pa lta bur gsan pa ming tsam du ma bzhag par tshig don gyi cha la sgro 'dogs bcad/ thugs nyams su gang bstar ba mtha' dag la nyams rtags dang dngos grub ma thob pa med cing gtso por birnya pa dang nā ro ta pa'i gsang chen slob bshad la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub/ dmar po skor gsum dang mgon po che chung sogs la brten nas (39na)mchog thun gyi dngos grub sna tshogs pa 'bad med du rnyed pa'o/ /gsol 'debs las/ slar yang grum stod kha'u'i lam bgrod tshe/ /bstan srung rnam gnyis dzo —318

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)ki'i zol gyis 'ongs/ /pho nya'i tshul du mkha' la zhabs bskyod de/ /gegs med 'phrin las bsgrub la gsol ba 'debs/ /nam yang 'bral med bltos par bcas pa kun/ /rje btsun bla mas skyong bar zhal bzhes shing / /chos kyi 'phrin las 'khor lo sgyur ba yi/ /rgyal tshab mchog tu bsngags la gsol la 'debs/ /'chi med bdud rtsi bsgrub pa'i bka' gnang zhing / /dbang bskur dam tshig rdo rje dril bu gtad/ /gzhal med sku gdung yid bzhin dbang po las/ /byin rlabs bdud rtsi bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal dbyings la bzhengs pa'i mdzes sku yi/ /ngo mtshar gsung gi snang ba lung bstan cing / /sngon nas 'brel ba'i mkha' spyod dga' ma des/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bstan la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa/ de nas rmu gshong du yab yum mjal ba sogs la phebs/ ring por ma lon par rdo rje 'chang kun spangs chos rje'i drung du phebs rtsis kyis gzhis nas chibs thog tu byon pa nas bzung kha'ur ma byon bar ā tsarla gzi brjid can gnyis kyis gar bsgyur zhing sku'i g.yas g.yon skyor ba'i tshul gsal bar gzigs pa mgon po che chung gnyis sku lus dang grib ma bzhin 'bral med du bsrung skyob mdzad cing 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mtshan mar gsal/dgung lo bcu bdun nas zhabs pad bsten pa'i dbang (39ba)du byas na lo ngo bdun tsam dang bcar bzhugs lo drug gi ring mdzad par kun spangs chen po'ang de bar zab chos rnams lod pa gnang nas mkha' spyod du gshegs par bzhed pa'i dgongs pas chos rnams rtag 'grus su mdzad pa dang / rje bla mas kyang nyin mtshan dal med lta bur gsan bsam la brtson pa'i shugs kyis ba ched pa rnams 'grub par brten dgung lo nyer gsum du phebs pa shing pho sprel lo skye 'chi la rang dbang 'dus pa'i dbang gis rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po de nyid zhing gzhan du gshegs pa'i gsung 'ga' shas phebs pa'i tshe/ bka' las bdag gis spyir bstan pa dang sems can gyi don dang lhag par bdag cag mgon skyabs gzhan med pa'i 'gro ba rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs nas zhabs pad yun ring du brtan pa'i thugs 'dun cis kyang gnang dgos zhus pas/ da lo ma shi na lo brgya tsam mi —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'thub pa'i nges pa mi gda' ste/ da rang de tsam yin pa 'dra chos rje rdo rje 'chang chen po lta bu mkhas grub bstan pa'i rtsa lag de la'ang dgung lo bdun cu don lnga thub pa la kun gyis sku tshe mthar phyin zer gyin 'dug /da lo 'di tsam lon bla ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi thugs zin/ sdom pa dang dam tshig la gnong 'gyod ye med/ lam 'bras thog mar thob nas da bar lam dus thun bzhi ma 'di chag ma myong / bstan pa dang sems can gyi don yang byed tshad byung / da nga'i tshab khyed tshos byed las che/ rje btsun rin po chesadaga' ston la gdams par/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'bral med du bsgoms na bla ma 'bral med du (40na)yong ba yin gsung ba dang / nged bka' gdams pa'i jo bo rje'i gsung las/ sprul gyi pags pa brjes kyang sgrul mi 'chi/ kho bo 'chi tshul bstan kyang a ti sha /gsungs pa bdog pas de dang 'dra/ khyed dad pa yod pa rnams la ni nga dang 'du 'bral med pa yin/ khyed tsho rkyang par ma zad khyod tsho la blo bstad pa tsho'ang ngas skyong ba yin/ ha cang chos rje'i dgongs pa la bla ma'i stong 'ur la dgongs pa yong ste/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba'i gsung sgros bris pa las/ bla ma de mnar med na bzhugs kyang rang gis sangs rgyas su mos nas gsol ba btab na rang rgyud la sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs 'jug ste/ de gnyis kyi chos nyid la dbye ba med pa'i rten 'brel yin bya ba yod/ de cis kyang yong ba yin pa gda' gsungs/ bdag gi gsung chos kyi 'phro 'ga' yod pa'ang skal dman 'ga' zhig la 'dzem pa'i rnam pas/ res 'ga' ja khang chung ngu yod pa sogs su shub bus gnang / res phyi'i spang kha dang mchod rten la zhabs skor mdzad pa'i tshul gyis phyags phyir 'gro gsungs nas mi gzhan med pa na sku khyel tsam mdzad nas gsung chos gnang / chos rje la 'di pa sngar nas cis kyang gshod bsam pa yod de brel ba dang snyom las kyi dbang du lus pa yin/ da dga' rab 'dril bas blo bde gsungs/ gzhan yang 'das ma 'ong gi gnas tshul lung bstan ngo mtshar ba ji snyed cig gsung gi gda'/ zhes gsungs pa rdo ring rin po che'i rnam thar bzhin dbri bsnan med par bkod pa yin/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi gnas tshul ni seng (40ba〉she rtse ba'i mnga' thang myur du 'jig pa/ rje nyid kyi sku tshe'i tshad/ snod ldan gyi slob ma rags rim yod pa dang chos—320

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags ga rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)ston pa'i dus tshod/ sku tshe phyi ma'i skor sogs kyi lung bstan shin tu rgyas pa yod 'dug kyang deng sang zin bris sogs gsal bar mi snang / rdo rje dril bu sngar thugs bed spyad pa'i legs pa zhig gnang ste chos rje rang 'di dkrol nas dbang bskur gzhan don rgya chen po mdzod cig gsungs/ gzhan dngos po'i gnang sbyin gyi rigs zhu yi med 'dug kyang da lam sku khams hreb pas rten 'brel 'phyugs dogs zhu ba mdzad/ nyin zhig sku srung khrod nas 'phags pa dang bdag chen rin po che gnyis kyi bdud rtsi ril bu dang sgrub yig bdag wo rdo rje lang gis mdzad pa gnang / rje btsun rin po che'i bdud rtsi'i phabs rgyun dang sgrub snod rnams bla brang shar par yod pas sku nye yin gshis g.yar po mdzad na yong /bdag chen rin po che'i bdud rtsi ril bu 'di khar song na skye ba bcu gnyis tso la sangs rgyas thob ba'i lung bstan thengs gsum byung / bdag la sgrubs shig par bka' stsal kyang ma grub khyed kyis sgrubs shig ces sku dpung steng du phyag gis cab cab mdzad byung bar/ sngar sems dpa' chen po la'ang thog mar mdzad dka' byung ba'i 'phros 'dug pas bdag gis mi 'ong ngam zhu ba gnang bar yig cha 'di gsal po yin pas 'di steng nas mdzad na 'grub gsungs/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bco lnga la kun spangs chen po dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i bzhugs gdan gyi khar byang sems dkar po (41nasgo theb kor gyi rgya tsam zhig byung ba de zhal du lhag ma ma lus par gsol bas brgyud pa zin pa'i rten 'brel 'grig /mchod 'bul dang dgongs rdzogs kyi rim pa rgya cher spel ba'i khur bzhes mdzad/ nyin gcig sprin dkar gyi phung po'i gseb na seng ge gnyis kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng na rdo ring rin po che sku'i dbyibs dang cha byad ji lta ba bzhin gsal bar gzigs te dbugs dbyung gzengs bstod byin rlabs mdzad/tshar chen nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs las/ slar yang 'od gsal ngang las sku bzhengasate/ /seng ge'i khri la zhabs sen pad+ma bkod/ /'dzum zhal bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis skal ldan gyi/ /snying gi gdung ba bsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes so/ /de'i tshe rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mngon sum du —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shezhal bstan pa'i ngo mtshar gyi snang ba ci yang shar zhing / rdo ring rin po cher byin rlabs gsan pa'i dus bar snang gi sprin gseb nas rje btsun ma'i sku gzigs par brten chos rje la mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs byas res kyis rtags khyad par can re yong gi 'dug gsung ba'ang 'di rigs la dgongs so/ /dbyangs can ba 'ad pa'i sgrib bral mkhyen mtsho'i nang / /mchog sred sprul pa'i gar dang las smon gyis/ /'brel ba'i gzugs brnyan shar nas lung ston pa/ /rnam gsum dam pa'i yon tan dngos ma bzhin/ /mi bzad dug gi rlangs 'khrigs sa bdag gdon/ /srog rtsa drag sngags ma ka tas bcad dang / /lhan cig chos srung rwa rtses klu gnyan byad/ /nyer bkrol (41ba tha grang bya'i lung bstan rna bar snyan/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan 'khor los thub bstan lus/ /kun tshang gling bzhir dbang sgyur yab rje'i khrir/ /mnga' gsol cod pan 'ching la gdan gsum lha/ /mkha' khyab me tog glu gar rol mor brel/ /yi dam chos srung dgyes pa'i dpyid kyi ma/ /'bod byed sos kyis khu byug 'dren pa'i glus/ /mchog thun dngos grub 'dab brgya grol ba'i sbubs/ /phan bde'i sbrang rtsi mngar po ci yang 'dzag /snyan brgyud chos kyi brda sprod ma lus pa/ /rang rigs dbang por gtad pas sarba dzhaḥ/ /chos dbyings zag bcas bde ba'i mal nyal kyang / /dag sku'i gdong bzhi sprul de su yis 'gog /byu dra'i 'khri shing bzhin du dmar ba'i gzugs/ /mnyen lcugs 'khril ldem rtse 'jo'i yid 'ong ma/ /dar babs lang tsho'i ut+pal dmar po'i sgros/ /'dzum pa'i bdud rtsi 'dren byed gzigs mor dngar/ /gsol 'debs las/ dpal ldan nā lan+da yi chos gra cher/ /bdag chen rje yi zhabs zung gus bsten cing / /rdo rje 'chang dbang rje btsun sgo rum pas/ /zab lam gdams pa stsal la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i yongs 'dzin dbang po mchog /drug cu rtsa gsum gus pas nyer bsten nas/ /rgya chen gsar rnying rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /ma lus thugs su chud la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes bar tshig gi zin so yod med sna tshogs kyang / de nas kha'u skyes lhas kyi sum cu rtsa gsum zer ba'i brang khang du sku mtshams shin tu dam par bcad nas lam dus thun bzhi ma dang gtso bor lam zab kyi rnal (42na tshe cur lhun blangs pa'i tshe dgyes —322

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)mdzad rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang gsang 'khrid kyi nyams len gnang ba'i dus mgon po lha brgyad 'khor dregs pa brgyad dang bcas pa gsal bar gzigs/ yang nub cig mnal lam du ma jo'i rnam pa can zhig gis ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma mjal na 'di na yod ces zer bar dgyes bzhin du bud med des lam sna byas te phebs pas dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal yin rgyu ba'i shing tho re yod pa'i dbus na rdo phung zhig gi gseb tu gnam sgo 'dug pa phye ste 'di na yod zer ba gzigs pasazhal bram gzugs dkar po ral pa'i thor tshugs can ras dkar po gyon pa phyed krung du bzhugs pa phyag g.yas na thod khrag dang g.yon ma mi rkang gi gling bu dang shing gi bum pa 'dzin pa/ 'od zer du ma 'phro ba zhig gzigs/ de nas kyang 'bral med lta bur dngos su yang yang 'byon zhing las thams cad bsgrubs par mchis/ gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar phebs nas rten brten pa thams cad zhib mor mjal ba gnang zhing khyad par mgon po dngos su gzigs/ /dge 'phel du rten bzhengs kyi tshe sku 'bag gi zhal rdul 'phyi ba mdzad pas pu thos dngos su 'ongs te 'phyi lugs 'di bzhin byed dgos sdo kyis/dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam babs pa'i tshe gdan sa 'og nas bdag chen rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug gi zhabs phyi mdzad nas dbus phyogs su phebs/ gsung ngag lam 'bras/ gshed dmar gyi dbang byin rlabs spros med kyi 'khrid/ rdo rje 'phrong ba'i dbang sogs bka' chos mang du gsan/gal (42ba ji dus mchod dpon dang dbang 'khrid kyi skor la thugs dogs sel gyi rigs nang bcar du 'bul ba sogs bdag chen rin po che'i phyag g.yog nang skor gyi rnam pa'ang yun ring tsam mdzad/ bdag chen rjes chos kyi 'khor lo skor zhig pa'i gnang ba stsal ba la brten nas rong ston shes bya kun rig gi gdan sa nā le rgyu'i tshogs chen la gsung ngag rin po tshogs bshad yongs rdzogs shig gnang / thams cad dad pa'i sa la bkod de bdag chen rin po che las kyang 'ur ba tsam byung bar drung 'khor nas phrag dog gi rnam pa ci rigs byung / lhun grub sdings pas sbyin bdag byas 'phan yul —323

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyebya bzang gi chos khri'i gdong gi stong der spyil bu zhig yod par bcad rgya mdzad de dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa zla ba lnga tsam song ba'i snga dro nyi ma rtse shar la 'od dmar pos lto'i phyogs rnams gang 'dug pa nyi zer yin nam dgongs/ gzigs pa na me dpung chen po 'ur sgra dang bcas pa blos mi 'khyud pa'i dbus na 'jigs byed yongs rdzogs 'khor bcu gcig zhabs g.yas brgyad kyi thad du las gshin rwa rtse shin tu rno ba g.yas gri gug g.yon pas mi dar ma zhig gi ske zhags pas bcings pa de la zhes nas 'phros pa'i me 'phog pa na bug pa dgu nas khrag 'dzag pa zhig gzigs/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg kyang mdzad/ lam yig tu rje ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs phyir lo brgyad tsam bsdad gsung ba'ang 'di'i skabs su yin par mchis/chu 'brug lo zla ba dang po'i nang du gtsang la phebs/ 'di res bsnyen par rdzogs kyang gsol ci la rtsa ba bcol bas 'og (43nad+ku 'byung / ston bo dong du rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po chen po'i bar gyi dbang yongs su rdzogs pa dang gur mgon gyi man ngag sogs chos bka'i rigs rgya cher gsan/ sngon yar klungs pa dang 'jam dbyangs sgeg pa dpon slob tu gyur pa'i rten 'brel dus 'dir 'grig tshul kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i rnam thar du/ bdag gis bla ma dam pa'i drung na mjal zhing gsung chos 'dra'ang gsan gyi 'dug pa mthong bas sngar ye ma mjal na'ang 'dris 'dris 'thad 'thad 'dra mo zhig gis sems la dga' tshor dang bla ma'i dga' ba la bsam pa dung dung pa byung / rje 'dar phyogs la phebs khar bdag yod sar thol gyis byon byung nas gos chen lcags nag kha do pa zhig dang stong skud dmar po mang po zhig gnang / 'di la phyag 'phreng thag pa bzhin mdzod gos chen 'di la bris sku lta bu mdzad dam gang na'ang mi la ma gnang bar phyag tshags mdzod/ rten 'brel zhig yod do gsungs shing zhal 'dzum mang po mdzad kyin 'dug pa de dus ni dga' ba la bsam pa las ma byung / da bsams na mgon po che chung 'di rnams thob pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa gnang bar 'dug go /—324

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanargyal ba'i dgongs pa zab gsal mkha' dbyings las/ /tshur mthong byis pas sbar chod ci zhig things/ /dus gsum gsal bar mkhyen des bdag lta bu'ang / /snyan brgyud gdams pa'i snod du rung bar dgongs/ /dam pa'i zhal bzhes rdo yi ri mo bzhin/ /'gyur med bden pas thugs la btags na yang / /(43ba〉ngang gis gso me ba btab pa mi dran pa/ /a ho las nye zhe dbang gis skyes pas lan/ /zhes so/ /slar rang gi bsti gnas su chos sgo ba zhakhrul zhig byams pa shes rab bzang po'i drung du dpal rnal 'byor gsang mtha' 'khor lo sdom pa'i skor gyi bka' babs te lam rdzogs par gsan/mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa 'jigs med dpa' bo'i lugs 'dzin pa gos spungasapa tshe dbang bkra shis la rje btsun gong ma'i yab mes 'khon rigs sngags 'chang rnams kyi yi dam gyi lha mchog gi dngos grub 'bad med du stsol ba dpal chen po khrag 'thung he ru ka yang dag lha lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi dbang dang yig sna/ bar chad bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhen nu lha khra stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dbang bzhi dang smad las gdug pa sgrol ba'i rjes gnang /man ngag yig skor/ chos skyong dkar bdud kyi rjes gnang las tshogos/ rnam 'joms bir lugs lha don lnga'i dbang lung / gur gyi mgon po gri gug lha lnga'i rgyud lugs kyi dbang / la ra'i dkyil 'bor la brten pa'i man ngag lugs kyi dbang bzhi/ lha brgyad/ lha bcu gnyis ma/ gyi ljang lugs kyi lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang / de dang 'brel ba'i sgrub skor sogs mkhas grub kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi thugasadam mgon pod yongs rdzogs/ klu sgrub lugs kyi mgon po gdong brnyan can phyag drug pa dang lasabazhi'i mgon po'i rjes gnang / par bu'i chog sogs las tshogos kha shas/ sman ja sprul sku'i rjes(44na)gnang / rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser chen rta bdag brgyad kyis bskor ba/ ljang gu klu brgyad kyisabaskor ba/ mthing kha lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba/ slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha wa lugs kyi sprin gseb ma rta bdag brgyad/ yang gsang drag po mdung dmar can rta bdag brgyad bcas pa rnams kyi rjes gnang dang rnam sras skor gyi yig sna kha shas/ dmar po skor gsum gyi rgyun gang yod/ dpal tsho gos kyi —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pebadag po jo bo rje'i ga ga ma dkar po phyag bzhi pa/ chags pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi rjes gnang dang yig skor rnams gsan/ kha skong dkar chag las/ 'on kyang 'cham dang 'gros kyi spros pa ni/ /'dod na rdo rje gdan pa las gzhan pa'i/ /tshad ldan med phyir de yi lugs bzhin ston/ /ces pa'i don ltar mgon po che chung gnyis kyi 'cham dbyangs sogs kyi phyag len dpyis phyin par sbyong bdar mdzad/ dpon slob gnyis chos skyong skor la go bsdur gnang nas deng sang bod na sa skya pa'i chos skyong la nged rang gnyis las mkhas pa med pa 'dra zhes kyal ka gsungs skad/ zhabs cher bsnyun yang gtsang chur 'jug pa sogs las gzhan ma'i 'phrod bsten gyi spros pa dor te thos bsam lhur mdzad pas kun ha las te chos sde'i gra rigs rnams yon tan gyi sbyong bdar dran bskul la de las lhag pa ma byung zer/ rdzong lugs kyi bstan pa'i srol 'byed chen po rtsang byams pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi dngos slob rgyud gsum smra ba shes rab rin cen gyi drung du gur gyi mgon po lcam dral lha gsum/ lha brgyad mkha' 'gro sbrags sgrub rnams kyi (44ba)rjes gnang / g.yin las ches zab pa rtsa ba'i man ngag gnyis/ rnam par dbye ba bcu gnyis/ yan lag gi man ngag bcu drug /cho ga'i lag len nyi shu/de dag gi yig cha'i gtso bo mang po'i lung sogs sa skya rdzong chung par grags pa'i man ngag mtha' dag gi zab chos mang po gsan cing / bla ma 'di dag gis gtso byas gur gyi mgon po'i skor kho na la bla ma bcu bsten lugs srol ma 'dres pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan pa/ ji skad du/ khyad par nag po chen po'i man ngag ni/ /brgyud ldan bla ma bcu phrag gcig la zhus/ /'gran zla kun bral drin can rdo ring pa'i/ /snyan brgyud zab mo bum pa gang byor thob/ /ces dang / e waṃ pa ni bsdus la spros pa chung / /mus srad pa ni dkar chag khrigs chags can/ /rdo rje gdan pa 'cham dang 'i nus pa bdag /kho bos thob pa'i thun mong brgyud pa gsum/ /zhes byung la/ gnod sbyin beg tse lcam dral gyi rjes gnang lung man ngag rnamasagasan/ gzhan yang snga phyi bsdoms par bla ma bsten pa'i skor la lo zla'i dus nges can ma rnyed pas phyogs mtshungs su bkod par/ dwags po paṇa chen phyogs las rnam rgyal ma rje btsun 'phrin las zhabs —326

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal nas brgyud pa'i zab chos du ma dang gar lugs sogs kyi chos bka' kha yar/ gzhung du rngog ston chen po bsod nams bstan 'dzin la rngog lugs kyi dkyil 'khor bdun gyi dbang dang rgyud bshad/ chos skyong dud sol lha mo'i skor rnams dang (45nas tra brgya rtsa ni dbang dang rjes gnang gang yin la dpyad gzhi 'dug kyang gsan/bla chen mdo khams pa yon tan rgya mtsho la sa dge zhal gsum gyi 'jigs byed mkhan por grags pa rnams kyi rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i rdzogs rim ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang la brten pa'i rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud sogs zab chos du ma/ 'gos rdo rje seng ge la gshin rje gshed dmar po lha bcu gsum gyi rnal 'byor bzhi'i 'khrid/ rnal 'byor bzhi/ bdud rtsi'i lha mo nor 'dzin ma dkar mo/ zhabrul 'khor/ phyi'i byad rdzas/ rnam rtog 'od gsal 'pho ba rnams kyi byin rlabs/ de dag gi yig cha mang po'i lung / sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang lung / rdo rje 'phreng ba sogs kyi dbang lung / chos rje nyan chen par kye rdor bka' babs bzhi/ gsang 'dus lugs gsum sogs/ grub mchog sbyin pa rgya mtsho la skyes lhas pa'i zab chos sngar gsan bldabs pa dang phran bu lus pa'i rigs rnams zhu ba mdzad cing dag pa'i snang bar yang yang mjal ba yod 'dug /mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug drang srong dka' bzhi par gtso bor dpal rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dbang lung man ngag thams cad gsan zhing dbang mdzad pa'i skabs khrag 'thung lha dgu'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dngos su bstan ging lnga gza' gdong / gnod sbyin beg gdong lcam sring gi chos skor rnams kyang gsan/ chos stong rnams kyi phyag nas bzung ste mi la mi sprod pa'i tshul du bran 'bangs su dngos(45ba)su gtad/ byang gter gyis thog drangs pa'i gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos skor ches mang ba gsan/ dpon slob gnyis car phan tshun thugs nang shin tu dag cing 'dar phyogs su'ang spyan 'dren ched bstad gnang nas zhabs togo chen po mdzad rjes su'ang shar phyogs la phebs res kyis mjal tsam re mdzad cing bka' chos gang 'os re yang nges par gsan/—327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyeldong gi sngags 'chang chen po chos skyong bsod nams bkra shis par gter kha mi 'dra ba nyi shu tsam gyi dbang lung gsan par phebs pa'i tshe sngags 'chang rin po ches khyed dpon slob rnams ma byon pa'i zhag gsum tsam gyi nub sngags gzhen dkar po zhig byung nas khyod la nga'i chos skor rnams zhu ba la mi zhig 'ong bar yod pas de la rdzogs par gshod de ngas byin gyis brlabs pa yin gsung ba byung gsungs/ drin can sangs rgyas rnam rgyal la shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi lam yongs rdzogs gsan cing yab mes brgyud pa'i bla brgyud yin zhes shin tu gus par mdzad/ brag dkar sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan la phyag rdor 'khor chen lam yongs rdzogs sogs chos mang du gsan/bzad g.yu gong par ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa'i zab chos gzhan nas ma rnyed pa du ma/ byang stag lung sbas don pa la phag gru lugs kyi phyag bzhi pa'i lam yongs rdzogs/ bsam sding mkhan chen sangs rgyas ye shes la mgon po lha chen dpal 'bar gyi rjes gnang / rwa sgreng mkhan po dpal 'byor bsam grub la mi'u thung gsod byed kyi rjes gnang /jo stan rong shāka pa bkra shis rin cen la a ti lam yongs rdzogs (46na skong 'dod rgyal nor bu gsal 'bar gyi lung gsan de skabs rdzogs chen gyi rtogs pa phul bas nged rang la nyams myong dga' mo yod pa'i lugs yin kyang 'di 'dra skye ma myong gsungs pas tshogs pa rnams dad nas gsung chos mang du zhus/ nya mgo gru khar mnyan pa dus la ma 'byor bas nga chu la 'ding ba bting nas 'gro gsungs pas mdun gyi nam mkhar dpal phag mo gru pa byon nas snyigs ma'i sems can nyon mongs can la gsang ba'i spyod pa ma byed gsung ba zhig byung bas gru la phebs/ gdan sa thel gyi gnas rnams zhib par mjal/ 'jag spyil sku 'dra rin po che phag mo gru pa dngos su gzigs spyan nam mkha'i mthongs su zhal 'dzum dmangs dang bcas pas lta stangs su bzhugs song ba brda ston khyad par can du dgongs/ khams lcags mo ba mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bkra shis seng ge la gur mgon khro bcu'i rjes gnang / zhal gyi gsang 'khrid rjes gnang dang / rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i 'khrid zab —328—

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)mo lo chen gnyan gyi thugs bcud ches dkon pa gsan/bla ma 'dis stan thog gcig tu zhal gyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag drug sto tsam song ba'i nus pa bsam gyis mi khyab/gsang 'khrid brgyud 'debs su/skyesamachog chos rje'i sras kyi thu bo pa//zhing skyong bran du 'khol ba'i rdo rje 'dzin//rtsa ba'i bla ma drin can mdo khams pa//zhes byung la/rtag brtan sprul skus 'khrid brdzus ma yin zhes smra ba ni sprang bos thang ston par 'phya ba'i dper snang /sham+bha ra 46ba 〉 ge༅rjes kun dga' sangs rgyas la gsabs lugs kyi stag zhon lha mang gi dbang lung yongs rdzogs/'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin cen pas ye waṃ chos ldan gyi mkhan po kun spangs pa mdzad nas thar rtser bzhugs dus rdo ring rin po ches khong sems dpa' chen po'i dbon yin zhing rang re'i brgyud pa'ang chos rje rdo rje 'chang yab sras gnyis la thug gi yod gshisad lam 'dir brel ba langs pa'i chos kyi gseng zhig kyang 'dug pas khyed rang ngor du lam 'brasagasan par byon zhes phyag tham dang bcas thar rtser phebs par lam 'bras yongs su rdzogs pa/mgon po'i nang 'khrid kyi man ngag chos rje dpal ldan rgyal po nas brgyud pa sogs dang gzhan dbang rjes gnang du ma gsan cing gsung ngag la bogs 'byin lta bu'i thugs bskyed kyang thon pas thugs mos shin tu che ba byung /mnal lam du rje rdo rje 'chang yin zer ba zhig dang mjal bas rkyen byas thugs rgyud la nyams rtogs khyad par can 'khrungs/yab chos rgyal rin cen rgyal mtshan la yab chos du ma gsan cing bla ma 'di nyid kyis mgon po stag zhon dngos su bran gyi tshul du gto pas las sgrub gyin 'dug pa'i rgyu mtshan lam yig na'ang gsal/'di yan la bka' drin che ba'i bla ma nyer bdun du mdzad cing gzhan yang bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge la bya rgyud sgo drug sogs/spyan snga shākya rgyal mtshan la sgra snyan/ma 'barjod sdeb sbyor sogs/grub r+sā rdo rje rgyal por khong rang gis rnal 'byor ma la dngos su gsan pa'i 'pho ba zab mo/gong dkar tshul khrims pa la 47na zangs gri can gyi rjes gnang dang bran bdud kyi rjes gnang thun mong min ba/des mtsho ni 0 3 2 9 pa 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba/gong

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)dkar ba rgya ston byang chub dbang rgyal/ rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo/ lam yig tu ku su lu'i bla ma gsung ba'i lcags sgog lung pa bkra shis dpal 'byor/ ngor chen lha mchog seng ge /sgra pa sku skye shes rab rin cen/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas 'phel/ sngags 'chang sangs rgyas grags pa/ sngags 'chang rdo rje legs ldan/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ stag lung rin cen rnam rgyal grags pa/ lo pa spyan snga ngag dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mus chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / bdag chen a tshes pa/ rnal 'byor ma dkon mchog ldan/ nub ra ba blo bzang brtan pa/ bya btang kun dga' mchog ldan/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgyal mtshan/ chos rje chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bkra shis rnam rgyal/ 'brug pa ngag dbang chos rgyal/ rje btsun dam pa kun dga' grol mchog /ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub/ chos rje dbusasmyon pa/ kre chen nam mkha' 'od zer/ snye thang lung zin pa/ grub chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bla ma blo gros seng ge /bdag chen kun dga' don grub rnams kyi steng du tshigs snga phyi bar gsum gyi mkhan slob rnams bsnan pas yongs 'dzin drug cu rtsa gsum legs par bsten nas thos bsam rgya cher mdzad pas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses/ drug cu rtsa gsum dam pa'i yongs 'dzin bsten/ /mdo sngags gsar (47ba)rnying dam chos mtha' dag la/ /thos bsam sgom pas 'khrul med thugs su chud/ /rtsod dus kun mkhyen gnyis par gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes byung la/ tsa ri rdor 'dzin pa chos kyi mgon po'am mthu mkhan rgya bor grags pa la chos skyong gi skor gsan pa kho rang gi rnam thar du 'dug pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshor chos 'brel gsan pa gnyis gsol 'debs su 'tshems pa zhig yin par mngon/bla mar rlom pa la la dag ni rigs rus skye brgyud stobs 'gyor go sa sogs kyi khengs pas chos 'tshol ba la bag tsha ba'i gnas su byed cing cung zad don du gnyer ba'ang / sdom gsum las/ rta dang nor bu la sogs pa/ khung zad tsam gyi nyo tshong la/ /kun la 'dri zhing brtags nas spyod/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba cung zad la'ang / /de 'dra'i 'bad pa byed pa mthong / /skye ba gtan gyi legs nyes ni/ /dam pa'i chos—330

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)la rag las kyang //chos 'di khyi yi zas bzhi du//bzang ga gang du'ang mi dpyod par//gang phrad de la gus par 'dzin//nyin gcig gi ni skyes ma'am//tshe gcig gi ni gnyen 'brel la'ang //'bad de brtags nas len pa mthong //deng nas brtsams te rdzogs pa yi//sangs rgyas ma thob bar gyi don//glam mchog la rag las mod//wo kyang rtogs dpyod mi byed bar//k+ṣe bos ga pa'i zong bzhi du//su phrad rnams las len pa mthong //kye ma snyigs ma'i dus 'di mtshar//zhes chos khungs btsun mi btsun sogs la mi blta bar bla chen du ming btags pa zhig 'gangs che'o snyam pa'i blun dad 48na ) kyi 'jug pa tsho dang mi 'dra bar rje btsun 'di nyid khungs dang tshol ba'i tshigs bcad re'i ho du'ang dka' spyad rtag tu ngu ltar mdzad pas gong du ma 'dus pa'i rigs med pa'i mtha' ma bkag mod/bshes gar+sā de dag la thos pa ji ltar mdzad na lung sdo bzhi/mdo rtsa/sum brgya pa/me rta go 'phreng rgyud/las rnam 'byed sogs 'dul mngon dang 'brel ba'i rgya bod kyi gzhung /brgyad stong pa/ngor lugs su grags pa'i mdo chung bco brgyad mdo phran gyi rigs sna tshogs/byams chos sde lnga/rigs tshogos drugabaka' gdams gzhung drug/blo sbyong gi 'khrid sogs theg chen thun mong ba dang 'brel ba'i rgya bod kyi yig sna/gsar ma rgyud 'bum/gdugs dkar zhe gnyis ma tshe dpag med lha dgu/'chi med rnga sgra/don yod zhags pa/bcu gcig zhal/mi gcigs pa lha dgu/phyag rdor 'gro bzang /rnam rgyal 'joms/rigs gsum spyi sogs bya rgyud kyi dbang rjes gnang /rig gtad/rnam snang mngon byang /phyag rdor 'byung 'dus sogs spyod rgyud kyi skor/rdor dbyings/dpal mchog/rdor sems/sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis sogs rnal 'byor rgyud/gsang 'dus lugs gsum/rim lnga dmar 'khrid/semasanyid ngal gso'i 'khrid/dgragadong 'jigs gsum/dus 'khor/lo nag dril gsum gyi dbang 'khrid/phag mo'i skor/mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/sdom 'byung /bong zhal can sa myu ṭi/sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur sogs bla med dang 'brel 48ba tha'i dbang lung 'khrid mtha' yas pa rje btsun gong ma lnga'i bka' 'bum sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang po'i gsung gis mtsho ni gsan ba

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)mtha' dag brir ma lang bas gsan yig sogs gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de ltar yongs 'dzin mang du bsten nas gsan pa'i chos rnams kyang dag dang ma dag pa'i shan legs par phye bas tshig gi cha la lung dang rigs pas sgro 'dogs rnam par bcad/ don gyi cha theg dman byang sems gsang sngags sogs theg pa so so'i ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rnams so so'i khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa'i nad thog tu sman bzhin gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas thar pa'i lam la bkri ba'i gnad 'gag ma 'dres pa thugs su chud par mdzad pas/ 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyis/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i cho gas gser gyi khams/ /sbyong pa'i rim bzhin dgag gzhag spang gsum gyis/ /gzhung lugs 'bum sde'i lhad kun 'byin pa la/ /kun dga'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin khyod bskos pa snyam/ /zhes pa'i don dang mtshungs shing / rtog ge dang tha snyad sogs gtsug lag mang por mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pas/ mkhas pa'i gsung las/ snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor zlos gar dang / /rtsis bzo gso ba sgra tshad nang don rig /skye bar 'grogs pas de dag sred pa bzhin/ /mthong ba'i mod la de yi blo dang 'thams/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu babs par ma zad gtso bor gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol man ngag gi gnad la byang chub pas/ tha snyad bslab pa chu 'dod smig rgyu'i rjes/ /snyeg ltar mthong (49na skos snying po'i don btsal bas/ /sbas don rlung gi zab gnad 'tshol ba la/ /gnad du che bas rtsis tshul bzhin du bslabs/ /gcig shes kun la mkhas na rtog ge pa'i/ /yun ring ngal byas rnams kyi khengs pa bstungs/ /zhes pa ltar yin zhing / de yang sdom gsum du/ lha chen skad ngan shor ba la/ /sdug bsngal bden pa mthong zhes grags/ /zhes pa ltar/ log pa'i bshes kyi rdzun tshig dang chosam yin pa smra ba lta bu'i 'chad nyan gyi gzugs brnyan tsam la mtha' ci bkag /drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' lung nod pa'am sbyin pa dang ldan pa'am tshul khrims dang ldan pa'am bzod pa dang ldan pa'am brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'am bsam gtan dang ldan pa'am shes rab dang ldan pa'am byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi tshogs gsog pa dang ldan pa'i tshig —332
