tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa su las nyan tam lung nos sam blangs pa'i slob dpon de la des chos kyi gus par bya'o/ /ming dang tshig dang yi ge ji snyed kyis bskal par gal te slob dpon de la g.yo med par rnyed pa dang bkur stis rim gro byas kyang da dung slob dpon de la gus par bya ba yongs su rdzogs par bya ba ma yin na chos ma yin pas gus par byas pa lta ci smos zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par bshes gnyen de dag rnams la mnyes pa gsum gyi sgo nas gus pa lhur mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa ni/ 'brom ston chos kyi rgyal pos bla ma se btsun dang / se ston kun rig gis rje btsun 'brog mi'i zhabs bsten pa'i (49ba)ngang tshul dang mtshungs so/ /bcu phrag drug lhag yongs 'dzin chu gter klong / /mkhyen dpyod brtson pa'i ri bo bsgril ba las/ /legs bshad nyin byed thon pa'i 'od stong gis/ /gangs can bstan pa'i snang ba ches cher dkar/ /thub gsung dgongs 'grel mes po'i ral klung las/ /lnga rig shes bya'i yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun/ /blo gros sto bar 'dzin pa'i drang srong khyod/ /sngon med — yi mgo po bzhi/ /bshesaganyen bsten la mi ngal kun dga' bo/ /bgrang yas bka' rnams sdud por 'od srungs che/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab shā ri'i bu'i/ /ngang tshul zla gzugs gangs can chu mtshor shar/ /drang nges gnad gsang dbye ba 'od gzi'i mdangs/ /mkhas rloms ni ru ka dpal bzod min yang / /mtha' klas chosakyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis char/ /brdar nus bi shwa ga rma deng 'dir 'grub/ /de yang sngar dbus nasabo dong du phebs pa'i sngon du bsnyen rdzogs lo rtsis kyi yong dgos rgyur 'dug rung thog ma nas lo zla sogs dus tshigs nges sbyar gyi sa bon zhig med 'dug gshis/ mdzad pa 'gangs che ba rnams phyogs su bsdoms pa'i gsol 'debs kyi go rim ltar byas pa 'gal med du rtogs pas/ gsol 'debasalas/ grub pa'i gnas mchogo kha'u brag rdzong dang / /mang mkhar cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong sogs/ /dben pa'i ri khrod rnams su jab mo'i lam/ /rtse gcig nyams su bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /mtshungs bral —333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)bshes gnyen sdom brtson dbang po mchog /yongs rdzogs mkhan po grags pa rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /(50na)gus bsten bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i sdom pa bzhes/ /dge slong rdo rje 'dzin la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes gong du smos pa'i gsan bsam mthar phyin par mdzad de dag go yul tsam du ma lus par thugs nyams su bstar bas/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtses gsol 'debs las/ brjod bral bde chen gnas lugs mngon gyur kyang / /rim gnyis bzlas par bcas pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /nam yang g.yel med sgrub pa lhur len pa'i/ /grub pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa'i don ltar bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa mdzad pa a lha'i bsnyen chen nā le spror gsung ngag gnang ba'i snga rol nas song zin pa dang snga phyir bde mchog yab bka' yum bka'/ 'jigs byed/gshed dmar/ phur pa/ mgon po che chung sogs yi dam chos skyong mang po'i ljags bsnyen dus rtags grangs tshad du thon par ma zad rgyun du'ang nyin mtshan khor yug tu thugs dam gyi rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mos dus 'da' zhing sngags kyi bzlas pa'ang nyin zhag re'i khongs su ag yo gsum ma/ya ma rā dzā/ shā sa na/ sa phur gyi snying po rnams so sor stong phrag re chag med du mdzad cing / bka' las/ ngas gsang sngags gsar rnying gi sngags phal cher bsnyen tshad bzhin ma bzlas pa ye med/ de rnams kyi nang nas mgon po'i sngags shā sa na 'di nus pa che shos la 'dug ste/ 'di bgrangs pas 'phreng ba la dngos su me 'bar ba yong gin 'dug /ces gsungs/ skabs shig zhal gyi bsnyen pa gnang (50ba tha'i tshe thog mar cung zad 'tshub pa'i rnam pa dang rjes su gzigs snang la bar snang nas gos chen lcags nag gi phod ka chen po gyon pa zhig gis phu thung gi sbubs nas lag pa chen po yang yang ston pa sogs byung ba'ang chos skyong gis dngos su rjes su bzung ba'i cho 'phrul du snang /gzhan yang grum stod kha'ur brag rdzong du bzhugs pa'i dus thugs rgyud la nyams dang rtogs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi 'char sgo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhabrungs shing dbang las byung ba'i ye shes khyad par can lam gyi dus su gong nas gong du 'phel ba dri ma dang bral ba phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes la dbang —334

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (1)'byor bar mdzad/ 'phan yul bya bzang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ bka' las/ nyi ma dgong phyogs skyo bsangs byas pa'i tshe mdun gyi spang gshong la gong mo mang po rtse zhing / rgyab kyi thang la phyugs rdzi gzhen nu mang po shing 'thu zhing rtsed mo byed pa mthong bas 'di dag kyang bsams na dge sbyor gyi bskul mar 'dug snyam nas rang sems la gsal 'debs su smras gsung ba'i nyams glu gnang ba'i skabs yun ring du bzhugs shing thugs dam gyi bogs shin tu che bar byung / chu bo rir phebs pa'i tshe brag phug tu sgrub pa mdzad pas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro mas tshogs kyi 'khor los mchod cing thugs nyams kyi ngang nas rdo rje'i lus kyi rtsa 'khor gyi lha rnams gsal bar gzigs pas/ gsung mgur las/ gnas spyi bo bde chen gyi ri bo'i spor/ /rje sku yi rdo rje yab yum bzhugs/ /ma mkha' 'gro so gnyis kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ /sku zla shel gsar pa'i mdangs 'od can/ /pha (51na po sol ba 'debs so rdo ring pa/ /bu mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes skyongs/ /tshogs mchode par 'bul lo drin can rje/ /lus snang stong sprul skur byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sogs tshigs don ngo mtshar ba yod/ chu bo ri'i dur khrod du tshogasa'akhor mdzad nas bzhugs pa'i mtho phyir shab shub kyi sgra dang bcas skor ba byed pa'i skad thams cad kyis thos par byung /dur khrod de'i gong tsam du thugs dam la cung zad bzhugs pa'i gnas der zhabs 'bring pa rnams kyis mngon sum du rlung 'tshub chen po'i dkyil nas thag sgra chen po yang yang byung skabs/dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba can sku stod ja bsus pa'i rlangs pa lta bu sngo skya nam mkha' khengs pa gsal bar gzigs shing shog dril zhig phyag tu phul/ de nas bzung dus rgyun du bde chen gyi nyams bzung du med pa rdol/ de la brten dus lan cig ma yin par bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes khor yug tu g.yo ba med pa'i rgyu mtshan/ thugs dam gyi rim pa stod phyogs su 'phel bar dgongs te rmu bla brang du bzhugs pa'i skabs shig zhabs cung zad bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan tshe 'khrul zhig dkon cog bzang por zhu shog phul ba'i nang du bdag kyang lus bsam gtan gyi khang bu'i sgor mi thon kyang —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pesems la bde chen gyi ye shes mnan pas mi non pa khor yug tu yod ces pa'ang byung /de yang rje btsun chen pos/ lta ba spros bral du blo cham 'gro na 'da' kha ma mi thebs pa mi srid tshe 'di dang mthong lam gyi bar na dar tsam las med/ ces pa'i tshad der phebs nges pas dam pa 'di (51ba)nyid bzang po bzang po zhes pa'i ming tsam gyi stong 'ur mkhan rnams dang mi 'dra bar slu med gtan gyi skyabs mchog tu lung dang rigs pas bsgrub nus pas dran pa'i mod la srid zhi'i gdung ba mtha' dag sel bar snang / bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje dang ma he'i zhal can sogs yi dam gyi lha mang po nang rang byung lus kyi pho brang du rlung sems dag pa'i gar mkhan me long las gzugs brnyan ltar phyi rol tu shar te zhal gzigs/ gur zhal/ beg tse/ stag zhen sogs dam can srung ma rnams rgyal gyis 'bangs la bsgo ba bzhin ji ltar ba ched pa'i 'phrin las bsgrub pa la mi g.yel lo/ /ring por ma lon par mang mkhar du byon te sa skya'i mi 'gyur ba'i gzer bzhi zhes pa shar du bya 'gyur rdo rje'i brag /lhor phul byung bdud po brag /nub tu cha lung rdo rje brag /byang du gar g.ya' yi brag ste bzhi'i nang nas cha lung rdo rje brag rdzong gi rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gzims spyil shing sgom ma zer ba'i phug par sgrub pa mdzad kyin bzhugs pa'i re zhig nye ba'i sri zhu ba des snga dro drung du phyin pas gzims zhwa sbubs thibs se byas sku dngos ni mi snang / ci yin sgo bca' sogs ni mdang nub kyi de ga 'dug skar khung ni shin tu chung gang yin snyam nas slar log ste sgo'i phyi nas bltas pas lto'i mchod rten gyi drung na chos gos rnam gsum dang bcas sku zil pa phrom me 'od mer re bzhugs 'dug pa na bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa ni gang la'ang thogs pa med par 'phur te byon to snyam dad pa zi bun pa'i ngang nas sku drung du phyin pa lta stangs kyi ngang na spyod de bzhugs(52na)pa mthong / slar gzims spyil du phebs/ brag gi phug nas lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa zhig byung ba thub bstan dge 'phel gyi mgon po'i thugs dar bzhugs/ bka' las/ 'phur ba yin zer ched du theb theb rang dgos dogs med sems cer bltas pas gang dgos sa ru slebs yong ba yin gsungs/—336

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanade dus bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngone du gyur pa'i nyams 'ur chen pos zhakhrul snang a 'thas rdzun phugs rdib pa'i kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa grub pa'i sa dang lam gyi rtogs pa mthar phyin pa mdzad pa yin te/ yang gsang brgyud 'debs las/ mang mkhar cha lung rdo rje'i brag rdzong du/ /blo gsal bung ba 'du ba'i pa blo'i tshal/ khyud sde rgya mtsho'i bcud phyung gdams pa'i gter/ khrin can tshar pa smyon par gso lob 'debs/ /zhes byung la/ gnas 'di dang thub bstan dge 'phel gnyis su cho me kyi skye ba med pa'i don mngon du mdzad pa'i tshul bstan pa yin te/ ji skad du/ gzhi 'khrul snang gi rang zhal bltas tsa na/ /brjod med kyi dbyings su rjen ne ba/ /gser gling du bol dum ngas ma rnyed/ /ma semasacan tsho mgo bo gang nas 'khor/ /zhes dang / lam bskyed rdzogs gnad du bsnun tsa na/ /spyir snang 'di nyams kyi ban ma bun/ /snang grag rigs gsum 'di rgyal ba'i ngang / khong rnal 'byor tsho blang dor ga la byed/ /lam sgom pa'i gos bu sgra bo che/ /gzhi mngon du gyur pa'i skad du gda'/ /'di rang bcas su yod pa rang ngo shes/ /da 'bras bu bya ba gzhan ma mchis/ /zhes gsungs/ (52bsko nas cho 'phrul chen po'i tshes bco lnga nas zla gcig tsam gyi bar sku mtshams bcad de dbang drag pad+ma nye bar bsnyen pa'i tshe rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyis zhal bstan zhing gsung gyi gnang ba dang bcas dbugs dbyung / 'phags yul gyi slob dpon pad+mā ka ra dang bod kyi lo chen be+e ro'i thugs kyi nying khu yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i gsung bsnyen dang de'i yig cha la brten nas myong grol bdud rtsi'i ril bu'i sgrub pa gnang ba'i tshe dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang gnod sbyin lcam dral rgyud nas bshad pa'i srung ma rnams kyis rang rang gi sku dngos su bstan pa'i tshe ging lnga'i rta rmig kyang nam mkhar mi shong ba lta bu gzigs/rmur skor tsam phebs pa'i tshe yang gzigs snang de 'dra ba byung ba'i rkyen gyis chibs drag tu bskul nas phebs pas bu ri 'phrang gi mas snar chibs pa'i rmig rjes shin tu gsal ba da lta'ang kun gyi spyod yul du mchis/ de yang cho 'phrul bstan pa'i mdo las/ rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin spangs nas/ /dben par dong ste dgon par gnas byed pa/ /nyon mongs spangs nas bdud ni bcoms nas su/ /—337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pebyang chub rdul med 'dus ma byas 'tshang rgya/ /zhes srid pa 'khor ba la yid 'byung ba'i rang byung gi bslab pa la brten nas myur du byang chub brnyed par 'gyur ba'i gtso bo ni/ dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ dge slong zhes bya sdug bsngal spong ba yin/ /dge slong zhes bya rgyal ba'i sras po'o/ /zhes 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la sras stong yod kyang thu bo la rgyal srid 'byung ba bzhin 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa (53na ti ge slong pha'i sdom pa yin la/ de yang bod 'dir sdom rgyun 'ga' zhig yod pa'i nang nas kha che'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa chen po'i sdom rgyun shin tu gtsang ba chos lung tshogs su bzhugs par brten/ gsung las/ bdag gis tshe 'di'i ngo srung rgyab tu bor/ /phyi ma'i don chen 'ba' zhig snying nas bsams/ /yongs rdzogs kha che'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa/ /shākya shrī'i grwar ni 'bad pas bzhugs/ /zhes pa ltar dgung lo so gcig pa dga' ba zhes pa chu pho 'brug gi lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga thub pa'i dbang pos bdud btul byang chub brnyes shing mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus chen gsum 'dzom gyi tshe nyes lhung gi cha phra mo'i 'dam gyis ma gos shing / tshul khrims kyi 'dab brgya yongs su bzhad pa las mya ngan las 'das pa'i ze'u 'bru'i bcud kyis skal bzang ra yig gnyis pa'i dga' ston ches cher spel ba sa'i steng na 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba'i don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mkhan po/ chos kyi bkra shis rnam rgyal gyis las slob/ rje ngag dbang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis gsang ston/ g.yag sde lcang ra ba blo gros phun tshogs kyis dus bsgo ba/ spos khang pa 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan sogs nyi shus las kyi kha bskang ste jo bo stan gcig pa'i bsti gnas nyang stod spos khang gi kun dga' ra bar bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i tshe sngar dge tshul gnang ba'i mtshan gyi steng du mkhan po'i mtshan sgra grags pa rgyal (53ba)mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bsnan zhing bag yod pa kho na mdzad de tshul khrims rnam par dag pa ni/ ji skad du/ kha na ma tho phra rab la'ang / /thugs ni shin tu 'jigs par mdzad/ /dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa yis/ /tshul khrims ma yin yid mi mdzad/ /bag yod —338

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)dran dang g.yo sgyu med/ /ltung ba'i nyes pas khyod ma gos/ /zhes mnyam med jo bo wo po'i rnam par thar pa dang mtshungs so/ /bzlas brjod nus pa'i glog zhags thod 'phreng la/ /'byug tshe bdud snying sngags smyon thog gzer gyis/ /'bigs kyang lha rgyud bskul ba'i dbyar gyi rnga/ /thos pas dngos grub rma bya'i mngal khur 'dzin/ /bde stong ye shes me lces gnyis 'dzin cing / /bsreg pa'i cho 'phrul la mtshar byis pa'i blo/ /ston med gnyug ma'i lam gyis 'dus mtha'i 'phrang / /brgal te bcu gsum sal snyeg 'di ci/ /mtha' klas chos kyi rang mtshang rjen pa sa shar tshe kun rdzob 'byul pa dbyig po ches/ /med kyang mngon sum snang ba'i sprul bsgyur gyis/ /sgyu ma'i glang seng 'jigs tshul bag la zha/ /bdag 'dra'i 'gro snying lcagasakhams 'khor ba la/ /nges par mi 'byung tshe 'di'i grabs gzhom na/ /mthon po'i sal gshegs kyang tshangs spyod grus/ /srid mtshor sgrol brdzu'i rdzun gyis 'drid 'di ci/ /'on te chags bral tshul khrims ngad 'thul yang / /dga' bzhi 'gros kyi bde stong smin legs mar/ /mnyam sbyor rtse dga' rgod pa'i theg gsum don/ /'gal med mdud pa'i gnad de lhod por grol/ /gsol 'debs las/ grub dbang (54na)bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gzigs/ /dge 'phel chos kyi khri la spyan 'dren pa'i/ /gzhi bdag gus pa'i rnam 'phrul pho nya'i tshul/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma ra son la gsol ba 'debs/ /ngag dbang dbyangs can lha mo'i bzlas brjod tshe/ /mkha' la me tog dkar po'i char babs shing / khyud mangs sgra snyan rna ba'i bdud rtsi mchog /'od gsal ngang du gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /mnal lam ngang du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /sgron me bteg nas rje btsun rdo ring pa'i/ /'khor slob la'i ba'i zol gyi rnam thar mchog /rtsom par bskul ba gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /grangs med mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshogs dbus kyi/ /gtso mo pad+ma'i dra ba can zhes pas/ /glegs bam bstan cing cho 'phrul sna tshogs bcas/ /'dri ba'i yo byad gtad la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos kyi khri la 'khod pa'i rab byung gis/ /rgyal ba'i rtogs brjod klog pa'i tshul can la/ /mkha' 'gro'i tsho gos rnams dga' bas nyan —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)pa sogs/ /dge mtshan du ma gzig bsal gsol ba 'debs/ /rje btsun bla mas 'kha bzang yang yang bstan/ /rnam thar rtsom pa'i bya ba mthar phyin tshe/ /dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang mos dgyes pa yi/ /srung mar zhal gyis bzhes la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes dngos sdo/gas sna tshogs pa/ de ltar mkhas btsun bzang po'i bdag nyid can rnams ni 'khor ba'i mtha' ma rdzogs pa de srid du rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyi rgyun chad pa med par 'jug pa chos nyid (54ba〉skun pas mdo sngags kyi gra dang sde/ sa skyong ba'i che dgu/ rigs rus kyis mtho ba'i ya rabs/ rnam dpyod dang ldan pa'i mkhas pa/nyams rtogs dang ldan pa'i sgom chen/ dpa' mdzangs longs spyod dang ldan pa'i dpon skya sogs skye bo thams cad kyi bsam blo'i yul du dam pa 'di nyid bdag cag gi skyabs gnas su thob na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa rtse gcig tu gyur pas/ rje nyid kyis chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgo ba'i tshigs bcad las/ 'di na skye rgu'i phan bde ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa mchog la rag las shing / /byang phyogs 'di na bstan pa'i snying po mchog /sa skya'i rje btsun zhabs las brgyud 'di yin/ /de yi yang snying gsang chen zab mo'i bcud/ /zhal dang snyan du brgyud pa'i mdzod 'dzin pa/ kho bo'i 'dren mchog rje btsun rdo ring zhabs/ /bka' drin mnyam med dam pa'i srol 'dir bas/ /de nyid mchod cing bkur ba'i sbyin pa'i bdag /stod lung sa yi thig le'i stobs ldan ni/ /spa ra ba zhes grags pa'i ba dan can/ /zhes pa ltar stod lung nas sde pa spa ra ba rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan pas gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gser sku gra tshar bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la gdan drangs te stod nas chibs kha bskyod/ dam tshig pa la ye shes sems dpa' dngos su 'jug pas mtshon 'dod chos rkyen sel gyi rim gro sogs re ba yongs su skong bar mdzad cing / rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyi rtag gtor 'dzugs pa sogs mgon khang bzheng ba gnang tshe/na mo gu ru de wa (55na sgo ṇ+ḍal dharma pā la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ kun khyab kun gyi byed po gcig nyid srid zhi'i gzugs kyis kun la 'khrud/ /rgyal dang rgyal sras slob mar bcas pa'i tshogs kyi gtso bo —34()

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (1)rgyal ba rje/ /mtha' yas mtha' med 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog rje btsun bla ma srid mtha' bar/ /gtsug rgyan gtsug gi nor bur gus mchod 'bral ba med par gtsug tu bzhugs/ /zhes sogs mkha' 'gro lnga bstod bskul dang / dam can srung ma dgyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa spyi dang bye brag tu/ /dpal ldan sa skya pa zhes grags pa yi/ /bstan pa'i nying khu rje btsun rdo ring pa'i/ /bstan pa sa yi phyogs 'dir dar rgyas mdzod/ /de nyid 'dzin dang mchod pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag /mi nor 'khor bcas bsrung dang spa ba dang / /'du 'bral med par rtag tu skyong bar mdzod/ /ces dang / da lta'i gnod byed mi dang mi ma yin/ /skad cig nyid la mngon sum 'dir khug la/ /rab rnon mtshon chas mgo lus dum bur gtubs/ khrag zhag don snying dmar po hab kyis thob/ khes 'phrin las rgyas par mdzad/ ring zhig na 'gro ba'i las smin bdo ba rgyal po gzugs can snying po ltar tshad bzung dka' mod/ hor bya rig sogs rjes ma rnams la'ang srung ma'i za kha zug ste ming gi lhag mar gyur/ (55ba ji bus su zla ba drug tsam gyi ring bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs spel nas gtsang du byon/chos sgo ba byams pa shes rab bzang po la sngar smos pa'i chos gsan rgyu'i sngon du rmu gzhong na bzhugs pa'i mnal lam du mi sngon po zhig na re phu na 'khor lo bde mchog byon yod pas chos zhus zer byung ba'ang rtsad gcod mi gnang ba dge 'phel mkhan chen byams pa shes bzang bde mchog la mkhas zer ba las g.yin khungs ma chod zer bas de gar thugs nges pa rnyed de dge 'phel du phebs bde mchog lo nag dril gsum gyi dbang 'khrid zhal gdams rdzogs par gsan tshe bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa dngos su gzigs pa dpon slob gnyis ga'i che bar mngon/ rang gi bsti gnas su bzhugasapa'i dus thub bstan dge 'phel gyi zhal bdag mdzad dgos par gsol ba 'debs mkhan sang nyin yong ba'i do nub 'od gsal gyi ngang du bzhugs gnas kyi seng g.yabs nas mi dmar rta dmar can zhig babs byung ba nas gus pa chen pos phyag btsal te thub bstan dge 'phel gyi gdan sa la spyan 'dren par yongs pa yin zer ba la khyed su yin gsungs pas/ bdag sho dmar gyi brag btsan lags/—34/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyemakhas grub dam pa khyed phu dgon pa'i gdan sa la cis kyang 'byon dgos bdag gis kyang 'phrin las sgrub pa'i grogs byed/ khyed kyi dgon pa 'di zhal bdag mdzad na 'di phyogs kyi sems can thams cad 'phral dang yun gyi phan bde la 'god nus shing dam pa khyed kyi chos rgyun yang bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du phyogs 'dir gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes zhus 'dug cing / (56na)srung ma 'di ni/ bar chad lam sel ma las/ brag nag ha bo'i mgon khang duḥ sho btsan dmar po dam la btags: zhes pa de yin zhing rje 'di nyid kyi bka' las cung zad tsam yang mi 'da' la/ gzhan du drag shul dang gdug rtsub che bas thub bstan dge 'phel gyi 'og tsam byang ri'i ldebs la rten mkhar yod pa'i mdun der bla chen sde dpon sngags pa rtogs ldan sogs lugs gnyis gang rung gis mngon par mtho rlom rnams kyis rta ma babs na nyin zhag gi khongs su rta 'chi ba yong ba'i grags pas/ sa skya nas bdag chen rin po che phebs skabs kyang de gar gtor bsngo mdzad rjes chibs yab g.yas 'bung /zhabs 'bring ba rnams rkang 'gros byed/ phyag rdzogs kyi rtogs pa klong du rdol ba'i sgam smyon sprul sku dang / stobs 'byor gyi dregs ldan sde pa nor bu sogs kyi rta na shi mang du byung bar rnam rtog langs gsol mchod phul bas mtshon ches mang la/ tshar lugs la de ring zhugs pa'i gsar bu ba zhig kyang rta 'bab mi dgos pa sogs mngon sum gyi spyod yul du gyur pas so/ /'od gsal gyi ltas ltar sang nyin thub bstan dge 'phel gyi chos gra chen po nas/ gdan sa mdzad dgos pa'i snyan zhus 'bul mkhan byung bas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya cher por 'gyur bar dgongs te thugs dgyes pa chen pos/ bka' las/ de ltar kho bo la rtse gcig tu gsol ba 'debs pa yin na cis kyang de bzhin du bya'o zhes zhal gyis 'ches pas gsol 'debs pa rnams yid bde (56ba)ba'i dpal la bkod/de nas mi ring bar kha che 'dus bzang mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyi phyogs su byon pa bzhin ngur smrig gos kyi nam mkha'i kha dog 'gyur ba lta bu'i 'dus tshogs kyi ser sbreng 'phan gdugs rgyal —342

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ tanamatshan rol cha sogs mchod tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pas mdun bdar chibs bsu'i bkod pa sngon du 'gro bas rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta'i lo thub bstan dge 'phel gyi gdan seng ge'i khri la zhabs kyi chu skyes rnam par bkod/ de nas khams pa sangs rgyas rdo rje/ mi lhag mgon bo 'od zer/chos rje brag chos pa/ phu pa dbu mdzad tshul khrims sogs rin po che lta bu'i gdul bya dbang po yang rab kyi skal ldan rnams la gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa slob ma mchog la bshad bya'i dbang byin rlabs yed lung shin tu smin pa lo 'khor gyi bar du 'dzugs pa lam skor phyi ma brgyad dang / rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis par kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun gyis nye bar spras pa'i gsung bshad/gzhan yang dbang rjes gnang sogs so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi sgo 'phar phye nas re ba don ldan gyi sa la bkod/de'i tshe 'od gsal la bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan pa yin zer ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen khyad du 'phags pa zhig dang rin po che rdo ring pa dngos su byon nas dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bstan pa ni rin cen sgang pa sgos kyi zab chos rnams ches cher spel ba la legs so mdzad par 'dug /mgon khang du rdzas 'khor lo gzungs sngags sogs chos skyong gi rten bzheng ba'i man ngag ltar legs par bskrun (57na ti sman 'dam las grub pa'i gur mgon mi tshad tsam/ lha mo/ las mgon yab yum/ pu tra ming sring/ zhal bram gzugs/ beg tse lcam dral rnams khru phyed do tsam/ rtag gtor 'dzin gtor spyan gzigs sogs rgyas shing ngo mtshar ba dang / de'i bzo phud du lam gos dang lam zab brgyud pa rkang gang tsam khyad par rje nyid kyi sku 'dra mi tshad chung phyogs tsam byon gtsang zhing rab gnas kyi skabasashangs g.yon gyi sbub tu ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam gnyis byung ba/ phyis mkhan chen rgyal rtse ba byamasapa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi khrus gsol dang mchod pa rgyas par mdzad skabs snyan g.yon gyi ltar tu ring bsrel che tsam gnyis gsar du 'grungs shing da lta'i bar du sku grib kyi rnam pa byung tshe spyan g.yas g.yon gyi 'gug nas khrag mda' 'dra ba'i dmar po zhig spyan 'bras kyi dkyil tsam —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyesleb pa rgyugs yong zhing de la khrus gsol byas na sangs 'gro ba'i ngo mtshar can ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs che nges/ phyi'i chos khri/ lha g.yabs/ de nang du bzhugs rgyur mang mkhar chu tshan gyi phu'i dol mtha'i gzhi bdag la rdo lha bzheng ba'i rdo thong zhes bka' shog mdzad pa bsgrags pas rdo gang 'dod ldang tshod cam rnyed pa'i ngo mtshar can la lam 'bras dang lam zab brgyud pa brkos pa rnams la/ dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i rab gnas sogs bstan 'gra'i don rgya cher mdzad/ gang gi sku rgyu rin cen rdo/ /sbyin po dol mtha'i gzhi bdag kyang / /(57ba)las nyon sgrib pa kun byang nas/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang myur 'grub shog /ces smon lam 'debs pa gnang zhing sa phyogs gang du phebs pa'am bzhugs kyang rung 'byung po mi ma yin mthu bo che mtha' dag srog snying mdong gsol du phul nas bka' bzhin bsgrub/ dgon pa shar sbug tu ngag dbang lha mo dbyangs can ma'i ljags bsnyen mdzad pa'i tshe me tog dkar po'i char 'bab dang nye skor du brdung mkhan med kyang pi wang gi sgra snyan po gsan zhing mthar zhal mngon sum du bstan nas lung bstan kyang thob/ spyir rig pa'i gnas lnga dang bye brag snyan ngag la thogs pa med pa'i rnam dpyod ni slob dpon bsten nas yun du sbyangs kyang skam skam khrig chags shig las yod dka' bar thugs rtsom gang mdzad snyan ngag tu 'gro ba'i blo gros kyi spobs pa nang nas rdol bar mngon/thub bstan dge 'phel du bzhugs pa'i dus rdo rje 'chang kun spangs chos rje'i rnam thar thugs rtsom gnang ba'i sbyar byang du spyir dam pa 'di'i rnam thar mtha' dag ni so so skye bo'i spyod yul ma yin par gong du brjod pa dag gis 'grub pa dang khyad par rje nyid zhal bzhugs dus gsol ba btab pa'i gsung las kyang grub thob thang stong rgyal po dang nged dpon slob kyi rnam thar su byung gi blo yul du shong ba med gsung bas bdag lta bu blo gros chung zhing sbyangs pa zhan la brjed ngas pas ji lta ba bzhin brjod nus pa'i spobs pa ma mchis shing / zhal slob mkhas pa dang grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma bzhugs pa rnams kyis mdzad pa 'os su 'dug pas mdzad grub pa zhig (58na tshe rong ngam snyam sgug sdod yun —344

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ lhanaring po'i ngang du gnas kyang grub par ma thos pa'i mtshams su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis cung zad bskul ba'i mtshan ltas kyang 'dug cing gsung ngag rin po che'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi kha skong dang / skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag dag gi rgyud la ye shes kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa'i mtshams sbyor du zhes byung ba'i ngo mtshar ba'i ltas ni gsung rtsom phyag bris ma las/ zla ba dang po la skyes pho mo mang po tshogs te sgron me khur nas rdo ring kun spangs pa'i gra pa rnams gar song 'tshol ba yin zer nas kho bo'i mdun phyogs su yad yud mang po byed pa la/ lan du rje'i gra pa 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba mang po yod nga yang yin byas pas 'o na rnam thar bshad rgyu yod dam zer ba la med pa snyam byed cing shin tu ngo gnong ba zhig la gnyid sad byung nas sems mi bde ba snyam byed pa 'ga' byung / de rjes kyi zla ba phyi ma'i nang du nub cig rmi lam du bud med snum bag can mang po brag steng zhig na tshogs khu dir dir 'dug pa la ltar phyin pas de rnams thams cad yi ge 'ba' zhig 'bri zhing kha mi 'cham pa'i zi re ba byed pa la don gang yin labs pas/ bud med rgan mo byad dmar cham me ba so 'dzar ba zhig na re/nged rnams khyed kyi bla ma'i rnam thar rtsom pa yin zer/ khyed rnams la rgyus yod dam byas pas po ti chen po zhig 'dug pa la mdzub mo btsugs nas 'di phag mo gru pa'i rnam thar po ti yin 'di'i nang nas 'bri ba yin zer/ khyed rnams ga nas yin byas pas nga ni slob (58ba'i pon la ba pa'i dus kyi la ba'i dum bu za mkhan gyi mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo pad+ma'i dra ba can yin/ gzhan gzhon nu zhig la mdzub mo bstad nas 'di seng ge'i dra ba can yin/ gzhan 'di rnams phyogs bcu nas 'dus par 'dug zer de rjes gnyid sad bsams par rje bla ma phag mo gru pa'i rnam sprul yin pa ni nges pa can du 'dug snyam pa byung /de nas zhag 'ga' song ba na nub gsum bstud nas rmi lam du 'dre mnan gyi rnam pa yang yang du 'ong ba zhig byung bas 'di 'dra'i rigs ne gu ba rnams rlung dbu mar 'jug kha ma'i 'od gsal gyi rtags su byed/ mgon po'i rgyud dur khrod nag po nas gyib gnon lta bur 'ong ba dang zhes chos skyong gi —343—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pertags su'ang bshad/ gang ltar dge sbyor du bsrangs pa drag snyam pa byas pas nub bzhi pa'i rmi lam du sngar gyi bud med de byung nas lag tu snag tsha thod pa gang dang lcags smyug cig gtad byung nas nged rnams kyis gang labs kyang mi go bar 'dug /mi gzhan gyi bla ma'i gra pas bla ma'i rnam thar 'chos kyi 'dug zer ba'i 'phro la gnyid sad byung bas kha sang nas kyi ltas thams cad 'dir 'dug pas da sang rang nas/ rje'i rnam thar rtsom dgos snyam pa byas nam langs dge sbyor grub nas gnyid zir tsam byung ba'i rmi lam du chos khri zhig gi steng nas ban+de gzhon nu zhig gis skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khri shing sgrog gin 'dug pa nyan mkhan yin zer bud med gzhen nu mchor mo mang po glu len rkang bro byed kyin 'dug pa rmis/sang de nas 'go btsugs nas brtsams pas ma grub bar la rje bla ma lan gsum rmis (59na)gzhan yang dge ba'i ltas mang po byung / tshar khar 'dod khams lha mo yin zer ba'i bud med bong bu'i rna ba yod pa zhig gis gtso byas mang po byung nas 'di la bka' rgya zhig kyang gyis bstan pa nged rang gis bsrung zer ba byung ngo / /zhes de ltar 'dod khams dbang mos rnam thar gyi mjug tu bka' rgyas thob ces gsol ba la brten nas/ de ga'i mjug tu/ nyi gzhen 'od kyis pad tshal 'byed/ /ku mud me tog zum par byed/ /'o ma skyes bu'i 'tsho ba de/ /brang 'gro'i srog 'phrog ha la'i bdun/ /de bzhin dam pa'i ngo mtshar gtam/ /skal bzang rna ba'i ut+pal rgyan/ /skal dman log rtog can dag gi /snying la zug rngu'i bcud len 'gyur/ /de bas gsang chen gtam 'di yang / /dad dang dam tshig ldan pa dang / /spyod ldan skal ldan zur gnas la/ /ston gyis skal dman dag la min/ /zhes bka' rgya mdzad cing dpal ldan lha mo dud pa'i sol ba can 'di ni rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan yab sras rnams la dngos su zhal bstan cing gsung gi gnang ba stsol ba'i srung ma'i dbang mo khyad par can du snang /rtogs brjod 'di nyid grub nas rje btsun a wa sgru tī pa chen po'i slob ma'i gtso bo spyod pa'i rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun grol mchog la gzigs 'bul gnang ba'i lan du/ blo gsal mkhas pa'i —346

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (ta)rnam dpyod gsar pa'i mdangs/ /mkhyen yangs rgya mtsho'i lcibs kyi drung phyung ste/ /ngo mtshar dad pa'i spu long cher g.yos pas/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i mched bo gang gi (59ba)drung / /kun tu dang ba'i rtse dga'i yid gcugs kyis/ /rnam grol mchog gi go 'phang ma thob bar/ /gang la gus pa'i ting 'dzin yar ngo'i dpal/ /snying la ri mor bris te 'di skad zhu/ /dpal ldan bla mas wa ྅tī pa'i/ /rnam thar legs bshad bye ba'i rang bzhin can/ /mthong tshe mgon po nyid dang sras cu bo/ /gnyis min yid la bsam pa'i lhag bsam rnyed/ /sangs rgyas ngo bor gzigs pa'i bden pa'i bka'/ /thog mtha' bar du snyan tshig spel legs kyis/ /smra mkhas 'jam mgon dpa' bo'i sgra dbyangs la/ /tshim par mi 'gyur 'di na blo ldan su/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i 'phreng bar phul nas slar yang phul ba'i snying po bsdu ba rje btsun a wa dhū ti pa chen po 'di nyid la zhal slob gtso bor dpal sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po sogs che dgu ji snyed cig mchis kyang dbyings la ye shes kyi rgyas thebs pa ni rdo rje'i mched po gong ma khyed nyid las gzhan du mi sems pa'i dad gus snying la bcags pa'i cha rgya cher 'phel ba'i skabs nyid du gyur lags zhes bstod sngags bkur gsum gyi zhu lan 'phrod pa'i lan du/ legs bshad kun dga'i dpal ster mkhasapa'i rje/ /rnam grol bdud rtsis myos pa grub pa'i dbang / /rje btsun bla ma'i thugs sras kun gyi mchog/gang de'i zhabs sen pad+mo bzhad pa'i drung / /dam pa'i ngo mtshar ma la ya rlung gis/ /snying dbus bdud rtsi'i rlabs 'phreng stong g.yo ba'i/ /blo gsal yid bzhin rgya mtsho'i 'jing dbus nas/ /zhu mchid sprin dkar dga' ma 'di spros so/ /kwa ye lhag bsam (60na)zla shel bzhu ba'i 'od/ /snyan tshig bdud rtsis khengs pa'i zil dngar can/ /dkar gsal chu 'dzin bu mo bzhad ldan ma/ /zhu 'phrin dbyar skyesadzornga 'di skad zhu/ /a ho drin can bla ma'i thugs kyi sras/ /byang phyogs 'di na nag po spyod pa zhes/ /snyan pa'i grags dkar g.yo ba'i mkhas grub dbang / /dam tshig rdo rje'i mched de'i bka' yig gi /mtshams sprin blo mtshor shar bas snying myos kyang / /zla zhal mjal ba'i dga' ston ma thob bas/ /snying la khyod sku'i snang brnyan 'bri byed cing / /bsam gtan zol gyi bdag por ngal gso bgyi/ /nam zhig —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'amakhas pa'i zla ris gzhon nu de/ /'dren byed ri bo'i spo la shar ba'i tshe/ /snying gi ku mud 'dzum dkar bzhad byed cing / /zab dbyangs bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis sim par smon/ /skabs kyi zhu mchid snying por gsol na ge re lha khang du gnas dus/ stod lung nas bka'i glegs bu skyes bcas rje bla ma'i rnam thar rnams phyag rgyas mtshan pa phebs pas dngos su mjal ba lta bu'i spro dga'i bdud rtsi gsar pas yid kyi chu gter ci yang gang bar gyur lags/ phebs don gyi cha la bsams dus rje btsun bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid la zhal slob sngar dag pa'i zhing du gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug rje btsun kun dga' legs pa'i zhabs la sogs pa rgyal ba'i rnam par 'phrul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa kho na yin snyam pa yod cing / da lta'ang dam pa nyid lta bu mkhas pa dang grub pa'i bdag nyid ji snyed cig bzhugs bzhin du bdag lta bu rnam thar rtsom pa sogs (60ba)kyi spros pa byed na rang gzhi med kyi rloms par 'dug lags na'ang / bka' drin bdag rang la che ba zhig lags te/ bdag blun po lug bong lta bu 'di dus da lta dam pa'i chos byed 'dod dang nyams su len tshul cha tsam shes pa/ltar snang mi khyur chud tsam 'di rje'i bka' drin kho na ma gtogs med pas bka' drin dran pas byung rgyal du brtsams pa lags na'ang legs 'dug gsung ba'i mdong gsol phebs pas dam pa nyid lta bus g.yo sgyu dang gcam bu'i zol zog gsung ba mi srid pas/ cung zad mgrin pa'i gzengs bteg nas rang gis rang la the tshom du gyur lags/ slad kyi zhu ba skye rgu rnams kyi phan bde mtha' dag rgyal ba'i bstan pa kho na la rag las la de nyid 'dzin pa la deng sang gangs can gyi ljongs 'di na mkhas shing dngos grub kyis kyang brgyan pa 'phrin las kyi tha gru yangs pa sogs dge mtshan du mas mngon par mtho ba dam pa khyed lta bu mchis pas sku'i 'tsho ba yun ring du brtan pa'i thabs rnams la ched du nan tan dang ris med pa'i 'gro ba rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par bskor du gsol/ bdag kyang skabs sbyar zhal gyi dkyil 'khor lta zhing gsung gi 'bel ba'i gtam gyi bdud rtsi myang bar snying nas smon lam zhu zhing / de bar du dben pa'i ri —348

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)sul bsten tshul sogs kyi snying gtam snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs pa snang bar shar na'ang dge sbyor gyi bogs 'don du che ba zhig 'ong snyam pa'i dad pa dang dag snang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa'i bka' drin zhu zhu/ zhes(61na〉nga shog tu byung ba'i brjod don gyis rtogs par nus/ de yang dus snga phyi gsol 'debs su phyogs bsdebs las rnam thar 'di rje sgo rum pa dag zhing du gshegs rjes mdzad par dngos su bstan pas gzhan la'ang mtshon no/ /dgung lo so brgyad kyi bar du phal cher thub bstan dge 'phel du stan chags shing stod phyogs kyi sa'i cha nges med du zha khas kyis bcags skya ser 'gro ba mtha' klas pa'i re 'dod skong bzhin pa nas phal cher lha sngags ye shes kyi thugs dam zab mo'i ngang nas/ dbang 'khrid lung man ngag gis skal ldan gyi slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa dang bdag wo rdo rje lang wo po'i rnam thar yid 'phrog ut+pa la'i do shal sogs bstan bcos mdzad pas mtshon 'khor lo gsum gyi bstan pa spyi dang bye brag kha'u pa'i ring lugs phyogs brgyar 'phel bar mdzad/ mang mkhar mu gu lung du skad gnyis smra ba lo chen 'byog mi'i sku 'dra rin po che mjal bar phebs pa'i dus sku thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros te thugs gar thim pas zag med kyi bde ba chen po la yun ring zhig gi bar cham gyis gnas par gyur to/ /ris med yid 'gugs thugs rje mig gi dkyus/ /ring yang myos ldan gzhen nu'i sen rjes shul/ /lhag bsam nu mar 'dud pa'i zla bzhin mar/ /mngon 'dod rtse dga' gtong min dngos po'i gshis/ /slob bshad bdud rtsir spyod 'bu'i lha min mgrin/ /lung rigs tshangs pa'i 'khor los rab phug kyang / /thar srog mi chad cha mthun zil mngar khong / /song 'bras a ho rdzogs myang skal bzang dpyid/ /(61ba〉skug gsum me yis log 'dren 'dod lha'i lus/ /rab bsreg legs ldan mgrin sngon ral pa'i rtser/ /dbang chu'i brgyud pa chad med tshes zhag tu/ /'char ba'i zla zer phan bde'i kun+da bzhad/ /lung rtogs rin cen mi 'dzad 'byung ba'i gter/ /zab rgya gnyis spangs zhabs kyi rnam par thar/ /rtsom par lha dang mkha' 'gros brda thabs sa/ /bskul ba'i sgyu 'phrul ngo mtshar med po che/ /—349

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ smosarjes 'brangs nyi zla'i 'od snang sgra skad kyis/ /ma phyes rtogs brjod ba ku la yi kha/ /dad brtson mkhyen rab mdzes ma'i 'gram chang gis/ /phye tshe legs bshad ze'u 'bru g.yur du za/ /spyod pa'i rdo rje gzugs g.yin yongs bsgyur dang / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug bla gos mnabs pa gnyis/ /phan tshun dag pa 'byamasaklas snang ba yis/ /tha mal 'dzin pa'i kun rtog ming du zad/ /gsol 'debs las/ shar phyogs nor 'dzin lam la zhabs bkod tshe/ /rnam dkar thog ma'i rten 'brel mtha' dag 'grig /grub pa'i gnas mchog sag thang jo nang sogs/ /rim par 'khas kyis bcags la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag gi lo dgung lo so brgyad kyi dus yul dbus sman ljongs dga' ba'i tshal gyi gzhi chen por zhabs zung 'khor los mtshan pa'i re ji bkod nas lo gnyis tsam gyi bar du bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad pa'i skor gyi mang mkhar nas chibs kha bskyod de 'bras yul skyed mos tshal du phebs pa'i bar rang gi rtogs brjod lam glu dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dga' ston zhes tshig don phun sum tshogs shing byin (62na)rlabs kyi gzi byin 'od du 'bar ba'i tshig sbyor ma nyams pa la bar skabs su gsol 'debs dang stong thun dgos nges 'dra sbyar ba ni 'di lta ste/na maḥsarba gu ru bu d+dha bo dhi sa te saḥ phyi ltar na phyogs med kyi ban+de/ nang ltar na gsang chen gyi sngags 'chang / gsang ba ltar pan rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po rdo ring kun spangs pa zhes yongs su grags pa de'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang / chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i ngang du ro gcig kyang / chos can gdangs 'gags med kyi rol rtsed tha dad du shar ba/ rje de nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma gtsug gis bsten cing / bka' drin chen pos 'tsho ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i bka' 'bangs rig sngags 'chang ba'i ban+de blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ da lta ming yongs su grags pa tshar pa chos rje/ don la ci med kyi bhu su ku/ yul phyogs med du rgyu ba'i sprang po yan pa blo bde zhes bya ba des/ yul 'dar stod mang mkhar gyi pho brang du skye ba med pa la skye ba'i cho 'phrul bstan/grum stod kha'u'i brag la sgom rgyu rdul tsam med pa la sgom pa'i ro myangs/ rgyal khams phyogs med kyi —350

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanabazhi mdor rang don gyi dgos pa ci yang med bzhin du nyin mtshan yang yud du 'gro ba'i dgos don mang po spyod cing gnas pa las/ bye brag tu rang lo sum cu so brgyad yan la yul dbus kyi sman ljongs su lan gsum phyin pa'i dang po/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa rje ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs phyir 'brangs te phyin nas lo brgyad tsam bsdad/ bar pa la sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i (62ba〉〉na bdag spa ra bas gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i gser sku bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la phyin nas zla ba drug tsam bsdad de mgyogs bskor byas/ de dag gi lo rgyus rnams bshad na/ dga' ba la bsams na nam langs pa 'dra ba/ skyo ba la bsams na sa rub pa 'dra ba/ btang snyoms pa byang thang skya mo la gar byed pa 'dra ba ji snyed cig yod pa labs kyang sprang po'i glu la nyan mkhan med pas dgos pa chung bas rgyab tu skyur la zhog /lan gsum pa rang lo so brgyad pa'i dus su phyin nas lo gnyis tsam bsdad dus kyi 'phros gtam/ yas phyin gyi lam du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul gyi rtogs brjod lam glu dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i dga' ston/ ku mu da gsar pa kha bye ba 'dra ba 'di nyid smras pa la ched du dgos pa chen po mi 'dug ste/ gsang dgos pa'i mtshang yang med pas/ snang ba gdong 'ded gzhin bzhag la/da lam lab pa ngos 'di snang ba la shar byung bsags na pa zhu zhig /de yang / de gong phyin dus gra rigasasbyin bdag so sor yong ba'i khas len kyang byas yod pa dang / rjes su rim par nan tan gyi 'bod mi 'phral du byung ba dang / 'dul bar 'os pa'i snod ldan gyi gdul bya 'ga' zhig kyang 'dul ba'i dus la bab 'dug cing / rang nyid kyang yul phyogs med kyi bdud rtsi bsten na nang du sems nyid la 'gyur ba chen po zhig 'ong shas che bas/ de snga phyin pa'i dus/ sbyin bdag gis rta drel gyis bskyel bsu byas ba'i tshe/ rta rdzi drel rdzi ming ngan bsam pa chung zhing ltogs 'dod che ba rnams kyi ngo mi zin bzhin du 'dzin dgos pa de sun la skabs su mi bab pa zhig 'ong gin 'dug pa dang (63na)khyad par lam bar rnams su yang sngar chos 'brel yod pa dang / da chos zhu 'dod kyi bla ma mjal ba/ gnas bzang po dang rten khyad par can mjal ba sogs dgos don thams cad blos btang nas/ bde gzar chen po zhabrug —35/ —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'akha ma'i gser yig pa bzhin du nam langs sa rub drel khal gyi rjes la lam gzhung bsrangs nas thal mar rgyug dgos pa de ye yid la mi 'bab pa zhig byung bas/ bya bral 'gros kyi 'gro bar brtsams te phag gi lo hor zla lnga pa'i dus/ sa gzhi rnams margad gsar pas byugs pa ltar rtswa sngon gyis sngo 'jam du gyur cing / in+d+ra nī la'i rgya mtsho glo bur du rdol ba ltar chu bo dang chu phran mtha' dag rab tu rgyas shing rlabs 'phreng gis mdzes pa'i lha ba'i 'dzum dkar phyogs brgyar rgod pa/ skye bo rnams dpyid kyi dus ston bzang po la babs pas dga' zhing chags pa'i rnam 'gyur shas cher ston pa'i ri klungs kun khyab par glu dbyangs dang rgod sgra 'brel mar rgyu ba'i tshe/ gdan 'dren gyi pho nya dang bcas pa'i nged dpon slob lnga phag gsum tsam yod pa thams cad ha cang rgan pa dang gzhon pa ma yin par lang tsho dar la bab pa/ dge sbyong la 'os pa'i cha lugs ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan zhe gcig pa/ ched du spong ba lhur len pa'i mtshon byed ras dkar gyi lcog pu gangs ri'i dum bu tshal du chad pa 'dra ba re dang / rba dbyug dkar po dung gi tshugs shing lta bu re/ bsam gtan gyi 'bol chung kha gang ma gra zur ma nyams pa re/ gra chung dang gra phad zur gsum pad+ma rā ga dang pad+ma'i rtsa ba thogs su btags pa lta bu re/ skal (63bskon rjes su 'dzin pa'i slad du snyan brgyud zab mo'i be bum po ti re dang bcas pa khur/ kho bo cag rkang 'gros kyis bul bas/ rta sngon po brtan brling 'dzom pa sga srab la sogs pa dkyus thub pa zhig la zhon/ thub pas dbyar gyi ras chen gnang ba dang mthun pa'i char skyob kyi ras nam thang yug po che mu men gyi mtha' 'jag btang ba lta bu zhig gyon/ mang mkhar thub bstan dge 'phel gyi dgon pa nas chas te/ rang gi bsti gnas su cung zad ngal gsos/ 'dar stod rnam rgyal stag rtse'i pho brang gi 'dun sang mchod rten gyi rab gnas dang dga' ston bsgrubs te rim par chas pa ni 'di ltar ro/ /yid 'ong mtsho chen ngogs su mas pa yi/ /dpal ldan ngang pa'i rgyal po 'dab bzang dbang / /ngur pa bye bas bskor ba'i mdzes sdug ni/ /mkha' la li khri'i rdul dmar 'khrigs pa ltar/ /de bzhin bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen la/ /rings par chas pa'i rnal 'byor ku su li/ /ngur smig 'dzin pa'i slob —352

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)'khor dang bcas pa//yul dbus 'dzin ma'i sman ljongs yangs par chas//gang de mthong ba'i skal bzang ga cho zhe nu rnams//bde skyid phyi ma bde ba'i rnamathar can//'di 'dra'i rjes su nga yang khrid na snyam//yid kyis re smon ci yang 'debs par byed//de'i nub ha cang mi ring ba'i grong khyer don grub gling zhes bya bar skyed tshal ljon shing gi do ra 'khrigs pa zhig 'dug pa der lcog gra rnams sprin dkar gyi 'phreng ba tshar du dngar ba ltar brgyab/chos spyod kyi rim pa 'brug gi sgra ltar du ldir/rgya ja bzang po ngar ngad 'dzom pa'i 64na〉spong ba dbyar gyi chu mtsho ltar chal chil du longs spyod cing gnas pa'i tshe/de'i dgon par chos rje'i drung gis nged dpon slob 'ga' gdan drangs gzhis len shangs len bzabs ma mdzad/nang so dang sngar 'dris kyi gra pa rnams kyis kyang ja 'dren sogs legs tshogos kyi rten 'brel thog mar 'grig pa byung /de snga yan char dkon tsam yod pa la/de rjes nged dpon slob rnams so sor dgongs thun gyi rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug par rtsom pa na/phyogs tha gru nas char sprin dal bu gtibs/'brug sgra zab mo'i sgra dbyangs dang bcas pa'i char gyi rgyun chen po babs pas/'bru bcud rnams rab tu sos shing skye bo rnams yid dga' bdes 'tsho bar gyur to//bhu su ku re lam du chas pa'i tshe//de yi gtsug rgyan rje btsun kha'u pa'i//thugs rje'i dge mtshan 'od zer stong los pas//rgya mtsho'i klu rnams dga' ba'i zlos gar las//phyogs kun char sprin gsar pas ched du gtibs//sprin sum nang nas yig sgra dal gyis rgod//glog 'phreng gzhon nu'i go skabasadabye ba yi//yid bzhin spos chu'i char chen deng 'dir babs//lo tog rtsi shing nyi gzhen gyis phye ba'i//pad+mo ji bzhin phyogs bcu na 'dzum dkar g.yo//mi rnams sbrang rtsis myos pa'i bung ba bzhin//rab tu dga' ba'i dar dir glu dbyangs len//zhes bka' stsal pas char rgyun gyis 'dzin ma rnams brlan te myu gu'i 'tsho ba skyed bsring ba'i sngon 'gro'i rten 'brel 'grig pa'ang spyir dam pa 'di gang du byon pa'i sar yul khams bde zhing bkra shis par 'byung ba chos nyid yin 64ba 'a/khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos rig byed ma'i chos skor na char dbab pa'i man ngag ches zab pa dngos su phyag len ma

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)mjad na'ang / rje btsun bcom ldan 'das mas rjes su bzung ba'i byin rlabs kyi mthu dang nges pa'i don du rlung sems la dbang 'byor ba'i grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnams phyi nang rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pas/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /zhes pa ltar nang gi ting nge 'dzin gyis phyi rol gyi chos rnams bsgyur du btub pa'i gnad gsang chen por mngon/ lam yig las/ sang nyin snga bar chas nas lcags la zhes bya'i la brgal nas rim par brgyud/ lcags thang gi mda' phyug po shar pa zer ba'i khyim bdag dad pa can zhig gi lcang ra klu sdings zhig 'dug par bsdad/ der zla ba yar ngo'i tshes bco lnga rje bla ma'i tshes mchod gyi skabs su bab byung bas/ snga ma mchod chog rgyas par byas sbyin bdag des kyang bsnyen bkur 'bul ba sogs yang dag byung / sang tsha ba'i steng du bla ma zhad dgon pa ba'i sgrub gnas/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i gsung ngag rin po che gsan pa'i yul sag thang ding zhes bya bar slebs/ de'i gtsug lag khang mchod rten chos khri dang bcas pa mjal/ phyag mchod smon lam gsol gdab byas te/ dpal jo mo nang gi ri khrod chen por slebs/ de'i nub sku 'bum thang du lcog gra byas bsdad pas/ der gnas mjal la 'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi skya ser pho mo mang po 'dug pa rnams kyis/nged dpon slob la ltad mo dag snang skor ba chos 'brel zhu ba sogs mang po byung / sang snga dro sku 'bum mthong grol chen mo/ sbyor drug brgyud pa'i lha khang (65na〉sogs mjal/ ri khrod la rgyang bltas byas pas blo 'gro zhing yid 'phrog pa/ sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyis 'di lta bu'i gnas su sgrub grwa'i rgyun btsugs/ skye bo mang po thar pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa ches cher ngo mtshar zhing rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar du 'dug /kho bo cag kyang 'di lta bu'i dben gnas zhig tu byang chub sgrub pa zhig nam 'ong snyam pa snying gi dkyil du lhang lhang ba'i dag snang byung ngo / /e ma nags rgyal sman btsun dbang mo'i ri/ /ri ngos tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags kyi khrod/ /khrod yang rdo ba'i spyil chung skyid pa'i nang / /nang der byang chub sgrub pa'i skal bzang tsho/ /mthong ba'i mod la yid ni za zir gyur/ /bdag kyang nam zhig 'di 'dra'i skal bzang zhig /cis kyang sgrub snyam snying gi gseb dbrag tu/ /'gyur med dam bca'i phur pa brtan —354

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)por thebs/ /de nas mnga' skor byas zhes byung / /gsol 'debs las/ gnod sbyin dbang po'i gnas su mchod gtor phul/ /ja lung ri bor zhabrul zhig bla ma mjal/ /mkhas grub dbang po kun dga' legs pa la/ /zab mo'i dbang mchog gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /ces/pa'i don lam yig las/brag ram chos sde'i mgon khang mjal/ gnod sbyin chen po la snyan dar gsol mchod 'phrin bcol dang bcas pa rgyas par byas/ brag ram slob dpon pas gdan drangs/ ja 'dren ras dkar gyi phyag rten dang bcas pa phul/ gnod sbyin gyi chos skor zhu ba'i snyan gsan phab/ rjes su de ltar byed pa khas blangs/ de dang khad nye ba'i chu mo lung gi dgon pa na grub pa mchog gi dbang (65ba)po 'brul zhig rat+na bha dra bzhugs pa'i drung du mjal/ de nub tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bcom ldan 'das pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa khrag 'thung lha dgu'i dbang / de'i tshe dbang / bka' sdod ging lnga gza' gdong gi srog dbang bka' gtad dang bcas pa zhus/ sang 'gro khar nged dpon slob thamasacad kyis lhan cig tu slob dpon chen po la pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi sgo nas bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhus/ de'i tshe rje bla ma 'khrul zhig gi spyod pas hūṃ ring hūṃ thung gi gdangs dbyangs gar stabs nged kyi gra pa rnams la bka' bkyen dang thugs 'dogs spel ba'i hur spyod mang po mdzad kyi 'dug pas khong tsho thams cad dad pa skyes/ 'jig rten chos brgyad med pa'i bla ma zer na 'di 'dra zhig 'ong ba yin zer zhing gda'/ ja lung ri bo'i spo la zhabrul zhig rje/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i bcud kyis myos pa des/ /gar dgu'i rol rtsed hūṃ sgra sgrog pa'i tshe/ /skal ldan snying la 'dod 'jo'i bka' drin sbyin/ /zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug 'dar phya ru ba rin cen bzang pos byin gyis brlabs pa'i mgon khang brag ram du gnod sbyin chen pos zhal dngos su bstan par bka' bsgo dam bzhag mdzad pa'i tshan du 'dug /dam pa 'di nyid kyi yongs 'dzin rnams kyi nang nas drang srong bka' bzhi pa 'khrul zhig dkon cog bzang po 'di nyid bka' drin che ba'i ja ma gcig tu mdzad cing / yang gsang khros pa'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas gnod sbyin beg tse dang ging lnga gza' gdong bran du 'khol/ rigs 'dzin chen po rgod kyi ldem phru can —353

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)gyi zab gter lhun grub dgongs pa zangs thal la brten nas (66na skozho zhe nu bum skur rang rig gdod ma'i kun bzang mngon sum du rang ngo 'phrod pas phyi rol kun rdzob kyi rdzun phugs rdib nas gang shar thams cad longs sku'i zhing du 'byams klas pas rje 'di nyid kyi nyams rtogs me long la gzugs brnyan bzhin bla nas blar 'phel bar snang / lam yig las/ de nas bo dong phun tshogs rab brtan gyi pho brang na/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang po kun dga'i mtshan can bzhugs pa'i zhabs drung du mjal/ ngos kyi dpal kye rdo rje'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhus/ nged dpon slob thams cad thun mong du gser g.yabs zer ba'i 'khyams gra zhig 'dug pa der phebs/ gdan khri shin tu mtho ba la bzhugs nas sku'i gzi brjid nyi zla zil gyis gnon nusapa tsam/ gsung gi gdangs 'brug ltar ldir bzhin pas rol mo bzang po 'brol ba dang bcas tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang bka' drin bskyangs/ kho bo rang gis sngar phul ba'i dbang dril shing khul mas gtso byas zang zing gi gnang sbyin bzang po'ang gnang / nged rang ni rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po chos dbyings su gshegs rjes rje 'di nyid bla ma'i gtso bo yin zhing / rdo rje 'chang dngos kyi 'du shes yod pas dad pa dang spro ba cig car byung / gra pa rnams ni ha cang mjal dka' zhing gzi brjid che ba tsam 'dug /nged rang gra pa rnams kyi bla ma chos rje dka' bzhi ba de 'dra ba zhig yong ba yin zer ba la/nged kyis de 'dra ma zer rje 'di pa ding sang gzur gnas kyis bltas na sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang kun gyi gtso bo/ (66ba)nged rang bdag chen rdo rje 'chang chen po'i brgyud 'dzin rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu/khyad par nged rang gi bla ma'i gtso bo rdo rje 'chang dngos dang zhal mi gnyis pa zhig yin thag chod pas/so sor snying nas gsol ba thob/ byin rlabs khyad par can 'jug nges pa'i khag khur ba yin/ 'phral che khyad che ba tsam rje la chos brgyad kyi rtog pa ci mnga'/ sbyin bdag stobs ldan gyi zhabs tog la dmigs pa yin mod byas/ de mthun gnas gsar nas nang so zhal ngo rnams kyis kyang bsnyen bkur shangs len yang dag mdzad do/ /—356

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)rnam rgyal rab brtan rgyal po'i pho brang na//chos kyi rgyal po rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan//'jigasamed seng ge'i khri la 'gying bzhin du/nges don zab mo'i ngang nas ma g.yos pa'i//zhal bzang ston gyi zla shel lta bu mthong //zhabs kyi pad+ma gtsug gi rgyan du blangs//gsang chen bdud rtsis snying la bde ba thob//kwa ye grogs dag chu gter kha dog la/ma 'jigs dad pa'i gzings su zhugs shig dang //bshes gnyen dam pa'i ded dpon bka' drin gyis//dngos grub nor bu thob par the tshom med//sasteng 'di na rje btsun sa skya pa'i//bstan 'dzin yongs kyi ral ba'i zur phud la//mkhas dang grub pa'i zhabs sen ngal gso ba'i/kho bo'i gtsug rgyan sngags 'chang 'di 'dra dkon/zhes pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang wo po'i zhal slob kyi khrod kyi rdo rje 'chang kun spangs 0 po'i 'og nas mkhas grub kyi dbang po rje bzhi sgo wo pa r+ṣa po 'di nyid 'gran zla dang bral ba yin zhing /rje 'di nyid kyis kyang thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi rtsa ba'i 67na / bla ma gcig tu mdzad/'di'i skabs lha rigs 'a zha'i saskyong bar byang gtsang gi phugs su bdag po sngags 'chang pa'i mi srun sgyu 'phrul gyi 'khor lo ma 'khor ba'i mnga' thang sgang la rgyab pa nas rje sgo rum par zhabs tog shin tu che ba'i gzi brjid kyi nyi 'od blo chung me khyer rnams kyis ma bzod pa'i rigs su snang /lam yig las/de nas rdzi lung du zhag gcig bsdad/sang nyin dge sdings na dpal sa skya'i chos kyis mngon par mtho ba'i khri la bzhugs pa/bdag chen rin po che khri thog pa'i drung bzhugs pa dang mjal/de snga nas dpon slob 'dris pa lta bu'i nang gtsang zhing thugs 'gol bas bka' lung bag phebs par gnang /nged rnams la bdag chen thams cad mkhyen pa chen po mdzad pa'i bla ma mchod chog rgyas bsdus kyi lung /de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'dod zhug ltar bka' drin bskyangs/sku na phra mo de lta bu la 'di 'dra'i lugasakyi gnang skyong dang ngo mtshar ba 'ong ba nges par 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul yin pa la the tshom mi za ba 'dug snyam pa'i dad mos dang /sa skya pa'i rmongs zhen gyis blo bde ba tshad med pa byung /byin rlabs kyi rten gnang sbyin sogs yang dag thugs rjes bzung zhes byung /gsol 'debs las/khro phu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pedaga' ldan byams pa'i bsti gnas su/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i sprul pas lung bstan zhing / /ḍā ki'i sku la shel dkar myu gu ltar/ /gsal ba'i 'od snang gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ /che'i/pa ltar lam yig las/ de'i nub khro phur phyin 'du khang chen po zhig 'dug pa der sdod sa byas/ nged (67ba)rang gcig pur zhal ras lha khang gi phyi skor byed cing yod tsa na/ skor lam de na bud med gzhen nu nad pa yin zer ba zhig khyel byas nas 'dug /skor ba 'ga' song tsa na de la mche ba je ring yong gi 'dug /mig 'khrul ba'am/ krung krum lta bu la bcos nas 'jigs pa ston pa yin nam snyam pa'i tshe mthar kha thams cad mche ba skya zang nge ba mtho re lhag pa tsam gyis khengs pa/ dpral ba'i dkyil na khrag gi mig sman tshe lung thang gi rdog po 'dra ba zhig byas har te langs byung bas/ 'di srin mo'am 'bal mo lta bu zhig yin pa 'dug snyam yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang bcas pas lag tu 'phreng ba khur nas ded pas skor lam la bros song / rjes la bcug phyin pas lho phyogs kyi khyim tshang gi nang zhig tu bros nas sgo de nang nas bcad song / de 'phral 'og tu log gam snyam pa la/ sems theng nge ba 'dra ba zhig byung nas skor ba gsum tsam byas pas/ khang pa de'i steng nas bud med de'i mgo 'dra ba zhig skra zing nge ba mthong tsam byas/ skad gdangs ngar che ba'i gdangs ma dbyangs la/ dad mos kyi snang ba mi 'dug kyang / /tshe sngon gyi las 'brel gcod thabs med/ khrag 'dzag srin po'i ri la phrad/ /'phan dkar gyi ljongs su rjes su 'dzin/ /'jigs snang log lta ma byed ang / /bde chen longs spyod rnal 'byor pa/ /zer ba zhig labs byung ba'i mod la sngar gyi 'jigs snang de zhig pa 'dra ba'i rig pa had de ched de ba/ lus ljid med pa 'dra ba'i za zi ban bun/ rdog pa gar rgyab mi shes pa/ snang ba 'di gsal la bstad so med pa skad bton la (68na/rgyug gam snyam pa zhig byung bas 'di bar chad dam dngos grub gang yin mi shes pa 'dug /da res nas brda zhig ston pa ma byung / /da mngon du ma gyur pa la gsang dgos snyam zla'o rnams la bgros ye ma btang / de'i nub 'og gi 'du khang nang gi lcog bur bsdad pa'i tshe/ gtor bsngo sogs spros bcas kyi dge sbyor rnams kyang de ga'i ngang du 'gro ba zhig byung / ci yin nam cha med —358—

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanaya mas ni che snyam dge sbyor gyi ngang du sral/der byams li/sku 'bum r+sā mo/rnam sras rang byon sogs mjal/phyag mchod smon lam yid ches pa btab/sang tsha thon la dge sdings nas bdag chen rin po tsho phyag phyi drung 'khor ga smo pa kha cig kyang gnas mjal la byung /nged tshos ja bzang po bskol nas drangs/dag snang byas thams cad bsdongs nas zhal ras lha khang mjal/de na phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sku li ma zhig 'dug pa de'i phag zhal dang thog gi bar la shel gyi 'khar ba btsugs pa lta bu zhig 'dug pas/'di gang yin byas lag pa reg pas 'od ma gtogs reg rgyu mi 'dug/dkon gnyer de na re/de phag zhal yin pa gda' zer/de khong rnams kyi ma mthong ba 'dug pas kha rog bsdad/sku de la mgo gtug te dbang bzhi blangs smon lam btab bo//lar rje bas mkha' spyod dbang mo 'di nged rang la thog ma nas dgyes pa zhig yin 'dug pas/rje bas rdo ring pa wo po'i gsung nas kyang /chos rje la mkha' spyod ma'i byin chas byas resakyi nged la ltas khyad par can re yong gi 'dug/'bad rtsol mdzad na 'dis mkha' spyod la 'khrid 64wo gda'o gsung ba yod cing /'di skor gyi gtam mang bo zhig yod de/snod mi 'dug pas nam mkha'i dbyings su phaṭa/sprang rgyal khams phyogs med rgyu ba'i tshe/khul ya mtshan gyi ltad mo 'di ltar mthong //shab dge sdings rdo rje'i pho brang na//rje sa skya lo tswa'i sku yi dpon//thugs gcig tu 'dres pa sras kyi mchog/khong 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu dngos dang mjal//gsung bag phos kyi bdud rtsi snying la sim//chos zab lam gyi rnal 'byor bka' drin zhus/khong skyon bral gyi mdzad 'phrin mthong ba'i tshe//nged saskya pa'i mdun ma grub 'dug snyam//sems dga' spro dang dad pas mchi ma 'khrug/zhabs spyi gtsug tu blangs nas smon lam bto//der shab stod kyi chu klung brgal nas phyin//yul ya mtshan can khro phu'i gtsug lag slebs//lha byams mgon gyi sku bas zhal bzang mthong //rten khyad par can kun la byin rlabs zhus//ma mi min mkha' 'gros 'jigs gzugs bstan//nga khro rgyal gyi nga rgyal dbyingasanas rgyas//mtshon 'phreng lcag gi 'ded drag btaX ba'i tshe/khong lung bstan gyi sgra dbyangs sgrog pa

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)skad/ khyod ye shes kyi ḍā zhi'i lung bstan dang / /mo sha zan gyi mkha' 'gro'i rgyang 'bod gnyis/ /nga rnal 'byor gyi sems la bde sdug med/ /gang yin kyang rang ngo dbyings su snyam/ /a la la rgyal khams bskor ba'i tshe/ /sngon med kyi ltad mo a re 'jigs/ /sems nyid kyi rang gdangs yin par go /drin can gyi bla ma de sku drin che/ /dpal mkha' spyod kyi dga' ma yid 'ong ma/ /dus ring nas bskyangs pa'i ma ma des/ /da rigs 'dzin gyi grub pa ster ba'i (69na)brda/ /yongs ngo mtshar gyi zlos gar ci yang rtse/ /zhes yang ba khyab bdag bla ma 'di nyid 'das ma 'ongs pa'i gnas lugs mtha' dag gsal bar gzigs pa'i mngon mkhyen thag thogs mi mnga' na'ang kun tu rgyus 'phags pa mod la gyi bu bcoms pa'i lo rgyus ltar chos gos 'og gi dug mdar ma dgongs pa'i bsngags brjod che na'ang rgyu mtshan 'og tu rim gyis gsal/ khro phur rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo mtshar cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa dang phag zhal gyi steng nas 'ja' tal le zug pa slar thugs gar thim pas zhag mang por zag med kyi bde chen kho nar 'byams pa sogs drang srong srin po ri dang 'phan dkar gyi ljongs su rjes su 'dzin/ zhes pa'i don ltar rjes sor 'phan yul du phebs pa'i lam zhig tu nam mkha' nas me dpung 'ur sgra dang bcas byung ba ci yin snyam gzigs pas chibs sga'i snga ru'i steng bab ma thag rnal 'byor mar gyur nas sku la 'khril bas zhag bdun gyi bar zag med kyi bde chen kho na'i ngang du song ba sogs rjes su 'dzin pa'i lung bstan du nges/ lam yig las/ de nas gnas kyi mda' na dam pa dmar po'i rus yin zer ba zhig gi lag na gdung rus las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku dang sras kyi thugs rang byon yin zer ba sogs 'dug pa mjal/ de'i nub gangs can chos 'phel gyi dgon pa'i 'khris/ lha mo dmag zor ma'i bla mtsho yin zer ba/ mtha' ljon pa'i tshal gyis bskor ba'i dbus na ne'u gsing gi dkyil na mtsho chung khor pa zhig 'dug pa'i kha stod skyid skyid 'dra ba zhig 'dug pa der lcog gra byas bsdad/ ja bzang skol zhing chos (69ba〉〉da byas pas gra pa rnams byon byung nas/ /'di pa cha lugs sogs rtogs ldan du mi 'dug /gra mthun la skyid mdog rnam pa sgo yangs pa zhig 'dug pas/ sdeb zil gnon —360

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)pa lta bu zhig brdzus pa yin nam zer/gcig na re nga dang zhal 'dris yod/sdeb zil gnon pa yin thag chod 'dug zer bas/phal cher de la yid ches song /su yin zer ba la/nga ci med kyi sprang po yan pa blo bde bya ba yin no ang byas pas/khyed rang su yin kyang nyams dga' la snang ba bde ba zhig 'dug zer ro//thag khra sbrul du zhakhrul ba'i snang ngo na//'jig skrag los la thug pa don byed nus//yid ches mos gus ldan pa'i gang zag la/khyi so ring bsrel phung sor song ngo skad//ming tsam brda tsam btags pa kho na la'ang //rang rang ngo bos grub pa rdul tsam med//ci med cir yang 'char ba'i ngo mtshar can//rten 'brel zab mo'i rang mtshang de ru rig skye bos bzhi mdor smra ba'i khungs med gto//gang zer bden par 'dzin pa'i blo chung tshos//gzhi med ri bong cal gyi sgra dbyangs kyis//rang gzhan mang po'i rang mtshang ston r+sā gda'//zhes byung /gsol 'debs las/chu mig nang gi rten mchog mtha' dag mjal//zab lam rdo rje'i pho brang e waṃ du//skal bzang rang rang blo dang la0 pa yi//chos kyi dga' ston spel la gsol ba 'debs//zha lu gser bkang chos gra chen po sa/bstan srung lha mo'i rnam sprul bud med gzigs//mtshan nyid kun ldan yongs 'dzin ku swā lis//dbang dang rjes gnang stsal lagaso leb 'debs//zhes70na tha lam yig las/stag la skya mo dung gi sgo brgal te/rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas gtsang chu mig ring mor slebs/de nub gnas la byas/sngon zangs dkar lo tsā bas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang /gnyan sgrol/'phags pa rin po che'i sku 'dra sogs bzhugs pa'i lha khang /bdag chen rin po che grags blo bas bzhengs pa'i mgon khang sogs mjal/gsol gdab smon lam yid ches par byas/de dag la ngo mtshar zhing byin rlabs kyi zil gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig 'dug pas dad mos tshad med pa skyes/ding sang zhabs ga bdag rkyen cher med pa'i gogs nyams chen po 'dug pa la sems kyis mi bzod pa'i skyo snang yang yod pa zhig byung /sang wo nyi ma phyed yol tsam na ngor e waṃ chos ldan du slebs/mdzo mo ra ba yod pa'i spang steng der lcog sgar byasaXsdad/lam zab lha khang du bla ma'i rnal 'byor rgyas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)pa zhig blangs/ spyi sgos kyi bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam btab/ g.yin yang lam 'bras lha khang gis gtso byas pa'i rten gsum rnams kyang mjal/ dbon po rin cen seng ge bas gzhis len skabs bab byas/ khrom thog dbon po sogs 'dod chos dgos zer ba mang dag byung bas/ thog cig la gur mgon gyi rjes gnang byas/ 'phral mkho'i ja gos dar sogs 'bul ba'ang 'ga' byung / de nas zha lu la chasate phyin pa'i lam bar nas lcags stod mthong byung bas/ nged tsho sa skya pa'i yus po che'i mi gsum gyi nang nas/ shar smad tsong kha'i (70ba'i ge bshes rin cen brtson 'grus kyi brgyud pa/ dpon chen dben shrī rgyal ba bzang po dang / hu shrī rgod po rin cen sogs rim par brgyud pa'i pha tshan shin tu nye ba zhig yin pas/ khong tsho dar rgud dang bde dog gang 'dra zhig yod dam snyam dgos med 'jig rten gyi rmongs zhen zhig skyes/ zhu rag gi bsam pa med kyang bya bral gyi gnas skabs semasang la gang shar lag tu blangs chog snyam pas der phyin/ khong tsho'i gzhis ka'i stod der lcog gra byas/ ngas lcog bur bsdad/khong gra pa rnams nyams dga' dang sbrags pas bsngo ba smon lam rgyab pas mang ja nyung ja gdan gnon dang bcas pa bskyal song / su yin zer ba la nged rnams la stod mthon po nas yin zer ba byas na'ang /rjes su ngor pa'i gra pa 'ga' sogs rim par brgyud nas cha tsam ngo shes 'dug pas/ dpon 'og ma 'dra ba'i mi gzhen zhig nga'i rtsar byung / 'di 'dra yin pa 'dra zer ba'i rtsad gcod zhib po byed kyin 'dug pas ci nas nged bya bral du song bas skyug bro byas dogs sbam me bsdad pa yin/ ngo bo de ltar yin pas mjal phrad tsam mdzad 'dod yod na de ga bgyis pas chog byas pas kho log song / re zhig nas slebs nas/ deng sang sku mtsham me ba zhig yod pas mjal ma bde byung / sang nyin cis kyang bzhugs pa gnang dgos zer ba la/ mjal bzhed med pa thugs dang bstun pas chog pa 'dug /nged tsho rgyal khams la ring po yod sdod pa'i long med byas/ don la rang gi rigs rus dang pha tshan sogasagang yin gyi blang dor med pa'am/ yang na mi sngun du ngo 'degs mi thub pa zhig (71na〉sgod pa yin yong / nga la shākya thub pa'i bka' drin gyis phyogs gang la phyin kyang bsnyen bkur byed mkhan ni thogs 362

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanamed 'ong gi 'dug /'di skor gyi zhen thag de chod pas blo bde/ lar btsun pa gnyen sred ches pa la de 'dra mang po 'byon/ khyod snying tshim tshim snyam pa byas/ nam zi la langs phyin/ nged tsho'i rjes la masakaphran bu dang bcas lam sna ba yin zer ba zhig btang byung / mi dgos log rgyug byas kyang mi nyan par zha lu bar phyin/ de nub rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang gi mgon khang mjal bas der gtor ma'i 'khris su bud med gos dkar khra gyon pa zhig byung ba de mthar phyi nang gang du song cha med pa la yal ba lta bu zhig byung / zha lu gnas kyi gser bkang gi thugs rje chen pos gtso byas steng shod kyi lha khang mgon khang rnams zhib par mjal/ gzhal yas khang gi mdo der drung chen bya ba yin zer ba'i gyod rgan bka' brgyud pa la rgyab rten bcol ba/ dom ra dang slel bem gyi sgrib shing rgyan pa zhig dang / drung rgyal ba zer ba'i ban gzhen mig ltag pa na yod pa 'dra ba zhig 'dug pas/ khong tsho ge ja 'dren gzhis len byas/khong rang tsho dang blo bstun pa'i cha le cho le mang po labs btang bas shin tu dga' song / de na je lasapa bya ba 'grul pa thams cad la za 'dod byed pa zhig 'dug pas/ slong mo dgos zer byung bas/ nged rang rnams sprang po ni mnyam por 'dug /khyed tsho zha lu ba yin snyam pa yod na'ang / nged tsho 'dar pa yin sprad chog byas pas thams cad bzhad gad theg ge byung nas za 'dod cher ma byas/ de nub ri phug tu phyin/ bu ston thams cad (71ba〉khyen pa'i chos khri'i mdun der lcog gra byas bsdad/ nā lan+da'i bco brgyad pa'i 'tsho byed cig yod pa des gzhis len bsnyen bkur zur chas sogs zhabs togo yang dag byas/ sang de ri phug bla brang na bzhugs pa'i bu ston rin po che'i sku 'dra phyag nas mas gtso byasapa'i rten gsum shar chen gyi rten sogs zhib par mjal/ mkhyen rab rin po che'i zhal slob bsresapo zhig 'dug pa la phyag rdor 'gro bzang gi dbang / rnam sras zhi drag gi rjes gnang / rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bka' gtad yig lung dang bcas pa zhus/ de nub rdzing phur brag sgo ba zer ba'i khams pa phyug po zhig gis gdan drangs der phyin/ tshe dbang / rta mgrin gyi rjes gnang sogs byas/ ja bzang po zhig phul byung bsal ma ja la shin tu mkho ba byung / zhen med kyi nye du'i sgo bsnyegs pas/ /dgos med kyi —363

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelam stabs de ru bcag /don med kyi lung sbug bskor ba'i 'bras/ /'brel med kyi sa mtshams de ru bris/ /spyir sems can kun drin can pha mar 'dug /sgos su byams gnyen la gang skyid yul/ /nga bya bral gyi mdun ma yang rtser yod/ khyed pha tshan sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /dpal zha lu gser bkang gi dgon pa na/ /ban smyon kun gri rings la shal 'dzunas byed/ /mi bsad la ya 'ud mi gda' bas/ /sprang po ngas ri phug dgon par bros/ /sngar 'dris kyi slob mas zhabs tog bzang / /ku su lu'i bla ma lam du mjal/ /gang zhus kyi chos 'brel lhug par gnang / khong bka' drin mi chung che bar 'khums/ /lar da lta gangs ri'i ljongs 'di na/ /dgon spyi chos kyi rang tshugs(72na 'dzin pa la/ khong 'gran zla bral ba'i zha lu pa/ /bod chos sde tsho'i srog shing dam pa lags/ /zhes gsung ba bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba brgya phrag tu longs pa byung na'ang rgya mtsho mtha'i skad shes pa kho bo las ma byung zhes bsnyems pa'i tshul 'dzin pa 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyi rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa'i rje btsun sgrol ma 'gangs can de mjal ba gnang ba'i mnal lam du bud med gzhen nu gos sngon po gyon pa zhig byung nas 'di gnyan lo sbrul gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas gsang ba'i thugs dam gyi lha de yin zer ba sad tshe rje btsun ma sgrol ma dngos su mos pa'i thugs dad 'khrungs/ rting res snar thang byang chen du phebs skabs dkon gnyer gyis mgon po zhal shing gi mchod rten 'di la gnas pa yin zer de nub der gzims pas ā tsarla zhig byung nas me 'bar gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi'i ngos 'dzin dang bcas pa smra zhing khyed rang gi gnas khyed rang gis ngo los shes zer dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs ston pa byung ba zhal gyi rnam 'phrul yin gsung / lcags stod kyi lo rgyus ni lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med du gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor pa bzang ngan gnyis 'dzin gyi mtha' las 'das pa gnyen srid ci la mnga' na'ang / rang cag snyigs mar spyod pa'i dge spyod sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo nas bshad pa'i tha ma'i rigs rnams la bag yod byed dgos zhes gdams par snang / lcags sgog lung pa bkra shis dpal 'byor de skabs grags chung yang ku su lu'i —364

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)mkhas grub chen por dgongs te chos 'brel gsan cing (72ba)rgyan gong du lha mos rnam 'gyur zur tsam byung ba sogs ni dus phyis chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i khrir phebs nas bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal ba'i rten 'brel du ma rga/ gsol 'debs las/ gus ldan sbyin pa'i bdag po'i bar chad bsal/ /nye bar mkho ba'i rnyed dang bkur sti bsgrubs/ /thar dgon sman lung gnas kyi lha khang mjal/ /rigs brgyud srung ma mchod la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa lam yig las/ khong brag sgo ba bya ba'i phyug po de/ /mig rgya khab las phra ba zhig yin zer na'ang / /nga bya bral la lam ja bzang po phul/ /dus gzhan gyi ja sigs gcig las dga'/ khos khengs dregs kyi brnyas pa yin las che/ /yul rgyan gong gi lha mo de gnod kyi 'dug /ngas gtor ma dang bka' bsgo drag po byas/ /de re zhig log nas bde bar byung / /de nas thar pa dgon par slebs/ de nub bsdad nas de'i steng shod kyi lha khang mgon khang rnams ni ba par mjal/ sang tsha thog tu sman lung du phyin/ bla brang pa de pa dang nye tshan rnying pa zhig tu 'gro bas ngo shes byas/ gzhis len yang dag byung / nā ro'i rgyan drug kha che paṇa chen gyi sku chos sogasakyi byin rlabs zhus/ gtsang khang gi rten gsum/ 'e ti'i gdung 'bum sogs mjal/ stag zhen mgon khang du gtor gsos snyan dar 'phrin bcol yid ches par byas/ de nas pa rnam gzhung la phyin/ grong stod du zhag sdod byas/ sang nyin snga bar phyin lhun grub rtser slebs/ ngas gnas tshang zhig tu bsdad/zla'o rnams gzims khang sogs kyi ltad mo dang / zhar la bsod snyoms kyang byed/ sde(73na po pon chos la dkar po zhig yod pa 'dug zer nas song / khong rnams kyis nyi phyed bar bskugs pas lan tsam yang ma khugs/ nged rang rnams kyi tsha thebs kyang chag pa zhig byung nas log byung / lar gnangasachung la blo rig rgod pa'i sdod pon dbon skya'i rigs 'di/ lug thug gi sgro bas wa mo'i nyin thebasagacog ba ma gtogos dgos pa mi 'dug bas de 'dra'i rigs la bya bral rnams la ma gzhung srong ba rang gnad du gda'/ de nas bsam sdings dgon par slebs nas de nub gnas tshol byas bsdad/sang nyin de'i ba gu brgyud pa'i pho khrom mgon khang / yang dgon gyi lha khang mgon khang sogs mjal/—365

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)chos rje'i drung du nged dpon slob rnams kyis bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel zhus/ sger gyi mgon dkar gyi rjes gnang zhus pas ma gnang bar/ rtsis kyi mgon po lha chen dpal 'bar gyi rjes gnang bka' drin bskyangs/ de nas rtsis gnas gsar gyi lha khang mgon khang rnams mjal/ sde pa bsod nams rab brtan pas gzhis len shangs len sogs yang dag mdzad/ der 'dol chung na tsha mo zhig yod pa des 'bod du rta pa gnyis rkang tshugs btang byung nas cis kyang yong dgos pa'i nan tan byed kyi 'dug pas khong byings po der bzhag /nged dpon slob 'gas skor tsam phyin pas gnas tshul nges par byung ba lags so/ /thar dgon sman lung 'phrul gyi lha khang mjal/ /pha mes brgyud pas bsten pa'i mgon gnyan de/ /snyan dar ba ling rgya mtshos mchod byas te/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i 'phrin las bka' bsgo byas/ /(73ba)de nas pa rnam rdzong gi gzhung du phyin/ /'khor rnams gtor tshogs med pa'i rnga gshang gi /sgra dbyangs snyeg pa'i bya rog bzhin du 'gyod/ kho bo pho tshod che ba'i khrom thog chod/ /phyin chad phyogs 'dir 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor rnams/ /'di 'dra'i rigs la rim pa ltar 'dzem mdzod/ /zer ba'i rgyang glu len zhid bsam sdings kyi/ /ri la 'dzegs pas lugs gnyis 'dod pa tshim/ /yang smras pa/ nyang stod kyi a mo 'dol chung na/ /tsha mo zhig yod pas nan gyis bos/ /rngan chen dang gnyis len bsres se ba/ khram dus kyi kha rgyan bcas pa byung / /gter sbyin 'dra yod snyam yod tshod gda'/ /nga rgyal khams kyi longs spyod char ltar babs/ /chos ldan gyi 'gro sa tshags las mang / /dpon ngan gyi khral 'bab yod don med/ /tshom po la snum bskus ma re mdzod/ /ces gsungs/gsol 'debs las/ bsam sdings grub pa'i gnas sogs rim brgyud de/ /yul ljongs rnams su dad ldan bkur stis mchod/ sham+bha ra gnas su 'dren mchog bla ma la/ /bstan srung rjes gnang gsan la gsol ba 'debs/ /dus der ye shes chen po'i gzigs snang du/ /zhun chen dud sprin me rlung 'tshub pa'i dbus/ /'jigs rung stag spyon zhen pa'i mon pa che/ 'khor bcas gsal bar shar la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes lam yig las/ de nas bod kyi lha btsan po'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa skya bo byang chub —366

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)sems dpa'i mdzad pa lhur len pa/ 'brong rtse nas khri nam mkha' bsod nams kyi drung bzhugs pa'i gzhis ka rnam sras mthong smon dang khad nye ba zhig (74nad+ku slebs/ su yin rtsad gcod mi gnang byung bas/ dpal ldan sa skya skor nas yin zer ba'i brdzus se ba zhus kyang dgongs nas cis kyang shogs gsungs nas phyin/ zhabs togo gzhis len yang dag thugs dkar bas kun nas bslangs pa mdzad/sde pa'i drung du pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa/ bka' sdod rnams kyi srog dbang sogs phul/ gzhan yang 'dod chos kyi thugs bzhed mang po 'dug pa yar lam 'bul ba'i khas len zhuganas rgyal mkhar rtser phyin rdzong rgyab tu lcog gra byas bsdad pas/ gnas chen pasacis kyang yong dgos gsungs/ dpal 'khor bde chen gyi shag tu bos gzhis len mdzad/ nang sosasne sbyor mdzad nas chos sde'i lha khang steng shod/ mchod rten chen po/ rgyal rtse'i li ma lha khang / gzims chung steng shod 'ga'i rten rnams zhib par mjal/ rgyal rtse nas sde pa chen mo de nyin re bzhin chos sde la zhabs skor la sgrigs bcug phebs pa mthong bas/ deng sang gi a po hor 'dra'i don spyi yod pa zhig mi 'dug na'ang / chos rgyal gyi mdzad spyod skyo sun med par bsgrigs su bcug pa 'di tsam rang thog tu babs na'ang nus pa dka' bas nges par chos rgyal du 'dug snyam pa'i dag snang chen po byung /de rjes 'brug pa ngag dbang chos rgyal dang de gong nas gsung chos kyi 'brel pa yod pas mjal ba dang ra lung bskor ba sbrags mkha' ro nas yar 'phrog gi nang la zhugs/ do ri sogs gnas mjal rim par byed 'dod yod na'ang gra pa rnams kyang mgyogs skor la dga' ba tsam 'dug cing /(74bsdad rang gi rkang tshab kyi rta de yang babs kyi rnam pa yod pa zhig byung ba sogs phyogs du ma nas mdor bstan pas 'phred la bcad de rong chung la 'gro ba'i gros thag bcad do/ /bod rgyal po gzhen nus gtsug gis mchod/ shar rgyal po'i mdzad pas yid rab grogs/ /rta mdo phyug gi bang 'gros de ru zad/ khong gra pa kun za thag nye la dga'/ /dpal ra lung gi ri khrod lta ba dang / /pha ngag dbang chos rgyal mjal snyam tshe/ /lus 'khos med kyi rkang pas rang mtshang bstan/ /nga lugs gnyis —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'akyi blang dor mi zhan yang / /lus rkang pa'i zhabrul 'khor 'dor len bral/ khong dud 'gro la 'gro 'dug gi skyabs gnas 'chol/ /nga mi phyed du 'dug snyam snying khong grang / /nga yang cig bsams pa 'di ltar shar/ /gnas lugs la lta ba'i mig yod na/ /chu bur gyi khra jig med kyang chog /ci bsams kun 'grub pa'i blo yod na/ sha rus kyi rkang pa med kyang chog /sems nyid kyi yang dgon mthong tsa na/ /ra lung gi ri ltas de gar gda'/ /dad mos kyi rang zhal mjal tsa na/ /mtshan ldan gyi bla ma de gar gda'/ /gang byung gi chog na ci byas bde/ /bya btang gi blo sna gang shar yin/ / 'gyur med kyi bden grub med pas 'tshengs/ /rong chung la sprang po'i lam sna zug /dpal 'khor bde chen du bsdad pa'i dgongs de/nged ni gnas chen pa'i mkhar las byed snang gi nang 'u lag pa dang thug tshom gyi khengs pa der nan med byas sgor bas zhe sun la tshig pa za/ zla'o rnams ni de'i nub char lhags 'dres pa zhig gis lcog bu rnams bsgyel/ 'dam bag gi dkyil du nyal dgos(75na byung 'dug /nged rnams chos sde'i sgor 'dzom tsa na thams cad phar yus tshur yus su 'dug pas/ ngas khas ma blangs par sngon la thal le phyin/ nyang stod gu la'i phu de na pho rog mdo sde mgon po bya ba'i grub thob cig gi sku 'dra snyan grags can/ mgon khang dang bcas pa 'dug pa mjal/ de nub dpon slob thams cad rnam sras mthong smon du 'dzom/ sang mkhar kha'i mdun man lung dgon pa'i 'khris la byas/ thu ru stag tshal zer ba'i lung nang du zhag gcig bsdad/ sang de snga bar la shin tu che ba zhig brgal phyin pas/ rong sham bha ra gyi dgon par tsha ba phyi ba la slebs/ sham bha ra chos rje'i drung du mjal/ mgon po stag zhen 'khor bcas kyi dbang rjes gnang /rong pa'i stag zhen gyi phur dbang du grags pa'i rten mjal bka' bsgo dang bcas pa zhus/ chos skyong de'i chos skor tshad ma dang / zhal bzhi pa'i las mkhan pu tra nag po rnams zhu ba'i rjes su slebs pa'i rgyu mtshan phul/ zhal bzhes kyang phebs so /lha snyan sham bha ra mgul gyi dgon par slebs/ /'khrul zhig bla ma'i zhal bzang ma rnga zhe du byas/ /pha mes brgyud kyi srung ma nag po de'i/ /sku brnyan mthong zhing dbang dang rjes gnang thob/ /de nub gnas —368

tshar wo blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)der nyal ba'i 'char sgo la//gnyid 'chag thog 'tsheg ba spu zing nge ba//mngon sum rmi lam gang yang ma yin pa'i//'og 'gyu'i tshul gyi za zi'i 'char tshul ni//gsur dud me dmar 'tshub ma'i lung stong na//stag chen spyon pa zhen pa'i mon nag cig/bstan dgra dam nyams 'tshol zer rgyug cing 'bral//75bstong gsum khu sgras 'gengs shing yod do snyam//res 'ga' ling pa khyi khrid mang po yis//ri dwags 'ded cing bsha' ba'i dmar phyog dang //gzhan yang stag gzig dom dred bya lug sogs/khyug 'bral 'phur lding ban bun za zi yis//nam langs bar du thub pa'i zhagi la snang byung //de dag legs par bsams tshe pha rgod rje'i//bstan srung mchog 'di mngon sum zhal gzigs nas//sgos dgra kha khyer khur nas za ba sogs//'jigs su rung ba'i las rjes ma' du bstan//de yi rigs 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag yin pas//da dung 'di yis dam nyams mang po la//dag po'i las sbyor 'grub pa'i ltas su go/de nas sha ra'i gru lcags thon pas/de'i gru shan gyi rta mgo'i ngos la rin spungs nas sde pa'i bka' shog lcags leb la gzong ris bris pa gser chus byugs pa la/gru lcags 'di dge rgyun la btsugs pa dang /mnyan pa la gzhis zur na byin yod pas/za 'dod kyi gtser ba byung na ngo bsrungs med pa'i zhu bas slebs pa gyis/phyis 'doms pa'i khrims lugs byed zer ba gzer gyis bsdams nas brgyab 'dug cing /mkha pa de rnams kyang snga gong dang mi 'dra ba'i ngo gnong ba byas/stogs 'dod cung zad byed 'dod pa'ang gnang sbyin zhu ba yin zer ba las mi 'dug pas/gzhis ka rin spungs pa khrims dam zer ba'i snyan grags bden par 'dug/rgyal po khrims lugs yod pa'i sa phyogs 'di 'dra ba zhig yong ba yin/snyoms chung lam bde ba/rdzas ldan blo bde ba sogs bsod nams dpag med 'ong ba 'dug/ngo mtshar snyam pas sde pa 7na〉'ang dag snang ci yang skyes/zhes 'byung bsabs ma sdings nas rim gyis 'chi med kyi grong khyer la co 'dri ba nyang stod kyi yul gru rnams zhabs kyis bcags nas sham+bha ra du yab mes kyis chos skyong dpal mgon stag zhen nag po'i chos skor rnams gsan pas bstan dgra sgo gcod pa'i ltas ma rga sum du bstaX cing /rje 'di nyid la brgya spyo phrom/drang nga kun

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lozhegrags/ chos dbang / o rgyan gling pa sogs kyi gter nas byon pa dang / jo bo chen po/ dpyal pa sogs las 'ongs pa'i stag zhen mtha' dag gi bka' babs pa'i be'u bum yang dbang lung man ngag thams cad khungs btsun brgyud pa las nye bar 'ongs te yid brtan du gyur pa ma gtogs khungs med dang lung med kyi dpe hrul sdud pa'i zog spyod mkhan po rnams dang 'dra ba ni ma yin no/ /gsol 'debs las/ skyed tshal dgon par chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad/ /smyug ri'i yang rtser rje btsun 'phrin las pas/ /'dzum zhal bstan nyid dgyes pas byin 'gyas brlabs/ /gsung gis rjes su bsngags la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa lam yig las/ de nub tsob yul skyed tshal du slebs/ gra pa rnams shol rag chen po der lcog gra byas/ sger gyis mkhyen rab chos rje'i dbon/ nged kha'u brag rdzong pa'i gra rigs kun gyi gtsug rgyan rje brag dkar rab 'byams pa bzhugs pa'i gzigs spyil du phyin nas mjal/ dad pa dang dag snang bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'kha 'phros 'bel gtam 'ar ma 'ur ma byas skyed tshal ba'i gra pa sngags chos kyi 'dod chen che ba mang dag la'ang rjes gnang rig (76ba)gtad lung sogs mang po byas/ de'i tshe dme pa mi bskyod rdo rje gzhu lung par phebs/ sde pa rin spungs pas gdan 'dren zhu rtsis dang / mnga' zhabs kyi skya ser thams cad la zhabs tog dang bsu ba sogs kyi khral rgyab/ thams cad dga' ba dang skyo ba spel ma'i 'ur ding ba 'dug /'bras yul ba
