dpon slob kyang de ga'i grabs yul khur che ba spro seg ge ba yod 'dug pas/ nged kyi bsam pa la 'bras yul ba'i tshan 'di dpon slob sbyin bdag la bsten pa'i khral 'bab tsam ni mi byed kha med du 'dug /de tsam gyi dang dod rang byed pa'i 'brel med dam snyam pa shar/ ngo shes phrad pa rnams khyed ga me pa mjal las che zer/ 'phral de tsam byed zer ba tsam byas/ don la ga me pa rang skyes bu dam pa yin nyen yod mod/ nged rang gi thos tshod la dpags pa'i lhan skyes kyi shar tshod rkarma pa'i rtsa ba rang dwags po rin po che'i slob ma'i gtso bo khams pa mi gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan/ dus gsum mkhyen pa khams pa dbu se zer ba de yin pas/ khong rnams la babs thob byed na/ rgya gar gyi nā ro mai tri sogs kyi gdams —370

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (1)pa bod yul gyi mar pa mi la sogs nas brgyud pa'i sgrub brgyud bka' babs chu bo'i gzhud lta bu zhig yod pas/ de gtso bor skyong dgos rgyu yin pa la/ dgos pa'i mchod rten nag por bzhag mi dgosabrag la dbu dkar gsol ba'i dpe'i rnam pas sa skya pa dang / dga' ldan pa sogs gang byed la mi bsdobazhin du 'gran pa'i rnam pas mtshan nyid dang / sgra snyan ngag khyud 'chad nyan 'di nas 'chad rang cher med pa'i rnam grangs(77na sgong la dngos ma gtsang ba myog pa zhig dang / 'jig rten gyi dpon chen dang / dpon chung dang / yang chung sogs chos brgyad gang 'phel gyi bya ba lhur len pa 'dra ba/khong rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma dang de dag gi gsung rab rnams la chas chos ras su bor re ba/ ding sang ga dze pa rang gi bshad sgrub kyi bstan 'dzin cung drag pa rnams la'ang smod cing / de dag gi gra rigasadrag pa tshun chad khong rang gi phyag phyir gang khugs byed pa sogs 'dug zer bas/ snying nas dad pa ldang ba ni ma skyes byung / de phyir nged rang sa skya pa'i bza' rkang ma gtogs/ ga me pa'i khral 'bab kyi khur ni ci yang med/ ding sang gi mi phal cher gyi byed pa ltar/ sde dpon dpon skya zhig gi bla ma bcol 'dug na cis kyang chos zhu snyam pa dang / mtha' mi mang gis skor 'dug na sangs rgyas yin snyam rgyug pa'i blun po nged rang min/ rang gi dgon chung la mang ja 'gyed bcas yod dam snyam pa dang / gzhan dgon chung ngam gra rigs re re tsam 'byor re ba'i ched du chos 'brel zhu ba'i ltogs la me 'bar gyi bla ma slob dpon ni min/ legs legs kyi khral 'jal ni byed don mi 'dug /lar rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po dang mjal nas gsung ngag rin po che 'di thob man chad/ gzhan bla ma dang ga dmasang ga gang la'ang byang chub sgrub pa'i ched du mi smon zhing / 'gram chu mi ldang ba'i nges shes gting tshugs shig yod pas lam gzhung bsrangs phyin/ 'on kyang rje thams cad mkhyen pa da rma 'phrin las pa'i zhabs 'bring du ga me pa'i zab chos mang po thob pas/ ga me pa sngon ma rnams kyi sku skye yin (77ba log chod na mi btub snyam/ ma dad ma gus pa ye ma byung ba byas/ de yang spyi theg chen gyi gang zag gis sems can thams cad drin can gyi pha mar shes nas dag snang sbyong ba dang / bye brag tu gsang sngags bla med kyi —371 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)sgor zhugs pa rnams kyi cir snang thams cad lha dang ye shes kyi rnam rol tu shes par byas nas de dag la dad pa dag snang tshad du bskyal nas so so'i rang zhal rjen par mthong ba'i mod la lhug par skyong ba 'di gnad du yod pas de ga'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag pa lags so/ /rje yongs grags kyi sangs rgyas rkarma pa/ /bod skye bo kun 'dud pa'i gnas gcig pu/ khyed bslu med kyi skyes bu los kyang yin/ khong dad can kun 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol/ /sems log rtog gi sprin gyis ma bsgribs kyang / khyed mdzad spyod kyi rnam thar 'od dkar gyis/ /nga snying dbus kyi pad+ma bzhad ma nus/ /dus da res rgya lam srong ba zhu/ khong phal cher gyis mjal ba stong 'ur yin/ khong la la dag mjal ba de che 'dod yin/ khong 'ga' zhig mjal ba ltogs 'dod yin/ khong de 'dra tsho snying nas dad pa min/ /nga skad stong la rgyug pa'i khyi rgan min/ /nga lto phyir du rgyug pa'i sprang rgan min/ /nga zol zog gis 'khor ba'i blun rgan min/ /nga dgon chung gis phongs pa'i bla rgan min/ /gnas dpal ldan sa skya'i dben gnas mchog /dpal kha'u'i brag gi pho brang na/ /rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug rdo ring pa'i/ /thugs ga khog tu 'dres pa'i gces phrug yin/ /ma bdag med mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi bcud/ /rje rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhal gyi rgyun/ /(78na8pal sa skya'i bla chen gdams pa des/ /rgyud yongs su tshim pas gzhan mi smon/ /dus da lta'i sa brdzus kyi ban+de tsho/ /chos 'di 'dra'i skal bzang ma thos pas/ /sems chos brgyad ltogs 'dod kyi rgyug 'bral gyis/ /yul gar 'gro dang 'dir 'gro med snying re rje/ /rje drin can gyi bla ma rdo ring pa/ khyed bsams bzhin du bka' drin 'khor thabs med/ /sprang rang mgo thon pa bla ma'i drin/ /de dran pa'i mod la mchi ma bku/ /nga phyogs med kyi dad pa mkha' ltar yangs/ /sgos karma pa la snying nas dad/ khyed chos brgyad ltogs 'dod don gnyer tsho'i/ /gnas tshul nas smras pa bzod par gsol/ /zhes pa sde srid rin spungs pa dang mchod yon gyi dbang gis skyed tshal ba rnams mi chos kyi mthun 'jug 'os 'tshams las dang dod lugs gang sa nas dgos don med pa'i pher rgya la thugs khrel ba —372

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ tanamed par snang / rje 'di nyid dpon slob lnga tsam dbu zhwa dmar po dang nyid kyis sku gzan ser po bzhesate skyed tshal seng g.yabs nas gzigs rtog mdzad pa rje btsun bod mkhar ba dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam 'gro ba tshogs su bzhugs pa des gzigs ma thag thugs dad shin tu che bar stings te de nyin brang khang du gdan drangs rnyed bkur cher bstab/ chos 'brel gyi thog mar zhal gdong bas can gyi rjes gnang gsan zhal slob kyi khrod nas mngon spyod kyi las sbyor yongs su rdzogs pa la brten te khra ma nas rtsa brlag tu btang ba sogs drag las la bka' babs shin tu che ba yong ba'i (78ba)rten 'brel 'grig gam snyam/ rje mi bskyod rdo rjes res gsang sngags rnying ma cho ge log dang skabs 'gar gter kha 'og ma'i tshes bas 'dzugs pa/ 'bri gung zur pa rin po che dang mjal dus bsnyen phur sogasasngags mas rnams dbu thog tu bzhag nasang yang 'di 'dra ba zhig 'dod ces gus par mdzad/ sne'u sdong gong ma chen por phul ba'i chab shog tu/ deng sang dbu ru byang phyogs brgyud 'di na/ /gter snon lcang lo can zhes bdud sprul de/ /zhes dang / bla ma gter gro bar zlo ba zhes thugs rnal du mi gnasapa'i gsung rigs dang mdzad pa sna tsho gos la dang ba mi skye ba ni thugs bden par zad/ sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan zer ba'i stong 'ur la sku'i ba spu'i cha shas tsam yang mi ldang ba rje btsun kha'u pa'i spyan sngar phebs pa nas bzung bla ma dang chos gzhan la brten nas byang chub mi sgrub pa'i dbang rnon chos rjes gong ba'i thugs mos la lhag par nges rnyed kyis lag bad snying gar zum mo/ /rim gyis lha mthong ba'i rdzong lhun grub rab brtan du phebs/ zhal ngo rnams la tshe rta sbrags ma'i dbang sogs bka' drin du stsal/smyug la rdzong du rje da rma 'phrin las phyogs las rnam rgyal du grags pa mjal du phebs/ der bdud mgon zhing skyong seng gdong can dang dam can mgar nag sogs kyi chos bka' ci rigasagasan/ spyir ris med pa'i bstan rgyun la dgongs pa'i 'chad nyan dang khyad par rje 'phrin las pa nyid kun mkhyen bkras rnam pa'i dpon por song ba'i thugs chen gyis nā le jir phan thogs mdzad dgos—373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)pa'i bslab bya/ gong dkar chos sder phebs rtsis kyis rgyu mtshan (79na)gsal bar thugs shin tu mnyes pa'i sgo nas phyag thugs gar thal mo sbyar te rjes su yi rang dang bsngags pa rgya chen po mdzad/bla ma dam pa 'di nyid kyang thugs dad shugs drag po'i rkyen gyis spyan chab 'khrug pa sogs phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ de nas mi 'gyangs par dpal 'dam bu byin gyi chos gra dang sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi rnam sprul thu btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi gdan sa gong dkar rdo rje gdan du phebs te/ smin grol lung man ngag sogs zab rgyas chos kyi sgo 'phar phye nas gdul bya rnams bzang po'i skal ba can du bkri bar mdzad/thub bstan dge tshogs 'phel nas thos bsam 'bras/ /yul ljongs skyed tshal bar gyi zlos gar gtam/ /bcad lhug spel legs nyams 'gyur dbyangs can ma/ /mgrin par byon nas gsungs kyang de las ci/ /sa skya'i ring lugs mthor brtsegs kha ba'i rir/ /gar mtshan na bun 'khrigs pa'i bshes gnyen dang / /thugs yid 'dres pa'i mdza' bcings zhags pa dang / /'brom ston nag tsho'i rnam thar gnyis pa bzhin/ /'phags bod gzhung brgya smra ba'i chos grags dang / /nges gsang theg pa mchog gi sde chen por/ /skal bzang skye rgu'i bung ba tshim byed pa'i/ /bshes gnyen pad dkar 'dab stong deng 'dir 'dzum/ /gsol 'debs las/ bde ba mchog gi pho brang srin po rir/ /slar yang rdo rje btsun mo'i rnam sprul gzigs/ /mkha' spyod dga' ma'i mdzes sku snyan grags can/ /rtsol med thugs rjes mjal la gsol ba 'debs/ /chu (79ba)'dzin dkar po'i gur khang la gnas pa'i/ /'chi med gzhen nu'i dris lan dbyangs kyi skad/ /rab dkar lha yi bdud rtsi gsar pa'i rgyun/ /ljags kyi pad+ma ra sim la gsol ba 'debs/ /grub mchog dbang po bsod nams bstan 'dzin gyis/ /dud sol lha mo bka' yi bran du gtad/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra dngos su bsgral/ /mngon spyod 'phrin las sgrub la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug gnyis spangs zhabs sogs dam pa bcu phrag tsam bsten —374

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (1)nas me 'bar las thog drangs mgon po lcam dral gyi chos skor rnams gsan pa'i dus/ bye brag 'dod khams ma'i skor la tsho gos bdag ltar sgrub pa/ bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa/ phyi pa ltar sgrub pa/ nang pa ltar sgrub pa rdzogs par gsan kyang sa lugs la rjes gnang zur bka' dang dam pa'i yi ger yum 'khor dang bcas pa sgrub pa la ngos 'dzin gsal ba sogs nas de dag la zhib mor spyod bzhed pas bod du grags pa'i lha mo'i rigs kyi chos skor phal cher gsan cing zhib mor mdzad pa na/ dmag zor ma dang lcags phur ma sogs khol mo'i rigs dang / rje mo'i rigs dud sol ma 'di la'ang sgrub lugs mi 'dra ba mang ba'i sa rngog gi sgrub yig mi 'dra ba las don gcig pa dang / rngog lugs la rjes gnang sgrub skor shin tu rgyas pa sogs gdams pa zab gnad che bar dgongs te rtsad gcod gnang yang sa skya pa dang dwags brgyud pa'i phyogs su rjes gnang gzhan ma'i rgyas bkab 'dra dang man ngag kyang tshang bar ma byung bar thugs ka ma khengs te/ thugs 'dun dur re ba yod pa (80na)'di resagong dkar nas gzhu rngog tshang 'og ma thar pa gling du phebs par gnas de gar phyi sgrub kyi rjes gnang dang sgrub skor yongs su rdzogs pa gnang ba'i rjes gnang gi dus ltas khyad par can zhig kyang gzigs pas bla ma dang lha la mi ldog pa'i thugs dad chen po 'khrungs/ phyogs der bla ma'i sku dgra gdug pa can zhig 'dug par 'di lta bu'i chos skyong yod bzhin du bstan dgra yal bar 'dor mi rung tshul zhu ba mdzad pa'i lan du/ khong tsho'ang lha 'di mchod pa dang mgon khang gi sku rgyab bstan pa sogs kyis yin nam sngar phan rtags mtshan gang yang ma byung / lan chags 'ded pa lta bur mchis pas da dung ci 'dra yod zhes thugs chad nge ba mdzad par/ des na kho bo la chos kyi bka' drin stsal ba'i yon du dam nyams 'di sgrol ba lags zhes gsol bar shin tu dgyes pa'i legs so gnang ba na/ khyab bdag bla ma 'di nyid kyis lha mo'i ljags bsnyen 'bum lnga bcu tsam sngar gnang zin pa'i mgon po'i yum 'dod khams ma dang dud sol ma gnyis thugs rgyud gcig par bzhed gshis lha nye bar zur du bsnyen pa gnang ma dgos pa nas/ gnas de ga'i mgon khang rngog ston gong mas bzhengs pa'i sku byin can gzi —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebyin bskyed pa dang dgra bo zhal du 'debs pa'i bcas legs par bsgrigs nas bstan srung gi zhal du dmar stob mdzad tshul/ dud sol ma'i chos skor gyi dkar chag las/ sa rngog bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod de bka' sgo drag po lan gsum byas pas rang nyid kyang skyi bun pa dang lha mo'i sku 'dra de'ang zhal khro zhing zhal ras nag dam byas(80ba tsher dra ba zhig byung gsungs/ de nas drang srong srin po rir phebs pa gong gi dkar chag 'phros las/ de nub nas lha mo 'di la gtor ma zur pa re bcos ched du 'phrin las drag tu bcol bas zhag bdun song ba'i nub drang srong srin po rir gnas tshang zhig gi khang steng du lcog bu phub nas bsdad/ srod dus gtor bsngos kyi mthar mchod g.yog gis khang pa'i bad steng du thun gtor phul ba'i gtor ma'i gseb nas me stag mtheb rdog tsam zhig chad song ba kho bo rang gis mthong / de je cher song nas rdza ma tsam dang mthar khang pa tsam du song ba mchod g.yog gis mthong ba la gzhung gi thang du babs song zer/ de nas ring por ma lon par mi tshang de pa la shi chad thon bud sogs mi 'dod pa du ma byung nas rjes stongs pa zhig byung / brgyud pa 'di las 'ongs pa'i lha mo 'di la drag shul nus mthu 'di lta bu yod pas rjes 'brang rnams yid ches par gyis la nan tan du sgrub par gyis shig /ces bka' stsal pa ltar rtags mtshan mngon du gyur/ de gar bzhugs mur sngar byung ba'i/ khrag 'dzag srin po'i ri la phrad/ /ces pa'i lung bstan thog tu babs te khro phur mjal ba'i bud med 'jigs su rung ba de ji lta ba zhig zhal gzigs/ de nas sngar gyi lung bstan thugs ngo 'phrod de mos gus chen pos rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par gyur te dngos su zhal bstan/ gsung gi gnang ba stsal ba sogs rje btsun rdo rje btsun mos mngon sum du rjes su bzung / rim gyis stod lung brgyud ra tshag tu rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i thugs dam rten mthong bas don ldan mjal tshe gzigs snang khyad par can byung bar (81na)gor ma chag cing de nasa'aphan yul bya bzang gi ri khrod du phebs/ thugs dam zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin khor yug tu gnang ba'i skabs shig nam mkha' be+e ḍūrla mthing ga'i mdog ltar dwangs pa'i dbus nas sprin dkar lang long du —376

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)'khrigs pa'i khrod nas lha'i bu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba gnyis byung nas dri ba dang / de la lan mdzad pa'i skor gsung mgur las byung ba 'di lta ste/ e ma ho/ kha bas bskor ba'i sman ljongs kyi/ /yul dbus sa yi thig le'i ngos/ /dben pa'i ri sul yang steng na/ /bla ma sgom pa'i ku su lu/ khyod kyi thog ma'i skye yul gang / /dam pa'i yongs 'dzin su yis bzung / /da lta nyams len ga dmasang ga gang / /phyi ma'i bstad so ji ltar yod/ zhes gleng ba la kho bo'i sems la 'di lta bu'i ngo mtshar ba bar chad dam dngos grub gang yin kyang rung lan drang por btab snyam nas 'di ltar smras so/ /ston dus bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas ltar/ /dkar zhing yid 'phrog chu 'dzin gseb/ /gnas pa'i 'chi med gzhon nu gnyis/ /rna ba'i bdud rtsi sgra dbyangs snyan/ shwakya'i bstan la rab byung zhing / /dam pa'i ded dpon gyis bzung yang / /snyom las dbang gis bcings pa yi/ /ser gzugs bdag gi skyes pa'i yul/ /gangs ri'i khrod kyi gtsang stod cha/ /chu bo pa ku'i lho yi ngos/ grum stod sa skya'i bya 'dabs ljongs/ /'brog mi lo tswa'i gnas kyi mda'/ /'phrang gsum nang nas srin 'phrang gdong / /rmu rje btsad bos bzung ba'i sa/ /der ni sngon gyi las dbang gis/ /dal 'byor rin cen rnyed (81ba lnga yin/ /thub bstan rin cen sgor zhugs nas/ /dam chos bdud rtsi nos pa yi/ /spyir ni yongs 'dzin bcu phrag bzhi/ /zung gnyis dag gis lhag par bzhugs/ khyad par tshe rabs dpag med nas/ /rjes su bzung ba'i 'dren pa mchog /tshe 'dir rang sems lhan skyes 'di/ /skye med chos skur ngo sprod cing / /zab mo dbang bzhi'i chu bo'i rgyun/ /bum pa gang byor gnang ba yi/ /bka' drin mnyam med rdo ring pa/ /'gran zla kun dang bral ba yin/ /nyams 'a gdams pa'i gtso bo ni/ /rgyal yum bdag med mkha' 'gro la/ /paṇa grub dbang po rū bas/ /nos pa nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod du/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo mnub pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan dbang bzhi'i lam/ /rdo rje theg pa'i snying po yin/ /yang snying zab mo bla ma'i lam/ /rang sems bla ma phyag rgya che/ /yengs ba med par sgom pa yin/ /phyi ma'i gang 'gro da lta med/ /sgyu ma'i skyes chen 'degs pa'i tshe/ kho bo'i bla ma slu —377

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyemed de/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar 'byon snyam yod/ /bde chen thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /rang semasastong pa spros bral gnyis/ /dbyer med bsres nas lhug par 'jog /gang ltar song yang 'gyod pa med/ /ces gsungs pa'i lha'i bu gnyis kyang rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i rnam sprul du nges/ yang skabs shig tu lha'i bu gzugs dang lang tsho kha dog phun sum tshogs pa zhig gis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba phyag tu phul ba ljags thog tu gsol bas ro brgya phrag bro ba byung nyid / klu'i rgyal pos yid bzhin gyi nor bu phul ba'i (82na)gtam zur tsam las zhib pa yig rgyun dang gsung bgros tshor mi gsal/ zla ba brgyad dgu tsam nas slar yang rngog thar pa gling du phebs sku dgra de la'ang rtags mtshan yong ba'i 'go tshugs pa sogs nas rngog ston chen po thugs lhag par dgyes nas rngog dkyil bdun la sogs pa'i rngog lugs kyi chos skor rnams gnang ba'i rjes su/ brgyud pa 'di pa rang gi srol la lha mo gsang sgrub rjes gnang 'di rngog pa'i bstan pa zin nges shig la byed pa'i lugs yin gsungs nas gsang sgrub kyi rjes gnang cho ga shin tu rgyas pa'i sgo nas bka' drin chen pos gnang / de dus kyang lha mo dngos su gtad pa tsam gyi nges shes dang yid ches pa byung / gong gi mngon spyod kyi ltas byung ba'i rjes nub mang po'i bar du sdig pa dag pa'i rmis ltas ches che ba ji snyed cig byung bas lam thams cad kyi nang nas lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di ga zab pa la nges shes khyad par me 'bar ba la shing bsnan pa lta bur gyur to/ /zhes gsungs pa spang rtogs mthon por slebs pa'i rigs tshor bla mar sri zhu dang byin rlabs 'jug pa gnyis ka shugs kyis 'byung na'ang phyi rabs kyi rjes 'jug rnams la rdo rje slob dpon gyi zhabs tog la 'bad na phan yon chen po 'byung ba rtogs pa'i ched du dgongs te gsungs par snang ngo / /snga phyi mang por bla ma yi dam chos srung gi zhal gzigs pas thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ o rgyan pad+ma dus dgra ma he'i zhal/ /rdo rje btsun mo yang gsang khros pa sogs/ /lha mchog du ma dngos su zhal gzigs nas/ /lung bstan gnang ba thob la gsol ba —378

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ tana'adebs//zhes 82bsko sungs so//gang thugs dag pa'i bas mo lte 'og nang //a shad gas mo yongs 'bar phyi rol tu//chu dang rlabs bzhin so sor gzigs pa'i tshe//nyer zhi'i yul nas 'tshol rnams smig rgyur snyeg/khyab bdag bla ma'i rnam 'phrul legs bris bu//yid 'phrog ri bong 'dzin ltar dkar ba gnyis//chu 'khur dbus na nyer gleng byang chen bar//thang lhod med pa'i thugs rje'i brda thabs tsam//dwags brgyud me lha'i mngal du ma bzod pa//mar lo'i thugs ba a lha wo dwangs ma'i khams/rngog ston gaṅgā las skyugs mgon khyod kyi//blo gros smin tshal skyed bsrings gdong drug lha//'dod khams dbang mo bran bkol mthu stobasamadas//log 'dren snying ga phug pa'i khrag dron skom//ma rgyud dregs tshogs kyis bcos rkan sgra yis//gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog kyang ming du zad//gsol 'debs las/dri med mkha' dbyings 'ja' gur ba 'ad pa'i dbus//o rgyan mkhan bos mdzes sku gsal bar bstan//'khrul zhig bla ma'i dbu gtsug mkha' ngos su//dpa' bo rta mgrin gzigs la gsol ba 'debs//'dar stod dgon pa chosa'akhor yang rtse yi/khri la zhabs bkod slob bshad bstan pa spel//rnam par rgyal ba'i yang rtser chosaskyong sku//bzhengs shing dge legs mdzad la gsol ba 'debs//zhes dbus phyogs su lo gnyis la nye bar bzhugs nas lcags byi'i mjug gtsang la chibs kha bsgyur/stag gru kha'i khad nyer phebs pa na nam mkha' la spyan hur gyis gzigs nas chibs sna 'khrid mkhan la khyod kyis ci mthong gsungs par bltas tsa na 83na 'ja' tshon bun bun 'dug pa mthong nas 'di ltar 'dug zhus pas cang mi gsung na'ang rjes su thugs nang gtsang ba 'drar de dus 'ja'i khrod na o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs 'dug pa gzigs zhes bka' stsal/phebs lam tshor 'phrin las rgya cher skyong mu nas lcags mo glang gi lor bo dong phun tshogs rab brtan du rje bas rdo rje 'dzin pa mkhan chen sgo rum pa mjal bar phebs skabs thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje 'di la chos gsan ba ched kyis zhal / rnams dang bka' bgros mdzad par/thugs dang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebastun chog pa thugs rtse mthun pa'i khrol cha mdzad cing / 'on kyang nged rang tsho'i byed srol bzhin brtag pa zhus gsung ba ltar khyab bdag sgo rum pa chen por zhus pa shin tu bzang ba babs/ thams cad mkhyen pas nan zhus mdzad par bla ma'i slob mar min gsungs nas zhal gyis ma bzhes pa'i tshe/ rje btsun sgo rum pas bla ma'i slob ma slob mar min zer ba bdog ste bla ma mnyes byed gang yin bya'ang mi gda' lags sam/ cis kyang gnang mdzod ces nan chags gsung bar gnas gsar ba mi min zer ba bden par 'dug /bla ma la thel 'bebs sogs sngar med kyi srol btsugs gsung sku rtsed dang bcas zhal gyis bzhes/ thog mar sgrol dkar gyi tshe 'khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun/ 'od zer drug sbrags kyi rjes gnang / chag lugs tshe dpag med dkar po/ dbyangs can ma dkar mo ste dkar lha gsum gyis sgo phye nas zhag drug gi ring la byin rlabs rjes gnang nyer drug lung du ma dang bcas pa stsal/ gsung gleng zhig gi 'phros la (83ba)nged la chos nyan par brtag pa byas pa e yin gsung ba nged rang yab sras min pa gzhan la rgyus ni med dgongs pa'i thugs 'jigs zhus pa'i ngang nas de 'dra'i srol yod pas byas lags zhus par/ legs po a byung gnang bar shin tu bzang gsol ba la bzhad cing nged kyi rmi lam du pha rgan yin rgyu ba zhig gis gnas gsar ba brtag pa 'di bzhin grabs 'dug pa ji ltar byed 'dri bar/ bstan pa la phan na chug pa dang mi phan na mi chug pa mdzod zhus pas chug 'dug pa bstan par phan pa yin nam gsung ba na/ thugs dgyes pa dang 'jigs pa cig car du byung / bka' las/rdo rje 'chang sgo rum par bzhugs pa rnams zhabs drung du gang thob dang de phyin gyi sa stong ngas 'geng gsung chos grol gdong dpal mgon dkar po tshe 'phel gyi rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa gnang / bla lung du 'khrul zhig dka' bzhi pa chen po mjal bar dpon slob nyung bsdus kyis phebs/ dmangs ma thugs 'gros chung khyad nas bal mdar gtang ba gnang / zla bo rnams do nub jo nang du slebs pa yong ba yod pas bdag thogs gzhi med par thon pa dgos snyan du gsol bar dga' bzhi nas kyis mngon par mkhyen pas khong rnams bal mda' rang du sdod pa 'dug do nub 'dir cis kyang bzhugs dgos —380

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanaganang ba bzhin bka' dang bstun te pad+ma yang gsang gi dbang gsan pa'i tshe 'khrul zhig chen po'i dbu'i thad du dpal rta mgrin bzhugs pa dngos su gzigs phan tshun thugs nang dag pas bde chen gyi ye shes chen po'i ngang du gsung sgros dang nyams bsdur sogs (84na8na tu 'phel bar mdzad/dpon slob gnyis ka phyir mjal 'dzom byung res kyi dga' bzhi bas/ de ring tshar pa chos rje khong 'byon gyi yod pa 'dug dpal mgon zhal sngon mgyogs su byung tshul dang / res chos rje tshar pa la bya ba khag can zhig mod par mchos dpal mgon zhal brel gyin 'dug gsung ba ni mgon po 'di nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa drag po'i skur bstan pa yin pas de 'dra'i rigs gzigs pa thag shin tu ring bas dpon slob gnyis dzi'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar ro/ /sang nyin jo nang du phebs lam dngos gzhi dang mi gcig pa'i brag skras zer ba rta bong bgrod mi thub pa'i gzar po der dre'u la chibs te byon/ snga 'gros sogs med na'ang rje btsun grol mchog gi thugs mkhyen gyis bcad de/ de ring mgron chen zhig 'ong bar 'dug pas bu ram sgor ba sogs gzhis len dang ser sbreng gi sta gon gyis gsung ba ltar brag sgras la rkang thang ma gtogs mi thar gshis gzhung lam phyogs su ser sbreng bsgrigs pa na/ brag lam la dpon slob 'ga' zhig phebs pa mthong ste de phyogs su mgyogs par phyin/ skya ser mtha' dag sngar bzhon pa dang bcas thar ba'i dpe med pa la da lam chos rje tshar pas 'phrul bstan pa yin zhes ngo mtshar gyi gnas su gyur/ phebs pa'i bgros med par bsu ba'i bkod pa la dpon slob rnams thugs rangs pa dang ches pa phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin song / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' grol mchog gi phebs bsur byon dpon slob gnyis kasamanyam phyag mjal dar rtse sprod (84bsko zims chung du bzhugs khri mnyam pa gnang chos kyi 'bel gtam sogs khams pa gsar rnying gi dpe bzhin gsung gleng zhib par mdzad/ jo nang chos grwa'i dbus su bal po shing kun gyi mchod rten la 'dra dpe blangs pa bzhedas skabs dang 'grig /rje 'di nyid kyi phyag rdor gyi li sku khyid gang ba zhig yod ba de 'bul ba mdzad ba rje btsun dam pa shin tu —381

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemanyes nas rten 'brel 'grig ces gzungs bzhugs la 'bul bar mdzad/dpon slob gnyis ka rdo ring rin po che'i zhal slob rdo rje'i mchod pa bla na med pa'i dad dung phun sum tshogs par de phyogs kyi skye rgu rnams mgrin pa gcig tu gleng / rim gyis rmu gshong dang thub bstan dge 'phel sogs su zhabs zung bkod de 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyis mtshon pa'i rnam dkar gyi 'phrin las dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bzhin pa'i mur/ se ston chen po mthu chen nyi ma bzang po dang mkhas grub chen po rin cen rgyal mtshan sogs sngags rnying ma'i rig pa 'dzin pa mang du byon pa dang gdung gcig pa se dkar rigs kyi thig le sa skyong ba 'dar pa dang / grangs chen 'dus tshogs rnams mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin mdzes byed ces pa chu mo yos kyi lo 'gor dge 'dun rnams kyis chos gos zlum por bgo zhing mchod rdzas sna tshogs thogs pa'i ser sbreng / sde pa dpon g.yog gis rin cen rgyan cha'i skya hrags dang bcas pas mdun bsus te 'dar stod chos 'khor yang rtse'i seng ge'i khri chen por zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo rnam par bkod/ phyogs de'i skya ser che dgu mtha' dag (85na)gis gtong ba'i snyim pa ring por brkyang ste zang zing gi bdog pa'i mchod sprin rgya cher spros/ phyogs 'dus gnyug mar gnas pa'i don gnyer can rnams la pha rgyud 'dus pa dang ma rgyud 'khor la sdom pas thog drangs rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang rig gtad 'khrid lung man ngag mang du gsungs/ khyad par gnyis su med pa dpal kye rdo rje'i man ngag lugs dang 'brel ba'i lam 'bras slob bshad kyi dbang 'khrid kyi byin rlabs lung sogs 'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro'i sgra dbyangs phyogs brgyar bsgrags pas/ mus pa dkon grags pa sogs phyogs lhung smyo chus zin pa'i glang po rnams kyi dregs pa'i mgo bo bkas par gyur/'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsnyen rdzogs gnang ba'i sgo dod pa'i tshe rje btsun sgo rum pa chen pos las slob chos rje tshar pa 'gab gsung ba bzhin bo dong du lha rigs 'a zhwa rgyal pos gdan drangs pa bzhin phebs/ 'dul ba'i gzhung nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin gyi las slob —382

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ lhanakyi bya ba gsol ba dang bzhi'i las kyi bsgrub bya la bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa byin pas thams cad mkhyen pa dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por mnga' gsol/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis thog drangs pa'i snod ldan 'ga' zhig la rdo rje nag po ོ po gur mgon gyi dkyil 'khor lnga'i dbang rdul r+sā la brten pa/ phyi 'khrid rdo rje brag rdzong du grags pa la nang gses kyis phyi nang gsang gsum yod pa'i nyams 'khrid zab mo smin rgyas su stsal/ rje mkhyen brtse'i thugs rab (85ba)dang thugs 'dun la mnyes pa'i gsung 'phros kyang gnang / rdo rje 'a zang sgo rum chos rje'i drung du dbang lung man ngag du ma gsan te gzhung skor mdzad nas 'khrul zhig dka' bzhi pa chen po mjal bar phebs pa na 'khrul zhig chen po'i gsung las rje rin po ches bo dong du mgon po'i zab chos shig mi mang rab cig la bshad yod pa 'dra pu tra 'di cung zad mi dgyes pa'i rtags tsam byed kyi 'dug pas 'tshub kyi rnam pa cung zad byung dogs 'dug gsungs/de nas lam bar du chibs g.yangs la 'dred pas rje nyid kha 'gram du bzhugs chibs grog po'i nang du lhungs kyang skyon med par rdo la rmig rjes bzhag pa sogs ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rdzu'aphrul bstan/ rmu gzhong du bskang bshags tshogos mchode rgya cher mdzad pas dam can dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhug par bstan/ dpal ldan grang mo cher re zhig gi bar stan chags nas chos kyi 'khor lo ji snyed cig bskor/ shing pho 'brug lo rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po dpa' bo'i tshogs dpon du mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su gshegs pa gsan pas rings stabs su phabs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i gdung yid bawo gyi nor bu he ru gaḥzhal brgyad pa'i ngo bor gyur pa phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rgya cher mdzad cing rjes sor me mchod kyi phyag phyi yang mdzad par snang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs la da nga yang ci 'dra byed mi shes gser chos dmar po skor gsum dang mgon po che chung sogs yongs rdzogs thob pa dang tshul ldan shes pa ye mi bdog pas ma 'gyangs par gsan pa 'gab ces bslab bya mdzad par brten rje sgo rum (86na)pa gshegs pa'i thugs ngal kyang sangs pa lta bu'i ngal —383—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)gsos/ zhabs drung rigs 'dzin chen po dang rje mkhyen brtse lhan du dkar bdud lcam dral gyi rjes gnang stsal nas grang mo cher phebs te skor cig bzhugs nas rmu gshong du stan chags pa'i dus sngar skyed tshal du chos 'brel gsan pa dang / phra ma nas kyis rin spungs su snyan phra phul ba'i rkyen gyis bod mkhar nas tshang ming gi lhag mar gyur pa'i rkyen ngan grogs shar lta bus bskul te rje btsun bod mkhar ba mi tri byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos zhabs pad bsnyen par phebs zang zing gi dngos po yod dgu lta bu 'khor gsum yongs dag gi 'bul ba rgya cher mdzad/ zhal gyi bdud rtsi rdzogs par myangs rjes bstan pa spel ba dang sgom sgrub rtse gcig tu mdzad dgongs pas sku la bcar nas bzhugs/ ma chen rdor bkras pa phyogs 'byon dang thug pa'i re zhig gnyer gyis gsung ba bzhin mdzad pa'i tshe de snga gong nas gsol ja cung zad dkon pa yod par mi nyag dbon po mgon po 'od zer gyis gsol ja phon shin tu che ba'i 'bul skyel slebs pas rje drung gi gnyer kha 'phrod ces thugs dgyes/ rin po che bod mkhar ba gtso bor gyur pa'i don gnyer can 'ga' la gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad kyi snang gsum nas bzung dbang bzhi pa'i bar gyi nyams 'khrid zla brgyad lhag tsam smin rgyas de'i cha lag tu dgos pa'i dbang byin rlabs lung man ngag /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang bzhi mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud/ rnal 'byor bzhi/ rnam par 'byed pa/ rwa rtse sems 'dzin/mtshan ma gyen bsgrang / (86ba)mtshan mo rgyu ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs nas dbang bzhi'i lam rdzogs pa'i 'khrid/ rwa pod/ dpal 'dzin pod chung rnams kyi lung phyag 'khrid/ shin tu zab pa gshed dmar bir lugs kyi dbang bzhi/ byin rlabs gsum/ spros med kyi 'khrid yig sna/ rta mgrin yang gsang khros pa'i dbang bzhi dang tshe dbang / rta pod/ dus kyi 'khor la'i bdag po chen po'i bar gyi dbang /rgyud 'grel/ shin tu zab pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang nyams 'khrid chos skor/ in+d+ra mkha' spyod/ mi tri mkha' spyod/ gzhan ma phag dkar shes rab gsal byed/ dpyal pa'i bden gnyis ma/ dbu bcad ma/ zhal gnyas ma rnams kyi skor/ seng ge sgra/ 'jam dkar/ seng gdong ma sogs rjes gnang —384

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)gi rigs mang ba/bstan srung gi gtso bo gur gyi mgon po gtso rkyang /sbrags sgrub lha brgyad/bstoganyisam/ phyi nang gsang ba ru mar gyi las mkhan dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang lnga/rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan dang brag rdzong ma gnyis kyi nyams 'khrid/ me 'bar kha skong /gyi ljang /ga rta du das la/brgyud rnams gyi glegs bam/dor rdzong gong dkar gsum nas brgyud pa'i be'u bum/sbas pa'i mgon po'am gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa'i bka' mi 'dra ba brgya bzhi/tshe sgrub srung 'khor dang gsang ba'i 'khrid man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa/ gnod sbyin beg tse/ dur khrod bdag po/dpal ldan dam gzor ma/rdo rje rab brtan ma rnams kyi skor/tshe sbyin yid bzhi 'khor lo'i rjes gnang dang stsed/ gser chos dmar byu 87na skor gsum gyi a mong dang a mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang /gto lo'i dmar chung skor gsum/ gser chos dang gra pa mngon shes gnyis kyi dzam dmar/ kun rig gi dbang /phyag rdzor u tsa ya/rnam rgyal mas/sme brtsegs dud kha sogs kyi rjes gnang /snying po don gsum dang chem bu lugs kyi dmar 'khrid/rnam sras bka' mi 'dra ba bco lnga'i rjes gnang /be'u bum yongs rdzogs/'ba' ra ba nas brgyud pa'i tshe 'khrid kyis ma snya zab chos shin tu mang ba gnang zhing 'dir bsdoms pa rnams kyang rje bod mkhar ba'i rnam thar spyan snga rin po ches mdzad pa nas bcos pa yin la/lo mang sbrel nas dpon slob chabs cig par bzhugs pa la brten rim gyis stsal ba'i dus la snga phyi khyad che ba 'ga' yod par snang /ga par chos skyong che chung gi skor rnams bla ma dang slob ma gnyisagar gto cha che bas dus r+sāg tu rdzogs par mi mdzad pas kyang shes nus/rdo ring rin po ches sgo pa chen por khyed la bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa'i slob ma mchog tu gyur pa gsum yod pas de gsum po la ring bsrel 'di 'dra re re byin gsungs pa'i ya rgyal gcig rin po che bod mkhar bar gnang ste zhal slob kyi gtso bor ngos 'dzin mdzad pa dang mthun par phyis su lo dgon pa sogs kyi zhal 'dzin mdzad/spyan snga rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/chos rje bstan pa rgya mtsho sogs la snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rdzogs par stsal/spyan snga rin po che/ཿmkhan chen thar pa rgyal mas/rdo rje 'chang dbang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)phyug rab brtan/ lo pa spyan snga (87ba thun dga' don grub/ rab mas chos rje chos sku rdo rje sogasagasung las skyes pa'i dam pa du mas kha'u pa'i ring lugs rgya cher spel/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshor gser chos bcu gsum dang mgon po che chung gi chos skor rnams 'bul ba gnang / chos 'khor rgyal lhun grub dga' ba'i tshal gyi bsil ba tshal du mgon po che chung gi sku dang / chos 'byung shod du gnod sbyin beg tse rnams bzhed ba'i zhal bkod snyan brgyud dang 'brel ba'i gzungs bzhugs rab gnas sogs gnang / mnga' ris drung pa rin po che lha'i btsun pa bsod nams dpal bzang / dga' ldan shar chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sgrom mda' mkhan chen sogs mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i bstan 'dzin mang por chos kyi bka' drin stsal/sa skyong dga' ldan pa a khu bkra shis zhes ngag gi dbang phyug dbyangs can bsnyems pa'i ster grags pa khu dbon gyi bla mchod du gyur pas mtshon dbu ru stod kyi rgyal khams su kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan pa'i sgron me ches cher sbar/ lha sa brag sgor star stong chos mdzad kyi bdag po kun rin pa'i sku la gri ltag phul ba sogs 'o brgyal byung bar brten 'phan yul mkhar rtser bdag chen mjal bar phebs dus/ rnam thar las spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di mar 'grib la song ba dang khyad par du sa skya pa'i bstan pa 'di da lta gang na'ang dar rgyas che rgyu rang mi 'dug rung chos rje'i drung gis dbus phyogs 'dir bstan pa la phan zhing sa skya pa'i rkang zin pa zhig byung 'dug /nged tsho sa skya pa'i zhal ngo chibs rags bsgrigs nas yong dus lha (88na)sa brag sgo'i thad du star sdong dbon po dang phrad tshe rbud shar re 'gro yang rje'i drung las dga' ldan thams cad mthun grub pa 'dug gsungs pas mtshon thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i 'og nas rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i zhal slob kyi dang mar mngon/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis bka' chos gnang dgos tshul gyi zhu yig phul bar/sa dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi sman ljongs na/ zhes sogs kyi lan dang bcas zhal gyis 'ches pa bzhin zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi la bla ma dam pa rdo rje 'chang bo dong du phebs/ thams cad mkhyen —386

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ lhanapa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dpon slob nyung bsdus la zab chos ji ltar stsal na/khyab bdag gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor ni//'phags pa'i yul du paṇa grub rnams kyis phye/khyud rgyal ma dros chu gter las byung ba'i//bka' babs rnam bzhi'i gdams pa'i chu rgyun ni//lo tsā rnam bzhi'i gsung gi 'bab stegs las//legs 'ongs sa skya'i bla chen thugs mtshor 'khyil//gang de'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i gzegs ma ni//phyogs brgyar 'phros pas kha ba'i sman ljongs 'dir//zab don lhu 'phreng bye bas phyug pa yi//rjes 'brangs chu klung rnam bzhi ring du 'bab/zhes pa ltar bka' babs bzhi ldan du bzhugs pa'i rdo rje nag po chen po gtso rkyang /lha bcu gsum ma/lha brgyad/lha bcu gnyis ma/las mkhan rnamasakyi rjes gnang /dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i dbang /brag rdzong dang gsang 'khrid dang thun mong min pa'i khos 'khrid/me 84'bar kha sgong dang bcas pa/snya brgyud/gyi ljang /dud sol/ngor pa'i pod ser/rdzong lugs dkar chag ma/rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam mgon pod rnams kyi lung /gsang ba yid bzhi nor bu'i yi ge dang zhal shes la brten nas phyag len dmar 'brid/rdo rje la yo tshar pa rje'i gsung las/de ltar rgyal ba'i dri med rgyud sde las//gsungs pa'i bstan srung kun gyi mchog gyur pa//drag shul mthu ldan stobs 'phrog nag bo zhes//rgya bod mkhas grub kun la rlung ltar grags//zhes pa ltar/lo chen gnyan gyi chos skyong brgya rtsa'i nang nas gtso bo mchog tu gyur pa gzha mgon zhal bzhi pa'i bka' mi 'dra ba'i rjes gnang brgya bzhi/tshe sgrub srung 'khor dang sbu gri'i so sdeb/rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i nyams 'khrid/phyi bram ze nang zhing skyong gsang ba stobs 'phrog nag po ltar sgrub pa'i lasatshogs man ngag phyag len dmar 'khrid dang bcas pa legs par gsan pa 'dir phyogs mtshudas su bsdus pa ma gtogs chos skyong bka' gnyan pas dus snga phyi 'ga' zhig tu rim gyis gnang bar mngon zhing /rje mkhyen brtse thugs sras kyi gtso bor bzung ste zab chos kun bum pa gang byor gnang bas/gsung las/bdag r+ṣa chos rje'i sku yid bon skyes shing /grub mchog rdo ring chos rje'i bstan la dad//sgo rum chos rje'i thugs kyi sras su gyur/shes rab ཿsnying rje rnam dpyod phun tsho gos shing //dad dang sgrub

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shepas bla ma mnyes pa ste/ /rgyu drug 'dzom pas zab mo'i gdams pa rnyed/ /grogs dag 'di 'dra'i skal bzang (89nasgo sgo bo tsam/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu babs shing rin cen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal sogs rin po che'i rigs dang ja gos dar go khrab kyis gtsos pa'i bdog pa gya nom pa/ mkha' 'gro lnga mnyes par byed pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen pos snyan brgyud dang po'i rten 'brel kun nas sgrig par mdzad pa sogs kyang / bsam 'phel nor 'phreng las/ phyi nang gsang ba'i man ngag zhu ba'i tshe/ /tshogs dang gtor mas mkha' 'gro mnyes par byas/ /rin cen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phul/ /gsang chen grub mtha' 'dzin pa'i dam bca' byas/ /zhes pas mtshon nus/ dkar chag dbang sdud pad+ma rā ga'i za ma tog las/ bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa'i gsang las yang gsang gser gyi chos/ /dmar po skor gsum zhes grags pa/ /zhes rje btsun sa skya par gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bur bzhugs pa'i nang nas thun mong bsgrubs pas mchog zhar la 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum yang / ji skad du/ kho bos dam pa'i zhabs pad ring du bsten/ /snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i zhal 'od snying la shar/ /'khrul med gdams pa'i gnang la nges pa thob/ /grogs dag 'di 'dra'i skal bzang kho bo tsam/ /zhes rdo rje 'chang 'di nyid la mnga' ba'i rje btsun rig byed ma/ tshogs bdag bgegs kyi rgyal po/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po gsum gyi thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang lung man ngag phyag len/ zhan byung dmar chung skor gsum dang bcas pa gnang / (89ba〉de yang nyin re chos thun gnyis dang 'chams dbyangs kyi phyag len rnams kyang dbyis phyin par thugs la btags par slob ma snod kyi skyon dang cung zad tsam yang mi ldan pas mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi rnam thar las/ mtshan phyed tsam dbyangs bslabs/ de nas dgongs thun yod tsam dang gtor bsngo sogs byas/ de nas mar me'i 'od la mgon po'i phyag dpe khag che ba sogs yi ger bris pas zla ba gcig la shog bu bcu gras sum brgya tsam tshar byung zhid / nged kyi mgon po'i dpe drag shos rnams la skyer thig gar po byas pa kho na yod pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/ zhes byung ba mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches po ti drug cu tsam phyag bris gnang zer ba dang dbyibs 'dra ba'i rdzu —388

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tana'aphrul gyi bkod pa las tha mal pa'i ngang tshul du mi sems shing /chos bdag por gnang ba'i nyamasakyis dpon slob gnyis ka la ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs snang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung /zhal ngo rim par dge ba'i bshes gnyen zla med pa byon par ma zad zhal slob mkhan chen bslab gsum pa dang sngags 'chang bsod nams cho me 'phel gnyis snyan brgyud mi nyams pa'i srog shing du song zhing /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung las skyes pa/bdag chen rin po che ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen/spyan snga kun dga' don grub/rje bka' stir ba/mkhan chen zha lu pa/glang bu chos rje/rgyal rtse bdag po byamasapa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/bya gzhong mkhan chen mang thos grags pa rnam rgyal/yangs can mkhan 90na ) po byams pa bsod nams mtha' yas/rje btsun bka' 'gyur bas zur thams cad mkhyen bar stsal bas mtshon te zhal slob de dag las kyang yang slob nyid slob sogs srid mtha'i bar du 'phel nas rang bstan kha'u pa'i ring lugs 'dzin par zla med pa'o//de nas bya rgod gzhong gi rten mjal la phebs de nub rgyal blon lha khang du bzhugs pa'i srod kyi dus rta rgyugs pa'i rmig pa'i khrab sgra chen po dang bcas 'od dmar po chos gsal ba zhig dmar 'ur 'ur byung ba'i khrod na rta dmar rgyan khrab khrag mang po btags par mi dmar zhig gis zhen nas skor phyogs la yud kyis song zhes pa tsam las gsal bar mi 'dug kyang /chos rgyal gyi dus byang gi so kha bsrung bar lha sras mu rub btsan po dang zhang blon lha bzang klu dpal gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i g.yul bshams dus o rgyan chen pos rnam sras bkug nas bstim pa'i 'phyar dar dang phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i chos skor rnams bya rgod gshong du gter du sbas pa gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyis spyan drangasapas gnas 'dir rgyal po chen po dngos su bzhugs gshis mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i zhal mngon sum du gzigs par snang /sang tho rengs thegs rtsis kyis sgo drung na ༷la 'gel ba'i bar la rdo kyong de la khyel mdzad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)bzhugs pas mdang gi rta'i rmig sgra de byung zhing 'od dmar po ches gsal bas sa'i rtsi sbur yan nyin mo ltar gsal ba drung na 'khod pa thams cad kyis mthong ba byung / de nas rmug gshong du phebs yol nas shangs chos rdo rje'i rgyas btab kyi brgyud pa drug (90ba)pa gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam sprul mkhan rin po che gzhen nu blo gros ched bstad kyis phebs/ bla ma 'di nyid bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen por dgongs te gsung ngag rin po che mkha' spyod skor gsum/ dmar po skor gsum sogs gser chos mgon po che chung / gnod sbyin beg tse sogs kyi dbang rjes gnang 'khrid lung man ngag rnams 'di nas bzung snga phyir mjal ba tshor rim gyis stsal zhing g.yin yang bstan pa spyi sgos kyi gsung chos ji snyed cig gnang / mkhan chen nyid kyi gsung las kyang nged rang 'gro don khyongs chung bas 'chad 'chad nyung gsung ba ltar chos bka' dog pa tsam yod tshod du 'dug cing / dbon yol pa bla chen du grags pas rags rim gsan tshod du 'dug rung khong pa rjes sor rtag brtan sprul skur ha cang mos drags pa'i skyon gyis rang bstan zin pa'i rjes che ba ma byung zhing / zhal slob 'di thon gyi grags mi che'ang dbus g.yo ru'i phyogs su bkra shis chos kyi sde gsar du bskrun pas bstan pa'i me btsa' lta bur song / bdag chen rin po che 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po thugs blo gzu bor gnas pas yar klungs bkra shis rtser phebs nas brag rdzong ma'i 'khrid kyis gtsos snyan brgyud kyi chos skor mang du gsan/ gsang 'khrid skor re thig phul ba mi 'gab 'dra dgongs te ma gsan gsungs pa mkhan rin po che'i gsan yig mgo btsems ma bya rog gis khyer te bdag chen rin po che'i sku pang du bskyur bas chos skyong gis gdams pa rnams gtod cig ces skabs dbye ba lta bus dpon slob gnyis ma'i che bar song zhing / thugs yid (91na)ches te tshang bar phul bas mi thog gnyis tsam gyi ring bzhi thog bla brang pha nor dang bral ba'i khang stong 'dra ba slar rang nor gtong len lta bu'i dbu tshugs shing /rim gyis sngags 'chang sogs sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams yab sras nas gong ma'i ring lugs kyi nyi ma phyogs brgyar 'char ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo yang brgyud pa 'di nas —39()

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtanaphye bas rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho'i bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo zhig tu mngon/ 'dar pa chos rje chosadabang rin cen dpal gyi rgya mtsho rje btsun kun spangs chen pos mgon po phur zhabs ma gnang ba'i chos gling drung pa sogs gzhi byes kyi 'dus pa du ma dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde pa 'dar pa rin cen dpal bzang sogs zhal ngo rnams dang / mdor na skya ser mchog dman mang por so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i dbang 'khrid lung man ngag sogs sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas 'dod pa'i re ba bskang /shing sbrul lo bo dong du thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i ljags bsnyen gyi sku mtshams shin tu dam par bar du gcod pa'i mtshan chen po zhig 'jug nye ba thugs kyis mkhyen nas gdan 'dren zhus pa la ma bltos par phebs/ rje mkhyen brtse'i gzigs snang la rje bla ma sku mdog byu ru ltar dmar zhing zhal rgyan sogs ye med pa zhig 'dug par sngar phan ni zhal rgyan gshor ba gnang gin med da lam ci yin nam dgongs shing / mjal ma thag thugs la dga' spro dang mos gus chen po 'khrungs/ bgegs kyi rnam pa byung ba la'ang dogs gcod zhu ma dgos par lhug par gsungs shing (91ba)cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan pa'i sgo nas yid srubs kyi g.yul las rgyal bar mdzad pas de nub nas bzung thugs bde nyams shin tu che bar gyur/zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang du thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug 'dar du phebs zhag nyer drug bzhugs thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i lugs kyi dpal mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gtor ma/ drag po'i mas dbyangs phyag len thams cad mkhas par sbyong bdar mdzad/zhan byung du gur mgon gyi man ngag mang po chig brgyud dang dud sol ma'i skor du ma gnang / tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos rdo rje slob dpon dang mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis las kyi rdo rje mdzad nas dpon slob rnams kyis nyer dgu la gtor chen gnang bas bstan la log par 'khu ba'i gzugs can gzugasamed kyi dpung tshogs mtha' dag thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du song /de nub mnal lam du rje bla ma rtse gdong yin snyam pa'i lung pa zhig na yar phebs pa'i mthar —391—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)khang pa zhig 'dug pa der byon pa'i nang du shing khris bteg pa'i 'bol gdan nar mor bting ba'i g.yas su khyab bdag kun spangs chen po dang / g.yon du kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa gnyis bzhugs 'dug par dpon slob gnyis la phyag 'bul dang byin rlabs zhu ba mdzad che/ thu chen 'jigs med dpa' bos phyag len sogs bkur gzos mdzad byung bar kun spangs rin po ches kyang 'di 'dra zhig mdzad thad dam dgongs pa shar bar rdo ring rin po ches kha sa nga tsho chos rjes gar byon gsung bar bdag gis jo nang pa'i gra pa 'jam dbyangs sgeg pa zer ba gzugs chung nge ba jo zhwa gyon pa de la chos (92na sko da kyin bsdad zhus par rdo rje gdan pas khyed rdzun ma zer/ 'jam sgeg dang gnas gsar rje drung mi gcig gsung ba na kun spangs rjes sngon dang da lta'i khyad par tsam las gnyis ga'i gsung la 'gal ba med/ khong yar klungs par gyur skabs 'jam sgeg dang deng sang gnas gsar chos rje yin pas rgyud cig /der ma zad chos rjes bsnyel yod pa 'dra/ khyed o rgyan gyi yul du s+tha bi rar 'byungs nas rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dbang zhu dus rnal 'byor pa sbrul gyi ga sha can de nga yin/ de dus s+tha bi ra pas gdug pa mang po bsgral gsung ba sogs bla ma rnam gnyis dri ba dri lan gyi tshul mdzad pas 'od gsal des khyongs shing mnal sad pa na thugs rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes khyad par can dang /sku tshe sngon ma'i gnas tshul la thugs nges 'drongs pas nged rang dpon slob rnams kyis zhal gyi gtor chen byas par kun spangs rje dang rdo rje gdan pa gnyis dgyes yod pa 'dra/ mdang rmi lam 'di 'dra byung zhes rje mkhyen brtse la gsungs par thugs la dgyes tshor dang spyan chab 'khrug pa sogs byung bas/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i rnam thar du/mnal lam ming du btags pa'i 'od gsal dang / /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gnyis ma' sum gzigs/ /lkog gyur sngon gyi gnas 'ga' lung bzhin thob/ /ngo mtshar 'di dang 'di 'dra gsung ba thos/ /a ho srid par 'khyams pas ches dub pa/ /bdag la nyid kyis ring mo zhig nas bskyangs/ /mngon gyi zhal bzhes slu med bden pa'i mthus/ /'dir yang slob bshad snyan brgyud lhug par stsal/ /—392

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtand dung khyed dang mtshungs(92ba thar ma gyur pa/ /de srid mgon skyabs dpung gnyen gzhan med pas/ /yid ches dad dang gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /slu med thugs rjes sngar bzhin gzung du gsol/ /zhes byung zhing / rje mkhyen brtse dpon slob phyir phebs gdong bla ma dam pas 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims kyi gter ma'i phur pa/ rje nyid dbang bum yun ring gnang ba'i phyag dril shing 'khrul ma shubs bcas/ seng ldeng gi kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka mu tig 'phreng ba/ 'phags pa rin po che'i thugs dam gur mgon hor sku zhig sogs gnang sbyin phun sum tshogs pa stsal/ yang khams pa a kro zer bas kha'ur rdo ring rin po che la mgon po zhal gyi chos skor dgos tshul zhus tshe rje 'di la spyan cer gzigs nas cis kyang byed gsungs zhal gyis bzhes kyang gnang ma thub pa phyis rje bla mas gnang dgos byung ba lung bstan du 'dug /mi ring ba'i shi skabs ga rje bla ma 'di nyid bo dong du spyan 'dren ma zhus par phebs nas gzhan don gcod kyi rigs med khyed la chos shig gzhod du yongs pa yin phebs pa gang yin dri ba zhus par 'jigs byed yin tshul byung ba bzhin 'o yug sding mar spyan drangs/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bzhi rwa pod sogs yig sna'i lung dang man ngag zhan tu zab pa rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi nyams 'khrid gnang bas rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gnad gsang thams cad thugs kyi klong du gyur pas bka' drin dran te mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ dran bas gdung sel khyab bdag ma lha'i zhal/ /ngur smig zol gyis rol pa'i pha rgod des/ /'byul med gnad kyi lam bzang (93na 'di bstan tshe/ /mtha' yas chos kyi rang zhal rjen par mthong / /gzhan yang pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dbang dang rta pod kyi lung rdzogs par gnang /rim gyis shangs mda'i rdo rje sgrub phug tu gnas 'brel zhag gsum mdzad pa'i nub cig gzugs med pa'i skad cig la zab bur song o rgyan rin po che bzhugs yod zer ba zhig byung bas rkyen byas/ rje bla ma zab bu phyogs la phebs pa'i me tshor du zhag gnyis 'i bzhugs pa nub khye'u gzhen nu sngags masacan zhig gis sngar gsan pa dang ma gsan ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs so sor dbye zhing / ma thob pa —393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shernams brag phug 'di'i ltag na yod gsung de o rgyan rin po che'i sprul par snang / rim gyis zab bu'i gzims phug gi sku brnyan bde gshegs 'dus pa'i drung du gcig pur thugs dam mdzad pa'i tshe dkon gnyer gyi bsam par bla ma 'di tshos gter 'don zer nas gzungs bzhugs mi blug pa'i nges pa med snyam sgo drung nas rdzi gsang bltas pas skad gdangs yid du 'ong ba shin tu snyan pa zhig gis thog mar gsung 'phros dang de'i rjes su chos lhang lhang gsung ba thos pas mi 'ga' re yod dam snyam thal gyis yongs pa na gcig bur bzhugs 'dug pas dad pa lhag par skyes shing de dus o rgyan chen po dngos su zhal gzigs nas zab chos mang po gsungs par gda'/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sogs la drag po rtsal gyi byin rlabs thugs dbang dang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs sogs stsal/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis drung yig mdzad nas bde chen dag (93btonang mar grags pa'i o rgyan rin po che'i gsol 'debs tshig don phun sum tshogs pa de yang mdzad/ myug rgyal khang du zhag lnga tsam bzhugs nas 'dar du phebs/ rnam rgyal chos rdzong du mgon khang gsar du mdzad nas rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i sku sa pa lo bcu drug 'gro ba'i tshad/ yum chen/ la mo/ zhal bram gzugasagasum khru phyed do/ rtag gtor mgon po che chung las mkhan bcas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i 'dzin gtor spyan gzigs/ thog tu man ngag las byung ba'i ru mtshon btsugs/ sku brnyan rnams dam pa'i shog dril zhal shes mas brgyan pa'i rab gnas zhag bdun mas 'og min gyi gnas nas mgon po dngos su byon pa'i gzi byin gyi 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogs pa med par sgrub pa'i sku rnams dus phyis sde srid gtsang pas rdzong bshig nas gzhis gar spos/ de nas kyang 'pho bang te deng sang sa skya'i khyad 'phags mgon khang du bzhugs par snang /rnga yab gling gi mgon sogs 'dren pa dang / /yi dam srung ma'i zlos gar gang thugs shel/ /dag pa'i tshon ris dbang gzhu ltar bkra ba/ /bur shing dngar ba'i ro bzhin dbye mi nus na/ /skye mang rjesabazung thugs sras gnas gsar bar/ /gnyis spangs bla ma'i gdams pa yongs gto de pa'i/ /rten —394

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyas mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtana'abrel zhing skyong dbang pos te se nas/ /dmar zlum spyan gyis gzigs te nye bar bsgrigs/ /g.yang sar 'jigs bral brtul zhugs gshog rlabs kyis/ /brgya phrag cho 'phrul bstan tshe gos ser mig /mkha' lding zhen pa'i khengs pa yongs bor nas/ /rus sbal gzugs kyis sa chen (94na)'degasapar brdzu/ /rab dkar chos 'khor gangs ri'i yang rtse nas/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan 'jigs med seng ge'i glus/ shes rlome ri dwags spyod med a mong gi /gdams pa'i sa chur mgo bo bstad de nyol/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rigs brgyud lha yi sras/ /stong phrag byung la mang por 'dzin blo chungs/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i slob bu gser ri'i sbubs/ khar ba'i grangs med zla ba 'di la stos/ /legs ldan dpa' bo lha min dpung tsho gos las/ rnam par rgyal ba'i gad brgyangs sgrog pa'i gnas/ /ha har bzhad pa'i dur khrod rgyu ba'i stag /mche ba'i rtse mor dgra bo'i don snying 'khrig /gsol 'debs las/ bstan srung mchog rnams las la bskul ba'i tshe/ /ru mtshon rtse la gri gug 'bar ba gzigs/ /bka' yi springs yig bi hā ra gtsug gis mchode/ /dam can bran du 'khol lagasol ba 'debs/ /mu stegs 'dul bar rje btsun bkas bskul zhing / /rnal 'byor dbang mos spyan 'dren tshul bstan kyang / /bstan la rjes dgongs sku tshe'i 'du byed mchog /slar yang byin gyis brlabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dad ldan bka' 'bangasamachoge gi skye ba gang / /lcang lo can nas yongs pa'i gnod sbyin gyis/ /dri med nor bu'i 'od zer 'phreng mdzes pa/ /drin bsang mchod pa phul la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes par tshig gis zin mi zin sna tsho gos pa'i lo 'di nang du dbyangs can lha mos rjes su bzung ba'i rje klu sgrub rgya mtsho zhes shes bya thams cad la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa de nyid zhabs kyi pad+ma la gtsug gi nor bus reg par byon te sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan (94ba)zla ba'i zer gyis rnam par phye ste mi 'phrogs pa'i dad pa mchog gi kun+da yongs su bzhad pa la brten lcags mo phag gi lo dpyid kyi dpal mo'i dga' ston dar ba'i tshe gsang chen slob bshad kyi sngags gra 'dar stod chos 'khor yang rtser mkhan rin po che 'jam pa'i dbyangs blo gros rnam rgyal/ thugs kyi sras gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi—393

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheta chen po klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ rje rab brtan pa sogs skal ldan gyi gdul bya kha shas la tshe gcig la 'dus pa rnam gsum gyi 'phrang brgal te bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa chen por bgrod pa'i nges lam zab mo snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi dang 'brel ba'i gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad kyi dbang byin rlabs 'khrid lung man ngag mtha' dag rdzogs par gnang / gsung rgyun nyams pa med pa'i lam 'bras kyi 'khrid yig chen mo'ang zin bris mdzad nas spyan lam du phab pas nga'i gsung ngag slob bshad kyi bka' khyed la babs slob ma'i tshil bu lta bu yin zhes dgyes rtser son/ zhal slob kyi nang nas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse gong du phud pa'i rje btsun bod mkhar pa/ mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros/ rje 'di gsum 'gran gyi zla med du mngon zhing / khyad par kun mkhyen klu sgrub pa'i gsung las skyes pa'i bshes gnyen paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen sogs mkhas grub mang du byon zhing / mkhan ngag dbang chos grags nas rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ sa skya khri rin po che/ rgyal rtse bdag po byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan khu dbon/bya gzhong mkhan chen mang thos grags (95na)pa rnam rgyal/ yangs can mkhan po byams pa bsod nams mtha' yas/ gzims shag chos rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal sogs mtha' klas pa byon te ru lag stod kyi 'dzin mar kha'u brag rdzong pa'i ring lugs gdugs dkar po gcig gis mngon par khyab pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa mchog tu yangs/ rje 'di nyid kyi bslab ston ltar klu sgrub rjes gzhi bsnyen mdzad par gegs kyi rnam pa cung zad byung ba'i tshe zhu yig phul ba'i lan 'di lta ste/oṃ su sti/ dpal brgyud pa kun 'dus rigs brgya'i mgon/ /pha dngos grub 'byung gnas yid bzhin nor/ /rje dran pas gdung sel rdo ring pa/ /bu snod ldan gyi rgyud la byin gyis rlomes/ khyed dal 'byor rten mchog legs par thob/ /phyi thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs rgya cher bcad/ /yongs las 'phro dang brtson 'grus gnyas su 'dzom/ /lam rdo rje theg pa'i yang bcud thob/ /dus deng sang bsam gtan gyi khang bu na/ /lus zab gsal lha ru lam me bsgom/ /ngag rdo rje'i sngags su dir ri sgrog /sems bde —396

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6dewo gyi ngang du cham me ba//chos 'di 'dra'i khos len shes tsa na//rten dal 'byor la snying po longs pa yin//ma 'gro ba'i drin lan lon pa yin//bu mkhas pa'i thugs la de ltar zhog/sems dga' ba spro ba rgya cher skyed//yang dar cig thugs la 'di ltar zhog/rje bla ma spyi gas na 'du 'bral med//chos ci gnang rang sems dag pa'i 'khrul//de rim gnyis lam du 'khyer tshul shes//da gang ltar byas kyang bde ba yin//zhes tshigs su bcad pas mdor bsdus te gdams nas95ba tha gegs kyi rnam pas khams 'dus pa sgyid lug pa ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba snyam byed pa sogs skabs 'gar 'byung ba ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi bogs yin pas lta ba gsal stong zung 'jug las ma g.yos par gnang ba zhu/zhes pa gnang ba la brten nas bgegs kyi 'ching ba mtha' dag nam mkha' la sbrul mdud bzhin grol/mkhas grub chen po 'di nyid la mkha' spyod skor gsum/dmar chen skor gsum sogs klu pa'i gser chos bcu bzhi/rdo rje nag po gur gyi mgon po/dpal mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po sogs kyi chosaskor thun mong dang a mong ma yin pa/gshed dmar spros med/bka' gdams sogs bstan pa spyi bye brag gi zab rgyas chos kyi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang bar mdzad do//lan cig shar phyogs su dgag dgos che ba zhig la phebs pa'i sta gon gyi tshe grang mo che'i mgon khang gi ru mtshon rnams la bka' bsgo 'phrin bcol mdzad pa'i dus gzigs snang la de'i thad kyi nam mkhar rdo rje srin po sku shin tu che ba zhig gis phyag g.yas kyis gri gug sgo tshad tsam 'char stabs su bzung bar me lce tsha zhing rtsub pa'i tsha tsha phyogs phar 'phro ba gsal bar gzigs shing /der ma zad gnyan mgon chen po dang pho nya las mkhan rnams kyis log par 'khu ba'i dpung tsho gis rnams phye ma leb dang me lce'i tshul bzhin rdul du brlag pa'i gzigs snang ci yang byung bar mngon/gtsug lag khang bsrung ba'i rgyal po li byin ha ra sogs snang srid kyi dregs pa can mang por bka' rtags kyi springs yig stsal ba dag kyang gtsug tor gyi rtse mor 'god cing dam las mi 'da' bas96na po thun las tshul bzhin du sgrub pa mang la/de bas ches/ga pa rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams kyang bran du 'khol te

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)ji ltar bsgo ba lhur len pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bstod par/gur gyi mgon po dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs/ /'chi bdag dbang phyug ging lnga gza' gdong sogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho mngon sum bran du 'khol/ /mthu stobs nus pa'i gter la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes byung bas kyang shes nus/ de yang kun spangs rin po ches khyed la mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs byas res kyis ltas ya mtshan pa re yong gin 'dug pas mkha' spyod du myur bar 'khrid nyen yod tshul tshe sgrub la nan tan skyed mdzod sku tshe ring pa byung na bstan pa dang sems can la phan zhing mthu stobs chen po yong ba'i lung bstan ltar snga gong zhig gzigs snang la skas ring po btsugs pa la bud med mda' dar khyer ba gsum babs byung nas khyed gdan 'dren la yongs zer bar da lta nga la pha ma'ang yod pas mi 'gro gsungs par bud med de rnams log song / grang mo cher bzhugs skabs shig 'od gsal gyi ngang du rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po byon te da lta rgya gar lho phyogs na mu stegs kyi rgyal po stobs che ba zhig yod pas de 'dul du khyed 'gro dgos pa 'dug gsungs par brten zhag 'ga'i bar bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa mdzad pa na 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sku drung du bzhugs pa'i nub cig dag snang du nam mkha' nas mthongs khung lta bu skya shar re ba nas rus pa'i skas btsugs par bu mo dmar mo lo brgyad tsam lon par rus rgyan chab be ba btags pa zhig rgyab 'bab (96ba / ཿ byung nas rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos khyod 'bod du btang ba yin 'gro'am mi 'gro zer ba la thugs mi spro ba'i rnam pas lam 'bras bshad 'phro yang yod gsungs pas skas de la rgyab 'dzegs kyis log song rjes skas bsdus shing mthongs khung mi snang ba byung na yang ltas de dag dang rdo rje btsun mos mkha' spyod du gshegs par bskul bas zhing khams 'pho'am dgongs pa'i thugs so ma nyir gyur pa'i tshe/ re zhig lon pa na kun spangs rin po che 'od gsal gyi ngang du phebs nas mu stegs pa'i rgyal po rgan pa de shi bas gzhon pa dang khyed las 'brel mi 'dug da lam gzhan zhig btang yong skor zhig 'byon mi dgos 'dug gsungs par snang zhing / skal ldan gyi slob ma mang pos yun ring por bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo —398

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanasgrig pa'i gsol btab dang / rje btsun a ba sgru tī pa'i bslab bya'i gsung rnams thugs kyis dran te kha ba ri pa rnams kyi bstan 'gro'i ched du sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku yin te/ deng phyin chad khyod kyis don 'di rtse gcig pa'i sems kyis yid la bya yis/ zag bcas kyi skur ni mi bsam mo/ /zhes 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa thams cad kyi ngang tshul yin zhing gdul bya so so'i las snang gi dbang gis mthong tshul sna tshogs 'byung ba ni/ myang 'das rgya gar 'gyur las/ res 'ga' ni sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa grongs sgo snyam du yang dag par shes mod kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni dus thams cad du rtag pa dang brtan pa dang ther zug pa yin te/ zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /(97na skosang ba'i bdag pos rjes su bzung ba'i 'a zha nam mkha'i mtshan can sbyin bdag gi gtso bo thugs dad shin tu che ba'i khar gshegs par sngon du phyogs tshe skyabs 'jug gi gsol 'debs nan tan du mdzad pas thugs rje'i rgyud bskul ba'i mthus mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi skyabs 'asdug ched du bstad pa rgyun mar gnang zhing / rje btsun rdo ring po chen pos rje nyid la bstos pa thams cad rjes su 'dzin pa'i zhal bzhes yod pa bzhin thugs yus pa'i rnam pas gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa na/ thugs dam 'od gsal zhig la rje btsun gnyis spangs zhabs byon nas gnas gsar ba'i sdo pa khong bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i sbyin bdag khyad par can yin gshis chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis kyang lus dang grib ma bzhin 'grogs nas grogs byed kyin 'dug /'on kyang sngon gyi las shugs shig gis rgya nag gi mtha' 'khob tu ru dra mo zhig gi mngal du zla ba bdun tsam gnas rjes ma de chos skyong rnams kyis bsgral nas phyag na rdo rje'i drung du skye ba blangs te don 'grub par mchis mod/ khyed kyis 'bad rtsol mdzad na yun thung ngu zhig gis chog pa 'dra gang ltar do nub mjal bar 'ong gsungs pa bzhin ched du thugs 'dun bstang pas tshes bco lnga'i nub ā tsarla 'dras brten nas sde pa sngon dus kyi srid pa'i cha byad bzhin byung ste/ kho bo tshe 'phos rung bla ma —399

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pernams kyi thugs rje dang grogs ā tsarla 'di rnams kyis byas pas rgyal kha byung / da lta lha'i sgom bzlas dang gtor bsngos kyang ma chag phyag rdor gyi gsal 'debs shig dgos zhu ba ltar phyag 'khrid mdzad/(97ba〉de nas zhag gsum gyi ring gsang bdag gi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste mtshan byang la dbang bskur lam ston mdzad pas zhag 'ga' zhig song ba na 'brug gi sgra snyan po byung ba'i rkyen gyis gzigs pa'i tshe nor bu mig gsum pa 'od zer 'phro bas gzims chung gi nang gang ba byung bas sde pa de gnod sbyin bde ldan 'od zer zhes 'brug gi bzhon pa can gyi rnam par lcang lo can du skyes te/dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos rjes su bzung bas rje 'di nyid la drin lan bsab pa'i ched du nor bu phul bar snang / sde pa gshegs rjes rje bla ma bo dong nas myug tu phebs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gtso bor gyur pa'i zhal ngo rnams dang don gnyer can nyi shu skor la nā ro ta pa'i slob bshad kyi byin rlabs/ rtsa dbu ma'i nyams 'khrid zab mo dang chos skor rnams stsal/ sems nyid gsal stong gsang ba'i rje btsun ma gcer mthong du ngo sprad par brten/ mkhyen brtse'i gsung las/ a ho rgyal yum dbang mos mngon sum du/ /du ma'i skye bar rjes bzung bla ma mchog /mchog 'dis zab mo'i nye lam 'di bstan tshe/ /tshe 'dir mkha' spyod sgrub la the tshom bral/ /zhes gsungs/ rim gyis shangs sreg shing rin cen sgang gi dgon par sde pa gnas gsar bas spyan drangs pa bzhin phebs/ dpal ldan chos skyong gi thugs bcud 'jam dpal dmar po'i dbang byin rlabs/ zab lam spros pa med pa'i nyams 'khrid zab slo shin tu smin par gnang bas mkhyen brtse'i gsung las/ dpe nag bltas ba'i bshad yams tsam ma yin par thugs nyams su ji ltar myong ba bzhin bstan pas sems kyi sgro 'dogs thams cad der chod/(98na)slar grub thob tu btags pa'i blun po 'ga' re'i rkang pa la gtug dgos bsams pa'i blo rtsa ba nas bud lam dang lam min pa'i shan chod pa zhig byung ste/ 'jam dpal khros pa dus dgra'i dbang po des/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis thugs bstan 'di bsten tshe/ /'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i don du kho bos rtogs/ /'jam dbyangs dngos su byon kyang zhu rgyu med/ /ces gsungs/ rim bzhin bstan pa'i —400

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)sbyin bdag chen po'i thugs ngo dang bstun 'o yug sdings mar phebs thugs sras mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la rje btsun yab dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i 'khrid sogs stsal/de nas rje bla mas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse la da lo zha lur gnas skor dang sbrags nas byon bu lugs kyi dbang rnams thob na ma thob na mdzod/ chos lung du bzhugs mkhan khri khang rje btsun ma rang khungs dag pas der zhu ba dang rnam sras kyi dbyangs rol 'dra yang rtsad gcod dgos pa'i bslab ston gnang ba ni yab sras gnyis ka zha lu'i mkhan thog tu phebs pa'i mngon mkhyen du mchis/ rje 'di nyid dbus nas mgyogs 'khor zhig mdzad nas khri khang du phebs dus rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug la bde mchog nag bo pa'i dbang dang zhal bzhi pa'i gsang 'khrid gnang / rje'i drung nas kyang gser dngul sogs 'bul ba stobs che ba bstar ro/ /mang thos nor bu'i gdengs can klu yi dbang / /rig pa srid sgrub mda' bzhin rab drang bas/ /rgya chen gzhung brgya smra la mtsho byung ma/ /snying zhugs mkhas des khyod zhabs gtsug tu bsten/ /slob bshad khyab 'jug rkang rta ge snod ldan gyi/ rgyal mawo (98bcur bkod dga' ston la rol kyang / /a mong rjes 'bangs lha min dogs bral ba/ /skal ldan shing rta gnyis pa sa 'dir snang / khrag 'thung gar la bzhengs pa'i zhabs sen rdul/ /ma mgon mkha' 'gro'i thor tshugs rtser 'dzegs nas/ /bka' rtags ri mo sde brgyad gtsug 'char ba/ /rgyal phran 'khor sgyur lung gi rjes 'gro bzhin/ /'chi med tshe byin brlabs pa gzhes bral skus/ /gsang bdag rig pa 'dzin pa nam mkha'i mtshan/ /mkha' lamakha' yi sbyor ba ji bzhin du/ /lag na rdo rje'i 'khor lor smin cing grol/ /gsol 'debs las/ 'dren pa mchog gis sngon nas lung bstan cing / /chos skyong lha mos gus pas spyan drangs te/ /dpal ldan zha lu'i chosakyi gdan khri la/ /zhabs pad mdzes par bkod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpal phug rnam par grol ba'i pho brang du/ /slob bshad zab mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /mkhas grub slob mas sa gsum kun khyab ste/ /bstan pa nyin mor mdzad la gsol ba 'debs/ /—401

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6she zhes sngar mkhyen rab rin po ches rje btsun rdo ring pa chen por zha lu'i gdan sa mdzad pa 'char shas kha bas nged kyi tsha bo 'di la'ang mgo 'don legs po mdzod gsung bar bdag de 'dra mi byed zhus pas khyed mi mdzad na nyid kyi gra pa zhig la nges par 'ong gsungs par brten/ rdo ring rin po ches sngar gyi lo rgyus dang bcas brag dkar sems dpa' chen por khyed mkhan po mdzad dgos pa yong shas che gsungs pa'i lan du bdag gis yong yang mi yong byed kyang mi byed zhus pas des na chos rje tshar pas mdzad 'gro nyen che gsungs pa dang / (99na)de mtshungs rje nyid kyis rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo mjal bar phebs dus khyed la 'di mkho ba'i dus shig 'ong cis kyang gsan mdzod ces lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i rjes gnang lung rnams rdzogs par stsal ba'i bla ma gnyis kyi lung bstan dus babs dang / bu ston rin po che slar yang rang bstan la bsams bzhin skye ba bzhes pa'i smon lam gyi mthu brtas te zha lu'i chen slob thams cad mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig pa'i tshul gyis mkhan po'i gsol 'debs la yong ba'i sngon du nub cig mnal du song tshul bstan pa'i srod 'khor la bud med smug nag 'jigs su rung ba mche ba gtsigs shing ral pa dmar ser rting par slebs pa zhig byung nas khyed kyis zha lu'i gdan sa mdzad dgos zer ba zhig byung ba dpal ldan ma'i cho 'phrul du 'dug ces zhabs 'bring ba 'dra la gsungs/ tho rengs thog kha nas rje nyid kyis zhal shar du gzigs te dung dkar po zhig bus pa skad shin tu che ba byung / sang nyin phyag phyi rnams la de ring su byung yang gtam kha ma len so ma song ba las med phebs par cung zad song ba na khang rnying slob dpon rnam sras/ rin spungs byams pa ba sogs zha lu'i mkhan por phebs dgos pa'i snyan gsan 'bul mi rnams slebs/ rgyu mtshan gsol bar zhal gyis ma bzhes pa'i de nub mnal lam du kun spangs rje bzhugs gdan dma' ba la na bza' hrul zhing zhal mdangs ngan pa zhig byas bzhugs nas khyed la zha lu'i gdan sa'i snyan gsan byung ngam gsung bar byung yang khas ma blangs gsol bar skyag re la a ngas na ning nas khyed la byas pa min pa e yin gsung ba (99ba)lung bstan du dgongs nas mkhan po'i zhal bzhes mdzad pa'i mtshan —402

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)lam du/ rdo ring rin po che sku mdangs dang na bza' legs shing shin tu dgyes pa'i ston pa zhig byung /de nas srin po zhes pa shing yos sos kyi dga' ston la babs pa 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i dus skya rags kyis chibs bsu dang 'dus tshogs rnams kyis 'phan gdugs rol mo sogs mchod pa'i yo byad thogs pa'i ser sbreng / mchod gar gyis sna drangs pas mdun bsus dpal zha lu gser bkang gi chos gra chen po snyigs kyi dus rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rin po che'i seng ge'i khrir phebs/ de'i tshe nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la me tog gi char 'dab ma lnga pas mtshon lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i ched du phab cing / gan spos kyi dri 'dra rung ba la zhib tu brtags na sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri bsung gis khyab pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas phun sum tsho gos pa byung / sngon mthu chen gangs pa shāka 'bum gyi slob ma sngags rnying ma bka' gter thams cad la mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i g.yung ston rdo rje dpal zhes gos dkar lcang lo'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa'i sngags 'chang chen po des phung po ri bo che nas gtum mo dub hrul ma'am/ gsar ma ba rnams tsa murnyi ra 'bod pa'i zhal brnyan ma he'i gdong can zhig gter nasabazhes pa dang cha 'dra ba'i yab kyi zhal 'bag cig kyang bzlos pa'i rwa nang du thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston chos rjes gsol zan gyi lhag la gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad kyi gzugs brnyan phyag bzo mdzad pa bcug pas byin rlabs shin tu che bar byung ba/ yos lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i dmar cha la bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba dang (100na thas ma sbyor ngan pa 'chang ba'i gzugs can gzugs med rnams tshar gcod pa'i ched du ma he mchod pa'i srol btsugs/ thog mar dam bzhag gnang mkhan chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa/ zhal brnyan bzhes pa po sngags 'chang g.yung gis mdzad de 'phrin las rnam bzhi thogasamed du sgrub pa'i dbu btsugs/ de nas mkhan thogs mang po'i bar lo skor rer 'cham pa'i srol rgyun nyams med du byung na'ang bar skabs su 'tshub kyi rnam pas shangs mtshal shor ba phyag zhabs rengs pa re gnyis byung bar brten la las dmod nas 'thor ba tsam las bka' bsgo ma mdzad pas nub par nye ba'i lo skor gcig gnyis ma he 'cham gra'ang chag pas 'cham dgos pa'i ltas sna tshogs byung ba nas —403

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)spyir rje 'di nyid mkhas grub kyi snyan pa che bar ma zad bye brag mthu stobs kyi grags pa phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i mthun snang grub gshis de dus bu lugs kyi chos rgyun sgrub mchod sogs bstan pa nyams che ba gso ba dang lhag par ma he'i bka' bsgo mdzad du re ba'i sngar gyi rgyun rnams dang bcas bstan pa spyi bye brag gi 'phel rgyas dang skye rgu'i bde thabs la dgongs te/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsang ba'i chos skyong las kyi gshin rje la bka' bsgo ba gnang dgos zhes zhus pa bzhin zhal gyis 'ches/dbus gtsang gi sde brgyad gnas sa gnyan po mtha' dag tu dus tshes 'di la shog cig pa'i brda 'grems su rlung sems la nang byan chud pa'i rtogs ldan skad gtong rdzong bda' mdzad/ dam pa 'di nyid las shugs dbang thang rim gro sogs la re ba dang / 'phral du zla sbrel gyi bsnyen pa tsam (100ba)gyis phan du re ba'i rigs ma yin par dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i zhal can gyi bskyed rim la brtan pa thob/ rdzogs rim klong du gyur/ bsnyen sgrub pha mthar son pas 'jigs pa dang bral na'ang gsang sngags phyag len gyi che ba mi nub pa'i slad du bdun gnyis kyi bar ljags bsnyen kha gso mdzad pa'i tshe 'od gsal du 'chi bdag yab yum la gshin rje pho brgyad mo brgyad/ lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas zha lu'i rdo gcal du stang stabs byed pa shar/ spyi sgos so so nas gra sgrig dgos pa'i rigs sngar srol 'phyugs med yong ba'i zhal ta gnang /dus der spo yig gnang ba 'di lta ste/ shrī mdu ru badz+ra ra wā ya na maḥ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid nas bzung bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras kyis gtso mdzad bdag gi bla ma rje btsun gnyis spangs zhabs kyi bar du byon pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'/ khro bo'i dbang po dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi lung / dpal zha lu gser bkang gi gdan sa bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal dus dgra nag po ma he'i zhal gyi brtul zhugs grub pa'i yi ge /srid pa gsum na gnas shing rgyu ba'i 'byung po mi ma yin pa rnams la zlo ba/ zla ba 'di'i nyer gsum gyi nyin lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og 'jigs rung gshin rje'i grong —404

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)khyer chen po nas dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' sdod chen po 'chi bdag kyilas gshin rje yab yum dang 'khor las kyi ma gzhin pho mo snang srid lha srin sdebargyad dang bcas pa sbyan drangs/mchod pa dang gtore 01nasgo dang bstod pas mnyes par byas/dmar r+pā gyi a: dang rdo rje bdud rtsi'i mna' chu blud/dam tshig rdo rje 'bar bas dam la bzhag cing bka' bsgos te rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang /skye rgu sems can yongs kyi bde skyid 'phel bar bya ba'i ched dang khyad par chos gra chen po 'di nyid kyis gtso byas dge 'dun gyi sde dang rnal 'byor 'khor bcas bde zhing dam pa'i chos spyod pa'i 'phrin las 'chol ba dang /de dag la gnod cing bar du gcod pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams srung ma dam tshig can rnams kyis rang rang gi khas blangs dang dam tshig rjes su dran pas mchod gtor gyis tshim par gyis la mthu dang nus pa stobs dang rdzu 'phrul gang yod kyis bcol ba'i 'phrin las sgrubs/'dir 'dus shing tshogs pa'i mi rnams kyang bsam sbyor dge zhing zhi ba'i sgo nas ngo mtshar gyi ltad mos yid tshim pa dang ma rungs pa'i las byas na 'di lta bu'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas tshar bcad 'ong snyam pa'i skrag shes par gyis/gal srid kha drag shed khyer mi sha kha mchu gsar rnying tshol bu lon/gtes gto 'dzin/spyod ga gshis ga gyi sgo nas rgya 'dre 4ba rtsod/gzings rkyen byas pa byung na chos sde chen po'i spyi sa nas lugs gnyis dang mthun pa'i tshar gcod phyis lam khegs pa gtor ba dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa rab tu khros pas bka' bsgos te gtes po su yin pa de 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po'i zas skal du ster bas nges pa gyis/so so tha dad nas dran 'dzin dang bag yod la gnas pa dge 101bshing zhi ba gal che/me pho 'brug lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la dpal zha lu gser bkang gi bla brang chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas bris/zhes zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer gsum gyi nyin thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i bzhugs khri'i steng du phebs pa'i mtha' skor gyi khyon kun skya ser gyi khrom khri phrag tu brgal bas bskor/zha lu chos sde pa rnams kyis / 0rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas dbyu gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)cho ga /las kyi gshin rjer mchod bshags bskang mdos rgyas par bstar/ lho phyogs na sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi rnam pa'i khang pa nas 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje yab yum la 'khor lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'bag chas gos kyi kha dog rnam pa sna tshogs pa 'gros kyi rkang grangs kyi nges bzung med pa'i yid la gang shar gyi 'chams stabs dang / ngag nas ki sgra bso sgra sogs sgra sna tshogs sgrog pas phal cher rnam rtog dang ya nga ba'i gnas su 'god pa'i gtso 'khor de rnams sbug sil rnga dung chen gyis gtsos pa'i rol mo gnam sa 'gas pa lta bus yar spyan drangs te khyams rar 'khor lugs sngar srol ji lta ba la/ rje bla ma'i drung du khyad nyer slebs pa'i tshe shes pa rang bzhin du gnas pa'i mis 'bag phod gyon par khu 'khris yong don mi 'dug rung zhal brnyan gyi ye shes pa'i nus pa 'jug gi yod pa zhig yin nam rje'i drung du 'gro ba la 'jigs pa lta bu'i 'gro ma nus par tsho 'then byas pa'i ngang nas rim gyis 'ongs te mgo bos btud pa na/ 'jam dpal drag por khros pa'i nga rgyal dpa' gdengs nang du shar ba'i phyi rol tu sku mdangs dmar smug tu 'gyur/ gdung shugs drag (102na)pos rtsa brgyud bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod pa sogs bka' bsgo ba'i tshig rnams khrom pa kun gyi rna ba'i yul du thos pa dang chabs cig par gtsug tu rdo rje dang lce thog tu bdud rtsi bzhag nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel zhing /gzugs can dgra dang gzugs med kyi bgegs dpung thams cad tshar gcod pa sogs 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i dam bsgrag mdzad pa'i tshe ye shes kyi khro bo'i gzi byin dang sde brgyad kyi 'tshub lhongs kyis der 'khod thams cad 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' bar gyur/ bka' bsgo grub mtshams nang du 'khod pa'i dad ldan rnams ni gangs ri la zla ba shar bas dkar ba bzhin sngar bas kyang gus pa ches cher 'phel/kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs dang rje btsun kha'u pa'i ring lugs la snying nas smod cing 'tshe ba dag 'chi bdag gshin rje'i dmar zas su bstab song snyam pa'i yid khong du chud/ bzang ngan dang bral ba'i btang snyoms can rnams dang tshod bgam par byed pa rnams ni tshar pa chos rje khong las shugs kyi dbang thang dang rdzas bsod can min 'dug kyang yi dam gyi lha'i gnang ba thob cing sngags spyon bgrangs pa'i —406

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tananus can zhig go zhes ca co'i sgra dir dir du glengs/ las kyi gshin rje'i gtor ma bstan dgra gang yod kyi phyogs su 'phangs shing sde brgyad rnams kyang dngos bshams yid kyis sprul pa'i tshogs kyi 'khor los tshim nas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i yi dam brtan pos so so'i gnas su dengs dngos gzhi khrom mi 'jam pa sogs ma byung na'ang zhag khongs der zha lu bar shin tu gnag pa'i bstan dgra zhig khrag skyugs pa'i (102ba)rkyen gyis dus kyi pho lha'i dbang du song / rnam sras mchod pa sogs rgyas par mdzad/me 'brug lo nag pa zla bar kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ khyab bdag bod mkhar ba chen po/mkhyen rab chos rje'i dbon bo sogs gra pa nyis brgya lhag pa la 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dbang cha dgu tsam dang / spros med kyi 'khrid sogs so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag rgya cher stsal/ sgrub mchod chen mo'i tshogs dbur phebs pa'i gung gseng zhig la chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku 'dra'i drung du gcig pur bzhugs te gdung shugs drag po'i gsol 'debs mdzad bas sku de gzi mdangs je cher rgyas shing sku'i cha shas thams cad las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros nas bar snang khyab pa dang slar tshur 'dus la la rje nyid kyi sku la thim/ la la sku 'dra rang la thim pa'i thugs nyams shar/ mi ring bar sprul sku bde bsam pas gzigs snang ji ltar byung ba'i sku zhig kyang thugs dam rten la bzheng du bcug /ri mthil gyi sgrigs kun spyod sgrub mchod che chung sogs chosarje thams cad mkhyen pa'i dus kyi grol rgyun nyams pa rnams gsos te bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad/ re zhig stod phyogs su phebs grang mo che dang rmu gzhong du rgyang tsam stan chags nasazha phur phebs skabs shig lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i gtor ma zhal bsgyur ba sogs dpal ldan ma 'dis tshon las thams cad sgrub pa'i dgyes mtshan gsal bar bstan/me sbrul slab dang po'i nang du thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis gtsos phyogs 'dusakyi slob ma mang du byon/ ri phug chos kyi pho (103na)brang chen por gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad yongs rdzogs gnang bar kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor ba gsang chen —407
