rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyebastan pa rgyas byed ces bya ba bum dbang gi rmi lam yan chad kyi zin bris yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu zhig mdzad/zla ba bzhi pa nas don gnyer can du ma la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i rim lnga'i 'khrid sogs bu lugs kyi 'khrid chen bzhi dang 'khrid chung bzhi rnams kyi nyams 'khrid rim bzhin chos thun gsum du bcad de so so'i rgyab rten gyi lung bcas smin rgyas dang / gzhan yang mdo sngags kyi zab chos ji snyed cig stsal/ de yang rim lnga gnang gdong dbang ma thob pa kha yar byung bar smin byed med kha med nas rje bla ma bka' chos gzhan gnang ba'i thugs brel gyis g.yengs nas gnang long ma byung bar kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse la khyed kyis gzhan ma'i rgyas bkab sogs 'dres bslad med pa'i bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i yig cha sor bzhag gi dbang zhig bskur mdzod bka' phebs pa bzhin thun mtshams kyi dgong mo bzhi tsam zhig mar me la gzigs 'jug mdzad de rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang cha gnyis gsung bzhin bsgrubs/ zha lu pa'i pha chos bde chen ral gcig gi smin grol gnyis bar zhig nas ya bral te rje bla mas grol byed ma gtogs smin byed ma gsan pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rjer gsan zhing / 'di gnyan cha che grags kyis mang por spel ba mdzad rung 'di dus rje nyid kyis da lam ngas bka' rgya bkrol ba yin pas 'ab mi yong bstan rgyun la (103ba)dgongs nas cis kyang mdzod ces gsung ba ltar dbang cha gsum la bde chen ral gcig lha nyer lnga'i dbang bzhi/ gzhan don nus pa kha shas la byin rlabs gnyis dang bdag po chen po'i dbang yang gnang bar brten chos 'di snum zad kyi mar me lta bu'i srog mthud pa'ang tshar chen bla ma nyid kyis bka' drin kho nar sems shing / rjes su gal chung chos la byas pa'i rgyun nub par nye na'ang mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis gsan skabs rigs 'dzin chen po'i mchod dpon bla ma smyo rgyan rgyal po yod 'dug pa nas dbang lung gnyis ka gong dkar phyogs su me stag tsam zhig byung mod/ la lar spang gi sha mo rdol ba lta bu ni gang yin ma shes/—408

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grag pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (ta)rje bla mas yos lo nas bzung lo gsum gyi bar gdan sa mdzad nas kun spangs kyi dgongs pa bstod pa'ang thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che sku na bsres song ba'i skabs zha lu'i gdan sa mi mdzad gsung ba'i bka' phebs pas zha lu ba rnams kyis nan cher zhus pa'i tshe 'o na lo drug tsam bya yi zhes zhal gyis bzhes nas gsum song mtshams su 'jog pa gnang ba'i tshe zhal bzhes kyi lo ma thengs tshul zhus pa'i lan du slar lo gsum byed gnang ba sku tshe rting ma zhig la dgongs pa'i zhal bzhes grub pa dang / sngar mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' las/ gnas gsar chos rje nyid bu lugs kyi chos skor gsan pa dang cho ga phyag len gdangs dbyangs tshun la bslab sbyang zhib mo dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan phebs pa'ang mkhan thog tu 'byon dgos par dgongs pa'i ye shes kyi gzigs pa gsal 'grib med pa'i thog tu babs pas zha lu'i chen slob sogs za rigs sbyin bdag kun mkhan chen (104na)thams cad mkhyen pas zur bzhugs gnang phyin chos rje gnas gsar ba las 'os pa gzhan med do zhes mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig tu glengs te/ sde srid rin cen spungs pa la snyan 'bul 'phul ba la'ang shin tu legs pa'i dgongs bstad bzang po'i bde khrol dang / gtso bor rje nyid kyi thugs rje'i gzigs pa lhod pa med pa sogs rgyu rkyen rnams 'dzom par brten zha lu spyi sos mkhan po'i snyan gsan phul bar/ rje bla ma'i dgongs bstad dang bcas bzlog ma bde bar lo gcig gi zhal len gnang ba na rje nyid kyis ngas lo gsum khyed kyis lo gcig mdzad na sde dgon tshos phyag rten yang mi 'byor bas gsum nges par mdzod/ de nas mdzad bde'i babs la gzigs chog /dgon sbag sbug gzhan gyi bla ma'i dod min chos 'jig rten ga nas kyang rnam gzhag rgya chen po'i slob thebasayod tshul phebs pa ltar chu stod zla ba'i tshes gcig rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor dus ma pham mgon po rin cen grub kyi gdan sar bsko ba gnang bar/ sde srid rin spungs pa'i bsko 'ja' khri ston zha lu'i chen slob dge 'dun yon bdag gzhan yang phyogs kyi sde phran gyis mtsho ni pa'i bdog pa rgya chen po spel/khyad par mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pas ber zlam dbu zhwa sogs kyi gnang sbyin/ dpon slob tshang —409—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shemar 'phral yun du dge ba'i bslab bya/ bkra shis me tog gi char chen po phab/ chos rje gdan sa pas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang cha gnyis dang sbyor drug gi 'khrid cig mdzad/yab sras lhan rgyas sde pa gnas gsar bas myug tu bro g.yis rtsed sna bsu ba ser sbreng gi bkod (104ba)pa dang bcas gdan drangs rnyed bkur gya nom pa bstabs/ dpal phug rnam par grol ba'i ri khrod du zla ba bdun tsam gyi ring rje 'di nyid kyis kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel sogs dpon slob bco brgyad tsam la gsung ngag slob bshad shin tu smin pa gnang / sngar mkhyen brtse'i mnal ltas la dpal phug tu pha bla mas gsung ngag bskyar nas gnang rgyu'i skor yang 'di'i lung bstan du mchis/ lam 'bras kyi mjug tu dmar po skor gsum mgon po che chung sogs kyi rjes gnang lung 'khrid yang bskyar dang shangs pa du gu ba'i gser chos kyi phyed tsam gnang / chos rnams gegs med du grub pa'i gtang rag yang steng du mdzad pa'i tshe mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin dum chad cig gi steng na mgon po thog tshad tsam gyi zhal nas ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ gi sgra la chos 'di'i bdag po sngar yang nga rang gis byas pas da dung yang nga rang gis byed zer ba gsal bar gsan/rje nyid zab bur phebs pa'i lam zhor du rje mkhyen brtses 'o yug tu gdan drangs nas sri zhu rgya cher mdzad/ myug tu shangs chos kyi 'phro dang sgrub thabs rgya mtsho rgyal khang du sgrol dkar gyi tshe 'khrid sogs thugs sras mkhyen brtse'i bzhed pa bkang nas stod du phebs/ sa rta'i dbyar yab tshan 'phan yul o rgyan gas ka bas gdan drangs te phebs/ lam zhen ngur smrig gi gtsug lag khang du rje btsun sgrol ma mjal ba gnang ste der bzhugs skabs dag snang la bud med mang po rten mjal gyin 'dug pa'i khrod na mig gsum yod pa'i bud med cig gzigs gsung ba (105na)rdzu bag tsam las 'phags mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs par gdon mi za/ rim gyis phebs pa'i bzhugs mtsher rgyal sa shin tu che ba zhig tu gnas mal mdzad pa'i nam phyed tsam la 'byung po des glags lta bar rtsom pa na gtum —410

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)drag 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mes mtha'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du bskrad pa na phyis mi sgo de la 'gong po'i 'tshe ba ye ma byung bar gda'/'phan yul o rgyan gzhis spur bzhugs skabs thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho hor bar ta ga rma dpal gyis rong po 'dam du gdan 'dren zhus pa'i phebs lam du sde pa o rgyan gzhis ka bas gdan drangs pa dang 'grig rje nyid kyis nged thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'du rgya mtsho'i zhal slob yin pas rten 'brel legs gsungs nas thams cad mkhyen pa la bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi chos 'brel gsan/thams cad mkhyen pas gur mgon gyi rjes gnang zhu ba mdzad pas kha'u brag rdzong pa'i zab chos thugs nyams su bstar ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo thog mar 'grig/slar rin po che bod mkhar nas la gsung ngag tsam ma gtogs snyan brgyud phal cher gsan cing nā ro mkha' spyod dang rig byed ma mgon po che chung sogs la nyams bzhes shin tu smin par gnang /nā le rgyu'i khams pa bla ma sdor dkar ba sogs don gnyer can nyi shu skor la bde mchog lo nag dril gsum gyi dbang /dpyid thig nag po rim bzhi/rig lnga rnams kyi nyams 'khrid/rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa/zhe gu chos drug gi dbang zhakhrid byin rlabasalung sogs༄ba chos mang dugasungs/phyogs der 'gro don 'phrin las 'ur cher langs pa'i ngang nasagatsang du phebs pa'i lam g.yung mda' mkhar gyi 05bsko yabs steng du bzhugs/mchod dpon gyis thugs dam gtor ma bshams phyag dril sogs phul yang spyan mkha' reg shar gyi ri rtse la zim me bzhugs pa las gtor bsngos mi gnang 'dug pa skabs mtshams shig nas zhabs bskul zhug par bsdus pa zhig mdzad/gsol ba sdos/bas kyang cung zad tsam las mi bzhes par sngar ltar bzhugs/de bar phyag g.yog byings kha la bkal nas sngon la song gsol dpon blo gsal can la da dung ja skol gsung gsol ja spyor gnyis tsam gyi bar bzhugs nas phebs/de'i tshe jo mo mkha' reg gi gangs ri'i rtser sprin dkar po chen po zhig lho phyogs su skyes /nga ba'i steng nas o rgyan rin po che sku mi tshad las

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pecung che ba za hor gyi sku chas sprad pa na bza'i gong len la stag lpags gsar pa'i mu 'gril yod pa/phyag g.yas na gser gyi rdo rje dang g.yon na ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa zhabs rdo rje skyil krung du bzhugs pa gsal bar gzigs nas rim bzhin bsti gnas su phebs so/ /gnyis spangs bla ma'i lung bzhin bu ston rje'i/ /seng khrir phebs la 'dod khams dbang mo yis /nyer bskul srid mthar bstan pa 'phel ba'i sgra/ /rab dkar bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung las sgrog /'jig rten gsum dbang lha r+ṣa nyi ma'i bus/ /rdo rje'i rwa rtse spu gri ltar rno ba/ khyod drung pad 'dab rjes 'gro'i 'jam mnyen gyi/ /reg byar lta la mkha' ngos rgyu skar 'khrigs/ /mkhan gzugs lha gral sgrig pa'i las dbang bcud/ /myangs pas srog ldan sbyin skyes mched min pa/ /lha sngags ye shes gser sgong mngal 'dzin pa'i/ /mes po blo gsal rgya mtsho yab sras tsam/ /(106na tha ston bzhed srol pad+ma'i skud pa la/ /rdo rje'i khams su rlobs zhes gnas gsar ba/ /gdung 'tshob dam par gsol tshe phyogs bcu'i rgyal/ /sras bcas yongs kyis bsngags pa'i me rtag gtor/ kha bshad chu bor snyan brgyud gser ldan ma/ /bying las gyen 'degs bstan 'dzin mig sngon can/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i rus sbal 'phrul gyi stobs/ /tshangs pa'i blo gros des kyang gzhal nus min/ /ris med 'gro ba'i bsod nams rlabs po ches/ /zhing gyur rgya mtsho'i gos can 'phrin las/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i gnag snum ral pa'i rtser/ /zhabs sen zla ba tshes te gcig tu dkar/ /gsol 'debs las/ khyab bdag bla ma'i thugs rjes bskul ba bzhin/ /rang gi bsti gnas dam par zhabs bkod de/ /skal bzang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /'bral med thugs rjes bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pas zin so yod med sna tshogs las sa lug 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis gdan 'dren gnang skabs myug tu rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan sku 'khrungs pa'i byin rlabs la spyan drangs pa bzhin phebs nas 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du smin par mdzad pa sogs rjes su bzung zhing dgung lo lnga tsam gyi dus dmar po skor gsum chos skyong che chung tshe dpag med —412

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)sogs kyi byin rlabs rjes gnang gi rigs kyang mang du stsal/sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyi rnam thar las/bdag gi spyil bu na de snga gong chos rje rab brtan pa'i bzhugs yul yin pas khong gnas rnying rgyal po de la gsol mchod gnang gin yod 'dug pas de'i nang na 06brgyal po de 'khor re 'gro ba zhig gzigs pa dang /lhag par bdag thugs rje'i gzigs pa mi lhod par gnang gin yod gda' bas zla ba de ga'i nang du rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po bka' drin mtshungs med tshar pa rjes myug nas phyag dam bdud rtsi'i ril bu'i thums gsol ras dang bcas phebs byung ba'i nang na khyod kyi sgrub khang der gnas rnying rgyal po 'di 'phral 'phral 'gro ba zhig 'dug pas bar chad dam 'tshub kyi rnam pa bzhin mi yong 'dug gam/ngas kyang dmigs pa sogs gang yod byed kyin yod lar rdo ring rin po cher rang re'i brgyud 'dzin kun la gnod pa mi byed pa'i srog snying phul nas dam bcas 'o skol rnams la 'di gcig pu'i bka' drin yang bsam pa'i re ba las 'das/gang ltar de la dmigasapa'i gtor ma 'dra dang dge sbyor 'bungs skyid de byed pa dang lhag par lam zab mo nyid la nan to gyis rtag tu gsol ba thob/gegs sel bogs 'don gyi skyel so 'di gcig pa yin no gsung ba zhig phebs byung zhes bslab ston rgyas par stsal/zha lu'i gdan sa kun spangs mdzad pa nas bzung rgyal khams phyogs med kyi gdul bya'i re ba skong ba tsam ma gtogs 'jig rten za zi'i mthun 'jug la thugs sun pa'i tshul gyis spong ba bsam gtan la gzhol ba'i rnam pas rmu gshong du lo gsum phyogs gsum mdzad pa'i skabs 'jam dbyangasamakhyen brtse'i rnam thar du lcags sprel zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nas gzhi bsnyen gyi sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshugs pa'i tshes bzhi'i nub rmi lam du rje btsun rdo rje 'chang pha tshar pa rje dang mjal rta ma spung gsang gi dbang rdzogos par gnang /dkyil 'khor gtore mtshig so gos kyang shin tu 107nagasal ba dang /phyag len la dogs gcod 'dra zhu rgyu yod pa'ang zhugashing lan gnang ba zhig byung /yang nub cig la bla ma bzhugs khri thog rtser stogs pa /ga gi steng na ber thul ne tse khags ra pa zhig bzhes

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)nas bzhugs pa'i sku 'khas g.yon na bdag 'dug pa la a skyabs kyis gsol ja zhus rjes gsol kha zhu yi 'dug pas nga'i de khong la drongs gsungs gsol kha de bdag la drangs pa zhig rmis/ yang nub cig dbu rtse 'og 'dra ba zhig na khri sngar gyi de las mtho ba 'dra ba zhig la bzhugs tshe 'khrid kyi tshar chos de gsung rgyu yin snyam pa byas bdag sku mdun na 'dug pa la gsung chos ha cang gsal ba ni ma byung rlung bum can gzung spyan lta stangs mdzad har re bzhugs pa gsal po zhig rmis/ yang nub cig bo dong rdzong gi bde ba can/ yin snyam pa zhig na bzhugs gdan mthon po zhig la rdo rje 'chang sgo rum pa chen po bzhugs de'i sku gzhogs g.yon bdag /bdag gi g.yon na rje btsun dbon bzhugs pa rje rin po ches gnyis len mdzad rgyu ba'i ston gshom bzang po byas pa zhig rmis zhes byung /zha lur bzhugs skabs 'od gsal du rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po na bza' sogs shin tu legs pa'i ngos ma chen rdo rje bkra shis phyags phyir khrid pa'i 'dar gyi phyogs su thal ler phebs pa zhig byung ba phugs de phyogs su sdod dgos pa yongs 'dug ces rje nyid kyi gsung 'phros las byung ba bzhin bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po 'dar pas 'di phyi bar gsum gyi skyabs gcig mgon gcig zhus par brten phal cher grang mo che phyogs su stan chags/ sde pa'i sku rim la 'jigs byed drug (107bcu pa gnang skabs liṅga skad ngan tser re re bton pa tho phyi na yod pa kun gyis tshor/ de bzhin gshegs pas lus las chad pa'i sgra gcan zin dang dgra ltar lta ba'i lhas byin la nye ring med pa'i bden tshig bka' stsal mthus lhas sbyin ma 'ju ba'i nad las grol ba'i lo rgyus bzhin dam pa 'di nyid kyang ris med kyi 'gro ba la ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes lta bur mdzad pa las 'dzin rtog gi phyogs lhung dri ma can mi mnga' na'ang / nyi mas ched du byas pa min par rten 'brel gyi dbang la zer 'phreng gis pad+ma kha 'byed cing / brag phug byang bstan du nyi 'od mi 'char ba dngos po'i gshis lugs su grub pa ma go bar rje nyid la re ba bca' ba'i skye bo mchog dman rnams thugs rje chen pos rjes su bzung bar brten se dkar rigs kyi thig le 'dar nas kyi mnga' thang je 'phel du gyur pa gdong dga' phyogs kyis ma —414

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (1)bzod pa'i bdag po kun rin par chos rje tshar pa 'di sa skya pa'i chos la mkhas drags/ gdung brgyud rnams chad na kho rang la bstan pa'i bdag po yong du re ba'i rmu gshong gi mgon po'i zhabs 'og tu mnan pa sogs ngan byed byas zhes phra ma bcug pa dang btsun mo gnyis kyi gdong dga' ba'i lcam la song ba'i rgyus sa skya dang gdong dga' ba rtse bstun gyi dmag shing byi mang mkhar phyogs su btang ba'i skabs dmag mi rnams kyis rmu'i mgon khang la lag rgyag byas sku rnams bshig pa'i gzungs bzhugs bdag chen pa'i spyan lam du phab pas/ sa skya pa'i bstan pa dang gdung brgyud 'phel ba'i spel tshig gzigs pa na thugs dbyung yang zer/ ma chen rdo rje bkra shis kyis dgon pa ni dmag gis bcoms zin 'dug mthu yod na rtags thon (108na)pa zhig gnang dgos zhus pa'i lan du bdag chen khong rang ci mdzad kyang kho bo sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas gdung brgyud la mthu mi byed khyod kyis yod na gyis zhes bka' bkyon pa'i rnam pa'ang mdzad/bya gshong du gtor bzlog la phebs skabs gnas khang de thog ma las yangs shing gru bzhi lam pa gyang logs la rdul sogs med pa'i snum zhag che ba de'i 'khor kun gyis gsal bar mthong yol rin cen gling du chos rje blo gros brtan pa mi ma yin du skyes nas smyug la ba yas mas la gnod tshabs che ba'i gtam byung ba na mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros kyis brtag pa dang yin na sbyin sreg dgos tshul zhu ba mdzad pa'i lan du de dngos bstan min rgya 'dres brdzus pas dgon pa la cher mi gnod gtor bzlog 'ur chil ba zhig mdzad na sku nye tshor 'gyur 'gro/ ma / la ba tshang la gang stongs shig yong ba 'dug tshul gsungs pa'i lung bstan gyi thog kho nar song / yang lo phyi ma zhig sa skya ngam ring gdong dga' ba gsum rtse bstun pa'i gsang dmag btang ba'i tshe rje nyid rnam rgyal stag rtser bzhugs skabs yin gshis/'dar pa rin cen dpal bas dmag bsdu gsog kyang ma grub gshis rdzong sprod dgos pa yong 'dra zhes rtab rtab por gsol ba na bka' las/ rdzong rtsig pa dka' ba ma gtogs sprod pa la gnangs med —415

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshelar lte khrag pho sa ru snying khrag 'thor ba legs pas tshab tshab ma mdzad gsungs nas cung zad song ba na bskyar zhu zhus pas/ da dmag ga tsam na slebs gsung bar rdzong ri'i rked sgrol tsam mchod rten rtse ring rtsar 'byor 'dug zhes par/ mchod dpon la khyod rang thog khar song la dmod nas 'di (108ba)thor/ mi rkang 'di lan gsum bus gsung ba bzhin byas pas dgun stod yin yang glog 'brug gi sgra drag po dang bcas ser ba cog mo'i sgo nga tsam babs pas dmag rnams skad cig la byer/ sgar thog tu srin bya dang 'ug pa babs pa'i 'phrul gyis nad rims kyis btab nas stong log tu song ste g.yul las rnam par rgyal/ de dus gzigs snang la mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin sngon 'khrigs pa'i steng du rje btsun rdo ring pa de nyid sku la chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis brgyan pa'i phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa dngul dkar gyi dril bu 'khrol ba yid tsam khros pa'i nyams dang bcas seng ge dkar mo rgyan gyis spras pa'i steng na rgyal po rol ba'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa/de'i dbu gtsug gi thad du bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yan gyi gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa yongs rdzogs/de'i g.yas g.yon du sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug /ku ku ri pa/ lo hi pa/ g.yung po khrag 'thung / dril bu pa/ nā ro ta pa brgyad po zhi drag gi rnam 'gyur du ma ston pa/ gzhan yang tshe dpag med/dzam+bha la/ gur 'kha/ las mkhan dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ de'i tshe/ dpal ldan rgyal ba kun gyi mthu stobs ni/ /gcig tu bsdusapa drin can chos kyi rje/ khyod zhabs dran pa'i mod la bdud dpung rnams/ /phye mar 'thag mdzad de la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes sogs gsol 'debs bdud dpung phyir 'thag mar grags pa zhal gzigs ji ltar byung ba dang mthun pa thugs rtsom gnang /gsung 'phros kyi lhongs su bdag chen kun dga' rin cen 'di ma byon nas sa skya ba'i bstan pa 'di grum tse gung med 'dra ba'i mtha' yod kyang (109na)dbus med pa zhig yong nges su 'dug kyang bdag chen 'dis bstan pa'i khur bzhes pa sa skya pa'i 'phrin las mtha' dbus med par rgyas pa 'di rang re rnams blo bag bro ba'i tshad yin gsung zhes bgros la lar snang ba bar skabs su lha khang bla brang —416

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)pa'i nye gnas kyi brgyud pa dang shar pa sogs gdan sa nang du dbang chen mangs pa/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje yab sras dang sa lo rnams kyi dus gnang re dka' tsho bdag po kun rin pas tshar bcad nas sde ma lag dang bcas pa 'jam dar la song ba 'jig rten phyogs nas mdzad go chod gras la dgongs snang ba bdag nyid chen po'i mdzad pa ji ltar yang dpon chen gyi gras la chud nges su 'dug /chos rgyun gyi phyag rjes ni shin tu chung / rdor dbyings kyi blos slong dang mgon sku bshig pa sogs gnang sgo ji ltar yang bla ma khyi dang mjug mgo'i dpe bzhin rje bla mas thugs gting nas ma gus pa ni mdzad/ gusapo rang ni gnang thabs kyang mi 'dug /gong gis las/ phyogs 'dir sa chen bde skyid 'od chags pa/ /thal ba ji bzhi skya bor sgyur byed cing / /dkon cog rten dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i tshogs/ /'jomasabyed bdud dpung tsho gos rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /zhes rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan kho nar mchos/bdag po kun rin pa'i phur zor skyer mda' 'ug sgro ma bo dong gi 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gzimasachung gi gdung ma la thebs nas ring por ma lon par gshegs pa'i mthu skad ni tshag mgo bum nang du bcos pa'i gtam rgyud kho nar 'dug cing / khong gi mthu de rdog gi gze ma rnon po phyogs kun tu 'dzug pa'i dpe bzhin sa lo (109ba 'jam rdor yang sku tshe ring po ma byung bas brgyab pa 'dra/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa'i lung bstan chen mor/ sa yi phyogs su bla mas slob ma bsluḥ zhes dang /byang chub gling pa dpal rgyan gyi shugs gter 'khor 'das rang grol gyi zhus lan gsal ba'i sgron me las/ mnga' ris gdug pa'i dmag 'go g.yo: 'khon rigs kun zhes bya bas 'khrug khol bur sdug bsngal cung zad bskyed ces sogs dogs pa'i gnas mang tsam yod kyang gnas lugs shes na zog po'i mtshang gi dpe ltar spros par dgos pa chung zhing gang shar thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rnam par 'char ba'i dag snang gi bden kha phul nas rtsod pa chos thog tu zhi bar byed do/ /de yang tsho mos las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi bkru zhing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gisami sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo min te/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /—417

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshezhes 'o skol gyi ston pa bu ram shing pas kyang chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor nas 'gro ba rnams phan bde'i lam la 'god par mdzad pa bzhin/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis mdo sngags kyi chos tshul gdul bya so so'i blo dang 'tsham par bstan pas mchog rnams kyis ni bstan pa phyogs bzhir skyong ba'i dar chen btsugs/ la la dag klog pa thos bsam gyi sgo nas 'chad nyan/ 'ga' zhig spong ba bsam gtan gyi rim pa lhur len pa'i bshad sgrub kyi chu rgyun rje bla ma'i 'phrin las ma dros mtsho las phyogs brgyar 'bab/ sa skyong ba'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sogs skye rgu grangs yas pa dkon cog gsum la bla mar 'dzin cing 'di phyi'i legs tshogs sgrub pa la sbyar ba'i (110na)grangs kyi mtha' ni brjod pa'i yul lta ga la zhig /'on te che long rags rim tsam brjod na/ rang bstan kha'u brag rdzong pa'i lugs srol 'dzin nges kyi skyes bu ni/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum thams cad la 'jam dpal rdo rje mi'i zlos gar can sras kyi thu bo zha lu mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po spyan snga rje btsun bod mkhar ba mi tri byams pa don grub rgyal mtshan/nyams dang rtogs pas bdag rgyud yongs su grol bas thugs rjes gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba rtse tshogs mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi gzhung lugs la ma 'jigs pa'i spobs pa rnam par dge ba ngam ring mkhan chen byams pa blo gros rnam rgyal/dbyangs can lha mos rjes su bzung bas gnas lnga rig pa smra ba la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen rab kyis mkhas pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa mnyan yod bya gshong mkhan chen mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi nor bus thugs rgyud yongs su gtams shing snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi bstan pa'i srog shing bo dong mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ mthu stobs nus pa rwa lo gnyis pa lta bu sngags 'chang yongs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba chos 'khor yang rtse'i mkhan chen bsod nams chos 'phel/ zab don snyan brgyud bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams shing mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos kyi gdan sa ba chos dbang rin cen dpal gyi —418

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)rgya mtsho/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge'i chos kyi khri la mngon par 'dzegs pa mkhan byams pa rab brtan/ zab (110ba tshe don chos kyi mnga' bdag smyug la mkhan po bsod nams dbang po/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i gzhung la blo gros kyi snang ba gcig tu dkar ba skyed tshal mkhan po rab brtan dpal 'bar/mang thos mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan mkha' ri mkhan po blo gros chos 'phags/ rab stims rgyud dzi rgya mtshor mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs pa 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ 'khrul zhig bla ma'i rigs sras zab don rtogs pa'i nyi ma rje gzhen nu stobs ldan/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin pa mchod dpon drung kun dga' legs pa/ bla ma'i zhabs togo lhur blangasapas byin rlabs thugs la zhugs shing snyan brgyud zab mo'i mdzod 'dzin pa ma chen rdo rje bkra shis/nges don zab mos rtogs pa'i klong rdol ba 'phags mchog byams pa bskal bzang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyi bstan pa'i shing rta chen po dbon rin po che khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/gnyan mgon gdams pa'i srog shing mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug drung yig byams pa don grub/ mdo khams gdung ba'i mun sel chos gling drung pa/ mi phyed dad pa'i dbang phyug rje mgon po 'od zer/thos bsam sgom la gzhol ba rje mgon bo rdo rje/ spar phu'i gdan sa pa pu tra ming sring bran du 'khol ba'i brag chos pa sogs dang / ris med pa'i bstan pa phyogs bcur spel ba/ rgya hor bod kyi skye rgu mtha' dag gi gtsug tor rtse mor zhabs zung 'khor lo'i ri mo 'god pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dpal bzang po/ ga me ba'i bstan 'dzin chen po rgyal tshab rin bo che grags pa don grub/mchog gi sprul sku mnga' ris gter chen nyi zla 'od zer/ byang pa rigs ldan (111na jim par byon ti shrī rdo ring dbon po kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan gyi mkhan po thar pa rtse pa paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / mkha' ri chos sde'i mkhan po kun dga' lung rigs/ rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po'i dbon po ngag dbang bstan pa'i rdo rje/ mnga' ris ru thog pa bla chen nam mkha' gzi brjid/kun mkhyen tshe dbang ba po shis kyi dbon po chos kyi rje rnam rgyal bkra shis/ chos rje smon lam pa/ dga' —419

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)gdong slob dpon shes rab rdo rje/ bsdu dngos bzhi'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa rje bsam gtan rin cen/ stobs ldan mang po'i bla mar gyur cing snang sems la dbang 'byor ba dpal sdings rab 'byamasapa chos dpal bzang po/ grub pa tshad du 'khyol bas don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa cha lung grub chen ma bde legs dpal 'dzom/ nges don zab mos thugs rgyud grol ba rje rdzogs chen pa byams pa rin cen rdo rje/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ma ma ba byams pa rab dga'/ myug chos lung pa chos rje nam mkha' mtha' yas/ khro phu gdung brgyud/ shangs 'ba' ra ba bya btang chos grags/ myug pa chos rje bsod nams dpal 'byor/ rin po che drung rams chos rje bsod nams tshul khrims/ rje byams pa rab dkar/ lo chen rnam rgyal grags pa sku mched/ brag ram slob dpon pa/ chos rje rin cen rgyal mtshan gtsang pa rdor rgyan sogs dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag lha rigs 'a zha'i sa skyong nam mkha' sogs sde pa gnas gsar ba'i zhal ngo /se dkar rigs kyi thig le mi rje rin cen dpal bzang sogs sde pa 'dar pa'i zhal ngo / lugs gnyis kyi rnam dpyod yangs (111ba)pa'i sde pa khri khang nas nyin byed dbang po dang dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po'i rigs brgyud o rgyan gzhis ka ba mi dbang rin cen rdo rje/ sde pa spa ra nas/ sde pa snang rtse ba nam mkha' tshe brtan rdo rje sogs sde dpon dpon skya'i rigs mchog dman du mas 'di phyi'i skyabs mgon gling dang dpung gnyen du gsol ba mtha' dag 'di phyi bar gsum du dge ba'i lam chen po la sbyor ba mdzad/thugs rtsom gyi rim pa che long tsam ni/ o rgyan chos kyi rgyal pos gtso mdzad 'dren pa 'ga' la bstod pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa/ so thar sdom rgyun/ gsung ngag slob bshad/ rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud/ lam zab rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'khrid/ rta mgrin yang gsang / skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ ne gu chos drug /grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe 'khrid/ tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma/ dmar 'khrid/sgrol dkar tshe 'khrid/ ku ru kul+le phyi sgrub/ 'dod rgyal thun mong ba dang dpal gur gyi mgon po'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi 'khrid/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i gsang 'khrid rnams kyi brgyud 'debs dang sham —42(/

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)bur rang rang gi lam rim dang sbyar ba'i smon lam rdo rje'i tshig rkang lta bu shin tu ngo mtshar ba dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhi drag gsum/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po gur gyi mgon po/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa/ rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/rnam sras ser chen/ mgon po beng chen/ zha lu'i dpal ldan ma la sogs te yi dam dang chos skyong so so la bstod pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i 'grel pa dngos grub rin cen sgo 'byed/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ bdag chen rdo rje lang / rje (112na〉sa rdo ring pa gsum gyi rnam thar/rje nyid kyis dbus la phebs pa'i lam yig sogs lo rgyus kyi skor/ kye rdor man ngag lugs dang 'jigasabyed rwa lugs kyi sgrub mchod kyi lhan thabs/ kye rdo rje phyi nang gi bskyed rim rnam bshad ngo mtshar ba/mgon po'i khog phug snyan brgyud rin chen lde mig /phyi nang gi 'khrid kha'u brag rdzong pa'i rgyun gyi nyams len zhal shes kyi skor/ gtor chog chen mo/ gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kyi stobs 'phrog rol pa/gtor ma gsum gyi zhal shes zungs 'dzugs/ thugs chog la sogs pa med du mi rung ba'i chos skor/snying chu bsreb/ dri ba lhag bsam rab dkar/ mgon po khro brtsadang / zhal bzhi pa/ phyag drug pa/ mgon dkar bzhi'i rjes gnang / zhal sgrub dus kyi rjes gnang lhan thabs zhal gyi gsang 'khrid/ tshe sgrub srung 'khor/ gur mgon gyi bskang gso'i lhan thabs/ pu tra'i sgos bskang / beg tse'i las byang / me 'bar/kha skong / snyan brgyud/ gyi ljang / dud sol/ zhal bzhi pa/ dmar po skor gsum sogs kyi dkar chag /mgon po che chung las mkhan dang bcas pa'i skor la chos sna bzhi bcu lhag tsam yod/ ja mchod/ gsung mgur/ chab shog /sgrol dkar tshe 'khrid zla ba'i chu rgyun sogs yod la/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos gsung 'bum pod gsum ma zhig bzheng ba gnang 'dug pa da dung ma 'dus pa kha shas yod par mngon/ de dag kyang legs par bshad pa kho na ma gtogs rtsom rnying brkus pa/ don med don log sogs snag shog gi gron du 'gro ba ci yang ma mchis/ zhal slob mkhas pa rnams kyis gsung rgyun zin bris su bkod pa'i rigs don gyi rje bla ma'i (112bsko sung yin mod/ de tsam rgyu mtshan du byas na —421 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pethug med du thal bas 'dir ma bkod do/ /gnyis spangs bla ma'i brda thabs lung bstan bzhin/ /se dkar rigs kyi sa la spyod pa'i thong / /zhabs sen ut+pal chun po nyer bcings nas/ /'di phyi'i mdun ma grum rtser ngang gis mdzad/ /mthu stobs brgya byin yan lag rnam bzhi'i dpung / /bso sgrar bcas te mtshon char phab pa'i mod/ /mi srun lha min sde rigs bsgral ba'i g.yul/ /pham pas gdong smad mya ngan khang bur brgyal/ /kun nas yid dbang dga' mas 'khrid pa'i glang / /rang bstan pad dkar rdzing bu 'dam bzhin du/ /brdzi yang bzang rdzu'i gser sbyangs rgyan mdzes pa/ /bshes gnyen rin chen bdun gyi bgrang byar min/ /ra gan gser chus byugs dang sa le sbram/ /so sor spyod la zhabrul med mkhas pa' tshogs/ /khyod zhal bdud rtsi btung ba'i ring lugs mtha'/ /nam mkha'i ska rags ma des gzhal nus min/ /rnam dag brjod pa yi'u wang yangs po'i khog /don gyi rgyud mang 'brol ba'i pusta daḥ zhes ldan yid dbang 'gugs byed snyan pa'i sgra/ /skal bzang skye rgu'i rna bar gcig tu 'jibs/ /gsol 'debs las/ zhing 'dir ma lus gdul bya'i don grub nas/ /rje btsun bka' yi pho nyas spyan drangs te/ /zab yangs mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /dge mtshan dang bcas gshegs la gsol ba 'debs/ /'od gsal nam mkha'i dbyings las bzhengs pa'i sku/ /skal bzang mchog gi thugs mtshor gsal bar bstan/ /gzhan yang rtse gcig dad ldan bka' 'bangs rnams/ /slu med dbyings nas bskyangs la gsol ba 'debs/ /(113na)rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa/ /mkhas dang grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin/ /'gran zla kun bral drin can tshar pa rje/ /rnam thar dran zhing snying nas gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes me tog 'thor bar nye ba'i sngon rol tu rin po che bod mkhar ba'i rnam thar las rang la yod pa'i zang zing gi dngos po rnams kyang phul bka' chos 'dra yang zhus/ rje'i zhal nas nga la yang dgra 'dra yod pas 'dul dgos pa yod gsung yang na so rgas pas mi yong 'dug pas nga'i dgra khyed slob ra/ rlams kyas 'dul dgos gsung / ha cang dgra tshan che shos 'khor bar skyur mkhan dug lnga yin pas —422

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ rtana'adi 'dul ba yin mod gsung / yang dug lnga med pa byas na ye shes lnga'i rgyu mi yong 'dug de yang mi yong 'dug gsungs/ bdag la da chos rje'i drung dbus la byon dbus su dgon pa che chung gang byung yang zhal bdag mdzod gsungs/ dam tshig dril bu yang 'di 'brol bar mdzod gdul bya mang po yong sun pa tsam yong gsungs te rjes su ji ltar gsung ba bzhin byung / zhes gsung gi tha ma lta bu'i lung bstan stsal/shing bya'i lo bo dong phun tshogs rab brtan du bzhugs pa'i tshe gzims chung gi sbug cig nas rje btsun rdo ring pa'i gsung 'dra rung ba'i gdangs las lan cig khur bskyed la sdod de nas ngas 'bod mi btang gis gsung ba dngos su gsal bar byung ba nas lo gnyis song ba me pho stag gi lo thugs dam 'od gsal la khyab bdag kun spangs chen po phebs nas chos rje yar byon gsung brda yang yang mdzad pa na thugs nges par byung ba'i rtags phyi rol sogs su dus ma yin par rlung ldang ba/ sa g.yo ba/ 'khrug long sogs mi dge ba'i ltas mang du shar/ de'i tshe thams cad (113ba)mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho la grang mo che'i spe'u ser por chos du ma stsal zhing gsung 'phros kyi lhongs la da lo drug cu rtsa lnga'i thog dog cha che ba yod zer yang ma lha tsam yod dam gsung ba sogs kyis mtshone zhabs 'bring ba dang drung du byung ba du mar zhing khams 'pho ba'i mdangs kyi gsung mang du byon yang / bdud kyi mthusakun dga' bos de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba ma btab pa bzhin bu slob dang nye 'khor ba rnams kyang gzhan 'phrul dbang byed nas rmongs byed kyi mda' bsnun pa lta bus brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs kyi rigs ma byung ba dang / gtso bor zhing 'di'i gdul bya phal cher rdzogasashing bla ma dam pa'i bka' ltar dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i lus can 'dren pa la thugs lhag par spro ba'i tshul gyis zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bdun brgyad skor la grib zas shig gis bslang ba'i sku khams mi bde ba'i tshul bstan par gsos sman dang sku rim sogs zhabs tog pa rnams kyis 'bad nas bsgrubs kyang dwangs skyed med pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin gzugs sku mtshan dpe'i dkyil —423

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 1)she'akhor chos dbyings dag pa'i klong du sdud par gzhol ba'i 'da' kha ma'i thugs dam zab mo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshe/ 'dar bla brang gi tshoms chen du dge 'dun rags rim gyis rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po'i sku bstod gsung ba'i tshe sdings tshabs kyis blo ka gcig dkyus nas chad pa rje bla mas thugs dam gyi ngang nas mkhyen te ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs nas blo ka 'di chad song bas bskyar nas thon gsung ba dpal mar me mdzad kyis sbrul gyi shun pa brjes kyang sprul mi 'chi gsungs pa bzhin skye 'chi la rang dbang thob pa'i gang zag gnas khang gcig nas (114na)gcig tu 'pho ba tsam gyi nyams las med pas blos gzhal ba dka' ba yin no/ /kha sang phan chad dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams mya ngan gyis gdungs pa'i shugs kyi gnam sa bar gsum gyi ltas mi legs pa mang ba 'di nas bzung nam mkha' be+eḍūrla mthing kha'i mdog lta bu la 'ja' tshon pir gyis bris pa ji lta ba 'khrigs shing me tog gi char chal chil du 'bab pa sngar tshor ma myong ba'i dri ngad bzang pos khyab pa sogs lha rnams kyis mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/ ting nge 'dzin de'i ngang nas lam gyi 'phro rdzogs par mdzad de bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa mngon du gyur pas/ mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ nyid 'di'i mdzad pa legs par mthar phyin tshe/ /kun spangs chen pos byon zhes bskul ba'i mthus/ /bgrang yas ngo mtshar ltas dang lhan cig tu/ /mkha' spyod gnas su bsto shegs la garbesna la ba 'debs/ /cheXs the rgo/ /de'i tshe rje mar pa lo tsā la nā ro ta pas puṣ+ṭha ha rir mdzad pa bzhin thugs kyi sras du ma la dag pa ye shes kyi sku dngos su 'di dang lo mang song nas kyang bstan te chos 'chad lung bstan dbugs dbyung rgya cher mdzad pa dper na 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gzigs snang la mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbus su rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ g.yas su sprul sku shākya thub pa/ g.yon du o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po gsal bar gzigs/ rin po che bod mkhar pas go yab gyi gdan sa bzhag nas dben pa bsden bzhed pa'i dus tshes bcu'i tho rengs shig rje bla ma phebs nas spyan nan cher gzigs —424

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)te gsungs pa rnam thar du/ nged rang la slob ma a re mang yod kyang chos rje'i drung dam tshig dang sdom (114ba)pa la gnas shing byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas bla ma dang bstan pa la bsams/ brtson 'grus drag pos skyo ngal spangs nas gzhan don byed dgos pa yin/ da lta bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa'i rjes su 'jug pa yod tsam gyi dus 'dir 'chad nyan thos bsam byas na phan yon g.yin las che ba yin/ gzhan don mi yong ba zhig yin na sgrub pa kho na byed pa khe che mod de 'dra ni ma yin/ yang 'di yin gyi mdzub mo 'dzugs rgyu med par dpe nyog mang po bltas pa'i 'chad nyan la snying po ci yang med/ bla ma gong ma tshad ldan gyi dgongs pa dang mthun zhing rang gi bla ma tshad ldan gyi zhal nas brgyud pa'i chos thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i nges nges de rang gzhan la phan thogs pa yin/ zhes byung zhing / rin po che yol pa gshegs khar steng mthongs su rje bla ma phebs pa'i sku rdo rje 'chang dngul chu lta bur song tshul/ mkhan chen bslab gsum pas rje dbang phyug rab brtan la lam dbang gnang dus rnam thar dang / rje nyid kyi bzhugs sa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras gnyis dbang ma grol bar bzhugs nas dbang bskur gyi cho ga mdzad kyin 'dug pa la khong yab sras kyi dbang bskur ji lta ba bzhin khyed rnams la bshad pa yin ang / de 'dra'i dga' ba la ang zhes byung /sngags 'chang rin po che'i rnam thar las/ rmi lam na rje bla ma tshar chen nyid sngon du gsung ngag rin po che gnang ba'i dus su lam zab gnang ba'i skabs kyi sku'i gzi byin dang zhal 'dzum na bza' sogs ji lta ba mdzad nas khyod kyis bstan pa rin po che'i bya ba lhur blangs nas snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi zas chos 'di nyid (115na)rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i gnas su 'chad par gyis shig gsungs byung ba dang gnyid sad byung bas de lta bu'i bla ma dang mjal gsung gi bdud rtsi zab mo thos pa'i dus kyang byas snyam mchi ma mang du shor tshe rabs kun tu gdul bya'i zhing khams su skye ba/ de nas kyang rjes su 'dzin pa zhig snyam pa'i gsol ba phur tshugs su btab ces dang /—425

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)de nyid las/ 'dar du gsung ngag bshad skabs de dus zla ba gsum tsam song ba'i bskyed rim gyis mngal 'byin pa'i dmigs pa gal gnad shin tu che ba zhig gi dus su the tshom cung zad yod pa zhig byung ba de de nub tho rangs kha'i dus su rmi lam na zhabs drung rjes zhu sna mdzad rje btsun tshar chen dang sngon gyi gzhi bsnyen skabs su phebs pa'i bla ma yab sras rnams zhal 'dzum lta bar mi bzod pa lta bu'i dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur ji snyed gnang / de nas sngon gyi bla ma nyid kyis skad cig la spyan nam mkhar gzigs pa dang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro yin zhu bas char sprin lhags pa ltar byas 'ja' tshon lham me ba zhig byas so/ /de nas bdag gi dogs pa phran bu 'di sel ba zhig zhu snyam pa na/ e ma legs pa'i lam la legs so zhes/ /de ga yin pas bka' stsal mi dgos te/ /logs su yod pa'i 'bras bu til tsam med/ /blo gros ldan pa khyod la ci zhig dgos/ /gsung ba zhig gnyid khongs su zin/ de nas me long la has btab pa ltar yal ba dang gnyid sad/ e ma ngas 'di lta bu'i lam tshang ba ma nor ba thos lan bskyal ba lta bu la'ang thugs dgyes dgyes gnang ba ni bstan pa nyams dma' bar 'dug snyam pa'i blo la 'khru 'phrig chen po dang dad pa'i dpal 'bar ba'i dga' spro dang / snying chu mig (115bsngar babs lhan cig byung / bsams tsa na nga rang skal bzang snyam pa'i blo bde phugs su chud bltos bcas kun kyang lugs gnyis bya ba phra rags gang la'ang gegs kyi mtshan ma mi 'byung ba zhig lags zhes dang /de nyid las/ 'dar du skye bdun ril sgrub skabs zhag lnga song ba'i snga thun gyi bar la gnyid kyi rnam pa thung tsam byung ba'i rmi lam na rje btsun sprul sku chen po pad+ma rgyal po'i sku nyid myug rgyal khang du skyes bdun sgrub pa'i skabs kyi sku'i mdangs ji lta ba dang g.yas na 'byul zhig chos skyong bsod nams yin zer ba'i sku gzi brjid che ba zhig dang / g.yon na tshar chen yab sras dang bcas dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum gye mdangs gsal le ba byas pa zhig rmis pa/ gnyid dwangs pa na e ma ho nga yang bsod nams che/ de lta bu'i slu med kyi bla ma rnams dang mjal snyam pa dang / da snying po bdag dang bdag la bltos pa —426

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanathams cad o rgyan bla ma'i drung du skye nges kyi smon pa yid tshes nges shig btab/ ces dang / rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan dpal phug tu bzhugs skabs dag snang du gsung ngag gnang ba'i thugs nyams shar/ yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sder lam 'bras 'dzugs pa mdzad skabs 'od gsal du yang yang zhal gzigs/ 'dar rnam rgyal stag rtser mnal lam du rje bla ma'i zhabs gnyis dbu gtsug tu bzhag phyag gnyis kyis zhal 'gram skyor nas byin rlabs gnang dus o rgyan dngos yin dgongs pa'i tshe de'i skur gyur/ rnam pa de ltar shar yang ngo bo pha bla mar thag chod pa'i mos gus kyi ngang nas mnal sad tshe dbu gtsug tu zhabs drod kyis tsha chil li ba byung bas mtshon te dngos slob yang slob mang por zhal ston chos gsung byin rlabs gegs sel bogs (116na tshe sna don lung bstan gnang ba sogs mang /rje bod mkhar ba'i rnam thar du/ rmi lam la tshar chen rdo rje 'amang chen po de nyid na bza' sogs shin tu bzang ba sku la 'od 'phro ba dang bcas phyogs shig la thegs song ba dang rje'i drung la bstos pa rnams ngas rjes su 'dzin no gsungs spyan cer ba zhig gzigs pa rmis/ de nas ring por ma lon par pha bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po de nyid dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su thim zer ba'i skad cha byung ba yug cig 'di bya dang 'di byed med pa'i ngang la 'di rmi lam yin la che bsam pa dang / de las sad de kye ma kyi hud shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa'i ded dpon chen po lan cig rnyed pa de nyid rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin du yal nas thal da mgon med pa'i bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams ji ltar byed bsams pa dang / mig mchi mas gang sems la bzod glags med pa'i sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa byung /slar bsam blo la sngon yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung bla ma gong ma tshang mas mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan khong rnams bde ba nas bde ba'i zhing du gshegs pas kham che/snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams ni thob rang re chos gsha' ma zhig byed dgos/ da dung gnas gsar nas rje drung rin po che lta bu yang bzhugs bsams pa dang 'jig rten phyogs nas nged rang tsho'i byung —427

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losetshul yang dran sngon nas bsams pa'i gnas de lta bu zhig tu thugs dam byed pa las g.yin thabs med bsam pa shar zhes byung ba/ rang sems bla ma'i ngo bor thag chod pa'i skyes bu de 'dra la'ang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon rol tu mchog zung nyid zhing khams (116ba/sna phos pa bzhin thugs la mi bzod pa'i tshor ba drag po byung na tha mal pa dag lta ci smos pas phyogs de'i skye bo rnams cho nge 'don pa dang brgyal ba sogs nyam thag pa'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa ston zhing / 'dar ba bsod nams lhun grub lo ngo bzhi tsam lon pa zhig kyang stod la 'tshangs pa byung ba na'ang rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen chos kyi dbyings su gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus kyang 'od srungs chen po sogs bstan pa'i gtad rabs rim byon ltar/ rje bla ma dam pa la re bltos 'cha' ba'i gdul bya rnams rjes su 'dzin par zhal skyin lta bu'i zhal slob kyi 'dren mchog 'di lta bu yod do zhes dbugs dbyung ba la ched du bsngags pa ltar rim gyis phyogs nas 'dus shing sku gdung za ma tog tu ma bzhugs pa'i gong du tshogs pa rnams la pur mjal sku gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bur shing las thang chu bzhin sku rngul zhu ba shel dkar gyi 'khri shing lta bu gsal la 'tsher ba kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa'i dge mtshan mtha' klas pa byung /zhal slob 'gangs che ba rnams dang / chos sde khag /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gnas gsar ba dang 'dar pa sogs kyis thog drangs mdor na skya ser drag yin mtha' dag gis snyan dar mchod pa sna lnga sogs che 'byor chung 'byor dang / 'dar stod rnam rgyal stag rtse nas sde pa yum sras kyis 'gan blangs/bla brang gnyer tshang / bo dong phun tshogs rab brtan sogs nas dge 'dun mang por bsnyen bkur te kye rdor gtso bor gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhal 'byed kyi chog gra'i tshe rdo rje slob dpon rigs kun khyab bdag chen po'i skur bzhengs pa la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'i tshogs gsog rgya cher bsgrubs skabs nyin zhag mang por me (117na)tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogs phyogs der 'dus pa mtha' dag ngo mtshar dang dad pa'i spu long g.yo bar gyur/sku gdung rin po cher dar zab kyi na bza' dang dri bzang gi phye ma'i sri zhu/ nyes pa'i skyon sel —428

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (ta)ba'i slad du tshwa sogs kyi zhabs tog dang bcas rin po che'i sgrom bur bcug ste nyin re bzhin mchod pa sna tshogs pa'i bkur sti chad pa med pa'i ngos lo bco lnga song ba lcags mo sprul gyi lo sde pa rin cen dpal bzang ba mched sogs dad pa dang gtong ba phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po chen pos gser gdung thog tshad byed gnyis tsam la sde pa rin chen dpal bzang mched kyi g.yu pad/ yum a mdzes rgyal mo'i g.yu spel rna brgyangs kyis gtsos g.yu mu tig byu ru spos shel sogs kyi phra rgyan phyug pa dang bcas bzhengs pa'i thog ma'i gegs sel nas gzung bzhugs rab gnas kyi bar thugs sras dam pa mtshungs med sngags 'chang chen pos mdzad pa ni rnam thar las/ de nas rje btsun rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho'i ring bsrel phung po gser gdung rin po che'i zhal bkod bdag la bar chad zhi phyir srung 'khor dang lhag par rgyu dang zangs bzo ba rnams la bgegs skrod dang bskyang chog byed dgos tshul gsungs bla ma drag por langs nas byas pas bar chad mtshan mas glags blta bar ga la nus/ rgyang grags tshun la bkra shis mnga' gsol ma grub bar du nyes pa'i go skabs bral/ lar bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje las gnad du mi 'gro ba byung dogs med/ 'on kyang srung 'khor ched bstad nan bskyed de bsgoms pa dang nyin mtshan dal med drag sngags rgyun chad med par bzlas/ zla ba drug gi khongs su yongs su rdzogs te rin po che'i gdung nyid mchod rten (117ba)du spyan drangs pa'i ye shes phyir 'brang gi bgegs sgrod 'jam dpal zhal dgu par langs te byas pas bdud rigs kyi tshogs thams cad byer zhing der tshogs pa kun kyang spu zing byed pa mang dag byung 'dug /mchod stegs su phebs pa dang mchod pa dang sku khrus 'bul ba sogs rgyas par byas/ pañca li ka snam sbyar gyi gra sbubs nas gnyis med kyi ye shes la kha dog med kyang bdud rtsi shel dkar gyi gong bu gcig tu byas pa tshul khrims kyi phung po gong 'phel dang dri bsung phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i spos dkar gyi rdog ma bdag gi pang du gnang byung bas sgrib med ye shes kyi thugs rje rgyun chad mi mnga' lags so/ /de ltar rgyu rin po che gser las grub pa'i gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo sgrub pa zla ba tsam byas —429

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'argyud nas ji skad bshad pa ltar bzhugs su gsol/ mthar rab tu gnas pa rgyud sde nas gsungs pa ltar mtshan nyid tshang ba'i sgo nas zhag gsum sbrel zhag byas/ sgrub po sbyin bdag dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor gyi rgyun thams cad gong 'phel du 'gro ba'i phyir rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg thun mong min pa'i phyag len gyis brgyan nas byas/ zhes byung la gser gdung rin po che'i dbu thog tu gnam rgyan/ snyan dar/ ting kong bu maṇ+ḍal me dam sogs mchod rdzas kyi rim pa rgya dpangs mtho ba/gdung rten gyi g.yas su rje bla mas bzheng ba mdzad pa'i lam zab dang g.yon du dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa dang bcas pa bla ma so so'i sku mdun du zhal dkar/ bzed zhal/zhal bsil/ ḍā dril/ dbang bum/ 'bru phor/ nang mchod ka li sogs nyer spyad phun sum tshogs pa/bstan pa'i sbyin bdag 'dar nas kyis zhing dang nas rtsa sbyar ba'i gser gdung rin po che'i drung du (118na8kar me sdong rkang bco brgyad re'i rgyun btsugs pa deng sang yang nag me la brten pa'i phyogs 'dra tsam re yod snang /sngags 'chang rin po ches nga'i pur 'di gdong dga' ba mi rtsa ma chad bar de phyogs la kha thod la zhog ces zhal chems ltar gdung rten du zhugs pa lcags stag 61 dus babs kyis zhugs 'bul dgos pa 'gyangs pas me rang 'bar lta bu'i rkyen gyis gtsug lag khang la me gshor byung dus rje 'di nyid gdung yang mes bzhes mod de yan chod phyogs de'i skye rgu mtha' dag gis shi gson gyi dge ba'i phud gser gdung la 'bul zhing / 'dar ba'i bya ba gang gi tshe'ang zan ril bsgril ba la yid gtod par snang / ma 'gyangs par 'di ga nas gser sga dngul sga cha 'grig legs pa re dang gos yug lnga rta sogs kyi yon sbyar zhing gtso bor gdan sa nas 'jam mgon sa skya pa chen pos thugs khur bzhes te dngul gdung thog tshad ma phra rgyan dang bcas grub pa'i nang du bdag chen rin po ches gdung chu phyag dang ba mang du 'jug pa gnang bas byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma nyams par yod/gzhan yang thub bstan dge 'phel dang grang mo che gnyis gar zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes bco lnga —430

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ 6)la gzhi rten sbyar ba'i mang ja/ zla ba bdun pa'i dus chen thog tshes bcu gsum nas zhag bzhi'i bar kye rdor sgrub mchod/ de zhor du grang mo cher tshes bcu bzhi nas 'ag gsum gyi bar dmar chen gtor bzlog /gnod sbyin yab yum/ pu3 ming sring / beg tse lcam dral/ sgo ma bzhi/ bran bdud/ nor bdag yab yum rnams kyi 'chams sogs rgyas par tshugs pa deng sang gi bar du ma nub par gnas/ gzhan yang sde pa gnas gsar ba/ khri khang pa/ o gzhi ba sogs sbyin (118ba)pa'i bdag po rnams kyis sgrub mchod dus dran gyi thebs sogs gnas dgon mang por bsod nams rgya mtsho'i rlabs 'phreng dus las yol ba med par gyur to/ /mtha' yas zhing du grangs med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro 'dren ngal khur bzung bzhin gangs ljongs 'di'i/ /gnyen gcig bsu mar 'ongs pa'i ḍā zhi'i tshogs/ /phyogs 'di kho nar brtse bral kye ma hud/ /sems can kun don ring nas thugs bskyed mgon/ /rtsod ldan duḥkhas ches mnar gdul dka' rnams/ /bor nas chos dbyings bde ba'i klong gzims na/ /zhal 'tshes rdo ba'i ri mo ming du zad/ /'og min zhing du ye shes them skas la/ /bshes gnyen mchog de 'byon par gsol btab nas/ /dbang gzhu'i gur khyim man+da ra ba'i char/ /thabs kyis skal dman 'gro rnams wed 'di ci/ /tshur mthong skye bo mya ngan khang bu mā /brgyal mod gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa rnams/ /sems nyid dag pa'i ngo bo tshar pa rje/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems gas dmigs su med/ /'on te chos kyi rgyal tshab gnas gsar bas/ /nyer mtshon bstan 'dzin dpyid kyi gser ldan ma/ /rngul chu'i rgyun 'bab de bzhin snyan brgyud chos/ /srid mthar mi nub 'phel der spro dga' brtas/ /de ltar rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i ded dpon tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs sa skyong 'dar pa rin cen dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i chu gter rgod pa dang / de'i 'grel pa snyan ngag mkhan 'dar pa bsod nams lhun grub kyis bsgrigs pa legs bshad zla ba'i snang ba/ rtsa 'grel de gnyis la gzhi bcol nas chos —431 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'a'akhor yang rtse dang mnyan yod bya gshong gi mkhan po 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i (119na sgom par thar pa ngo mtshar nor bu'i mgul rgyan rnams la'ang rje bla ma zhal bzhugs dus zin bris nges sbyar med pa'i skyon gyis lo tshigs gal che ba rags pa tsam las zhib cha ma mchis shing / mdzad pa 'gangs che ba rnams bsdebs mtshungs su 'dug pa zhal slob kyi rnam thar dang sgo bstun pa'i lo zla sogs cung zad gtan tshigs kyis gzhal nus kyang mtha' dag rtogs par dka' bas gsol 'debs tshigs bcad ma rtsa bar bzung / 'grel pa dang 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa gnyis la 'khrul skyon ngos zin pa thor bu byung ba rnams la dag sbyor byas/go rim phyogs tsam las nges sbyar ma thub rung don gyi cha la dpyad gang bzod kyi lugs bgyis par slad nas kyang mkhas pa rnams kyis dag ther dang snon 'bri mdzad 'tshal lo/ /rgyal yum ye shes mkha' 'gros rjes bzung sa drug dka' ba med bgrod nas/ /brtul zhugs spyod pas log lam 'phyan kun mngon mtho nges legs gnas bkod de/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar gshegs rnal 'byor dbang phyug chos skyong zhabs/ /a ho ngur smig gos kyis nyer klubs rigs kun bdag po tshar pa rje/ /'gro snang rdzing bu gaṅgā'i klung rdul snyed/ /sna tshogs sgyu dra'i zla gzugs 'char ba'i tshad/ /bskal brgyar 'tshol ba'i rtse gcig ting 'dzin mkhan/ /mkha' mtha' ma rnyed ldog pa'i 'dab chags bzhin/ /bcu gsum rnam par sprul pa'i zlos gar gtam/ /gya tshom smra min lung rigs nges ster nor/ /grangs med skye bar bsgrubs pa'i legs byas kyi/ /tshong zong des khugs tshul la gcig tu rangs/ /thos bsam cha bsags zla dkyil dman pa'i zol/ /gzhan ngor 'phel dang 'grib pa ltar sbyor yang / /dpag (119ba)dka'i yon tan ri bong snang brnyan de/ /mngon sum gsal bar 'char la gang gis bston/ /snyan brgyud ring lugs dpyid kyi dga' ston tshogs/ /chad med 'bod pa'i rtogs brjod g.yin gsos glu/ /blo gsal rna ba'i bcud du srid mtha'i bar/ /ches dngar phang 'gro'i sgra bzhin snyan par shog /ched du sgo gsum 'bad rnams zung 'jug sku/ /mngon gyur de srid tshad ma bzhi —432

tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar/ (tanaldan chos/ /ston dang nyer mjal thos bsam sgom pa yi/ /bzang po'i skal ba can du 'gyur bar shog /gsung ngag gser chos rdo rje'i chos skyong gis/ /zab don slob mar bshad bya gdams pa'i char/ /snod ldan gdul bya'i 'dzin ma rab brlan te/ /bshad sgrub snye ma srid mthar g.yur za shog /de yang tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i rtogs brjod bya gshong mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa der zhabrul gzhi kha yar yod grags dang / sa spyod 'dar pa rin chen dpal bzang khu dbon gyis sbyar ba'i gsol 'debs rtsa 'grel khungs btsun yang khyab che ba zhig mi snang bas bsgrig mdun yod ngos drin can bla ma dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dngos bka' 'gyur ba chen po dang 'dren mchog dam pa mkhan chen zha lu pa gnyis kyi bka'i khur lci ba'i steng / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa'i bstan pa'i sbyin bdag pā ṇi/ ka tsan/ swa ra su sti byā ka ra ṇa sogs brda sprod pa'i gtsug lag rgya mtsho'i mthar son zhing / sdeb sbyor/ rtsis dkar nag gis mtsho ni pa'i rig byed du ma la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa 'dar pa ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub gyis lo rgyus kha 'thor rnams bsdu ba sogs 'bad pa chen pos bskul ba dang / rab 'byams rgyud sde'i bang mdzod bco brgyad chos rje (120na)byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/gnas gsar zhabs drung dbon rin po che nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ grub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam pa chen po'i dbon ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs gsum gyis gsung ngag brgyud pa'i kha skong du dgos pa'i mtshams sbyar bar brten rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtsham dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa slob bshad bstan pa'i nyi 'od 'di ni kha'u brag rdzong pa'i ring lugs la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa'i za hor gyi ban+de slob bshad 'dzin pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i zhes ā na la zhes pa me 'brug gro bzhin zla ba'i yar tshes bco lnga rje bla ma mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i dus dran gyi nyin pho brang chen po dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya —433—
brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi bstan pa srid mtha'i bar du rgyas

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)no༅༅/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo khyab bdag he ru ka ngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol ba gdan gsum tshang ba'i sde dpon rje btsun bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa bdud rtsi'i za ma tog ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄7/ /su sti pra dza saḥ rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo khyab bdag he ru gaḥngur smrig gar gyis rnam par rol ba gdan gsum tshang ba'i sde dpon rje btsun bla ma dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs pa brjod pa bdud rtsi'i za ma tog ces bya ba rigs kun bdag po bla ma mchog gis zung 'jug lam bzang mngon gyur de srid byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje stong chen gzugs/ /'pho med dbang phyug bde chen gyis drangs thugs/ /rab brtan bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan che/ /sgreng mdzad dpal ldan skal pa bzang por bsngags/ /tshogs gnyis lus stobs rgyas pa'i sa srungs dbang / khams 'dus 'phreng gegs lcags kyu las grol te/ /grub pa'i mtha' snyog lam du zung 'jug gom/ /lhod por sku gsum grong bgrod tshul 'di mtshar/ /mkhas ngom rmongs pa'i zhus pa mi ston par/ /ma bcos lhug pa'i thugs kyi shel (2na)ngos su/ /rab mas shes bya'i tshon ris kun shar bas/ /grags min don dang ldan pa'i thams cad mkhyen/ /ched du bcos ma'i gzhan 'drid lhur len dang / /zhig po'i rtsing spyod mtha' gnyis dang bral ba/ /tshul khrims dbu mar rnam dag bag yod kyi/ /nam yang lhod med btsun pa'i rtse mor son/ /gnyen chags gcan gzan lugs la byang sems su/ /rmi rlom lus can kun la rtag snyoms pas/ /gcig tu phan pa —435

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)sgrub pa'i lhag bsam thugs/ /rdul bral ston zla ltar dkar bzang po'i dpyid/ /a ho phyi rol nyan thos bslab pas mdzes/ /nang du rlabs chen spyod mdzad rgyal ba'i sras/ /gsang ba bcu gsum rdo rje'i sar gshegs pa'i/ /rtogs brjod smra la 'jig rten mes bo ngal/ /'on te thun mong gdul bya'i bsam pa khams/ /dbang por 'tsham pa'i rnam thar gaṅgā'i klung / /rdul las sor mo'i rtse yis blangs pa tsam/ /(2bskong tshe snod ldan tshogs rnams rna ba blogs/ /de'ang ji skad du/ rgan pa'am ni gzhon pa'ang rung / /gang las chos ni rnam shes pa/ /de la gus par phyag bya ste/ /zla ba tshes la ji bzhin no/ /zhes zab pa dang rgya che ba'i dam pa'i chos tshul bzhin du ston pa zhig gi mthu la brten nas rjes 'brang gi slob ma yang slob sogs mtha' klas pa'i yon tan gyi cha mtha' dag rgyas par 'gyur ba ni zla ba tshes pa la brten pa/ dkon brtsegs le'u zhe gsum pa las/ 'od srung 'di lta ste/ dper na zla ba tshes pa la phyag 'tshal ba ltar nya ba la ni ma yin no/ /'od srungs de bzhin du gang dag nga la rab tu dad pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag bya yi/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni de lta ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa las ni nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung ngo / /de la 'di skad ces bya ste/ zla ba tshes par thams cad phyag 'tshal gyi/ /zla ba nya la de ltar phyag mi 'tshal/ /de bzhin gang dag nga dang de dag gis/ /rgyal sras byang chub sems dpar phyag tshol cig /ces gsungs pa'i don bzhin bstod phyag gi yul du bshad pa ltar tshigs su bcad pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas skabs su babs pa gleng bar bya ba ni dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang gsum mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag nyid rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po bslab gsum 'tshams sprin gos kyis klubs pa rje btsun bla ma dam pa dbang phyug rab (3na)brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa mdo tsam brjod pa la/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems can kun yid shes pa dang / /mngon par shes pas brtse ba dang / /—436

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)sangs rgyas zhing bzang sgrub pa dang / /yongs su brtag phyir sangs rgyas bsten/ /dbang po shes dang rgyal ba yi/ /zhing sbyong sgyu ma ltar gnas dang / /bsams ba'i na srid pa len pa dang / /las ni rnam pa 'di brgyad bshad/ /ces pa ltar 'phags chen dam pa rnams ni bsams bzhin srid par skye ba blangasanas 'gro ba'i don la me tog gi tshal du bung ba dang ngang pa dwangs pa'i rdzing bur 'jug pa dang mtshungs par ngan song gi gnas kyang mtho ris kyi dga' tshal ltar spro ba lhur len par mdzad pas ri dwags dang 'dab chags sogs skye ba sna tshogs su sprul pa'i mtha' brjod par ga la nus na'ang bstan pa'i gsal byed kyi sgron me spar bar nus pa'i skyes bu mchog gi tshul 'ga' zhig brjod na/ rje nyid kyi gsung las/ rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dbang phyug brgyad ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku/ /sku drin mnyam med rtsa brgyud bla ma yis/ /lung bstan rjes su bzung la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon tshe 'phags yul grub dbang ku ku ri/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir rgyal ba kun gyi dngos/ /o rgyan drung na 'khor gyi dge slong gis/ /bstan dang 'gro kun skyong lagasol ba 'debs/ /de ltar legasabyas skye ba du ma'i mthar/ /dpyal ston kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal/ /pad+mas lung bstan zhabrul zhig rin po che/ /tshul khrims rgyal mtshan zhabs (3ba〉pa gsol ba 'debs/ /he ru gaḥdapal dgyes pa'i gar mdzad kyang / /tshul khrims rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i dge slong ma/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo shī la bha dra'i zhabs/ /'brel tshad don ldan khyod lagasol ba 'debs/ /sngon gyi legs byas dge ba'i 'brasabu las/ /bla ma lha dang srung mas rjes bzung nas/ /'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i 'phrin las skyong ba'i dpal/ /dbang phyug rab brtan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /zhes pa ltar 'phags pa'i yul du grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i nang tshan rnal 'byor dbang phyug ku ku ri pa/ rgyal dbang pad+ma thod 'phreng gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir phebs pa'i tshe nye bar gnas pa'i dge slong / dpyal ston chen po kun mkhyen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ o rgyan chen po'i lung gis zin cing dpal zha lu gser bkang gi khri thog tu byon pa'i 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ ye shes mkha' —437

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)'gro'i gtso mo rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo sogs bstan 'gro'i mgon dang gling du gyur pa rim par byon pa'i yang srid du rje bla ma dam pa 'di nyid phebs tshul ni/ ma pham pas/ rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang dang / /zhes cho rigs khungs btsun pa gsungs pa dang phyogs mtshungs par 'o skol gyi ston pa bu ram shing pas gzigs pa rnam pa lnga'i nang gses rigs phun sum tshogs pa rgyal rigs la dgongs nas 'phags pa'i yul gyi sa'i dbang phyug 'gran zla dang bral ba zas gtsang ma'i sras su bltams pa'i sngon byung gi rnam thar dang rjes 'jug gi nyams len 'dra bar/ spyir ri kha ba can gyi 'gro ba rnams rgya gar gyi rgyal po rū pa ti dpung bcas g.yul pham ste bud med kyi (4na)chas su bzhugs nas su la'i ljongs su yongs pa las 'phel ba'i lo rgyus yod na'ang yongs su grags pa phyag na pad+ma dang rje btsun sgrol ma gnyis kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo las mched pa bod mi'i rgyal khams su gyur par mi'u gdung drug gam bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan sna tshogs su dbye ba'i bye brag lha rigs 'a zha rgyal po zhes bod btsad po'i sku zhang dang bka'i mdun na 'dun chen po nang rjer gtogs pas rdo ring gi yi ger yang dbon 'a zha zhes gsal zhing bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus 'a zha ye shes g.yung drung gis khams nas 'dul ba der bas ma'i sdom rgyun bzhes pa'i gtsang du 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i sde 'ga' zhig btsugs/'a zha lha'i blo gros kyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang la 'khas tog dang a mes jo sras phur pa 'phel gyis gser srang bcu bdun rngeg lor phul te rgya gar nas chos bsgyur ba'i mthun rkyen mdzad cing 'a zha jo bo blo gros kyis rtsis lha khang dang zung du 'brel ba'i gtsug lag khang btab/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa dang ti shri kun blo gnyis kyi zhabs la nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' bzang po/shākya seng ge rnams kyis gtugs par nyang gzhung mtha' dag shes su bcug pa'i 'u/nga las gnang bas gnas gsar stong dpon du grags/de dag gi gdung rim par byon pa las stong dpon kun dga' rdo rje'i sras nang so chos rgyal ba'i —438

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ (1)jo mor rin chen sgang bla brang nas 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i lcam dpal ldan 'dzom pa zhes par nang so rnam rgyal dpal bzang / nang so mgon po rin cen/ 'jam dbyangs(4ba)kun dga' blo gros sogs lcam sring brgyad zhabrungs pa'i nang so sku mched kyi khab tu lha khang chen mo ba'i sras mo dpal 'jam byon par sras nam mkha'i rdo rje tshe brtan dpal 'byor bzang po zhakhrungs te yum snga mo nas grongs pa'i tshong 'dus mgur mo ba'i sras mo byang sems bu khrid blangs par gcung nam mkha' rgyal ba byon pa'i jo mor se ston rig sngags 'chang gi gdung brgyud 'dar chos rdzong pa don yod rnam rgyal gyi sras mo tshe brtan bu khrid bzhes par sras zhabs drung brtan pa'i drung ngam bsod nams rab brtan/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /nor bu bzang po bzhi 'khrungs pa las gcen zhabs drung brtan pa'i drung la 'dar chos rdzong pa'i sras mo nam mkha'i drung bsus par sras ma byung ba slar tshe dbang drung blangs par sras 'a zha nam mkha' phun tshogs byung bar jo mo shangs brgya tsho pa'i lcam bsod nams 'bol le bzhes par sras bzhi byung ba de dag kyang lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa rnams 'jig rten phal pa'i ngang tshul las 'das pa'i ngo tsha khrel gzhung gi bag yod cing skyes rgyal rnams dpa' brtul dang bud med rnams mdzangs ma'i rang bzhin can dkon cog gsum la bla mar bzung nas mchod pa dang ma nus pa byams pas skyong zhing spros bcas dang spros med kyi thugs dam la brtson pa lhur mdzad pa sha stag byon pa'i phyi 'phyar de ltar grags kyang don thams cad mkhyen pa'i gcen 'gran zla dang bral ba zhabs drung brtan pa'i drung gi sras su ngos 'dzin la/ de'ang chu shel gyi bu mo lang tsho ngom pa'i sa 'dzin gyi 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir ru bzhir grags pa las g.yas(5na)ru gtsang gi rgyal khams kyi sa'i cha bod srin mo gan rkyal du bskyel ba'i dbyibs can gyi sa dgra gnon byed du chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis brtsigs pa'i nang nas gtsang 'gram dang khad nye ba dge bcu'i yon tan du mas ma rga par spras pa'i sum rtsen yul la co 'dri ba myug bkra shis rgyal gyi pho brang du/ sa hore mchod —439

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheyon gyi lo gsar pa'i dbang du byas na stod 'grel pa kā la sgruXzhes pa dus kyi pho nyar grags pa shar phyogs rgyal khab chen por wu ldu zhes phyogs 'di sa pho rta'i lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa/ gtsug lag spor thang dang bstun pa legs sbyar gyi skad du sa rma gro/ gangs can pa'i skad du don grub tu 'bod cing rgya nag pa wu'i zhes pa sa lug dpyid zla 'bring po rgyal gyi nya ba'i thabs kyi cha'i rgyal ba dang po res gza' pa sangs dang rgyu skar gro bzhin 'dzom pa'i dgong ja'i dus dge bar yum la snyun mi mnga' zhing sim pa'i tshor ba chen po nyams su myong bzhin pa'i ngang nas sku bltams 'phral rmo mo tshe dbang gis gur gum dang gi hang gis ljags la dhīḥbris/de skabs rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gnyis dpal zha lu'i chos grwar stan chags dus yin pa zhag bdun thog rje tshar chen phebs nas mtshan nam mkha' don grub dbang por btags/ de nub tshar chen gyi thugs dam 'od gsal de gar gzhen nu 'di 'brul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi sku'i skye ba yin no/ /zhes pa'i lung bstan bsdud mar lan gsum du byung / sku na ches (5ba)phra bas dbang brda 'phrod pa sogs ga la 'ong yang yid srubs sder bcas kyi g.yul las rgyal ba'i ched du dpal ldan bla ma 'jam dpal rdo rje ma he'i zhal can dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i nus pas gzhi ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched thams cad ting nge 'dzin gyis mngon par sbyangs te 'bras bu gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga'i ye shes kyi ngo bor byin gyis brlabs pas sku tshe mdzad 'phrin thams cad mthar phyin pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo thog mar 'grig /yab mes yum sogs chabasacig par dbang zhu ba mdzad pa'i lung bstan gyi tshe gsang mtshan dri ba'i lan a mes rigs 'dzin gyis gos dkar mo zhes zhus pas tshar chen gyis/ zhad po drung pa klungs log pa 'dra gsungs pas tham bas cad bzhad shin tu bro ba'i rnam 'gyur sogs dgyes dgyes mdzad/ rnam snang ming dbang gi gsang mtshan 'dogs pa dang dus mtshungs par zha lu nas kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis/ bsod nams nam mkha'i khyon ltar yangs pa yi/ /bsams pa don kun yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dpal/ /phyogs las rnam —440

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ rtanapar rgyal ba'i 'phrin las can/ /brgyud 'dzin dbang po lo brgyar 'tsho bar shog /ces pa'i brtan zhugasakyi tshigs bcad skyel mi 'grig pas ngo mtshar dang dge mtshan 'gran pa bzhin no/ /rgyal kun bla med ye shes phrul bo ches/ /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par mkha' mnyam mthas/ /blo gros mig sngon gom pas gzhal ba'i mthu/ /phra ba sgrib pa'i lus can kun gyi gshis/ /srid pa'i lam du 'khyams pasang la dub ste/ /ma rig 'thibs po'i mal du nyal ba'i (6na 'gro/ /slong ba'i thugs bskyed skya rengs mas drangs pa'i/ /skyes rabs nyin byed mdzad med shar 'di mtshar/ /'od gsal lha rigs 'a zha'i gdung gis mtho/ /gangs can btsan po'i nang blon snyan grags 'bar/ shar phyogs gong ma'i lung dang las gas che/ /mkhas grub rim par byon pas bstan srog bzung / /dbyig 'dzin dwangasamatshor rnam par rgyal byed gzugs/ /gsal la nyer 'khu bkra shis rgyal khang du/ /rigs bzang ma snyigs gsar pa'i spel legs sku/ /me rtag mtshan dpe'i 'dab brgya mngon par grol/ /dus kyi dgra bo 'jam mgon tshar pa rjes/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags su/ /'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i 'khor lor rab smin tshe/ /mtha' klas skal bzang sgo brgya dang por phye/ /mkhyen rab zur phud lnga ldan dang mtshudas pas/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug bla ma yis/ /mkhyen yangs klong nas thon pa'i bden pa'i tshig /mkhyen ldan yongs kyi rna ba'i rgyan du dngar/ /dgung loganyis bzhes pa'i tshe mgon lug mang por nad byung bar thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi ljags chu'i byin rlabs dang gzhan gyis thabs sna tshogs byas kyang ma phan par gzhen nu sku rdzi'i rgyab la gdan drangs te lug rnams la phyag nas gtor bas nad mtshams myur du zhi ba nang las dpon po byin rlabs che ba 'dug ces gsung ba ni spyan snga rin po ches rgyal ba thog rdugs pa'i sku bang du thog phab pa'i lo rgyus ltar che ba 'don pa la dgongs pa 'dra/dgung lo lnga tsam 'gro ba'i dus kun (6bsgo khyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis dbang gnang ba'i tshe gzhen nus bum pa tshur bzhes nas dbang bskur ba'i stang ka mdzad pas rgyal yum gyis sngon gnas —441—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'arjes dran gyi bag chags sad par dgongs te thams cad mkhyen pas bum par dbu thug thug gnang nas nga'i bla ma yin gsung mnyes mnyes rang mdzad/ rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjer tshe dpag med grub rgyal/dmar po skor gsum/ gur zhal/ stag zhon sogs rjes gnang gi rigs mang ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi drung du dus 'khor gsang 'dus 'jam rdor rwa lugs dgra nag bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs sogs sngags gsar rnying gi dbang bka' kha shas gser chos dang mgon po che chung gis mtsho sgo rjes gnang thor bu/ 'od zer dri med lha lnga'i rig gtad sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo sogs rjes gnang gi rigs mang ba/ rje rigs 'dzin chen por kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi sngags rnying ma 'dus pa mdo dbang chen mo zhu ba mdzad pa'i zhabs phyi mdzad nas gsan/me stag dgung lo brgyad kyi dus chos dbang rin po che'i gter chos thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che nas brgyud pa'i gong khug mar grags pa'i tshe sgrub gnang ba'i dus 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug nyin ltar gyis phebs te gegs sel bogs 'don sogs spyan dmigs kyi bslab don mdzad/ dpal phug rnam par grol ba'i ri khrod 'ding ba'i skabs las mis brag bshags pa'i rbab nyen byung ba na rmo mos bros gsungs par 'jigs pa med pa'i dpa' gdengs kyis phaṭa sgra dang bcas sdigs (7na7dzub mdzad pas phar bzlog pa der 'khod kun gyis mthong bas ya mtshan du gyur/bo dong du bzhugs dus mdun gyi nam mkhar mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa longs sku'i cha lugs can mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba zhig gzigs pa ni dgung lo brgyad cur nye ba'i bar bstan 'gro'i don du bzhugs pa'i dge mtshan du mngon/ thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs gang du phebs kyang rje 'di'i drung du 'khor ba'i khyi rnams la zan sogs kyi sku skyos re gnang / thengs gcig sngon mo rdzong nas bo dong du phebs dus khyi gu chung chung yid du 'ong ba zhig sku phag nas bton nas dbon rin po che 'di na gsung gnang ba de la thugs kyang shin tu mnyes par gyur cing rgan du ma song bar la sku 'khris rang du sdod pa'i spyod pa yang g.yin las legs nges sku rtsed kyi —442

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)rigs zhu/ zhal ngo rnams gnas gsar nas bo dong du phebs pa'i tshe zham 'bring ba tshos ma shes par khyi de sngon mgyogs shing gcig pur 'gro/ phar phebs skabs kyang de dang 'dra/ ming bdud mo g.yul rgyal ma zer zhing rjes su gsob byas nas spyan gzigs su yod pa sngon grub chen ku ku ri par 'byungs pa'i brda chos las khyi dkyus ma ni ma yin no/ /rog tshor thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bka' brgyud gsang rdzogs kyi sgrub chen gnang dus rje 'di dgung lo bcu gcig 'gro bas mchod gar gyi gar dpon mdzad pas kun ya mtshan du rtsi/ bo dong du dza zhal gnyis ga'i dus 'khor gyi dbang bka' 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs (7ba)kyis gnang ba'i khyad par bu lugs kyi bdag po chen po'i bka' dbang gi dus dbon rin po dkar mas su mdzad/ dbang stegs kyi khrir chos kyi rgyal tshab chen por mnga' gsol/ slob dpon chen po'i sku tshab gter byon yid bzhin nor bu dang / chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i thugs dam bsnyen phur thams cad mkhyen pa rang gi 'bral spang ma dang bcas gnang skyes su stsal ba bstan pa gtad nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ring por ma lon par gsang bdag gi drung du gshegs pa'i sngon 'gror snang yang rjes 'jag rnams dogs gnas tsam yang ma byung bar mngon/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po zhing 'di'i bkod pa bsdus par kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs thugs sna bstungs te lcang lo can du gshegs pa'i thugs 'dun drag po dang las 'phro gling pa'i chos bdag yin par dbus gtsang sa sa bskul ba'i ngos ma zin par dus thog tu ma 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel 'phyugs skyon gyis sa pho 'brug lo mdzad pa tha ma bstan skabs rje 'di bo dong bkra shis sgang du yum dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/'jam dbyangs byang gling rjes srung 'khor mdzad cing nyin re bzhin gra lnga'i dbang tshar re gnang bas dbang chog phal cher thugs blor zin pa byung / skabs shig thams cad mkhyen pa sku'i rnam pa dngos gzhi 'dra ba la dbu skra zing nge ba phyag stabs 'di yin med pa zhig nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs pa gsal bar gzigs pa ni bar do ye shes kyi skus mngon sum du rjes su bzung bar 'dug cing —443

rgya la dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegazigs snang la ji ltar byung ba'i bris thang bzhengs/ rje bla ma bslab gsum (8na)bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la rkyen sel gyi chos bka' ci rigs gsan/ snyigs dus kyi rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po'i gdan sa ngor e waṃ chos ldan du phebs dus rmang lam du lam zab khang gi sgo 'gram g.yas g.yon du rdo rje 'jigs byed/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ mdun du dpa' bo bram ze'i gzugs can sku mdog sngo ba zhabs bsnol nas shing gi gling bu bzung ba dang bcas pa gzigs pa'i gnas tshul rje btsun bla ma mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan la zhus pas zhal la gtor bsngo mdzad na legs zhes stsal ba bzhin de nas bzung chag med du gnang /khum bu lung du bzhugs pa'i tshe dag pa'i snang ba la mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang bslab gsum rgyal mtshan sku'i cha lugs dkyus ltar la g.yas chos 'chad dang g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzung ba de'i zhal nas kho bo'i g.yas su sgrol dkar dang g.yon du phyag rdor mdo lugs bzhengs na legs gsung ba bzhin de ltar bzhed ba gnang ba'i bris thang la lung bstan thang kha zhes thugs gtsigs shin tu che zhing lung bstan tshul khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos dri ba zhus par gsal gsal mi gnang gsung / g.yang du bzhugs skabs shig rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser chen la mchod gtor phul zhing 'phrin las bcol bas ring por ma lon par glang thang nas gos dar dang stong skud kyi 'bul ba mang du byung / dus phyas kyang mnal lam du bya rgod gshongs kyi rnam sras mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i rtags re byung na sang nyin zang zing gi bdog pa ster mi re nges par 'ong 'dug cing lar rnam sras (8bsko drag gnyis po 'di tshe rabs sngon ma nas las kyi 'brel pa yod pa'i chos skyong zhig yin 'dra bas shin tu 'go zhing rjes gnang byed res kyang 'tshub lhongs kyi rnam pa re nges par yong ba'i dam dog che tsam dgos pa 'dug ces rje bka' 'gyur ba sogs la gsung ba ni 'khrul zhig rin po ches zha lu'i gdan sa mdzad dus chos skyong 'di nyid la gtso por mdzad pa'i shugs yin pa 'dra/rtsod dus pad+ma'i rgyal tshab gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po nyi zla —444

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)'od zer la dpal o rgyan chen pos dngos su gnang ba'i 'chi med grub pa'i rlung sbyor gyi gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa shing pho khyi'i lo yab nam mkha' phun tshogs dang lhan cig par bya rgod ga sgo pas su rigs 'dzin rje la gsan pas/ ji skad dus ma/ gsang chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rigs 'dzin rjes/ /gsang las yang gsang nying khu'i gdams pa 'di/ /gsang sngags 'chang ba nam mkha'i ming can la/ /gsang zhing sbas pa'i dbyings nas gnang ba yin/ /zhes ched du brjod pa'ang mdzad/ gzhan yang snga phyir bka' brgyad bde 'dus rigs yongs 'dus dang drag po dbu dgu sogs rnying ma bka' gter gyi dbang lung man ngag gi gsan pa cher gnang /mkhan chen sdings ma ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi drung du gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad kyi dbang khrid lung byin rlabs dang bcas pa gsan pa'i rgyu dbang gi dus mkhan chen rin po che'i gzigs snang la/ rje nyid bzhugs pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa (9na〉ba khyen brtse'i dbang phyug yab sras dbang ma grol bar bzhugs nas dbang bskur ba'i cho ga mdzad kyin 'dug pa la khong yab sras kyis dbang tshig ji lta ba bzhin khyed rnams la bshad pa yin ang / de 'dra'i dga' ba la ang / zhes gsungs pa ni bstan pa rin po che srid mthar mi nyams pa la bla ma rnam gnyis mnyes par snang / tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las/ nga dal 'byor rdo rje'i lus mchogo thob/ /pha mtshan ldan bla mas rjes su bzung / /lam tshad ma snyan brgyud bzhi ldan thob/ /da gang ltar byas kyangs ma ho/ /zhes pa'i don du mchis/ gzhan yang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs nyams khrid/ mgon chen gyi rjes gnang kha shas lung rags rim/ brag rdzong ma dang gsang khrid kyi nyams khrid/ rwa lugs bcu gsum ma'i dbang / rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi nyams khrid/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang gisagatsos dbang rjes gnang rig gtad khrid lung sogs gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu gsan cing bka' drin che shos su mdzad pas/ brag rdzong ma'i sa bcad las/ blo 'das gdod ma'i mgon po rdo rje 44 / /gang 'dul dag pa'i zlos gar drin can rje/ /bka' drin dran no pha rgod bslab gsum zhabs/ /snying nas 'du —445

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kye'abral med do thugs rjes skyongs/ /zhes pa'i don/ khyad par tshe rabs dpag med nas/ /rjes su bzung ba'i 'dren pa mchog /tshe 'dir rang sems lhan skyes 'di/ /skye med chos skur ngo sprad cing / /zab mo'i dbang bzhi chu bo'i rgyun/ /bum pa gang byor gnang ba yi/ /bka' drin mnyam med rdo ring pa/ /(9ba)'gran zla kun dang bral ba yin/ /zhes tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las byung ba dang mtshungs par sems/sku na gzhen dus nas rab tu byung ba gnang bzhed che zhing 'jam dbyangs byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis kyang sku chos gnang ba 'gab tshul dang / nged rang gra rkyang yin yang brang khang dbang chas sogs phyi nang kun phugs 'jags rtsis kyi lhan du bzhugs na yong ba sogs kyi bslab bya nan tan du mdzad rung 'phrang 'go gter ston gyi rta mgrin dregs pa kun 'dul gyi bskyed rdzogs 'khrul med tsit+ta dmar po las/ lnga brgya tha ma dus kyi snyigs ma laḥ shan+ti'i ming 'dzin bdud kyi bar chad kyisaḥmanga' ris phyogs nas hor gyi mnan pa 'don: ha la 'big gis ngam ring bar du 'joms byang gi ngam rar bdud srid 'go nad slong : sa bdag nam mkha'i snying la bar chad la jug: de dus byang gi ri sna bcu gsum rtser pad+ma mtshan brgyad gtsug lag bcu gsum re: brtsigs na byang phyogs rgyal po mnga' thang rgyas: zhes pa ltar/ byang gtsang rong gsum gyi bde gzar yo 'byoms che skabs/ me byi lo byang pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ kun rin pa/ gtsang pa nyid shag pa/ rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi lung bstan bzhin 'gong po'i sprul pa kun spangs pa rnams rtse bstun pa'i chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi phyogs su phul te gnas gsar bar bka' bkyon dus 'pho 'gyur chen pos mdzad dka'i skabs su song ba dang sras kyi bgres kha yin gzhas/ sgo du ma nas yab yum phyag phyi ba sogs tshang mas mgrin gcig tu khyed kyis chos mdzad na gnas gsar ba ming (10na)gi lhag ma lta bur gyur nas nged rnams su la re zhes nan tan chen pos gshol btab pa ni/ shā ri'i bu'i smon lam du/ ha cang phyug po'i khyim dang ni/ /dbul po'i khyim du mi skye bar/ /bar ma'i khyim du skyes nas kyang / /rab tu byung ba byed par shog /ces pa'i don bzhin sde pa gnas gsar ba zhes rgyal srid kyi snyan grags dang re dogs kyi —446

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)dbang gis re zhig sku rten bsgyur ba sogs gzhan dbang mthu btsan pas ma 'grub pa byang gling rjes da lam sku chos gnang ma bcug kyang phugs mdzad dgos pa yong gsung ba mngon mkhyen du mchis/rin spungs 'khas drung nas bka' lung lci ba dang yab yum gnyis kyi bka' nan ma bzlog pa'i dgongs pa stong ched pa rnam dga' gdong gi rdzong gsar phag ri'i rdzong dpon la phebs de dus gtsang rong zlos mtshams kyi gtsang kong gnyis kyi dmag gis phag ri rdzong la bskor ba rdzong rtsis sprad nas tshad dang bdag rkyen chen po 'ong zhes kun spangs drung gis zhal len cher mdzad pa de thog tu bskyal na shogs che ba yong nges yin 'dug kyang sde dpon ci rigs kyi lugs bzhin 'phral du kho mthong nas 'dod pas ngo tsha bsgrigs pa'i mna' dang las 'bras sogs phugs kyi nyes dmigs thams cad rgyab tu bskyur ba de 'dra thugs la ma babs pas nged rang tsho bkag por 'gro skabs mgo 'dren bdag rkyen mdzad mkhan rin spungs pa yin gshis bslus brgyab tshe lugs gnyis ka nas mi btub gsungs te sna len tsam yang ma mdzad pa'i dus phyag sprel gyi rdzong dpon pa rnam rdzong shar pas dus ngan skye bo'i spyod tshul mngon sum du (10ba)bstan te bslus brgyab pa'i rdzong sde pa gtsang par
