sprad cing dam pa 'di nyid kong dmag la gtad de sa dong du bzhugs bcug dong gi kha pir phub kyis bcad khyi thu po btags nas nye skor du 'grul mi yong ba'i dam dog chen pos shin tu 'o brgyal skabs spros med la brten pa'i thugs dam rnams ma/ chag cing /gsol ba'i phud mchod la brten nas chos skyong rnamasakyi gtor bsngo ma gtogs gzhan ma'i spros pa che ba rnams gnang ma thub/ de yang mo gal gyi bu'i phyag zhabs thams cad kun tu rgyus 'dam bu ltar bcoms pa'i lo rgyus bzhin yul khyad par can rnams la'ang kun rdzob tu las kyi 'bras bu mi yang ba'i mtha' ma bkag cing / de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes shākya'i mdo las/ des bskal ba grangs med par gang sdig pa'i las mngon par 'dus byas par gyur pa de dag gis/ de yang phyi ma'i dus na klad pa na ba tsam gyis thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ semasanyams nga ba tsam gyis thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ skur pa btab pa tsam gyis thams cad 'byang bar —447

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)'gyur/ brnyas pa tsam gyis thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ 'thing slad byas pa tsam gyis thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ co dris pa tsam gyis thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ rnyed pa chung bas thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ skye ba gcig kho nas thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur/ zhes pa ltar sbyang bya'i sdig lhung chen po'i tshogs kyang tshegs chung ngus gzhil bar gyur pa ltas ngan g.yang du lon pa yin pas rang rgyud pa'i ngang tshul du mi sems so/ /mi ring bar gzhis nas gser gyis gtsos dngos po gtos che ba'i blus mas (11na/nyes dmigs las grol te rang gi bsti gnas su phebs chog pa byung / dka' spyad chung ngu tsam gyis rkyen mi theg par dge sbyor la thang lhod mang du 'byung ba'i bzang por rlom pa mang po'i spyod tshul la brtags kyang ches brnag par dka' ba'i dus der rkyen ngan thog babs kyi dbang du mi 'gro ba ni ltar snang sde dpon gyi drung 'khor gyi sha tshugs can la snang ba thams cad bde stong gi rol bar 'char ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po ste/ rdo rje 'chang kun spangs chos rje dgung lo so bdun bar sne'u sdong rtser bzhugs pa yan chad la'ang thams cad mi dge ba'i las lam cung zad tsam gyis ma gos shing gzhis ka rtse'i zhol du rlung sems dbu mar chud pa'i lam rtags sogs dpag par dka' ba'i rtogs brjod dang dbyibs mtshungs par mngon/ sku'i rgyan cha lugs khyim pa'i rnam pa cam las tshangs par spyod pa'i brtul zhugs lhur len pa sogs sgo gsum bag yod kyi spyod tshul kho nas dus 'da' zhing dbang lung man ngag gsan pa phyag dpe 'dzin bshar thugs dam la rtsol 'don gyi kun tu spyod par gzhol ba la brtan thams cad kyis bla ma lta bu'i mthong dang drung du 'khod nas chos dang 'brel ba'i gleng bslang la spro ba 'phel ba ni/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ nad kyi 'jigs pa ma byung zhing / /dam pa dag dang 'grogs par brtson/ /dman pa'i tshig ni ma smras pa'i/ /nyin gcig lo brgya bas kyang mchog /ces dam pa dang nyin gcig 'grogs pa dang skyes phal dang lo brgyar 'grogs pa'i khyad par gyi don du nges shing glang bu nas ma chen tshe dbang don grub ces rnam dpyod mchog (11bachu yangs shing khyad par kha'u brag rdzong —448

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ (1)pa'i ring lugs la ldog tu med pa'i mos pa brtan po dang ldan pa des/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi drung du gur zhal gyi chos skor yongs rdzogs dgos tshul gyi snyan 'bul zhus pas dbang lung re mang gnang ba'i mtshams shig lhag ma rnams gnas gsar dbon rin po cher zhus gsungs pa sde pa'i thugs la/ dbon rin po che sku rten skya bo 'di 'dras gnang ba zhig cung mi yong ngam snyam pa la rjes sor zab chos mtha' dag lhug stsol zhus chog pa byung bas rje bla ma bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi gsung de mngon par mkhyen pa dang rje bla ma 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa gting tshugs pas brgyud bcas sbyin bdag gi mthil du gyur/zha lu 'jam dpal dbyangs byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan la bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs bu lugs kyi dbang 'khrid lung man ngag du ma gsan/ de'ang nye du dang 'bangs sogs srid pa'i phun tshogs la mngon par zhen pa rnams kyis 'bad pa du ma'i sgo nas bshol btab kyang rje bla ma 'di nyid tshangs pa/ brgya byin/ dbang phyug /'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal yang zag bcas kyi bde ba 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal chu shing ltar snying po med pa'i rang bzhin du gzigs te thog ma nyid nas nges par 'byung ba'i dam bca' brtan po las cung zad tsam yang g.yo ba mi mnga' bas dgung lo so gcig tu phebs pa 'gal ba zhes pa sa mo glang gi lo rgyal bas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i bzang po dang po'i nyin gdan sa 'og srid gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i chos gra chen por rta nag thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi khri pa mang thos sde snod gsum pa tshul khrims kyi dri ngad phyogs bcur khyab pa'i (12na)gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa mkhan chen byams pa rab brtan gyi drung du tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa legs par bzhes pa'i brje ba rnam pa gsum gyi skabs mtshan dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ mgon po khro bcu'i rjes gnang sogs chos rnam grangs mang du gsan/de nas ma 'gyangs par 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i gzhung lugs bye ba'i srol 'dzin kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa bsod nams seng ge'i bste gnas chos gra chen po thub bstan rnam par rgyal —449

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)ba'i gling du don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po byams pa rab brtan pas mkhan po/ khrims ldan ngur smig 'dzin pa chos 'od zer gyis las kyi slob dpon/ gsang ston/ grib tshod pa sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa rigs brgyad kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa dge slong gi dngos por bsgrubs te legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba'i rgyal mtshan chen po shākya seng ge'i ring lugs kyi ba gam mthon po'i rtse mor mngon par bsgrengs pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa nye bar 'khor gnyis pa lta bur gyur pa ni char chen gyi gsung las/ deng dus 'di na kha cig gzhan dbang gis/ /rang yul bla ma tshul 'chal dag la nod/ /gzhan dag bsams bzhin thag dang sar bgrod nas/ /chen po hor 'dra'i spyod tshul can la zhu/ /bdag gis tshe 'di'i ngo bsrung rgyab tu bor/ /phyi ma'i don chen 'ba' (12bton ga snying nas bsams/ /yongs rdzogs kha che'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa/ thu kya shi'i grwar ni 'bad pas sdos kas/ /zhes pa ltar paṇa chen lugs kyi sdom rgyun khungs btsun bzhes pa yin zhing mdor na theg pa che chung gi nyams bzhes mtha' dag mthar phyin pas tshar chen gyi gsung mgur du/ phyi tshul nyan thos kyi spyod pas tshul khrims srog bzhin du bsrungs shing / /nang du gzhan phan gyi snying rjes 'gro kun bu bzhin du bsams nas/ /gsang ba gnyis med dgag sgrub blang dor dang bral ba/ /bzo med lhug pa ru skyong ba rnal 'byor kho bo'i spyod pa/ /zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par snang / sngon gnas dran dang goms pa'i nus mthu rnams/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar na 'od zer ltar/ /na tshod phra yang rgan blo'i thos bsam tshul/ /ma drug rnam dpyod yangs la gcig tu sdang / /bla ma yi dam chos srung 'bral med du/ /yongs rig gsung gsang rgyun mi chad bzhin par/ /dngos nyams 'ga' 8 phyogs tsam ston pa 'di/ /mngon sum gzigs rnams gab pa'i brdzu bag mkhan/ /ngan spyod mtshon gyis mi phigs khrel gzhung ngo / /tshul gnas dam bca'i gtsug nor 'od 'bar des/ /mi dge lha min bcoms kyang rang sde'i byar/ /rjes brtse'i brgya byin gnyis —45(lha

khyab bdag dbang phyug rag brtan gyi rnam thar/ rtanapa dmigs su med//rin ོ spungs pa'i srid kyi gas don phyir//rang gi bde ba bor ba'i gtso len 'dis//'gro ched lus sogs 'dor ba'i rgyal sras kyi//rlabs zhi spyod pa'i ra de da gdod 'khums/khyim gzugs sgong sbubs mkhas btsun grub brnyes pa'i//dbyangs snyan legs 'khrol ka la piṅka'i bya//mthong tshe 13nasgo tshams sprin gos kyi 'dab gzhog can//ngur khyu phal cher don med ca cos ngal//blo gsal gdams pa'i rgya mtsho dpag dka'i mtha'//mkhyen brtse'i rdzings kyis dbangaphyug brgyad ldan gling //bgrod nas dngos grub rin wo 'dren pa'i khur//'degs nus snying stobasatshul la khyab 'jug zhabs//pad 'byung slar yang gangs can 'gro ba la//rjes brtse mchog gi sprul sku mnga' ris pas//theg dgu'i chos sgo phye tshe rgyal po dza//skyengs te 'og zhi zhing du bros sam snyam//risamed mdo rgyud chu phran kun btungs pas//yangs pa'i mkhyen rab lte ba ma khengs par//bslab gsum tshangs pa'i zhal sgo'i ril klung nas//phab pa'i snyan brgyud gaṅgā las la brel/khrid 'byor 'dod lhar ldang ba'i nges byung mes//rten 'brel lugs 'byung 'khor ba rags pa'i lus//bsngags te bag yod dbang phyug brgyad ldan lha//gtan mdun ral rtser thar pa'i zla ba tshes/mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan mkha' spyod he ru ga'i grong khyer du me glang sku'i bkod pa bsdus par brten bstan pa spyi bye brag gi gsan bsam 'phror lus pa rnams gas pa'i ched du/saglang bsam grub dgon gsar du phebs/snyan gsan 'bul bar gnang ba ltar sngags 'chang rin po ches zhal gyis bzhes te rje 'di nyid zhag shas chos skugs su bzhugs/rin po che mtsho sgo ba'i rkyen sel la skor tsam byon nas phyir lam dgra jag gi 'tshe ba mang ba'i gangs dbar slang stongs la srung ma'i dbang po rdo rje nag po r+ṣa po gur gyi mgon po ru 'dren sde 3ba tha zhi dang bcas pas mngon sum lta bur bsu ba'i gzigs snang byung bar phyag phyi ba g.yul rgyal sogs kyis bya nag zung 'brel gyis gshog gar dang skad snyan sgrog pa 'di mgon po'i phebs bsur 'dug ces gleng ba chos 'chad tī mdzad pa po gnyis rka'i che bar mchos/tshar chen yab sraXkyi zhabs pad yun ring du bsnyen pas zab chos kyi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)bdag po mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rin po che dgon gsar ba sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyi drung du zla ba brgyad kyi ring gser chos dmar po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang chos skor/ mgon po zhal gyi rjes gnang / tshe sgrub bsrung 'khor dang 'brel ba'i khrid/ be'u bum rags rim sogs mdor na gdung brgyud rim par byon pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi skor sngar rje bslab gsum par ma gsan pa'i 'phros rnams su ma zad sngar gsan rnams kyang bskyar bldab dang pad+ma dbang chen yang gsang khros pa'i dbang / rta bod/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs kyi dbang / rwa pod/ dpal 'dzin pod chung sogs zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan cing mjug tu tshe dpag med lcags sdong ma'i dbang gnang ba'i tshe lo rgyus dang dngos gzhi'i mtshams su slebs dus tshe chang khol nas lud pa rje 'di nyid kyis mang du bzhes pa'i lhag ma rnams ril bur sgril ba 'bru sha'i sngags 'chang chen po 'di nyid nyams rtogs kyi yon tan phul du byung zhing sngags smyon bsam gyis mi khyab pa bgrangs pa'i byin rlabs kyis pha bla ma mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis bstan pa'i bdag por rigs kyi dbon dam pa bcu phrag brgyad kyi bar du (14na tsher tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rten 'brel du sems la/ mdor na bka' drin che ba'i bla ma zhig tu mdzad pas zhaX gyi gsang khrid kyi yi ge las/ rgyal ba kun dngos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang / /rigs brgya'i 'khor los sgyur ba'i zlos gar gyis/ /deng 'dir skye rgu'i don slad bshes gnyen sku/ /pha rgod sku drin dbang po dgon gsar ba/ /mgon de'i gsung gi gsang ba mi zad pa/ /zab rgyas snyan brgyud bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho las/ /dad gus snyim pa'i bcud kyis bsdus pa 'di/ /skal bzang snying la grub pa'i dga' ston spel/ /zhes pa gsang 'khrid gcig pur ma zad zab chos g.yin la'ang sbyor rigs par mchis/ dbyangs can lha mos rjes su bzung bas mdo rgyud/ sgra tshad/ snyan dngags sogasarig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhyen rab kyi spyan dkyus shin tu ring bas dus thog de na sa dge'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan dag gis bsgrun du med pa thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho zhes gsang chen slob bshad 'dzin pa'i shing rta pa chen po de la sgrol dkar dang dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i rjes —452

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)gnang sogs chos bka' kha yar/rje byams pa skal bzang la ba gu dang tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi 'khrid sogs cho me mang ba/rin po che stobs ldan 'od zer la 'dod rgyal gyi 'khor lo'i phyag len/dza bir gyi snur rlung sogs man ngag zab chos mang dag/thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchod dbon drung pa dkon legs par gsung 'bum nang gi chos sna 'ga' zhig gis mtshon pa'i zab don gyi chos bka' du ma rnams gsan/sku rten skya bo'i 14bdus su'ang sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan la nges pa rnyed pa du mas bka' chos zhus par ma zad rab tu byung ba nas bzung dbang 'khrid lung man ngag gis mtha' klas pa'i gdul bya'i re ba yongs su bkang /chu 'brug bka' drin mnyam med 'bru'i sngags 'chang chen po'i drung du rje dam pa 'di wo dang /chos rje byams pa shākya blo gros/chos rje ngag dbang pa/chos rje dkon cog legs 'dzin/khams pa'i slob bu gsum dang bcas lhan cig par dbang 'khrid lung man ngag mang du gsan/dgung lo so brgyad pa me pho spre'u'i lo dbus la phebs pa'i dgongs pa bstad/zha lu ri phug nas rtse gdong du phebs zhabs drung khri rin po che kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i phyag phyi mdzad shu gu la brgyud paṇ+ḍita chen po kā ma la hi la'i rnam 'phrul rong ston shes bya kun rig gi gdan sa rgyun ster ram 'dam bu sbyin du 'bod pa'i chos gra chen por byon/rtse gdong khri rin po cher tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi dbang gsan/zhabs drung khri chen gyis nā le rgyu'i mkhan tshab tu mnga' gsol te re zhig bzhugs dus khamasabod kyi gra pa rnams la rgyud sde bzhi'i nang nas dbang rjes gnang nyams 'khrid dang lung ci rigs kyi chos char phab/rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sku'i snang ba ches gsal bar byung ba tshar chen la 'phan dkar gyi ljongs su rjes su 'dzin/zhes pa dang dbyibs mtshungs pa'i nā ro ta pa'i slob bshad zab mo thugs nyams su bstar pa 'ga' zhig yul phyogs 'di ngos nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel zhig yod par mchis/ ldan༄ra tshar chen gyis mkha/ chen blo gros chos 'phags la rje mkhyen brtse'i dbang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)phyug mjal thub pa gyis gsung ba phyag tu ma khel ba'i ngang sku gshegs pa'i gshis bla ma'i bka' bzhin ma 'grub pa'i dam tshig skong byed du rje 'di nyid phebs dgos tshul zhus pa ltar skyed tshal 'og tu byon/rje mkhyen brtse'i zin bris gshed dmar spros med kyi 'khrid yig de tshar chen gyis 'di la kho bos glo dgon pa mi 'dug pa ma gtogs tshig gi zur ma nyams pas lung byas chog cing tshigs bcad rnams kyang snyan po 'dug pas klog thong gsung mkhan chen par ljags lung gnang 'dug gshis 'khrid lung gsan/ rim gyis sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms dang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sogs kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar kun mkhyen 'jigs med dpa' bo'i bsti gnas gong dkar rdo rje gdan du phebs te gnas rten rnams zhib par mjal ba'i mgon khang du mchod gtor 'phrin bcol rgyas par gnang / rin po che klu dbang gling pa rnam rgyal bkra shis la dpal mgon zhal khra can gyi rjes gnang dang 'jam dbyangs nag po'i chos skor sogs gsan/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po sku bongs thog tshad tsam gser gyi lhun po la nyi ma 'bum gyis 'khrud pa'i gzi byin can mtshan dpe gsal la rdzogs pa dang / chos kyi rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku'i snang ba gsal bar gzigs/de nas dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi chig brgyud rdo rje'i brgyud pa bdun ldan gyi nang tshan sangs rgyas gnyan ston chen po'i rnam 'phrul mkhan chen gzhon (15bsko kyi blo gros mjal bar gsang chen slob bshad kyi sngags gra yar klungs bkra shis chos sder phebs/ mjal tsam nas dpon slob sngar nas 'dris pa lta bu'i thugs dgyes shing gsung gleng 'phel bar mdzad/ mkhan rin po cher tshar chen gyis mdzad pa'i kye rdor maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod dang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i zhal gyi gtor skyong gi lung / tshe dbang grub rgyal ma'i dbang phyag drug pa'i rjes gnang sogs chos 'brel kha yar gsan/khyed kyis chos sde'i gra pa rnams la gur zhal pu tra beg tse rnams kyi rjes gnang mdzod gsung ba ltar bka' ba 9 ༷na ba ji/bas/hor zla lnga pa'i nyer gcig thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku mchod dus dran la dpon slob bcu gnyis —454

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)kyis dpal rdo rje'i 'jigs byed rwa lugs rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas zhag brgyad kyi bar bdag 'jug tshar brgyad bzhes pa'i nyer gnyis kyi dgongs mtshams chos sde'i thad kyi nam mkha' li khri ltar gyi dbus na 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan gyi gur khyim dang gzhan yang lnga ldan brgyad pa sogs bun long nge bas khengs pa dpon slob thams cad kyis gzigs shing sgrub mchod tshugs gdong gi tshes bcu dgu'i nub ngo mtshar ba'i mnal lam zhig byung gsung ba las 'di yin gsal bar ma gsungs snang yang phyi rol tu shar ba dang nang du ye shes kyis gzigs ngor byung ba mtha' dag bla ma 'jam dpal rdo rje gang thugs dag pa'i ngo bor ro gcig pa'i rang zhal mngon sum gzigs pa'i rnam 'phrul lo/ /hor zla bdun pa spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa byang gter thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi sgo nas gnang ba'i dus thugs dang ba'i snang ba dang dad gdung (16na〉 yin pa'i shugs drag pas hūṃ gi 'dzab bskul tsam gyi tshe me tog gi char dad ldan kun gyi mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du gyur cing / nyi ma dmar thag chod skabs nam mkha' li khri lta bu la 'ja' kha dog lnga 'khyil ba dang dra phyed sogs mang pos mthong 'dug pa/ bka' las rtags de dag o rgyan mkhyen brtse'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs yin snyam pas slar yang dad gus kyi snying phur brtan par thebs/ zhes nges rnyed mdzad pa ni o rgyan sangasargyas gnyis pa'i sku 'khor du laṅka'i rgyal khab dpal gyi ri bor bzhugs pa las spur rgyal gyi yul nasagasol 'debs mdzad pa po yang byin gyis brlab par bka' brgyad kun 'dus bla ma rigs 'dzin gyi rnam par byon pa'i brda thabs tsam mo/ /phebs gdong mkhan chen pa'i gsung las chos sde 'di la khyed kyis gang legs mdzad dgos tshul gyi zhal ta dang bzhugs 'ding ngur smig gis gtsos gnang cha spams bstod cing mgon po'i bka' bsgo shin tu rgyas pa zhig gnang ba de las rgyas pa bla ma gzhan la zhu ma myong bas de la brten nas yun ring po'i bar blo bde cham me ba byung gsungs/ bzhugs 'ding gi gnang sbyin dang gra pa rnams la rjes gnang mdzad dgos pa rjes su chos sde'i mkhan por phebs dgosapa'i rten 'brel bla ma yi dam chos srung tshogs kyis dgongs pa rtse gcig pas bsgrigs par mngon /—455

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'chos sde 'di dbus phyogs su gsang chen slob bshad pa'i sngags dgon bzang shos yin par ma zad mgon khang du rdo rje chos skyong rnams mngon sum du bzhugs nyams kyi gzi byin che (16ba)zhing o rgyan chen po'i lung gis zin pa yin zhes rje bla ma lhag par thugs gtsigs che ba yin 'dug /de nas dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan khu dbon rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing dam can srung ma sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i rtsis dang bsam gling bde ba chen por phebs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku brnyan tshul khrims ma dang nang rten sogs la smon lam dang dbang bzhi bzhes pa/ mgon po che chung las mgon bcas par mchod gtor bskang bshags 'phrin bcol mdzad/gong ma sde srid phag mo gru pa drung chen tā'i si tus phyag dar ba'i chos gra chen po dpal gyi rtses dang du phebs te paṇ+ḍi ta chos kyi grags pa'i thugs dam rten thub pa gser gling mar grags pa mnyam med jo bo chen pos gdan drangs nas dge bshes khu ston pa'i rten skal du byung ba des gtsos phyi nang rnams zhib mjal mdzad de rim gyis chu bo chen po pa klu'i klung brgal ba'i lha sras khri srong lde'u btsan gyis o tan+ta pū ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe byas te bzhengs pa'i bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po'i dbu rtse rigs gsum/ gling bzhi gling phran/ jo mo'i gling phran/ jo mo'i gling gsum sogs rten brten pa thams cad la phyag mchod bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyor gnang / thang yig las/ khyad par yar klungs shel brag mchims phuganyis: rgya gar dur khrod bsil pa tshal dang mtshungs: zhes ches cher bsngags pa'i gsung gi dben gnas bsam yas mchims phur (17na)byon nas gsang phug tu gnas 'brel mdzad de rang rig bla ma'i rang zhal ma wa rna sum du gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor zab mo'i thugs dam dang gnas kyi tshogs zhib par gzigs/ bsam gtan gling dang bsam yas ri mthil tshor bla ma yi dam gyi zhal gzigs lung bstan dbugs dbyung mang ba byung tshod du gda'ang dman cha blangs te gsal bar mi gsung / rgod dkar la brgyud nā lan+dar byon pa'i zla —456

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ rtanaganyis bar chos 'phro sogs mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i ngang nas me bya zla ba gnyis pa'i nang du 'a zha ye shes g.yung drung gis sngon smon lam rgya cher mdzad pa'i rgyun skyong ba'i ched du dpon slob drug gis swā la'i sman ljongs kyi lte ba lha ldan sprul ba'i gtsug lag khang du phebs pa'i zla ba gnyis kyi ring yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab mthong bas rnam par grol ba jo shāka yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo/ thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan sogs ye shes sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs pa'i rten rnams la zhabs skor 'bum ther gyi dus nyin re bzhin mjal ba'i mchod 'bul dang smon lam dbang bzhi bzhes pa sogs tshogs gsog gi rim pa smin rgyas su mdzad/ jo bo rin po cher dngos su smon lam gnang ba'i dag pa'i gzigs snang la jo bo'i sku 'od kyi rang bzhin gur gum mdog can lam mer gsal ba dang mnal lam du dbu'i gtsug tu rdo rje sems dpa' khru gang shin tu gsal ba zhig shar ba las sgrib dag pa'i rtags 'di ltar byung ba rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang de ltar bya dgos so zhes pa'i (17ba tha do chos su snang / dngos su'ang bud med rgan song lag na 'o ma rdza phor phyed tsam dang la phug rdog gcig bzung ste g.yon skor du 'ongs pa dang zhabs skor gnang ba zhal 'dzom par bud med des rje'i zhal la cer gyis blta zhing 'o ma dang la phug phyag tu phul nas sgrims po glod zer ba gsan pas thugs kyi nyams rtogs la bogs shin tu che ba thon/ bud med de gar song cha med du gyur pa ni rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi dam tshig la g.yon pa'i kun spyod gtso bor bshad cing gsang sngags sgrub pa'i gnas la lha sa'i dur khrod 'di khyad du 'phags tshul dpal mar me mdzad kyi gsung bzhin lha sre mar grags pas bka' chems bka' khol ma gter nas 'don pa'i lung bstan pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos smon lam chen mo zhig gi dus sngar za ma myong ba'i kha zas zham 'bring pa 'ga' la gnang nas mkha' 'gros mgron du pos gsung ba sogs kyis mtshon gnas kyi khyad par las ye shes mkha' 'gro tha mal gyi rnam par rgyun mi chad par 'byon pa yin 'dug pas rje btsun rdo rje btsun mos rjes su bzung ba'i rtags yin na'ang mngon par mi mdzad/—457—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)bkra shis rtse nas mkhan rin po ches nā lan+dar phyag dpe g.yar bar dge slong ye shes blo gros dang byang chub gnyis gnang ba/ jag nyen sar mgon pod 'bog gi rting na gril ba shab sgra dang bcas don na yang jag pa gnyid du song nas ma tshor bar ya mtshan che zer skad/ de nas rgyal sras lha rje'i rnam 'phrul 'bri gung zhabs drung chos rgyal phun tshogs mkhar rtser byon pa dang 'grig /de'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen (18na)brtse'i dbang phyug yang zab kyi chos bdag lung bstan gyis zin pa'i chos bka' rnams gsan dgos rgyur sa khad 'byangs pa'i gangs can bstan 'gro'i legs byas kyi snod du ma shong ba'i gter ston dang gter slob gnyis ka sku tshe mthar ma phyin pas stabs ma 'grig pa rjes kyi rten 'brel la dgongs rje 'dis 'bri gung rin po che'i drung du yang zab kyi dbang lung rdzogs par zhus shing gter bdag gi bka' gtad dus ma gza' rdor gsum mngon sum du gnang byung ba'i thugs nyams shar/ snyan brgyud ha la nag po'i skor gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba tshig brgyud kho nar bzhugs gshis kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis g.yin la ma gnang ba'i ngang lcang lo can du gshegs pas snyan brgyud rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rin po che bod mkhar ba tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sras kyi thu bo gzhan dang mi 'dra bas gsan yod pa gzhir bcas kyi spyan snga rin po cher bzhugs yod 'gro bas de gsan pa dang zhar byung mthil sogs kyi gnas mjal gnang rtsis kyi thog mar phag mo lo'i dgon par phebs pa be'u bum nag po'i skor ni mkhas grub mi tri'i zhabs kyis kyang ma gsan gsungs nas ma byung na'ang dpal mgon las bzhi dang rnam sras bka' mi 'dra ba bco lnga'i rjes gnang gshed dmar spros med kyi khrid sogs zab chos mang du gsan cing dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bur gyur/ 'bri gung mthil mjal bar thegs pa'i gser khang dang khang gsar sogs phyi nang gi rten brten pa rnams zhib mor gzigs/ slob dpon chen po'i (18ba tha zhugs gnas zho stod gter sgrom du phebs bzhed kyang kha char ches pas lam gyi khyad nas slar mjal ba'i rten 'brel mdzad de phyir —458—

khyab bdag dbang phyug rang brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)byon pa'i chibs thog gi sku'i g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab tshor bu mo dkar ser dmar ljang 'dra byung ba'i gzigs snang ni gnas der phebs ma thub par ma dang mkha' 'gro cung zad 'phreng ba dang zhabs skyel gyi rnam par 'dug/mer te gtsang po rgyas par sa sne zhig la ko ba btang ba rdib la khad byung ba dam can rdo rje legs pa skyes pa'i cha byad can du byas te ka ba bzung bas chu bo'i 'jigs pa las grol ba 'phrin las bsgrubs par dgongs/nā len+t+ra ra byon nas skabs shig dpal ldan rtse zhes bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dam gtor snod sa skya nas bya rog gis khyer ba'i gnas gzhi 'ding sar bzhag ste lung bstan pa'i mgon khang rdo rje chos skyong rnams rang bzhin gyis 'du ba der phebs pa'i zhag kha yar bzhugs/bskang bshags bstod 'phrin gyi sgo nas bstan 'gro spyi bye brag gi rnam dkar spel ba dang bzhed don gyi tshogs sgrub par dam bsgrags pa'i dus las mgon pu tra ming sring ri rab tsam zhal gzigs pa ni bdag chen rin bo che dang kun spangs rdo ring pa chen po gnyis kyis gnas der bsnyen sgrub las sbyor phul phyin gnang ba'i rgyun bzhin bstan pa rin po che'i mel tshe dus drug tu mdzad do//zhes zhal gyis 'ches par go/bgrang yas rgyud sde'i rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i tshal//smin grol rtsa sdong yal 'dab nyer mtshungasakyang //zab gsar nying khus 'dod 'jo'i mchog sbyin pa//slob bshad snyan brgyud yongs 9na po du sa brtol tsam//rnam dag bslab gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nyid//chos dbyings mtshams sprin lusaphra'i mngal zhugs tshe//mkhyen brtse nus ldan bsod nams chos 'phel zlas//gang thugs āt+pal dkar po ci yang bzhad//'jam dbyangs dbyangs can dgyes pa'i klu sgrub rje//zab don don gsal byamasapa skal bzang zhabs//mas stobs stobs ldan mtshan 'chang rig pa 'dzin//kun legs legs bshad gdams pa'i sgo 'phar phye//kun 'byung nyes brgya 'byin par thabs ston ched//kun bzang chos kyi nyin byed gdung gsob ste//kun mkhyen shākya'i gdan sa'i mkhan tshab tu//kun dga'i lam 'dren bla mas mnga' gsol mdzad//snyan brgyud bstan pa/ /dugs dkar yu ba de//mgon khyod phyag tu don

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)gyis legs gtod pa/ /gzhen nu'i mtshan 'dzin mes po'i blo gros can/ /mkha' spyod gnas su bgrod pa'i nyer bsdogs bzhin/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du ma sa /ngo mtshar dag pa'i snang ba 'byams klas 'od/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i phra rab rdul gyi zhing / /ma smad gzigs mo gsal la 'phros sam snyam/ /thub pas byang chub mchog brnyes khyod byin brlabs/ /dbang por bstan ma sa las lus phyed du/ /thon pa'i bden gtam 'gro kun snying ga la/ /nges rnyed dam bca'i sa bon snyoms par bkram/ /grangs med bskal par gsog pa'i tshogs chen yang / /thabs mkhas 'phrul gyis ra sa'i gnas 'dir 'dums/ /gsang ba ye shes ḍā (19ba)kyi tha mal tshul/ /bstan nas tshig dang brda yis rjes su bzung / /o rgyan thugs kyi thigs pa ro bda'i zas/ /lha gcig sras dang mtshungs par longs spyod pa'i/ /las smon rten cing 'brel 'byung lde mig des/ /mchog thun ba ched dgu tshang ba'i sgrom bu phye/ /dbu ru'i phyogs 'dir mnyam med kha'u pa'i/ /bstan pa'i gdugs dkar bsgreng mkhas bod mkhar rje'i/ /rgyal tshab mi pham chos kyis rgya mtsho dang / /thugs yid gcig 'dres sras kyi thu bor gyur/ khrag dron 'dzag pa'i g.yang gzhi lding thabs gyon/ /don snying za zhing rgyu ma'i ga sha can/ /mi sdug gshin rje'i sdod pon ming sring rnams/ /ci bgyi'i las bcol g.yar dam slar bcas 'dra/ /de nas rim bzhin gtsang la chibs bskyod pa'i lam zhor du paṇa chen shākya shrīs dbyar gnas mdzad cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i drang srong srin po rir phebs nas paṇa chung bi bhā ti tsan+da'i phyag bzo'i bde mchog byin rlabs can mjal zhing smon lam gnang / gong dkar chos sde'i klu dbang gling du bzhugs pa'i nub oṃ gsum ma'i sgra dir dir sgrogs byung bas rkyen byas kyang ldebs la rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sku ri mor bris pa shin tu gsal ba gzigs pa sku 'khor ba zhig gis 'di thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyag bris yin zer ba'i thugs snang la shar ba nang par logs der ci yang mi 'dug pa nye lam 'di la brten nas rgya bod kyi grub brnyes du ma lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa'i lo rgyus/ lam glu dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs las/ dpal mkha' spyod kyi dga' ma yid (20na tshe(nga —460

khyab bdag dbang byug rang brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)ma//dus ring nas bskyangs pa'i ma ma des//nga rigs 'dzin gyi grub pa ster ba'i brda//zhes pa dang mtshungs par mngon/gam pa la brgyud ma pham mgon po kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs kyi dben gnas zha lu ri phug chos kyi pho brang du phebs te bzhugs pa mu nas sa khyi lor gzhubs chos lung du a spyi'i bsnyen chen gnang skabs dpal kye rdo rje lha dgu'i rten brten pa thog tshad tsam gzigs pa ni/tshar ོ gyi gsung mgur du/dpal bde mchog 'khor lo rnal 'byor ma//lha dgyes pa rdo rje rim bzhin du/khyod byang chub sgrub pa'i yi dam gyis//zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar zung 'jug mngon du ma gyur gyi bar du rjes su 'dzin pa'i brdar mchis/gyang shing lta bu zhig gi steng na rje btsun dkar po rnam gsum bzhugs pa sku dwangasashing gsal ba 'od kyi rang bzhin la rjes su sku rnams cung zad 'byogs pa'i rnam pa mnal lam du gsal bar shar zhing /ljags bsnyen bas cha'i sbyin sreg sogs tshang bar grub nas bka' brgyad yongasardzogs kyi zhal gzigs shing de nas bzung sngags sgrub nar mar mdzad/dpal phug tu byon pa'i nub mnal lam gyi tshul du tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos gsung ngag gi dbang byin rlabs khrid man ngag thams cad gnang ba'i nyams shar ba ni rje brtse ba chen por rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi3 pas rgyab ri dang mnyam pa'i sku dngos su bstan te gsung ngag lam 'bras rdzogs par gnang ba dang shar chen gyis mnal lam bzung nas spros med gsan pa'i lo rgyus dang dbyibs mtshungs pas mnal lam gyi zol las mngon 20ba〉kyim du rjes su bzung nas zhag shas kyi bar ma gnang ba'i nges pa mi 'dug go/de nas ri phug tu phebs 'di lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la mkhan chen gzhon nu blo grosagazugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshe 'dar du tshar ba rdo rje 'chang gi gser gdung sku drung du mar me rgyun spar/kha'u ba'i bstan 'dzin rnams la thugs dam 'dogs rten/dgon pa tshor mang 'gyed bcas 'byor pa'i ngag mar bstan 'dzin rnams kyi bgres khar song gshis rin po che dgon gsang ba yar klungs su phebs thub la re'i snyan gsan byuX ༷'i lan du na so smin pa dang sa khad stings par

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'abarten phan thogs yong ba dka'/ de bas bstan pa'i nyi ma o rgyan gnyis pa dpon drung mkhyen rab gdul bya'i mkha' la byin rlabs kyi 'od zer 'bum phrag 'gyed nus pa'i sngags 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan spyan 'dren par 'os so zhes pa phul/ de ltar dang len mdzad song bas de phyogs kyi re 'dod thams cad 'grub par go bas blo bde/ zhes gsungs par gnang zhing rin po che yol pa ba rang gis sngar nas thugs rtse bstad pa'i zhal chems la chos sde 'di gsar par song gshis mkhan thog tu gnas gsar rje drung gdan 'dren thub pa cis kyang gyis zhes sde ba dngos grub pa dang gra rigs rnams la gsung gi tha ma stsal ba dang mthun pa byung ba ltar sa phag nang du yon mchod thun mong nas gdan 'dren gyi snyan gsan 'bul mi mngags pa zha lur 'byor rgyu'i zhag lnga tsam gyi gong nub cig mnal lam du ā tsarla gzi brjid can rgya dang sma ra bzang po gos gser ma dkar (21na)ser dmar ljang gi ber brtsegs mdang rgya nag gi thags zhwa nag po gyon/ lag nas ma na ho dang g.yang ṭi'u'i spos phor thogs pa'i lag g.yas gdan 'dren pa'i tshul byas te rta pa mang po byung ba ci yin nam bsam pa khong tsho yong ba'i ltas su 'dug gsungs la/ de ni dbus 'gyur sman ljongs kyi dga' tshal chen por rje btsun kha'u pa'i lugs 'dzin gtsang ma 'di kho na las ma mchis pas gnyan mgon zhal bzhi pa'i las mgon pu tra gang rung dzo zhi'i gzugs su sprul nas bstan pa'i srog 'thud cig pa'i brda thabs su go/tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las/ da tshe 'jug la re smon 'di ltar yod/ /don tshe 'di yi re bltos lings te bskyur/ khong mgo nag mi yi khyu nas bud/ /gnas nges med kyi ri khrod stong pa sa /zas zhen med kyi rtswa dang ldom bu'i zas/ /lam 'khrul med kyi rim gnyis rnal 'byor la/ /sems rtse gcig tu yengs med lhug par 'jog /rkyen gang shar gyi snang ba lam du 'khyer/ /dus cha ba nam yong gi sgugs sdod byed/ /rje bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs de la byed/ /ma khams gsum 'gro ba'i drin lan 'jal/ khyed dad ldan slob ma'i dkor sbyong yin/ /zhes pa'i don ltar spyir 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ba dang /chos kun snang stong sgyu ma lta bu 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi don thugs su chud pas srid pa'i 'byor ba —462

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)dang zang zing gi 'du 'god la ye mi dgyes shing dbus gtsang gi sde rigs rnams kyi 'pho 'phyugs dang sgos gnas gsar ba rang gi dus 'gyur sogs 'phral rkyen de dag gis kyang thugs sna bstungs te (21ba〉snas 'dzi chags sdang gi g.yeng ba mi dgos pa'i bas mtha'i dben gnas su rnaX 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan chos skyong dang nā ro ta pa'i gdams pa la brten nas sku tshe 'dir zung 'jug brnyes pa zhig mdzad dgongs pa kho nar thugs la bcags na'ang bkra shis rtse yon mchod zhu nan ches pa dang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i ring lugs dri ma med pa srid mtha'i bar rgyas na dgongs pa'i snying stobs kyi 'khur lhag par bzhes te 31 shas bar khur bzhes dang skabs babs la phebs pa'i zhal bzhes gnang / dbus su phebs dus spyan snga rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgya mtshor be'u bum nag po'i skor rtsad gcod gnang rung ma bzhugs par brten gzhan la gsan pa'i yul med par thag chod de gsung rtsom gnang ba'i drung yig byams pa don grub la tshig gcig kyang ma lus par bzhugs pa'i thugs nges rnyed cing gnyan mgon la brtag pa phul ba yang babs pas rje byams pa don grub la snyan brgyud ha la nag po'i skor yongs rdzogs/ sngar rin po che rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel gyi drung tu gser chos dang chos skyong che chung gi skor phal cher gsan na'ang zab chos 'di skor bka' dam zhing dus gcig tu cha tshang 'dril na chos skyong bka' gnyen pa'i dpon slob tshang mar 'tshub cha byung dogs che bas lcags khyi lo slar yang 'phro lus kyi dbang rjes gnang lung man ngag phyag khrid kyi rigs dang gsan grub pa 'ga' zhig la'ang bskyar bldab dang / g.yin yang bstan pa spyi sger gyi chos bka' mang du gsan pas rje dgon gsar pa'i gsung las/ thugs ba thed kyi don ma lus par blo nus kyi (22na) rig pa rtsal dang bcas pas bsgrubs zhes gsungs par snang zhing / kha'u pa'i bstan pa'i ched dzu khams phyogs su 'bul sdud la mtshungs med dgon gsar ba rdzong bda' gnang rtsis kyi kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i bslab ston bzhin khams gsum dbang sdud ga ṇa pa ti'i sgrub pa gnang ba'i rten rnams kyang phyag tu 'bul ba mdzad/ ha la nag po'i skor dgos phebs pa ltar khyab bdag sngags 'chang chen por maṇ+ḍal —463

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shegyi tshul du phul/ 'di'i gra pa rnams la rten 'brel gyi khyad nas sbyong rgyud bcu gnyis kyi gtso bo kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbang gis phebs pa ltar bka' bzhin bsgrubs/ dbus phyogs su 'gyangs med 'byon skor da lam thogs gzhi gang chung mdzod gsung ba stobs 'phrog dbang po'i gsang khrid sogs 'phror lus dogs pa'i dgongs pa can du mngon/'phar ba zhes pa lcags mo glang gi lo ri phug tu bzhugs dus yar klungs bkra shis chos sde nas yang bskyar gyi gdan 'dren byung ba ltar zla ba gsum pa'i nang du dbus su phebs nas sa ga zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i nyin bkra shis chos kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa'i sde chen por seng shes btegs pa'i rin po che'i khrir zhabs zung gi pad+ma rnam par bkod par pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtse nas gong ma sde srid phag mo gru pa mi pham dbang sgyur rgyal pos bsko 'ja'i lung bzang po gnang sbyin dang bcas pa dang gra rigs sbyin bdag gzhug mar gnas pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i zang zing gi bdog pa ring por rkyong ba sogs khri ston gyi mchod sprin rgya cher bskrun/hor zla lnga pa'i 'jam dpal dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi sku mchod chen mo la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum (22ba〉pa'i sgrub mchod tshogs chen la 'dzugs pa gnang skabs phyi nang gi 'tshub dang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i lhongs kyi rnam par sku shin tu mi bde zhing thugs sems g.yin dang mi 'dra ba'i 'tshub rang lo zhe dgu tshun gyi byed dgos la lha 'dre dang mi'i rnam pa 'dra bas mgrin gcig tu bsdigs pa'i rnam par byung yang bden pa'i 'dzin stangs mtha' dag bzang ngan re dogs dang bral ba'i gnas lugs kyi ngang nas sa chog nas zhag bdun gyi bar sgrub mchod rgyas par mdzad pas dus dga'i dbang po ma he'i zhal can gyi dkyil 'khor zhal 'byed pa la 'khu zhing zil mi bzod pa'i 'byung po thams cad mtsho la kha ba babs pa ltar rang zhir song bas 'gro ba'i lo tog gi bcud myang bar byed pa'i stobs dang bral te char gyi rgyun chen pos 'dzin ma'i khyon kun gsher ba na skye bo'i tshogs kyang sgrub mchod byin rlabs che zhes dad pa dang bstod —464—

khyab bdag dbang byug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)bsngags kyi me rtag 'thor/ gsung ngag bla ma brgyud pa'i kha skong gi rten bzheng dang gzungs 'bul gyi sta gon gnang nas dus babs su bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab tu gnas pa nyin gsum ma zhi rgyas kyi sbyin sreg dang bcas shin tu rgyas pas byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'od du 'bar/ gra rigs rnams la kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dbang dang mgon po che chung gi rjes gnang sogs nyer mkho'i chos bka' mang du gnang /hor zla bcu pa'i nang du bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi dus dran du mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa dze tā ri lugs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa mdzad/ ji skad du/ rtsod bzlog mu stegs byed la yod ces thos/ /dgra chos zhes(23na)bya g.yung drung bon gyi yin/ khrug sto rtsa bzhi gshin rje pa la grags/ /'dir ni drag po gtor ma'i bzlog par brjod/ /ces lcags mkhar zur dgu pa'i man ngag rwa lugs la grags che na'ang mgon po la zhwa dpe lham 'gebs lta bu ma yin par lugs 'di'i phyag bzhes khungs ma dmar chen gtor bzlog 'di bka' gnyan zhing 'tshub lhongs che bas mkhan rin po che gzhen nu blo gros kyi dus su sde dgon gyi sku rim la gnang ba rjes su lo gcig gnyis shig chag pa sde pas sngar lugs bzhin gtor bzlog gnang dgos pa'i gsol ba btab par gra rigs la la mkhan rin po che mthu stobs che drag pa ma gtogs 'di 'tshub ches pas ci 'dra 'ong zhes yid gnyis byed par rje nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i skur bzhengs pa'i bsnyen song rnams kyi gsung zla dang bcas hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i nang du gtor sgrub 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i zhag gsum pa'i nyin gdab las gnang tshe liṅga lan gsum 'phar ba sde pa dpon g.yog gsum gyis dngos su mthong ba ni pho nya'i tshogs kyis dgra bo'i bla tshe mngon sum du bkug par 'dug cing de dang dus mnyam du mgon khang gi sring mo'i zhal nas rlangs pa 'tshub 'khyil gyis thon zhing zhal nang gi rgyu zhags 'dzar/nyer dgu'i srod la gtor rgyag gnang dus gtore zor las me ched pa rgyugs shul du sal gshor —465

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gebrus pa lta bu dang mi gsum tsam gyis 'degs dgos pa'i gtor ma phyag gis bteg nas ri thang mtshams kyis shin tu sra zhing lhag par dgu 'dren pa'i sa chu 'khyags sgang la 'phen pa gnang ba phyed tsam dim pa de nub gtor slang 'then (23ba)ma thub par nang par 'don dgos pa sogs kun gyi mngon sum du gyur pa'i rtags ngo mtshar bar ma zad gzhung nas bshad pa'i mtshan ma phal cher rdzogs pa byung zhes nye 'khor ba rnams la gsung gleng mdzad/de skabs mgon khang gi ru 'dren sde bzhi'i bud med mdun la shin tu rngams pa'i tshul gyis byon te zhabs g.yon bgrad pa dang phyag g.yas kyi gru mo skya la reg par dus rgyun gyi bskang gso ba'i rnga lcag 'gel bzhin pa la de dgongs sngar ltar ba theg pa sa la lhung bas ci yin bsams bltas pa na phyag skya dang bral nas gcus par shes shing ding sang gi bar du'ang mthong na mi mthun pa med par yod/mkhan rin po che'i rnam sras lha khang gi gtso bo ser chen gyi sku tsam grub nas 'phror lus pa chu stag 'khor rta bdag brgyad dang mdung dmar can phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i sku yang lhan cig par bzhengs nas rab tu gnas pas ye shes sems dpa' zhugs nyams kyi zhal dkyil la rdul mi bzhes pa ding sang bar du mchis/ sngar sngags 'chang rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel gyis phugs nged kyi gdan sa 'di yang khyed kyis mdzad dgos yong yang yang gsung ba dang / nye lam bkra shis chos ster mkhan por phebs pa'i nyer bsdogs dus da res dbus su yun ring ma bzhugs zhes bslab ston stsal bar brten gtsang la chibs kha bskyod pa'i zhor lam du tshe chu 'bum pa mjal bar phebs/ dgun grang dus las nam zla dro ba'i dus tshe chu cher mi phebs kyang de dus babs te dpon slob thams cad kyi bzhes rgyu byung ba ni byin rlabs dang sku tshe'i rten 'brel lo/ / dzode nas zha lur shar rgyag phebs/ de dus khyab (24na)bdag zha lu ba chen po 'khrungs par rgyal gdon gyis snyun 'dre byung ba la zhag bdun thog tu rje nyid gdan drangs te rte mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs dang dbu skra bubs kyi mgul srung gnang bar brten sku khams shin tu bde bas/ de skabs bar —466

khyab bdag dbang phyug rag brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)chad kyis mi tshugs pa dam pa 'di nyid kyi bka' drin yin zhes yang yang gsung zhing sku na tshod phra mo de nyid nas brtse ba chen pos 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par sprul pa 'di nyid kun mkhyen bu dang kha'u pa'i bstan 'dzin chen po zhig 'ong ba dgongs par gor ma chag /dgung lo bcu tsam nas bzung ri phug tu bzhugs skabs yang yang mjal ba'i gsung chos kyang ched du gsan pa dang zhan chos sogs kha shas gsan/hor zla bdun pa'i nang du rin po che rta ra ba 'dar rdzong du bzhugs pa dang mjal/ rdo rje nag po zhal bzhi pa'i gsang ba'i nyams khrid shin tu zab pa'i skor rnams smin rgyas su gsan cing dgyes pa'i gsung gleng mang du stsal/ chu yos kyi lo 'jam dpal dbyangs byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyi bzhugs khri ri phug gi gdan sa gnang ba'i mchog dman mang por chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing sku mtshams dam po'i ngang nas spros bcas spros med kyi rnal 'byor la gzhol shing pho 'brug gi lo 'od gsal la lung pa 'di yin zhes ngos bzung du med pa'i ri sul zhig nas rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po legs ldan rdo rje phebs pa yin zer ba'i rta pa mang bo byung ba'i rjes su bla ma rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel yang phyag na tshe ril mang po bsnams pa nas 'ga' zhig gnang ba ni de skabs rin chen dgon gsar (24ba tha mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshogs dpon du gshegs pa'i dag ba ye shes kyi sku rjes su 'dzin ba dang sku tshe'i lhag ma gnang ba'i ltas su snang /bla ma rin po che'i dgung zhag ma grol gyi bar du bshes gnyen dam pa 'jam dpal dbyangs dang dbyer mi phyed bar bcom ldan 'das 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye nas sgrub mchod rgyas par gnang ngo / /drang srong bsam gtan la gzhol srin po rir/ /rab 'byor zla ba'i phyag rjes bzo rig tshad/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i sku brnyan bar snang la/ /bde chen gar bsgyur waṃ yig gzigs pa'i mod/ /stong nyid snying rje'i nyams ldan e yi gzugs/ /mkha' spyod dbang mo'i mdzes sku sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /mthu stobs—467

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kye'ajigs med dpa' bo'i chos kyi grwar/ /'dren byed cher dngar thabs shes zung 'jug brda/ / da smir pa'i paṇa chen sdom pa'i rgyun/ /gaṅgā'i 'byung gnas ma dros chos lung der/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i lha sngags ye shes kyi/ /byin rlabs gzi byin nyi ma'i dngos brgya 'bar/ /lnga rig grub dbang gha ya dha ra'i zhabs/ /ngur smig gar gyis rol ba tshar pa rjes/ /gsung ngag smin grol gnang phyir ye shes sku/ /mngon sum bstan pa'i skal bzang khyod nyid tsam/ /tshad med lha mo rnam bzhi'i bkra shis glus/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ched 'dus sde 'dir/ /spyon zhes bskul ba'i sngon 'gror bstan srung tshogs/ /rgya gar dzo gi'i zol gyis lhags pa snyam/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor zla ba'i ma ma gang / /nyes brgya chu srin tshad du yongs gzigs pa'i/ /nges par 'byung yang gzhan phan bya dka' bar/ /mi zhum khyod (25na〉skun byang sems spyi yi srol/ /sdig sems gshed mar shar ba ha la nag /srog gcod 'bar ba'i las kyi ral gri che/ /bstan srung phyag rgyar gtod pa'i drin can rje/ /byams pas bdud sde yongs 'joms don kun grub/ /bsod nams cha bsags chos kyi dkyil 'khor nya/ /yongs 'phel gang ba'i zhal lung ga bur rdul/ /rdzogs par btungs pa'i blo gros kun mu da/ /mtha' klas lung rtogs ze'u 'bru ci yang bzhad/ /yid 'phrog lta na sdug pa'i ljongs kyi mthil/ /pha rgod bla ma'i khri la zhabs pad zung / /bkod nas rnam gsum 'khor lo'i mdzad pa yis/ /thub bstan gsal ba'i nyi ma gnyis pa shar/ /ye shes rwa chen gdengs pa'i rnon po'i rtsis/ /ma rungs 'byung po'i lto ba rab phug tshe/ /skye rgu'i bde skyid 'phrog pa'i lus med dpung / /mya ngan khang bur smre sngags cho nge 'don/ /gar dbang tshe mtha' yas pa'i mgon po dang / /dbyer med bslab gsum ngur smig 'chang ba'i rje/ /mchod sprin spel ba'i legs byas gzugs can du/ /gyur na 'jig rten khams 'di snod du chungs/ /rgyu rlon bsad khrag dren mos ma tshim par /mchong bar rings la rngam pa'i pho nya'i tshogs/ /dmar chen zor las chad pa'i me dpung dang / /lhan cig dus mtha'i rlung ltar 'tshub cing song / /'khrul pa'i rang mtshang zhig nas da lta'i bar/ /rjes brtses dngos grub char 'bebs ngal gsos bu/ /dmar ser snang brnyan bskrun pas rmugs 'dzin gyi/ /—468

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)mkho dgu'i 'byor ba 'dren pa'i shing rta'i skrun/ /thos bsam sgom pa'i cod pan rab bcings te/ /'jam dbyangs byang (25ba gling chos rje'i rgyal srid bzung / /bka' drin mtshungs med rje btsun dgon gsar ba'i/ /ye shes dag pa'i rang zhal mngon sum bstan/ /shing sbrul lo dbyar gyi nam zla shin tu gnyan pa'i dus ming lam du 'a zha gsang bdag nam mkha' rdo rje ral gu dang sku gzan smug po bzhes pa phyag g.yon par raka 'phreng sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i stang stabs kyi lho nub kyi phyogs bsrung ba zhig byung 'dug pa/ bka' las/ 'di yang nged rang gi dogasapa yod pa'i phyogs kyi bar chad dang / ser ba 'chor ba'i nyen kham can yod 'dug pa bsrung ba mdzad pa 'dra zhes pa 'khor rnams la stsol/ skabs shig mnal lam du ā tsarla mdog sngo bsang nge ba zhig dang lhan cig par rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras ser chen gyi sku shing la bris pa lta bu'i snum bag can gsal bar gzigs gsung ba don du rgyal chen 'di nyid shin tu 'go bas zhal gzigs par mngon/bkra shis rtse mchod yon nas gdan 'dren byung ba ltar yar klungs su phebs te phyogs de'i skye rgu rnams bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas gang la gang 'tsham gyis re ba bkang /bu ston rin po che'i rnam thar snyim pa'i me tog las/ nga chos bshad pa'i slob dpon yin mod byas na dam tshig la nor la ma 'cham pa'i bar mi bzhin spo bgos gtong / rang gi blo dang mi mthun na bla ma yin yang khyi spyon 'ded pa'i dmag mi ltar rdo char byed/ ces pa'i don thog tu babs te zha lu ba rtsing por spyod pa 'ga'i kha dbang du song nas skor yang tsam yang med par bla ma dga' bzhi pa brgyud gzhis ka rtser zhus pa'i dpon chen rgyal mtshan bzang po ri phug dbu mdzad du btsan bskos gnang ba'i ma mdzes (26na〉lo byung ba ni/ bu ston rin po ches dge 'dun spyi'i snyan bskul zhal gdams las/ da dus snyigs sems can thams cad spyod pa 'gyur ba'i dus 'dir nga 'di 'dra la thug /nam yang med khe nyen bsres zer nas drag po'i spyod pa byed pa yod de/ de 'dra 'o skol gyis cha rkyen dpung gleng mchu gang gis kyang mi 'pher bas sems chung byas nas mgo la lag pa 'gebs pa'i mdun ma la —469

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)brten pa dang / gra pa gra g.yog la sogs pa rnams la so so nas zhal ta bcug nas 'thab rtsod kha smras kha mchu mi yong ba'i thabs la sbyar dgos mi ngan re re'i ring la mang po 'phung la gtong ba blo rin lta bu yong ba yin/ zhes bka' stsal ba gang zag 'di 'dra'i rigs la dgongs par snang / nub cig mnal lam du mgon khang na gos 'bol mtho ba zhig gi steng rdo rje 'chang rta ra ba'i sku'i dbyibs dang na bza' sngar ji lta ba la ra ka'i 'phreng ba bzung ba'i phyag gnyis dbu'i steng du bzhag ste/ lho nub rnga yab gling phran nas/ /o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /mos pa'i bu la byin gyis sgro bres/ /zhes gsungs nas byin rlabs mdzad byung ba'i de ma thag o rgyan rin po che dngos yin dgongs pa'i sku lus thams cad zi chom me ba zhig byung bar snang /de'i rjes bla brang gi yang steng du lcog bu phub ste bzhugs pa'i tho rengs kyi dus shig mdun gyi nam mkhar o rgyan chos kyi rgyal po na bza' dang dbu zhwa sogs za hor ma'i cha byad can 'od lnga'i gur khyim na bzhugs pa shin tu gsal bar gzigs pa sku tshe 'di la o rgyan rin po che'i zhal gzigs byung ba'i thog ma yin gsung / sa dmar dgon pa ba rje btsun ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal (26ba)po la mnyam med bsam gtan gling pa'i yang zab a ti'i skor rdzogs par gsan cing rjes su bzhi thog tu bdag chen khri rin po cher 'bul ba gnang bas zab chos 'di nyid srid mthar mi nyams pa'i bstan pa'i srog tu song / de'ang thang yig tu/ khyad par yar klungs shel gyi brag phug 'di bdud rtsi sman sgrub byas pa'i gnas yin pas gsang sngags mthar phyin nyes rgyan yul lta bu: ya mtshan sgrub khang brag phug khyad 'phags yod zhi khro la sogs gzhal yas khang mang bzhugs bod 'bangs dag dang spro bar 'gyur ba'i brag yon tan brgya ldan bsam las 'das par brjod: de la gnas tshad tu rus sa mi phebs: zhes o rgyan chen pos bod kyi gnas chen gangs brag thams cad byin gyis brlabs te sgrub gnas ches mang ba'i nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa yon tan gyi dben gnas yar klungs shel gyi brag phug tu dgung lo zhe brgyad pa me rta hor zla brgyad pa'i mjug la thegs pa'i sta gon gyi tshe gzims —47()

khyab bdag dbang phyug rang brtan gyi rnam thar/ rtanakhang gi thog tu lcog bu byas bzhugs pa'i dus byung ba'i gong gi gzigs snang de las che ba'i o rgyan rin po che za hor ma'i sku 'ja' 'od kyi klong na khra lam mer bzhugs pa zhig shin tu gsal bar 'od gsal la shar zhing gnam gang gi tho rengs o rgyan chen po gong ltar gzigs pa las 'phros pa'i bcom ldan 'das snyor lo sdom pa in+d+ra ni la'i mdog ltar gsal la 'tsher ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i snang ba 'byams klas pa mang bar gzigs/hor zla dgu pa'i tshes gnyis la dpon slob dam tshig gtsang ba kha shas dang bcas thegs pa'i dus nam mkha' 'jam zhing thugs la sngar med pa'i bde nyams chen po dga' 27na〉la le ba'i ngang nas gzims khang gong du bzhugs gnas mdzad de sku mtshams bsdams/sprul sku rat+na gling pa'i gdung brgyud chu mig dgon gsar ba'i lag gi gter chen chos kyi rgyal po rat+na gling pa'i gter byon o rgyan yab yum gyi sku tshab mthong ba don ldan dang 'gro ba kun 'dul/rdo rje lang nyid kyi phyag gi sku tshab yid bzhin nor bu gsum rigs 'dzin bla ma sgrub pa'i rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs su gsol ba'i spyan sngar sman raka gtor gsum gyis thog drangs phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya chen bshams te zhag bdun gyi bar paṇa chen rin po che pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal mched gnyis kyi zab gter bla ma bka' 'dus kyi ljags bsnyen kha gso gnang ba'i tshes bzhi'i tho rengs sku'i mdun thad kyi mkhar 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim sor lnga pa zhig gi dbus su o rgyan chen po'i sku chung ngu gsal zhing dwangasapa lam me ba gzigs/tshes dgu'i nub gter srung dang gzhis bdag sogs dgyes pa'i 'tshub lhongs shin tu che/sku mtshams grol kha'i tshes bcu'i nyin lha brag gter byon nang rigs 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi 'phrin las la brten nas zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshogs rnams mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung pos mnyes par mdzad pas 'dzab bzlas gyi dus gnas 'dzin kun gyis mthong bar me tog gi char chen po bu yug ltar 'tshis/sgrub phug nas tshe chu glo bur du rdoX ba chu bo'i rgyun bzhin re zhig bar babs shing de

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'ayod rnams kyi zhal du gsol ba sogs gnas ston 'khor chos dus te phun tshogs pa lnga tshang ba'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar mchog tu 'grig /chos sder phebs nas ho me (27ba)zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i thor thun grol 'tshams mnal la cung zad song ba'i tshe slob dpon chen po'i sku'i snang ba chu las chu lhar shar ba ltar snga ma 'gags pa dang phyi ma gsal ba kha yar byung / khra 'brug gi gnas mjal la byon te smon lam rgyas par 'debs pa gnang ba'i nub rmang lam gyi tshul du bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje sku'i snang brnyan khra lam gyis shar zhing shel brag gi ri ngos mtha' dag sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i skus khyab pa dang mngon sum du bzhugs yod dgongs pa'i gdung shugs lhang lhang ba'i ngang nas mnal sad/me lug hor zla dgu pa'i nyer bzhi la chos sde nas sang thegs rgyu'i nub 'od gsal la rje nyid slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i sku'i dbyibs can dbus dang phyogs bzhir re re ste lnga rnams che chung mi tshad tsam so sor bkrag mdangs dang ldan pa'i 'ja' tshon lnga'i gur khyim yod pa'i rnam pa ni thugs rig pa'i ngo bo don gyi pad+ma 'byung gnas gcig nyid las thod 'phreng rigs lngar shar ba ye shes lnga'i gdangs 'gag med du 'khums/nyer lnga tshes bcu'i mchod pa shel brag tu gnang nas zhag gsum gyi bar bzhugs ring rigs 'dzin bla ma'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi 'phro 'du'i dmigs pa rtsol ba la ma bltos par 'bad med du ngang gis shar ba thengs gnyis dang gnas kyi ri brag kun dang khyad par gu ru phug pa'i brag gdong thams cad o rgyan zhi khro sogs mdor na sras bcas rgyal ba'i sku'i snang ba 'ba' zhig tu shar ba gang zag khyad par can rnams la dus thams cad du dag pa'i snang ba sha stag 'byung bas 'di tsam la ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa gcig tu mi 'os na'ang (28na)zhag gsum po der gnas kyi gang zag byin gyis brlabs so zhes dpag dka'i yon tan g.yin rnams sbas par mchis/ tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las/dgra gnyen bar ma'i 'gro ba kun/ /gdod nas dag pa'i he ru gaḥ lha dang lha mo'i rnam rol tu/ /dga' mgur spyod pa bla ma'i drin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don du gda'/ chos sder phebs nas rdo rje 'jigs byed 472

khyab bdag dbang phyug ra po brtan gyi rnam thar/ rtanachen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhengs te rten brten pa'i tsho gos de'i thad kyi nam mkha' gang bar 'gro 'ong dang tho rengs kyi char rang gi sku 'ja' 'od phung nge ba'i dkyil na yod pa'i thugs nyams shar/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes brgyad kyi thor thun dngos gzhi rdzogs nas pad+ma drag po dbu dgu'i rnal 'byor gyi tshe dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rje nyid gtso bo'i rnam par shar bar reg mthong gi mas ma brtan po rnyed/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes la shri de ba a yu'i bsnyen mtshams mdzad pa grol rgyu'i tho rengs tshe lha'i sku'i snang ba gsal zhing tshes bco lnga'i tho rengs sngar bas kyang gsal ba zhig byung gsung ba sku tshe mthar phyin pa'i rten 'brel khyad par can du go/dgung skag phyis skyel gyi dog char dgongs hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bzhi nas sku'i bcad rgya tshugs pa'i tho rengs skur glags lta ba 'byung po'i cho 'phrul gyi 'od chen po 'khor zhing 'brug pa'i steng du rje btsun pad+ma thod 'phreng mi ṣ+ka tsam pa gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa zhig bzhugs 'dug bas ba mo la nyi ma shar ba bzhin de 'phral du zhi/zhag lnga tsam nas slar yang slob dpon chen po'i gzigs snang je gsal la song bas yid srubasakyi bar gcod las rnam par rgyal/tshes gas nyi shar gyi dus cung zang mnal 28ba tha'i nyams la rje nyid rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i rnam par lam gyis gyur pa ni rje btsun kun spangs chen pos/chos rje la mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs byas res kyis nged la ltas khyad par can re yong gi 'dug 'bad rtsol mdzad na 'dis mkha' spyod la khrid nyen gda'o//zhes tshar chen la gsungs pa'i lo rgyus dang tshul mtshudas par mngon/sde pa bkra shis rtse pa'i sras po na phra ba zhig gdon gyis zin nas dbugs kyi 'gyu ba 'gags te grongs par thag bcad pa na rje de nyid spyan drangs bka' bsgo'i byin rlabs mdzad pa dang lhan cig par gsos pas log rtog can 'dra'ang ha las te dad pa'i sar bkod/sa sprel zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum nas cho me sde'i gra pa don gnyer can rags bsdus la/tshar chen gyi gsung mgur du/mi phal cher so skye'i bla ma bsten//nga sangs rgyas dngos kyi bla ma bsten/khong dpe nag bltas pa'i slob mas khengs//nga snyan ༷/da zab mo'i gdams pas tshim//zhes so skye'i bla

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyem gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i tshig tsam bshar sbyang lta bu ma yin par gsung ngag rin po slob bshad kyi khrid dbu btsugs te nyan rang dang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam dang thun mong du gyur pa snang ba gsum sems bskyed kyi mtha' brten pa/ sngags lam la lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyis sems kyi gzhi rtsa bcad nas dbang bzhi'i lam gyi nyams khrid/ kye rdor yab bka'i rgyu lam yum bka'i dbang byin rlabs kyi rim pa rgyab brten lung dang bcas hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu'i bar la rdzogs par gnang ba'i tshe bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i si rtse ra'i byin rlabs la cung zad (29na kho ka' ba'i thugs dogs byung ba na rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i tshogs la gsol 'debs gnang ba'i sgo chung nag po zhig nas bdag chen rdo rje 'chang bla gos dang sa zhu gsol te rta nag por chibs pa phebs nas gser gyi rdo rjer g.yu'i phras brgyan pa maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du 'jog pa gnang byung bas mnal sad dus thugs dogs rnams lhag med du chod pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas yin zhing nub cig kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs na bza' shin tu bzang ba phyag sil bon gong ma dkrol ba gnang ba na sgra cher sgrog pa ni zab chos 'di nyid kyi 'phrin las phyogs brgyar khyab pa'i brdar mngon/ 'khrid kyi snga phyi tshor/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel dang lnga mnal lam gyi tshul du byung gsung ba don chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bla ma rnams dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal lhug par bstan nas legs so'i tshig gis dngos su gzings bstod par gor ma chag /ye shes kyi mgon po gzigs snang la gsal bar shar ba ni 'brog mir paṇa grub dbang po gha ya dha ras/ da khyod la ci dgos gsungs pa la gsung ngag rin po che 'di la da dung gdams pa'i 'phro 'dra yod na gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ nga 'phro ye med khyod la 'di 'dra dgos pa'i mtshan min yang nga rang gi byed lugs yin gsungs nas gur gyi thang sku rgyab la bzhes/ 'phreng ba mgul la bcug /gtor ma dbu thog tu bzung nas gdams pa'i lhag lus ri'i dbu snying gnang ba dang chos kyi mjug (29ba)tu mgon rkyang gi rjes gnang sogs mdzad —474

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ (tanapa'i bla ma shad ston yan chad kyi srung mar ma zad brtse chen snying po'i zhabs nas bzung bka' babs bzhi ldan du bzhugs pa'i chos skyong gi gtso bo yin gshis bgegs rigs kyi tsho gos rnams phye mar 'thag pa'i slad du sa zad tsam yang mi gol bar mngon/'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor lhur bzhes pa'i shugs kyis 'chi bdag ma he'i zhal can bka' bzhin sgrub par zhal gyis 'tshes slad sku'i snang ba mngon sum du bstan pa ni/rje tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las/dpal ma he'i zhal can gshin rje'i gshed//chos srung ba'i gtso bor gur zhal gnyis//de rim bzhin bsgrubs la bstan pa srungs//zhes pa'i don dang mas sa par snang zhing /wo gcig mnal rib be ma zhig la rje nyid slob dpon ོ po pad+ma'i sku'i rnam par nyams khyad par can shar ba 'dis mtshon bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma'i zhal gzigs dang gsung gi snang ba stsal ba mtha' yas pa yod tshod du mchis na'ang thugs dkyil che bas bsnyel ba'i brdzur brten no//sa bya hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu dgur gtsang la chibs kha bsgyur rgyu'i tho rengs gzhan gyis bsam sbyor pa'i byad rbod la brten/thog zhabrug 'byung bar nye ba'i glog ga so gos shin tu 'jigasapa'i sgra 'od gsal du byung ba'i tshe rje nyid badz+ra bhe ra ba'i sku shin tu che zhing gzi byin dang ldan pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i rnam par gyur ba dang chabs cig par mi mthun pa'i phyogasade dag 'phral du zhi ba'i mod la mnal sad do//gsang bdag 'a zha'i mthu stobs thor rlung gis//log tshon sbyor ba'i chu 'dzin thamathar bskrad//yang 30na jid mang por 'go ba'i lus ga po//gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi dpal rjes snyeg/lhun po phyer 'thag mthu chen dgon gsar bas/khyod rjes 'dzin par bskul tshig mchil pa yis 'bod grogs mgon po'i byin rlabs lcags kyi phye//'dren pa'i khab len rdo bar rkang ba 'jog/za hor saspyod gos kyis brjid ldan yang //sa smig dras drubs na bza' gcig tu bas//rig sngags brtulazhugs grub pa'i gsang gos can//pad 'byung // ma'i dgyes zhal zla ba tshes//a ti rdzogs wo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyeyongs kyi yang snying bcud/ /rje btsun ye shes rdo rjer dgongs pa'i gter/ /gsan tshe blo 'das chos sku'i rang zhal la/ /yengs pa'i kun rdzob bden pa bag la zha/ /bod 'bangs dga' spro'i dpal ster gnas kyi rtse/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud len sgrub pa'i zhing / khrel dkar brag ri rab brtsegs dpa' bo dang / /ma tshogs sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas der byon/ /bka' brgyad yongs 'dus rigs 'dzin bla ma yi/ /thugs rje snying zhugs rtags mtshan phyi ru shar/ /gang snang zhi khro rab 'byams rten brten pa/ /grub pa'i gzigs mo de la yun rings yengs/ khrag 'thung rnal 'byor ma dpal mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /dpyid thig bde chen gar gyis 'byams su klas/ /ma he'i zhal dang dbang drag dbu dgu pa/ /gtum rngams gad mos kun bzod ma 'di 'dar/ /thod phu'i grub pa'i 'khor sgyur sprin 'dzin gyi/ /thugs la nyer gab slob bshad rnam par rgyal/ /dug lnga'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig pus/ /shes ldan rnams kyi zug rngu ma lus phyungs/ /(30ba)rang bstan 'chad nyan yid bzhin rgyal mtshan rtser/ /bkod la yongs 'dzin tshogs kyis legs so byin/ /mi'u thung rdo rje srin po'i zhal sgo las/ /lugs 'di srid mthar mi nub g.yar dam bcas/ /rin cen 'byung gnas khod du na kra bzhin/ /mkhas grub bye ba'i bsti gnas zha lu nas/ /zhing dkyil pha bong lta bur bstan 'dzin 'ga'/ /dbyung ba'i ngan spyod de la mchi ma bku/ /'jam dpal ches cher khros pas 'byung po'i 'tshub/ /thal ba'i rdul du brlag la ya mtshan ci/ zhan tu zhi dul pad+mā ka ra'i skus/ /brlang spyod bdud sde ming gi lhag gyur mtshar/ /rim gyis rong brgyud khu lung du phebs nas zab bu lung du thegs pa'i sta gon gyi tshe sder ma tsam gyi rgya khyon gyi 'od lnga'i gur khang nang du o rgyan rin po che sku chu zheng gab pa zhig dang nub gsum gyi bar rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho phebs te dgyes pa'i tshul shin tu gsal ba nyams dang mnal lam ci rigs pa byung / 'o yug brgyud byon pa'i dus phyogs de'i yul lha gzhi bdag gter srung sogs dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis bsu ba la 'ongs pa'i nyams ltas ngo mtshar ba'i ngang nas gnas su phebs/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprugs kyi sku 'dra rang byon la mthong snang mang du byung gsung ba —476

khyab bdag dbang phyug rang brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)spyan ras gzigs mngone sum du gzigs shing / des sku mdog rigs lnga mtshon pa'i kha dog sna tshogasasu shar ba 'dra/ zhal ras lha khang du bla ma bka' 'dus kyi sgrub pa zhag bdun gnang ba'i nub dang po la paṇ+ḍita dmar smug paṇa zhwa can phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa zhig byung ba ni o rgyan bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i (31na skyogs dang thams cad mkhyen pa sku dngos lta bus shā sa na'i sngags 'ur 'don gyi ngang nas ra ka'i phyag 'phreng bzung ste sdigs mdzub kyi stang ka mdzad pa ni nyin phyi ma'i 'tshub de bzlog thabs la dgos par snang /zhag gnyis song ba'i tshe pha rol gyi bsam sbyor ༅ pa'i byad rbod la brten thog 'khyug 'byung bar nye ba'i gnam ngo shin tu 'jigs pa lha sngags ye shes kyi nus pas rim gyis je 'jam du song /bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gzigs snang yang shar/ gter lung bcu gsum sogs gnas rnams thams cad mjal ba dang bcas bzhugs zhag bco lnga song bar chu rlung gis mtshon pa'i sgra mtha' dag badz+ra gu ru'i 'dzab sgrar lhang lhang sgrog pa gsan zhing gzugs snang kun zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs su shar cing bde bar gshegs pa'i sku brnyan gyi zhal la me tog mang po shar ba sogs la spro ba dang / gzigs snang khyad par can gyi bla ma dang gnas la dad gdung phan tshun 'gran bzhin pa'i ngang nas mkhas grub chen po khyung po du gu ba'i dben gnas zhed zhed du phebs nas gnas rten rnams zhib par gzigs/ ye shes mgon po'i las mkhan gnod sbyin k+ṣe tra pā la sku'i dbyibs dang cha lugs yongs grags la phyag g.yas kyis thod pa'i cang te'u 'khrol ba'i sgra lhang lhang sgrog pa gsan pa 'di dpal shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bstan pa rang tshugs thub pa'i 'bur don ni rim gyis 'grib/ chos rgyun yang blos byas rang bzo'i 'chal 'chol dang bklag lung dam dum gyis gzhan snang 'drid pa'i (31brkos 'dir rje 'di nyid kyis bstan pa rma med du bzung ba la mnyes sam snyam/ ri phug tu byon te phyogs 'dus kyi don gnyer can du ma la ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung mkhas grub khyung po'i zab chos ba gu chos drug gi dbang byin rlabs 'khrid lung —477

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shesmin rgyas su gnang ba'i 'od gsal du kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs phebs nas dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dang legs so stsal/pad gling drag po dmar chen gyi rtsa bsnyen gnang ba'i sgang tsam la lhongs kyi rnam pas sku stod shin tu mnyel bar 'phrod bsten sogs kyi thugs blo tsab tsub gang yang ma mdzad par lta sgom gyi ngang nas bzlas brjod la 'grus par gnang bas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar gcod kyi tshogs rang sar dag ste sku khams shin tu bde/ drag po dmar chen zhal gsum phyag drug pa gtso 'khor gyi zhal gzigs kyang gsal bar byung / dpal gtor zho ltar zhu ba yo rgyan chos kyi rgyal pos dngos grub char bzhin 'bebasapa'i dge mtshan rnyed/ sku mtshams grol nas ngor zur chad bla ma mnga' ris par tshe dbang gnang ba'i dbang sgrub kyi skabs tshe chang khol te phyir lud pa'i byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma che/hor zla dgu pa'i nang du ljags bsnyen kha gso bdun gcig gi dus tshes bcu'i tho rengs rmang lam du dpal kye rdo rje zhal brgyad pa'i sku mi tshad tsam dang drin chen o rgyan chen po gsal bar gzigs pa'i ngang la mnal sad/ khu lung nas dbon rin po che bsod nams rab brtan mjal bar phebs te zhag shas sku zhabs su bzhugs shing thugs dgyes pa chen pos tshe dbang rkyen sel sogs gnang nas phyir thegs/ 'dar chos 'khor yang rtser gser gdung rin (32na)po che mjal bar phebs pa'i dbang 'khrid lung man ngag rgya cher gnang zhing rnam rgyal stag rtser sde pa yum sras la 'dod chos mang du stsal/nub cig 'od gsal la tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po zhal khyim dang na bza' ji lta ba gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i zhabs gnyis rje nyid kyi dbu gtsug tu bzhag cing phyag gnyis kyis zhal 'gram skyor nas bka' bsgo rgyas pa zhig gnang bar thugs gdung shugs mos gus drag pos gsol 'debs mdzad pa'i mus nas tshar chen rin po che 'di o rgyan rin po che dang dngos su mjal ba'i byin rlabs nus mthu khyad par du 'phags pa yin snyam par tshang chen o rgyan rin po cher lam gyis song ba'i thugs ga'i thad du thugs yid rtse gcig tu bstad de rnam pa o rgyan las ngo bo rin po che tshar pa rang yin snyam pa'i ngang nas mnal —478

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)sad dus kyang zhabs dbu gtsug tu bzhag pa'i drod de ga tsha chil le bar dngos su byung zhing thugasasems bde 'bol le bar gyur/ yang mnal lam zhig la sngags 'chang chen po bsod nams chosa'aphel dang rje nyid kyi thugs ka sbyar ba lta bus bka' bsgos shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i ngang sad pa'i thugs bde ba'i tshad cig byung /de nas mi ring bar tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi yab gzhis rmu gshong dge ba'i tshal gyi mgon khang du tshar chen gyi phyag nas ma'i gnod sbyin beg tse'i sku mjal/ snyan dar dmod nas gtor bsngo 'phrin bcol rgyas par gnang ste phyir phebs gdong gdung mtshams la spyan gzigs kyi mda' dar mang po yod pa'i khrod nas dar skud dmar po 'dom bcu tsam zhig phyi skas 'go'i bar brkyang ba'i gdan 'dren tshul mdzad (32ba)pa ni chos skyong 'di nyid la mnga' brnyes pas pad mtshor ngang pa ltar dam can rang bzhin gyis 'du bar bsam/ de nas mnyan yod bya rgod gzhong du 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis spyan drangs snyan brgyud kyi chos du ma stsal/ 'od gsal du rdza thog 'og gi shod la 'gro rtsis byas par skor lam du ban+de chas bzang snum bag dang ldan pas phyag bgyis byung ba'i ngag nas dngul chu na blo gsal rgya mtsho'i gter yod do zer bzhin pa'i ngang rjes 'brangs te jo bo'i sku mdun gyi thad du nga'i ming la gnod sbyin rdo rjer grags zhes 'dzum 'dzum ngo shes gang yang zhu ba zhig rmis gsung ba rje byams phrug par snyan brgyud kyi chos skor rnams gnang dgos pa dang rgyal chen rnam thos sras dgyesapa'i mtshan ma yin nam snyam/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen la snga phyir snyan brgyud kyi chosabaka' gnang ba'i chos skyong che chung gi skor mdzad skabs man ngag shin tu zab pa rnams mi gnang ba'i rtsis kyis zur du brtan nas bla bre'i steng du 'jog pa gnang ba thag pa chad nas phyag dpe rnams byamasaphrug pa'i sku pang du babs pa ni chos skyong gis chos dngos su gtad pa lta bu'i dpon slob gnyis ka'i che bar mngon/bo dong du thegs pa'i dpal ldan dmag zor mar bkang gso mchod bstod rgyas par mdzad/—479

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyegazims dpon pad+ma'i khang g.yabs su bzhugs pa'i nub dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sku gsal ba/ sa skya pa chen po'i sku las 'od sngon po 'phro ba'i nang du dgyes mdzad rdo rje lha dgu'i rten brten pa gsal bar gzigs/ 'di skabs yum bsnyung yun ring ba'i dbang bskur byin (33na)rlabs/ sman dpyad/ sku rim gang rgyas mdzad kyang sku tshes ma zin par dgongs rdzogs rgya cher gnang zhing bdun tshigs shig la thugs rje chen po'i dbang rgyas par mdzad pa'i nub mnal lam du sku gdung steng gi nam mkhar thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi sku dbyibs sngar ji ltar la paṇa zhwa bzhes pa zhig gsal bar byung ba rjes su 'dzin pa'i brda yin nam snyam/ zhugs 'bul grub nas zhag kha shas song ba na kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse khyel bzhugs mdzad nas 'khas pus g.yas pa'i steng na maṇ+ḍal bsnams te 'bul tshul gyi/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/nas/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog /ces gsung ba'i sku'i 'khris na yum de zhal khyim dmar cham me ba la dbu skra sil bu sku rked yan chad khebs pa'i mthar de 'dra ba ngo mi shes pa 'dra dang bcas rje nyid la skor ba byed pa drin lan yin rgyu bar byung ba yum ku lu ta'i zhing du mkha' 'gror gyur ba'i ltas su mkhyen/ 'di dus bkra shis rtse'i sde pa chos rje grongs pa'i yar 'dren la phebs dgos tshul gyi gdan 'dren byung bar yum sku khams bde zhan gyi dbye ba ma phyed par dgongs khrol dgos tshul gnang bar sde pas gal srid mi phebs pa 'dug na o rgyan mtsho mo lta bu gzhan zhig gdan drongs zhes mngags tshod nas bsam sdings sprul sku byon pa mchod yon 'brel zab kyis grub mtha' 'gyur ba'i 'go tshugs/ lcags khyi lo dbon rin po che bsod nams rab brtan zha phur dge tshul sgrub par phebs pa'i snga nub lha chen rtsis kyi mgon po'i las mkhan srog gi bdag po gos dkar gyi tse ber dang de steng du khrab gsol (33ba)ba lag na dri ngad bzang po'i spos kyi chun po dar skud kyis bsdams pa spos skor byed pa'i tshul gyis 'ongs pa rjes su gsung bgros kyi lhongs la rmi ltas de bzhin byung ba la dpags na khyed tshul khrims 'go thon pa'i btsun pa rnam dag zhig 'ong ba'i ltas su 'dug stsal/—480

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i tshe rab tu byung ba'i mtshan mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol ba gnang ste tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi bar bsgrubs nas shākya'i sras su mdzad/nyer mkho'i dbang lung thor bu stsal/khu dbon lhan cig par gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya mjal bar skor tsam phebs/ri phug tu stan chags/bkra shis rtse nas sde dgon tshang mas phebs dgos tshul gyi spyan 'dren yang yang byung bar brten dbon rin po che zhabs phyir khrid de yar klungs phyogs su phebs/lo 'phros kyi ring 'chad nyan byin rlabs sogs skya ser so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i re ba bkang ngo //tshar chen bla mas 'bral med rjes su bzung //zab lung gter srung gzhi bdag bsu bar 'ongs//bka' 'dus bsgrubs tshe gu rus dngos byin brlabs//'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i nus pas bgegasadapung bzlog/gzugs rnams lha dang sgrar grags sngags kyi gdangs//bzang ngan gang shar bde stong chos sku'i dbyings//snang brnyan bzhin ras la chags chu skyes kyi//'dab ma'i mig zur 'dzum pasargod do snyam//glags lta dam sri'i gzugs phung 'dam lta bu/khrag 'thung pad+ma'i stang stabs 'grosakyis brdzis//tshe chu khol ba'i gzigs ma phyogs brgyar 'phro/dbyer 34na thad rtsa gsum ma 'dresaso sor gzigs//pha rgod bla ma'i gdan sar chos 'khor bskor//se dkar sa spyod gtsug gis zhabasapa dab teg/tshar chen yab sras sku yi dag snang du//byin rlabs ma wa zhe sum bde drod ches cher 'bar blo 'das gdod ma'i mgon po tshar pa rje//blo gsal rgya mtsho'i ded dpon zhabrungs gnas der//blo stobasanus pa'i dbang phyug gnod sbyin ches//blo chen gtsug rgyan khyod la 'dud phyir 'brangs//mnyan yod bya gzhongs lung bstan ngo mtshar rnyed//lha mchog 'dod khams dbang mo dgyes zhal 'dzum//brtse chen thugs rje'i dwangs mtshor kye rdo rje//'jam dpal dus dgra'i snang bas ci yang shar//mkha' mnyam 'gro kun mar shes kyis drangs pa'i//byang chub sems chus thugs rgyud rab gsher yang //yum la mched brtson sri zhus yid can 'gro//mi gtoX dam bcar nges rnyed 'dren pa bzhin//ye re

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kye'aphrul lus phra mi mo'i gzugs/ /bsgyur ba g.yin ngor bla mas lam ston gyi/ /zol las ku lu ta zhing mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /tshogs kyi slob dpon mdzad la rings sam snyam/ /rang gzhan phyogs su lhungs pa'i kun rtog rnams/ /rang sems 'khor 'das dbyer med klong grol yang / /rang lugs bstan pa'i srog rtsa rab 'dzin pa'i/ /rang rigs shākya'i sras su legs par bskrun/ /chu byi shar nas dbus gtsang gi sde dpon phal cher mdun ma gcig tu dril te gtsang skur gnyis kyi thog tu ngan gra bsgrigs par grags shing la la gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis rtse chen grang chen par de 'dra rtsoms (34bskog par ngan bslab mdzad pa'i 'phung bshig sbyor ngan yin 'dra zer ba gang ltar na'ang sne'u sdong rtse nas dbu mdzad lha bya yar rgyab 'phyong rgyas 'bog mdong sogs sde dpon rags bsdus thugs rtse gcig pa'i bde gzar langs par bkra shis rtse pa dpon g.yog yar stod kyi dmag phyi 'brangs zin rjes sde pa dngos grub rdo rje glo bur du nga dge slong rgan po lcags kyi chos gos gyon pa yin zhes rdzong nas chas te mar lam chos sder byon pa rdo rje 'chang gis sku na dang sku rten gang sa nas 'byon pa mi 'gab gal te phebs na gsol go ma mchod gsungs par dngos lan med pa'i rdo rje phag mo mkhyen zhes g.yas chung gi rnam pa mdzad/dmag rta bzang shos rnams song zin pa'i gsar ma shin tu rgan pa zhig la rta go sprad sde pa rang gsol go bzabs sprod dang bcas chos sde'i 'gag tu rta la chibs pa dang lhan du bla ma lkugs pa dmag la 'gro bar go cha ma gyon zhes chig lab dang bcas byon par smon mkhar ri zur du g.yul bub skabs go cha med na bros pas thar rgyur rtas go cha ma theg pa'i yur por 'gyel thog rgya ri ba'i dmag gis ded nas dbu shor ba ni bar bar grub mtha' bo dong bar 'gyur nas 'phyos mdar dgon pa btab pa sogs la brten rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi spyi lung gsang ba'i gal mdo las/ glang ri'i mdun ngos gdug pa'i ri gsum la: thugs lha rigs gsum bzheng zhing mnan gzir 'bad chos kyi gra 'byung dam tshig ma gtsang na: pho bdud thugs 'khrugs nyer gcig gri ru 'chi: zhes bkra shis —482

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)chos sde'i rgyab ri la sbal sdig sogs srog chags ma rungs pa'i dbyibs can gyi (35na〉nge sbog gsum yod 'dug pa dang pho bdud kyi gtso bo legs ldan gur gyi mgon po yin pas mgon po'i bka' chad byung bar gleng / gtsang dpung yang g.yas ru byang phyogs kyi bde gzar rtsa ba ma chod pasa'agor gzhi che zhing drung pa rgyal tshab pas bshol ba ma gtogs yar stod sde pa khri pas lhun po sgang bskyur nas dwags por 'bros rtsis mdzad pa sogs sku rab pa phyogs gtogs dmigs pa med pa'i dbyings su rgyas 'debs par nye ba'i grul drag po'i skabs sde pa ma chan grongs pa tsam las bkra shis rtse'i sde dgon byings la 'pho 'gyur sogs nyes skyon cher mi 'byung ba dam pa 'di'i gzi byin dang thugs rje kho na'o/ /lo snga rting tshor 'brum nag mched drags pa'i khyab bdag sman lung pa blo mchog rdo rje sku 'brum ma thar bar rje 'di nyid kyis srung ba dang byin rlabs gnang zhing o lo rang skyon mi yongs zhes zhal rtsis bzhes/ de rjes tsher ma can gyi nad kha yar byung ba yang thugs 'dzem cher ma thub cing / lhag par me byi lo shel brag tu 'brum yol mdzad dus sne'u sdong rtse nas lo gsar 'phros gtam la 'phral du gdan 'dren gyi sku dbang bed spyod lta bu byung skabs phebs lam du thor bas shi ba'i phung po dang 'dzom pas thugs ya nga ba byung bar phyis su kho bo tsher ma can gyi nad ma 'gos pa'i ngang du song ba bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i bka' drin yin yang yang gsung / chos kyi rgyal po dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi thugs sras rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po zhes sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi sprul ba'i zlos gar de nyid rgyal khams phyogs med kyi gdul bya'i re ba (35ba〉skong ba'i bar khamasastod smad dang rgya yul phyogs su chibs kyi kha lo bskyod pa'i phebs zhor du bkra shis chos sder spyan drangs pa dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur/ drag po dbu dgu ye shes 'od mchog gi dbang lung sogs zab chos kha yar 'bul ba gnang zhing tshur yang chos kyi 'brel pa ci rigs gsan/chu glang bkra shis rtse'i rdzong du bzhugs skabs rje nyid rdo rje nag po gur gyi mgon po'i sku shin —483

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ losetu che ba gzi byin can du gyur pa bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i mtshan mar mngon/ bkra shis chos ster bzhugs skabs shig zhabs drung nam mkha' sngar gyi sku'i cha lugs ji lta ba/ ye shes ḍā ki ne gu ma smug nag /su kha sid+dhi g.yu'i mdog can/ khro bo stobs po che rnams kyi sku'i rnam 'gyur gsal bar bstan te byin gyis brlabs shing bar chad bsrung ba/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug /mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ pha rgod sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel bzhi sku gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa dgyes pa'i zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas te mnal lam du byung tshul gyi bsnyel tho zur tsam 'dug pa nges don la mngon sum du lha dang bla ma 'di dag gzigs shing chos bshad lung bstan dbugs dbyung sogs rgya che ba zhig yod 'dra yang rgyu mtshan zhib tu ma rtogs pas rang bzo'i rdzun tshig gi mdzes rgyan 'bri bar ma spobs/shing stag lor lha brag gter byon gyi lcags dong ma'i tshe sgrub zhag nyer gcig gnang ba'i dus 'od gsal du tshe dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs gzhung nas bshad pa ji lta ba'i rnam par gyur pa lan gnyis kyi bar du byung ba ni gar (36na)dbang 'chi med grub pas lcags kyi srog pa rtsa'i dngos grub stsal nas byin gyis brlabs par gdon mi za/ chos sde'i mgon khang gi gtor 'khris na gnod sbyin chen po beg tse pho rkyang gi rnam par mda' gang tsam pa'i sku tshad gtum rngam brjid bag dang ldan pa shin tu gsal ba gzigs pa ni sa lugs byings la chos skyong 'di nyid grags chung yang bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba thugs gtsigs che zhing mgon po zhal gyi las mkhan dmar nag gnyis kyi dmar po yin pas rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje nas bzung lugs 'di'i chos srung gi gtso bo zhig tu mdzad gshis dpon slob sde dang bcas pa mtha' dag g.yel med du bsrung bar dmar zlum gyi spyan nyi zla ltar 'khyil ba'i brdar mngon/ lo sngun ma'i bde gzar rgyun rings par brten bsgrigs kun spyod rnams bag yangs pa gra pa la shes 'chal ba'i skyon byung ba bslab pa bskyar zhing dge 'dun gyi khrims su bca' ba legs par bsdams pa'i nub mnal lam du nang mdo sbug byas pa'i spro sa der tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po bzhugs —484

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)pa'i sku mdun du shing gzheng chen po rtsam pa'i phung pos gang ba zhig bzhag 'dug pa'i drung du byon pa na rdo ring rin po che'i don yin nam gsung ba mnal sad nas thugs bsam gnang tshe bdag 'di phyogasasu sdod 'dod med kyang chos sde 'di'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gang nus su bgyis pa dang nye lam dge 'dun rnams khrims la bkod pa sogs don du gnyer ba 'di bla ma yab sras kyi bstan pa kha'u pa'i thugs su grags pa 'di la bsams pa yin pas gsung de'ang don de'i thog tu 'bebs bar 'dug snyam pa dga' spro dang mos gus tshad (36ba thad pa byung tshul mchis/dbus gtsang sa khad 'gyangs pa dang sku na smin pa nas phebs 'grul rtag po ma thub par brten dmar ser zhes pa me sbrul hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i dus dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin du dam pa tog dkar pos rang gi cod pan ma pham pa'i dbur bcings te rgyal tshab tu bskos pa ltar chos dang rigs kyi rgyal ba'i sras dbon rin po che mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan rje rdo rje 'chang rang gi chos kyi khrir mnga' gsol nas yon mchod skya ser mtha' dag gis legs 'bul dang bcas phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston rgya cher mdzad de rje bla ma gtsang phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i ri phug tu phebs/ dbyar khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos thog drangs pa'i kha shas la bde chen ral gcig gi rdzogs rim sems nyid ngal gso'i 'khrid sogs chos bka' kha yar/ de rjes glang phu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug gis gsol ba btab pa la brten nas zha lu pa chen po sogs chabs cig par gur gyi srung 'khor brag rdzong ma phyi nang gsang gsum gyi 'khrid/ rnam sras kyi rjes gnang skor/ lung kha shas gnang / de mus ngor nas mkhan chen sgrub khang pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub phebs par gdugs dkar zhe gnyis ma'i dbang / gur mgon gsang 'khrid sogs stsal/ ston sdeb glang bu nas kyis gzhis skar spyan drangs te byang gter thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi sgo nas mdong ston chos skyong bsod nams kyi phyag bzhes bzhin skye bdun ril bu'i sgrub pa mdzad pas dril bu dbu tsam 'phel/ zhal ngo tshor brag rdzong (37na)phyi nang —485

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6gegasang gsum gyi 'khrid/ phyag chen lhan skyes/ bla ma rin po che skal bzang par gsan pa ngo sprod rgyas pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen
