brtse'i dbang phyug gi rnam thar mgur 'bum sogs dbang lung mang du stsal/dus der khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos tshe rabs thams cad du rjes su 'dzin dgos tshul zhu ba gnang bar gsol 'debs dang bcas pa'i bka' bzhes gnang / shangs brgya tsho bas gdan drangs dpyal phur gyi dbang sogs gsung chos rgya cher stsal/sa rta lo ri phug tu phebs nas sku mtshams dang grol ba'i skabs mkhan chen sgrub khang pa dang khyab bdag zha lu ba sogs kha shas la dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dbang / gur gyi rjes gnang mang dag dang be'u bum rnams kyi lung rags rim/ mkhan chen zha lu par rā lugs 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma/'od zer dri med/ gtsug tor dri med/ phyag rdor 'gro bzang sogs dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang lung sogs mang du gnang / de skabs rje zha lu pas bdag zhakhrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi dus phyag phyir e yod zhus pas yod gsung / rgyal yum gyi dus yod dam zhus pas med phebs/ mkhan chen zha lu pas rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i ljags bsnyen zla gcig gnang skabs zhal 'don gnang rgyu'i sku bstod gsol 'debs shig dgos zhes zhu ba gnang ba'i bka' rtsom gyi kha byang du ri phug dbu mdzad chen mo'i thugs dam zhes pa'i phyag bris stsal ba/ de dus btsun chung de la ri phug gi bla ma yong bsam pa rang gzhan su la yang med mod/ thugs mngon par mkhyen pa mchis zhes yang yang gsung / sa lug brag (37ba)rdzong ma'i bsnyen mtshams zla ba bdun gyi bar mdzad pa thengs nas/ rje rdo rje 'chang ston rgyab lcags stod du dbang bzhi grol nas zha lur phebs 'phral do nub tshogs 'khor gyis gsung /zhugs me btang tshogs la rol skabs 'o me des lhab lhab byas pa dang dran byung mdang thams cad mkhyen pa phebs byung ba de ring khyed 'byon pa la lta ba 'dug gsung ba rje mkhyen brtse'i rang lugs spel ba la rnam par sprul ba'i dbugs dbyung du gda'/lcags sprel yar klungs nas khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan rdo rje 'chang gi sku —486

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)gzhogs su skor tsam byon pa'i phebs lam du bzhugs skabs rdo rje 'chang gi mtshan lam du rmo mo tshe dbang gis dpon rin po che'i yin zer ba'i zhu yig dar sngon po'i rten dang bcas pa phul nas khong 'byon gyin yod zhus ba drung du 'byor bar kha sang rmi lam zhig byung ba khyed glo bur du 'byon par lta bas ya mtshan gsung / nub cig 'od gsal du paṇ+ḍita'i zhu yig yin zer ba phyag tu byung ba ci yin nam dgongs par sang nyin mkhan rin po che ngag dbang chos grags kyi zhu yig 'byor zhing / nub phyi ma'i mtshan lam du mi zhig na re mkhan ngag chos pa 'di khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa'i dpal gyi skye ba yin tshul byung ba bla ma de nyid shes bya rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i rnam dpyod la dpags na sngon gyi lo paṇa zhig gi bag chags mthu brtas par gdon mi za snyam/ zhabs drung dbon rin po che sogs la zla ba gsum gyi bar mgon po'i gsang 'khrid smin rgyas kyis gtsos bka' chos mang du stsal/ zhal gdams shig zhu ba gnang bar/ rang nyid mgon por byed na gnas lugs sgom/ /mgon po 'bral (3ni thad 'dod na gsang rten sgom/ /dus kun skyed rdzogs zung 'jug 'bral med sgom/ /sgom gsum ldan pa'i gdams pa dbon la 'bul/ /zhes sku rtsed kyi tshul du mdzad/ nyin tha ṇi ga nam mkha' lagazigasapar khyab bdag zha lu pas ci 'dug zhus pas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che phyag sdigs mdzub dang bcas phyogs bcur bsrung ba mdzad 'dug gsung bar bar skabs kyi zha lu'i bstan pa'i gegasabyed rnams bsal nas nyams gsos sogs 'phel rgyal yong ba dang lcags lug bstan pa'i byur chagasakyi zlal mo brag sku skyer mkhan po'i sta gon gyi bdud las bzlog pa'i lung bstan du snang /rje rdo rje 'chang gis mkhan chen klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / dbon bka' 'gyur ba/ mkhan chen zha lu pa sogs la gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos bka' shin tu 'phel ba gnang mur/ gtsang sde srid nas snar thang / pa rnam bsam sdings/ thar pa sogs chos sdomang por nyams gsos mdzad pa'i tshe zha lur yang de dang phyogs mtshungs su byung zhing 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po gshegs pa'i mkhan po med pa dang 'grig pas rdo rje 'chang la mkhan po'i snyan gsan phul ba bzhin gza' tshes—487

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyelegs par thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas skar 'dzin du btsun gsar 'ga' zhig la dge tshul gyi sdom pa gnang ba thog tu khel na thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston yab sras kyi rjes su tshar chen dang thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse gnyis las bka' drin che ba ma byung ba'i rgyun dang bcas bstan par phan pa 'ong nges na'ang / zha lu'i gros pa mang (38brkog gis rtse gdong zhabs drung gis gtsos pa'i sa skya pa'i rigs mi dgos pa zhus pa dang / bde rgyas nas sogs kyis khong dpon slob kyis mkhan po mdzad na chos phyogs nas phan thogs rung gnas gsar ba dus phyis klung rgyug po mi 'dug pas 'jig rten na sa mi zin zhus pas sde srid thugs 'gyur te zha lu sku zhang la sko bzhag mdzad pa legs bshad rin po cher/ blo chung zhig gis phan btags pa/ nam zhig gnod pa chen por 'gyur gyi don du song / gzhis rkyang mgron rkyang gi rnam par sdo srid nas lcags mo bya lo hor zla drug pa'i dus tshes dge bar ri phug dbu mdzad du bskyar bsko mdzad/ zhabs drung dbon rin po ches thog drangs pa kha shas la bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i dbang gnang / de rjes rje bka' 'gyur ba yar klungs su phebs/ lugs 'di la kye rdo rje'i sgo nas bdud rtsi ril bu sgrub par bla ma sngon mas rjes ma la sgrubs shig pa'i gnang ba stsal ba zhig dgos pa la rjes su de 'dra'i par bkab ma byung zhes lugs srol dar ba mi 'dug rung pad+ma yang gsang khros pa'i sgo nas sgrub pa gnang bar ril bu mang du 'phel ba sogs byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che/chu byi khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bas bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab ston zhu bar sku zhabs su phebs/zha lung bzhugs mur rje rdo rje 'chang sngags 'chang dgon pa spyi lung pas gdan drangs/ thugs rje chen po nyon mongs rang grol gyi sgo nas skye bdun ril sgrub gnang bas 'phel kha che ba mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lngar spyod pa sogs kyi stor song yang ngan song gi gnas las thar zhing (39na)myur du bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i myong grol skye ba bdun pa'i dam rdzas kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don rgya cher mdzad cing / yang 'ug gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i gzhis rtse skor gyi sngags pa/ sgyi lung yab sras kyis —488

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)dbus pa'i zha lu tshong 'dus kyi sngags pa/ rje dbon bka' 'gyur ba dang khyab bdag zha lu ba sogasadon gnyer can mang por bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sgrub dbang gnang / ngor du tshigs phyi ma gsan te/ zha lung drung du phebs rdo rje 'chang sde pa khri khang pa'i dpon sa gdon drag shul can gyis gtses te mi 'tsho bar thug pa sman pa dang sngags pa nus pa can gyis bor zhing / sman pas da dung bla ma byin rlabs can 'drag dan 'dren thub na bde ba'ang srid/ ces gleng ba ltar rje 'di nyid spyan drangs/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi byin rlabs gnang ba'i mod la nad las grol pas phyogs lhung drag po'i gdon gyis zin pa rnams kyang ya mtshan du 'dzin to/ /rin lding gi slob dpon du mkhan chen zha lu pa 'byon gdong gdan bzos gnang byin bkra shis phyag nas rgyas par gnang ba'i gsham du/ bltas pa tsam gyis khams gsum dbang du sdud/ /cesasogs gsungs nas mjug tu rnying ma zhig byung song ngo ang gsung / rin lding nas rje zha lu pas mjal bar phebs par rig 'dzin chen po'i bka' 'dus dang drag po dbu dgu'i dbang gnang /ngor nas rin po che sgrub khang nas mjal bar phebs te bka' chos dang gsung gleng 'phel bar byung / pha rgod rdo rje 'chang dgon gsar ba'i dgongs bstad kyi phebs sgo ltar gtsang sde srid kyi bka' shog /sde pa 'dar (39ba)pa yon mchod kyi snyan 'bul dang bstun chu phag mgo zla ba'i dus tshes dge bar bstan pa'i bdag po tshar pa chos rje yab sras kyi gdan sa 'dar stod chos 'khor yang rtse'i seng khrir phebs nas phyogs de'i skye rgu kun la 'khor lo rnam pa gsum gyi sgo dang po phye/ dbus gtsang sa khad khrungs pa'i gshis mkhan rin po che gzhen nu blo gros kyi pur sbyangs la sku dngos phebs ma thub par zhabs drung dbon rin po che rdzong bda' gnang / dus shig zhal dkar gyi gsol ja bo bas phyag tshig nas sar lhung ba dkar 'khyil 'khyil 'khor ba las gas chag ye ma byung ba phyis su'ang yod bar snang / 'dar bkra shis sdings pa zhes pa'i sngags pa yon tan can du byed pa zhig la sdo pa bsam grub pa'i g.yog gis gnod pa cher byas par brten sngags pa 'chi khar log pa'i smon lam mtshams sbyor —489

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'agyis 'byung po chen por skyes te lo gsum gyi bar ser bas lo mi skye ba'i chos can du byas pha yul mi rnams dbul 'phongs dang 'jigs skrag phan tshun du 'gran par thabs ma rnyed pa'i tshe rje 'di nyid kyis byang bu bzhu ba gnang bas sngags pa 'khor ba mtha' can du gyur cing lung pa'i mi rnams bde skyid la bkod/ kong po dung mtsho rgyal mtshan gyi gnyer pa dang bla brang pa'i rta rdzi thug 'phrad byung ba gnyer pa rkyen lam du song bas tshong pa rnams kyis gzims khang nang du 'tshangs pa sogs thugs bsun cher bzos/ stong la spu gnag mang po gnang yang dgon par mtshon rtse bstad pa sogs la brten mar lam phyugs nad kyis shi/ dre'u la'ang drel nad kyis god kha che bar 'dre mthong ba zhig gis grang mo che nas yin zer ba'i lcags kyi a tsa ra gnyis tshong dpon (40na)dang 'grogs nas 'dug labs par dogs pa skyes te gsang thabs kyis 'dar dang bkra shis rtser mang ja bskol 'dug rung skor thengs de ga'i yar lam nga la grang mo che nas 'bod mi byung zer ba sogs rig pa ma zin pa'i 'chal 'chol sna tshogs pa smra bzhin pa'i ngang la 'das pa'i skad cha gsan pas thugs snying rje chen po'i sgo nas skyabs 'jug gnang / thengs shig mnal lam du bla ma rin po che bsod nams chos 'phel phebs nas 'dar pa'i sde pa 'di tsho la skyabs 'og byed mkhan mi 'dug pas khyed kyis mdzad dgos gsung ba zhig byung ba ltar ched du gnyer ba'i srung ba rdo rje'i ra phur du chud pa gnang /de'i rgyu mtshan yang sngar bdag po sngags 'chang chen pos tshar chen la nged rang gnyis mthu 'gran gsungs par kho bo rmi lam tsam du'ang sa skya par mthu mi byed zhus kyang ma gsan par des na 'dar gdong gnyis la thug pas nged kyis gdong dga' bar las sbyor byed/ de nas srung 'khor mdzod/'dar la yang de dang dbyibs mtshungs tshul gyi zhal khyad spar bas tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos dgun 'khyags pa chom chom la gdong dga' bar thog dbab pa dang rin po che dgon gsar ba'i zhal chems su gdong dga' ba'i mi rtsa ma chod bar du kho bo'i pur de phyogs su kha bstad la zhog gsungs pa ltar gdan sa nas kyang 'dar phyogs la gtor bskul 'dra gnang tshod nas nyer 'tshe byung dogs la dgongs —490

khyab bdag dbang phyug rang brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)par 'dug /skabs shig ku ru ku lce'i rjes gnang stsal dus char cher babs shing tshogs bdag gi tshe ja gtos can 'bul mi byung /shing pho (40ba)byi ba'i lo bkra shis rtse chos sde'i thugs brel rnams chod nas lam lā sa bla brgyud zhal thang la phyag nas zhu ba sogs dang bcas 'dar du phebs/ chu shel gyi dbang po nag pas nya ba'i dus tshes dge bar chos kyi rgyal tshab dang rigs kyi dbon mkhas btsun rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs rje btsun dam pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po glang phu chos rje 'jam dbyangs cho me skyong dbang phyug /skyid gshongs chos rje mkhan mang thos grags pa rnam rgyal gsum gyis thog drangs snod ldan gyi slob ma nyer gsum la rje tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las/ ga dmasang ga mkha' 'gro yi snyan brgyud/ /gsung ngag yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ /nyams len phyogs re tsam ma yin/ /bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i man ngag gi rdzings la brten shrī nā lan+da'i mkhan po dpal ldan chos skyong sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i rin po che'i gling du bgrod pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i lam po che/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu bla chen 'brog mi'i zab chos/ sa skya pa'i 'jam mgon rim par byon pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi nang nas kyang slob bu mchog la ston pa lam 'bras slob bshad kyi snang gsum la zla ba phyed gnyis/ de rjes sems bskyed/ ljags bsnyen kha gsos bdun gcig gi ring slob ma rnams kyi bsag sbyang / rgyu dbang gi dus phyogs 'dus dang bcas pa dbang cha mang po/ lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med/ phyi dkyil rang lus dkyil gyi sems 'dzin/ dbang phyi ma gsum sogs so sor lam ltag grub (41na)mtha'/'da' kha ma/ sgyu lus/ 'od gsal/ rmi lam dang bcas pa'i nyams 'khrid dbang byin rlabs sogs cha tshang bar khyon bsdo mes zla ba phyed brgyad la smin rgyas su gnang ba ni tshar chen gyi gsung mgur du/ nyamasalen gdams pa'i gtso bo ni/ /rgyal yum bdag med mkha' 'gro la/ /paṇa grub dbang po bi ྅ pas/ /nos pa nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod du/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo ma nub pa'i/ /bla ma'i —491

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyegasung ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan dbang bzhi'i las/ /rdo rje theg pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes gsang sngags kyi yang snying tshad ma bzhi ldan gyi snyan brgyud legs par gdams/ rin lding nas zha lu pa chen po rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis rdo rje 'chang la zhu yig tu lo 'di bzhugs kyi bka' bzhes blo bde ba zhig dgos zhu ba gnang ba'i tshe spyir bstan pa dang sgos khyed rang la bsams lo lnga sdod pa'i mnyam gzhag brtan po byed ces pa'i zhu lan stsal lo/ /legs 'dod g.yo sgyus log pa'i lam 'khrid mgrin/ /legs ldan gri gug 'bar bas nyer gtubs kyang / /legs tshogs kun 'byung rdo rje 'dzin khyod kyis/ /legs pa'i mdung rtse bde chen gnas su bskyal/ /pad 'byung khros pa'i mthar thug dbu dgu pa/ /pad 'byung bstan pa'i nyin byed byang pa rjes/ /pad 'byung zab gter bdag po khyod nyid kyis/ /pad 'byung dgongs pa skong slad ched du gdams/ /rtsa gsum 'khor lo'i snang ba zad mi shes/ /gcig las du mar bsgyur ba'i sna tshogs 'phrul/ /tshur mthong byis blo brid mod nges don du/ /chu dang rlabs 'phreng dbye ba gang gis (41ba)'byed/ /gar dbang 'chi med grub pas lcags srog rtsa/ /bdud rtsi'i 'od 'phro tshangs bug nas bcug tshe/ /lnga pa'i zhags pa 'phen pa'i dka' thub can/ /nyi ma'i bu de ngal ba'i gnyid la g.yur/ /gnyen po'i rlabs kyis ma zin tha rengs rgyud/ /tshul ldan myu gu skems par mngon phyogs pa/ /rnam dag sdom pa'i char gyis gtan bde'i snye/ /smin de thugs rje'i mkha' glang sdug po'i drin/ /gsung rgyun 'dzin pa'i stong phrag sras mnga' yang / /rigs kyi thu bo mtshungs med bka' 'gyur ba/ /slob bshad mang bkur khri la rab bkod pas/ /chos kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i res su son/ /rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag dpal ldan don grub thugs/ /rnam dpyod lus phra mig dkyusang pos phyogs/ /mkhan chen zha lu pa dang glang phu rje/ /rang bstan gdams pa'i bang mdzod lde mig gtad/ /rgya chen gtsug lag kun la gzhan gyi dring / /ma ltos dpyod ldan ngag dbang chos kyi grags/ khro phu lo stor mkhyen nas legs bsngags pa/ /'dam khrod yid bzhin nor bu'i byi dor 'dra/ zhes byar srid kun yongs mkhyen bu ston rje'i/ /ri phug chos kyi pho brang nyams dga' bar/ /—492

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ rtanabastan pa'i me ro slar yang gnyis pa zhig /gso ba'i legs ldan dbyid dus bzhin ras dngom/ /bde gshegs zhi khro 'dus pa dkyil 'khor cher/ /zur ston 'ug bya lung sogs rig sngags 'chang / /mtha' klas smin pa dpal gyi mchims phu mā /rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i mdzad par co 'dri snyam/ /tshar chen bla ma'i gdan sa sa srungs steng / /rnam dpyod spyan stong mnga' ba rab 'gying tshe/ /log rtog lha min mo yi (42na sgong la lhungs dang / /lhan cig slob bshad bcud kyi dga' ston rgyas/ /rang rang las 'chir rloms pa'i gro sog mdas/ /srog rtsa 'gags nus min yang stes dbang gis/ /mig 'bras bcar ba skyob phyir dgon gsar bas/ /gzhom med 'khor lor chug ces ched du gdams/ /mtho ris dbang chu slob bshad ral klung nas/ /rnam dpyod skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangs kyang / /mkhas grub drang srong phal gyi phyir skyugs pa/ khong snod zla ba'i ma ma gsar pa mtshar/ /rgyal tshab dbon rin po che myug nasa'apho 'phyugs skabs rtse gdong du bcol/de nas ri phug tu drangs slar 'dar du gdan drangs pa'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i kha stong/ kha'u brag rdzong pa'i brgyud pa na rim gyi sku thang sogs bzhengs nas lam 'bras lha khang bsgrig pa'i bslab ston stsal ba ltar legs par grub pa des lcags yos me shor byung skabs kyang ma tshig pa'i byin rlabs can du grags/ gzhan yang snga phyi 'di dag tu rje 'di nyid dang glang phu chos rjer zab chos mang du gnang ba tshar chen gyi gsung mgur du/ nga kun spangs chos rje'i bu brgyud la/ /chos zab mo gdams pa'i snyan grags yod/ /de thob 'dod kyi tshab tshub mang na yang / /thob nges kyi snod ldan re re tsam/ /zhesapa ltar rjes 'brangs kyi slob ma grangs mang na'ang gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa nyung bar mchis/sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyang snyan nas snyan zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i zab chos do pa ston tshul/ rgyal tsha lung mang po dbon bcas/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ zhad ston khu dbon tsam ma (42bskotogs phal cher bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yan chad gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud lta bu'i tshul du byon pa yin na'ang sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa dang sngags 'chang kun dga' bsam grub sku —493

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'amached kyi dus thor bu las ma gsan cing bdag chen kun rin pa dbus su phebs dus 'phan yul dpal ldan rtser rje btsun bod mkhar ba chen po dang mjal skabs nged kyis bdag chen zhal snga nas las brgyud pa'i chos rnams rin po che tshar par zhu dgos rgyu yin yang mi ngan gyis dkrugs nas ma byung da cha khyod kyis bsod nams dbang po spun la 'phrod pa byed dgos pa'i gsung 'phros la gzhigs na sku tshe'i mjug la thugs 'gyod byi la shor ba'i skar khungs 'dra mo byung tshod du 'dug /'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos yar klungs bkra shis chos sder mkhan rin po che gzhen nu blo gros la mgon chen gyi phyi 'khrid nang 'khrid sogs kha yar gsan rung chos bka' mtha' dag ma rdzogs pas dpal ldan sa skya pa'i lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser chos rnams sngar nang nas phyir mi 'da' ba la ding sang phyi nas nang la mi 'da' zhes gleng ba byung mod sngags 'chang bla ma sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams de nyid bar skabs kyi zhal ngo rnams dang mi 'dra bar bstan pa rin po che gces par 'dzin pa'i lhag bsam gyi mthu phul du byung bar brten lo pa spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub la tshar lugs kyi chos skor rags rim tsam gsan na'ang cung zad thugs kha ma gang bas rje bla ma 'di nyid gdan 'dren pa'i bca' gzhi shar ba bdag po kun rin pa sku na phra dus tshar chen gyis chos 'brel (43na)gsan cing / rje sa skya lo tsā'i sku yi dbon/ /thugs gcig tu 'dres pa sras kyi mchog /khong 'jam dbyangs gzhen nu dngos dang mjal/ /gsung bag phebs kyi bdud rtsi snying la sim/ /chos zab lam gyi rnal 'byor bka' drin zhus/ khong skyon bral gyi mdzad 'phrin mthong ba'i tshe/ /nged sa skya pa'i mdun ma grub 'dug snyam/ /zhes dpon slob lugs legs yong bar mngon du phyogs na'ang spyir bstan pa'i sku chags bdo ba dang 'phral rkyen 'dar gdong gnyis la brten sa skya nas tshar chen yab sras la dmag sogs bka' bkyon mang du mdzad par 'di phyogs nas bla ma khyi dang khyi mjug mgo bo'i dpe ltar las sbyor sogs skyon du gyur pa ma gnang na yang rang shugs kyi sel chen po zhugs par yas mas gnyis ka nas 'khon gcugs sbyong ba'i sel 'don mdzad de shing mo glang lo hor 494

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)zla gsum pa'i nang du gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar gdan drangs pa'i tshe lha sa rdzong gi thad tsam nas bla brang sgo sper ma phebs bar dpal mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po bram ze'i gzugs can sku mdog dkar bo sku bong thog tshad gsum tsam pa phyag g.yas rtse gsum dang g.yon thod pa khrag bkang bsnams pa/ rin po che/ rus rgyan/ tshangs skud/ dar gyi ang rag can/ yum sring mo bzhi'i 'khor dang bcas zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling nger bsu ba'i tshul mdzad pa gsal bar byung zhing dam pa 'di la mgon po 'go ba'i gzigs snang bdag chen khri rin po cher yang mang du byung bar mchis/nyer lnga la sgo rum du phebs dus na ga po chen po sku gzi tha rjed shin tu che zhing zhal 'dzum (43ba)bag dang ldan pa'i dbu gtsug na rje btsun brtse ba chen po sku mdog mi sha kha na bza' bzhugs stangs sogs bris thang khungs btsun las byung ba ji lta ba zhig gsal bar gzigs/ 'khas drung bdag chen rin po cher/ gur mgon lha brgyad ma/ lha bcu gnyis ma/ 'khor rkyang dang zhal sgrub dus dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang / bram ze'i mngag gtad/ chos skyong gnyis ka'i man ngag gi yig sna'i skor du ma'i lung dang phyag khrid/ dkar bdud/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi man ngag skor sogs kyi lung / snyan brgyud ha la nag po'i be'u bum ma bu'i skor rdzogs par phul bas dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bur gyur pa'i rgyu mtshan/ bdag chen rin po ches gnang ba'i mgon po'i chos khrung las/ sngon chos rgyal 'phags pas dam pa kun dga' grags la chos skyong gi man ngag thun mong ma yin pa rnams gnang ba'i tshe 'di rnams nged kyi tsha bo rnams la 'phrod par gyis gsungs pa bzhin dam pas kyang bla ma bdag nyid chen po kho na la gnang 'dug pa dang / dus phyis bdag chen rdo rje la4 gis kyang rje rdo ring pa la de dang 'dra ba'i bka' stsal phebs 'dug kyang bar skabs kyi zhal ngo phal cher la 'di skor gyi man ngag yongs rdzogs bzhugs pa zhig ma byung 'dug mod khyed rang skal ba dang ldan pa dang brtson 'grus 'dzom pas gur zhal gtso bor gyur pa'i sa skya pa'i bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi chos skor zab mo mtha' dag lus pa med par bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thob pa ni bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs —495

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6serje dang / mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis 'phrin las bsgrubs pa'i dge mtshan (44na〉pas byung ba yin yang dag pas shin tu ngo mtshar zhing rjes su yi rang ba'i gnas so/ /zhes gzengs bstod pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsis kyang kho bo cag gi yid la dga' bde'i dpal ci yang zhig thob par mdzad pa yin la/ zhes gsal bar gsungs pa ba/shes nus/ gdan bdangos gzhi dang kha'u bsam brling sogs kyi lha khang mgon khang rnams mjal bar snang ba'i dus bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam rdo rje chos srung gi tshogs la bka' bsgo gnyer bcol rgyas par mdzad/ shing glang zhabs drung dbon rin po che bkra shis rtser rgyud sde bzhi dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod nyer gnyis sogs 'dzugs pas mtshon dbus phyogs su bstan dang 'gro ba'i legs tshogs spel bar 'dar nas rdzong bda' gnang ba bzhin 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pas gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod nas me yos lo mjug 'dar du phebs/ bka' chos sogs gsan/sa sprul lor rgyal tshab dam pa dbon rin po che/ khyab bdag zha lu pa sogs la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bdag po chen po'i bar gyi dbang rdzogs par gnang ba'i nub gzigs snang du byang gling 'jam pa'i dbyangs bkra shis rgyal mtshan shin tu dgyes par mdzad pa ni rang nyid kyi rnam par sprul pa la chos bdag po'i tshul du 'phrod pas dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi smin grol srid mthar 'phel ba la dgongs sam snyam/ khu dbon gnyis chabs cig par nub zangs mdzod dmar po nas byon pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi sgrub chen la brten nas 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa'i skye bdun ril bu sgrub pa gnang ba'i tshe nyin (44ba)re bzhin nub phyogs nas 'ja' dkar ring po sgrub khang gi rtser zug pa dang / ched du spar ba'i spos dud kyi sgrun par mi nus pa'i dri bzang gis sgrub khang gi phyi nang gang ba dang / grol nyin nam mkha'i mthongs kun 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim rma bya'i mdongs kyi sgro gdugs ltar phub cing me tog gi char chen po lag pas zin pa lta bu babs/ ril bu 'phel che ba byung zhing lo phyi ma'ang gong bzhin sgrub chen gnang ba'i mtshan ltas dang dngos gzhi 'dra ba la bum pa'i steng —496

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ rtanan thugs rje chen po bzhugs pa sgrub pa'i sgang la bum pa'i nang du thim song ba bud med rtsa sgo yangs pa zhig gis mthong ba ni mthong ba po de'ang las dag pa zhig ma gtogs tha mal pa yin tshod du mi 'dug cing ches cher snyigs ma'i sems can lhag par 'dul bar dka' ba rnams la gru 'dzin ri bo'i spo nas 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug shin tu dgyes brtses myong grol gyi rdzas rnams brlab par byon pa gdon mi za'o/ /gtsang sde srid du bslab ston zhu ba gnang ba'i tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gdan sa chos 'khor yang rtse'i khri thog tu dbon rin po che nang bskos kyis mnga' gsol/ sku na cung zad smin na'ang zhabasadrung dbon rin po che chos kyi bdag por dgongs te sngar ma song ba'i dbang byin rlabs/ rjes gnang /rig gtad/ nyams khrid/ lung man ngag /phyag len dmar 'khrid sogs bre gsog phul gsog gi tshul gyi chos 'khor chad med du skor/ lcags stag gtsang sde srid nas zha lu'i mkhan por phebs dgos pa'i bka' shog byung yang dgung lo mtho ba dang sku gcong sogs kyi stabs mi nus pa la tshig sbyangs kyi dgongs pa zhu ba (45na skonang zhing khrol/ de nas lo kha shas kyi bar ngor shar pa'ang gdan sar ma 'khod pas mkhan med du lus snang /khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po ri phug dbu mdzad thog nas lcags lug grang mo cher mjal bar phebs pas rdo rje 'chang gi bka' las/ bla brang tshom chen du khyab bdag zha lu par da ni rin po che rang ri phug gi gra pa kha ya kog po ma gi tsho'i dkyil du ma bzhugs par 'dir thugs dam mdzad na gsungs pa la sde srid nas dgongs pa yang mi yong ba 'dug bdag gis bor nas brlag 'gro ba 'dra zhus pas da 'o na bskyar bkod cig byas yun ring po mdzad dgos pa yin nam gnang ba 'di dus ri phug dbu mdzad gnang nas lo gsum gyi skabs yin zhing me byi gra ngan ci rigs kyi mi bsrun pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyis se rag sgrub sde dang khang dmar nas sogs sku nye tsho'i sar lo gcig tsam bzhugs dgos byung ba glang lo'i mjug tu sde srid gtsang pas dbu mdzad bskyar bsko gnang ste snga rting gnyis dril bar lo sum cu —497

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyertsa gsum song bas lkog gyur gyi chos rjen par gsal ba de las yid ches kyi gnas gang du mchis/de dang mtshungs par rje zha lu ba sogs dpon slob thugs nang gtsang sa tshor sde srid gtsang pa'i mtshan don yang yun ring mi yong ba'i rgyu mtshan gsal po yang yang gsung bas mtshon/ yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed pa mang du yod par gda'/ dam pa 'di nyid kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten tshul mdo tsam smos zin cing der ma 'dus pa ni/ sa skya khri chen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod (45bskoms/ zhwa dmar dkon cog yan lag /stag lung dbon rin po che/ ra lung dbon mi pham chos rgyal/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal yab sras gnyis/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /zha lu mkhan chen bsod nams dbang po/ chos lung mkhan chen nam mkha' mtha' yas/ e waṃ mkhan chen dkon cog dpal ldan/ ngor mkhan chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/gser mdog can mkhan po ga rma bzang po/ yol mo ba nam mkha' brgya byin/ rgyal sras pad+ma chos rgyal/tre bo sprul sku dpag bsam dbang po/ rong pa chos bzang bkra shis/ thugs sras zla ba'i sku skye/ lcags zam sprul sku bstan 'dzin nyi zla bzang po/ byams pa rin cen rdo rje/ byams pa don grub/ kun bzang rin cen/ drung rams pa bsod nams tshul khrims/ 'o yug pa so pa lags/ glo bo pa blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs yongs 'dzin mang du bsten nas la lar chos tshul rgya che ba dang 'ga' zhig la tshe dbang tsam gyis kyang mtha' brten pa'i gsan bsam gnang ba'i chos kyi zhib cha ni gsan yig gi bsnyel tho rnams tshang bar ma mthong bas zhib par 'bri ba'i rngo ma thogs mod/ gsan pa mdzad pa tsho yang thos lo ma yin pa'i grub mtha' so so'i lugs srol ma 'dres par zhib mo dpyad de thugs su chud par mdzad/thugs nyams su bstar bar 'os pa smos ci 'tshal de las g.yin pa rnams thub bstan rin po che mi nub pa'i ched du gdul bya so so ba'i blo dang 'tsham par 'chad nyan gyi bya ba la thugs rtsol lhur bzhes/nā ro pas tai lo dang ses 'brog mi bsten pa ltar yongs 'dzin tshogs kyi yon (46na)tan la bsngags pa dang dad gus gtso bor bton pa'i shugs la skyon yang yon tan du 'char ba'i snang tshul —498

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)dpag par dga' la/rtag brtan sprul sku gtsang shed kyis stod phyogs su phal cher bstun phyogs dgos pa zhig yod snang bas bkra shis rtse dang gser mdog can tshor chos bka' 'dra gsan zer ba'ang stes dbang tsam las gsan ma gsan la ma stos pa'i thugs rab la med spyad nas gnang ba dang /sgrub mchod kyang tshul ldan med par grags che gshis thugs 'dun med na thob par yang mi 'gro 'dug pas gsan thor med pa dang bcas chos kyi grangs su brtsi yin med pa 'dra snyam pa log rtog tu shar mod/nges don du ji ltar yin ma nges so//mgon po 'di nyid la chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa sogs slob ma ni sa chen po'i rdul bzhin bgrang bar dka' na'ang zab chos kyi mchod sprin mnyam med dgon gsar bar yang dbul zhing /rags pa tsam smos na rje btsun sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/pad+ma'i gdung 'tshob byang pa rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po/rtse tshogs mkhan chen pad+ma bsod nams/mkhas grub chen po bod mkhar ba'i thugs sras spyan snga rin po che mi pham chos kyi rgya mtsho/gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍita chen po mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags/shes bya'i gnas kun la mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen/spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi dpon rigs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag lo pa spyan snga kun dga' don grub/gsar rnying gi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bur mkhyen pa'i spyan snga ba klu 46bsgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag e waṃ mkhan chen dpal ldan don grub/skyed tshal mkhan chen 'bum rams pa thar pa rgyal mtshan/slob bshad kyi bstan 'dzin chen po rgyal rtse zhabs drung byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/dam pa'i chos kyi rgyal tshab chen po rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos kyi rgyal tshab dam pa khyab bdag zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bstan pa'i srog shing chen po glang phu chos rje 'jam dbyangs chos skyong dbang phyug/'dar skyid gshong pa mkhan wo mang thos grags pa rnam rgyal/yangs can mkhan po byams pa bso/ ༷mas mtha' yas/so zur gnubs gsum sngags

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshepa'i rgyal por grags pa'i zur 'ug bya lung pa'i chos rje yab sras/ mthu chen nyi ma bzang po dang mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan rin chen rgyal mtshan sogs se'i sngags 'chang rim par byon pa'i gdung 'dzin bkra bzang chos rje nam mkha' rig 'dzin/ kyi ston sngags 'chang chen po tshe ring dbang po/ sger pa ba ngag dbang nyi ma/ ri phug dbu mdzad rin chen rgya mtsho/ bla ma sgyi lung pa skyo ston yab sras la sogs slob bu mtha' yas par sngags gsar rnying theg pa thun mong ba'i dam pa'i chos kyi char chen po phab ste ding sang gi bar du dbus gtsang 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir bshad sgrub kyi rgyun bzang po dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel ba'i bka' drin bla na med pa'o/ /'chad nyan dang phyogs phebs ma gtogs thugs dam gyis (47na)khor yug lta bu yin na'ang rgyun gyi nyams bzhes bsnyel tho 'di la srod thun thor thun gyi dbye ba mi gsal zhing bar mtshams nas tol khong phran bu yod shas che yang tho nang bzhin bkod pa la/ thog mar gnyid sad 'phral lce byin rlabs kyi bzlas pa/ seng ge sgra'i mngon rtogs/ bzlas pa sum brgya/ thugs rje chen po'i mig 'byed/rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi bzlas pa nyer gcig tsam/ 'jam nag bzlas pa/ de nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngon du btang ba'i bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor/ rdor bzlas brgya re/ sngagasagasum po brgya rtsal nyung mtha' byas pa'i gang 'gro/ bir srung nyis sbrel/ dpal kye rdo rje'i lam dus tshong po/ tshe sgrub lcags sdong ma'i bzlas pa brgya rtsa/ dkar cha bzhi'i gtor ma sogs/ khro bo sme brtsegs khro mo sme brtsegs rnying ma'i khro bo sme brtsegs zhe gu'i sgom thun/ rnam 'joms ljang ston/ gu ru zhi ba/ gu ru dmar chen/ mthing kha/ drag dmar pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal/ rta mgrin tshe sgrub nye brgyud/ ye shes 'od mchog /rdzong chen ma/ 'khor ba dong sprug /bka' brgyad dril sgrub/ 'joms byed phur pa spu gri/ zab thig gi rta mgrin tshe sgrub/ phyag rdor/ stobs po che/ de nas bzang spyod sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung re len/ a ra pa tsa na/ 'byung 'dul/ u tsa gos sngon can/ gtum po/ rta mgrin gsang sgrub/'gro ba kun sgrol gyi gzungs gang mang dang bcas pa/ bla ma yab sras kyi sku bstod rnams sngon du 'gro —500

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)ba'i rab yangs ma brgya rtsa la nyung mtha' byas pa'i gang 'gro sogs lam 47bzab sngon du 'gro ba'i lam dus rgyas pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa/'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bzlas pa yod tsam re/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i 'khrid bzlas pa dang bcas pa/rta mgrin yang gsang dpa' gcig/gtor bsngo'i rim pa la thog mar drag dmar/'jigs byed/las gshin sbrel ba/kye rdor bde mchog/nā ro mkha' spyod/phyag rdor/u tsa/rtsis mgon/lcam dral/las mkhan bcas pa'i gtor bsngo/bskang gso/mdos sogs/gur zhal/mgon dkar/tshogs bdag/dur khrod bdag po/beg tse/dam can/khyung lung ma/rnam sras/beng /dpal ldan rdo rje rab brtan ma/rdo rje ri phug ma/spyi gtor/gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtor bsngo thun gnyis re/bka' brgyad kyi cha gsum rgyun du/brag rdzong ma/gur gyi gsang 'khrid/zhal gyi srung 'khor tshe sgrub/zhal gyi gsang 'khrid/bir srung sogs rgyas par mdzad nas lha la ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dus 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhal gzigs gsang ba'i rnam thar du 'dug pa bzhin o rgyan pad+ma za hor ma ji lta ba bsgoms/thugs rjes 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad bcom ldan 'das//mtshan tsam thos pasang na 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob//dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyasasman gyi bla/be ḍūrla yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo//zhes pa'i gsol 'debs byas slob dpon chen po rang la bstim/dbyer med kyi ngang la rmi lam 'dzin pa'o//rang bzhin lhan skyes sam/zhu bde lhan skyes kyi ngang la nyal/sang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis lang /nyer dgu sogs la 48na ) dus gtor/rdo rje chosaskyong mang po la dmigs bsal dang /khyad par nyer lnga la rtsis mgon gyi lha mor gtor 'bul tshogasa'akhor dang bcas pa/gnam gang la drug cu pa sogs mdzad tshul gyi tho 'di ltar bris pa yin na'ang mtshan phyed dang phyed yol tsam cung zad mnal ba las sku lus gnang dang ma bral bar thugs dam kho na mdzad ces drung du bcar pa rnams las thos so//dam pa 'di nyid kyi mkhyen pa'i cha nas rgyud sde che chud gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbang chog /byin rlabs/rjes gnang /sngar thugs 'dzin gnang myang ba'i riXsal nyi ma re gnyis kyi gzigs rtog mdzad bas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebasnyel gso grub cing gsar pa'i thugs 'dzin ha cang gi zhag mang po mi thogs shing chos bka' gnang ba'i dus rgyun gyi zhal 'don ltar shin tu byang ba/ rgyud bshad dang 'khrid sogs la tshig skam tsam gyi skyor zlos ma yin par dka' ba'i gnas mtha' dag la zhib mor ston pas 'phral sbas pa'i rnal 'byor lta bur mkhas nyams mi mdzad na'ang blo gros zab cing gting dpag dka' ba rgya mtsho chen po bzhin tshad du bzung bar mi nus/ 'jig rten gtso rgan gyi spyod pa g.yo sgyu'i rnam pa ni lo mang por skur bcar na'ang sna re tsam yang mi mthong zhing thos pa'i yul ni lta ga la srid/ chos kyi bka' mchid dang bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar lo rgyus/ khyad par thams cad mkhyen pa'i mtshan gsan pa na spyan chab gsil ba'i mos gus dbang rnon chos rjes 'brangs pa'i thugs dad lhur mdzad cing khyab bdag sdings ma ba bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyi rnam thar sogs thugs rtsom(48ba)pod longs shig snang ba don med kyi bskyar bshad tsam min pa'i brjod don phun sum tshogs pa sha stag mchis/ brtse ba'i cha nas sku tshe mang por mkhas pa dang grub pa'i yang srid bzung pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa la goms pa'i bag chags kyis rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun gyi sgo nas bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i thugs bskyed bcos ma min pa 'khrungs pa'i rgyus chags sdang gi sgang gshong med pa'i btang snyoms kyi thang bde mor ris med kyi 'gro ba thams cad la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas rjes su bzung ba mtha' dag 'bri bar ma lang zhing dper na shing bzo ba dpal ldan sogs 'chi bar thug pa mang dag mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa dang / gshin po sogs la lhag par brtse bas rigs drug gnas 'dren gyi sgo nas gnas ngan len las bskyabs pa'i sdig can 'ga' yang mi lus thob nas skye dran gsal ba'i lo rgyus mang / dbul phongs ma nus pa gzigs pa'i tshe bzod glags med pa'i skyo shas dang nges 'byung gis zin pa'i zas gos gnas mal sman gyis mtshon te phan 'dogs pa la brtson pas gzhan don du gang 'gyur ma gtogs rang gi bdog pa la 'jungs pa'i rtog pa ye mi mnga'/ gtso bo mchog dman bar pa gsum so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi sbyin pa bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa/ thos bsam sgom pa/ nyams len byed lugs phra —5(12

khyab bdag dbang phyug ra po brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)mo tsam la'ang ras chod du ma song ba'i skyo ngal med par bsrab bya'i sgo nas mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi sar sbyor nus pa'i cha nas grub pa'i dbang phyug ku ku ri pa sogs (49na tshe gzod ma nyid nas bskyed rim mthar phyin cing rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa klong du gyur pas grub pa brgyad dang zhi sogs kyi las rab 'byams la chags thogs mi mnga' yang thub bstan 'jig pa la nye ba lta bu byung na min pa sku la sdo ba sogs thugs sun dbyung ba'i ma rungs skye ba du mar drag shul gyi cho ga mdzad pa lta ci/ de dag mi dge ba'i mthus ga 'gro mi bzad pa'i du khas mnar ba la brtse bas kun nas blangs te thugs rje rjes bzung gi ting nge 'dzin la gzhol/ bka' chos gnang tshe gsung gdangs snyan chags pa thos pa'i mod la sems khongs rang bzhin gyis lhod 'gro/ phyi rol tu nyon mongs pa me ltar 'bar bas gdung bzhin pa blo brel tshub tshub pa drung du slebs pa dang da res kyi sems gnas 'gyur/ ji tsam bsngad kyang sdod spro ba dang sku'i tshul khrims kyi dri bsung tshar bas khams gsal sing nger dwangs/thugs dam mdzad sar bsdad na byin rlabs kyis rang gi dge sgror yang gnas gzhan du byas pa dang ye mi 'dra ba yod/ dbang rjes gnang gi dus zil che bas da ltar rang byin rlabs khyad par can zhugasabyung snyam pa 'byung bas mtshon te gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar dpog par mi nus pa blo dman rnams kyi yul ma yin no/ /'khon rigs 'jam dpal dpa' bo rim byon gyis/ /tshig brgyud rin cen rtsing spyod 'dam bying las/ /rnam dpyod shing rtas 'dren pa'i sa skya ba/ /dbye mod shul du skyes pa'i tsan dan bzhin/ /pha bzang gong ma'i phyag brgyud khyad par nor/ /pha rol (49bsko yengs khyer ya ma brlas bor ba'i pha chos gnas gsar bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /pha rgod kun dga'i mtshan can snyim par son/ /log rtog ba tshwas nyer gang chu klung che/ /snyan brgyud 3 shis yan lag brgyad ldan du/ /bskrun par kha'u'i brag nas lha mesa'aphrog dbang / /dgyes bas bram ze'i gzugs kyi zlos gar bsgyur/ /rdo rje srin po gzi byin 'bar ba'i steng / /rje btsun brtse chen ma lnga zhe sum rab gsal ba/ kho bos bstan pa'i mar rtse ches spar ba'i/ /—503—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'ame ro da gdod gsos zhes gzengs bstod snyam/ /phyag na pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo sa /skye bdun sha la brten pa'i sgrub pa yis/ /srid pa'i duḥkha bcil ba'i myong grol rdzas/ /'di ko ris bral 'gro srog 'tsho ba'i sman/ /dbang po'i bzhu ris phub pa'i lding khang na/ /phang phung man+da ra ba'i 'dab 'phrong g.yo/ /sngon med dngar ba'i dri bzang rab 'thul pa/ /a ho legs bris mchod pa'i rnam 'phrul mtshar/ /ngan 'gro'i g.yang la gom pa yongs 'phyan pa'i/ /nyam pa'i 'gro mang thabs mkhas mdzad pa yis/ /'dren phyir kā la sha nang pad dkar 'chang / /mngon sum byon des yid kyi gdung ba sel/ /legs ldan dmar zlum spyan gyis chig brgyud snod/ /nyer gzigs lung bstan chos kyi rgyal tshab la/ /tshar chen bla ma'i gdams ngag bum pa gang / /thugs gsang za ma tog byo de rmad byung / /'jam mgon dgyes pa'i mkhyen rab mkha' ltar yangs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug brtse ba'i rjes su 'gro/ /lag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs gzi 'bar (50na thas/ /nges rnyed dad pa'i spu long ci yang g.yo/ / sku cung zad hreb pa sogs gang ci nas zhing 'dir bzhugs par mi bzhed pa'i rnam pa ci rigs byung bar khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos brtan bzhugs dang gsol 'debs yang yang gnang ba'i thugs dang rim gyis bsrings shing khyad par 'chi med mgon po'i sgo nas sku tshe spel ba'i gsung chog rgyas par mdzad dus dgun grang sgang yin rung tshe gtor zho ltar gyur pa sogs dpon slob gnyis ma'i thugs rje dang byin rlabs kyis ngo mtshar ci yang shar/ 'phrin las rgya mtsho zer par blo skyon cher med 'dug na'ang zhabs drung dbon dbus phyogs su phebs 'gyangs zer mi mang bas rkyen byas dpon slob chen mo sku gdangs na ni smos ma dgos de min gzhan du gshegs na 'ong bar mchis rdo'i dos 'dra zhes skur pa btab pa byams pas snyan du gsol ba na kho bden dbon drung gi ngo ma spongs pa min pa lugs gang nas kyang sdod 'dod med gsung ba/ rje mkhyen brtse'i nyams mgur du/ snying nas dam chos 'tshol ba'i skye bo la/ /chos med skye ngan de dag lhag par sdang / /tha chad snum gyi dri ma phra mosakyang / /dkar gsal dar gyi kha dog nyams pa bzhin/ /bdud sprul skye ngan du ma'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /—504

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)dad ldan 'ga' yang 'brel med mu cor sgrog /da ni khyed rnams bde bar bzhugs shig dang / kho bo khyod dgyes bya ba myur bsgrubs kyis/ /dus kun sdig pa'i so nam ma mdzad par/ /zhim rgu bzhes shing bde bar gzims su gsol/ /zhes pa'i don (50ba)thog tu babs shing sngar khyab bdag zha lu par lo lnga bzhugs pa'i zhal len gnang ba'ang lhag dang bcas grangs thengs pa'i chu mo bya'i lo'i tshes bcu zhig gi skabs gsung chog rgyas pa dang gsol ja yang bzang zhing mang bar gnang / mjal mi byung tshad thong gsungs pa'i thugs gtsigs che ba 'dra la ched du zhus pa la ma ltos par bka' bsgo'i byin rlabs mdzad/ byams pa bstan 'dzin la de ring o rgyan chen po phebs par mchod pa blo kha rdzogs pa rang byung / srod thun gyi gong du nga kho bo ni rgyab 'gro ba yin su la'ang ma zer gsung bar sku mi bde ba med dam zhus pas de 'dra mi bdog phebs pa la byams pas zhabs drung dpon rin po cher rgyu mtshan gsol ba na de 'phral 'bul ba bsnams te phebs tshe de su yin gsung bar bdag lags sku la snyun med dam zhus pas gang yang mi 'dug byams pas zhus pa 'dra gnang ba la sku mi bzhugs pa'i dgongs pa bstad yong 'dug pas de ltar gnang na mi yong tshul gyi gsol 'debs slar yang nan cher mdzad rung dgongs pas ma bzhengs par cang mi gsung bar ni bzhugs pa'i tshul gsal bar byung ba na de bas kyang nan tan bskyed de phur btsugs su gsol pa btab pas zhing brje bar mngon du phyogs pa des de 'dra rang gnang ci dgos thugs dang bstun nas sdod pa lags pas thugs 'byog pa mdzad mi dgos rang gnas su spyon gsung / de ltar zhal gyis 'tshes nas lo ril po gsum lhag tsam tshe mtha' yas pa'i ngo bor thugs bskyed de gdul bya'i dpal mgon du bzhugs/dgung lo dang sku gcong gi khyad nas da rang lam dus(51na〉sgogs dkyil 'khor chen mo rnamasalcogs mdog ma kha bas yo rgyan sgrub pa kho na la dril lam dgongs pa'i nub cig mnal lam du kye rdo rje'i thugs dar slob dpon chen po bzhugs 'dug pa gsal bar shar bas mnal sad tsa na gcig tu bsgril na mi legs par mkhyen te mya ngan las mi 'da' ba'i bar du lam dus thun gnyis ma chag par —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)mdzad ces rje bka' 'gyur ba chen po gsung /shing phag lor ri phug nas khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mjal bar phebs dus gsung gleng mang du gnang ba'i mthar phyag mtheb ker te rin po che nu ro la zhes rje zha lu ba'i phyag nas 'jus 'phreng tshul gyi chos dang 'brel ba'i zhal gdams mtha' yas pa gnang nas dgyes dgyes mdzad/ de'ang rje btsun rdo ring pa chen pos chos rje rdo rje 'chang gis kyang don lnga las ma zhugs kho bo don bdun gyi khar slebs bla ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi thugs zin pa sogs sku tshe 'di'i bzhed pa mtha' dag lhun gyis grub nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa la spro ba'i tshul rnam thar du gsal ba dang mtshungs pa'i dgung lo yang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel dang snyoms pa'i don brgyad du phebs pa dang de bar rgyal bstan spyi dang bye brag bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i ring lugs rgyal tshab rin po che 'jam mgon bsod nams mchog ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyi phyag tu legs par 'phrod pas rnga yab dpal gyi ri bor sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan chen po'i 'dus pa'i (51ba〉khor gyi gral du bsgrig par spro ba dang zla ba gcig las gzugs brnyan 'bum phrag mtsho rdzing du 'char ba ltar dag pa dang ma dag pa'i zhing khams mtha' klas par sems can gyi don rlabs po che mdzad par dgongs te 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo'i chu shel gyi dbang po smin drug gi dga' ma dang rtse ba'i dkar cha'i bzang po'i nyi ma nub rir gzhol ba'i tshe gzugs sku mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor chos sku'i klong du sdud par mngon du phyogs pa'i rlung gi 'gro 'ong rgyun chad pa na khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos sku la 'jus nas gsol 'debs gnang bas gsos pa lta bur spyan hur gyis gzigs te da lta rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje dang thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis bkra lam gyi phebs byung bar rang sems bla ma'i thugs dang dbyer med bde ba chen po'i ngang la cham mer 'gro ba de sad pa zhig byung phebs pa mkhan chen yol pa gshegs gdong sde pa dngos grub rdo rjes gsung chen po'i gsol 'debs kyi thugs dam sad de/ 306

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)bka' las/ de min na steng gi mthongs dkar 'gram 'di rin po che tshar pa phebs byung ba la gsol ba btab pas sku de rdo rje 'chang dngul chu'i mdog lta bu zhig tu gyur par mthong ba'i mod la rig pa thim pa byung bas de'i ngang du song na don chen po grub pa las khungs te zhag bcu'i bar nad kyisamanar ba'i lus 'di la sdod dgos par 'dug /ces pa dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i thugs dam sad par snang / lo grangs de tsam zhig khyed kyi thugs dang bstun yod cha de 'dra mdzad gzhan 'dra/ 'on kyang khyed la bltos bcas mtha' dag byang (52na〉spyib kyi bar du rjes su 'dzin no zhes zhal gyis bzhes nas snang mched thob gsum gyi mthar 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku'i ngang du thugs dam la zhag gcig gi ring bzhugs/ dgongs rdzogabang kyi grabs yul thugs gra 'grig mi 'grig khyad nas zhag 'ga' zhig gsang ba'i tshul gnang /rje bka' 'gyur ba chen po sang phyi dro gdung mjal la phebs shin tu 'dod pa byung bas byon pa dang thugs dam grol ba 'grig shangs g.yas nas byang sems dkar po khyor ba gang tsam phebs pa zhal du mchod pas nyams rtogs kyi bogs lhag par che zhing rdo rje 'chang kun spangs chos rjes me tog 'thor ba'i dus sku khams zags te bzhugs stan steng du 'khyil kha tshar chen chos kyi rgyal pos lhag med du bzhes pa snyan brgyud kyi bstan pa zin pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa dang dbyibs 'dra bar mchis/rje bla ma'i gdung khang gi g.yas su thugs dam rten gyi kye rdor gyi sku zhig yod pa zhal thad sor bsgyur rung sku gdung rin po cher lan gsum 'chus pa byung / zhing brjes pa'i wo nas rlung phra mo tsam gyis 'gyu ba 'gags te nam mkha' mthing zhun pa'i mdog ltar sngo la ston gyi rdul bral bzhin dwangasapar lha'i tshogs kyis me rtag 'dab ma bzhi pa dang lnga pa sogs yu ba ldan pa'i char bu yug lta bur 'tshubs/ shel la tshon ris kyi kha dog bsgyur ba 'dra ba'i dbang bo gzhug phyogs kun tu dkris/ ched du spar ba'i sbos dud kyis bskrun par mi nus pa'i gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu las sngar ma myong ba'i dri phun sum tsho gis pa ldang ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan ji snyed ba byung / dpal kye rdo rje man —507

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loshengag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas (52bskokhor lo'i mgon po bla ma rdo rje 'chang la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa nam mkha'i khams yongs su gang ba ting nge 'dzin gyi mthus sprul bar ma zad dngos su'ang chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod brgya phrag tu longs pa nyin re bzhin bstar bar mchod dpon 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gcig pus lag dar bas nyin mtshan kun tu ngal ba'i dka' thub la brten pa'i tshogs bsags/ dgyes rdor/ 'jigs byed/ yang gsang khros pa/kun rig /smyung gnas dang lnga'i gdung chos btsugs/ ri phug nas khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po phebs pa rgyang gzigs nas nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa la 'ja' dkar sku gdung rin po cher mdung tshugs su zug pas mtshon pa'i gzigs snang khyad par can byung bar gda'/ zhabs drung dbon dang rje zha lu pa gnyis gsol tshigs gnang ba'i tshe nam mkha' thams cad me tog gi char gyis gang bas chos chen gyi rgya mthongs la mi shong ba lta bu babs/ nye skor gyi ser tshogs gral dbur yangs can mkhan rin po che ngag dbang chos grags gdan drangs pa'i tsha ra mang ja 'gyed 'bul ba sogs gya nom pas bsnyen bkur/ yul mi rnams la 'byu khro zangs sogs kyi sbyin gtong mdzad/hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi nub kye rdor man ngag lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo nas sku gdung rin po che dpal he ru gaḥzhal brgyad pa'i rnam par gyur pa la rdzas chen bcu gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i mtha' klas pa'i mchod pa thams cad mchod bya mchod byed dang bral ba'i gnas lugs rang ngo don gyi bla mar rtogs pa'i rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po nyid kyis phyag dar nas zhugs su (53na)phul ba'i sang nyin nam mkha' thams cad 'ja' sprin dang lha rdzas man+da ra ba'i char gyis gang / pur khang zhal phye bas tshoms la dung dkar g.yas 'khyil mgo sprod dbar du 'phel gdung yungs gar spungs pa lta bu byung / sa skyar dkar po rgyang grags bus pa'i tshigs su mang 'gyed tsha ra/ bzhi thog tu bdag chen khri rin po cher 'bul ba/ gtsug lag khang dang mgon khang rnams su mchod pa/ kha'u skyes lhas su mang ja zhwa 'gyed/ zha lur mang ja tsha ra sa—508

khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)lugs gtso bor gyur pa'i dbus gtsang gi dgon pa mang dag la mang ja bsngo rten/yar klungs su ser tshogs rgyas pa'i gral dbur rdo rje brag nas byang bdag rigs 'dzin chen po gdan drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang 'gyed tsha ra/bkra shis rtse chos sder rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyan gtso bor bzhugs pa'i lam zab lha khang dngos gtsang ba/nag pa zla bar dpal dus kyi 'khor bo'i sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod star chags su btsugs/tshar chen yab sras gsum gyi bka' 'bum gsar bzhengs sogs rdo rje 'chang mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi thugs khur bzhes te drin can bla ma gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje slob dpon gang gi dgongs pa zag med chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs par mdzad do//'gro ched mnar med gnas su 'jug pa la//rgyal dang de sras spro dga' cher lta na//mi bsrun cher mal gyis 'byung zhi ba'i dbyings//gzims par mdzad na sems pa'i ngang tshul ci//'chi med legs ldan mgon po la brten nas//'chi ba'i dngos brgya 'joms pa'i rten 'brel mthus//'chi bdag bdud sde'i dpung bcas zil mnan te//'chi gsos sman bzhin gdul bya'i re ba bkang //yid srubs 'jam mnyen 53bsgo da' yis rnying phug pas//da dbang rnal du mgyur༄kha rjod 'gas//yid mang mnar byed duḥkha tsher ma de//yid can 'dren mchog gsol btab mthu nges phyungs//mtshungasamed bla ma'i sras kyi thu bo mchog/ring lugs pha mthar spel ba'i zha lu par//byang chen bar du rjesa'adzin brda thabs su//tha ma'i gsung gi gnang ba ci yang stsal//kye ma mgon khyod thugs rje nyin mor byed//'char nub spangs kyang skal ga 'gro ba'i ngor//dam pa'i chos kyi snang ba 'od po che//bzhud pas stug po'i smag gis khyab 'di skyo//sā la'i ljongs 'di'i skye rgu yongs bor nas//brtse med mkha' spyod gshegs la ngo mtshar ltas//blo brid 'di la dga' bar sems pa rnams//ma gas snying de lcags kyi gong bur zad//rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug phyag rgya cher//dang po'i mgon por bzhengs la bltos min kyang //'gro ba'i tsho gos chen rdzogs/bye rgyal tshab rjes//kun bzang mchod sprin mkha'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'angos dog por bkang / /zhing 'dir gzugs sku'i ri bor rab btang yang / /cha shas nyer gang snying rje'i zla dkyil ngos/ /lhag bsam ri dwags snang brnyan rtag 'char ba'i/ /ngang tshul 'di la bsam skyin rtse dga' rgod/ /de ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i thun mong ba'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor ngur smig gar gyis rol ba mkhas pa dang grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba rje btsun dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa ni rgya mtsho chen po ltar gting dpog par mi nus na bdag 'dra'i blo dman tshogs kyis tshang bar brjod pa ni lta ga la zhig /'on te cha shas tsam gyis zin bris gnyis gsum snang ba'ang phan (54na〉spyon go bsdur tshe lo zla sogs nor 'khrul 'ga' zhig mchis pa mi thog brjes pa'i rgyus yod kyang dkon gshis dri yul yang cher mi 'dug mod 'on kyang rin po che yol pa ba/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chen po bsod nams chos 'phel gsum gyi rnam thar la zhib tu dpyad/ khyab bdag zha lu pa thugs rgyus mnga' ba rnams la dri mol zhus/rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba'i gsung bgros thor bu blor zin pas brgyan/ dus tshes sogs nges pa dang gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub rung gi steng du bag la nyal gyi tshogs kyang rung mthun sbyar te bris pa spyir so so skye bo 'khrul ba'i rang bzhin can yin par ma zad sa bon ha cang mi gsal ba sogs nas nongs pa'i tshogs yod na'ang bla ma tshang ma'i dus kyi brgyud pa la phan pa'i lhag bsam gyis bkod zin to/ /blo 'das gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku'i dbyings/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar longs sku rta ljang can/ /sprul sku'i 'od zer 'phro ba'i bsam pa dang / /'tsham par spro ba'i pha mtha' gang gis rnyed/ /'on te dbang phyug yon tan brgyad ldan pa/ /mkhyen rab nor 'dzin bu mo'i mngal yangs por/ /lung rtogs yongs 'du'i rtsa ba ches brtan pa'i/ /sgyu 'phrul gar las 'dod dgu'i gru char phob/ /snying po'i —510

khyab bdag dbang phyug rang brtan gyi rnam thar/ 6)tshad ldan yang srid bdag chen rje/ /snyan brgyud chos kyi nyi ma rdo ring pa/ /slob bshad shing rta'i srol 'dzin tshar pa rje/ /rnam gsum bstan pa'i ched du khyed byon snyam/ /mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang phyug bla ma de'i/ /gdung 'tshob bstan pa'i rgyal srid nyer bskyangs te/ /bshad sgrub ring lugs dar mdzad gnas gsar ba'i/ /rtogs brjod zla bas snying gi zug rngu 'byin/ khyod zhabs bsnyen pa'i (54ba)skal ba ches dman yang / /gsung rgyun bdud rtsi nges legs srog zungs su/ bsgyur phyir dang bas rnam thar gleng ba 'di/ /a ho las dkar mthu yis rnyed la rangs/ /bsod nams yongs byas te se'i gtsug gtor nas/ /slob bshad yan lag brgyad ldan nyal 'gro'i klung / /bgrang ring skye ba'i blo grosachu gter nang / /rab 'bab thos bsam sgom pas ro gcig shog /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sdo kun gyi bcud/ /lo paṇa zhal drod ma yal gsang ba'i chos/ /legs 'dzin brgyud pa mu thi la yi 'phreng / /thub bstan de srid chad med dar gyur cig /ces dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho spro ba dang bsdu ba'i byed pa po dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dbang phyug rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rtogs brjod bdud rtsi'i za ma tog ces pa 'di ni mkhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis ring po nas gyis shig pa'i bka' stsal dang dbon mkhyen rab blo ldan dang mkhyen rab rnam rgyal gnyis kyis kyang bskul ba la brten nas bgyid mdun che na'ang don med kyi g.yeng bas snyoms las su lus pa nye char ā nal zhes pa me 'brug hor zla gnyis pa'i mjug nas snyan brgyud bstan pa'i nyi ma mkhan chen zha lu pa chen pos skyid shod lho mos gzhis gar gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras slob bshad 'dzugs pa gnang skabs gsang chen bstan pa'i shing rta pa bco brgyad chos rje byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i dbon rin po che nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ grub pa'i dbang phyug lcags zam pa'i gdung 'dzin sger pa chos rje ngag dbang (55na tha stan 'dzin phun tshogs gsum gyis lam 'bras brgyud pa'i rnam thar kha skongs la da lam cis kyang dgos zhes gsung —511 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pegis bskul ba ltar kun spangs chos rje'i ring lugs la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa'i slob bshad 'dzin pa za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes nag pa zla ba'i nyer gnyis zla ba gro bzhin gyi 'grub sbyor la dbu btsugs kyang som nyir gyur pa'i dogs gcod 'dras bul 'gros kyi ngos chu shel gyi dbang po snron gyis nya pa'i dkar cha'i gang ba gsum pa lhag pa lha mtshams kyi 'grub sbyor gyi nyin rang byung 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gzhal med khang pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa char chen chos kyi rgyal po'i ring lugs byams mgon mchog gi sprul pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs pa 'tshang rgya tshul bstan pa de srid du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig // sarba mgi lo// //—512

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ (tanar༅༅//dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa ma lus ba'i ngo bo khyab bdag rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dpyod ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya bzhus/sa/༄༅//tri kā le khu laḥbha ( /dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa ma lus pa'i ngo bor rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo tshul khrims kyi dri ngad phyogs brgyar khyab pa'i 'tshams sprin gsar pa'i bla gos can rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dpyod ldan yid dbang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+ma ra yan lag mchog gis btud nas gsol ba 'debs na thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du ma gyur bar de srid du brtse ba chen pos rjes su gzung du gsol//rin chen phung bor spungs pas rnyed min bsod nams ye shes tshogs chen pos//nyer bskrun chos gzugs sku gnyis mngon gyur stug po bkod pa'i mgon po mchog/sna mang sprul ba'i zlos gar bsgyur las zhing 'dir mkhas grub tshul bstan nas//thub pa'i ring lugs rgyal mtshan bsgreng mdzad dpal ldan skal pa bzang na ) por bsngags//'pho med gtsugator rtser bcings bde chen waṃ//stong chen e dbyings sna tsho gis lha mo dang //mnyam spyod kā la tsan+d+ra bshes gnyen du//ston pa'i zhakhrul po che gzhan dmigs su med//tshul de legs pa'i cha bsags grong khyer na//dpal ldan rgyu skar 'khor

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyelor skal can rnams/ /smin mdzad 'jam dbyangs grags snyan 'bar ba'i lha/ /ljongs 'di'i shing rta chen por bstan nam snyam/ /yang na bdag med mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kun/ /nyer 'dzin rnal 'byor dbang phyug ring lugs srog /zungs su shar phyogs slob dpon ga rje gaḥ /byon tam blo 'di som nyi'i dra bar tshud/ /gcig tu dkar pa'i thub bstan kha ba'i ri/ /log rtog na bun bsangs nus rnam dpyod nyi/ /ma pham bla ma'i ring lugs pa kū la/ /'byed pa'i g.yon mig 'gram chang da gdod 'thor/ /rgyal sras slob ma'i tshogs kyis mgrin gcig glu/ /nyer blangs gdugs dang ba dan rol mor (2ba)bcas bu ston chos rje'i bshad sgrub bdag po sa /mgon khyod mnga' gsol ched du dbang bskur nges/ /lhun po'i rtse mor rnam par snang mdzad kyis/ /yongs sprul gzha' tshon ltar bkra'i gzhal med khang / /gangs can dwangs mtshor sgrib bral 'char nus deng / /rdor sems ngo bo mi gtong khyod gcig pu/ /gang blo yangs pa'i mngal du mkhas grub kyi/ /yon tan gser sgong smin pa'i rtogs brjod ched/ /'dzin la khyab 'jug rig rtsal chen po'i mtha'/ /'dzad na bdag 'das brjod pa'i khur de lci/ /bsam gtan par bcos 'gog pa'i ting 'dzin mkhan/ /rtog ge'i tshig mdas nges pa'i don snying 'bigs/ /cher rlom 'phyon ma'i spyod tshul gleng mthong tshe/ /sgyid pa mi skyur gzengs bstod sems de spro/ /rdzun phra rtsab kyal ser bas phan bde'i lo/ /'joms 'dren lce yi glog zhags mang 'khrug mod/ /gtan mdun myu gu bskyed nus ngo mtshar gtam/ /chu 'dzin lang long g.yo ba brgya lam tsam/ /de phyir gdan gsum tshang ba'i he ru maḥ /bshes gnyen sgyu drar rol ba'i thun mong gi /rnam thar nor 'dzin gzhi las sor mo'i rtses/ /blangs pa'i rdul gyi grangs cam bshad kyis nyon/ /de yang mkhas 'jug las/ bstan bcos byed pa'i dam pa yis/ /ston pa la ni mchod brjod bya/ /bstan pa spel phyir dag pa'i tshig /'di la 'thad pa bzang po mthong / /zhes pa ltar yul khyad par can la ched du brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa ta sgru ra'i rgyud las nye bar drangs te skabs su gleng bar bya ba ni/ mgon po zhi ba lhas/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal (3na)sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung —514

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ (tanaba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te kun ring gnas gyur cig /ces lus can rnams rgyu kun 'byung las nyon gyi bden pa las 'bras bu sdug bsngal bden pa 'byung ba'i zug rngu rtsa ba nas 'byin par byed pa'i rtsi sman gyi ljon pa chen po/ khyu lam gyi bden pa las 'bras bu 'gog pa'i bden pa'i zhan la gnas skabs srid pa'i bde ba rnams kyang 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu sa gsum gyi sgron me sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che yin la/ de yang sangs rgyas phal po che las/ nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa ji tsam pa/ /sems can ma lus mtha' yang de bzhin no/ /zhes nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa de snyed ltar sems can gyi khams kyang zad pa med pas 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa'i ched du 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi grangs kyang 'di tsam mo zhesablo'i ra ba las yongs su brgal la/ 'on kyang lha rnams kyis 'di ni bskal pa bzang po'o zhes pa'i ched du brjod pa'i grags can gyi bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong sa stong dang lnga tshang bar 'byung ba'i bzhi pa 'o skol gyi rnam 'dren zas gtsang gi sras po 'di nyid rgyud bla mar/ thugs rje chen posa'ajig rten mkhyen/ /'jig rten kun la gzigs nas kyang / /chos kyi skulas ma g.yos par/ /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tsho gis kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang / /lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la (3ba7khas pa dang/ /btsun mo'i 'khor bcas rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / /byang tso snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde 'joms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'bor lo dang / /mya ga 'das par ston mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes 'og min gyi gnas su nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas dga' ldan gyi gnas su dam pa tog dkar po'i rnam par bstan pa de nyid 'dzam bu'i gling du shākya'i brgyud du gcingasate mdzad pa bcu gnyis bstan pa'i gtso bo ni/ chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor te gdul bya rnams smin grol gyi lam la bkod pa'i lung gi bstan pa'ang / ji skad du/ mdo sde dbyangs bsnyan lung —515

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyebastan dang / /tshigs bcad ched brjod gleng gzhi dang / /rtogs brjod de lta bu byung dang / /skyes rabs shin tu rgyas pa dang / /med byung gtan la dbab pa'i sde/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so/ /zhes yan lag bcu gnyis sam/ bsdu na sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum du 'du ba'i bstan pa de 'phel zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'ang de 'dzin la rag las pas/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po khyab bdag zha lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub nyid kyi sku'i skye ba snga ma zha lu byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po yin par rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis 'dar chos 'khor yang rtser dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gnang ba'i tshe 'od gsal la shar ba dang ging chen tshangs pa dung thod can (4na)gyis kyang ngos 'dzin mdzad/rjes su zha lu pa'i bstan srog bzung ba'i mdzad pa la dpags kyang som nyi dang bral la/ gzhan ma dam pa'i yang srid mtha' yas pa yod par gor ma chag na'ang rnam thar gyi zin bris dgos tshul zhus pa'i reg zig tu/ phran bu bdag la rnam thar 'god 'os pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan ci yang med kyang bla ma'i bka' gcog ma nus pas g.yar tsha spangs nas g.yar khral du 'tshal ba la/zhes yon tan thams cad rkun po'i nor bzhin sba ba lhur blangs te mngon par mi mdzad pas spyan dang mngon par shes pa mnga' ba rnams ma gtogs bdag lta'i dman blo'i yul las 'das pas rnge ma thogs/ sku tshe 'di'i thun mong ba'i gdul bya dang sgo bstun pa'i mdzad pa rags rim tsam la sku bltams pa'i yul ni/ jo bo chen po mar me mdzad rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs 'od dpag med pa'i lha khang na byang chub kyi sems bsgom par mdzad pa'i tshe phyag na pad+mas zhal bstan nas/ skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gang yin pa de khyod kyis shes sam/ /'di nas byang phyogs na nga'i zhing khams yod/ khyod kyi yi dam jo mo sgrol ma yang de na sems can gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ khyod kyi gdul bya mang po yang de na yod pas byang phyogs bod du song zhig /ces bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di dge ba bcu rdzogs par tshang zhing rgyal blon lo paṇa byang —516

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bka' drin las chos khrims dar gyi mdud pa dang rgyal khrims gser gyi gnya' shing zung du 'jug pa'i (4ba)'bangs rnams bde skyid la spyod pa'i stod mnga' ris skor gsum/smad mdo khams sgang drug /bar dbus gtsang ru bzhir grags pa las ru lag gi sa'i cha sa hor mchod yon gyi dus che gsal chen mo'i tshe khri skor bcu gsum du dbye ba las zha lu khri dpon gyi chab 'bangs su gtogs pa 'chi med kyi grong khyer sa la 'phos pa lta bu nyang smad yin la/ de yang mnga' ris su bod kyi lha btsan po'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa ye shes 'od dang bstan pa phyi dar gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa sprul pa'i skyes mchog rin chen bzang po gnyis kyis thub pa'i ring lugs dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i tshe log par 'khu zhing 'gran zla can zhang zhung gi bon rnams phyogs g.yin du bskrad pas thun mong gi rdzu 'phrul thob pa'i bon zhig gis dmod bor nas gshang nam mkha' la 'phur ba song ba'i rjes su 'khun dir ri ri 'phur nas 'ongs te nyang smad kyis phyogs rgyang / skyi li/ mag gsum zer ba'i mag gi phur pa phug cig tu yul chags nas gzhis bzung ste pha tshan mang du 'phel bar bon rigs 'khon tsho gshang 'phur du grags/ rus rdza yin pas thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po cher 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i bstod chen bskul ba po bla ma rdza pa zer ba'ang 'di pa'i rigs su gtogs/mi rabs mang zhig gi bar bon g.yung drung gi man ngag la mkhas pas grong chog la shin tu brin/ ring zhig lon pa na rdza rigs kyi bon zhig gis sku zhang rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub kyi zhabs la thug /mkhyen rab rin po ches gzhan phan che bar dgongs te gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugasabaslab tu (ldan〉cug par bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa/ rtsa bshad man ngag phyi ma ste rgyud bzhin grags pa gtso bor gyur pa'i gzhud man ngag lag len rnams slob dpon mkhas pa mang du bsten te dbyis phyin par sbyangs/ khyad par sman gyi lha mo'i pra sgrub kyi sgo nas dpyod pa don rig /mthong ba yul rig /thos pa sgra rig gsum la brten mi dgos par nad 'di yin dang sman dpyad bcos ka gang 'phrod mtha' dag sems la wal gyi 'char ba'i thun mong gi mngon shes grub pas lha rje byings las khyad —517

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)zhugs pa'i gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las ches cher 'phel bas drung 'tsho chen mor grags/de'i sras 'tsho byed bstan pa grags pa/ de'i sras sangs rgyas grags pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis thugs la btags nas rog tsho byang pa sman grong rin po che zhes che'i rig byed kyi gtsug lag la gzhan 'dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa chen po gang de'i drung du slob gnyer la rdzong ba sogs lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas bdag rkyen mdzad/ bslab sbyangs kyang mthar phyin nas nyang gzhud du dpon tshang sman khang nas zhes spyi mchod li por gyur/ yab lha rje de dang cho 'brang ni sngon gyi lce lo tsā ba khyi 'brug dang dz+nyā na sirnyi sogs lce'i gdung rabs rim par byon pa las bar skabs su shar rgyal po'i lung gis zha lu khri dpon du bskos nas lung lag rtags kyis mngon par mtho/ dpal ldan sa skya pa bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyi dus gong nas nga'i bla ma'i gdung rabs chad na mi yong ba btsun mo drug len par lung byung ba bzhin dpon chen ang (5ba'i na gyis de don bzhin do dam mdzad pa'i zha lu khang gsar ba'i sras mo bdag nyid chen pos khab tu bzhes par 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa nga gnyas sku 'khrungs par brten zha lu sku zhad du grags shing / rgyal ba gnyisapa bu ston rin po che'i sbyin bdag gi mthil sku zhang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zur sras dpon kun dga' bsam grub la gzhis dge sdings skal bar phog pa/sa sku zhad dge sdings par grags pa tshong 'dus mthil du gzhis bzung ba'i ming bde rgyas pa zhes gtsang rong gi drung 'khor drag khar gtogs pa'i sku zhang lha a nyan rgyal po'i sras mo ye shes mtsho rgyal bsus pa'i sras su 'phags pa'i yul du stod 'grel ba'i rjes su 'brangs te rab byung du grags pa'i nang tshan shwa bha kṛ zhes pa ljongs 'dir dge byed du 'bod cing 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu zhin yin zhes chu pho stag tu grags pa'i nam mthong zla ba phyi ma'i thabs kyi cha'i dga' ba gnyis pa zla skar rgyal la babs pa'i tshe yum la snyun zug sogs mi bde ba'i rnam pa med par chu shel gyi dbang po shar ri'i phrag pa las thon pa ltar bltams so/ /lha dang rig sngags grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /'chi med lam du bya ltar 'phur ba'i bon/ /g.yung —518

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)drung gshen gyi lugs srol 'dzin pa'i rigs/ /nyang smad sum rtsen skye rgyus mchode pa'i gnas/ /mang bkur gnam bskos rgyal po'i lung bzang pos/ khri dpon las ka 'dzin pa'i mi dbang dang / /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi bka' drin mthus/ /mtho ris sman pa gnyis pa lta bur bkur/ /brtul zhugs grub thon snang rigs 'gro (6na tha'i gnyen/ /'jam mgon bla ma'i sku zhad sa spyod lcam/ /smin legs rtse dga'i cho ga rdzogs pa las/ /rgyal sras gzhen nu'i zla ba gsar du tshes/ /de yang mngal du zhugs pa'i tshe yum gyi mnal lam du mchod rten la skor ba mdzad pa dang dngos su'ang sdor dkar la brten na zo mdog bzang zhing dmar skyur shor na mi bde ba byung 'dug pa bzhin dgung lo bcu bdun bar yab yum gyis sku skyed bsring phyir sha phran bu dbang med kyis bzhesasu bcug na ma gtogos dmar gyi ris la mi dgyes pa yod par snang / sku tshe sngon ma rnams nas glagasalta bu'i 'byung po gdug ba can zhig gis yum sras gnyis ka gshegs par nye ba'i zug rngu drag posagatses pa'i tshe gru rdo rje seng ge la sogs pa rig sngags grub pa'i brtul zhugs can rim par byon pa'i chos rje dgon nub pa gru rig pa 'dzin pa dge bsnyen gyis bgegs bskrod byin rlabs rten 'brel du ma mdzad pas phan ngo tsam las gzhi med du ma gyur na'ang rigs brgya'i bdag po dbang phyug rab brtan nye skor du phebs pa dang 'grig pa'i skyer sgang lugs kyi rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bstsal/ dbu skra bubs kyi bsrung ba dang rdo rje'i ra ba'i khor yug chen po'i nang du chud par mdzad pas bdud rigs kyis brlang por spyod pa'i nus pa mtha' dag nyi zer gyis ba mo la reg pa bzhin sku tshe'i bar chad kyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal bar brten/ bgegs dbang du ma song bar da lta'i bar 'tsho ba 'di bla ma dam pa de nyid kyi bka' drin yin zhes thugs bzo ba'i gsung bgros yang yang gnang / 'on (6ba)kyang bka' las chung ngu'i dus nas btsun pa ma byas par gnyid du song 'phral rmi lam lta bu'i zhakhrul snang za zi la ser ba drag po 'bab pa'i rkang shar shar gyi khrod nas 'bag gyon pa sogs 'jigs gzugs mang pos mtha' bskor nas mi tshugs pa lta bu yong ba zhig rgyun du byung —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shelags shing / deng sang yang dog cha che skabs phran bu yong gi 'dug lags/deng sang gi bar du bya ba che chung ci byed kyang bgegs bar chad re nges par yong gi 'dug gsung ba la dpags na mkhan chen gnas drug pa/ snar thar mkhan po/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po gsum la bsam yas kyi gnas srung chen po'i bar chad byung ba'i gzhan gnyis gshegs/ 'jam dkar gyis thugs sras rin po cher gra lnga'i dbang zhus pas bgegs las grol na'ang / des rin po che gdan sa bar gnod tshul kun mkhyen bus gsungs pa bzhin/ thugs sras rin po che dang 'jam dkar bsu rigs kyi bag chags sad pa'i lha 'dre'i stogs ma byung ba'i nges pa med dam snyam pa'i kun rtog gi ri mor shar mod kha dmar ni gdags par ga la nus/ lo nang der rje rdo rje 'chang gis rjes gnang byin rlabs sogs gsung chos yang yang gnang / gcen chung ngu nas grongs pa'i sri byung dogs kyi lo gcig gi bar gso ba rig pa'i gzhung nas bshad pa ltar zla re bzhin mtshan rim gyis spos pa'i rting ma don grub bsod nams dbang gi rgyal por gsol/dgung lo gnyis tsam gyi dus rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan mjal bar phebs pa na sku rgyab kyi thang kha'i lha mgron rnams la phyag mdzub bstad (7na skos gang yin zhes dri ba gnang bar bla ma dang lha'i rigs 'brul med du ngos 'dzin mdzad pas 'di 'dra ngo shes pa dgod bro ya mtshan che zhes dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang mdzad/ dgung lo bzhi lnga tsam gyi dus rtses po kha sbub pa khri'u shing gi lugs su byas pa'i steng du byams bzhugs mdzad mchod gnas kyi gra pa 'dras sa chog la dbyangs 'then pa dang mnyam du khro spro mdzad pa'i stang ka dang / res gdan sna tshogs brtsegs pa bzhugs khri'i tshul du mdzad rdza brdungs pa'i phye ma dang rnam pa bsres nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbyibs bris te sgrub mchod tshugs pa'i rnam pa dang yum sbyin bdag yin rgyu'i lugs kyi dpon sa rin po che deng sang sku khams bzang po byung ngam gsung ba sogs ni 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje'i sngon gyi bag chags bzang po'i mthu brtas par gdon mi za zhing / rje rdo rje 'chang 'khrul zhig tshul khrims rgyal mtshan du zhakhrungs —520

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)pa'i dus 'khor du yod ces gsung ba la dpags na'ang thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i ring lugs spel ba'i dam pa 'ga' zhig gi rnam par sprul par lung rigs kyis bsgrub nubata sam snyam/dgung lo brgyad bzhes pa sa mo bya'i lo gtsang sde srid nas yab dpon tshang sangs rgyas grags pa rong byams chen gyi gnyer par bskos pas yab sras lhan cig tu phebs/ sngar gyi rgyun bzhin gso rig gi phyogs dpe 'dzin pa sogs sbyong dar gyi dbu btsugs kyang rje nyid dam pa'i chos kho na mdzad pa'i thugs bzhed kyis sku lus bsgyur/thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i lo dga' ldan gyi gnas nas ma pham mgon po zhing 'dir gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta'i tshul (7ba〉zung ba thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i bsti gnas ri phug chos kyi pho brang du dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs rje btsun dbang phyug rab brtan gyi zhabs drung du phebs nas gtsug phud phul ba'i mtshan bsod nams dbang por gsol/ slar yab kyi khyad nas byams chen du byon 'di lo rje rdo rje 'chang yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sder rjes res chibs kha bskyod pa'i zham ring du khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba byon par rong dga' ldan byams pa gling du thog ma'i mjal 'dzom mdzad/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dbang rjes gnang rigs mi gcig pa bco brgyad tsam gsan pa'i dang por grub thob kyi 'khor los sgyur ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ྅ pa'i bzhed srol dpal kye rdo rje'i man ngag lugs ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du rgyu dus kyi dbang gis smin par mdzad pa sku tshe 'di la thugs kyis dran pa'i dbang gi thog ma yin gsung ba bu lugs la dus 'khor gsang 'dus rdor dbyings sogs gtso bor mdzad na'ang thog ma'i 'jug sgo spyir rje btsun gong ma'i bzhed pa dang / yang sgos kha'u brag rdzong pa nas brgyud pa'i gnyis med dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i dbang thog mar gsan pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi bstan pa la mchog tu bya ba mdzad pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig par mngon/mkhan rin po ches nged deng sang skyed tshal gyi mkhan po bzhag nas rong dkar chos su (8na)ri khrod byed kyin yod kyang khyod rang mtshan nyid kyi yon tan ma rdzogs par bdag gis skyed tshal du bsdad nas —521

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pebartsi bzhag sogs thos bsam gyi mgo 'don byas gra skor zin nas ngas ri khrod la phyin khyed rang zha lu pa dang sa lugs kyi sngags chos la bslab sbyang byas na yong phebs par thugs la dgyes tshor dpag tu med pa byung na'ang mkhan rin po che srod thun la thugs rig dang sa khyad kyis rtsig pa'i steng du thugs dam gnang ba bstan pa'i bgegs chags kyi rnam pas sku rbab gshor ba'i rkyen gyis ma dang mkha' 'gro grong khyer chen por sku'i bkod pa bsdus pas/ skyed tshal du mtshan nyid thugs gnyer mdzad pa'i gra gshol te ri phug tu phebs/dge slong rin chen 'phel zhes bu lugs kyi cho ga phyag len rnams shin tu byang zhing rje rdo rje 'chang sogs dam pa du ma'i zhabs la gtugs te mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi thugs dam smin pa de la gnas kyi slob dpon zhus/ rgyud sde gong 'og gi dkyil 'khor mang po thugs 'dzin dang phyag khrid sogs nyin mtshan thang lhod med pa lta bus thugs gnyer la 'grus par mdzad/ rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po lha bo pa rin chen rgya mtsho la thog mar dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi dbang bcu bzhi rdzogs par gsan/ rje nyid kyi dge rgan rin chen 'phel dang bla chen bsam grub rgyal mtshan gnyis bka' bgros pa'i bu ston bka' 'bum gyi lung rgyun chad du nye bar 'dug pas rin po che dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la zhus pa 'gab tshul ltar ston lo de gar dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel mchan bu bcas pa rdzogs par gsan nas bka' 'bum rim gyis zhu ba'i dbu btsugs/chu mo (8bskong lo mkhan rin chen rgya mtsho'i drung du dbang chos 'ga' zhig gsan/ bka' las/bdag gi dge rgan rin chen 'phel gyi gsung las bslab gnyer dang chos zhu ba'i mjug 'khyongs pa gyis/ dgon pa che chung gi kha 'dzin bsko bzhag byas pa'i bla ma ma byed/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i ring lugs kyis gtsos pa'i grub mtha' phyogs med kyi chos la thos bsam sgom gsum dang 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum g.yel med ngos bsnyen sgrub thugs dam la brtson po mdzod/ rang gzhan gyi bstan pa thams cad la phan thogs yong / dbus nas dpon slob gnas gsar nas phebs byung na gsung chos —522

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanazhu gang thub dang / ngor sgrub khang du dbang chos sgra'i ri mo sogs zhu dgos tshul thugs rtsar bcar ba'i bslab ston yang nas yang du mdzad/ dge rgan de deng sang yang dran po rang yong gi 'dug ces gsung ba drin du bzo ba'i dam pa'i rnam thar du snang / dge slong rin chen 'phel zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du bsnyung ba'i dus rin po che lha bo pa gdan drangs nas bdag gi dge gzhen 'di la kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che yab sras nas brgyud pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rnams gnang thub pa rang sku mkhyen no zhes don gnyer chen pos zhal chems bzhag /kun dga' zhes pa shing pho stag gi lor sa skya nas bdag chen rin po che 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po zha lur phug tu phebs pa'i tshe byang gling bla brang du tshigs snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes pa'i dus gtsug phud 'dreg pa'i skabs kyi khrus chu'ang rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mkhri po'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu rgyun 'dres (9na)pa'i kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i bum chu nas gnang / mtshan rin chen bsod nams mag grub tu gso le/ sang chibs kha sgyur ba gnang rgyu'i dgongs/phyag mdud/ bdud mi ril bu/ bum chu chen mo nas chu bum chung gang / zang:nga gi bdog pa'i tshan grangs/cha su sti/ 'jam dbyangs ngo bo bla ma'i mchog /bsod nams ye shes mthar phyin pa'i/ /chos kyi dbang po dam pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis sgro mes/ /sarba ma bla lo zhes phyag bris su mdzad de stsal nasa'adi ngag tu 'don pa dang / nga bya 'gyur du gsung ngag 'chad pas de dus slebs pa gyis/ khyed la sa paṇa gyi sdom rgyun zhig dgos pa 'dug pas lo nyi shu lon nas nga'i rtsar shog /gnas gsar rje drung dbusanas byon byung na chos zhus gsung ba sogs thugs rtsar bcar ba'i bslab ston mang du phebs 'dug pas/ bu ston rin po che'i bum chu ni rje 'di nyid kyis sa zhal gyi dbang gi rgyun thams cad dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas rgya cher spel te bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa dang / 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen gyi sdom rgyun bzhes dgos sogs ma 'ongs mngon sum du mkhyen pa'i lung bstan du 'dug pa bdag chen 'di nyid slob dpon chen po pad+ma'i rnam sprul du grags pa don la gnas pa'i dpon slob gnyis ka'i che bar mngon no/ /—523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ loselcags stod du phebs nas bdag cag gi ston pa'i gser sku'i rten dang bcas pa'i bka' shog bslab ston zhib 'khod gnang zhing / rting sor zhabs drung khri chen gzhis ka rtser phebs dus mjal ba gnang skabs sngar lugs ltar thugs rjes 'dzin pa'i dgyes nyams ci yang gnang nyid (9ba tsher bras sil yu thung gang gi gsol ras mdzad nas 'di su la'ang ma ster bar btsun chung rang zo gsung ba ltar chos rje kun bkras pas phyag mdzod kyi sbug tu zar bcug nas lhag ma lus pa bzhes pa yang rje btsun gong ma'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pas thugs kyi bum bzang bltams pa'i rten 'brel yin nam snyam mo/ /sngon goms ma 'dris 'gror brtse'i snying rje'i gzugs/ /na tshod ches phra'i shel la tshon ris bzhin/ /'a zha'i rje btsun mthu stobs me dpung rtser/ /glags lta'i sbur ma ming gi lhag mar byas/ /bzang po'i bag chags mthu brtas ngo mtshar gyi/ /ri mo gzhen nu'i dus shar dri za'i rgyud/ /dang por brdungs tshe dman cha bzung ba'i gzings/ /mngon sum gsal ba'i mtsho nang zhig 'di ci/ /kun mkhyen bla ma'i gdan sa ri phug tu/ /kun spangs chos rje'i gdung 'tshob gnas gsar bar/ /kun nas dang bas gtsug phud nyer phul tshe/ /kun dga' bsod nams zhing gi dbang por son/ /pang nas skyes dang nye rgyal ji bzhin du/ /mched zla rje btsun dbon dang thog mar rje/ /thar pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor smin byed nor/ /bde legasa'adod dgu'i gru char che cher bab/ /sdom brtson rin chen 'phel dang lha chen rje/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sogs bshes gnyen 'gas/ /bu ston chos rje'i gsung rab 'chi med kyi/ khang bzang 'jug pa'i chos kyi them skas btsugs/ /'jam dbyangs dbang po'i drung du rab byung tshe/ /ma 'ongs mngon sum mkhyen nas brda thabs dang / /dgyes zhal 'dzum pa'i lung bstan thog babs pas/ /skyengs (10na)te pad+ma ka ra rnga yab bzhud/ /tshar chen chos rgyal po/ thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i zhabs/ mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel te yab sras bzhi ka la zab rgyas chos kyi bka' drin rgya cher gsan pa'i grang chen slob dpon kun spangs pa rin po che shākya seng ge la mnyam sbyor rigs bsdus dang rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs thun mong ma yin pa lha bcu gsum ma/ e —524
