zha lu lo chen rin wo bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanawaṃ shar khang pa mnga' ris pa nam mkha' dpal ldan la bde mchog pad+ma dra ba/ dpal 'khor chos sde nas rin po che lha bo pa gdan drangs te sngon ma'i 'phros kyi dbang mang du gsan/ bu lugs kyi dbang phal cher grub pa'i rjes su phyag gi rdor dril rje 'di nyid la gnang nas rdor dril bla ma'i phyag tu 'phrod do zhes thugs dgyes pa'i nyams gang yang mdzad cing / thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston nas brgyud pa'i rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dbang yang gnang /bod 'dir brtsams chos kyi gsung 'bum bla ma dam pa dang chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis las mang ba yod tshad du mi 'dug cing / bu ston rin po che'i mdo phyogs kyi gsung rab ni thor bu ma gtogs phal cher chad nas lung rgyun khungs ma mi 'dug na'ang sngags sogs gang yod phal cher bla chen bsam rgyam pas do dam mdzad nas rin po che dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyi drung du tshang bar gsan/'jam dkar ma ti lugs kyi ljags bsnyen 'bru 'bum ma sha'i las sbyor bcas pa gnang pas sku na smin par song nas kyang dbang 'khrid rjes gnang sogs gang la'ang thogs pa med pa'i mkhyen rab rje btsun (10ba)brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i byin rlabs kyi bdud rtsis thugs kyi za ma tog yongs su gtams par nges rnyed kyi dad pa ci yang 'phel/ shing yos ngor e waṃ chos ldan du phebs/ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub la bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos gtsos pa'i dbang cho sgo 'ga' zhig gsan/ thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad lugs kyi bslab bya zhib tu stsal zhing thugs mos kyang lhag par che bar byung bas bka' drin che ba'i bla ma gcig tu mdzad/ phyir byon nas sman khang du yab yum gnyis kyis khur bzhes pa'i 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje'i bka' 'bum po ti gcig 'bri ba'i snag shog yig mkhan rin po che lha bo pa dang / slob dpon dkon rgyan pa gnyis gdan drangs pa'i zhabs tog 'bul ba sogs kyi mthun rkyen sbyar/me 'brug bu lugs kyi dkyil chog mang po dang yo ga pa rin chen tshe dbang gis mdzad pa'i yig cha rnams thugs 'dzin dang gar thig gi sbyong dar nan tan du mdzad/—523

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo'ame mo sbrul lo rje rdo rje 'chang gis zhabs drung dbon rin po che yar klungs bkra shis rtse chos sde'i gdan sar rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol ri phug tu phebs/ rje 'di nyid kyis mjal bar byon par sngar rgyun bzhin thugs dgyes pa chen po mdzad/ bde mchog bde chen ral gcig gi smin grol gnyis dkon zhing ya bral lta bur gyur pa'i grol bde sems nyid ngal gso'i nyams 'khrid kyis gtsos dbang chos kha yar gsan mur rang bstan kha'u brag rdzong pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa chen po glang bu nas 'jam dbyangasachos skyong dbang phyug byon pa'i dpon slob gnyis (11na lko.o sa cig par rdo rje nag po chen po'i brag rdzong ma phyi nang gsang gsum gyi nyams 'khrid zab mo sa skya tshad kyi rna bar ma grags shing rdo ring dbon po kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs 'khrid gzhung dngos bstan gyi yig nag thug phrad du 'jog pa tsho dang mi 'dra ba'i snying khrag gi zungs lta bu'i zhal shes kyis brgyan pa smin rgyas/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras lnga phrag lnga'i rjes gnang gang rnyed kyi las tshogs lung sogs gsan/ ring por ma lon par ngor nas mkhas grub chen po dpal ldan don grub phebs par mgon chen gyi gsang 'khrid la'ang thun mong ba rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa dang / thun mong ma yin pa gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud du byon pa gnyis las phyi ma'i bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor gyi zab 'khrid gzhan yang gdugs dkar zhe gnyis ma'i dbang sogs zhu ba mdzad pa dang lhan cig par rje 'di nyid dang glang phu chos rje gnyis kyis kyang gsan/ ston rdo rje 'chang glang phur gdan drangs pa'i zhabs 'bring du phebs/ glang phu nas sbyin bdag zhus/pa'i byang gter gyi thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol sgrub chen la brten nas skye bdun ril sgrub bdun ril sgrub kyi tshe gzungs thog rdo rje slob dpon chen po dang / glang phu chos rje/ rje nyid dka' bcu pa grags pa bkra shis bzhis 'dzin pa'i thun dpon mdzad nas yi ge bcu ma dang gsung mi chad du 'dzab khor yug gi dang dngos gzhi grol nas skya ser rnams la sgrub dbang dang ril bu bkye ba sogs kyi phyag g.yog gnang bas skal ba bzang dgongs pa'i dgyes rtser son/ de nas glang phu'i (11ba)zhal ngo rnams la rdo rje nag po chen po'i brag rdzong ma phyi nang gsang gsum gyi —526

zha lu lo la rin byu bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtana'akhrid/phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor/thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gsung 'bum sogs chos mang du gnang ba rnams lhan du gsan/klu khang du skye ba kun tu rjes su 'dzin par gsol btab gnang bar rdo rje 'chang gis zhal gyis 'tshes/khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan brgya tshor phebasapa'i zhabs phyir 'byon rtsis la zha lu nas gdan 'dren byung ba'i phyir bteg zhen dga' ba gdong du bzhugs sar rdo rje la4 tshar pa chos rje'i phyag bris dpe mang du byung ba slar rdo rje 'chang dang mjal skabs 'bul ba mdzad/'phags yul nas nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i paṇ+ḍita khungs btsun byon pa'i rjes ma paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen nas brgyud pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug gi nyams 'khrid rin po che shākya seng ge la rgyas par gsan/sor sdud kyi skabs mun mtshams zhag bdun mdzad/chag lo gsum pa rin r+pā chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i dus 'khor chos khrung sogs lung mang du gsan/rdo rje 'chang shangs nas sa pho rta'i lo ri phug tu phebs sku mtshams yun ring bar gnang ba grol rjes sgrub khang nas mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub dang lhan cig tu dus 'khor sdom chen gyi dbang /gur mgon gyi rjes gnang kha shas/snyan brgyud kha skong sogs be'u bum phal cher gyi lung dang rje nyid kyis sger du 'jigs byed rwa lugs 'od zer dri med gtsug tor dri med phyag rdor 'gro bzang gi dbang dang lung rjes gam/nga nga rgyu gsan/ bdag 'khrul zhig rin po che'i dus zhabs phyir e yod zhus 2napas yod gsung /rgyal yum tshul khrims bzang mo'i dus e yod zhus pas med pa 'dra gsung /zla gcig par brag rdzong ma'i bsnyen mtshams gnang ba'i skabs zhal 'don mdzad rgyu'i gsol 'debasazhig zhus par slo ka gsum pa zhig gi kha yig la ri phug dbu mdzad chen mo'i thugs dam zhes gnang ba de skabs nyams 'char lta bu las dgung lo bcu bdun tsam las mi 'gro gshis de 'dra'i dogs gnas phyi nang su la'ang med rung /don du lkog gyur gyi chos mngon sum du gzigs pa'i lung bstan la thugs nges lhag par rnyed/re zhig brtag gnyis thugs 'dzin sogs gsan sbyong mdzad/sa lug lo rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i bsnyen chen / ba bdun mdzad skabs nub kyi mtshan lam du ha

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sheshang gi cha byad can gzugs bongs che ba rta pa mang po'i 'khor gyis bskor ba ri phug gi ma ṇi chen mo'i thad tsam du yod mur gzims khang du 'tshangs nas sbug der 'od mer re bsdad song ba thugs 'jigs zhum pa'i snang ba shar zhing sang nyin rgya 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin nam dgongs pa'i rdo rje 'chang la zhu yig phul ba'i lan du bzlog 'khor gyi rtse la bskyon gsung ba bzhin mdzad kyang rgya 'dre de gdug rtsub che ba yod tshod nas srod thun zhig la dngos su sdig pas zhabs kyi brla nang la so btab pa phyag gis bzung nas phyir 'phangs pa na shi zin 'dug pas bslab ston zhus par ro de bzhugs gdan 'og tu chug gsung ba bzhin bcug /de skabs spyan gyis gzigs par ma zad thugs nyams la shar tshad kyi snod bcud mtha' dag rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan yin dgongs pa'i zhabs sa la 'degs 'jog mi nus pa lta bu (12ba〉grang ba'i rgyu mtshan zhur btang ba'i lan du gnas lugs rang ngo rang shes don dam gyi mgon po yin/ dus thams cad du bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi thugs dam dang ma bral ba mdzod ces zhal gdams gnang / don du gang snang thams cad bla ma'i rnam par shar ba 'di gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i gsung bsnyen gyi rtags su 'dug /rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan ston lcags stod du dbang gzhi mdzad nas ri phug tu phebs pa dus mtshungs sku mtshams grol ba 'grig nas rje 'di nyid kyis mjal bar phebs pas de nub bzhugs me'i sar tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston gnang / bka' las 'o me 'dis lhab lhab byas pa dang dran gsos byung mdang rmi lam du thams cad mkhyen pa phebs pa zhig byung ba de ring khyed 'byon par lta ba 'dug phebs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa la mchog tu 'gyur bar don gyis dbugs dbyung mdzad pa 'dra/lcags sprel lo lho gser mdzod ser po nas byon pa'i rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi ljags bsnyen zhag nyer gcig gnang / yar klungs nas khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po phebs pa dang lhan cig par snang srid kyi chos thams cad rgyud gsum gyi dregs pa'i rnam rol gsang ba rang sems gnas lugs don dam gyi mgon por ngo sprod pa'i man ngag gi nying khu rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i gsang 528

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)'khrid thun mong ma yin pa zla ba gsum gyi bar smin rgyas su gsan pa'i tshe nub cig grib gnon gyi rnam pa byung bar rgyu mtshan zhus pa na nag po chen po 'grub pa'i rtags su bshad pas ngan rgyu med tsam las gsal bar ma gsungs (13na)kyang lugs 'di la rtags mtshan shin tu legs par ngos 'dzin mdzad srol snang / shā sa na'i ljags bsnyen gyi sku mtshams dam par mdzad pa'i 'bum phrag gnyis tsam nasagayin rkyen gyis lor lus par da dung yang byed dgos rgyu yin pa 'dra zhes yang yang gsung / rtsisaganas gsar gyi dkon gnyer gyis rdo rje 'chang la rtsis mgon gyis rjes gnang zhu yi 'dug pa'i zlar lhan du gsan/ dkon gnyer de dang ngor pa'i gra pa kha shas la rje nyid kyis shākya thub pa gtso 'khor dgu pa'i dbang mdzad/lcags mo bya lo klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gsol btab mdzad pa dang phyogs mthun par rje bka' 'gyur ba dang mkhan chen zha lu pa gnyis kyis kyang gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dbang chos mang du gsan/ gtsang sdo srid nas snar thang thar pa zha lu sogs dpon rnying du ma'i nyams gsos mdzad pa dang 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dag zhing du gshegs pa dus mtshungs pa'i mkhan po med pa nas zha lu'i mkhan por sku zhang bsko ba'i sgo dod/ las sne ba rnams kyis gra rgyun thams cad 'du dgos pa'i brda rgyag la brten rje 'di nyid kyang bka' chos gsan 'phror phebs dgos shar ba thugasashin tu ngal ba byung rung gnang thabs zad cing rdo rje 'chang yang thugs 'phreng ba'i sgo nas sku chos bzhes 'phro dang sku phya ma legs po zhig gnang / chos 'phror lus pa thugs kyis ma bzod pa'i rgyu mtshan dang bcas bslab ston rgyas par stsal/ zha lu gser bkang du mkhan po bsko ba sogs za zi rnams rim gyis zhi ba'i tshe rje rdo rje (13ba 'chang dgon pa sgyi lung pas gdan drangs pa'i zhabs phyir byon/ thugs rje chen po nyon mongs rang grol gyi sgo nas skye bdun sgrub pa'i phyag phyi mdzad/ yang 'ug /bla ma skyid lung pa sogs stod smad kyi sngags 'chang ches mang ba 'dus pa dang zhabs drung dbon rin po che sogs la bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub dbang gnang ba dang phyogs mtshungs su —529

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)gsan/ de dus sde srid nas rin lding slob dpon du 'byon dgos pa'i bka' shog byung / dbang grol nas zha phur dpon slob phyogs mthun du phebs/ ri phug tu rdo rje 'chang gi sku zhabs su gdan gzos dang tshe dpag med kyi skus gtsos gnang sbyin bzabs rgyas bkra shis tshigs bcad mang du gsung zhing phyag nas 'thor ba'i byin rlabs gnang mjug tu/ bltas pa tsam gyis srid gsum dbang du sdud/ khes sogs gsungs nas rje 'dir rnying ma ba zhig byas byung ang gsungs/ zhabs drung dbon rin po che nas dung chos legs po zhig gis gtsos pa'i gnang sbyin mdzad/ dpon slob thams cad phan tshun 'bral mi phod pa lta bu'i ngang nas rje nyid kyis nyang stod phyogs su bteg /rin sding pa rnams kyis chibs bsu thab bsu bzabs rgyas dang bcas rin cen lding khang phub pa'i sngags grwar phebs/rnga chen zhes pa chu pho khyi'i lo hor gyi zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin dpal ldan rnal 'byor rgyud rgyal gyi ston pa rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i seng ge'i khrir phebs par rgyal rtse rdzong dang bla brang dkar po nas bsko 'ja'i gnang skyes/ dge 'dun tshogs pas bgegs skrod dang bkra shis mnga' gsol rgyas par (14nasgo dzad/ sngar slob dpon par phyag mi 'tshal ba'i brgya 'og gi drung 'khor rnams kyis kyang gus pa'i sor bcu snying khar sbyar ba sogs mchod yon thams cad thugs yid gcig 'dres kyi dga' ston phun sum tshogs pa mdzad do/ /mkhas grub yongs 'dzin tshangs pa'i ral klung nas/ /mkhyen brtson skal ldan shing rtas nyer drangs pa/ /dbang lung rigs gtad rjes gnang gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /'thung nus dza hū de gzhan na su/ khyad par dkyil 'khor bya ba spro bsdu'i mgon/ /rin chen chos kyi 'byung gnas rgya mtsho'i rlabs/ /legs bshad yol med phyag mtshan yongs gtad pa/ /bu ston bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol bzhin/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i brag ri mthor brtsegs rdzong / khyud gsum dregs pa gsal stong zung 'jug tu/ /ngo sprod mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs snyan brgyud kun/ /pha rgod gnas gsar chos rje'i drin las rnyed/ /yid 'phrog lta na sdug pa'i skyed tshul du/ /zla med bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral bar/ zhal 'ches nyi ma'i gnyen dang —530

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)kun dga' bo'i/ /rjes 'gro'i rnam thar 'di ko gcig tu mtshar/ /ma rbadas rgya 'drer dzuba'i snying dron khrag /mi'u thung srin po'i zhal sgor hub kyis drangs/ /gang snang bla ma'i ngo bor rtag 'char ba/ /rab 'byams dag pa'i zhing gi bkod par 'gran/ /sum rtsen sal 'phos 'dra nyang stod yul/ /rin chen lding khang phub pa'i gzhal med cher/ khyab bdag rnam par snang mdzad mtshams sprin mdog /gsar pa'i bla gos 'chang la gcig tu brel/ /mi ring bar ri phug tu rje rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs drung du byon rin po che gser gyi (14bsgo ṇ+ḍal bteg nas rigs 'dzin chen po'i gter gsar bla ma bka' brgyad yongs 'dus dang drag po dbu dgu'i dbang gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i chos ci rigs gsan/ phyir phebasanas rin lding 'du khang gi shing rtsi ldebs bris kyi khur bzhes dang sgrub mchod bskang ba gzhan don gyi 'phrin las sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa gong 'phel gyi ngang nas ring por ma lon par bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dgongs pa bstad pa de yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tshosasad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba nas bzung so thar gyi sdom rgyun dar rgyas su gyur pa rgyal po dar masabastan pa rma byung ba'i rjes su dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis mdo smad nas bstan pa'i me ro gsos te rje btsun sa paṇa yan chad kyi sdom rgyun phal cher bla chen dang pā la rnam pa gsum nas dar pa'i stod 'dul ba'i rgyun yang byung mod/ da smi ra pa'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa chen po bod du phebs pa nasabazung tshogs sde bzhi dang 'jam mgon sa paṇa nas brgyud par paṇa chen brgyud pa zhes snyan grags che zhing bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal pa/ kun mkhyen bu/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang grags pa sogs mkhas grub phal cher sdom rgyun 'di nas bzhes pa mang zhing / khyad par der phyogs su bsnyen rdzogs kyi gra bzang ba nas dpal e waṃ chos ldan yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gtsug lag khang du mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag tshul khrims kyi dri bsung gis phyogs kun tu khyab pas 'phags pa nye bar 'khor sa 'dir byon pa lta bu brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te yongs rdzogs (15na lnga stan pa'i mnga' bdag sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub kyis —531—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)mkhan po/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi la mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po brang ti pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas kyis las kyi slob dpon/ mkhas grub shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas kyis gsang ston/ dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su dge bsnyen nas bzung bsnyen rdzogs kyi dus sgo brjod pa'i bar 'dul lung rgya bod kyi rnam bshad rnams kyi dgongs pa bzhin grangs gsum du gcod pa sogs phyag len shin tu dngos gtsang ba'i sgo nas khrag skyug ces pa chung phag chu stod zla ba'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba'i tshe yongs su rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po rnam par dag pa bzhes te nyon mongs pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba ni/ sum brgya par/ nyon mongs dgra g.yul rgyal byed tshul khrims te/ /nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spong / /dpal 'byor sa dang me tog mda' can 'joms/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal snod dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pa'i don thog tu babs shing mkhan slob khungs btsun de dag 'bad pas 'tshol ba'ang rdo rje 'chang tshar chen gyis/ deng dus 'di na kha cig gzhan dbang gis/ /rang yul bla ma tshul 'chal dag la nod/ /g.yin dag bsams bzhin thag ring sar bgrod nas/ /chen po hor 'dra'i spyod tshul can la zhu/ /bdag gis tshe 'di'i ngo srung rgyab tu bor/ /phyi ma'i don chen 'ba' zhig snying nas bsams/ /yongs rdzogs kha che'i paṇa (15bskon bsod snyoms pa/ shwakya shrī'i grwar ni 'bad pas zhugs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don kho nar snang /rin lding 'du khang gi shing rtsi ldebs bris grub pa'i rab gnas la zha lu nas mkhan po sku zhang gdan drangs/ thugs brel rnams chod nas slar ri phug tu byon/ ngor nas mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub phebs pa'i rdo rje 'chang dang zhal 'dzom gyi dpon slob gnyis gar chos ka gsan bzhin pa'i mkhan po sku 'ad dang rje 'di nyid sogs kha shas la rin po che sgrub khang nas kyis sgrub thabs brgya rtsa gnang ba'i skabs gtsang sde srid rgyal rtser bzhugs thog gzug po nas la bka' bkyon gnang rtsis rdzong dpon dpon g.yog trags pa thugs blor ma chud pa'i nyer gsum la bong gong nas kyi dge rtsa'i bka' —532

zha lu lo r+ṣa rin r+pā bsod na mtshomachog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtana'agyur la phyag nas gnang bar bsnyad btags kyis gzug po nas 'byor lags 'khor bcas gragasayul chos sder brdzangs/chos sde'i slob dpon rnams kyang nyi ma rtser shar la mar rten r+ṣa mo'i mdor gdan 'dren la 'byor dgos pa'i brda 'grems byung bar brten 'phros byung 'phral sgrub thabasabargya rtsa 'phror bzhag ste bshad nas phebs pas mtshan phyed tsam la chos sder 'byor/sang nyin slob dpon rnams kyis phebs bsur byon pa dang rtse'i brgya sgo bsdams gzug po nas la bka' bkyen yin 'dug zer bas gdan 'dren pa rnams so sor gyes/re zhig de gar stan chags nas: mo sgrub mchod dang dgun chos sogs rgyas par mdzad/slar ri phug tu rdo rje 'chang gi bslab ston bzhin bla ma bka' brgyad yongs 'dus kyi ljagasabasnyen gnang /shing byi'i lo rdo rje lang dbang phyug rab khrin〉rtan tshar r+pā chos kyi rgyal po'i gdan sar phebs pa'i legs 'bul la byon/rje bla ma'i sku rim la sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sbyin sreg gang mang dang /gtsug rta me 'bar ma'i chu bzlog mdzad/dge slong r+pā po mkhas grub par thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i 'od zer dri med kyi srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga'i lung gsan/phyir phebs nas rdo rje 'chang la le 'di tsam bzhugs kyi zhal bzhes dgos pa'i zhu yig 'bul ba gnang ba'i lan du khyad kyi ngor lo lnga sdod pa'i mnyam gzhag brtan po byed gsung ba'i zhal len 'byor/rin lding gi slob dpon sdo srid du nan bskyed kyis khrol cha zhus nas rtsis sprod sogs kyi thugs brel dang 'grig pa'i 'dar du gsung ngag rin po che gsan par 'phros byang yang phebs ma thub/de nas lo lnga tsam gyi bar ri phug tu bcar btsos ngos chos brgyad kyi bun long mtha' dag rgyab tu bskyur nas yi mas de mi mkhyen pa lta bu'i brtson pas bgrang yas rgyud sdo rgya mtsho'i pha ro 'khu son pa'i thugs gnyer smar bar mdzad/skabs shig 'dar du rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud tshugs par brda byung rung zha lu'i gra rgan 'dras bslab gnyer la gnod ces phebs ma bcug pas thugs 'phreng yang gnang thebs dang bral/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shenub cig mnal lam du sngar brag rdzong ma'i ljags bsnyen dus byung ba'i hwa shang de yin rgyu'i khul zhig gis gzims khang steng gi rgyal mtshan dar lcog sogs rgyan du ma 'dug pa rnams bcag song ba zhig byung ba sang nang par ldum rar byon pas byang chub shing gi sdong po de yang dngos (16ba)su skams tshar ba gzigs gshis bar chad du dgongs nas 'dar du zhu yig phul ba'i lan du/ rgyal ba kun dngos mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi /thugs sras dam pa dbang phyug rab brtan la/ /mi phyed dad pas snying nasagasol 'debs na/ /bdag sogs bstos bcas 'bral med thugs rjes bzung / /gang byung thugs rjer shes pa'i mos gus kyis/ /bgegs dang bar chad gang gis mi brdzi bar/ /ci bsams don kun 'bad med lhun grub nas/ /bstan dang 'gro don mkha' khyab 'gyur bar shog /ces pa'i smon lam yang stsal/sa 'brug lo 'dar du phyag 'bul la phebs pa na 'u cag dpon slob mjal ba'i dus kyang byung zhes dgyes pa chen pos chos mang du gsungs/ khyad par thams cad mkhyen pa bu'i rim lnga'i 'khrid yig za ma tog dang / kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i kha 'byed lde mig sbyar ba'i nyams 'khrid rgyas par gsan pa'i tshe mnal lam 'dzin pa gnang bar zin nas yum bde dog ci 'dra yod dam dgongs gzigs par phebs pa zha lu'i gtsug lag khang gi 'gag der byon pa dang mnal sad/ de dus paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags sku rkyang gis tshom chen du rdo rje 'chang la gsung chos gsan pa'i tshe rje nyid gzims chung sbug tu bzhugs yod pa gsung chos kyi mtshams shig la shar mar phebs nas kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i bstan pa zha lu pa'i grub mtha' 'dzin par gzhan chos lugs mang po bgrangs nas mthar g.yin su'ang mi yong pas nyid kyi pho rgyab cig ces bslab ston gnang ba sogs la thugs mos che bar 'dug rung gsung chos zhu ba ni stabs 'grig (17na)pa zhig ma byung bar gda'/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bar tshig sgra'i khyad nas bla brang rtser phun tshogs dngos grub ma'i lung rdor dbyings kyi dbang sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig stsal/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi srung yig zhu ba gnang 'dug pa 'di lta ste/—534

zha lu lo chen rin wo bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)oṃ su sti/ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi bka'/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po'i lung / ma he'i zhal gyi rnal 'byor pa rdo rje 'dzin pa dbang phyug rab brtan dpal bzang po'i yi ge /khamasagasum du gtagos shing sa gsum du rgyu ba'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad kyis dgongasashing nges rgyu/ nged kyi rdo rje'i slob bu rgyud sde 'dzin pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po 'di nyid bstan 'gro'i don dang rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum dang gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la sogs pa lugs gnyis bya ba gang dang ci byed kyang khyod yul khams so so'i lha 'dre mi gsum gyis gus pa'i bkur sti mchod bstod snyan spel dge ba'i grogs su gang 'gro bgyid pa ma gtogs bsam gtan gyi bgegs dang bar chad du 'gro ba skad cig kyang ma byed/ gal te gong las 'gal 'byung na rdo rje 'jigs byed rab tu khros pas 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zas skal du gtod pa nges par gyis/ 'di'i do dam ched gnyer dgos pa rgyal po chen po rnam thos srasa'akhor dang bcas pa dang gnod sbyin chen po beg tse ba 'khor dang bcas pas nyin mtshan du bsrung (17ba tshe skyob g.yel ba med par mdzod/ ces rnam byung zhes pa sa pho 'brug gi lo zla ba drug pa'i tshesadrug gi nyin grang chen bla brang rdo rje'i pho brang nas bris/ zhes pa stsal/ de nas ri phug tu phebs/ rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po ri phug dbu mdzad rin chen rgya mtsho lo sngon ma'i ma he'i 'tshub kyi rnam pa yin nam gang ltar rgyal mkhar spel gzhir sku gshegs pas gzhis ka rtse nas 'og tho dgos phebs pa bzhin rje nyid dang bla chen bsam rgyam pa gnyis phul ba/ sde srid kyi phebs sgor nged rang gi 'dod par rin lding bla ma rnying pa yin pas 'bod mkhan thongs phebs pa bzhin 'phros byung 'phral byon ba'i dgongs khrel nan chags zhu ba gnang rtsis la sku ngos kyis rin lding gi slob dpon rgyun ring ma song yang khrol cha byasapa yin/ da lam dgongs pa zhu re ma byed ces pa'i lung lci bas de rigs kyi spros pa dang bral te gsol dpon skyid stod nas dang thugs nang gtsang gshis bka' gros gnang bar da cha bskyar zhus mdzad nas—333

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)dgongs khrel yong / de las rgya mkhar bla gzhis 'jags pa'i bka' 3|ga zhu ba 'thad tshul byung ba bzhin dbu mdzad kyi ring 'jags pa'i smin grub kyang byung /zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug la ri phug dbu mdzad du phebs pa'i bsko 'ja'i gnang sbyin dang bka' shog sgrog par bde rgyas pa a bar lha rgyal rdzong bda' mdzad/ 'dar nas rdo rje 'chang yab sras kyis thugs sras sems dpa' chen po sogs bla ma na rim gyi dbang bum cha/ rdo rje dril bus gtsos pa'i bdog pa/ ngor nas sgrub khang thar rtse klu sdings pa bcas bla brang khag /nyar phyogs kyi sde dpon sbyin bdag gzhis byes kyi gra pa la (18na)sogs so so nas legs skyes kyi tshan grangs ring du bstar/ sgyed bu kha spro rgyas par gnang / /rin po che dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang bla ma bsam grub rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje'i phyag len ji lta ba'i sa gar gyi khro spro/ gar dbyangs/phyag rgya/ cho ga'i khrigs rnams zhib mor phul ba bzhin sa sprul sgrub mchod chen mo'i dus gnang ba kun ya mtshan du 'dzin/ 'dar du phyag 'bul la phebs thog zhabs drung dbon rin po che dang lhan cig par stag tshang lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i mngon dkyil gyi steng nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun nas bdag po chen po'i bar tshang bar gsan pa'i nub rdo rje 'chang gi 'od gsal du byang gling rje dgyes tshul bstan pa chos bdag por sprad pa la dgongs pa 'dra/ gzhis ka rtser rtag brtan sprul sku rin po cher nyi ma spas pa'i lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rjes gnang sogs chos kha yar gsan/ dus 'khor gsar 'gyur zhig yod gsung ba dgos tshul zhus par dbang rdzas mi 'grig 'dug pas slar rtag brtan du byed gsungs kyang do gal ma gnang bar ma phebs/ dbang rdzas de dbang gsum pa'i dus phyag rgya ma dngos su gtod pa'i so thar gyi bstan pa 'jig thub nges shes pa zhig yod par snang ba jo bo chen pos/ gsang ba shes rab dbang skur ni/ /tshangs par spyod pas blang mi bya/ /zhes dus la ma babs par dngos dbang bkag pas tshul de 'dra rnam dag bstan pa'i gras su mi 'gro bar ma zad rje 'di nyid sku shin tu btsun pas bzhugs gral de 'drar ga la (18ba)phebs/ lhun rtse bde —536

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ lhanaskyid gling lcags ri kha stod kyi mchod gzhis la brten pa'i dbyar chos dgun chos ma chad tsam yod pa dang dus mchod chen mos mtshon sgrub mchod kyi rdo rje slob dpon la chag med 'byon pa sogs thugs khur che bzhes gnang ba na gal chung chos su byas pa'i cher rlom gyi spyod tshul dang mi 'dra ba'i dam pa'i rnam par thar pa ngo mtshar bar mngon/lcags mo lug lo 'dar du phebs rje rdo rje 'chang gi bka' las/ zha lu'i gra pa kha ya lkog po mtsho'i zlar bzhugs pa las 'dir byon nas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen sgrub cig mdzad na yong gnang bar/ re zhig sde srid nas dgongs pa mi khrol tshul zhu ba mdzad pa'i lan du 'o na bskyar bsgos shig byas rgyun ring po zhig mdzad dgos pa yong phebs pa de kho na'i thog tu song ba mngon mkhyen yod do ba'i cal sgrog tsam ma yin par grags pa don dang ldan pa'o/ /mkhan po sku zhang snyun yun ring gisabatab ste sa sbrul nag pa zla bar la stod du gshegs pa'i stabs 'di lo mkhan po'i 'os tho bsdus tshe/phyag mdzod dpon po byang chub la dri ba gnang bar rtag brtan mkhan po zal mo brag pa'i sku skye la mthun grub yin tshul g.yo zhug byas par sde srid thugs 'byul te rtag brtan mkhan por bka' shog gnang bas khong pa chos sde brag dmar du 'byor/ dpon po byang chub kyis spyi sa'i zhu yig brdzus ma dang bcas dbu chos gnyis gzhis ka rtser btang bar dri ba gnang lan bu dol lta grub mi gcig cing tshad ma'i 'dod mthun min tshul zhus pas ri phug dbu mdzad dang phyag mdzod pa gnyis pos gsung ba ltar phebs/ sku zhabs (19na〉su rje nyid la sger du dri ba gnang bar jo nang rje btsun rin po che skyes bu dam pa g.yin dang mi 'dra yang lta grub byang nas kun mkhyen bu'i bstan par phan pa dka'/ zha lu par tshar chen yab sras bka' drin che bas rab gnas gsar zhabs drung dbon rin po che/ de min glang bu nas chos rje'i drung / ngor mkhan po shes khrung ba gsum po gang rung 'os pa 'dra/ dngos gzhi rnam dbyingasanas gang bcad las 'os ci yod zhu ba gnang bas sde srid zhal skyengs nyams kyis zha lu ba'i zhu don pa spyi tshogs la sgyur sbyang dang bcas zal mo brag pa'ang mkhan po mdzad mi dgos gsungs par brten 537

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)thar par byon/shing pho khyi lo gzhis ka rtser khyab bdag zha lu pa dpon slob brgyad skor la gsol phogs sogs dgos cha tshang ma gnang / bla ma kun dga' dpal 'phel gyis slob dpon mdzad nas yog dbyangs nyis brgya lhag tsam sbyong dar gnang / de nas e waṃ chos ldan du phebs rigs brgya'i bdag po dpal ldan don grub la thugs rje chen po'i dmar 'khrid smin rgyas su gsan pa'i nub kyi mnal lam du rje nyid zha lu'i chos sde'i shar sgo nas byon pa dang zhabs sa la mi reg par mi gang tsam 'phags/ mo yan gyi byang sgo nas bud med rgyab la chu zom khyer ba zhig mthong byung ba dang dam pa nyid kyi phyag tu phur pa bu chung lo brgyad pa tsam byung ba bud med de'i spyi bor btab pas bshang lam gyi bar phug ste sa la sbrags/de nas nam mkha'i mthongs thugs blos mi 'khyud pa tsam du 'phur bas lung pa thams cad chus mer pa khengs pa gzigs pas 'di 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po (19ba)yin sems can thams cad 'don ma thub kyang yab yum gnyis 'don dgongs te phyag chu la yul yul mdzad pas sbal lcong 'dra mo phyag mthil du byung / nga shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba la thegs dgos dgongs te 'phur bas shar phyogs mngon dga' yin snyam par phebs/ der mi 'khrugs pa'i stong thang 'dra ba zhig sngo cham gyis gzigs pa dang mnyam du mnal sad/ yang skabs shig rmang lam du nub phyogs bde ba can du 'byon dgongs te mkha' la 'phur ba na sgrub khang gi ja khang du phebs nas nga bde ba can du 'gro rgyu yin gsungs par mi zhig na re 'od dpag med 'di ga yin zhes rje dpal don pa phyogs la brda thabs byed snang ba dpon slob gnyis dzi'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i che bar mngon/ yog dbyangs sbyong dar gnang skabs sde srid nas thugs khur bzhes pa'i ri phug tu 'du khang zhig gsos kyi 'go 'dzugs mdzad pa lo gnyis lhag tsam gyi bar 'gor ba'i ldebs bris la nye skabs khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos ngor sgrub khang du bslab ston zhu ba gnang par kun mkhyen bu'i rnam thar/ 'bras spungs dang sham+bha la'i bkod pa bris gsung ba bzhin seng g.yabs la rnam thar zhing bkod rgyas pa 'du khang la skyes —538

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanarabs so bzhi pa/ gnas bcu/ sgo nang byang du chos skyong skor/ lho na sbyin bdag //spugs na rgyal chen bzhi/ steng gi 'khor g.yabs la mdzad bcu dang bstan pa'i gtad rabs bu ston chos 'byung ltar/theg pa chen po'i lugs kyi cho 'phrul/ gzims chung na 'khrid chen bzhi'i bla brgyud/ gtsang khang dang mgon khang so so'i ldebs bris rnams dngos gtsang ba thugs (20na/bur che bzhes kyis zhal bkod gnang / sham+bha la dang 'bras spungs 'bri ba'i sa stongs da lta yang lus/ mkhar las kyi tshub cha'i rnam pas rje nyid shin tu bsnyun par ngor sgrub khang du snyan 'bul mdzad pa na thugs dam skyabs 'jug dang sku rim sogs kyi bslab bya gnang / 'gag tu mi su slebs byung yang gtam ngan gang khyer yod dam bsam sems la gtser po byung gsung / 'dar du zhu mi gnang par bzhugs 'ding rnying pa'i byin rlabasarten dang bcas da lam skyon ci yang mi yong / thugs dogs rgod po de nyams yin tshul dang / bla ma yi dam srung ma'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rdo rje'i slob bu bsod na mas mchogo grub kyi/ /tshe 'phreng tshe yi bar chad kun sgrol nas/ /tshe ring nad med lo brgyar brtan par shog /ces pa gnang zhing / 'di dag gi snga gong kun mkhyen rong ston nas brgyud pa'i tshe sgrub zhag bdun ma'i ljags bsnyen gnang ba'i 'od gsal du bris thang zhig gi ldebs la byon pas gtso bo ngo mi mkhyen pa la lha mgron du kun mkhyen gung ru phyag gnyis pus steng du brkyang ba 'di khyod yin zhes mi zhig gis zer/ sku de'i mdun na ril bu 'dra mo bzhi 'dug pa byung ba mnal sad nas thugs som nyir gyur nas rdo rje 'chang la lo bzhi lta bu gcig la 'chi ba 'dra brtan pa gnang dgos snyan 'bul zhu ba mdzad par bzhi la min pa 'dug bzhi bcu la dgongs pas cho de dgos pa 'dra 'on kyang gegs sel byed gsungs/ tshe dbang mang po dbang byin rlabs gnang ba gong gi bden stobs brjod pa sogs kyis sku tshe'i 'phreng sgrol bar thugs ngesashes gnang 'dug cing / mnal ltas(20ba 'di dgung lo sum cu zin tsam gyi tshod yin 'dra bsad cha bdun cu'i nang du phebs gshis khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan gyi phebs sgo de sgrib bral ye shes kyis gzigs pa kho nar snang zhing gegs sel gyi tshe dbang gnang ba'i mthus da cha grangs tshad las—539

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)kyang brgal ba bzhugs par mngon/ sku khams dwangs rdzas rab gnas bkra shis rgyas byed steng nas rnal 'byor rgyud dang rjes su 'bral ba'i rab gnas nyin gnyis ma'i rdo rje slob dpon du rgyal kun ngo bo rje btsun bla ma rin po che bsod nams mchog grub nyid phebs te sangs rgyas de sras slob mar bcas pa'i ye shes sems dpa' bzhu blugs su dam tshig pa la bstim nas phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston rgya cher mdzad/ 'du khang gi zhal spror tshogs pa la sems nyid ngal gso'i nyams 'khrid zla gcig gi bar dang bu ston rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi ljags lung btsugs pas thog mar gra dmangs phal cher yod na'ang brgyad stong pa nas bshad pa'i bdud las kyi rnam pas je nyung du song ba yongs rdzogs 'dril ba lnga tsam las ma byung zhing deng sang ni lnga po'i khrod nas kyang gcig las ma lus 'dug pas brgyud yig yod nges kyi rgyun rnams 'bad rtsol byed ran du snang ngo / /nyes brgya 'khor ba na kra'i grong khyer gyis/ /nyes dmigs tshul la nges par thugs byung pas/nyes bral phun tshogs cho ga'i gru gzings kyis/ nyes ltung dri bral rin chen gling du byon/ /'chi med pad 'byung gdung 'tshob gnas gsar bar/ /'chi ba'i dngos brgya 'joms par gsol btab tshe/ /'chi dang skye bar dbang ba'i gdengs tshad mthus/ /'chi bdag la lngar bzlog (21na)par zhal gyis 'tshes/ /don med 'du 'dzi'i rnam g.yeng rgyab bskyur nas/ /don chen rgyud sder bcu phrag bgrang bya'i bar/ /don tshig kun sbyangs mkhas pa'i rtser son pas/ /don ldan dal ba'i rten la snying po blangs/ /'tshub 'tshub lha mi'i gdon gyi dmag gi dpung / /long long sdug po'i sprin nag ltar 'thibs pa/ /'jigs 'jigs ma he'i zhal can dbang rab kyi/ /'ur 'ur thugs rje'i rlung gis pha mthar bskrad/ /rmi lam sprul bsgyur sngon nas goms pa'i mthus/ /'khor ba'i mtsho las 'gro 'dren lhag bsam dang / /mtha' klas dag pa rab 'byams zhing khams la/ /gcig tu gzigs mor g.yengs pa de med byung / /'khas rdul byang gling chos rje'i khrir bkod nas/ /smin grol gar theg dbyangs dang dus kyi chos/ /bya ba las kyi 'khor los bu ston rje'i/ /bstan pa'i nyi ma gnyis pa deng 'dir shar/ /sku tshe'i tshad sogs lkog gyur shes 540

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanabya'i gzugs/ /gnas gsar bla ma'i thugs kyi me long du/ /gsal bar mgon khyod dad pa dbyar gyi mtsho/ /'phyur ba'i rtse mo tshangs pa'i yul sa brgal/ /thun 'tshams gos kyi phang du zla bzhin ma/ /rtse dga' rgod pa'i mkhan po zal brag pa/ /'jam mnyen gzhan snang 'dring pa'i me rtag mda'/ /'phang ba'i cho ga ma rdzogs bstan pa'i gsos/ /shing phag lo rje rdo rje 'chang mjal bar phebs ring zhig bzhugs shing brtan bzhugs kyi gsol 'debs mdzad/ tshur 'byon khar slar yong thub nges kyis gsung zhing rje 'di nyid kyi phyag g.yas nas rdo rje (21ba)'chang gis 'dzin pa gnang thugs dam la brtson po mdzod gsung ba sogs 'phral phugs kyi bslab ston mang du stsal/ phyag mdzub ker nas nu ro la zhes dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dpag med mdzad pa na bka' las nga rang tshogs bsags snyam pa dang sems 'phreng zhing dga' yal le bde 'bol le skyid ngo shes pa rang zhig byung gsung / phyir lam ngor du phebs 'dar nas rin po che sgrub khang nas la phyag tham rngul gzan gyi rten bcas yod pa phul bas na bza' de 'phral du bzhes nas rin po che'i phebs sgor 'chad nyan gzhon dus khyer kha ma byas na rgas pa myur po yong bas 'bungasamadzod/ 'chad nyan yang zhu mkhan gcig byung na de la byed gnyis gsum byung na de la byas pas mthar je mang la 'gro chog gang la'ang sla chos ma byed/ rang sdod mkhas snyom chung ngos dus kun tu thos bsam sgom gsum dang ma bral ba mdzod ces bslab ston mang du gnang / phyag mdzub ker nu re la zhes gsungs/ gzhis ka rtser phebs nas kha'u pa'i bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i mched po 'jam dpal dbyangasachos skyong dbang phyug la dpyal phur gyi dbang lung dang / slar ha la nag po'i be'u bum sogs zab chos rgya cher gsan pa mdzad pas gnas gsar ba khu dban dang sgrub khang pa'i 'og nas thugs mos che/rim gyis zha lur phebs me byi shar nas sgrub khang du khyab bdag dpal ldan don grub mjal bar phebs pa na sku na smin cing snyun gyis zin pa'i nyams kyis sku khams shin tu dub pa'i gsung mi gsal/sprul pa'i sder 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa sku'i bkod pa bsdu kha'i tshe 'phags pa rin po cher tshig dgongs —541

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyemi dgongs (22na〉sna tshogs byung ba dang dbyibs 'dra bsam pa mang tsam gsungs mthar gsung shed chen pos chos rje dbon la dpal mchog nga slong dang gsung / dpon pos sku skyor nas tsong mdzad pa rje nyid la spyan cer gzigs nas da mang po lab mi thub pa 'dug kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i bstan pa khyed la khag yod do phebs pa gsung gi tha ma yin gsung / hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bzhi la ngor du mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub mkha' spyod kyi zhing du gshegs pa'i gtam ngan zha lu phu'i bsam gtan sgang du byung 'phral ri phug tu phebs nas mchod 'bul ba rdzong bda' mdzad/tshes gnyis la 'dar du rdo rje 'chang dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i thugs gar bsdus pa'i gnas tshul dang bcas zhabs drung dbon rin po che'i phyag tham thugs dam gsal 'debs skyel mi 'byor gshis bka' drin che sna(sa kyi bla ma gnyis ka gshegs pas/ bka' las/ bla ma gnyis ka dang bral bas sdug pa la tshod ma byung gsung / de 'phral nor gling nas chibs drel g.yar ngos e waṃ chos ldan du khyab bdag bla ma dam pa'i sku gdung rin po che mjal ba dang gdung 'bul phul nas rtsol khyad kyis 'dar la phebs skabs rgyang gzigs nas 'ja' dkar po snam bu brkyang pa lta bu grang mo che'i gdung gi thad du zug /gdung 'bul 'bul ba gnang zhing bzhugs ring gdung yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i drung du stan chags nas gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag nyid la mchod 'bul gsol 'debs dbang bzhi len pa sogs rgyas par gnang / thugs ngal shin tu che bar khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos (22ba)thugs brel che bzhag chung bshol gyi sgo nas rwa pod kyi ljags lung sogs thugs gso thabs ci yang gnang gsung / dpon slob gnyis tshoms chen gyi nyi mthong la gsol tshigs skabs me tog gi char kha ba lta bu babs pa gzigs/ tshur lam ngor du phebs pa dang shar chen shes 'byung pas sgrub khang du pur khang zhal 'byed mdzad pa dang 'grig byin rlabs gdung skal zhu ba dang pur tsha 'debs pa'i phyag phyi mdzad ngos rang gi bsti gnas su phebs/lcags lug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis lung bstan gnang ba thog tu babs pa —542

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanaltar/ me byi'i ston rnam thar snyim pa'i me tog las/ yon tan can gyi mi byung na zhing dkyil gyi pha bong ltar mja' phyogs bzhi nas btsugs nas 'don zhes pa'i don bzhin lo 'di'i stod zha lu'i gra pa mi srun pa 'ga' zhig gis rang bstan seng ge'i khog pa 'jig pa la dpa' ba'i thes bsdus sogs 'tshub stongs sna tshogs kyis thugs srun dbyung bar sgrub khang du rin po cher bslab ston zhu ba mdzad par bal mo ya gcig la sgra mi 'byung bas tshur phebs sgo ma byung bar sde srid la zhu snga mdzad gsung ba bzhin re zhig rin lding pa sogs gra ris dang khang dmar nas kyis gtsos pa'i sku nye rnams la brten phal cher se rag sgrub sder bzhugs pa'i 'brug pa sprul pa'i sku'i mgron gnyer khang dmar rje drung mkhyen brtses skar rtsis kyi ri mo phul/ me glang 'brum thag chod nas gzhis ka rtser 'bod mi bka' shog gnang ba bzhin byon/ mi snar bde 'byor byang pa yongs pa'i lte bo rnams gan dung gis gnas nas dbyung gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas tshogs su bka' khrims (23na)bsgrags shing dbu mdzad bskyar bsgo mdzad/de nas gra pa shigs bsdus la gzhung nas phogs sogs mthun rkyen gnang ste bya tshor zla gcig gi bar sa gar mchod gar rnams la sbyong dar gyi do dam gnang / grub bstun sgrub mchod dang rnam srasamachod pa rnams kyi gzigs mor sde srid kyang phebs pa'i gra 'grig byung ba'i legs sor pa rnam tsho bo gzhis ka mchod thebs su sbyor 'jags byung / sngar gzhis rtser bka' 'gyur gyi zhu dag la byon skabasanas chos tshol gsan 'dug pa dang bcas dpon slob paṇa chen rin po cher bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i mdo phyogs kyi gsung rab bka'i lung gsan/ de nas ye waṃ chos ldan du phebs mkhan chen thar pa rtse pa nam mkha' sangs rgyas la sa paṇa dang 'phags pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs chos du ma gsan/ bzhugs mtsher sgrub khang du yod par tho rengs shig mnal lam du gu ru drag po'i sku brnyan shin tu gsal ba zhig byung ba nam blangs tshe thar pa rtser dbang la byon gsung ba'i 'phros byung ba na ci yin nam dgongs tshe dbang de gter kha gong ma'i drag po me'i spu gri'i dbang yin 'dug gsung ba drag po'i sku de yang zhal gzigs ma lta bu zhig yin nam snyam/ 'di lo zha lu'i mkhan —543

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyethog tu rin po che shar pa byon nas mi ring bar ngor tshogs chen la 'phreng ba zhe lnga ma'i dbang gnang ba dang der ma zad dbang chos kyi rigs rgyas par gsan/ yo ga ma las bu dga' ba dbang ldan chos 'khor du mkhas mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes gdan drangs dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi dbang bcu bzhi po dbang cha nyer lngar bcad pa tshar bzhi/ gtum po spyi gzugs kyi dbang sogs dbang rjes gnang lung rgya cher gnang / mar phebs nas ri phug tu ri khrod dga' ldan slob dpon la bu ston bka' 'bum gyi lung stsal/sa stag rin lding gra tshang gis chos lung 'du khang zhig gsos grub par bkra shis rgyas byed kyi yi ge dang brgyud pa'i phyag len nas rab tu gnas pa'i bkra shis kyi dga' ston nyin gnyis ma rgyas pa re gnang / pan nya rir rtsa khu nas kyis 'bum bzhedas pa'i rab gnas kyang gong bzhin sbyin bdag gi re ba yongs su 'geng bar mdzad/ ri phug tu phebs bstun khang rnying gra tshang pa rnams kyis rtsol ba la brten tshogs chen du rdor dbyings kyi dbang cha nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sgo nas phyogs de'i gdul bya rnams smin grol la bkod/ 'jam dpal drag por khros pa 'jigs mdzad rdo rjer rwa kyo zhang mal gnyos te lo tsā ba lnga dang / rga lo yab sras/ kun mkhyen bu/ rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ ngor rdzong sogs mkhas pa mang po'i bzhed srol khungs btsun mtha' yas pa'i nang nas rwa chen lo tsā pa rdo rje grags kyi phyag len bsre bslad dang bral ba rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs bdud las rnam par rgyal ba dang / rwa 'khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud gnyis sbyar te ma he mchod par dmigs pa'i ljags bsnyen sngon 'gro rgyas pa dang bcas grub mtshams bya yul nas 'brug pa sprul sku rin po che dpag bsam dbang po 'brong rtse rgyal byed tshal du phebs par ched bstan zhabs 'grul gyis byon/ phyag chen gyi sngon 'gror tshogs gsog tu phyag mang po dgos kyi yod 'dug pa rje nyid kyi sku gzugs (24na)kyis cung ma lcogs pa'i nyin re phyag stong phrag gnyis re dang de 'phros yig brgya'i zhal 'don gnang / gtso bo phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi nyams 'khrid dang bla sgrub kyi 'khrid bzabs rgyas/ gzhan yang nā ro chos drug /o rgyan —544

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanabasnyen sgrub/ bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i dbang sogs chos bka' du ma gsan/ snga dro zhig phyag dbang la phebs dus dbu la pus 'khyud bzhag nas rin po che la bya bral gyi bsko 'ja' yin no gsung /nyin gcig sku la bzhes bzhin pa'i sku gzan dang sku chos sbrags ma gzims dpon gyis rje nyid kyi sku rgyab la bskon nas gnang ste/ rje rdo rje 'chang chen mi gzugs can/ /pha mtshan ldan bla mar gus pas 'dud/ /spang gnyen dbyer med kyi nyams len 'di/ khas len bral ba'i lta ba yin/ /ched du mi bsgom pa'i rang babs 'di/ /sgom med yengs med ces sgom pa'i mchog /gnyis 'dzin dang bral ba'i rang grol 'di/ /a ba dhū ti pa'i spyod par gsungs/ /gzhan phan gyi sems bskyed rgya chen pos/ /sdig spong dge sgrub kyi las 'bras brtsi/ /dge tshogs sems can gyi don du bsngo/ /de bka' brgyud gong ma'i gdams pa lags/ /zhes pa 'di zha lu'i gdan sab rin po che bsod na mas mchogo grub la dpal 'brug pa dpag bsam dbang pos gdams pa'o/ /che bzhi pa'i zhal gdams dang sang zha lur thegs rgyu'i de ring de gsung mgur mang du 'then pa'i rjes su rje yi snyan la gzan lags kyang / sprang la snang ba 'di las med khyed dpon slob sang thegs rgyu'i blo 'phul yin/ rten 'brel gyi byed pa zhig yod (24ba)gsungs nas gsol ja bzhes can gang gsol ras su gnang / thugs dam gang 'phel gyi ngang nas kun mkhyen bu ston rin po che'i bstan pa la gang phan yong ba mdzod/de ltar mdzad na nged kyi phyag phyi byas par yang 'gro/ zha lu ma na gra pa kha cig rtogs ldan yin zer nas zha lu rang gi cho ga mi byed par 'brug lugs kyi bla ma mchod pa byed kyi yod zer ba de 'dra la mer ni mi dgyes/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po ches cho ga rgyas par dga' na rgyas pa/ bsdus par dga' na bsdus pa mang po mdzad 'dug pa des ma 'thus pa ci yod/ rin po che g.yeng ba rang la ma 'byamasapar mthar thugs dam rtse gcig mdzad dgos so gsungs/ dam pa nyid sku zhabs pa rnams kyis skyel ma mdzad nas bzhugs sgar gyi mtha' tsam du phebs pa dang sku zhabs la 'bod mkhan byung ba ltar thegs par sku phrag gi byin rlabs khug mag shog bu'i khud du thams cad sprugs nas gnang / sang nged —545

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sherang dpon slob thegs dus rgyab gyes rang ma byung ba mdzod gsungs/ zha lur phebs nas sa yos ma he mchod pa'i gra sgrig grub rjes sku mtshams shin tu dam pas las gshin gyi ljags bsnyen dang / de zin nas bskang gso dang drug cu pa sogs rgyab chos kyi sku rim rnams smin rgyas su mdzad/ ma he mchod pa'i dus drug cu pa dang las gshin gyi gtor ma gnyis ka rgyag pa gnang / rim gyis rnam sras mchod pa sogs sngar rgyun bzhin grub nas lcags 'brug nang du sgrub mchod dbyar dgun gyi dus chos sogs sngar bzhin chag med ngos dpal 'khor chos sde'i dus 'khor gra tshang shar byang gnyis dang gzhi gra bcas pa'i don (25na)gnyer can brgyar longs par dpal dus kyi 'bor lo'i bdag po chen po'i bar gyi yongs rdzogs dbang cha bzhi gnang / lcags sprul zla ba lnga par bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i dpung chen gzhis ka rtser 'byor ba'i dbus gtsang thams cad dus gcig tu mi bde ba'i bde gzar chen po langs/ ston ka sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan kyang dpung thog tu phebs/ rgyal ba myong kha pa chen po'i sngags chos gsan sa phal cher bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal slob rnams yin pa'i grags pa dang / sde srid kyi zhabs phyir bzhugs skabs sku drung shag lhun pa sogs dang bcas thugs 'dris kyang yod tshad kyis lta grub mi gcig pa'i khrod nas gzigs phyogs legs pa 'dra zhig 'dug pa bzhin rje nyid kyis gtsos pa'i ri mthil gyi chen slob rnams mjal bar phebs par thugs mnyes mnyes dang spyi sger du bslab ston gnang / mi ring bar dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che zha lu'i mkhan thog tu gdan drangs chog pa snyan bcags phul/ bde gzar thag chod nas spyi so'i zhu yig 'bul ba dang bcas mkhan po'i skor gyi snyan 'bul zhu bar sde pa bsod nams brtan gyi sku zhabs su byon par don ris 'di la ster bya ci la dgos pas phyir slog yod/ khyed rang rnams kyis kyang dpon slob zhabs drung rin po cher gsol ba thob/ 'di nas kyang snyan 'bul zhus pa'i bsko bzhag dus thog tu byed gnang ba bzhin zha lu chen slob dang gzhung gi spi sna bcas bkra shis lhun por snyan 'bul phul bas/ paṇa cen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' las/ nged na so 'di las gzhon pa zhig yin na kun (25ba/mkhyen bu'i bzhugs khri la 'dzeg —546

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)pa shin tu spro/ da cha lo mthos pas phan thogs dka' na'ang nang se'i drung gi phebs na na chags pa dang bcas re zhig de ga byed de zhes zhal bzhes byung bas thams cad spro ba 'phel/hor zla drug pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin gza' skar dus tshes dge bar ri mthil gnyis ga'i chos kyi khri la zhabs zung gi pad+ma rnam par bkod/ khri ston gyi mang 'gyed sogs shin tu dpangs mtho zhing gya nom pa stsal bas phyogs de'i skye rgu rnams rnam thos kyi bu'i gan mdzod du chud pa lta bus dbul ba'i gdung ba mtha' dag rnam par bral te dad pa dang gus pa phan tshun 'gran pa'i lus kyi ba sbu g.yo ba dang mig nas mchi ma 'khrug pa sogs dga' spro'i rtse dga' khong nas rgod pa'i rnam 'gyu ci yang ston par snang / chu lug sgrub mchod chen mo'i dus bkra shis lhun po nas chibs kyi kha lo bskyod chog gar dbyangs sogs la thugs dgyes rtser son pa'i rje 'di nyid la gzengs bstod kyi bka' mchid mang du stsal/ drung chen sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin zhes phyi nang tshang ma thugs blos bkal nas rje bla ma nyid chos ldan gyi bya ba 'ba' zhig la tshig dril gnang chog pa'i phyag g.yog tu 'gyur pa de shing sprel dus kyi chos nyid du song ba'i skabs/ rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po bcad rgya lo gsum ma mdzad pa 'grig gshis sgrib sbyong gnang ba'i dus shig rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba'i phyag bris gnang bar da nang tho rengs bdag gi rmi lam la rdo rje 'chang de gsal por phebs nas bra'u ba de da cha mi lus bzung tshar bas khyed tsho de tsam rang byed mi dgos gsung ba gsal po byung ba lar rmi lam bden pa rang dka' na'ang da lam dang bla ma'i thugs rje dang dge ba rgya che (26na〉pa myur ba sogs kyi nus pa yin 'dug pas thugs las ci yang mi gnang ba rang zhu gsung ba byung zhing / thun bar du gsol 'debs pad dkar bzhad pa'i chun por/ lte ba'i pad+ma ra rlung lnga'i ti la ka /rtse gcig bsgoms pas kha sbyor rnal 'byor gyis/ /lus sems rtsa la dri bzhen zhugs gyur nas/ /bde ba mchog gis bdag rgyud tshim par shog /ces pa'i rje btsun yab dang thun mong pa'i rtsa dbu ma'i nyams su da kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bzhed pa ma nor ba de dang / mchog gi sprul sku rigs 'dzin mnga' ris pa legs ldan rdo rjes chu bo ri nas —547

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6pegadan drangs pa'i bla ma sku gsum gyi nyams 'khrid zab mo 'bul ba gnang ba'i sku khams 'dus pa la shin tu phan pa thong / ljags bsnyen snga ma rdzogs shing phyi ma ma tshugs pa'i bar rje bka' 'gyur bar dbang lung gi rigs du ma 'bul ba gnang / drung chen 'das po'i dge sgrub tu dkon mchog la mchod pa/ sgrub mchod/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sku 'bum phrag gsum/ sāts+tsha kai ka ni'i gzungs bzhugs pa 'bum phrag gcig /sku'i rten du bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dga' ldan du bzhugs pa'i zhing bkod bzhengs nas rin lding gra tshang du sbyar/ gsung gi rten du 'phags pa brgyad stong pa bzhengs nas rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen por phul/ thugs kyi rten du 'od zer dri med dang gtsug tor dri med kyi ljags bsnyen sngon du 'gro bas byang chub chen po'i mchod rten phal thog gsum tsam la dri med kyi srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga gzungs 'bul rab gnas rgyas par gnang bas bla ma dam pa nyid kyi mi 'phrog (26ba)pa'i thugs rje chen po'i mthus mi 'brugs pa'i sku par gnang skabs phyogs nub byang nas bya rgod cig 'phur ba'i rjes la 'ja' dkar po zhig tal gyi zug pa dang srog shing 'dzugs nyin 'ja' kha dog lnga ldan srog shing la gdugs ltar phub pa dri med kyi dkyil 'khor la zhal khebs btang na mi gsal zhing phye na gsal ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas khyad par can dang / rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba'i mnal lam gnyis gang la dpags kyang drung chen mngon mtho'i skas la 'dzegs nas mtho ris kyi grong du ring por mi thogs par 'jug pa'ang / ji skad du/ gang zhig gser gyi ri la gnas bcas pa'i/ /de'i 'dab chags rnams kyang gser du 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar dam pa'i zhabs yun du bsnyen pa'i phan yon du mngon/skabs shig rmang lam du rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang du byon zer ba zhig byung ba ltar phyin pas lha mo'i gtsang khang du slebs pa dang bud med kyi dkon gnyer byas nas lha mo'i sku de rnam pa tsam yin/ lha mo rang 'di'i rgyab kyi sgo chung 'di'i nang la yod zer rang la stod dang gsungs pas da lta'i sku 'dra'i rgyab na sgo chung 'dug pa phye ste de nang du khrid nas 'di yin zer rdo rje sems dpa'i gser sku mi tshad tsam legs po zhig bstan byung /—548

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ tanaslar lha mo'i sku mdun du phebs pa na nged rgyan gong pa rnams 'di rang 'don zhes blo ka gcig shar te brtan byung ba deng la slobs dang gsungs pas/ gzhi la dmigs pa'i ngang nyid las/ /dang po re phyar rgyan par bya/ /smyug nag ma chen 'khor gyi 'bum/ /tshig gcig thugs kyis bsnyel/ da dung mjalalam zer nas g.yabs(27na skong zhig tu gdan drangs pa de na mi dkar po bal gyi thod gyon cing rnga brdung gin k+ṣe snar la/ ming po klu chen thod dkar k+ṣiṃ snar la/ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ k+ṣiṃ zer/ de nas dgon chung zhig tu byon zer nas de'i 'du khang gi phyi zur na rdza'i chos yang 'dra mang po 'dug /rjes sor mnga' bdag pa'i shul gyi dgon pa byams pa gling dpon slob zhabs drung gis rje nyid la gnang ba rdza gru gsum sogs mnal lam ji lta bar byung snang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i yum gyi dgongs rdzogs la dmigs pa'i dri med mchod rten rdo'i gdugs lhung bar nye ba bkra shis lhun po nas thugs khur bzhesapa'i hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu skor la zhig gsos kyi 'go tshugs/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya'i rgyal po'i mchod rten la bya ba byas na ma 'ongs byams pa'i bstan pa la 'bras bu 'byung ba sogs mdo rgyud du ma nas rgya cher bsngags pa ltar gdugs gser zangs kyis gtum pa'i ya thog gi zangs rnamasarje bla ma 'di nyid kyis 'bul ba mdzad dril bu me long sogs rgyan cha du mas mdzes shing gdugs za ra tshags bkod pas khyad du 'phags pa'i yid 'phrog 'grub tu nye ba na sil snyan lta bu'i sgra dang me tog gi char 'ja' 'od kyi gur sogs ltas ya mtshan par byung /hor zla bcu gnyis ba'i tshes bcu bdun la dpon slob zhabs drung rin po che tshogs kyi mgon por phebs/ rdo rje'i slob dpon gyi phyag len rnams thugs rgyus khog nas rje 'di nyid kyis mdzad de rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye rab gnas bkra shis rgyas byed kyi phyag len bzhin zha lu'i dge 'dun rags rim gyis gsung ram bteg nas (27ba)rab gnas sbyin sreg mchod gar dang bcas pa rgyas par gnang bas/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i bka' las/ rab gnas rang da lam lasargyas ba byas pa med dam zhes gsungs shing thugs shin tu dgyes par gnang / shing bya lo rdor dbyings—549

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyertsa lugs kyi bsnyen pa 'bring po bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor la brtan pa dang thugs sras sems dpa' chen po'i gsar 'gyur gyi yig cha bzhin dbyangs can ma'i ljags bsnyen grangs tshang mdzad/ ston mjug rgyal po mchod yon gnyis ka gtsang phyogs su chibs kha bskyod bsam don lhun gyis grub pa'i rtse mor bzhugs thog rje 'di nyid kyis phyag 'bul la phebs te bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos 'dul ba la gces pa'i gzhung brgyad la sogs pa gsung rtsom mdzad/ zha lu 'dir gzhi gsum gyi phyag len sogs bstan pa'i 'byung khungs yin na'ang deng sang 'phel 'grib kyis ming gi lhag ma lta bur song ba/ gang na gzhi gsum la sogs pa las kyi cho ga yod par thub pa'i bstan pa yod par gsungs pas don gyis bstan pa nyams pa gsos pa'i bka' drin bla na med par 'gro ba 'dug gshis bdag gis khur len zhus gzhi gsum gyi cho ga 'dzugs par gzhi rten du sngar sde srid ga me phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dgongs rdzogs la gnang ba'i lcags ri stod dang lhun rtse bde skyid gling gnyis bzhes pa de sbyor 'jags tsam zhus na ji ltar yong gi rgyu mtshan 'jibs chags pa 'bul ba gnang bar sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyis zhal gyis bzhes par brten bkra shis lhun po nas bdog pa gya nom pa'i zhu rten bstar bar sde pas gtan tshigs gtsang (28na〉byad gnang / de 'phral gzhi gsum cho ga 'phyugs med 'dzugs dgos pa'i bca' yig dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i phyag tham gyis mnan pa zhu ba mdzad/ phyag len spyan 'khrid la thon rgyal byed tshal pa'i slob dpon don grub dpal ba bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon po nas rdzong bda' gnang ste dbyar gnas gso sbyong dgag dbye rnams legs par tshugs so/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos dpal ldan bla ma gnyis/ /mkha' spyod zhing du gshegs kyang dam pa khyod/ /byang chen de srid rjes 'dzin nang rtags phyir/ /ston pa'i skal bzang 'di la su mi smon/ /lnga bdo'i snang tshul rtsub mo'i tsher mal la/ /snying stobs bzod pa'i ya lad btsan po yis/ /bu ston ring lugs srid mthar spel ba'i khur/ /'degs la mi ngal rgyal sras rnam par thar/ /gar thig dbyangs kyi phyag len —550

zha lu lo chen rin r+sā bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanargya cher spel/ /rnal wor rgyud sde'i smin byed sgo 'phar phye/ /rin chen grub kyi gsung rab srog gi zungs/ /'di ko dga' ldan gnas nas byon tam ci/ /gting mtha' mi mngon gsan bsam chu gter gnang / /rgyu yang ngom med tshor pa'i gser sbal de'i/ /snyan pa'i grags pa thos na deng dus kyi/ /bstan 'dzin khron pa'i 'phar 'gro don snying 'gas/ /log par 'khu ba'i dgra bgegs brag gi ri/ /ma he'i zhal can mthu stobs rdo rje'i thog /'bebs dang lhan cig drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dpal/ /'phen khyod rdor 'dzin bye ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /g.yu 'brug phyag rgya'i mkhar 'khrigs sgra snyan po/ /sgrog tshe mi chos char gyisamyu gu bsrings/ /gser gzhed mar khus bkang ba'i (28ba〉khan slob kyi/ /rten 'brel zho la phug ron sder rjes gsal/ /sngon goms kun 'byung sa bon bskyed pa'i long / /med par nges legs zhing du rim gro pa/ khrangs tshe 'ja' ris las kyi me long la/ shar bas dge sdig tsos bu gcig tu mtshungs/ /bstan skyong ma mo dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyi/ /ya mtshan cho 'phrul 'od gsal ngang du shar/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten ched du sri zhu'i ljid/ khur la mi mngon rus sbal gzugs su sprul/ /bsdu dngos bzhi dang yongs 'brel nyi zer gyis/ /sa spyod snyan gyi bad dkar 'dab stong bzhad/ /'dod yon sbrang rtsis spyosapa'i rkang drug rnams/ /gzhi gsum cho ga'i glu dbyangs mgrin par len/ /me khyi lo rin lding gra tshang dang zha lu bzhi grwa'i don gnyer can mang por rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dbang cha gnyis ma/ rdor dbyings mi zhakhrugs pa 'chi med rnga sgra'i smin byed stsal/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshesabacu bdun la yum gshegs gdong mgul ga nas rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi tshe mas btone pa'i rked pa chag pa'i nang ngos ring bsrel shin tu tsher ba gnyis phebs pa nga rang la rje bla mas thugs rjes gzigs ba yin 'dug pas bslang gsungs nas la du gsol/ rje nyid kyis thugs khral ma gnang phyag g.yog gang drag zhu gsungs par de 'dra mi dgos khyed rang gshegs dus nged gdan 'dren la yod gsung ba ye shes kyi ḍā gi ma sbas tshul can du gor ma chag cing gnas skabs su'ang yi ge drug pa dung phyur bzhi tsam song ba'i thugs dam smin las ri bo gru 'dzin nas lag na pad+mas rjes su bzung —331

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ logeste 'ja' 'od kyi gur dang bcas zhing khams 'phos/ rten (29na〉bzheng gi thebs su gser spyi gcig ma gtogs yum gyi phyag rdzas gang yod steng rje nyid kyi dam tshig rdor dril chos gos rnam gsum sogs med kha med 'dra las gzhan pa'i phyag rdzas yod dgu kun khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bas gtsos pa'i bla ma rnams la bsngo rten/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga /gsung sgrog smon lam sogs kyi rgyur dgongs rdzogs la gnang / phyag rdzas rnams 'dzangs gshis rje nyid kyis yum la dmigs shākya mu ni'i pho brang 'brul snang sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang la zhabs bskor gnang bzhed kyi spos khang du phebs/ mkhan po khang dmar nas kyis na bza' gsol chas chibs pa dang bcas mthun rkyen sbyar te phyag mangs su phebs pa'i nub kyi mnal lam du gser gyi rgya phibs dang bcas pa lha sa yongs su rdzogs pa gsal lam gyis gzigs/ mi zhig na re sngar byas la 'gyod sems dang phyin chad la sdom sems kyis sogs mang po zer byung yang brjed nas mi 'dug gsung ba sgra ji bzhin pa rang min pa 'dra/ rngog gis jo bo chen po lha sar spyan drangs te bsu ba'i tshe thugs rje chen pos kyang bsu ba mdzad pa'i mi hreng skya bo zhig byung nas mahā paṇ+ḍi ta byon pa legs so rgyal bar gyur cig gsungs nas bzhud pas jo bos chibs pa las babs te brgyugs pas ma zin pa'i lo rgyus dang / khu ston yer par byon dus nya mgo gru'i mnyan pa lta bu'i rnam thar yin nam snyam/ de nas rim gyis gnas 'gag gong du phebs 'brug pa sprul sku rin po che mjal ba gnang / phyag mdzod mnga' ris pa dang sngar nas thugs 'dris yod gshis lha sa bar gyi chibs khal/ zhabs skor ring (29ba)gi gsol mar dang bzhugs shing phul/me phag hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig la bstan pa'i bdag po jo shākya rnam gnyis/ rang byon lnga ldan/ byams pa chos 'khor sogs rten rnams zhib mjal ngos bstan 'gro'i legs tshogosaspel ba'i smon lam rgya cher mdzad/ rim gyis zhabs skor btsugs/sa byi hor zla dang po nyis brtsegs kyi snga mar cho 'phrul mchod pa'i smon lam chen mo tshugs pa'i nged 'bras spungs nas tshogs dbur lha sar slebs/ chu rta tshong 'dus lcang ra stod du zha lu ba'i chen slob —552

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ tanarnams phrad par byung ba de dus gral 'go ma des skyes bu dam pa dang mjal ba ni dkon pas bla ma'i rnal 'byor zhig bka' drin skyong dgos zhes ngos kyi rgyu mtshan byung ba ltar 'phral du phul gsung 'phrosamadzad mkhan de rje bla ma yin par snang / de skabs sger du zhal 'tsho ba med/ de skabs ngos phrad kyi thugs re bskyungs na'ang khe gsum nas lcam yum sras byon pa 'grig pa'i bzhugs mtsher gcig pa gdong dga' ba dang bde rgyas pa gnyen lam du song ba'i gdong dga' mas gzhon pas ban rtse'i sne sbyor yong tshul 'dug pa bzhin 'dir rgyu mtshan gleng bar brten dgongs mo'i smon lam la 'gro khar ja gral zhig thog ngos mjal zhus/ de bar ri phug gi dbu mdzad yin zer pa las rgyu mtshan zhib pa ma nges pa gsung bgros la gzhigs pa na tshar lugs pa zhig yin pa 'dra snyam sang gung tshigs grol 'phral gdan drangs/ ja sbyor gsum tsam gyi yun gsung gleng 'phel bar byung zhing zur gsos phul/byams pa gdan 'dren gyi sang nyin ka brgyad sbug tu gung tshigs kyi mgron la phyin dus (30na)rje 'di nyid kyang lhan cig par byon/ rgyud sdospyi la sa zhal gyi phyag bzhes 'dra mi 'dra'i dbye ba dang bye brag kha'u brag rdzong pa'i skor la zhib cha shin tu che ba gsung gin 'dug pas 'di lta bu'i mkhas grub chen po snyam snying nas mos pa zab/ tshar lugs kyi chos bka' 'dra lus na snyam pa shar yang sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi dgongs mdangs ma byed pas lag thog tu 'gel ma bde/ de skabs gtsang dang sa khad 'byangs shing nye skor du ngo mkhyen pa'i rigs che ba med gshis gsol chas re dkon byung tshod nas/ bka' las/ bka' brgyad smad pas spyan 'dren zhus pa'i phyags phyir shog gsungs nas phyin sder kha mang po 'dug pas rnam rtog la 'di rnams nang du slebs na dbul ba sel bya 'dug ste susakhyer 'dis khyer med ba la 'gro'am bsam pa la rdor legs phrug gu chung ngu yin kyang hur dragasathams cad gzan khyogs byas khyer nas nang du slebs/ bla ma thugs rje can gyi bka' drin gyis de skabs kyang mu ge dang bral zhes gsung / nged 'bras spungs su 'gro khar rje nyid la bdog pa'i skyesadang gsol chas phul/ gshol brtan pa'i zla ba gnyis par yar klungs bkra shis rtse nas chibs bsu —553

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6shebyung ba bcas yer pa lha ri snying po'i gnas yongs rdzogs dang / dpal bsam yas kyi dbu rtse rigs gsum mjal ba gnang nas yar klungs su khyab bdag gnas gsar ba chen po dang gdan 'dzom/zhag bco lnga'i ring bzhugs te phar bu lugs dus 'khor gyi yig cha rnams dang / tshur bde mchog bde chen ral gcig gi glegs bam gyi lung rnams (30ba)gsan len mdzad/ chos sde nas chibs khal g.yar po dang bcas gong dkar rdo rje gdan du phebs/ rje nyi ma gling pa dang mjal 'dzom mdzad pa sngar nas dpon slob thugs 'dres pa lta bu'i thugs nang gtsang ba byung / tshur sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang phar bu ston rin po che'i gsol 'debs tshogs gnyis ma dang rnam rgyal gyi gzungs kyi lung 'bul ba mdzad/rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtshos sne shan dang rtse'i mi sna bcas phyi nang gi rten tshang ma chib gzigs ngos gsung ngag lam 'bras gsan pa'i snyan gsan phul nas(ri phug tu phebs/ dbus phyogs nas phyag tu 'byor pa'i rnyed pa dang rin lding spyi so'i 'bul ba khang drag nas kyi ma'i gos sna thig sogs phyag rdzas gsar 'byor gyi steng sngar gyi gser spyi dang bcas byams pa gling gi dgon par yum gyi dgongs rdzogs su bzo gra btsugs te/ sku'i rten du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal po'i gser sku/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston yab sras kyi sman sku/ gsung gi rten du mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī dang shar chen ye shes rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum po ti gsum/ thugs kyi rten du dngul dkar gyi mchod rten mda' gang pa dri med kyi srog shing 'dzugs pa'i cho ga sogs rten rnams la gzungs 'bul dang rab tu gnas pa'i rim pa shin tu dngos gtsang ba byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'phro ba gnang / sku gzugs mchode rten gnyis ri phug gi gzims mal sku 'dra rin po che'i sku mdun du bsgrigs/yum gyi gdung rus rnams rus cho go mdzad par bu ston rin po che'i phyag par gyis su tsā btab ste ri rtse dang chu bo chen por gdan drangs (31na)zhabs cung zad bsnyun par phyag rdzas lhag rnams sku rim du btang bas sku chas dkon gshis shi gson gyi don du grong chog gi sgo nas gzhan phan rgya cher mdzad/—354

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanazha lu mo yan rnams kyi do dam byas nas gzhi byes kyis dbang gzhi btsugs pa'i 'bul bar nas khal sum brgya tsam dang / rdor lags bkra shis lhun po dang ngor gnyis su me tog 'bul bar rdzong bda' gnang ba'i skyes sogs kyis gsol thab tshugs pa byung /sa glang dbang ldan chos 'khor bas gdan drangs tshogs pa la gsung chos mang po 'bul ba mdzad/ gra rkyang so sos kyang thab gdan chos sogs nyer mkho'i rnyed pa btab/ ri phug tu phebasaskabs khang drag nas kyis shar chen du gdan drangs/ de zhen rtse chen sgrol ma mjal te khrus gsol rgyas par gnang nas khrus chu bum pa gang bsnams te pa rnam dga' gdong rgyab rir sman chu grang tshan zhig yod 'dug par phebs/ de'i sngon sdo pa nor bu dpon g.yog gis grang tshan brgyab nas log rjes rdzing chu phran bu ma gtogs bskams 'dug pa ston pa sangs rgyas kyi sku la sgrol ma'i khrus chus sku khrus gsol ba'i chu rgyun rdzing nang du 'bab pa byas/ gser chos kyi man ngag ltar rje btsun ku ru ku l+le la gsol 'debs dang gtor ma gnang bas rdzing mer gyis skad cig nyid la khengs te rdzing gi phyir lud 'gro ba byung / grang tshan bsten pas zhabs yab nang du mi shong pa'i snyung ro de yang zhag gcig gnyis la gzhi med du song /lcags stag lo nged rang gi ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung gi ched du gzims mal sku 'dra'i sku mdun du rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bshad rgyud rdo (31ba)rje rtse mo'i cho ga rdo rje 'amang mkhyen rab chos rjes dbang ldan chos 'khor du btsugs pa'i phyag len ji lta ba/ sgo bzhi'i dbyangs chos skyong chen po'i bstod re sogasazhag bco brgyad bsgrubs pa'i mchod gzhis snga sor rje nyid la gtsang sde srid kyis gnang ba gzhung nasade lam du 'jags pa'i dar rgyas gzhis ka sbyor ba mdzad/ sgra dbyangs lha mo'i rjes gnang spyi 'gro'i gzhogs drung las sgra 3 ba nas brgyud pa'i khungs btsun de shin tu dkon pa dang 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang gnyis ngor du mkhan chen shes rab 'byung gnas la gsan/ dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che srad la phebs sa 'dug pa mjal ba legs tshul snyan 'bul mdzad pa bzhin —335

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6 pengor mkhan pos byon par/ paṇa chen rin po ches gdan bzhengs phyag babs sogs legs po gnang bas bka' gros thon pa'i tshad du phyin/ ma he mchod par dmigs pa'i bu lugs gshed dmar lha lnga dang tshar lugs rdo rje 'jigs byed las gshin dang bcas pa'i ljags bsnyen gnang / ma he'i bka' bsgor bkra shis lhun po nas dpon slob zhabs drung phebs pas gra sgrig gis zha lu'i gra tshang bzhi'i gra pas ma khom par ri phug dbu mdzad kyis drug cu pa mdzad srol yod pa ltar rje 'di nyid kyis gshed dmar drug cu pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gnang ba'i chog grwar rin lding gra tshang nas gra pa bco lnga bzabs mchor dang bcas 'ongs par gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang bskur rgyas par mdzad/ dbang ldan chos 'khor nas gser rnga zhe gcig brnyan po dang bcas drug cu pa sogs smin rgyas kyi thugs khur bzhes pas dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che'i dgongs (32na)par shin tu bde bar byung / shing rta paṇa chen rin po che sku na smin pas dbus phyogs su phebs 'gul thub ris min 'dug pa nas nged dang mchod yon gnyis gtsang phyogs su bteg /bkra shis lhun po'i rta bsu ba'i slob dpon rnams kyi khrod du rje bla ma 'di nyid byon zhing / ser sbreng ba'i zlar zha lu'i gar pa mang shigs bzabs mchor mchis zha lu'i dbyar bdag gnang gi yod 'dug gshis sang nyin bla brang rgyal mtshan mthon por ja sbyor sbrel zhig la gsung 'phros phran bu las brling ba ma byung / nged rang gis kun mkhyen bu'i sku bstod dag pa don dam mar grags pa brtsams pa tshogs su 'dzugs pa'i khur bzhes gnang / rgyal po sku ltem nas phebs ma thub rung nged dang sde pa sogs kyis zha lu ri mthil gyi gnas mjal rgyas par byas pa'i gnas bshad kyi phyag chen tshang ma rje bla mas gnang / bu ston rin po che'i gsol 'debs/ dpon slob zhabs drung gi brtan bzhugs nged rang gi ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad gsum tshogs chen la gyis gsung ba bzhin bklags lung phul/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du rje bla ma dbus su phebs 'bras spungs su zhag shas bzhugs dgos tshul phebs pa ltar tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs dang snying po don gsum gyi nyams 'khrid sogs phul/ sngar nas 'di rigs kyi 'jug med par brten zhib dpyod kyi do gal ma —356

zha lu lo wo rin r+ṣa bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanashar ba 'di lo bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gshegs pa'i pur sbyong bzhin ma nges pa'i dgongs pa byung na snyam phung po sreg sbyang gi skor dang rim gyis rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs dogs gcod 32bsgong du zhus/gsol phogs kyi 'dzin dang bcas gong dkar chos sder phebs/shing lug lo nyi ma gling du rdo rje 'dzin pa wo po tshul khrims bkra shis pa'i drung du dpal ldan sa skya pa'i zab chos gsung ngag rin po cher ngor rdzong chos sde ba ste thun mong ba'i lugs gsum/thun mong ma yin pa slob bshad dang bzhir yod pa'i srid gsum 'gran zla bral ba chos rje bla ma dam pa'i gsung rab pod nag gzhir bzhag pa'i dbang 'khrid byin rlabs gzhung bshad lung man ngag sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi par/rdzong lugs kyi gegs sel gyi yi ge gcig ma gtags bla ma rin po ches gang gsan thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thugs kyi za ma rtag gtams/bla ma kun bzang rtse paṇa chen bsod nams mag ldan la yo ga khams gsum rnam rgyal dang chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dbang sogs chosabaka' du ma gsan/de nas 'bras spungs su phebs zhag kha shas bzhugs yar klungs bkra shis rtse chosasder gsung chos gsan ring phogs yig gi 'dzin phul/hor zla lnga pa'i nang du bkra shis chos sder phebs nyin rol cha ser sbreng sogs phebs bsu'i bkod pa rgya wo pos mdun bdar te rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba wo po dang gdan 'dzom bka' 'gyur bzheng ba'i thugs brel ma chod ring gsar ma'i rgyud 'bum sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/gshed dmar sprosamed kyi 'khrid sogs chos bka' mang du gsan zhing 'khor lo sdom chen gyis gtsos pa'i dbang chos du ma 'bul ba gnang /smin drug zla ba'i tshes nyi shu nas kun mkhyen klu sgrub rjes/tsho gos bar bshad pa'i drang don za zi'i gtam/r+sām par spangs33na ti slob bu chag dag la//ga rtses par gdams pa nges don snying po'i chos//zab mo slob bshad 'byongs par byin gyis lhos//zhes tshogs bshad tshig gi na yams tsam ma yin par snang gsum gyi dus srid 'byor kun skyug nad can la zan bzhin blo ldog pa dang 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi skabs ku/ rdzob k+ṣ-i kyi rang ma sgo mngon sum du rdeb cing

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)bum dbang man chad la so so'i dmigs pa rdo rus thug par ma zad tshe 'dir grub mtha' ma snyogs na bar do sogs lam gyi tshod 'dzin rnams nyams 'og tu chud nges pa'i gnad kyis tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las/ bdag dbang po brtul zhing brtson khrus zhan/ /don gnas lugs tshe 'dir ma thob na/ /'phrang srid pa bar do'i gnas skabs su/ /lam dran pa rnam gsum gyi gdams pa bsgom/ /rje bar do 'phrang sgrol gyi rdo ring pa/ /sems rang byung rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lam de dag gi nyams tshod 'dzin pa'i phyir/ /thabs sgyu ma rmi lam gyi gdams ngag gis/ /dus nyin mtshan gyi snang ba gcig tu bsres/ /sgom khor yug gi ngang la nyams su len/ /rje sgyu ma ngo sprod kyi rdo ring pa/ /lam rmi lam 'byongasapar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes sa skya tshad kyi rna bar ma grags pa'i ma dang mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs mngar por 'thul ba gsung ngag slob bshad kyi nyams 'khrid zab mo'i dbu btsugs/me sprel dbo zla'i dkar phyogs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la gegs med du legs par grub pa'i chos yon rgyas pa dang bka' 'gyur rin po che bzheng ba gnang ba'i legs byar sngar lo gsum ma gnang sa'i ri phug gi (33ba)gzims khang rnam grol yang rtse rtsa ba nas 'bul ba mdzad pas thugs dgyes pa'i rtse mor phyin/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur bas mkhan po/ rje 'di nyid kyis las slob mdzad nas brtul zhugs spyod pa'i he ru gaḥkong smon rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi gra slob shel brag tu sdod mkhan 'ga' zhig rab byung bsnyen rdzogs su sgrub pa mdzad/ pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtser lha gzigs phag mo gru pa mi pham bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rnam rgyal dpal bzang po mjal bar phebs pa nged zha lu pa'i sbyin bdag gi rtsa ba yin zhes dgyes dgyes dang bsnyen bkur gzengs bstod gnang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi bsti gnas rtses dang bsam gling bde ba chen po'i gtsug lag khang mjal bar phebs/ sku 'dra tshul khrims ma sogs la smon lam rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgo gnyer gtad mdzad/ sger pa gzhis gar phebs 'kha ngo rnams kyis bsu phyag sogasang gus pas btud/ 558

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ lhanagrub thob chen po'i sku brnyan gyis gtsos phyi nang gi rten rnams zhib mjal gnang skabs da lta'i rje drung ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi tsam 'gro ba des grub thob chen po'i sku brnyan phyag nas ma'i sku mdun nas dpe cha shog gcig ma zhig bsnams nas gzhan su la'ang ma sprad par phul ba sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub yin snang /tshur lam phan bde'i 'byung gnas zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dbu rtse rigs gsum/ gling bzhi gling phran jo mo gling gsum dang (34na) bcas pa'i gnas mjal mchod 'bul rgyas par mdzad nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phebs gsung gleng zhib mol ngos rim gyis gong dkar chos sder chibs kha bskyod pa'i nyi ma gling dus 'bor dang yo ga rdor dbyings kyi dbang /sgra mi snyan pa'i tshe sgrub kyi lung / rin po che kun bzang rtse par rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dbang dang rtogs brjod dpag bsam 'khri shing gi lung / rab 'byams chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho'i chos sgo'i 'phrin lasadang por 'byed ba'i rten 'brel du 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i rjes gnang gsan/ mtshungs med nyi ma gling pa'i gsung bzhin rje dpal ldan tshul khrims kun bzang rtse pa/ mdo pa chos rje/ rab 'byamasachos rje sogs dbang cha gnyis la dpal mchog rdor sems dang mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum gyi dbang sbyor drug gi sngon 'gro yan phul ba'i dkyil 'khor zha lu nas bris pa mkhas pa gnyis kyis bzhengs pas rje nyi ma gling pa'i gsung las/ nga'i ma dgon zha lu de brlag pa med pa 'dug gsungs dgyes skad/ gra dmangs la yog 'khrid sogs lung kha shas stsal/ nyi ma gling pa dang dpon slob gnyis brtan bzhugs 'bul res dang phan tshun thugs 'phreng bzhin pa'i ngang nas bla ma rab 'byams pa dang dpon tshang 'jam dbyangs gnyis phyag phyir 'khrid yar lam dpal 'khor chos sder rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kha yar sgrub pa gnang nas ri phug tu rab 'byams chos rjer rje btsun gong ma gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi lung gsan/ phar yang 'ga' zhig gnang / dbang ldan chos 'khor ba dang gzhi (34ba)gra mang zhig la rab byung bsnyen rdzogs stsal/—559

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'bakra shis lhun por dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che mjal bar phebs pa'i ja gral gyi sar bla ma rab 'byams par bka' 'gyur gyi lung yod tshul snyan 'bul mdzad par ga me pa rang byung rdo rjes g.yag sde paṇa chen la dbyangs gsal gyi rjes gnang bskur nas des chos thams cad thob par 'gro gsungs par gzhogs drung nas skar lugs pa rnams kyis lung mdzad pa yin/ bklags lung khungs ma deng sang bod na med tshul sogs bka' phebs rgyas par stsal/ byams pa gling du chos dbar bteg kun mkhyen bu'i nye gnas bsod nams grub kyis mdzad pa'i gar yig steng nas dus 'khor gyis gar dpon tshang 'jam dbyangs kyis phul ba bzhin sbyong bdar dpyis phyin pa gnang / lho bod kyi bde gzar chen po de langs pa'i sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan dpung thog tu rgyal rtser phebs pa mjal bar byon/ ri phug gi dus 'khor sgrub mchod la sa gar sbyin sreg mchod gar sogs kyi gar dpon dang chog dpon rje bla ma 'di nyid kyis gnang / dkyil 'khor de'i steng snye mo ru'i bla ma sogs nyer lnga la bdag po chen pos mtha' brten pa'i dbang rdzogs par stsal lo/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i smin byed dbang gi sgo/ /sgo 'phar brgya phrag phye tshe gdan gzhus kun/ /kun nas tshang ba'i mgon khyod 'og min zhing / /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i gtso bor da gdod 'khrums/ /sbasapa'i rnal 'byor ma dngos grub 'dzin du/ /gshegs la bltos pa min kyang rjes 'jug rnams/ /tshogs chen gsog la bskul 'dis thams cad sgrol/ /sbyin pa'i pha (35na)rol phyin pa ming du zad/ /'od gsal lam nas lha ldan gas la/ /ma sgribs shar ba ji bzhin mngon sum du/ /gzigs tshe bla nas blar 'phel dad pa yis/ /rgyal kun byin rlabs thugs kyi dpal ber gtams/ khrus gsol bcom ldan rig byed lha mo'i mthus/ /sdig to'i dri ma 'brud pa'i rdzing bu mā /gyen 'byung sman gyi chu bo o ga sdus/ /gzhan snang zug rngu'i dug kun drung nas phyung / /rang byung thugs rje ches sogs ri mthil gyi/ / gnasarten mig gi bdud rtsir bsten pa'i tshe/ /dad spel lo rgyus tam byu ra yi rgyud/ khyab bdag bla ma'i rnam dpyod sor mos bskul/ /thu ston 'jigs med dpa' bo'i chos kyi sder/ /thub gzhung lus kun rdzogs pa'i —560

zha lu lo wo rin wo bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanagasung ngag chos/ /mkhas grub rdo rje'i slob dpon nyi gling rje/ /se ston ngur smrig zol gyis 'ongs pa bzhin/ /thun mong lam gyi kun+da bshad nus pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin 'bum phrag zla bas sud min gnad/ /slob bshad pad dkar ze'u 'bru'i sbrang rtsi'i bas/ /'thung ba'i skal bzang bung ba khyod nyid tsam/ /'chi med grub pa'i mgon po lcags zam pas/ /tshe byin brlabs pa'i rten 'brel lhun gyis grub/ /'jam mgon gong ma'i legs bshad lha lam gyi/ /mtha' 'jal gshog rdzogs mkha' lding gnyisagazhan med/ /dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang / /'gro la mngon sum ston pa'i zla ba bzang / /rin chen mdzes pa'i do shal nyer dor nas/ /phyag dar khrod pa'i gos kyis klubs 'di ci/ /sa khyi gnam sa'i dbang phyug bstan (35ba/ridzin da yan rgyal po'i khri 'don la phebs zhor gong dkar du khyab bdag nyi ma gling pa dag zhing du gshegs zin 'dug pa'i gdung mjal mdzad/ de skabs khri 'bul ba'i mi tsho gos ha cang ches pas nged dang mjal gleng zhib par ma byung / sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan la zha lu mthil bcad dgon gyi bka' khyab dgos tshul zhu gnang ltar sde pa nor bur bslab ston phebs/ gtsang du byon nas rje nyi ma gling pa'i 'dra sku legs pa zhig bzhengs pa dang lhan du dngul thebs su srang bcu gsum 'bul ba gnang dgos tshul phebs pa'i bogs zhing sbyar bar brten lo lo bzhin dus ja chag med tshugs pa'i thugs khur ched du bzhes/bkra shis lhun por gtsang dgon skor gyi rgyu mtshan 'bul ba mdzad pa'i bca' yig bu ston rin po che'i dus sor bzhag la yul dus kyi dmigs bsal dgos pa rnams rje nyid kyis dbyi snon mdzad nas dbon slob zhabs drung gi spyan lam du phab pas rin po che bka' drin bskyangs 'di 'dra zhig rang dgos gsungs dgyes pa'i gsung dang bcas mjug tu bu ston rin po cher hor rgyal posaganang ba'i shel tham gyis mnan/ kun mkhyen bu ston rin po cher gsol 'debs dang bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i smon lam gsung rtsom gnang / sku zhabs pa kha cig la rin po che lta bu thams cad kyis byas na rang lugs kyi bstan pa la dga' mo yong bar gda' ste gsungs skad/ gzhis ka rtse nas mi —561—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'asna'i tsha 'jun dang bcas 'jol nyog tu spyod pa rnams nyin gcig la phyi rol tu dbyung nas khrims legs par bsdams te da lta'i bar du gnas pa dam pa 'di'i bka' drin ni zha (36na)lu ba rnams kyis gzhal dka'/ khams mnga' ris kyis gtsos pa'i phyogs mtha'i gra rgyun yong srol mi 'dug cing tshong 'dus sogs nye skor rnams kyang 'gags pas gra rgyun shin tu dkon par rje 'di nyid kyis phebs sgo byung ba bzhin zha lu mi sde'i mi gra yangs pa dang dge 'khor bu gsum bar ma'i gra khral sbyor 'jags byas/ gong dkar nas kun bzang rtse pa dpal ldan tshul khrims ri phug tu gdan 'dren gnang /sa phur stod las smad las kyi dbang sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/ phar sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi dbang sogs kha shas phul/ bla ma phyir thegs nas bsnyen chen bar chad sel byed du sgrol ma bcu bdun ma'i ljags bsnyen gyi rjes su de ba pi tsu'i skabs sku khams shin tu 'dus che bar mnal lam du/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan phebs nas de ba pi tsu'i sngags phreng zhal nas 'khor bzhin pa de phyag gis bzung ste khyod la mi dgos na bton gtong gsung ba dang / yang nub cig rmang lam du rna bar brgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa la bcud ldan gyi gdams ngag zhus nas dben pa'i gnas su nyams su len par khyed gang la sdug zer ba dang / nub cig phyag g.yon pa'i sku rus ma gtogs sha pags bcad pa las sku mtshal mang po zegs yong gi 'dug pa mi zhig na re sdug sran chung rang drags pas da res khrag gi lhag ma ma lus na yong ba 'dug ste lhag dum pa lus song zer ba byung ba ni sngon rnal 'byor dbang phyug kyang grub pa brnyes khar khams 'dus kyi 'phreng bgegs kyis mnal lam du ltas mi sdug pa mang du byung ba 'phreng ba chab khang (36ba)du bor nas ci bder bzhugs pa na bdag med ma bud med tha mal pa'i tshul gyis grub pa thob khar dam tshig nyams sam zhes lung bstan pa bzhin slar bskur nas sgrub pa mdzad pas bdag med lha mo bco lngas rjes su bzung ba'i lo rgyus dang phyogs mtshungs shing / sku mtshal gyi lhag lus pa'ang bsnyen chen rdzogs par grub na sngon bsags kyi sdig sgrib mtha' dag lhag med du byang ngo zhes pa'i brda yin nam snyam/ gong dkar du khyab bdag bka' —562

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtana'agyur ba chen por gnas tshul 'bul ba gnang bar zhib pa slar 'bul tshul gyi zhu lan byung / 'on kyang sku gegs kyi rnam pas sku mtshams 'phror lus/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes pa bcu'i nyin rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar ba chen po laṅka'i rgyal khab pad+ma 'od kyi zhid khams su gshegs pa'i dus mnal lam byung tshul bka' las ri phug byang gling du
