rje bka' 'gyur ba dgyes mdog rnam po byas bdag gi rtsar phebs nas phyag 'phreng raka de 'di dang la mi dgos pa 'dug thugs bcag mdzod cig gsungs nas bdag la gnang / sku mdun tshur bstan rgyab 'gros kyis sgo nang nas zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas thegs song zhes gsung / de yang rje bka' 'gyur ba gong dkar du me tog 'thor ba'i zhugs 'bul la rje 'di nyid phebs dgos tshul gyi nged rang nas yi ge phul/ gong du slar zhib cha 'bul gsung ba'i nga 'di la dgongs par snang / de skabs gad sgo zhang tshan dang bkras sgang nas sogs lag sprel gyi bde gzar langs pa'i skabs yin rung pa rnam man la skya langs med gshis khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po shar rgyag chos sder phebs/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi (37na)sku gdung rin po che 'jam dpal dbyangs dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhengs pa la sreg rdzas kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung rgya cher spro bar mdzad pa'i tshe zhugs rtsol pa la ma bltos par rang 'bar lta bu dang de'i sang nyin me tog gi char 'dra ba nyi ma'i 'og nas 'od skya sim sim gdung khang la nye bar mang du babs pa'i ngo mtshar can byung / thugs bral chod nas rje bla ma po ta lar phebs/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las bshad pa bzhin nged rang yang 'jig rten khur len dang khyad par bde gzar gyi g.yeng bas bdag chen sngags 'chang chen po dang 'brug pa pad+ma dkar po gnyis la 'gran bzod pa'i ban ling gis blo kha rdzogs pa'i zhib cha zhu ma thub rung da lta'i bzhugs gnas grang khang chos 'khor shar chen dang khang rnying pa'i mchod gzhis bkra shis lhun po'i gzims dpon sog po blo bzang chos 'phel gyis phrogs pa lcags yos sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan gyi dgongs khrel la brten tshang ma shor ba'i gzhung khongs su yod pa dgongs bzhed ltas phyir —563—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)'bul zhus pa khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i dgongs rdzogs la dmigs nas gsang 'dus sgrub mchod nyin bzhi spar ba gnang /lcags khyi'i ston sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i khri 'bul la phebs/ de skabs rje 'di nyid dang lhan du ngor mkhan chen dpal gling pa gra thang mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal bzang sogs kha shas la chag lugs tshe dpag med kyi rjes gnang / grub rgyal dang rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs/ thig le bcu drug gi dbang / bka' gdams (37ba)pha chos bu chos/ spyod 'jug gi lung dang ngor mkhan po byon rjes slar dpon slob rnams la dmar chung skor gsum dang beg tsi'i rjes gnang rnams phul/thig le bcu drug gi nyin 'ja' sprin byung phebs pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar bzhin chos kyi che bar mngon/ zha lur mchod gzhis dgos tshul mdzad pa bzhin pa rnam la phyi gzhis rka'i mi gra yong 'bab rnams sbyor 'jags zhus pas dus mchod chen mo'i nyi ma bzhi 'phar ba dang /zhing yan 'bul mkhan rnams dang bcas deng sang dpal mchog dang rtse mo gnyis zhag bcu gnyis kyi bar tshugs pa'i cho ga yongs rdzogs re 'gro gi yod par snang / gsol phogs phul nas dga' ldan khang gsar gyi lcog tu khyab bdag zha lu pa nyid kyis zla gcig bar rta mgrin zhabs brgyad pa'i ljags bsnyen gnang / de grub nas po ta lar rgyang tsam bzhugs/ nged kyis khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen pos thugs rtsom mdzad pa'i rnam sras lnga phrag lnga'i rjes gnang gi yig cha'i lung zhus pa chos 'brel gyi thog ma yin/ de snga zhig mnal lam bzung nas nged la dus 'khor gyi dbang gnang rgyu'i lugs kyis 'phur nas po ta lar phebs pa'i gzims chung de da lta'i 'di ga sgra ji bzhin par 'dug gsung / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang nyams 'khrid yang bskyar zhal gyi spu gri so bsdebs kyi 'khrid/ rigs 'dzin chen po'i dag snang rlung sbyor tshe sgrub/ gshed dmar bskyed rim sogs 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i gsung pod longs rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung 'bum thor bu/ dbyangs can dkar mo'i rjes gnang khyad par can (38na ting sgrub skor/ rtse mo'i kha 'bar ma sogs bla ma sna tshogs kyis —364

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)mdzad pa'i sgrub skor rjes gnang gi yi ge /nyi ma mdung gang ma'i sgom lung sogs dang rje nyid kyi thugs rtsom pod longs tsam yod tshod nas rab gnas phun tshogs dpal 'bar gyis gtsos zab chos mang du zhus/ khyab bdag gnas gsar ba chen po dag zhing du gshegs rjes tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi ring lugs 'dzin par rje 'di nyid las lhag pa zhig mi 'dug pa dang sa zhal gyi rab 'byams rgyud sde kun la mkhyen rab zla bral bar dbang rnon chos rjes 'brang ba'i dad pa lhag par thob/ chos ldan gyi bya ba rgya che ba re mdzad res kyi smon lam log pa'i 'tshub stongs re yong gi yod 'dug pas brtag thabs bzhin dpal 'bri gung zur pa rin po che gnam lcags me 'bar gyi gter gsar hūṃ sgrub rdo rje gro lod kyi dbang lung phul/ gong dkar chos sder a gi'i bsnyen chen gyi ring rtse nas gsol phogs kyi 'dzin dang bcas phyir phebs skabs zhal gnad dbab mgon po'i rjes gnang de chad par nye 'dug pa khyab bdag zha lu par 'bul dgos pa'i mtshams sbyor gyi yi ge bsnams nas lcags zam du phebs pa dpon slob thugs nang gtsang zhing dgyes pa'i sgo nas rta mgrin zhabs brgyad pa'i byin rlabs dang lung gnang dbab mgon po'i rjes gnang byung zhing rjes su'ang dbang chos mang du gsan/ bka' las/bdag gis tshe 'di la mjal kha dus la ma thos na phyi ma myur du mjal ba dgos zhus pas de ga byed phebs byung ba sprul pa'i sku 'di dang myur du mjal ba la dgongs pa yin pa 'dra la/ gsung (38ba〉pas da cha mtshams ji ltar dam yang sger pa'i zhal ngo rnams dang rin po che rang nam yin la mtshams 'og tu phebs chog gnang ba sogs bka' drin bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskyangs/ dngul gdung bzhengs dusasku rgyur phan pa'i srang bcu gcig phul zhes gsung / gong dkar sne'u khang gsar du bzhugs skabs mnal lam du rje nyid lcags zam gyi ga: ngos nas zhal shar du gzigs nas phebs pa dang shar nas 'phreng de la grub thob thang stong rgyal po mi lpags kyi na bza' gyon pa zhig byon/ khrug rtsod bzhugs nas g.yang gzhi de thengs gsum brdabs song bar rje bla mas dri ba zhus pa na lcags zam pa dang khong la sdang ba'i dgra zhig bsgral ba yin gsung / da ci drag zhus pas ngan song sdug bsngal ma myong sogs —565

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 62)smon lam thob gzhan byed rgyu ci yod gsung / de nas mi zhig gis khyed kyis lcags zam la rab gnas gyis zer/ gcig na re lcags la 'gro mi nus zer ba la nga lcags zam pa'i bu chen lcags la 'gro mi nus pa e yin gsungs lcags zam gyi steng gi nam mkha' la 'phur nas lcags zam dang dgon pa la rab gnas gnang ba byung bar gda'/lcags glang zla ba dang po nas bzung gong dkar rdo rje gdan du thog mar gegs sel la hūṃ sgrub cig gnang rjes nga a gi' bsnyen chen bcu cha'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa hor zla bcu gcig pa tshun la gegs med du legs par grub pa ni snyan brgyud ma bzhi ldan gyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshugs pa lta bur song / dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che sku na mthon por phebs pa'i phyogs 'byon ma thub gshis kun spangs gnang (39na)ba'i dgongs pa bstad/ mkhan po 'os mi 'os sna tshogs pa'i khrod nas 'dre dang glud kyi dpe bzhin chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i bstan par kha phyogs ma log pa zhig gal che gshis rje nyid sku mtshams la bzhugs thog sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtshos phyag tham mdzad pa bzhin 'di nas kyang da lam sku mtshams kyi thog snyan gsan byung ba rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rin po che'i bzhugs khri chos phyogs su ma zad 'jig rten phyogs nas kyang shar rgyal pos shel tham gnang ba sogs 'gangs che bas dngos grub kyi sgo bye ba lta bur 'dug pas zhal len gnang ba 'gab tshul zhus hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po po ta lar phebs rdor dbyings kyi dbang / lam 'bras pod nag /dzam dmar srog sgrub kyi rjes gnang man ngag skor/ skyer sgang pa'i thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum pa/ ba ri lugs kyi rnam 'joms/ seng ge sgra'i rjes gnang dang ngag bsrung 'grol/ dur khrod bdag po'i las tshogs kyi lung sogs zhus/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i 'dul ba'i bslab bya'i lung phul/ phebs rdzong dang bsko 'ja'i tshan grangs tshogs chen la 'bru 'gyed/ gzhi rtser sde pa'i phyag tham dang bcas chibs kha gtsang du bskyod/ /chu bo stag gi lo cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus chen tshes drug gi 'phrod sbyor phun sum tshogs pa'i tshe —566

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ lhanagangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gnas lnga rig pa smra ba la zla med pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po bu ston rin cen grub ces ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa rab gsal gyi rnam par sprul pa'i gdan sa dpal (39ba)zha lu gser bkang dang ri phug gi chos kyi khrir zhabs zung gi pad+ma rnam par bkod par gzhis ka rtse nas zhing mo che ba mi snar mngags pa'i gzhung gi tshan grangs dang gra rigs sbyin bdag sogs kyi legs 'bul bcas phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis dang dga' ston rgya cher spel te chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i me ro slar yang gso ba'i sgo 'phar phye/ zhing mo che bas phyi nang gi rtsis sprod zhib par phul/ bu ston rin po che'i zhal gdams dbu sngas 'gor bzhag nas yang yang gzigasate dbyar dgun gyi dus chos/ gar thig dbyangs sogs gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub mchod/ dbang byin rlabs/ rjes gnang / lung nyams 'khrid sogs kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs gshegs pa nas bzung ming gi lhag mar gyur pa ri mo rnying pa gab pa slar yang gsal ba'i tshul du bstan pa'i byi dor mdzad/tshogs byi rdzing mkhan po sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis 'bad pa chen pos gsol ba btab pa ltar mkhan po'i zhar byung du dpon mkhyen rab rnam rgyal sogs don gnyer can du ma la gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad kyi nyams 'khrid rgyas par stsal/ zab chos 'di nyid gnyan drags pa'i tshub stongs kyi rnam pas kun slong skyon can gyis thugs sun dbyung ba 'dra byung ba'ang ring por mi thogs par zla ba gza' las grol ba bzhin 'jam chags su gyur/ mkhan por sger du rdo rje brag rdzong ma'i nyams 'khrid/snyan brgyud po ti dang kha skong po ti phal cher gyi ljags lung / rdor dbyings kyi dbang / sa'i ṭa'i ṭīka chen sogs chos bka' mang du stsal/ dbus su phebs pa'i nye (40na〉skun la rdor legs rdzongs bda' mdzad nas grub pa'i 'khor ༷ ba bi ྅ ba'i bzhed gzhung 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i gtso bo la bzhi 'bum dang 'khor la bzhi khri'i ljags bsnyen shin tu dam pa gnang /chu yos lha me zla dgu pa'i tshes 'gor po ta lar phebs rwa lugs kyi dmar po mda' gzhu 'gong ba'i dug dbang dang / gur las byung phyag rdor 'byung 'dul/ snyemado sngags long shākya dpal ba'i dag —567

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sesnang gi me dbang / gtsug tor 'bar ma sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhig zhugashing 'jigs byed kyi sngags btu'i rjes gnang dang tshe dbang 'chi med dpal ster phul/ ma he mchod pa'i bka' bsgo gnang rtsis 'dug pa 'jam dpal rdo rje dngos dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i 'khor lo'i mgon pos mdzad thub pa gzhir bcas kyang dam tshig mi gtsang ba'i sa nas mang ja sogs zab 'brel byung na 'tshub lhongs mi yong ba'i nges pa med cing / de rigs la 'dzem cha'ang gnang dka' ba nas da lam res ma gnang ba 'gab tshul nan tar gsol/ zha lur phebs nas ma he mchod pa ma grub bar 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba'i ljags bsnyen/ las gshin la bskang ba 'phrin bcol/ drug cu pa sogs sku mtshams khog nas star chags su gnang /shing 'brug lo gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skyar phebs nyin ga ra gzhung du las sne drag pa lnga chibs bsur byung / bzhi thog tu phebs skabs drung 'khor skya ser rnams kyis bla brang mdor phebs bsur 'ongs nas mjal dar dang / gzims chung 'gag tu phyag mdzod pas mjal (40bskor dang phyag phul/ bdag chen rin po che yab sras gnyis kyis bzhugs khri'i steng nas dbu zhwa phud de bzheng ba dang mjal dar bzhugs gdan bzos sgo sogs bdag nyid chen bo bzang po dpal ba'i dus zha lu mkhan por gang gnang ga'u le'i nang bzhin gzengs bstod/ zhabs drung chen mor bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang nyams 'khrid/ rngam sras kyi be'u bum po ti gnyis/bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti sogs gsung chos rgya cher gsan zhing lugs gnyis nas bdag rkyen phul du byung bas dpon slob thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bur gyur/ slob bshad kyi bstan 'dzin chen po yangs can mkhan po gzims shag pa ngag dbang rnam rgyal la ni gu yongs rdzogs gsan rtsis gzims shag chos rje'i sku khams kyis ma lcogs par brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun gyi rnam thar sogs thor bu dang 'jam mgon sa skya pa'i lcam sring zhabs drung rje btsun drung la'ang ljags lung gi rigs gsan/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis rab tu gnas pa'i bse mgon ye shes sems —568

zha lu lo r+ṣa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)dpa' dngos su bzhugs pas gtsos mgon khang dang mchod khang rnam grangs ches mang ba/dam can srung ma sprin bzhi du 'du ba'i zhing skyong dbang po'i pho brang tshar lugs zhes grub mtha' 'bur du dod pa'i rdo rje gdan kha'u skyes lhas/mkhas grub mang pos grub mtha' stogs pa'i dben gnas bya 'gyur sogs kyi rten brten pa rnams zhib mjal mdzad nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgyas pa'i smon lam rlabs chen dang /rdo rje chos skyong rnams la bka' bsgo gnyer du gtang /bya 'gyur 41na gyi brag logasashig tu rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa ba pa gzigs pa spyan 'khrul lam dgongs te zhabs 'bring ba rnams la khyod tshos mthong ngam gsungs pa la gang yang mi 'dug zhus skad/de ni lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa pad+ma'i skud pa ltar phra ba rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mdzad de bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal ba'i rten 'brel du mngon//zha lur phebs nas dngul dang gos dar sogs kyi tshong bsgyur la brten 'du khang chen mor gser shog shin tu phyug pa'i shing rtsi legs par bskrun te rab gnas rgyas par mdzad do//mang bkur rgyal por gsol ba'i dga' ston zhan//mi dbang bka' rtags lung gi lcid chen pos//gser bkang dwangs mtsho ri khrims ldan ngur pa'i khyu//thos bsam skad snyan khrol ba'i chog bstar//rdor 'dzin dril can bla ma rnam gnyis kyi//thugs dgongs chos dbyings klong du nyer rdzogs par//gcig tu brtson 'di bshes gnyen bsten tshul la//rtag tu ngu yi rnam par thar ba bzhin//gsar pa'i legs bshad dngos grub 'dod 'jo'i gter//nā ro ta pa'i snyan brgyud gsang lam mchog/mgon khyod zhal lung ro bda' bdud rtsi'i bcud//sgos med 'thung ba'i thog ma'i skal bzang rnyed/khamasa'adus 'phrang gi dbang du ma gtong zhes/khyab bdag bla mas mnal lam lung bstan mthus//dgyesamadzad rdo rje longs bsnyen grub mtshan gyis//sa drug ma wa zhe gyur dpal ldan chos stong bzhin//brtul zhugs spyod pa mthar phyin thang stong bas//log 'dren phye mar 'thag pa'i stang stabs mdzad//4bamakha' la 'dab chags ltar 'phur sprul bsgyur rdi/9/'od gsal gcig gis khor yug 'byams su

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyeklas/ /kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs de'i seng ge'i khrir/ /mgon khyod rgyal tshab dam par dbang bskur bas/ /cher snyigs bstan pa'i me tog ldum ra la/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i chu bo 'dren par bskul/ /'khon rigs 'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes su bzung / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dgyes zhal mngon sum bstan/ /rdo rje'i chos srung rnams kyis 'phrin las kun/ /'bad med sgrub pa'i rten 'byung lhug par 'grig /kun dga' ra ba'i kho ra khor yug rnams/ /gser gyi ba gam lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro/ /dam tshig ye shes gnyis med rab gnas pa'i/ /dga' ston dpyid kyi pho nya'i glu bzhin snyan/ /shing sprul gyi ston rje nyid po ta lar phebs hor zla bcu pa'i tshes drug nas zhag shas kyi bar klu sgrub rjes mdzad pa'i lam 'bras kyi 'khrid/ /dzam lha 'brug zhon ma'i rjes gnang sgrub skor/ /jo bo a ti sha lugs kyi rta mgrin gshog pa can dang shwa na bzhi skor gyi rjes gnang / /bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti/ /rnam sras kyi be'u bum/ /bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i las chog gi lung sogs gsung chos mang du nos rten 'brel gyi khyad nas 'phrang 'go gter ston gyi tshe rta phul zhing byad rbod kyi thugs rtog dang bcas sku ha cang bde ba mi 'dug pas byad 'grol zhus/ /dgun grang ring gong dkar chos sder sku mtshams la phebs pa'i gsol chas phul /sku mtshams ma tshugs gong du slob dpon rnam mkhyen grong pa sogs chos sde'i gra slob kha shas dang gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin (42na〉pa bu ston chos 'byung dang bsam gtan gling pa'i a ti'i lung gnang / /mdo pa chos rje mtshungs med dge ba'i dbang por 'jigs byed ro langs brgyad skor gyi dbang dang ras chen dpal 'byor bzang po nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang mda' 'phel ma gsan/me rta cho 'phrul chen mo'i thog dmar po rir phebs kye rdo rje man ngag lugs kyi rgyu lam gyi dbang / /lam zab bir srung / nā ro mkha' spyod/ sngar mthong ba'i gur zhal gyi be'u bum kha skong gi yig cha du ma/ dgas ljon skor gsum thub pa dgongs gsal/ bu ston chos 'byung / lam 'bras pod dmar dang bod khra'i stod cha/ sman bla'i mdo chog /mkhan ngag dbang chos grags kyi rnam sras lnga phrag lnga'i rjes —570

zha lu lo wo rin wo bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanaganang yi ge ma ti lugs kyi 'jam dkar/sna tsho gos yum/las gshin dpa' gcig/bstobadun ma//bse bya bzhis bskor/khrag mdog dmar po/trag shad/gdugs dkar/legs ldan mched kyi rjesaganang sogs dbang lung zab chos mang po/man ngag dbang rjes gnang gi phyag len dang /gzhung don gyi rigs la the tshom pa du mar dogs gcod zhus pas/mdo las/gang zhig zas dang gos kyi gtam tsam ni//de ni rab dang mchog ces sems ma yin//mi yi rnyed pa rab mchog rnyed nas ni//gcig la gcig gis chos kyi gtam yang bya//zhes zas gos sogs gnas skabs gyi 'du 'dzi'i gleng mo ni skye bo phal ba dag gi ngang tshul yin la/rnyed pa mchog ni dam pa'i chos kyi legs bshad yin par gsungs shing /mgon po klu sgrub kyis//smra na yid phebs 'brel ba dang //don 42ba ) gas la yid du 'ong ba dang //chags sdang zhe sdang spang ba dang //'jam zhing ran par smra bar bya//zhes brjod bya'i don khungs dang 'brel zhing tshig don rnams ma 'dres par so sor gsal la snyan par smra bas yid la 'jebs pa//rang phyogs la chags pa dang gzhan phyogs la sdang ba med pa gzu bo'i tshig gis gdul bya'i blo mchog dman dang bstun te ran par smra ba'i yon tan mtha' dag bla ma dam pa 'di nyid la tshang bas rgyal pa'i gsung rab spyi dang khyad par rdo rje theg pa la mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/so sor thar pa'i bcas pa phra mo la'ang mi 'da' ba'i btsun pa'i mchoge tu gyur/ bdag g.yin mnyam par brje ba'i byang chub kyi semasabacos ma ma yin pa thugs rgyud la mnga' bas bzang po'i tshad du phyin/bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog la brten nas rtogs pa'i bdag nyid chen por gyur/khyad par kun mkhyen bu dang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i ring lugs thugs kyi dpal be'ur bcangs pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu zla med bar mthong nas gcam bu tsam ma yin par khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor yid ches kyis mos pa thob/se ston chen po'i dbang chog nges don bde 'jug gi steng nas 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dbang bzhi yongs rdzogs dang byad 'grol phul/skyi gtsang gi chu bzang bas sku khams kyang shin tu dwangs/nā ro mkha' spyod 7dang 'chi med dpal ster gnyis kyi brgyud 'debs/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6kyegashed dmar gyi brgyud 'debs thugs sras lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i 'phro 'thud rnams bzhed pa bzhin brtsams/ chos (43na)yon gyi maṇ+ḍal rgyas par bteg nas gtsang phyogs su thegs/ re zhig zha lur sku ngal gsos nas gdan sa gong du phebs bdag chen 'jam dpal dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs drung du dbu sems lugs kyi sems bskyed/lam zab nang ma sogs dbang lung byin rlabs mang du gsan/ 'jam mgon sa skya pa chen po yab sras la dgongs bzhed dang bstun pa'i bka' chos ci rigs 'bul ba gnang / lo phu mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang dpal bzang la kye rdor 'jigs byed/ rdo rje khyung khra bo sogs kyi zab chos mang du gsan/ bla ma 'di rdzong lugs kyi bstan 'dzin zla med pa zhig 'dug ces bsngags brjod kyang mdzad/sa sprel lo 'gor gtsang nas shar rgyag po ta lar skor tsam phebs nas mi 'gyangs par chos sder bzhugs mur zha lu'i mkhan por khrol cha dgos tshul la rdor legs pa 'byor/ nag pa zla bar slar gong dkar nas po ta lar phebs 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa/kye rdor nag po mtsho skyes tom bhi gsum/ gtsug tor dri med dang 'od zer dri med rnams kyi dbang / gshed dmar gyi spros med/ 'od gsal/ bdud rtsi gsum gyi byin rlabs dang chos skor/ lam zab nang ma sogasalam 'bras dang 'brel ba'i byin rlabs bco lnga skor lam 'bras pod khra'i smad cha/ khyung khra'i byin rlabs trelas tshogs klu dbang gi rgyal po khro mo sme brtsegs kyi rjes gnang / rwa pod kyi kha skong dang zhal (43ba)gyi rdzong pod/ dbu sems lugs kyi sems bskyed gnyis/ sems nyid ngal gso'i 'khrid sogs dbang chos mang du zhus/sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i dgongs rdzogs kyi sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i gser thang la rdo rje dbyings kyi gsung dbang gi sgo nas rab tu gnas pa mdzad pas sde pa de nyid sku bsod che snyam pa shar/zha lu'i chen slob 'ga' 'byor ba'i mkhan po re zhig ngang bsring gnang ba'i ngo chen dgos tshul ltar rgyu mtshan gsol bas lo gcig gi zhal len mdzad/ rkyen sel gyi tshe dbang sogs phul te gtsang du chibs 572

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)kha sgyur/ pa rnam bsam sdings na bu ston rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi par gtos che ba dang sku par yod 'dug pa rnams dgongs bzhed ltar zha phur phul/ gra gzhen rnams kyis gdan drangs pa'i tshe mkhan rin po che nyid kyis spos sna dang tshogs pas ser sbreng rgyas par bstar/ gtsug lag khang gi ldebs ris dang gnam rgyan sogs kyang phal cher grub/ 'phyong rgyas snyem bu bar 'phrong rtse byung ba'i kha spror gdan drangs legs bya'i skyes dang rab gnas rgyas par gnang /zha lur bzhugs pa'i mchod gzhis kyi don skor la rdor legs pa rdzong bda' mdzad/ sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs mchod dpon gyi las sne'i skabs yin pa brgyud phebs sgo byung ba bzhin pa rnam snang gi mi gra yongs 'bab rnams sbyor 'jags zhus/ snar thang 'bag sna sa stong bsod nams rab brtan gyis zha lu bar gnang pa rin cen rtse ba lha bsangs dran 'phrul che zhing bskyod thabs 'dra la brten pa'i phyogs pa kha mchu ma chod pa'i mur 'dug pa rin cen rtse bas snum gyi dkar 'don ma nus par (44na)brten nor bdag por sprad/ thugs rje chen po don yod zhags pa'i sgrub mchod zha lu sa la bting ba nas zla ba dang po byung res la tshugs pa bar skabs su chag na'ang 'di lo 'bag sna'i sa ris la brten nas sngar lugs su tshugs sa bya lo zha lur bzhugs pa'i dpyid lha'i jus rim la dmigs pa'i zha lu spyi sos las gshin gyi gtor bzlog btsugs skabs glo bur du sku ltem pa'i zham ring pa rnams blo 'khol pa'i dus gzigs snang du beng gi 'cham sku zhal 'dzum pa nas skyon mi 'dug gsung ba ltar 'phral du sku dwangs/ dbyar sku shin tu bsnyan pa'i brtag pa dgos tshul dang bcas phyag brisabyung 'phral brtan bzhugs kyi tshigs bcad sku ber bzhugs 'ding sogs phul/ brtag par shar ba'i sku rim rnams mdzad pa'i dus/ 'od gsal du mgon po gur mi tshad tsam du shar zhing / brag rdzong ma la nyams len mdzad pas sku bde ru song / 'jigs byed bu lugs ma byed par tshar lugs gyis zer ba bzhin nyams bzhes gnang bas kyang bogs shin tu che/ de nas nyang stod du mkha' drag nas kyi gzhis gar dpon tshang mthong smon rgyas pas bcos ka mang du phul bas dwangs rgyu'i khul gyis zha lur —573

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)tshur phebs nas sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyi khri 'don la bteg /byad skrod kyi rtags dang snyung gzhi yang je mthor song nas skyi gshongs su bzhugs rdor legs khri 'bul la rdzong bda' gnang / grong gseb tu bzhugs pa ma 'gab pas rin lding ba'i dgon lag chos lung du bsgril/ dpon tshang skyid dpe ba ngag dbang bzod pas thang chen nyer lnga dang bsnol rtsar gtar (44ba〉pa sogs sman dpyad kyi 'phrod bsten mang du zhus pas skyed blangs/ sku gegs la dmigs pa'i srung 'khor bzhes yig /bden pa brjod pa'i tshigs bcad tshan grangs dang bcas 'bul mi mngags/ dal 'gros kyis po ta la ra sa bya'i mjug tu phebs/ nged lag pa na ba dang thug pa'i rjes gnang 'bul ma thub rung de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung dang skyon chen po'i gter sku mang po'i byin rlabs phul/ sku khams dub par 'dug pas chos zhu ba'i spros pa ma byung / gsol phogs dang bcas sku'i 'phrod bsten la gong dkar chos sder bzhugs/lcags khyi zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes 'go la yar byon log tri'i rig gtad phul pas rgya mthongs kha phye ba lta bu'i snyun gzhi la khyad mnga' che ba byung gsung / kun mkhyen bu dang byang sems bsod grags pa zhal sprod kyi bris thang byin can zhig gnang / zhal 'don tshigs bcad ma dgos phebs pa nged rang la nus mthu gang yang med mod 'on kyang 'brog mi'i gsung 'gros rdo ring rin che'i rnam thar du drangs 'dug pa bzhin/ tshe mtha' yas dngos dbang drag pad+ma yi/ /'khor lo'i mgon po ngag dbang blo gros gter/ /skal bzang rgya mtshor nges pas gsol 'debs na/ /bar chad bdud las rgyal bar bdag byin rlobs/ /zhes pa bris nas phul/ mtshan sgyur gnang rgyu yin phebs par tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang por gsol/ 'phreng ba zhe lnga ma'i dkyil thang bzheng ba'i 'go tshugs dang 'grig pa'i rgya bod kyi gzhung dang rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam thang kha bstun pa'i zhu dag gnang / gtsang (45na)du shar rgyag thegs rtsis la gong dkar du chu 'bam gyis bsnyun par skyid dpe nas kyis chab nad gzhi med du btang yang zhabs nad la drung 'tsho sum dga' rdzong bda' byas—574

zha lu lo chen rin wo bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)pasangs med du bde/ dbyar thog gsol chas phul nas cho me sder bzhugs/ sku khams ma gzhi yang dwangs skyed shin tu che bas chos sde'i gra pa byed sum brgya tsam la dbang cha bcu lhag tu bcad pa'i gdugs dkar lha mang gi dbang dang legs ldan mched gsum gyi rjes gnang stsal/ mang thos 'phrin las rnam rgyal la bka' gdams glegs bam dang grub thob brgyad cu'i byin rlabs sogs chos bka' mang du gsan/hor zla lnga pa'i nang du dmar po rir phebs zhal dkar po'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa/tshogs bdag gi rjes gnang khyad par ba dang thun mong ma yin pa/ /'chi med rdo rje'i lha mo'i rjes gnang / bka' gdams lha bzhi'i 'khrid/ dpal yo'i blo sbyong chen mo'i 'khrid/ yang dag gi dbang sogs chos bka' 'ga' zhes zhus shing / rim gyis gtsang du thegs mkhan po kun spangs mdzad pa'i sgo dod nas sprod dpang du gzhis rtse nas zhing mo che pa rdzong bda' byas pa'i thog mar gser sku mda' gang tsam gcig /gzims mal sku 'dra rin po cher dbu paṇa/ rnam sbyar/ dbu thog tu bla bre sham ldan/mchod khang gi lta mo gling gcig la gnam rgyan/ sku mdun du dngul gyi maṇ+ḍal che ba/ ljangs gser gyi maṇ+ḍal/ li ting 'gag gzugs bdun tshar/ bum pa gras mtshungs bcu/ mchod kong / /rten khri (45ba)dmar 'jam legs pa mi tshad tsam/ bla bre sham ldan/ rnga bo che thog tshad/ gsol cog rnams re/ gos snyel gnyis/ sba stir/ rtsid phying gru bzhi gsum/ gos gdan kha gang ma/ bzhugs 'ding/ 'jag gdan ring ba cha bzhi gar dpon la gos gdan kha gang bzhi rnams dang / bla brang gnyer tshang du rtsam khal brgyad cu/ tsha khal bzhi bcu/ nas khal stong tsho gcig /lug khog brgya/ chag bubs bzhi/ mar khal bzhi bcu/'bras khal drug /snum mkhar khal bzhi/ phyur ba khal phyed gnyis sogs sprod 'phar rgya cher gnang /lcags phag zla ba dang por rje bla ma'i zhabs phyir zha lu'i chen slob sogs dpon slob nyi shu skor gyis tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i bzhed srol gyi tshe chog la brten nas maṇ+ḍal gyi tshan grangs bzab rgyas dang bcas nged dang sde pa thun mong du ring 'tsho'i rten —575

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokye'abyung mdzad/ mkhan rin po che'i zhabs phyi bsgugs sdod chen slob gra rigs rnams kyis zhol du tshe chog btsugs/ nged kyi rje bla ma'i drung du sa skya bka' 'bum/ sems dpa' chen pos bsgrigs pa'i blo sbyong be'u bum/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ bde mchog lha lnga'i dbang / rwa rtse sems 'dzin/ gtum mo zhag bdun ma'i 'khrid sogs zab chos mang du zhus/ khyab bdag bla mar paṇa chen nags rin nas brgyud pa'i tshe dbang khyad 'phags phul zhing chen slob tshor ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung gi lung bklags/ zha lu sku zhad la mkhan po'i bsko 'ja' phyag tham sogs sde pas mdzad/ rje bla mar bdog pa/ (46na)maṇ+ḍal gyi tshul du bteg nyer lnga la dpon slob rnams gtsang du thegs/ sgrub mchod chen mo'i thog dbang cha gcig la 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang gnang / sku zhang mkhan thog tu byon zin pa'i thugs g.yeng bor nas ngor mkhan chen sgrub khang pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan gdan drangs sam+bha zhi'i dbang dang lam 'bras bod dmar gyi lung sogs chos mang du gsan/ khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos/ ngor mkhan chen/ gnas gsar zhabs drung dpon nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ zha lu'i chen slob sogs la dbang lung mang du mdzad gdan sa gong du rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras mjal ba gnang zhing zab chos mang du gsan/ tshar lugs kyi bstan 'dzin rgyal rtse zhabs drung byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan la tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma lha so gsum gyi dbang sogs chos bka' kha yar gsan/ phyir byon nas dbus su bteg pa'i lam du rlung 'tshub shin tu che ba byung bas bshol nas zha lur sku mtshams bsdams pa'i rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi bsnyen sgrub gnang /chu byi zla ba dang po nas gong dkar chos sder bzhugs gdan 'jags ring dpon po lo tsā ba gsol phogs kyi rgyu mtshan la byung ba bzhin 'dzin phul/ zla ba lnga pa phyi ma'i nang du po ta lar phebs/chag med bzhi yang skyor dang phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa/ mi 'brugs pa lha bcu gsum gyi dbang /rta mgrin shangs lugs kyi byin rlabs/ phyag bzhi pa dang seng gdong ma dmar mo'i (46ba)rjes gnang /gsang 'dus 'grel chen sogs kun mkhyen bu'i gsung rab du ma'i lung dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi phyag —576

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ (tanargya 'ching tshul mkhyen rab rje dang dkon cog lhun grub gnyis kyi lam 'bras kyi 'khrid/ ngor chen dang rdo rje gdan pa gnyis kyi kye rdor gyi bskyed rim rnam bshad/ bla ma dam pa'i phur pa'i skor/ spyan ras gzigs chem bu lugs dmar 'khrid kyi yi ge /'dul ba me tog 'phreng rgyus sogs zhib rgyas zhus/hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug nas brtsams te khyab bdag zha lu chen pos dgos tshul phebs pa'i zhar la chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa sogs nyi shu skor la g.yu thog snying thig gi dbang bzhi/ tshe dbang / lung yongs rdzogs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'byul 'khor gyi lung dang phyag 'khrid phul/ slob dpon be+e ro tsa na'i sku'i rnam sprul rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling bar chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i drag dmar yongs rdzogs dang gter gsar gyi skor gsan/ gter ston rin po cher mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs dang nyams 'khrid 'bul ba gnang / hor zla bdun pa'i nang gtsang phyogs la thegs zha lur zhag gnyis gsum zhig sku ngal gsos nas dpal ldan sa skyar phebs/ nged la bskul ma gnang ba'i brtan bzhugs tshigs bcad le tshan dang bcas bdag chen yab sras gnyis dzir brtan bzhugs rgyas pa dang dkar po rgyang grags bus pa'i tshogs chen la mang ja zhu pa gnang / dbang rjes gnang sogs chos mang du gsan zhing de mtshungs phar yang 'bul ba mdzad/ rim bzhin bsti gnas su phebs byams pa'i (47na)rnam sprul chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi dgongs pa bzhin dpal 'khor chos sde'i sa ga zla bar dge rtsa chen mor grags pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i sgrub mchod yod pa'ang phyis skor dbang ma thob par byung rgyal du spyod pa'i ya nga ba zhig yong snang bas/ 'di lo khyab bdag zha lu pa chen pos nged la khyab cha dgos tshul dang gter ston rin po cher yang de ga'i bskul ma dgos pa'i phebs sgo bzhin mkhan po dang rdzong sdod la yig rgya zhib 'thems byas pa ltar bu lugs pa rnams kyi dbang mkhan chen kun spangs pa chen po dang /zha lu'i chen slob chos 'chad gsum bcas pas gtsug dgu dang 'od zer can ma gtogs sar dang gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug ngor pa'i lhag sa lugs dbang bka' rnams 'jam —577

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lokyemagon sa skya pa chen pos gsos/ sa skya nas ma gsan gshis sgrol ma bcu bdun ma gur par rje nyid kyis gnang / zha lu pa tshor klu sgrub lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs chos rje bco brgyad pa dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi rab 'byams pa chos rje rin cen rgya mchos mdzad pas/ phyag chen thig ler/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir la mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /zhes pa'i 'jigs pa las grol zhing deng sang bstan pa rma med du gsos pa'ang khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po'i bka' drin no/ /slar sa skyar phebs chos bka' phar 'bul (47ba〉tsur zhu du ma mdzad/ sngar e waṃ chos ldan du nyes med phun tshogs ldan du nyes med phun tshogs thon na'ang chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa nas brgyud pa'i ri bong cal sgrog gis smig rgyus bslad pa sel phyir gong dkar du mtshungs med dge pa'i dbang por tshar gcig gsan mod lha khang chen mo'i mkhan por kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho nas brgyud pa zhig yod 'dug par brten dge bsnyen nas bzung pa snyen rdzogs kyi bar bsgrub pa gnang /chu glang zha lur phebs te ring zhig nas dbus su chibs kha bskyod tshong dpon bsod nams mgon po la skor gcig gong dkar du phebs pa 'gab tshul gyi yi ge phul ba dkyil du 'byor ba'i thog chos sder bzhugs/ zhag shas nas sku bad sogs bsnyun ro sna tshogs langs pa'i 'phrod bsten gyi skabs mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab rgan gra'i chu tshan la phyin pa'i lam zhor phyag 'bul la yongs skabs phebs bzhed yod tshul gyi gsung gleng mjad 'dug pa ltar 'gyangs med yar phebs pa lcags zam du zhabs 'bam langs 'phrod bsten du drung 'tsho ba sum dga' btang ba sku la 'phrod ngo che bar byung / de bar lcags zam rje drung la ljags lung mang du stsal zhing phar yang pad+ma bka' thang dang grub thob chen po'i rnam thar sogs gsan/hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu la khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po chu bo ri nas phebs/ zhag shas rdzong du bzhugs gser gyi khu bas bris pa'i 'phags pa brgyad stong pa'i glegs bam lo sngon ma tsho phyag mdzod —578

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanabasod nams rin cen gyis do dam byas gsar du bzhengs pa nged la ster ba gnang dge ba bsngo ba'i smon lam rtsoms shig ces bka' stsal ba'ang bris/ nyang gi brag dmar rdo rje spyi blugs/ (48na)tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi dbang dang thang lha'i rigs gtad gter ston rin po che dang lhan du phul/ sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyis mdzad pa'i drug cu pa lcags mkhar dgu pa'i lung phyag len zhib 'khrid/ des mdzad pa'i drag po'i spyin sreg paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags kyisamadzad pa'i lhag bsam rab dkar gyi dri lan rnams kyi lung zhus/ nged rang dang sde pa phyogs mthun du tshe mtha' yas pa'i cho ga la brten nas ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung mdzad/ sku'i 'phrod bsten du 'ol dga'i chab tshan la phebs pa'i dgos cha rnams gra bsgrigs/ chab tshan sku la shin tu 'jug pa'i zhan byung rdzing phyi'i byams pa mjal ba gnang nas tshur phebs pa dang sde pa shin tu bsnyun pa gnyis 'grig par byang gter lcags sdang ma'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa stsal ba byin rlabs kyi rten 'brel 'grig /dgun dpyid kyi ring da pa la grogazhis khar stan chags/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po che/ chos rje bco brgyad pa/ gter ston rigasa'adzin chen po rnams la tshe dbang gi rim pa gsan/ de phyin sku mtshams ngos 'jigs byed ra lugs kyi sgrub mchod dang mthun par tshor dril bu lha lnga'i mngon dkyil gyi thugs rtsom gnang / chu stag sos nas char chu che ba byung na gzims khang thang khyad nas lho mos su spo pa mdzad/hor zla bdun pa'i nang du chos rje bco brgyad pa/ gnas gsar dpon rin po che/ 'dar pa chos mdzad blo gsal bstan 'dzin sogs don gnyer can 'ga' zhig la brag rdzong ma phyi nang gsang gsum/rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa'i gsang 'khrid mgon po zhal gyi phyi nang gi 'khrid/ rnam sras lnga phrag lnga'i rjes gnang / gur 'kha dang rnam sras (48ba)kyi be'u bum rags rim gyi lung sogs dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba'i tshe gnas gsar dpon dang 'dar pa chos mdzad la phogs/chos rje bco brgyad par zur gsos/ dbang chos gnang ba'i phyag dpe sogs dgos cha mthun rkyen thams cad bsgrigs/ mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug bco brgyad chos rjer klu sgrub lugs kyi bcu gcig zhal gyi —579

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'dabang / kun mkhyen rong po/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin cen gsum gyi bka' 'bum gyi lung gsan/ zhabs drung dpon la chig brgyud ha la nag po'ang chos kyi bdag por dgongs te rdzogs par stsal/ zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'byung du bden brjod kyi tshigs bcad/ dbu zhwa nas bzhugs 'ding bar gyi na bza' yongs rdzogs/ bkra shis pa'i dar dkar dang bcas phul/skyid dpe nas dang dar mo nas sgo bstun gyis rtsa lto sbrags ma'i sku sbyongs phul bas bsnyun ro gzhi med lta bur gdangs/ nged rang gis gsar bsgrigs bde mchog la zhu dag zhib tu mdzad/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i nang du gdan sa gong nas bdag chen rin po che yab sras phebs skabs rje nyid po ta lar stan chags/ yab sras gnyis dang phyogs mtshungs su lo chen rin bzang gis spyan drangs pa'i mgon po shing drung ma dang gnam lcags rdo rje/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa dang 'phags pa rin po che gnyis kyi dbu thod/ sa paṇa gyi zhun thigs 'jam dbyangs seng zhen/ slob dpon pad+ma'i phyag gi pad phur khams gsum rnam rgyal dang bsnyen phur chu bo gyen bzlog /mkhar chen bza'i phyag rdor tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i sku sham la 'dra sku bris pa (49na sgoms kyi mjal kha phul/ bdag chen yab sras bsam yas su chibs kha bsgyur nas nged rang gis 'jigs byed rwa lugs lha bcu gsum ma dang / klu sgrub lugs kyi bcu gcig zhes gyi dbang sogs chos bka' kha yar zhus/ khyab bdag bla ma gtsang la phebs/ tshar pa sna'i lam dog sar rta rgyag po zhig khal bskyur nas 'ur ba dpon slob tsho'i steng du mchongs stabs su 'ongs pa sga 'gyur pa'i bug pa la lag pa gnyis 'gyus te bkyig pa ltar gyur/ de min chag grums chen po yong nyen pa bzlog pa'ang rje nyid kyi thugs rje dang rdo rje'i chos srung rnams kyi nus mthu'o/ /dpal 'khor chos sder phebs nyin sa zhal gyi gra gtsang rnams kyis chibs bsu rin lding pa sger gyis thabs su zha lu'i mkhan po rnams kyi sol rgyun bzhin gling gseb tu chibs ma gzhol bar gur khang du phebs nas gzhis len bzabs/ sku mtshams shin tu dam pas rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ljags bsnyen btsugs/ 'di nas brtag pa phul ba'i don bzhin rin lding gra tshang du tshe chog brgya —580

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ 6)rtsa dang 'chi blu tshar lnga bcu/ chos sde spyi dang sger du gur pa rin lding pa gnyis la mang ja rnam gzhag rgyas par mdzad/ bka' las/ sa skya zhabs drung phebs pa'i rnam g.yeng tsam ma gtogs bla ma thugs rje can gyi bka' drin la gnas khang skyid pa chu 'phrod pa thugs dam 'phel ba/ khams bzang ba bde zhing skyid pa byung lags/ sa skya zhabs drung gi phebs sgor nged tsho yongs pas thugs dam la thugs sun ma byung ngam gsung ba 'jigs byed la bsnyen pa byas pas 'jam dbyangs sprul pa dang mjal ba bsnyen rtags su 'gro mod zhus zhes gsungs/ gdan sa gong gi zhabs drung rin po che (49ba)gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gsan rgya 'dug na'ang gsung ngag slob bshad kyi 'khrid lung tsam las ma byung 'dug pa bstan rgyun la dgongs nas gsan dgos pa'i snyan 'bul phul ba bla chen spyi rigs kyi bzang brdzu lug pa sbos pa lta bu'i stong ldir mi gnang par dgongs par bstad song ba bzhin dpon slob gnyis la legs so'i zhu mchid dang mgon khang tshor 'phrin bcol gyi snyan dar sogs skad gnyis smra bar phul ba/ bka' las/dbon po lo tsā ba la thugs dam bka' shog rin po che byi ba la glang chen sbrang bu la mkha' lding / phyug po'i bu la rnam thos sras su bsngags pa lta bu'i gsung rdo rje'i tshig gnang sbyin gya nom pa dang bcas spyi bor phebs pa dang lhan du gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya'i mgon khang so sor snyan dar 'phrin bcol/ rigs ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje gong bzhugs rin po cher yang bsngags brjod gnang cha dang bcas phebs pa bzhin zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la shab la phyin zhes gsung ba ltar gdan sa bar dge sdings bkra shis bsam grub tu 'jam mgon sa skya pa chen po'i zhabs phyir gnas gsar zhabs drung dbon sogs don gnyer can du ma la gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad btsugs pa snang gsum grol mtshams bdag chen rin po che phur sgrub la chibs kha sgyur/ rje nyid ljags bsnyen kha gso'i skabs bdud rigs kyi 'tshub ltongs kyis sku ltem babs shin tu lci ba byung ba'i tshe nub kyi mnal lam du bud med lus thog tshad gang tsam pa gtsang mo'i gos rgyan lam tsam byas pa brjid chags pa de'i g.yas dpon sa rgyal mtshan ba/ dpon sa tshe brtan pa/ /bud med gzhan zhig dang (50na)'khor 'ga' 'dug pas —581 —

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6'phyag 'tshal zhing dpon sa rgyal mtshan pas dar dkar po 'bul tshad tshad byed pa byung bar bstan srung ma chen mo'i cho 'phrul du dgongs/ re zhig chos mtshams mi gnang ka med nas zha lur phebs gnas tshul skyel bar dpon po lo tsā ba byung bar sku rim gyi brtag babs sogs rgyu mtshan gyi zhib cha phul/ dpon tshang skyid dpe bas zhal skyugs thengs gnyis drangs pas bde skyid che nges byung /bsam yas su gsol mchod gnang dgos gdan sa gong gi sne sbyor bka' shog dang bcas rdor legs pa zla ba bdun pa'i mjug tu 'byor/ bsam yas su chos rje rkan phu ba rdzong bda' byed kha dang 'grig pas gsol chas bka' shog sogs bskur nas rdor legs pas 'di khar khri phebs khyad nas bsdad/ sku rim thebs su nas khal nyis brgya dngul srang bco lnga dang re zhig dbus la phebs pa bar chad chung ngo shar ba sku khams kyi nam lcogs la byon nas 'gab pa'i phebs lan ngag ma bcas rdor legs brdzangs/hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig la khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po phebs zhag bzhi'i bar rdzong du bzhugs/ de nas lho mos su bcad rgya dam par gnang / de yang tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros kyis/mkhas pa'i yul sar mkhas pa'i gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ /chen po'i mdun sar chen po'i gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ /blun po'i mdun sar grong pa'i tshig gis dga' ba bskyed/ e ma rmongs pa'i mdun sar chal chol gtam gyis dga' ba bskyed/ /ces gang zag so so'i blo dang mthun par la jug pa zhig ma gtogs brjod pa mtha' dag rna bar mi (50ba)'bab pa'o/ /tshogs bshad za zi'i sbyor ba dang mdo sngags kyi 'khrid phyogs re tsam don du gnyer pa'i skye bo rnams kyi blor chud dka' bas/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya 'a paṇ+ḍa tas/ lung bzang 'dab ma'i khur gyis lci gyur cing / /dri med rig pa'i ze'u 'bru mdzes pa can/ /don bzang sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyi za ma tog /blo gsar bung ba 'du ba'i dga' ston yin/ /zhes rin po che lta bu'i gdul bya mchag kho na'i spyod yul du gyur pa'ang ji skad du/ /yon tan ldan pa yon tan la dga' zhing / /yon tan med pa yon tan la mi dga'/ /nags kyi bung ba mtsho yi pad+ma dga'/ /sbal —582

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ (tanapa lhan cig gnas kyang de lta min/ /zhes sbal pa pad+ma dang bskal bar 'grogs kyang dga' bar mi sems shing bung ba nags klung du sdod kyang / /pad+ma'i bcud myang ba la brtson pa ltar nā lan+da nas rgyud sde rgya mtshor mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs bco brgyad chos rje byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba'i dpon gnas gsar zhabs drung nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ lcags zam chos rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun sum tshogs/ 'dar pa rje drung blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ drung yig 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ mchod dpon rin cen 'jam dpal sogs don gnyer can nyi shu skor la hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer lnga nas chos 'khor bskor ba'ang tshar chen gyi gsung mgur las/ nyams len gdams pa'i gtso bo ni/ /rgyal yum bdag med mkha' 'gro la/ /paṇa grub dbang po bi rū pas/ /nos pa nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod du/ /dbang bzhi'i chu bo ma nus pa'i/ /bla ma'i gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan dbang bzhi'i (51na〉pam/ /rdo rje theg pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes bdag med rdo rje btsun mos mkhas grub kyi gtsug rgyan dpal ldan chos skyong la gnang ba nas bzung zab chos dbang gi chu bo ma nub cing snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs gdung brgyud rim par chig brgyud du byin pa gsung ngag rin po che slob bshad kyi dbang 'khrid lung byin rlabs rnams gegs med du shin tu smin par stsal ba'i rgyun nub pa med pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo phun sum tshogs pa ni dpal mgon stobs 'phrog dbang po dang las mgon pu tra chen po gnyis kyis 'phrin las bsgrubs par gor ma chag /chos zhu ba rnams kyis sgrol dkar gyi tshe chog 'chi blu dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs phul zhing dpon slob so so nas chos skyong rnams la gtang rag dang tshogs mchod rgyas par mdzad do/ /rtsa chen bla ma'i snyan brgyud bdud rtsi sogs/ /smin grol lung gi bgrangs yas sgo phye tshe/ khyab bdag rdo rje sems dngos zha lu par/ /nges rnyed gzhan du 'tshol ba'i spros pa bcad/ /'khon ston 'jam dpal rdo rje yab sras nas/ /rigs kyi bdag por bkur pa'i che chugs gzhu/ /dman 'gror rjesabartse'i rgyud kyis rab bkug pa'o/ /lhag bsam mar me mdzad dpal tshul la 'gran/ /mdo rgyud gdams383

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ lo2)pa'i tshong zong rin cen dpya/ /ris med gzhan la gtong dang sa nga nyid kyis/ /blangs nas lung rtogs nor bu'i blo gros mdzod/ /yongs su gang byed ded dpon gzhan na ci/ /thub bstan srog zungs 'dzin khyod zil mngar bcud/ /phrog bdud snga phyir langs pa'i sgra gcan mgrin/ /mchog gsum thugs rje bskul dang drang srong gi /dmod dbal rdo rje srin po'i (51bstakhor los bcad/ / sbyor ga yun du zhen pa'i bsnyun gyi dri/ /ma dag zug rngu 'byin pa'i mtho ris chu/ /'dren pa'i ro nus sbyor sde 'phrul po che/ /byed po lha yi sman pa tha skar skyes/ /blo gros rab yangs rkyen gyis mi g.yo brtan/ /kun bzang mchod pa mtha' klas dkyil 'khor la/ /spro ba'i dbang gi rgyun nyams slar gso ba/ /bstan la gcig tu che ba'i mdzad pa'i phul/ /ma dang mkha' 'go'i kha rlangs /spyi ra'i/ /gzegs ma phyogs brgyar 'phro ba gsar pa'i gter/ /mi bsun 'byung pa'i tsha ngad yongs bcil ba/ /gan jag thang ta'i rnam par sprul las ba 'kho/ /chas dkon zab don snod du rigs sad par/ /snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan gsungs pa'i mod/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i bden tshig glu/ /len zhing srid mthar 'phel ba'i shis pa brjod//de ltar rje 'di nyid kyis dam pa'i chos gsan pa dang gar thig dbyangs skar rtsis sogs gnas kyi slob dpon rags rim gong du gsal ba bzhin dang / gzhan yang rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod rnams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug /'brug pa zhabs drung bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'brug pa sprul sku rin po che blo bzang mi pham dbang phyug /ngam ring mkhan chen klu sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ zha lu mkhan po nam mkha' chos ldan/ chos lung mkhan chen thug po pa lung rigs kun dga' rgya mtsho/ bzang ldan mkhan po rgyal rtse ba kun dga' bsod namasagrags pa/ bsam sdings sprul sku bde chen mtsho mo/ lcog gra sprul sku ngag dbang snyan grags bzang po/ /(52na༄kha bdag sman lung pa blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rje/ chos rje dkon gnyer dpon dge steng pa byamasapa kun dga' 'byung gnas/ mnga' ris 'od gsal mchog /dgon pa sgyi lung ba sngags 'chang skyo ston dpal 'byor tshe brtan khang rnying slob dpon dge slong bsam gtan/ sde pa gnas gsar pa nam mkha'i —584

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtanamatshan can/ kun mkhyen dpal bzang dbang po/ /bla chen sa shrī/ zha lu bla chen rin cen 'od zer/ rasachen kun dga' lha dbang / khro phu dus zhabs pa dpal rgyas dbang po/ khang rnying slob dpon rin cen tshul khrims/ rtse chen dus 'khor slob dpon chos kyi rje bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ snar thang paṇa chen gragasapa dpal 'byor/ mnga' ris rgyal tshab pa brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ lho stod sde pa dbyangs can spobs pa bzang po/ ri khrod dbu mdzad bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ grub chen bkra shis don grub/ bla ma rin po che bsam grub rgyal mtshan/ mnga' ris phyag rdor ba sogs mang du snang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor pa'i slob ma'i grangs ches mang na'ang rags rim tsam brjod na rje btsun sa skya ba ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug yab sras/ khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ glang phu chos rje rin po che/ rgyal rtse zhabs drung byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bzang ldan mkhan po rgyal rtse kun dga' bsod nams grags pa/ tshogs bye rdzing mkhan po sangs rgyas bzang po/ lcags zam sprul sku/ lha khang mkhan chen/ lo phu mkhan chen byams pa ngag dbang (52ba)dpal bzang / bco brgyad chos rje byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub khu dpon/ gnas gsar zhabs drung dbon nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ khyab bdag khra tshang ba chen po/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa/ mtshan sgrog mkhan po ngag dbang 'phrin las/ sger pa rje drung ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs/ chos rje dkon gnyer dpon dge steng pa byams pa kun dga' 'byung gnas/ ngor nas mkhan sgrub khang pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/mkhan dpal gling pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan thar rtse pa/ shar pa klu sdings ye shes pa/ sgrub khang dpon po shākya don grub/ thar rtsed bon po/ zha lu nas mkhan po sku zhang / slob dpon rin cen tshul khrims/ bla chen dge 'dun dpal bzang / dus 'khor slob dpon bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ dkar po slob dpon klu sgrub rgyal mtshan/ ri phug dbu mdzad sangs rgyas 'od zer/ khang rnying slob dpon mkhyen rab rab brtan/ rab rgyas slob dpon rin cen chos 'phel/ grang chen slob dpon blo bzang bkra shis/dkar po slob dpon mkhyen rab dar rgyas/ bla chen rin cen phun tshogs/ bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho/—585

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ 6sedabye dmar bla ma sangs rgyas chos 'phel/ gong dkar chos sde nas/ gra thang mkhan po 'phrang 'go sde pa chos rje/ slob dpon rnam mkhyen grong pa/ nam mkha' mdzod pa/ mtshungs med nyi ma gling pa/ kun bzang rtse pa dpal ldan tshul khrims/ mkhas grub dge ba'i dbang po/ bla ma rab 'byams pa rin cen rgya mtsho/mkhas pa'i dbang po dge slong 'phrin las pa/ dpon slob rig pa rnam (53na)rgyal/ bla ma rnam rgyal bkra shis/ theg mchog gling pa dge slong 'jam dbyangs sogs chos 'chad pa/ dpal 'khor chos sde nas/ lha bo slob dpon bkra shis rgya mtsho/ gser bkang slob dpon dga' bde nas/ cho se 'khor slob dpon mkhas mchog bstan pa'i sgron me/ rin lding slo dpon kun dga' byams pa dang rin cen bzang po/ byams chen slob dpon/ gur pa slob dpon rnams dang / gzhan yang dga' ldan gsung rab gling slob dpon gnas lnga rig pa gung thang pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ skyed tshal 'og mkhan po khyung / 'dzam gling chos 'khor gyi bla ma/ 'ba' ra sprul sku/ g.yu mtsho sku skye/ dbye khang bla ma mnga' bdag pa/ 'dar pa rje drung blo gsal bstan 'dzin/ snye mo ru'i mkhan po rgyal ma pa/ khro phu dus zhabs pa/ rgyal byed tshal bshad grwa'i bla ma/ lho stod pa dbyangs can spobs pa bzang po/ mnga' ris phyag rdor pa/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan/ mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab/ dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ dpal grong sngags rams pa/ dpon tshang dar mo ba/ drung yig 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin/ 'bras spungs bsam blo rab stims pa spyin pa/ dge slong bkra shis don grub/ ma ṇi ba rin cen dga' ldan sogs ches mang /thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i gzims chung dang sbrags pa'i ri phug gi thang kha chos khri la gser gyi rgya phibs dgos tshul phebs nan bzhin rgyug mtho bco brgyad kyi khyon tshad grub par nye skabs dang / sdom gsum du/ so so thar pa'i bstan pa ni/ /nub kyang gzugs (53ba〉brnyan tsam zhig snang / /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa ni/ /gzugs brnyan tsam yang mi snang ngo / /zhes deng sang rgyud sdo bzhi'i smin grol mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ni shin tu dkon zhing bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'gor 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rin cen bzang po sogs kyi bka' drin las rnal 'byor rgyud dar rgyas che ba rim gyis —586

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ rtana'agrib par nye ba na/ kun mkhyen bu ston gyis bstan pa gso bar bzhed nas yig 'jog dang phyag len gtso bor mdzad cing / mkhyen rab chos rjes nga dga' ldan nas rgyal ba bu ston chos rjes rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa spel bar btang pa yin te lag rjes blo kha rdzogs pa zhig ma byung / chos rjes drung du rnal 'byor rgyud la bya ba byas tshul zhun 'gro dgos pa yod na'ang / ngo gnong ba las med gsung ba rnam thar du gsal zhing / khyab bdag bka' 'gyur pa chen pos/ rnal 'byor rgyud 'di phyag len dka' la dkon pa 'dug pas dar zhing rgyas pa zhig byung na bsams gong dkar chos sder yo ga sgrub mchod nyin gcig spar thub/ da zha lur rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum bo sgo bzhi'i phyag len gar dbyangs rgyas pa zhig tshugs la re yin zhes rje 'di nyid la gsung gleng byung ba sogs la brten bstan pa'i 'phel rgyas dang bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pa skong byed rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum po khro spro gar dbyangs sogs cha tshang ba'i steng 'jigs byed dang gnas bcu mchod pa gnyis bsnan te khag bco lnga nyin bco lnga'i bar gyi sgrub mchod rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar ba khu dbon dang mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyi dgongs rdzogs/ dam pa nyid kyis lam gyi bogs 'don pa'i tshogs gsog la dgongs te (54na〉bkras btags/ rnam rgyal gyi mchod rten/ sku ber legs pa/ kha thi dmar ser dang rgyan bzhi sogs gos yug lnga/ maṇ+ḍal mdong mo lnga bcu ma bcas khyon bsdoms dngul srang sum brgya/ rta lnga/ dre'u gnyis/ ras dkar yug rnams kyi rten spams mtho ba dang bcas bka' nan lci ba sa 'byed kyi sgo dod pas yo ga'i bstan pa la lo tsā ba chen po rin cen bzang po slar yang byon pa lta bur snang / gsung ngag rin po che grub nas deng sang sku ngal gso ba dang sbrags gsan yig bsgrigs pa gnang skabs yin zhing / rdo rje'i khri la g.yo ba med par bzhugs te dam pa'i cho so kyi 'phrin las gdul bya'i rgyud la chad pa med par 'jug pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel lhun gyisagrub bzhin pa 'di ltar lags so/ /a ho dam pa'i yon tan nam mkha'i tshad/ /'jal ba'i dka' thub mes pos bskal ba brgyar/ /—587

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ ()blangs kyang pha mtha' ma rnyed zag bcas kyi//gnyis la g.yur na bdag blo phra mos ci//ngo mtshar mdzad pa mang po'i tshig tshogs kyi//phang phung lo mas don gyi ze'u 'bru sgrib//thun mong 'gro ngor smin pa'i 'bras bu'i bcud//myangs na gzur gnas ljags kyi dbang po tshim//sangs rgyas sras bcas phyogs der bsngags pa yi//bsod nams phung po zad mtha' grangs yas na//gdan gsum tshang ba'i sde dpon rtogs brjod glu//blangs 'dis bskal gsum tshogs rnams dang 'dums snyam//ma dag 'khor ba mtha' bral tshang tshing nags//mi dge rnam smin gcan gzan rgyu ba'i srang //mu med las sgrol bshes gnyen bka' drin gyis//me tog mda' can g.yul de gcig tu pham//gaṅgā'i rdul gyis mtshon min 54basprul ba'i lus/pus po'i lha nga sa rabatsugs gus phyag 'tshal//phyi nang gsang mchod blo 'das rang semasangor//yongs lod nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar dbye//sdig lhung mtshan gyi smag rum sto mes bzhi yi//gsar pa'i skya rengs kyis bsangs snying nas bshags//theg gsum skye 'phags yongs kyis byas so cog/ston zla'i mdangs 'dzin dge la lhag par rangs//bgrang yas rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i chos 'khor kun//thub bstan de srid bar du bskor bar bskul//mgon khyod nges pa lnga ldan longs sku bzhin//bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs//'dis mtshon rnam smin dkar por bsags pa'i las/ma lus mu mtha' yas pa'i sems can tshogs//byang chub 'god ched rdo rje'i slob dpon zhabs//g.yung drung lta bur mi g.yo'i rgyu ru bsngo//dpyad gsum kun nas dag pas yid ches gnas//gnas lugs gsong por brjod pa 'khrul bral tshig/tshig don lung rigs 'brel 'di blo ldan tshogs//tshogs kyi dbus su dga' ba'i gtam du long //zab zab rtogs par dka' ba'i rnam par thar//snyan snyan brling po'i sdeb sbyor nyer spangs te/yang yang rang gi yid la goms pa tsam/gsal gsal mchog dman yongs la phan phyir bkod//legs byas phung por spungs 'dis yang srid kun//dge ba'i bshes gnyen mu thi la yi char//rtag tu babs nas gtan mdun zla bzhin ma//'grub pa'i bskal ba bzang por tsor bar shog / 88

zha lu lo chen rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar/ lhan ces gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje'i slob dpon mkhan chen zha lu pa tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i rnam par thar pa dpyod ldan yid (55na skobang 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu 'di ni mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug bco brgyad chos rje byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub lha rigs 'a zha'i rdo rje 'dzin pa nam mkha' bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ lcags zam chos rje ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs gsum gyis gsung ngag brgyud pa'i kha skong la rtsoms shig par bskul ma mdzad pas mtshams sbyar rang nyid kyang mchog tu dad pa'i spro ba chen pos kun nas bslangs te rje bla mas reg zig tu mdzad pa la gzhi byas 'phags pa'i yul du ā na la zhes me dang / mang bkur rgyal po'i khab tu bing shing zhes g.yu 'brug gos dmar can gyi lo chu stod zla ba'i shes rab kyi cha'i bzang po gnyis pa pa sangs nam gru'i khrub sbyor gyi dus dge bar za hor gyi rigs las lo rgyus smra ba'i na pa 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du 'bod pas pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtshos bgyis pa phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu la bhā bha ( / /maṅga lo// //—589

〈gangs can khyad nor 〉 dpe tshogs chen mo'i bsdu sgrig dang las zhugs mi sna'i mtshan tho/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gtso bo/ blo bzang lhun grub/ dbang grags/ tshe ring /bsdu sgrig 'gan 'dzin pa gzhen pa/ blo bzang stobs bcu/ phur bu chos 'phel/las zhugs mi sna/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ rgyal mtshan byams pa/ grags pa kun ldan/ tshe brtan rdo rje/blo bzang 'phags mchog /snyan grags/ blo bzang 'jigs med/ tshe ring ma/byams pa brtson 'grus/ rdo rje mtsho/ spen pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ lha skyid/lhag pa sgrol ma/ bsod nams dbyangs can/deb 'di'i zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ blo bzang chos 'byor/ phur bu chos 'phel/glog 'phrul yig 'jug pa/ lhag pa sgrol ma/ bsod nams dbyangs can/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ byams pa brtson 'grus/
